name: Bottomless
brief:
Product: Bottomless
One-liner: Building the first sensor enabled marketplace for repeat purchases
Industry: Consumer / Food and Beverage
Tags: Marketplace, IoT
target:
How it works

How do you like your coffee?

Build your own coffee rotation

Pricing

Roasted to order from partners across the U.S.

Customer reviews

Frequently asked questions

Start by taking a quiz to find your perfect coffee rotation. We'll send you a Bottomless scale with your first order. Store your coffee on the scale, and it will reorder your next bag at the perfect time.

Our rotation engine is the most advanced ever built. You can specify almost any possible coffee configuration, and we pick the perfect coffee for you based on your location, preferences and ratings.

We have an online store featuring a variety of roasters. If you like consistency, you can pick a specific coffee to be reordered repeatedly. If you like variety, you can choose one of our rotations or create your own based on your preferences. Change the products linked to your account at any time.

Membership costs $7.99/month and includes the scale and unlimited shipping. Additionally, you'll get 20% off your first bag and a 10% discount off each subsequent order.

Signing up for a Bottomless membership directly offers you access to our full marketplace and a customized rotation of different brands for a monthly fee. Signing up with a brand gives you access to Subscribe by Usage with one brand at no additional cost.

Yes, you will get an SMS or email alert 8-12 hours before reorders are placed, giving you a chance to change your product, postpone, or cancel. You can also customize the "eagerness" of the algorithm by opting for "never running out," "just right shipments," or "prioritizing freshness."

Yes! The scale can easily be "zeroed" with almost any home coffee container or jar.

A ton of our customers do this. It works perfectly fine, just pour less than half a bag into the hopper at a time.

Try Bottomless for 30 days

name: Torus
brief:
Product: Torus
One-liner: Legora for physical engineering firms
Description: Torus lets engineering firms and project owners build infrastructure 10x faster to reindustrialize America and the West. We're working with multiple Fortune 500 companies to build critical infrastructure including data centers and critical energy installations.
Industry: Industrials
Tags: Construction, Energy, Enterprise Software, AI, Industrial
target:
Agents that think in P&IDs , HMBs , and spec sheets .

Torus's AI agents understand every parameter across your specs, drawings, and datasheets. They cross-reference every detail and adapt to how your firm works.

Engineering intelligence

Upload documents. Torus extracts every parameter, maps cross-document relationships, and flags what doesn't match. Engineers see consistency flags. PMs see workflow automation. Same project, same data.

Beyond a chatbot

Most AI tools for engineering are just chatbots. You upload a document, ask a question, get an answer. One document. One question. One answer. That's not how engineering works.

Every spec, drawing, and datasheet cross-referenced at once, and the follow-up already drafted in your firm's format. Every value that has to agree with another value has a check with a name: relief set point against design pressure, transformer rating against connected load, code edition against project spec. More than fifty categories, and each flag carries the rule that fired. The labels on the plant are the checks that apply to each piece of equipment.

Autonomous follow-up

Across the whole thread

It's hard to build in America.

The projects are getting bigger and the teams aren't. Every substation, pipeline, and treatment plant runs on thousands of documents across dozens of firms. When a design pressure in the process datasheet doesn't match the piping spec, it's a $500K rework order caught too late.

Torus gives every engineer the capacity of a team.

You stay in control of your data.

Two ways to run Torus. You pick how much stays inside your walls.

Making engineers formidable.

Built by engineers who have delivered capital projects and AI researchers who have shipped frontier autonomous systems. Not a chatbot: the agentic layer that reads a project, keeps it consistent, and drafts it.

Gradient is everything.

Join the mission. Open roles in engineering, software, and operations.

See Torus on your project.

Send us 5-6 documents from a current project. We'll show you what Torus finds in 15 minutes.

brief:

Industry: B2B / Human Resources
Tags: SaaS, B2B, HR Tech
target:
People analytics, workforce planning & HCM

Your org changed this morning. Your spreadsheet didn't.

Most HR systems store your data. ChartHop puts it to work — connecting your people and business data into a living model of your organization, so you can see what's changing, model what's next, and act on it in the same place.

ChartHop, the organizational intelligence company: HCM, planning, analytics, agentic AI.

Hundreds of companies plan, lead and grow their teams on ChartHop.

Connect people decisions to business outcomes.

Organizational intelligence is everything HR runs, connected to your business data in a living model: HRIS, headcount planning, compensation, performance, engagement, goals, analytics and agentic AI.

HRIS →

One home for people data, org charts and the tools your team actually uses.

Headcount Planning →

HR and Finance plan headcount together, without the spreadsheet handoff.

Compensation →

Fair, transparent, budget-aware pay cycles.

Performance →

Integrated cycles people actually complete.

Engagement →

Sentiment data that shows how teams are really doing, by manager and level.

Goals →

Goals that track against live business data.

Analytics →

Board-ready answers in a single click.

Agentic AI →

Agents that watch what matters and act on it.

Start with the systems you already run

ChartHop connects ADP, Greenhouse, Workday, SAP, and 100+ HRIS, ATS, FP&A, and business tools into a living model of your organization. No rip-and-replace, and no new silo to maintain.

Software everyone loves

Ask ChartHop AI anything. Then let its agents do the work for you.

Every answer comes from a living model of your actual organization. So does every action.

Get answers in seconds, not days

Ask in plain English and get an answer drawn from your whole org — people, cost and output — with links back to the source.

Create dashboards, comp cycles, surveys and headcount plans from chat, instead of waiting on an admin to configure them.

Access Guard

People, agents and outside assistants see only what the person they're acting for is allowed to see — so leaders get self-serve answers without exposing comp or performance. Your data never trains outside models.

name: Corelayer
brief:
Product: Corelayer
One-liner: AI production engineer for regulated industries
Description: Corelayer is the AI-native platform for production software support, built for regulated industries like finance and healthcare. It continuously monitors alerts, logs, infrastructure, and underlying data for issues and uses agents to debug and suggest fixes. We're helping SRE, production services, and on-call engineers at companies ranging from growth-stage fintechs to Fortune 500 financial institutions spend less time on support and more on high-leverage work.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, B2B, Enterprise Software, AI
target:
Production on autopilot

Proactive incident response and prevention for complex production environments.

Trusted by engineering teams from the growth stage to the enterprise

How Corelayer extracts signal from messy production systems

Infrastructure that enables agents to reason over enterprise-scale production environments.

Proactively monitors your environment

Ingests alerts, exceptions, and anomalies from across your stack, with sub-agents filtering noise and false positives.

Maintains a rich context graph

Explores your environment, observes failure patterns, and learns from engineers — purpose-built for causal reasoning across production.

Escalates what actually matters

Applies your team's definition of business-critical to group related issues and summarize impact and blast radius.

How Corelayer fits into your workflow

Everyone works differently. Designed to adapt to your setup.

CLI & MCP

Give your coding agents production context to inspect, summarize, and fix open issues.

Use corelayer preflight to give your coding agent rich context like learned system patterns and known failure modes so it can catch potential issues before they break prod.

Browser

Visualize what's going on in production at a glance, validate and continue agent investigations, and inspect the context graph.

Slack & Teams

Get notified on critical issues, run ad-hoc investigations, and ask anything about production.

Designed for the most sensitive environments

Deploy Anywhere

Deploy in your own cloud or on-prem, so data never leaves your environment.

Data & Model Control

Zero data retention by default, with BYOK and custom gateway support.

Enterprise-Grade

SSO, RBAC, SCIM provisioning, audit logs, and dedicated support.

SOC 2 Type II compliant.

We're building a fundamentally new way to understand your production environment. Agents that proactively root-cause and prevent incidents with superhuman understanding of your systems and organization. Agents that only surface genuine issues that actually matter to your users. We're building the infrastructure to make this possible in the world's most critical production environments.

Corelayer is built for data-intensive teams , with anomaly detection for silent data issues and agents that securely query underlying data while debugging.

Corelayer is designed for regulated environments , with BYOC and on-prem support, custom PII masking, and secure inference options like confidential compute.

But don't take it from us…

I've tried literally every AI SRE product… Corelayer is very impressive.

The only product I've seen that's been able to catch and fix Heisenbugs.

Corelayer is seriously saving me right now.

name: Monte
brief:
Product: Monte
One-liner: Continual Learning for Agents
Description: Monte is an applied research lab building products for continual learning and recursive self-improvement for AI agents.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Reinforcement Learning, B2B, Infrastructure, AI
target:
Monte Specialized Agents Trained on Your Work

The post-training and continual learning layer for proprietary intelligence. Research-first, embedded with your team.

About

Monte helps companies turn general models into specialized agents that continuously learn from organizational knowledge.

Today's AI applications are general and static . While foundation models become increasingly capable, they fail to specialize to your work and don't learn from how you use them — so every interaction starts from zero. Meanwhile, as token costs climb, companies pay more each day for generic intelligence not built for them .

The future of software is specific and adaptive . The best systems will not just execute work — they will learn from it , measure themselves against real workflows, and improve from experience.

Monte's researchers work directly with your team to build evaluation, memory, and post-training systems around your real workflows. Our platform turns organizational knowledge into proprietary intelligence you own .

Build intelligence that compounds .

Capture

Extract signal from real work.

Traces, outcomes, policies, and expert judgment become training signal for continual learning.

Measure

Evaluate against reality.

Build measurements around the workflows, constraints, edge cases, and standards the system has to meet in production.

Train

Tailor intelligence to the work.

Use reinforcement learning to shape agents around the company's tools, processes, and goals.

Compound

Keep learning after launch.

Build memory and route outcomes, feedback, and production data back into training, so models keep improving through experience.

Our Team

Monte is built by three Harvard graduates in computer science, statistics, and physics, with backgrounds in AI/RL research at Harvard, MIT Lincoln Lab, and NASA JPL. We've shipped agents, trained models, and built the infrastructure behind systems that learn continuously in production. We're backed by Y Combinator.

name: Who LetEmily is for
brief:
Product: Who LetEmily is for
Description: LetEmily is built for managers who care about the people they lead and have more context than they can hold: team leads, first-time managers, engineering and product managers, directors, and founders who manage directly. Here is who it suits, and who it does not.
target:
For managers who care, and are out of room to hold it all.

Who it's for

For people who lead people

First-time manager figuring it out as you go? Experienced leader with more people than working memory? Founder suddenly responsible for a team? What these have in common is wanting to develop people, in a job that fragments exactly the attention that takes.

Free forever · Cancel Pro anytime

Who is LetEmily designed for?

Managers who care about developing the people they lead, run regular 1:1s, and are responsible for a small number of individuals they know by name, and who have run out of room to hold all of it at once.

The caring part is not a flourish. Emily is built around continuity: holding what someone is working toward and picking the thread back up months later, and that is only worth anything to a manager who wants to help them get there. If 1:1s are a status meeting in your world, a shared agenda document will serve you better and cost nothing.

The rest is a narrower definition than "leaders" and deliberately so. The product assumes recurring conversations with specific people, context accumulating over months, and a real cost when your attention has to be somewhere else. If your role is closer to running a function through metrics than knowing a handful of individuals well, most of this will not land.

Is LetEmily for the manager, or for the team?

Both, though only one of them ever logs in. Emily works for the manager, from the manager's own notes, but what she is for is the growth on both sides of that relationship.

For the people you lead, it is continuity: someone who remembers what they said they wanted, builds on the last conversation, and does what they said they would do. That is most of what good management feels like from the receiving end.

For you, it is the only honest record of how you have actually been leading. Not a rating, a record. Where your attention went, which conversation you keep putting off, what you committed to and whether you closed it. Managers are usually wrong about all three, because until now nothing was writing them down.

When should someone start?

If your role is closer to running a function through metrics than knowing a handful of individuals well, most of this will not land.

Is LetEmily for the manager, or for the team?

Both, though only one of them ever logs in. Emily works for the manager, from the manager's own notes, but what she is for is the growth on both sides of that relationship.

For the people you lead, it is continuity: someone who remembers what they said they wanted, builds on the last conversation, and does what they said they would do. That is most of what good management feels like from the receiving end.

For you, it is the only honest record of how you have actually been leading. Not a rating, a record. Where your attention went, which conversation you keep putting off, what you committed to and whether you closed it. Managers are usually wrong about all three, because until now nothing was writing them down.

When should someone start?

name: Codag
brief:
Product: Codag
One-liner: The AI gateway for cheaper, faster, permissioned agents.
Description: Codag compresses tool call outputs before agents read them, which reduces token spend by 20-30% while retaining output accuracy. Govern and see analytics on agent dollars across all model providers and internal agents.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Developer Tools
target:
Cut the tool-output tax your coding agents pay

the problem

Agents are great at reasoning and terrible at reading

Tool output floods the window

Test runs, search results, file trees, logs. One big result can push out everything the agent already learned and force another expensive lap.

You pay for every byte it reads

A session makes hundreds of tool calls, and a handful carry the answer. The rest is billed input the model reads once and throws away.

one command

Set up once Go back to your agent

No wrapper command, no config files to edit, no new workflow to learn. Setup attaches the agents it detects and rolls everything back if any step fails.

codag setup

Attaches Claude Code and Codex

Sign in through the browser, or set CODAG_API_KEY for CI. Setup verifies your workspace with a live unbilled check, installs a per-user local service, and attaches the supported agents it finds.

Other tools are detected and reported, never modified. Everything is reversible with codag disable .

then nothing changes

Same agent, same prompts, same model

Your provider account, your credentials, your gateways. Model traffic goes through a local proxy on your machine directly to your provider.

Codag only changes how large tool results reach the agent. Check it any time with codag status and codag savings .

how it works

The short version up front The exact bytes on demand

Large eligible results are reduced to what the agent needs. Nothing is lost.

observe and classify

Every result is classified by kind. Unrecognized passes through untouched.

reduce what is large

Large results shrink to the failures, matches, and signal lines.

retrieve exactly, locally

Omitted bytes stay encrypted on your machine, pulled back exactly on demand.

Every token, accounted for

What your agents spent, what they would have spent, and the difference.

all metrics are counts, sizes, and decisions. never prompts, commands, paths, filenames, or output.

Questions, answered

What is Codag?

Codag is a developer tool that cuts what coding agents cost to run. It teaches agents like Claude Code and Codex to read large tool results efficiently: big outputs are cut down to the parts that matter before the agent reads them, and the exact content stays retrievable on your machine. Setup is one command.

Does Codag change my model, my agent, or my prompts?

name: s2.dev
brief:
Product: s2.dev
One-liner: API for unlimited, durable, real-time streams
Description: S2 is an API for durable streams. We make working with streaming data dead simple and reliable. The more we worked on data systems, the more we felt like there was a missing building block. The seamless experience of object storage simply did not exist for durable streams – so we set out to fix that! S2 reimagines streams as an unlimited and access-controlled web resource. Like if Kafka and S3 had a baby. - Building agents?
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Developer Tools, Open Source, API, Infrastructure, Databases
target:
Streams as a cloud storage primitive

The serverless API for unlimited, durable, real-time streams.

Used by

The missing building block

S2 is to moving data what object storage is to static data.

Like if Kafka and S3 had a baby. It turns the log into an actual web resource.

Infinite streams

Streams get a first-class treatment, so you can have any number of them, per device, per user, per session, and so on.

Append quickly

Append records atomically to the tail of a stream. Every record is durably ordered on object storage before being acknowledged.

Read from anywhere

Read efficiently from a sequence number, timestamp , or offset from the current tail. Guaranteed to be strongly consistent .

Simple, powerful API

Working with streaming data shouldn't feel exotic.

True web resources

Interact with S2 streams using REST APIs.

Granular access controls

Issue access tokens so that clients can safely and directly access streams.

Convenient CLI

A command-line interface that makes streaming data as simple as local files.

Streams on tap

Check out the applications developers are powering with S2.

Local-first and multiplayer experiences

Build stateful collaborative experiences reliably with S2. Real-time does not have to mean ephemeral. Try our multiplayer AI chat .

Agent sessions

Event sourcing for agents, with a stream per session . Branching, multi-agent coordination? Now tractable.

Real-time feeds

Broadcast data to unlimited subscribers. Let them consume from where they left off, be it seconds or days ago.

Sandbox execution events

Stream per sandbox instance for observability. Your clients can access historical and real-time events without custom proxy infra.

Built for scale

An elastic system with a focus on correctness.

Ready to start streaming?

Join developers counting on streams as a cloud storage primitive.

No credit card required · Your first stream in seconds

brief:
Product: Seeing Systems
One-liner: Modular AI-Commanded Drones for Defence
Description: We engineer inexpensive, autonomous strike drones designed to operate in the most contested combat environments on Earth! By combining true hardware modularity with an agentic control system that lowers cognitive load on operators, we enable faster upgrades, broader adoption, and more than 2x reduction in lifecycle cost.
Industry: Industrials / Defense
Tags: Hardware, Drones, Defense, AI
target:
Designing the next era of advanced defence technology.

With more than a decade of experience at the intersection of AI and robotics, we develop intelligent unmanned systems that deliver exceptional performance without unnecessary cost.

Bandit

Bandit is a cost-effective FPV platform designed for high-volume training and attritable one-way effector missions. Built for affordability, scale, and operational simplicity, it enables realistic operator development while providing a low-cost option for missions where mass and expendability are critical.

Banshee

Banshee is a modular autonomous drone platform built for contested theatres. Its fibre-optic-guided clip-in module resists jamming while maintaining precise operation. Modular radio components enable wireless use and adaptability as requirements evolve. Upgradable hardware, software, and payloads keep the system effective and relevant over time.

Aerie AI

The intelligence engine behind every complex mission. Aerie is intelligent swarm software built for multi-platform operations. It handles the complexity of coordinating multiple drones, transforming individual assets into synchronised, tactical units. Ground control software built for AI.

Intelligence.

name: Quill Bills
brief:
Product: Quill Bills
One-liner: AI-Powered Medical Billing
Description: Quill Bills is a medical billing company that works with healthcare providers to significantly lower billing costs and recover denied claims. Our platform performs much of a biller's job autonomously, and we sell this platform to private practice doctors and medical MSOs.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare IT
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Healthcare, Health Insurance, Healthcare IT, Billing
target:
Run your billing autonomously.

The AI-native RCM and practice management software for independent practices and the billers who run them.

Submit claims in days seconds .

Touch each claim twelve zero times.

Get paid in months weeks .

One pipeline, from visit to payment.

Ingest Data

Drag-and-drop paperwork or sync encounters straight from your EHR on a schedule.

Process Data

Extraction turns every page into structured data: encounters, demographics, and insurance plans.

Auto-Code

Read superbills and progress notes, then assign accurate CPT and ICD-10 codes — with your payer-specific code conversion rules applied automatically.

Verify Eligibility

Real-time 270/271 checks, payer portals, or an AI phone agent as the fallback.

Submit Claims

Clean 837Ps go out electronically in one click — solo or in bulk. Anything questionable is flagged for review, never auto-submitted blind.

Post & Reconcile

ERAs post themselves through your rules. Denials land in a workbench. Patient balances roll into statements.

Automated Claim Scrubbing

Every claim runs a full scrub before it leaves: coding checks, payer-specific rules, prior-auth flags, and a payer history scrub that compares the claim against denial patterns from your recent claims to that same payer. Hard errors block submission; warnings are one click to override.

Automatic Payment Posting

ERAs post themselves through a rules engine you control — every rule reads as a plain-English sentence, and the AI can draft one from a stuck payment. Scanned EOBs are extracted and posted the same way. Anything without a matching rule routes to review with the exact reason attached, never a silent partial post.

A Real Denial Workbench

Rejections and denials land in separate lanes with open dollars attached. Every CARC and RARC shows up in plain English, grouped by how you'd actually fix it — resubmit, appeal, rebill COB, transfer to patient, or write off. Work one claim or an entire reason bucket in bulk. AI reads each denial and recommends the next action; appeal letters print themselves.

Secondary & Tertiary, Built In

Primary, secondary, and tertiary each get their own lane. COB claims go out with every prior payer's adjudication attached and validated to the penny — a secondary can't leave until the primary's ERA is posted and the balances tie out. Crossovers are detected so you never double-bill, and open balances move between tiers (or to the patient) with one action.

Automated Patient Billing

name: Equator Therapeutics
brief:
Product: Equator Therapeutics
One-liner: We are developing a drug to burn calories and increase metabolism…
Description: We are developing a drug to increase metabolism and burn calories without exercise. Obesity and type 2 diabetes have reached epidemic proportions. There are 2.2B overweight people and 500M people with type 2 diabetes worldwide, and these numbers increase drastically every year. Existing drugs are not effective enough to reverse the trend. Our drug can solve this problem, because it addresses the root cause of metabolic disorders – the imbalance between caloric intake and expenditure.
Industry: Healthcare / Therapeutics
Tags: Biotech, Therapeutics
target:
Restoring natural heat production to treat metabolic disorders

Mitochondrial heat production for weight loss

Nearly 50% of Americans live with obesity, and the numbers keep rising

To date, treatment of obesity and metabolic disorders has focused on dieting and exercise. Yet most people who diet and exercise do not achieve sustained weight loss.

There is a third major mechanism essential for weight regulation: natural heat production, or “thermogenesis.” Thermogenesis burns calories as effectively as exercise does as we go about our usual routines. Our ancestors used thermogenesis to keep warm. But today, thermogenesis is inhibited by comfortable living temperatures.

Recent scientific breakthroughs at Equator Therapeutics have enabled pharmacological stimulation of thermogenesis to achieve sustained weight loss. We are now developing a first-in-class drug to reverse metabolic disorders.

We are targeting mitochondria – the powerhouse of the cell

Mitochondria are the organelles in our cells that burn calories to power our bodies and keep us warm. In an experimental tour de force , we measured the tiny electrical currents that mitochondria use to generate heat. This allowed us to identify and characterize the proteins responsible for these currents.

Our unique high throughput assays have allowed us to identify an unprecedented number of thermogenic compounds. We are now utilizing our singular capacity to directly record the electrical currents that these compounds induce in mitochondria to identify the most selective and safe activators of thermogenesis.

Our methods & expertise also uniquely position us to modulate mitochondrial energy production more generally. Our long-term plans include programs to develop first-in-class drugs targeting several other important therapeutic mechanisms in mitochondria.

The foundations of our work

Mitochondrial uncouplers induce proton leak by activating AAC and UCP1 ( Nature , 2022) .

H+ Transport is an Integral Function of the Mitochondrial ADP/ATP Carrier ( Nature , 2019)

Brown Fat Mechanism of Fatty-Acid-Dependent UCP1 Uncoupling in Brown Fat Mitochondria ( Cell , 2012)

Meet our team

The team at Equator leverages our singular expertise in bioelectricity, computational chemistry, and high-throughput interrogation of mitochondrial physiology to develop a drug that activates our targets.

Jonah Sinick, Ph.D.

Yuriy Kirichok, Ph.D.

Katherine Widdowson, Ph.D.

Simon Vu, Ph.D.

Our advisors are world leading experts in thermophysiology, metabolic disorders, and computational chemistry.

Gerald Shulman, M.D., Ph.D.

Michael Grabe, Ph.D.

name: Arden
brief:
Product: Arden
One-liner: AI-native internal audit firm
Description: Arden is the AI-native platform for internal audit and SOX teams. We build AI agents that automatically pull evidence from your stack, test controls end-to-end, and produce audit-ready workpapers in minutes instead of weeks. Internal audit is a massive but underserved market. Every public company in the US is required to do SOX testing, yet teams still run it through spreadsheets and screenshots. Arden is the engine that does this work.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
target:
Audit work, on autopilot.

Today's leading internal audit teams trust Arden to deliver better audits, faster.

Backed by Silicon Valley's best

Meet the audit teammate you always wanted.

Run your audit procedures end to end.

Arden lives where audit work happens. It chats with you, sits in the walkthrough, and turns policies, docs, and notes into flowcharts in minutes.

Agents crawl your systems, take screenshots, and pull data over API, then validate every bit of it. No PBC back-and-forth.

From ITGC to financial reviews, Arden handles the full testing suite. It maps to your RCM and runs every control on it.

Every exception is investigated before it reaches your workpaper. Root cause traced to the source system, annotated in detail.

Controls and rules watched continuously across your systems. Alerts arrive the moment something breaks, with a remediation playbook attached.

I don’t see a goods receipt on this Veritas bill, what stands in for it in the match?

Yes, the controller submits and the AP releases.

Noted. Entry and payment release are segregated.

Tracing J. Doe’s SLA exception:

I recommend escalating this exception. Access stayed active 24 hours past the 72-hour SLA.

Built for the complexity of real audit environments.

Works with your stack.

Arden connects to the systems you already run — and we build custom connectors for anything that’s missing.

Audit-grade traceability.

Every action is logged and replayable, and every conclusion carries the field, file, and timestamp behind it.

Custom deployed + partnership-minded

Our operating model pairs enterprise-grade security with white-glove partnership, led by ex-Big 4 professionals and leading AI engineers.

Security built for audit-grade evidence.

Purpose-built security

AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit, SAML SSO, and 24/7 monitoring on isolated AWS.

Data sovereignty and control

Decide what Arden can access, set retention, and delete data anytime. Read-only by default.

No model training

Your data stays yours — never used to train models, and customer work stays separated.

SOC 2

Built to certification standards from day one, with an independent SOC 2 audit underway.

Audit-grade traceability

Every action is logged and replayable — each conclusion carries the field, file, and timestamp.

Auditor in the loop

Arden drafts, your team decides. Workpapers finalize only after reviewer sign-off.

Frequently Asked Questions.

name: Physical Turing
brief:
Product: Physical Turing
One-liner: Evaluating humanoids in the real world
Description: Physical Turing rolls out humanoids in the real world and captures failures for benchmarking and post-training. We procure, staff, and operate a wide range of target environments for real-world rollouts, helping robot makers, model companies, and enterprises continuously evaluate where humanoids succeed, where they fail, and what needs to improve before each deployment.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Robotics, B2B, AI
target:
Test and improve your robot in the real world

Physical Turing operates your robot in its target environment and finds failures for benchmarking, post-training, and deployment decisions.

Independent testing for

Humanoid manufacturers

Capture real-world failures in the vertical your robot will operate in, with intervention from operators with domain expertise.

Enterprise customers

A neutral benchmark to assess the reliability and safety of robots you want to purchase.

1 . Pick an environment, we'll staff and run the tests

Use our network of environments to see how your robot performs before deployment, or have us operate directly in your environment.

Real environments

Real tasks

2 . Data from each test is analyzed to find failures

A short 30 second test attempt can provide gigabytes of data. Scale this over many attempts and you've found hundreds of fatal failures in your policy, along with evidence that tells you what went wrong.

LiDAR point cloud

Livox Mid-360 · one accumulated sweep of the test cell

Joint telemetry

Left arm, actual vs command — the playhead follows the replay

3 . Receive a report on each failure and what caused it

Our analysis platform, Seer, labels every event, tracks every object, and judges every attempt against your test spec. A failure comes back as a scored verdict with evidence on what caused it.

Agentic Analysis

What the robot sees

Instance masks tracked on the ego camera

Ready for the Physical Turing test?

Your robot will meet the real world exactly once. We make sure that isn't the first time it's truly tested.

Independent by design

We don't build robots. We have no incentive but the truth about how yours performs.

Logged and reproducible

Every result is instrumented, logged, and repeatable. Receive a detailed report as well as raw testing logs & visualizations.

Controlled variance

We test in the messy, variable conditions your robot will actually operate in, while keeping everyone safe.

Flex and scale with ease

brief:
Product: Authologic
One-liner: Stripe for online identity verification
Description: Authologic is an orchestration and aggregation layer for local KYC & AML methods. We allow businesses to check the identity of their clients online using video/biometrics, banking data, and government issued digital IDs. Our API allows a flexible definition of verification scenarios based on the risk profile of the client or risk involved in the given process.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
target:
eID-Native Identity Infrastructure

Authologic verifies every user with the best available method automatically — from EUDI and Apple, Google & Samsung Wallet to biometrics and document-based verification. Built for humans. Ready for AI Agents.

AI threats & eIDAS 2.0 — the identity landscape just changed.

AI fraud is accelerating . Governments are issuing digital IDs. Apple, Google, and Samsung are making them easy to carry. eIDAS 2.0 is redrawing the compliance map across Europe. name: Salus
brief:
Product: Salus
One-liner: Guardrails to validate your agent's actions before they execute
Description: Your agent processed a refund without looking up the order ID, costing you thousands. You only found out three hours later from a support ticket. Evals, output scoring, and observability can reduce the likelihood of mistakes like these occurring - but there's no solution that inspects and prevents an action as it’s about to execute. Salus does that.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, B2B, API, Infrastructure
target:
Agents that act, safely.

Runtime authorization for AI agents

Put agents in production without losing control. Salus checks policy, evidence, and intent at runtime, returns exact fixes to the agent, and stops wrong actions before they become real.

See a real action caught, corrected, and completed.

The agent relies on old information.

It proposes a booking using the $299 itinerary saved earlier in the conversation.

Salus stops the action.

The booking never reaches the airline. Live availability and the current total were never verified.

The agent fixes the problem.

Salus returns the exact missing step. The agent searches live inventory and discovers the new $375 price.

The corrected action executes.

The customer confirms the new price. Salus verifies the evidence, the booking runs, and a receipt is created.

Snapshot total $299

The airline remains untouched.

Evidence verified · receipt created

Authorized does not mean correct.

Agents can have valid credentials, valid permissions, and perfectly formed tool calls and still take the wrong action. Salus controls the final step between intent and execution.

Prevent. Repair. Prove.

Stop the wrong action before it reaches the provider.

Salus holds unsupported writes before your backend performs them.

Give the agent the exact correction it needs.

Fixable actions return with the missing evidence and the next step.

Prove every decision.

See the policy, evidence, timing, verdict, and execution result.

Works with the stack you already use.

Protect the tool that performs the write. Keep your model, agent loop, framework, and backend unchanged.

OpenAI · Anthropic · LangChain · LangGraph · CrewAI · AutoGen · Vapi · Retell · MCP

Safer actions. Better outcomes.

Trust your agents with real work.

Start with one action that matters. Salus stops wrong actions, tells the agent exactly how to fix them, and sends only real judgment calls to your team.

brief:

Description: CircuitHub offers on-demand electronics manufacturing powered by our factory-scale robotics platform, The Grid. target:
On-demand circuit board assembly

Rapid, low cost manufacturing

for fast moving robotics companies.

Get your PCB prototypes from design to delivery in weeks days with CircuitHub's automated, on-demand manufacturing.

Low cost prototype and batch production.

Traditional manufacturers have to charge high prices for prototypes and low volume batch production due to lack of automation.

CircuitHub achieves economical on-demand production at low volumes through a technical breakthrough that flattens the price curve.

3 day full turnkey fab and assembly by default. Made in the USA

Traditional manufacturers have to charge high prices for speed due to lack of automation.

CircuitHub ships 81% of full turnkey orders within 3 days as standard, enabling rapid prototyping and on-demand small batch production.

Reliable delivery times and consistently high quality.

Traditional manufacturers leave you guessing as to the quality of service you'll receive from them.

CircuitHub is the first in the industry to publish key performance indicators in real-time.

Andrew Seddon

CEO at CircuitHub

35K+ common parts in shared inventory.

Traditional manufacturers do not stock common parts or make it easy to manage your key parts in inventory

CircuitHub allows you to easily manage an inventory of custom parts or pull from our shared common parts.

Get to market in half the time

Low price and rapid turnaround enables frequent design iteration and agile small batch manufacturing. Rapidly iterate on prototypes with reduced upfront design time. Gradually scale into production without capital intensive large production runs.

One-liner: connect, migrate and implement enterprise systems

AI agents for enterprise implementations.

superglue's AI agents connect, migrate and implement enterprise systems. Cloud-hosted or on your own infrastructure.

What superglue can do.

superglue learns how your systems work from your company's knowledge. It performs the implementation that normally requires human coordination and engineering work.

ERP Implementation Agent

Implement NetSuite, Sage Intacct, SAP, Business Central or Acumatica in days. Agents map and migrate legacy data, configure the system, and keep data in sync post go-live.

AI Rollout Agent

Connect ERP, CRM, databases, and internal systems to AI platforms like Claude. Create governed data access for AI agents and track data usage across your org.

Customer Onboarding Agent

Connect customer systems, import historical data and go live in hours. Let agents manage the entire implementation process end-to-end.

name: Sunflower
brief:
Product: Sunflower
One-liner: We are building an AI-native telemedicine clinic for addiction. 🌻
Description: Sunflower is building an AI-native telemedicine clinic for addiction. There are over 18,750 patients on a waitlist for Therapy or Meds, representing $153M worth of TAM just waiting to be served. We started by launching Sunflower Sober, the first AI Sponsor for addiction which grew to 100 MAU in less than 6 months and currently driving about $1.5M in run-rate worth of subscription app revenue.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare Services
target:
Online therapy & medication for addiction treatment

You don’t have to face this alone. Get matched with a licensed therapist and start your personalized recovery plan from the privacy of home.

Addiction therapy

Therapy that understands addiction

Your therapist understands how addiction works and helps you make changes that support recovery. Whatever you’re struggling with, this is a place to start.

For alcohol specifically

Struggling with alcohol? There’s medication for that

Naltrexone can help reduce alcohol cravings and the rewarding effects of drinking. After a medical evaluation, a licensed prescriber can determine whether it’s appropriate for you. If prescribed, a licensed pharmacy can ship it to your home.

Outcomes reported in alcohol-treatment research

Reached a good clinical outcome with oral naltrexone and clinical support 1

Alcohol-free days at six months with digital CBT and weekly clinical check-ins 2

Lower likelihood of a heavy-drinking day during treatment with oral naltrexone 1

These are published study outcomes, not Sunflower Clinic patient outcomes or a guarantee of individual results. Populations, interventions, and outcome definitions differ by study.

Three steps

How it works

STEP 1

Meet your therapist

We connect you with a therapist experienced in addiction therapy who understands the challenges of recovery.

STEP 2

Get a personalized treatment plan

Your therapist builds a plan around CBT, motivational interviewing, and relapse prevention.

STEP 3

Ongoing support and check-ins

Weekly video, progress tracking, and messaging between sessions.

Who we are

Our care team

Raphael Golebiowski, MD

Medical Director, Behavioral Health

Kera Passante

LPC therapist

Brad Holt

Glen Rebman, DO

Senior Psychiatrist

Between sessions

Paired with the Sunflower sobriety toolkit

Medication, the Sunflower app, and free peer groups so support doesn’t stop when the call ends.

“I think this group is amazing! To be able to have a safe place to come and share our experiences really matters so much to me! Thanks for these meetings, they really help me!”

D.M. Peer support group

caffeineluvr App Store review

“I really appreciate the intimacy of the group. It’s really comfortable sharing with others. It’s a really relaxed atmosphere. Thank you for starting this group!”

Reuse what works

Connections, clean records and rules from the first application can be reused in the next.

See what Khotan could build for you.

name: Tsenta
brief:
Product: Tsenta
One-liner: AI career agent that finds matching jobs & applies on your behalf
Description: Tsenta is an AI career agent that matches you with jobs, applies automatically, and gets you the best offers on the market. We grew to ~$3M Annualized in three months. We built it after manually applying to over 3,000 jobs ourselves, so that candidates would always have someone on their side. Today, more than 90,000+ job seekers trust Tsenta to automate their job search.
Industry: Consumer / Job and Career Services
Tags: Marketplace, Consumer, Recruiting, HR Tech, AI
target:
Be the first to apply to every job that fits you. Hands off.

Tsenta watches 50,000+ career pages across Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and 15+ more ATSes, and submits a tailored resume the moment a fitting role goes up. Hundreds of applications a week.

Four stages. One agent. Zero spreadsheets.

Be the first qualified applicant on the job.

Tsenta watches 50,000+ company career pages. The moment a role drops that fits your résumé, you know — and you're already in the top 100 applicants.

A résumé and cover letter, rewritten per role.

Every application gets keyword-aligned, recruiter-readable, ATS-safe materials — generated from the actual job description, with the changes shown to you before anything goes out.

Tsenta opens the form. Tsenta hits submit.

Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby — nineteen ATSes covered. Login, every field, the open-ended questions in your voice, and the upload. You watch it happen, or you don't.

Replies, interviews, rejections — auto-routed.

Recruiter emails land back on the right application. Status moves on its own. Your inbox stops being a graveyard and starts being a pipeline you can read.

One agent. Any screen.

Apply on the web.

Discovery feed, application queue, recruiter inbox — every surface of Tsenta in one place, on any browser.

Apply over iMessage.

Tsenta texts you when a match drops. Reply yes; the application happens in the background and you get the receipt.

Apply from Chrome.

On any job posting on the web, the Tsenta toolbar drops in. One click and the form is filled before the tab finishes loading.

Apply with an agent.

A Tsenta MCP server and CLI for Claude Code, OpenClaw, and any agent that speaks tools. Your assistant applies on your behalf.

Pay for the applications. Not the tool.

Enough for a real job search.

For the desperate, the laid-off, the OPT-clocked.

Hit every match before anyone else.

What people ask before signing up.

Have something else on your mind? Write to founders@tsenta.com . A real founder will reply.

Tsenta surfaces roles that fit your résumé and preferences, including location, salary, experience level, and role family. Matches include an explanation, and you can paste a job URL to add a role to your application workflow.

brief:

One-liner: Build your GTM workforce
Description: We’re redefining how teams execute GTM by making them leaner, faster and engineer-driven. In an AI-first world, we’re replacing SDR-heavy models with a hybrid approach, empowering full-cycle AEs through a blend of manual effort and automation.
Industry: B2B / Sales
target:
GTM infrastructure for AI agents.

Your agents bring the reasoning. Cargo brings everything underneath: one data model, maintained connectors, execution that retries, and a trace of every run.

Agents wired to a dozen APIs. Or agents on a runtime.

Cargo does not replace the agents you built. It is the floor they stand on.

Your agents today

On Cargo

Seven primitives. One system.

Everything a GTM is made of, as resources in one workspace. Defined once, versioned in git, used by your team and your agents alike.

Bring your own or use ours. Each has a prompt, tools, memory, and a check on its own work.

Programmable or visual. Same play.

The same play: asked for in Claude Code, defined in TypeScript, run from the CLI, or built in the app.

Create a play that qualifies demo requests against our ICP and assigns them to a rep.

Notify the team in Slack when it is a strong fit.

5 cookbooks , one job each. Ready for

Account scoring

Keep every account scored and tiered against your written ICP by a deployed agent that re-scores as accounts arrive and as the ICP changes, writing the rationale back to the CRM.

Agentic engagement

Deploy an agent that holds email conversations with leads: a sending domain, a mailbox, native sendEmail and listEmailEvents on the agent, a native email trigger on reply and unsubscribe, and a heartbeat that checks thread status when nothing inbound happened.

name: Genecis Bio
brief:
Product: Genecis Bio
One-liner: Makes guilt-free plastics from food waste
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Bioplastic, Synthetic Biology, Climate, ClimateTech
target:
Plastic, without the pollution .

At Genecis Bioindustries, we care about the beginning and the end.

We're a climate biotech company turning organic waste into sustainable, biodegradable materials, offering a circular economy solution for products’ beginning and end of life.

Product Offerings

Single-Use Plastics

Governments are rapidly banning single-use plastic packaging, including plastic bags. Genecis PHA plastic provides a responsible alternative to single-use plastic with the same properties as oil-based plastics.

Automotive & Textiles

Replacing harmful oil-based plastics with biodegradable PHAs presents an opportunity to differentiate your company as eco-friendly and environmentally conscious to your customers.

Genecis PHA is tunable: we can produce rigid and flexible PHAs to replace both automotive parts and softer textiles.

Packaging

Half of all plastic produced is designed to be used only once, resulting in an estimated 10 million tonnes of plastic ending up in the ocean each year.

By making the switch to Genecis PHA, your packaging can be composted or will naturally biodegrade, reducing environmental pollution without significantly increasing production costs.

Medical Tools & Products

PHA plastic can be used in the production of medical implants, sutures, cardiac valves, vascular grafts, and other medical equipment and packaging.

Because Genecis PHA plastic is produced from natural materials, it can be utilized safely in medical procedures.

We’re designing the future of plastics.

PHA is a safe and guilt-free alternative to traditional plastics. We engineer bioplastics that rival the performance of traditional plastics , offering a sustainable solution to plastic pollution. Our process is lower in cost and emissions than competing bioplastics producers because we use organic waste as a feedstock.

We work with businesses to de-risk their transition to sustainable products by helping them incorporate PHA and biomaterials into new product design, so they can make a difference without sacrificing quality or profitability .

Dream it — Polymer Development

We’ll develop and test the ideal polymer formulation for a current or new product line.

Genecis customizes PHA polymer composition to meet target biodegradability, functionality, and quality requirements for partners’ products.

Build it — Rapid Product Development

Let’s collaborate to develop new PHA-based products that align with your brand and sustainability goals. We'll work closely with you to ensure that the final product meets your specifications and is ready for commercialization.

Grow it — Co-Branding

Connect with consumers who care about sustainability and high-performance products.

Stand out with innovative products with enhanced functionality.

Increase sales and profitability while differentiating your products in a crowded marketplace.

Let's build sustainable products together.

name: Captain
brief:
Product: Captain
One-liner: Self-tuning file search for AI agents
Description: Captain syncs complex, multimodal files and cloud storage from sources like S3, SharePoint, and Google Drive, and makes that knowledge searchable for your agents. Instead of stitching together parsers, embeddings, vector databases, rerankers, and retrieval infrastructure, Captain self-tunes the retrieval pipeline to your data and workloads. On benchmarks, this improves accuracy from roughly 78% with standard RAG to over 97% by tuning retrieval to the unique structure and content of your data.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: B2B, API, Data Engineering, Infrastructure
target:
Retrieval your agents can trust.

[ Now self-tuning captain_eval ]

The complete file search platform. Synced with cloud storage, fast and accurate, and optimized for complex retrieval.

One platform from raw files to ranked answers.

Powerful ingestion and self-tuning retrieval, behind one query API, ready for production scale.

Sync files and self-improve search as one platform

Every layer above ships together, on one index. Nothing to wire and nothing to keep aligned.

Search

Sub-second queries through a deterministic API, with filters, rerank and candidate depth all yours to configure.

Iterate

Keep search in line with ever-changing data. One MCP tool call runs evals on your own files and tunes retrieval toward your targets.

Process

Index what DIY RAG can’t: scans, handwriting, tables, screenshots, recordings. Captain turns each one into clean, structured, searchable text, more carefully than you would by hand.

Engine

Unify a fragmented, multi-provider pipeline into one engine: pre-filtered vector search, embeddings and vector storage on a clean data model and serverless infrastructure, behind a drop-in API.

Sync

Change events update the index as files change, and a scheduled sweep catches anything an event missed.

Files in. Answers out.

Add Captain to your coding agent.

Built for teams that depend on every answer.

Used by Y Combinator, compliance teams, and engineers building agents that need reliable answers.

The accuracy was noticeably better. Setup took 5 minutes, and it scaled to thousands of docs a day.

Captain is a step function increase in capability compared to out-of-box RAG pipelines.

Your data is the benchmark.

A public benchmark tells you how a system ran on someone else's corpus. Run captain_eval with Captain's MCP and Captain builds hundreds of Q&A evals from your own files, scores retrieval against them, and tunes until it hits your target.

When evaluated against other leading file-search APIs on production queries, alternatives fail to answer about one in three questions.

Usage insights

See what people search for, and exactly where answers fall short. The feedback loop makes retrieval better over time.

Knowledge gap discovery

See the questions your data has yet to answer, surfaced automatically, so you know exactly where to close the gaps.

Retrieval attack detection

Catch black-hole vector attacks (arXiv:2604.05480) before they reach production, a failure mode most DIY search layers never see.

The accuracy is not a model. It is one index, an eval loop, and parsing that keeps every word.

name: ContextFort
brief:
Product: ContextFort
One-liner: Visibility and Controls for Browser Agents
Description: ContextFort gives security teams visibility and controls for AI browser agents. It’s a Chrome extension that: Detects when an AI agent takes control of the browser Records every action during the session (pages visited, clicks, text entry) Provides controls to prevent risky actions and cross-site data leakage
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: Cybersecurity, AI
target:
Visibility and Controls for AI Agents in the Endpoint

Know exactly what coding agents are doing on your engineers' machines.

What AI coding agents can access

When an engineer runs Cursor or Claude Code, the agent inherits their full system permissions. No sandbox. No restrictions. Every file, every credential, every network connection.

Environment variables & secrets

AWS keys, database credentials, API tokens in .env files — all readable by the agent as context. The agent doesn't need to be malicious. It reads .env to "understand your project" and sends it to the AI provider's API.

Why CrowdStrike isn't enough

EDR detects threats. It doesn't audit what AI agents are doing. These are fundamentally different questions — one asks “is this malicious?”, the other asks “what did this agent do?”

OS-level telemetry for AI coding agents

ContextFort monitors from the kernel — independently of the agent. Built with eBPF on Linux, Endpoint Security Framework on macOS, and ETW + Minifilter on Windows.

File access telemetry

Every file the agent reads or writes — .env, credentials, SSH keys, source code.

Network monitoring

Every outbound connection — what data is sent, where it goes, which process initiated it.

Process tree tracking

Full visibility into every subprocess — shell commands, package installs, builds.

Independent audit trail

OS-level logs the agent can't tamper with. Know exactly what happened and when.

Track websites & apps automatically, set goals, create alerts, and block distractions. Take personal productivity to a new level with RescueTime Focus.

name: Tinfoil
brief:
Product: Tinfoil
One-liner: Encrypted AI with verifiable privacy
Description: Tinfoil makes it easy to make your AI workloads secure and provably private. You get the privacy of on-prem deployments, while running on the cloud. It's like end-to-end encrypted messaging but for your AI applications. We’ve built a full-stack platform on top of the latest NVIDIA GPUs offering confidential computing capabilities, meaning that you don’t have to trade off performance for privacy.
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, Security, Privacy, Cloud Computing
target:
Private Intelligence

Our products

For your private thoughts, projects, and apps.

For your thoughts

Private Chat

Chat with powerful AI assistants while keeping your conversations private. Available in the browser and on iOS.

For your projects

Private Inference API

Build AI applications that keep all data private. Our API is OpenAI-compatible, open-source, and fully verifiable.

For your applications

Tinfoil Containers

Run any Docker image in a secure enclave. Bring privacy and verifiability to applications and custom AI workloads.

Industry highlights.

Tinfoil in case studies, research, and collaborations.

Featured in a Llama case study as the only multi-GPU infrastructure offering production-ready, verifiably private AI.

Collaborating with Red Hat on open-source confidential AI infrastructure for private inference.

Security audit and webinar collaboration on TEE vulnerabilities and confidential computing best practices.

Our story on building audit-ready, verifiably private AI with Ubuntu as the foundation for multi-platform confidential computing.

Industry Programs and Collaborations

Infrastructure built for privacy.

Tinfoil makes your AI workloads secure, verifiable, and private.

Case Study

Workshop Labs

Workshop Labs built Silo, the first production-ready multi-GPU private post-training and inference stack for frontier models, powered by Tinfoil Containers. All customer data is processed inside hardware-isolated secure enclaves with customer-managed encryption keys, with less than 10% performance overhead on production workloads.

Pour Demain

Pour Demain, a Brussels-based AI policy think tank, used Tinfoil Containers to build a verifiable clean room for auditing frontier models. Their work shows the feasibility of running gray-box interpretability evals on a 744B parameter model inside confidential enclaves: the auditor brings the eval, the lab brings its weights, and both get cryptographic proof of exactly what ran, without the weights ever leaving the enclave.

Privacy of local. Power of cloud.

Tinfoil runs AI models inside secure hardware enclaves. This gives you the privacy of local AI with the power of cloud computing.

Closed Source Models

Open-source & Custom Models

Have a security or privacy question?

Detailed answers on what Tinfoil can and cannot see, how secure enclave attestation works, what would happened with legally-compelled disclosure, and more.

What does end-to-end privacy mean?

How is Tinfoil different from typical AI security approaches?

Is there a performance overhead when using Tinfoil?

Is Tinfoil compatible with closed-source models like GPT-5 and Claude?

What analytics and observability does Tinfoil offer?

Can I deploy my own AI models?

What type of workloads are suitable for Tinfoil?

Egocentric human data in commercial and residential environments: calibrated stereo RGB with dense metric depth, synced IMU, 6-DoF VIO, and 3D hand pose.

name: Foaster
brief:
Product: Foaster
One-liner: The AI-native McKinsey
Description: Foaster is building the AI-native McKinsey, starting with AI transformation. We deploy AI agents that interview a company's employees at scale, map how work actually gets done, identify bottlenecks and AI opportunities, and draft a transformation roadmap in just 2 weeks. Expert consultants review the final outputs, add judgment where it matters, and feed their corrections back into the system.
Industry: B2B
target:
Your AI Transformation Partner.

Foaster maps how your company really works, identifies where AI should change it, and helps you make it happen.

Our method

AI agents for scale and depth. Human experts for judgment and implementation.

Interviews

AI agents conduct parallel, 30-minute interviews across your entire organization to capture every workflow, manual task, and tool usage that defines how work actually gets done.

Map

We build a granular map of your operations, visualizing how work flows between people and identifying every operational friction, bottleneck, and inefficiency.

Roadmap

A personalized transformation roadmap tailored to your specific operations and business goals, including impact analysis, technical feasibility, and implementation timelines.

Transform

Agents personally upskill every employee and track adoption monthly, while our human experts provide guidance each month and FDEs step in when implementation is needed.

AI transformation starts when the company can finally see itself.

Our solutions

AI Transformation Assessment

A one-time deep diagnostic to know exactly where AI creates the most value.

Continuous AI Transformation

Ongoing support to drive adoption, upskill teams, and keep transformation on track.

Enterprise Deployment

A dedicated team of Forward Deployed Engineers to build and scale custom AI solutions.

FAQ

Consultants interview a handful of leaders and give you a deck. We interview your entire organization through AI, map how things actually work, and stay with you to make sure the transformation happens. It's faster, deeper, and built for real change.

Each employee has a private 30-minute conversation with an AI agent about their daily work, tools, bottlenecks, and ideas. No prep needed on their side. It's simple, confidential, and people are often more open than they'd be with a human consultant.

The first Assessment takes about 10 days. We run all interviews in parallel, then deliver a full operational map and a prioritized transformation roadmap, validated by a dedicated human expert. You get clarity fast.

Every week, each employee receives a personalized briefing: relevant AI tips, industry news, and a short presentation tailored to their exact role and daily tasks. Because we know what each person actually does, the content is immediately actionable. That's how you make transformation stick.

Yes. We work with companies from 50 employees to large enterprises. The scope, format, and pricing are adapted to your reality. Every organization faces different challenges, and the engagement reflects that.

Industry: B2B / Sales
Tags: B2B, Sales, Marketing, AI
target:
Find leads no one else can and book meetings automatically.

Avina is an AI agent platform that uses buying signals to help B2B sales teams find, prioritize and automate outreach to prospects that are actually in-market.

FIND LEADS THAT NEED YOUR PRODUCT

Trusted by hundreds of B2B sales teams

Stop chasing cold leads. Start closing warm ones.

Avina monitors your entire TAM for buying intent, scores every signal with AI, and triggers the right action so your reps only spend time on accounts ready to buy.

Find leads that need you.

Avina tracks signals across the web, LinkedIn, job posts, and your site visitors, with RB2B, Vector, and Clearbit built in. Live audiences refresh daily as new signals fire.

Score and enrich them.

Avina scores every account for ICP fit, then finds target contacts at those companies and enriches them with verified contact details. No juggling multiple data providers.

Reach them on every channel.

Avina drafts and sends AI sequences, builds hyper-targeted ad audiences, syncs ABM segments, and feeds traditional sequences in your existing tools.

Sync back to your stack.

Push enriched contacts, live signals, and account scores into your CRM and Slack in real time, or trigger webhooks to any tool that supports them.

“ Avina delivers real-time signals on key accounts: activity, context, and insights our reps can turn into action. Right persona. Right time. Right message. Game-changer. ”

Axel Billaud

Revenue Operations

HOW IT WORKS

Find. Prioritize. Automate.

Track key buying signals, enrich the right contacts, score accounts with AI, and trigger outreach automatically.

Find every in-market lead.

Avina’s AI Signals Agent continuously scans first-party, third-party, and web data to surface buying signals tailored to how your buyers behave, far beyond what fixed-signal platforms offer.

Describe buying behavior in plain language; Avina builds a custom signal for feature launches, pivots, tech stack changes, and more. Our agent reads context, not keywords, to catch subtle buying moments competitors miss.

98% of your website traffic leaves without a trace. Avina’s X-Ray Pixel combines providers like RB2B, Vector, Clearbit, and more into a single pixel, automatically identifying anonymous visitors, enriching their contact data, and routing high-intent prospects to sales in real time.

Track website visitors, job postings, hiring surges, champion moves, social engagement, and ad interactions from day one. No setup or configuration required. Avina starts capturing intent the moment you connect your data sources.

One-liner: Robots that run autonomous depots for autonomous fleets.
Description: RoboDock builds robots that automate depot operations, like charging and vehicle checks, for electric and autonomous vehicle fleets. We turn fleet depots from manual sites into self-running systems that lower operational costs and increase vehicle uptime.
Industry: Industrials / Energy
target:
Powering autonomy

Autonomous depot operations for AV and EV fleets - starting with charging and vehicle inspections. Built on intelligent perception, advanced sensing, and reliable infrastructure.

The robotics layer powering autonomous EV and AV depots — starting with charging and inspections.

Manual charging breaks at scale.

In live EV and AV depots, ports, and logistics yards, charging and core depot operations are still manual — performed multiple times per day, across mixed fleets, in tight urban footprints, and under real-world constraints.

The result isn’t just inconvenience.

It’s missed charges, unpredictable downtime, and rising labor and infrastructure costs – all of which directly limit vehicle uptime, scalability, and reliability at fleet scale.

We introduce a new standard for depot operations.

Vehicle arrives at stall

Parked within standard EVCS envelope ‍

Plug insertion + charge start

Vision-guided alignment and verified connection before power flow

Vehicle inspection

Sensing systems assess vehicle readiness before redeployment

Closed-loop system

Every charge event learns and improves system accuracy and efficiency

Built for real-world autonomy

Autonomous Plug-In & Unplug

Robotic execution replaces manual labor and reduces vehicle downtime.

Vehicle Inspection

Intelligent sensing evaluates vehicle readiness, enabling safe redeployment and continuous system learning.

$1.2M+

Recovered Per Depot, Per Year

Built by Experts in Autonomy

Zinny Weli

Built and deployed real-world robotic charging systems at scale. Previously owned autonomous charging development at Zipline and designed robotic charging systems at Amazon. Stanford-trained in robotics, with deep experience in field deployment, safety, and weather-rated autonomous systems. Now applying that expertise to close the final manual gap in fleet electrification.

Celine Wang

Engineer across autonomous systems, vehicle maintenance, and mechatronics. Previously retrofitted semi-trucks with self-driving systems at Plus, focusing on sensor + actuator integration and vehicle performance. Car enthusiast and proud Stanford tree. Leads RoboDock's technical direction.

Unlock autonomous depots

name: Paloma
brief:
Product: Paloma
One-liner: Digital transformation for real economy businesses
Description: Paloma gives manufacturing companies an embedded team of engineers and ops experts who replace their manual operations with custom AI-native software.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, SaaS, Analytics, Manufacturing, Operations
target:
Purpose-built software for companies that make real things

The tools your operations team would build themselves, if they had the engineers. We're those engineers.

What we build

Operational Intelligence

Connect your ERP, spreadsheets, emails, and the data that lives outside all of them.

We teach the system how your business works so your team can ask questions like "Why did logistics costs go up last month?" and get detailed answers in minutes.

Custom Internal Tools

Your team needs tools that fit their workflows. Not another platform to adapt to.

We build AI-native, custom software for the specific way your company operates. A compliance checker across 15 languages? An OEE tracker pulling from the shop floor? A cleanup system for 850,000 messy records? No problem.

Workflow Automation

Your best people spend hours every week moving data between systems by hand.

We take that manual work off their plate so they can do the work they were actually hired to do. WhatsApp orders into the ERP. Pen-and-paper shift reports digitized. Field data structured without anyone touching a keyboard.

How we work with you

Operational diagnostic

We shadow your team and map your core processes end to end. You get a clear picture of where the biggest opportunities are, without getting locked into a six-figure deal upfront.

Trial engagement

We pick the highest-impact problem with the smallest meaningful scope, and build the fix. If it doesn't deliver value, walk away.

Ongoing partnership

Expand to other teams and workflows. Every engagement builds operational context, so each build is faster than the last.

AI you can trust

Built on a bespoke layer that understands your business

We spend time with your team first, learning how your business actually runs, so we can teach the system your terminology, your logic, and your way of working. When the system answers a question, it's not guessing, it's reasoning with your definitions, your rules, your way of doing things.

Every answer shows its work

When the system says logistics costs went up 12%, you can see exactly which data sources it pulled from, how it calculated the number, and every step it followed to get there. No black boxes. When the AI runs a calculation, it uses real math on real data, not language prediction. It pulls from specific sources, applies defined formulas, and follows the same steps every time. The numbers are computed, not generated.

Full audit trail

target:
Enabling Safe and Accurate Infusion Therapy for Anyone, Anywhere

The DripAssist platform is the complete solution to remotely monitor, track and analyze gravity IV infusion.

DripAssist Infusion Rate Monitor

AUTOMATICALLY MONITOR GRAVITY IV INFUSIONS IN ANY ENVIRONMENT

Out-of-hospital services are rapidly becoming the preferred method to administer common IV medications due to increased patient satisfaction, improved care outcomes and reduced hospital readmission rates.

As the first and only FDA-cleared infusion rate monitor to accurately monitor gravity IV infusions, the DripAssist platform enables infusion therapy to be delivered safely and affordably in any environment.

precise monitoring of gravity iv infusion

Infusion providers can confidently deliver safe and accurate gravity infusion therapy in the home.

The ability to use gravity infusions to safely and efficiently administer medication allows patients to receive high-quality care in the comfort of their home.

Immediate insight to actionable information

DripAssist monitors infusion data that shows patients are receiving medications at the prescribed amounts and rates.

Infusion providers can evaluate the correlation between infusion rate and care outcomes to assess medication response to help predict treatment tolerances for each patient.

simplified and efficient workflows

Monitored gravity infusions can enable providers to safely move away from using expensive and often unreliable pumps to deliver home infusion therapy.

The ability to remotely monitor infusion accuracy and precision saves time and expense, and improves patient safety.

Our Difference

Reduced Operational Cost

DripAssist enables 70% of infusions that are currently done with expensive and unreliable pumps to move to gravity, with no impact to patient safety.

DripAssist simplifies the workflow of administering infusions and removes the need for calibration, maintenance, and other recurring costs of maintaining infusion pumps.

Improved Patient Safety

As DripAssist continually monitors gravity infusion rates, providers get immediate validation that medications are being administered according to prescriptions and treatment plans.

DripAssist has proven results that directly improve patient satisfaction and health outcomes.

Value Based Insights

By remotely monitoring, aggregating and analyzing infusion data, providers gain assurances that infusion treatment protocols are properly followed for every patient, every time.

This supports provider efforts to improve patient health outcomes and reduce operational costs as they move to a value-based care model.

Learn more about monitoring gravity IV with DripAssist in your environment

name: Turing Labs Inc.
brief:
Product: Turing Labs Inc.
One-liner: AI for R&D of consumer brands like P&G to develop better products
Description: Developing a consumer product like Dove is complex, time-consuming, and expensive; companies like Unilever analyzes millions of data points to develop a blockbuster consumer product. Turing makes this process 10x more efficient. Turing's AI harnesses the data from several sources and helps to make a better decision about product development 10x faster.
Industry: B2B / Retail
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B
target:
Innovation-led Growth Operating System for Consumer Products

World’s first Innovation-led Growth Operating System

Launch products that win at shelf.

AI that sharpens every innovation bet, helps R&D execute and deliver winning formulation faster, and funds the launch from margin you couldn’t see.

Hit the launch window without giving up the claim, the taste, or the margin. Reformulate for the new regulation without pausing the innovation pipeline.

That’s the Innovation-led Growth Operating System — purpose-built and domain-trained for consumer products.

Trusted by the teams behind the world’s leading consumer products:

For decades, scale won — build the brand, ship it everywhere, drive out cost. That equation is breaking. Companies are being attacked from both ends: private label on value and disruptor brands on function - all while managing regulatory and supply chain risks. Those upstarts now take 35% of category growth from barely 15% of shelf.

AI was supposed to help. But most teams got more copilots, more experiments, and the same fragmented decisions. The real bottleneck is not idea generation. It is deciding which bets deserve R&D time, which tradeoffs matter, and which launches can actually win. That's why we built domain-trained AI engine and orchestrated agents to drive commercial success.

We call it the Innovation-led Growth Operating System for consumer products — one system that picks which bets win, formulates with precision, funds them from unseen margin, and compounds every lesson.

Manmit Shrimali Founder & CEO

Built for the industry, from day one

Six years in the making. Tested across categories, regions, and companies from day one. The breadth is what makes it reliable — the hard surprises aren't surprises anymore.

Built for your reality, not an ideal

Real formulations come with high variability, legacy instruments, and constraints no controlled environment anticipated. Turing's domain-trained optimizer and agents are built for it.

Built for production, not pilot purgatory

Leading companies don't pilot Turing. They run it — across reformulation, cost, compliance, and scale-up, at scale.

We didn't build it to solve our own problems. We built it to solve yours.

Your team is making million-dollar product bets with incomplete confidence.

70% of CPG teams are beaten to shelf by a comparable product.

You commit to a concept, then find out at the shelf whether it was the right bet.

The answer exists in past projects, supplier data, sensory results, or formulation history — but no one can find it when the decision is being made.
