name: Config - Superpowers for Hardware Teams
brief: Product: Config - Superpowers for Hardware Teams
target:
Superpowers for Hardware Teams

Config brings together engineering, operations, and manufacturing to make shipping high-quality hardware easier at scale.

Drawings and designs managed in a way that works the way you think, with automatically generated BOMs. Compatible with NX and SolidWorks.

Manage your whole team's schematics and layouts with ease, also with automatically generated BOMs. Compatible with Altium.

Complete your BOM with firmware releases. Revision build assets manually and automatically with GitHub Release integration.

Groundbreaking Design Management

First-of-its-kind version control designed just for hardware. Config lets you track, annotate, and approve every critical decision. All without files, formats, and out-of-date versions getting in the way.

Config works right out of the box with the CAD software of your choice. Manage designs, commit changes, and create revisions for mechanical and electrical designs directly from NX, SolidWorks, or Altium.

One-click Bill of Materials

Save your team's precious time. Config replaces the lengthy process of manual BOM creation with one-click BOM from your engineering assembly, all driven by CAD.

Toggle and re-order asssembly hierarchies by just dragging them around. No more manual marking of levels.

See what has been changed, added, or removed between your BOM revisions just by glancing at the colors.

Keep your part revisions up to date with one-click that re-synchronizes CAD data throughout your entire assembly.

Assign new or existing part numbers to parts right from the BOM. Never end up with duplicate part numbers ever again.

Every change to a BOM item is recorded at both a part and BOM level for maximum traceability.

No CAD yet? Easily sketch out your first BOM just like a spreadsheet and assign part numbers before CAD is ready.

Magical Design Reviews

Collaborate with your team on every revision of every part right in the browser. Add annotations, comments, and complete reviews.

Finally. Your Team, on the Same Page

Config brings together all your teams to speed up and simplify shipping high-quality hardware.

Birds-eye view of your build progress without relying on out-of-date and error-prone spreadsheets.

Fully reviewable revision and commit history for every part in your project. Never question which version or which part ever again.

Designate part type-specific families in highly customizable number schemes.

You don't have to give up accountability to make hand-off easier. Easily take ownership of any part.

Welcome Your Vendors In

Data sent to vendors doesn't get lost with Config. Ditch email for a solution that's secure, traceable, and easy-to-use.

name: Tekton Dynamics
brief:
Product: Tekton Dynamics
One-liner: AI control layer for welding robots
Description: Our mission is to empower every manufacturer, no matter their scale, to invent and build anything using intelligent robots. Today’s industrial robots are fast but "blind". They struggle with any task that isn't perfectly repetitive. We are building the eyes and brain (a proprietary vision system and AI model) that allow industrial robots to see, reason, and perform complex work with sub-millimeter accuracy and the adaptability of a human expert.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Manufacturing, Industrial
target:
Automate welding — even on high-mix products. No programming needed.

Tekton Dynamics builds the AI control layer that turns any robot into an autonomous expert welder.

3 steps to autonomous robotic welding.

We handle the integration. You upload the jobs to your robot — and it welds. No teach pendant, no programming, no roboticist.

Tell us about your setup

Share your current welding setup and goals — we come back within 24 hours with a free automation and installation plan.

We install our system — in under an hour

We mount our vision system and AI edge device onto your robot cell and run the first sample welds. No roboticist required.

Upload jobs — the robot does the rest

The robot plans the path, adapts to the part in front of it, and welds like an expert, every shift. No teach pendant, no programming.

See it on your parts.

Book a 20-minute call — we'll talk through your setup and what autonomous welding looks like for you.

The latest from Tekton Dynamics.

Tekton Dynamics at the MTC's Robotics & Automation 2026

We'll be at the MTC's Robotics & Automation Conference in Coventry — because advancing Britain's industrial base means pointing physical AI at one of its hardest labour shortages: welding.

Tekton Dynamics at the Defence Procurement Conference 2026

We're in Birmingham this week to make a simple case: a resilient industrial base starts with closing the welding skills gap.

Why we built a control layer, not another welding robot

The robotic hardware was never the bottleneck. The robotic intelligence to run it on real, high-mix work was.

We are building the intelligence layer for the machines that build the world. Join us.

name: Floot
brief:
Product: Floot
One-liner: The app platform inside Claude and ChatGPT.
Description: Floot is the layer where vibecoded software runs. SaaS is dead. Hundreds of millions of people already spend their day in Claude or ChatGPT - and increasingly, when they need an app, they won't buy one. They'll describe it, and it will exist. We're building the infrastructure that makes that real. When Claude creates an app, it needs somewhere for that app to live: a backend, a database, hosting, a domain, the ability to scale, various services, maybe even to be able to work as a mobile app.

target:
Build apps in Claude . ChatGPT . Cursor . Get it live in minutes.

One conversation with your AI. A real app with a database, live at its own link.

Connect Floot to Claude Claude ChatGPT Cursor as a connector

Prompt your AI to build your project

Keep refining until it's exactly what you want

Everything you need, built-in.

Build, launch, and run your business from a single platform with everything you need built right in.

Publish with One Click

Put your app online instantly with its own shareable link. Just one click “publish” and you're live.

Backend, Data & Logins

Your app can save information, let users create accounts and run recurring tasks automatically. Floot handles the technical setup for you.

Emails & Notifications

Send emails, receipts, updates, and notifications from your app, without setting up extra tools.

Built to be Found

Floot makes your app easy for search engines like Google to understand and discover, with SEO essentials built in automatically.

Integrate Your Tools

Stripe payments, Google login, Zapier, and thousands of other services. Floot guides you through the setup step by step.

Why Floot?

name: Financial Datasets
brief:
Product: Financial Datasets
One-liner: Connect your agent to the stock market
Description: Financial Datasets is the largest search index for stock market data, built for AI agents. We index the world's markets so agents can search every filing, answer any financial question, and monitor markets in real time. For 40 years, market data was built for humans reading a screen. We are rebuilding it for agents that research every company, all day, across the world.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Fintech, Investing, Stocks
target:
Connect your agent to the stock market

Built for the AI era, our market infrastructure is the best way to power smarter agents.

Institutional-grade market data for AI

For decades, market infrastructure was built for human use. We built the first platform designed for AI agents.

Search across thousands of stocks and assets

Query real-time stock data, fundamentals, and market metrics across thousands of tickers to power your AI agents.

Analyze deep real-time and historical datasets

Give your agents access to deep real-time and historical financial datasets to power analytical workflows and derive actionable insights.

Extract precise context from filings

Pull specific text data from SEC filings and feed them to your agents for deep research and analysis.

Single source of truth

A system of record for the core market data that your financial agents need

Operational KPIs

Sector-specific metrics that drive investment theses

Forward Guidance

Management outlook structured as ranges and point estimates

Non-GAAP Metrics

Adjusted metrics with GAAP equivalents and reconciliation

Income Statements

Revenues, expenses, net income, and profitability metrics

Balance Sheets

Assets, liabilities, and shareholder equity

Cash Flow Statements

Operating, investing, and financing cash flows

Financial Metrics

Valuation, profitability, and efficiency metrics

Executive and director buy/sell transactions

Segment Breakdowns

Revenue and operating income by product and segment

Institutional-grade market data

Verified against SEC filings, earnings releases, call transcripts, and press releases

Methodology

Clean and effortless APIs

Build your first request in seconds. Leave the data wrangling to us.

Start building today

Connect your agent to real-time, structured financial data through a clean, predictable API.

name: Forever Labs
brief:
Product: Forever Labs
One-liner: We bank your stem cells to help you live healthier, longer.
Description: Forever Labs collects and stores adult stem cells, and develops therapies based upon stem cell rejuvenation.
Industry: Healthcare / Therapeutics
Tags: Anti-Aging
target:
Forever Starts Now.

Own Your Biology. Forever.

The most powerful medicine you'll ever use is already inside you.

Today your biology is the youngest it will ever be. A quick, minimally invasive collection preserves your cells at their youngest, so they are always available when you need them.

Your cells peak today and decline from here

As you age, your stem cells decline in both number and potency. Every year you wait means banking older, fewer, less capable cells.

Preserve them now, while they're at their strongest, for the regenerative therapies available today and on the way.

Stem cell potency, relative to your peak at birth

The best time to bank was the day you were born. The second best time is today.

Schematic. Marrow stem cell (CFU-f) frequency falls roughly 1,000-fold from birth to age 80 — Caplan 2007 , Stolzing 2008 . Individual results vary.

Bank now with one of the largest physician networks in the U.S.

Board-certified physicians at the forefront of regenerative medicine, collecting and preserving your cells to clinical standard.

How it works

Your membership is all-inclusive and covers your physician visit, collection procedure, shipping, storage, and portal access. We will never surprise you with unexpected add-on fees.

Choose a provider

Choose a board-certified physician from our provider network — the visit is included in your membership.

Schedule your procedure

Schedule your in-office stem cell collection at your preferred time and location, at no extra cost beyond membership.

Ship your sample

Your stem cells are carefully shipped in insulated packaging to our ISO-accredited labs for processing and viability testing — included with membership.

Store your stem cells

Once cells are tested, we securely store them and send you a photo, or "Cellfie," of your stem cells — viewable anytime in the Forever app (iOS & Android) and client portal alongside your vials and storage location.

Activate your biology

When you're ready to use your stem cells, we coordinate with your physician for preparation and delivery.

Ready to bank your youngest cells?

Safe and compliant activation

We apply best practices while working with your doctor.

Stored cells

Your youngest, healthiest cells stay cryopreserved and ready for the moment you and your doctor decide to use them.

Regulatory allowance

We work only with autologous cells under the FDA 361 pathway, plus emerging state pathways like Florida's SB 1768.

Physician oversight

brief:
Product: Relling
One-liner: deploying the first billion robots for manufacturing
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Robotics
target:
American automation is built on Relling.

Intelligent robots for high-mix assembly, inspection, and cleaning tasks.

Relling deploys frontier AI to extend what robots can do, putting advanced automation within reach of the manufacturers who build America.

How we work. Sixty-two seconds on what a Relling cell is, how it is built, and how it lands on your floor.

More films

Rebuilding American manufacturing expertise.

Engineers, roboticists, and shop-floor veterans making advanced automation practical for small and mid-sized manufacturers.

A team from SpaceX and NASA , with a track record of exceptional engineering.

Automation that's within reach

Advanced robotics shouldn't be a luxury only the biggest plants can afford. We build it to fit shops your size.

It runs from day one

We do the slow, hard engineering before your cell ships, so it arrives tested and dialed in instead of tying up your team for months.

Your people stay safe

Safety is the longest part of our process. Every cell is proven to work safely beside your crew before it ever runs a shift.

Turnkey workcells that run reliably.

Designed, built, and qualified by Relling, tough to stop running.

Turnkey, configured to your part

Sized, fixtured, and tuned before it ships, operated from day one.

Reusable skill library

A new part is a reconfiguration, not a rebuild.

Vision, inspection & technician interface

Sees the part, adjusts in real time, verifies its own work.

What we automate.

One robot. Many tasks. Flexible robots for any task — Relling doesn't believe in human-in-the-loop fixture stations. :)

The hard work happens before we reach your floor.

Integrators build and debug on your site, one step after another, for months. We build and qualify every cell in parallel at Relling HQ, so yours arrives ready to run, online in under 30 days and a fraction of the cost.

Representative figures. Final numbers scoped per deployment.

Built for contact-rich, high-mix production.

From job shops to mid-sized suppliers, configured for the contact-rich, high-mix work in automotive, aerospace, electronics, and defense.

Start with one job. Scale when it pays off.

Built for the way smaller manufacturers actually buy. No plant-wide overhaul, no robotics team to hire.

One cell, one job

We scope a single cell to one part or task on your floor. You prove the idea without betting the business on it.

The hard part is on us

name: Refresh
brief:
Product: Refresh
One-liner: Training gyms for computer use and software engineering work
Description: Building RL environments for coding and computer use.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
target:
Environments for the next capabilities

Refresh builds simulated worlds for coding and computer use, with verifiable rewards that move models forward.

We build artificial worlds where agents are evaluated, trained, and improved through reinforcement learning, spanning the following environment types:

Computer use software worlds

Terminal-Bench style tasks

Long Horizon MCP tool gyms

Accelerating superintelligence

Frequently asked

A quick primer on what we build and how labs and enterprises use it.

What is a simulation environment?

How can enterprises use simulation environments?

Enterprises use Refresh simulation environments to turn their own high-value workflows into measurable, repeatable tasks. With success defined by verifiable rewards rather than subjective judgment, teams can evaluate agents on the work that matters to them and then hill climb, iterating on prompts, tools, and models against an objective signal until the agent reliably completes the workflow.

How do you build environments?

Refresh builds environments by partnering with expert engineers in our network to source real tasks that break the leading models. We reproduce each failure, codify it into a verifiable task, and confirm a high failure rate across frontier models before it goes into an environment, so every task targets a genuine capability gap rather than something models already handle.

Who uses Refresh?

We're lucky to be trusted by frontier AI labs and enterprises evaluating and hill climbing the capabilities of their agents. Labs use Refresh environments and evals to measure and push the frontier of what their models can do, and enterprises use them to turn their own high-value workflows into measurable, trainable tasks.

How can I work with Refresh?

Email contact@refresh.dev to request environments or discuss a bespoke dataset, or see our careers page .

One memory. Every workflow.

Quantstamp is a global leader in blockchain security. Since 2017, we’ve secured billions in digital assets and worked with some of the most recognized names in web3.

Trusted by the industry’s most notable projects

Quantstamp has been our dedicated partner for audits over the past year, and the experience has been nothing short of outstanding. We look forward to continuing our partnership!

Quantstamp has been an essential partner in enhancing the security of Venus Protocol. Their audits are always thorough and detailed, helping us identify and address any potential vulnerabilities. With their expertise in DeFi security, we've successfully strengthened our platform and improved the protection of our users' assets. We highly recommend Quantstamp to any project seeking reliable and high-quality security audits.

As we continue to push the boundaries of innovation, Quantstamp has been an invaluable partner in ensuring the security and integrity of our platforms and smart contracts. We deeply appreciate the expertise and professionalism they bring to every engagement and look forward to continuing our collaboration as we grow.

target:
The AI Code Reviewer.

AI agents that review and test pull requests with full context of the codebase.

“ We've tried more code review tools than I can count. Greptile outperforms them all by a mile. Honestly the only AI reviewer that doesn't annoy the s**t out of me. ”

CTO @ Brex

James Reggio

How Greptile reviews every PR

Greptile constructs a graph index of your codebase, then uses a swarm of agents to catch potential issues that humans might miss

Indexes your codebase

Builds a graph of your repo - files, functions, and dependencies.

Swarm of agents review the PR

Parallel agents review changes, assess their impact beyond the diff, and flag issues.

Greptile learns your codebase over time

Reads other engineers' comments to understand your coding standards.

Catch them all

From style violations to security risks and multi-file logical bugs

NVIDIA

Unbalanced CUDA release wipes context

Meta PyTorch

Undefined method breaks every step()

Solana

Mid-loop overflow leaves orphaned keys

Reviews that adapt to your team

From custom rules to continuous learning, Greptile gets smarter about your codebase with every review.

Your house, your rules

Write standards in plain English, point Greptile at repo-specific context, and enforce the patterns your team actually cares about on every PR.

We're getting to know each other

Greptile learns your codebase and coding standards by reading your team' PR comments.

Designed to work seamlessly with every coding agent, Greptile serves as the unified validation agent for all code changes.

Connect Greptile to any AI agent to share comment context.

Let any coding agent iterate with Greptile until all issues are resolved.

Security-First Design

Built for enterprises across defense, healthcare, and financial services.

Host Greptile in your own air-gapped environment.

SOC 2 Compliance

Independent audits, reports available on request.

Enterprise Ready

SSO, audit logs, dedicated support.

name: Frekil
brief:
Product: Frekil
One-liner: RWE Generation in minutes
Description: Today, it takes months to understand how drugs perform in the real world, delaying safety insights and leaving patients exposed to unknown risks and benefits for far too long. Frekil turns that months-long process into minutes, with full auditability and scientific rigor. Frekil accelerates real world evidence (RWE) generation for life sciences companies on their own clinical data from months to minutes.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Health Tech, B2B, Biotech, Healthcare, AI
target:
RWE Generation in minutes.

Test hypotheses, build cohorts and run end-to-end studies on your own clinical data with self-improving AI agents - helping revise, discuss and ground outputs in literature at every step.

What our users say.

“ I ran a target trial emulation to compare ACE inhibitors vs ARBs for patients with heart failure. The tool generated the exact statistical code I needed to handle confounding, and gave a transparent, auditable trace from the raw data to the final survival analysis. ”

“ We used the pipeline to validate a new prognostic score for sepsis. The reproducibility is impressive. It generated a complete set of TFLs along with the underlying scripts used to query and structure the hospital records, giving me exactly what I needed for a publication-ready paper. ”

“ I needed to extract a complex patient cohort and run a sensitivity analysis on treatment sequences. The platform handled the temporal data mapping automatically and gave me the transparent statistical code required to independently verify the clinical science. ”

From raw data to publication-ready evidence.

Frekil uses a continuous, self-improving AI engine to automate the entire epidemiological workflow—while giving you full control through conversational interfaces and feedback loops.

Chat with your data

Connect your EHR, claims, or registries and initiate studies using natural language. The agent structures your inquiry and interrogates the data directly.

Refine each step

You are never out of the loop. Review causal DAGs, adjust cohort definitions, and tweak statistical plans through intuitive feedback before execution.

The 8-Stage Pipeline

Literature Review

Question Clarifier

Cohort Builder

Causal DAG Builder

SAP Generator

Data Extractor

SAP Executor

Report Writer

See exactly how it works.

Dive deep into the technical architecture. Explore how we map data to OMOP CDM, account for immortal time bias, and execute sandboxed statistical code.

No clinical data ever touches AI.

AI generates the code. The code runs in a sandbox. The data never leaves. We built a hard architectural wall between the models and your patient records. This isn't a policy. It's how the system is built.

Stitch the data once. Generate evidence infinitely.

Frekil runs the same evidence infrastructure across every RWE use case — label expansion, post-market safety, payer value dossiers, competitive intelligence, and trial feasibility — tailored to your specific research question and output requirements. And because its agents are self-improving, every study you run makes the next one sharper.

name: Luca IQ
brief:
Product: Luca IQ
One-liner: API-first tax engine for CPA firms and developers
Description: Luca IQ is an API for deterministic tax calculation and an IRS Authorized e-filing engine - the foundation for accounting firms and fintechs building on tax.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
Tags: B2B, API, Infrastructure, AI
target:
First Modern Professional Tax Software Made Exclusively for Firms

Y Backed by Y Combinator

From client intake and tax preparation through e-filing, review, and delivery, Luca IQ helps your firm complete accurate returns without disconnected tools or manual busywork.

Why Luca IQ exists

Tax software wasn't built for how firms work today. It was built for a desktop era of disconnected systems and manual data entry. That's why accountants still spend hours retyping information and moving data between tools.

We're rebuilding tax software from the ground up. Made by CPAs.

How it works

From Client Upload To Review, Step By Step.

Everything your clients need. One secure link.

Send clients a document request list and smart questionnaire, then let them securely upload everything online. In-office workflows are supported too.

Automated organized workpapers, ready for review.

Review structured source documents, resolve missing information instantly, and apply judgment where it matters.

Review the return, not the data entry.

Review the prepared return, make adjustments, and trace every number through a complete audit trail.

From signature to filed return.

Collect Form 8879 e-signatures, deliver the completed return, and e-file with the IRS from one workflow.

Build tax products without legacy tax software.

The modern tax engine, behind a single API.

The claim

Review-Ready in Minutes

We eliminate hours of document organization and data entry so your team can focus on review and professional judgment. Every number traces back to its source, every calculation is auditable, and every position is clearly explained.

Auditable, Not a Black Box

Every field traces back to a source document. Nothing is a guess.

Human in the Loop, Always

Firms review every return before delivery. Automation removes the busywork, not the judgment.

US Based Customer Service

Luca IQ has US based customer service with a team of CPAs to help guide you through busy season.

Built for Busy Season

Handles volume the same way in March as it does in June. No slowdown when it matters most.

Other vendors sell you a tool. We built the platform underneath it.

Our story

Built by a CPA Who Lived the Problem

brief:
Product: Revenir
One-liner: First API solution for tax returns.
Description: Your free money back to you with the trust of your own bank. Individuals and corporations to claim back their value-added tax globally.
Industry: Fintech / Consumer Finance
Tags: Fintech, SaaS, Travel
target:
Automating tax recovery through partnerships with banks.

80% of VAT goes unclaimed. Don’t miss out on eligible cash. Revenir makes VAT refunds simple and hassle-free, ensuring we reclaim what is owed.

We partner with Banks

Enhance your customer experience by partnering with Revenir. Our white-label solutions allow banks and card providers to offer hassle-free VAT reclaim services directly to their customers. Whether through API integration or a dedicated portal, Revenir adds value, drives customer satisfaction, and helps you stand out in a competitive market. Plus, there’s potential for additional revenue generation from the service. Let’s work together to make VAT refunds effortless for your customers.

Our trusted network of collaborators and partners

Without Revenir

VAT reclaim has historically been a tricky process to navigate for customers, with paper forms and long queues. Revenir streamline this process by partnering with card providers.

Hours of queuing at the airport

Clunky, confusing, form-driven process

Reclaim merchants take a >30% commission fee

With Revenir

Simply make your purchases, upload a picture of your receipt to your banking app and we’ll handle the rest. Your VAT reclaim will turn up in your account! Revenir automate form filling using innovative AI technology.

Entirely digital process – no queues in sight.

No paperwork required

Automated refunds within 48 hours

Improving the user journey for VAT reclaims

With Revenir, there’s no need to wait in line or fill out complex forms at airports. Receive a VAT refund directly to through your bank account, hassle-free. If you like the sound of that, join to our waitlist and we will keep you updated with our partnerships pipeline.

Our Technology

At Revenir, we leverage advanced technologies including machine learning, optical recognition, and proprietary algorithms to simplify the VAT reclaim process for travelers. Our platform identifies eligible purchases automatically, ensuring that you receive the VAT refunds you’re entitled to without the usual hassle.

Through strategic partnerships and agreements with local tax authorities, Revenir facilitates seamless processing and swift delivery of VAT refunds directly to your account. Experience the future of VAT reclaim with Revenir – efficient, reliable, and designed to maximize your savings.

AI and Machine Learning

Revenir securely leverages the latest AI technology to interpret forms, receipts and data to streamline our services for our customers.

Pattern Matching

Revenir are a technology company adept at pattern matching, integrating technology through a unique AWS architecture.

API integration

brief:

One-liner: The AI copilot for in-person conversations.
Description: AirCaps is bringing AI assistance to in-person conversations. Our AI-copilot provides live captions, translations, AI meeting notes and insights for in-person conversations in real-time. It's deployed as an app for lightweight AR glasses so you can see visual information overlaid onto your field of vision. You can think of it like a Zoom AI meeting assistant or Granola, but for in-person conversations, and with the ability to proactively help you in real-time, not just after the conversation.
Industry: Consumer
target:
AirCaps Smart Glasses — Elevate Your Conversations

Never miss a word. Never get left out of the conversation. AirCaps are lightweight smart glasses (49g) that display real-time captions, translate 60+ languages, and provide AI meeting intelligence directly in your field of view. Designed for the Deaf and Hard of Hearing community, international travelers, and professionals. Starting at $599.

Real-Time Captions

97% accuracy, even in noisy restaurants, parties, and crowded spaces. 300ms latency — captions faster than you can blink. Powered by a 4-microphone beamforming array for superior noise isolation.

Translation in 60+ Languages

Translate conversations in real-time across every continent. Close deals in Tokyo, catch up with family in Mexico City, order dinner in Paris. 95% accuracy with context-aware AI that understands idioms, slang, and cultural nuances.

AI Meeting Intelligence

Never miss a detail. Never forget a commitment. Get real-time insights, automatic meeting notes with action items, MEDDIC tracking, speaker identification, and searchable conversation history. Built for sales reps, doctors, founders, executives, and lawyers.

How AirCaps Works

Four microphones capture nearby speech. AI converts it into text, or a translation, in a fraction of a second. A private display built into the lenses shows the result, visible only to you. See the technology in action with our captioning demo and translation demo .

Built for However You Communicate

brief:

Description: Explore Aria’s B2B financing solutions with seamless API integration for improved payment experiences, risk scoring, and invoice financing.
target:
Make late payment irrelevant for your business

Embed instant payment into your platform. Your suppliers get paid today. Your buyers pay on their terms. Aria takes the credit risk — API-first, live in weeks.

Invoice confirmed. Aria pays the supplier within 24 hours. The buyer settles on their usual terms. Your balance sheet stays clean.

92% of B2B buyers approved in seconds. They pay in 30, 60, or 90 days. You get paid today. Your brand, your checkout, Aria’s financing.

Aria is the infrastructure making late payment irrelevant in B2B

Making instant payment the default for B2B marketplaces

Stop losing suppliers to platforms that pay faster

Turn every invoice into revenue

Offer payment flexibility without becoming a lender

Optimise working capital without operational overhead

See how Malt uses Aria to empower their global expansion journey

Instant financing taken care of, every step of the way

Risk assessment, underwriting, payment, insurance, collections, reconciliation. B2B payments are infrastructure problems disguised as transactions.

We handle every step.

Payment flows, handled.

Process B2B payments across 100+ countries and currencies with one integration. SEPA, SWIFT, FPS – we handle the rails. Dedicated IBANs, automated reconciliation, configurable payment flows. Risk checks, automated.

Dozens of risk checks that traditionally take days – debtor solvency, KYC/KYB across 100+ countries, fraud detection, invoice validation – now processed automatically with 92% instant decisioning. Non-payment, insured.

Invoices are purchased outright, not financed. Buyer defaults? Aria absorbs it. Disputes? Aria resolves them. Collections? Aria handles it. Zero credit risk on your balance sheet. Payment becomes infrastructure, not liability.

Embed instant financing in weeks

Launch invoice financing without rebuilding everything. Aria’s API lets you pay suppliers instantly and get reimbursed later, all within your existing workflows.

Start paying faster

One-liner: Building low-cost cruise missiles
Industry: Industrials / Aviation and Space
Tags: Aerospace, Industrial
target:
make more missiles

INTRODUCING MAV & goose

WHY WE BUILD

HOW WE BUILD

We Build FOR THE CONFLICT WE FACE

mass manufacturing

By combining commercially available components with vertical integration of critical subsystems, we control both cost and supply. Simplified tooling and minimized part count enable automotive-level production, reaching hundreds of thousands per year while driving down costs by orders of magnitude.

Containerized Launch

Containerized launch keeps our systems hidden until the moment of fire, with up to 64 Goose vertically launching from a single 20-foot CONEX. Rapidly mobile and forward-deployable, these launchers turn ordinary logistics assets into high-capacity strike batteries.

PACK DYNAMICS

Swarms of smaller, easily producible missiles can accomplish missions that today rely on exquisite, high-cost systems. Our platforms are meant to be launched in masses, with only some providing advanced guidance and others carrying payloads, networked together to overwhelm defenses.

EXPORT-FRIENdLY

Our systems are export-ready from day one, built with modular designs and adaptable architectures. Allies can integrate their own components and leverage local supply chains, enabling faster adoption and scalable production abroad.

CAREERS

Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare IT
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Healthcare
target:
Intelligence that powers healthcare revenue.

AI employees built for coding, claim management and denial management workflows—working alongside your team to deliver cleaner claims, fewer denials, and faster reimbursement.

Our AI Agents Are Live At

RESULTS WE'RE PROUD OF

Measurable revenue outcomes.

Featured Story

See why a CEO with 30+ years in RCM recommends CombineHealth

CombineHealth helped us reach 97% coding accuracy and cut our turnaround time by nearly half. Within weeks, we saw far fewer charts waiting in the queue.”

More Revenue Cycle Leaders. More Proven Outcomes

“For an emergency physician group our size, even a small reduction in denials has a significant financial impact. CombineHealth helped us achieve a 10% denial reduction.”

“Amy delivered 97% coding accuracy even at high volume and gave our coders more time to focus on the charts that needed them most.”

“The value wasn’t just better coding. We were surprised by how Amy identified 5× more CDI opportunities than our traditional workflow!”

“An 85% faster eligibility verification process and 6% fewer eligibility-related denials gave our billing team the efficiency we'd been missing.”

THE COMBINEHEALTH ADVANTAGE

End-to-End AI Revenue Cycle Automation Platform

Built for Cleaner Claims, Fewer Denials, and Faster Reimbursement

CombineHealth's proprietary AI revenue cycle automation platform brings together agentic AI, deep revenue cycle expertise, payer-policy logic, and continuous learning from payer responses and denial patterns to help healthcare organizations automate complex RCM workflows at scale with greater control and visibility.

OUR PLATFORM. REAL IMPACT.

Trusted AI Built for Real RCM Work

Coding & Upstream Intelligence for Cleaner Claims

AI employees help control the upstream workflows that shape claim quality — from eligibility and CDI to coding and claim submission — so teams can catch issues before claims reach the payer.

Transparent AI With Configurable Rules

AI employees operate within configurable workflow logic, payer rules, thresholds, and review requirements — while showing the rationale behind actions, recommendations, and exceptions.

Resolves Denials. Prevents Repeat Issues.

AI employees help automate AR follow-up, denial workflows, and appeal drafting — while feeding payer outcomes back into upstream workflows - eligibility, coding, claims - to reduce repeat issues.

Integration with Major EHRs and PMSs

Customer Success Stories

CombineHealth AI Outperforms Expert Coders Across 1,000 Emergency Department Charts

A parallel coding study showed 97% coding accuracy, 50% faster turnaround, and 5× more documentation gaps identified with Amy.

Eligibility-Related Denials Reduced by 8%

A hospital group achieves 80% faster insurance eligibility verification and reduces eligibility-related denials by 8%.

name: Upwave
brief:
Product: Upwave
One-liner: Marketing analytics for the world's biggest brand marketers
Description: Upwave is the #1 marketing analytics platform for the world's biggest brand marketers. Upwave's software shows marketers the impact and effectiveness of their brand investments. We use data science and machine learning to answer an age-old question: does brand advertising work? Upwave's enterprise platform is used by the blue-chip marketers like Unilever, Clorox, Verizon, American Express, T-Mobile, Corona, State Farm, Uber, and dozens more.
Industry: B2B / Operations
target:
The Brand Outcomes Measurement Platform

Dynamic, Real-Time Dashboard to Maximize Brand Lift

With Upwave’s real-time platform, marketers can create dynamic campaign dashboards, access all modules, and easily see if the campaign is driving lift.

Cross-Channel Coverage

Cross-channel measurement with accurate, privacy-safe data in a unified dashboard for CTV, Digital, Social, Linear, Addressable, Retail Media, and Streaming Audio.

Granular Cut-Level Controls

Evaluate Brand Lift at a tactical level, giving granular insights to compare performance of media, creative and more.

Better Math and Methodology

Upwave’s methodology is designed, and meticulously checked, to ensure our sample is high-quality, census-representative and clean of bias or other interference.

Put a Performance Lens on Brand Investment

Upwave allows marketers to regularly measure, improve, and maximize with an always-on, analytical rigor for brand campaigns.

AI-Powered Insights and Reports

Bayes, Upwave's AI Agent, helps customers turn data into digestible, on-demand insights both in-platform and available to download–at the click of a button.

Actionable Optimization Recommendations

Upwave’s Brand Optimization is purpose-built as a tool for decision makers to clearly understand over–and underperforming– tactics, without a statistician on staff.

On-Target Profiles and Reach

Upwave uses real attitudinal data and machine learning to verify whether a campaign is reaching your brand-specific audience– beyond age and gender.

Hear from Our Partners

What’s New with Upwave

Upwave Announces Predictive Brand Lift™ in Closed Beta

name: Playgent
brief:
Product: Playgent
One-liner: Sandboxes for AI agents
Description: When enterprise agents fail in production, the conditions that caused the failure are critical: user state, data, tool calls, and context. Without a way to recreate these conditions, teams can't fix what broke. Playgent provides infrastructure to create high-fidelity sandbox environments for AI agents. Our environments come packaged as a single MCP url where tool calls are mocked, authentication is abstracted away, and test data can be initialized via natural language or JSON specifications.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare IT
Tags: SaaS, Infrastructure, AI
target:
RL Environments for Finance .

Post-training for

What is an RL environment?

A reinforcement learning environment is a simulated world where agents learn through interaction .

Agents take actions, observe the resulting state, and receive rewards that guide their learning. In finance, this means realistic market conditions, document processing workflows, and decision-making scenarios that mirror real-world trading, compliance, and operations.

The quality of your environment determines the quality of your agent.

We build tasks , verifiers , and environments that teach agents how to think.

Through our network of expert contributors, we curate challenging financial tasks, design verification rubrics, and create realistic environments for post-training. Every task is benchmarked, every environment is production-ready.

See our research →

Purpose-built for Finance and Banking

Real tasks that drive real results.

LBO Returns Analysis

Assuming the Company is acquired as of 31 December 2025 for a price of EUR 45.0bn (the price includes the existing debt being refinanced) by a private investor committing 50.0% of the price in equity while the remaining amount is funded via non-amortizing senior secured bank debt bearing an annual cost of 7.5% with a 5-year maturity, calculate the cash proceeds and IRR for the private investor using an exit multiple of 12.0x the EBITDA 2030 (EUR 6.0bn). Assume the exit takes place on 1st January 2031.

Normalize Earnings/Adjusted EBITDA

Normalize 2024 earnings by identifying any non-recurring operating items embedded in the financials and producing Adjusted EBITDA for 2024 with a clear reconciliation from reported to adjusted.

Synergies & Integration Analysis

Analyze potential cost and revenue synergies from the proposed merger, quantifying integration costs, branch consolidation savings, and cross-sell opportunities. Produce a detailed synergies breakdown with implementation timeline and risk factors.

Frequently Asked Questions

Learn how our expert network powers RL environments.

We work with a network of finance experts who curate challenging tasks, design verification rubrics, and create realistic environments for agents to operate in. This expert-driven approach ensures our environments reflect real-world complexity and domain-specific nuance.

We benchmark agent performance across our expert-curated tasks and sell this data as production-ready RL environments for post-training. Our environments include tasks, verifiers, and the infrastructure needed to train agents that excel at financial decision-making.

Contact us to discuss your use case and access our RL environments. We'll help you integrate our data into your training pipeline and start improving your agents' performance on financial tasks.

name: Golpo
brief:
Product: Golpo
One-liner: Create Whiteboard Explainer Videos with AI from a Prompt or Document
Description: Golpo AI is the world's best platform to create fully produced whiteboard explainer videos from just a prompt or document. Instead of hiring an agency, you simply input a prompt or document explaining what you want, and in minutes you get a whiteboard explainer video in a style similar to Khan Academy or RSA Animate. After creation, you have the ability to edit all aspects of the video with just prompts.
Industry: B2B / Productivity
Tags: Education, eLearning, Video, Sales Enablement, Marketing
target:
AI whiteboard explainer videos from any document/prompt

Trusted by 190,000+ users at top companies

From prompt to polished whiteboard video in under 10 minutes

Enter your prompt and any documents. Set your voice and video style. Click Generate.

Get your generated whiteboard video in minutes

Everything you need to make whiteboard videos your way

Incorporate real images and videos in the AI explainer

Drop in real photos, screenshots, logos, or video clips and Golpo weaves them directly into the whiteboard explainer, with your actual footage and images alongside the animated illustrations. Learn more here .

Pen in hand

A live hand draws every frame as narration plays, matching the authentic feel of a real whiteboard explainer, not a flat motion graphic. Learn more here .

Voice instructions

Direct the narrator in plain English. Set tone, pacing, accent, and emphasis, and the generated voice follows your instructions. Learn more here .

Video instructions

Steer how the video is built with high-level guidance (focus areas, sections to skip, visual treatments) before a single frame is generated. Learn more here .

10+ video styles

From crisp sharpie sketches to blackboard chalk to technical diagrams, pick a style that matches your brand, tone, or channel. Learn more here .

Videos up to 10 minutes long

Generate long-form explainers, full lessons, or feature breakdowns, up to 10 minutes in a single pass. Learn more here .

Bring your own script or audio

Write the script yourself, or upload pre-recorded narration. Golpo uses it as-is and time-aligns the animation to your voice. Learn more here .

45+ languages

Generate videos in any language. One prompt, global reach, native-sounding narration in every supported locale. Learn more here .

Vertical video

Export in vertical (9:16) for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts, or standard landscape for YouTube and embeds. Learn more here .

Solutions

Enterprise Learning and Training

Create engaging training and L&D videos that employees actually watch. Onboard new hires, roll out policy updates, and deliver consistent content at scale.

Turn internal docs, SOPs, and compliance material into whiteboard explainers in minutes — no production team required.

Educational Content

Transform lesson plans, textbooks, and study guides into captivating whiteboard videos that keep students engaged.

name: Axal
brief:
Product: Axal
One-liner: We design, assemble, and test custom PCBs fast.
Description: We help companies get custom PCBs built without having to manage multiple vendors themselves. We review or create PCB designs, find the right manufacturer, coordinate production, inspect and test every board, handle any manufacturing issues, and deliver the finished boards directly to your office. Our goal is to reduce manufacturing errors, shorten iteration cycles, and get your boards to you as quickly as possible without compromising on quality.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Hardware, Robotics, Manufacturing, Electronics
target:
We design, assemble, and test custom PCBs.

Y Backed by Y Combinator

Axal is an engineering team that handles PCB design or design review, component sourcing, assembly, testing, and delivery. Our goal is to get you a working board fast.

Free 30-minute engineering review. A practical way to start.

Breadboard / dev board

Custom board design

Assembled & verified

HOW IT WORKS

One team from design to delivered board.

We handle every step of the PCB process, helping hardware teams move at software speed.

Design the board, or review the one you already have.

Schematic design, component selection, PCB layout, power design, DFM, and revisions. If you already have files, we review them for issues before you spend money on a build.

Firmware and software development are not included.

Source the parts the board needs.

We handle BOM sourcing and procurement so the right components are ready for assembly, including alternatives when parts are long-lead or unavailable.

Assemble the boards in-house.

PCB assembly happens at Axal. We place and solder components, run the build, and handle rework when something needs fixing. Your board does not get handed off to an outside assembler.

Test before anything ships to you.

We check boards with methods such as X-ray inspection and electrical testing, and we document what was verified. Problems get caught before boards leave for your office.

Receive verified boards.

We ship tested boards with build and quality documentation, so you know what was assembled and what was checked.

ANY STEP OF THE PROCESS

We help at any step, and we move fast.

Design, components, assembly, testing, or the full path. Bring what you have. We start quickly and keep the build moving.

An idea

You know what the product needs to do. We help turn that into a board that can actually be built.

A working prototype

It works on an Arduino, Raspberry Pi, or similar board. We help you move to a custom PCB without losing momentum.

An existing PCB

You need a redesign for cost, reliability, form factor, or production. We pick it up and keep going.

Finished design files

The design is done. We source components, assemble in-house, test, and ship.

A partner that answers the phone 24/7.

WHY AXAL

Less coordination. Fewer late surprises.

You can piece a build together yourself. Teams come to Axal when that path is costing too much time, too many emails, and too many failed iterations.

name: Sherloq
brief:
Product: Sherloq
One-liner: One place for all your queries, directly on your SQL editor
Description: Companies use Sherloq as their single source of truth for their SQL on top of their existing data stack. Today, data-driven organizations face the challenge of giving 2 of their data analysts the same task and getting 2 totally different results from their analysis. Although SQL is the #1 coding language for data analysis, it is still managed independently on each user's internal documentation tools (notepads, Slack channels, or docx files).
Industry: B2B / Analytics
Tags: Generative AI, SaaS, B2B, Analytics, AI
target:
AI Data Agent for your SQL

Based on your context, directly in your editor

Meet AI SQL Chat: The new way to interact with your SQL

No more generic code. Sherloq feeds the AI Chat with YOUR own SQL.

AI that knows your SQL, because it’s built on it

Sherloq helps you build an AI-ready SQL repository from your real work

Knowledge on-the-fly

Save and manage queries from your editor, or import existing SQL and logic from anywhere.

Version Control

Create versions of your queries without going through the long processes of regular code.

Permissions and Teams

Manage who can view and edit each folder and SQL. Easily create and share with specific people or teams.

Works as a plugin, no integrations needed. We import your queries from wherever they are.

What our users are saying

There’s definitely a need for something like this so that I can easily access my code. The way we’ve been handling things up until now feels obsolete.

The snippets give me a great starting point for writing queries without having to rewrite everything from scratch. I can start with the basics and then customize as needed. It’s very easy.

I’m super happy with the product! We had a lot of attempts to share the queries inside the team, and all of them failed. This one works, does it's job in an amazing way - and also logs your own queries, which is pretty helpful as well. Great.

We use Sherloq, which is super easy for saving frequently used queries and also for things you may need to use in the future. You can also categorize by topic, write a description, share. Very comfortable.

Love using Sherloq! Before, I would save my SQL in hundreds of different places which would take me so much time, but now I can easily find exactly what I'm looking for. Can't go back after using it.

We're happy to use your platform every single day!

Data security is our top priority

We're SOC2 compliant , and don't have any integrations into your data or metadata, read more here . We maintain strict infrastructure security with SSO support and on-prem solutions for Enterprise plans.

Up and running in less than minutes

Download the Chrome extension or Intellij plugin to get started

One-liner: Get Paid for Family Caregiving
Industry: Healthcare / Consumer Health and Wellness
Tags: Consumer Health Services, Healthcare, Health Insurance
target:
You Already Care for Them. Now, Get Paid for It.

CareOasis helps Ohio families turn home caregiving into a supported, paid role. Secure your loved one’s comfort while securing your financial future.

Become a Paid Caregiver in Ohio

When a family member or friend needs in-home care due to age, disability, or illness, it’s often a loved one who steps up to help. If you’re already providing daily care, you may be wondering: can I get paid for this in Ohio? The good news is—yes, in many cases, you can.

CareOasis helps family caregivers in Ohio get paid for the care they provide.

Not in Ohio?

CareOasis currently serves Ohio families, but paid family caregiving programs exist across the country. Our free state-by-state guides explain how to get paid for caring for a loved one where you live.

How to Apply for Caregiver Compensation in 4 Easy Steps

We make the process as simple as possible, with a dedicated team to support you along the way.

1. Check Eligibility

Use our simple online form to see if you and your loved one qualify. We'll ask a few basic questions about your caregiving situation and the care recipient's needs.

2. Complete Enrollment

Our team will guide you through the enrollment process for the right Ohio Medicaid program, whether it's PASSPORT, MyCare, or Structured Family Caregiving. We handle the paperwork so you can focus on what matters.

3. Get Certified & Trained

We provide or connect you with the necessary training to meet state requirements. Our goal is to ensure you feel confident and prepared in your role as a paid caregiver.

4. Start Receiving Pay

Once enrolled and certified, you'll begin receiving regular compensation for your dedicated care. We manage the billing and payments, ensuring you get paid on time.

brief:
Product: Prequel
One-liner: Helping B2B co's sync data to their customers
Description: Prequel makes it easy for companies to share data with their customers. It helps you export data directly to your customer's Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks, or other data warehouse on an ongoing basis.
Industry: B2B / Analytics
Tags: SaaS, Analytics, Data Engineering
target:
The API for data warehouse integrations

Replicate live data from your platform to your customer's data warehouse. Sync data from your customer's data warehouse into your platform. Securely and at scale. White-labeled end to end.

The best way to build and manage data warehouse products

Support every customer with one platform

Prequel is compatible with every major database, data warehouse, and object storage service. Transfer up to 100 million rows per destination, every 15 minutes.

Deliver a seamless, native experience

Use our React SDK to embed Prequel in your product. Customers will be able to set up their destination, choose the tables they want, and select their sync frequency.

Secure at every step

Data is replicated using ephemeral workers, so no data remains on Prequel's servers. Prequel can be deployed privately, on our cloud, or using a private cloud.

Give your customers analysis-ready data

Product leaders rely on Prequel to send trillions of rows of data to their customers every month.

Why product leaders build data products with Prequel

Fastest time to market

With Prequel, you can add 20+ platforms in less time than it would take to integrate with one data warehouse.

Smallest impact on teams

There's no need to become an expert in dozens of products or build pipelines for each platform and region.

No surprise charges

We charge for destinations, not data. Budgets are more predictable as a result.

Optimized compute costs

We invest in tools that help you optimize your source query to minimize compute costs.

Ready to see Prequel in action?

Book a demo to see how Prequel can work for you.

Smart Sourcing in Procurement where AI makes a Difference

Find your suppliers 10x faster

Alpas Team

Schedule a product call

Geopolitical tensions

name: Verge Genomics
brief:
Product: Verge Genomics
One-liner: We use human data and AI to develop better drugs faster.
Description: Verge uses artificial intelligence and human data to develop better drugs faster. Verge has an end-to-end technology-driven drug discovery and development platform, featuring one of the field’s largest and most comprehensive proprietary patient genomics datasets from human tissue. Verge uses machine learning to mine this data and develops these insights into new drugs using it’s human-centric biology and chemistry platforms.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
target:
Frontier AI for human biology, starting with the brain.

All-in-human foundation models to transform neuroscience drug development.

Our Mission

Over the last decade, we have built one of the largest proprietary collections of multimodal patient brain data. We’ve used that data to train foundation models that can reason about what’s happening inside a patient’s brain, and predict how it will change with treatment. We’re now using that platform to usher in a new era of precision neurology, where we can predict which targets to drug, and in which patients.

Run smaller, faster, lower-risk clinical trials.

Enriching a Parkinson’s trial for L-DOPA responders with vBx-1.0 lifts the responder fraction from 52% to 69% — shrinking the required enrollment by 43% at fixed power.

Human Data

Multi-modal patient data directly from the brain.

The brain is the molecular ground truth for neurological disease, but it’s one of the hardest datasets to collect. Over a decade, we’ve built one of the world’s largest proprietary multi-modal neuroscience patient datasets of its kind: deep molecular profiling on 12,000+ brains, across 6,000 patients including paired proteomic, genomic, and clinical data. Plus a physical inventory of 900+ frozen brain tissue samples spanning the major neurodegenerative diseases.

Foundation Models

Building world models of patient biology.

We are building the first AI system designed to reason about neurological disease at the patient level. The output is a virtual biopsy of the brain — a reconstructed picture of what’s happening inside a patient’s brain, generated from a routine blood draw.

Applications

From better targets to better trials.

Our platform is solving the hardest problems in drug discovery — which targets to drug, in which patients — to increase the probability of clinical success. Drug developers can use our platform to power target discovery, target characterization, biomarker identification, and patient stratification — the full set of questions needed to design programs that work in humans.

Our Research

STAT News: “Verge Labs’ new AI model solves patient stratification problems for neurology clinical trials”

Verge’s CEO, Alice Zhang, and Head of Product & Engineering, Emily Ripka, spoke to STAT News about the release of vBx-1.0, the company’s breakthrough foundation model for precision neurology.

Verge Labs Unveils vBx: A Breakthrough Foundation Model for Precision Neurology

The new ‘virtual biopsy’ model predicts brain activity, therapy response, and side effects in patients with up to 3x greater accuracy than previous state-of-the-art models.

Introducing vBx-1.0

name: Golf
brief:
Product: Golf
One-liner: Agentic AI Security and Governance
Description: Golf gives enterprises visibility into shadow AI and control over AI agents and MCP. See what's connected, enforce policies, and generate audit trails - all from one place.
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, Security, Infrastructure
target:
Your agents connect to your data & you can’t see it

Your teams connect Cursor, Claude Code, and Copilot to production via MCP. These connections bypass your SIEM, DLP, and identity layer. Golf discovers every one of them.

This is already happening inside your organization

Engineers connected Cursor to your codebase

It reads customer records, deal pipelines, and contact lists via MCP. It can update fields, create records, export data. Your security team was never notified — because the engineer set it up in 30 seconds.

Claude Code is querying your production database

Someone connected it via MCP. It's closing issues, changing priorities, reassigning work across your org. No one approved it. No one's reviewing what it does.

Copilot is pushing to your reposright now

It injects hidden instructions into tool responses. Your agent follows them - exfiltrating data, modifying records, escalating permissions. It looks normal. Your security stack doesn't see it.

The control layer for AI access

Between tools and data. Every connection discovered. Enforced. Audited.

Discover. Enforce. Audit.

Three capabilities. One platform. Every AI agent and MCP connection — without controlling the LLM or changing how anyone works.

Discovery

See every AI agent, MCP server, and data connection in your environment — including ones you didn't know existed.

Monitor AI tools and MCP connections. Track usage, data access, and actions.

Enforcement

Granular policies per tool, team, and data source. Block PII exposure, credential leaks, and unauthorized access in real-time. Sub-ms latency.

IAM policies prevent PII leaks and unauthorized access. Instant rollback with no friction.

Audit

90-day trail of every prompt, action, and data access. Pre-mapped to SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, FINRA. Evidence export in minutes.

Track all agent interactions and MCP calls. Create compliance reports quickly.

Your gateway has a blind spot. It's every agent you didn't build.

AI gateways sit between your app and the LLM - useless for third-party agents like Claude, Copilot, and ChatGPT that make their own calls. Golf operates at the MCP layer. Every agent, every tool, every connection - visible and governed.

Live in minutes. Governed in days.

Deploy & Discover

Golf deploys across endpoints and discovers every AI tool, MCP server, and agent connection — including shadow infrastructure.

Enforce & Control

All traffic flows through the MCP Gateway, where you define granular policies per tool, team, and data source with sub ms enforcement.

Identity & Audit

name: Modern Health
brief:
Product: Modern Health
One-liner: A mental health benefits platform for employers.
Description: Modern Health is the leading mental wellness platform that combines clinically validated assessments, personalized stress management support, an international network of certified behavioral health coaches, and licensed therapists to deliver mental health support across a broad range of individual needs. Modern Health empowers employers to lead the charge in helping their employees be less stressed, more engaged, and happier through evidence-based technology and professional support.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare Services
Tags: Mental Health Tech, Health Tech
target:
The Global Standard in Mental Health

Modern Health delivers evidence-based, equitable mental health services worldwide — from self-guided tools to crisis care — ensuring our members have the right support wherever in the world they’re located .

Solve your greatest business challenges with Modern Health

Boost productivity and prevent burnout

Equip your workforce with the mental resilience tools they need to combat burnout and maintain peak performance.

Optimize operational efficiency

Optimize your organization's performance with our sustainable mental health model. We address long-term needs, reduce absenteeism, boost retention, and enhance operational efficiency—all while improving your bottom line.

Attract and retain top talent

Elevate your employer brand and attract top-tier talent in a competitive marketplace by showcasing your commitment to employee well-being through comprehensive mental health support.

The Modern Health Difference

One platform, designed for your entire team

When mental health benefits only support employees with more severe mental health concerns, organizations miss key opportunities to prevent burnout and reduce costs. Our Adaptive Care Model offers a full spectrum of support, flexing to meet clinical and subclinical needs.

Built for global access and equity

We’ve curated an elite, proprietary provider network that spans 200+ countries and territories, 80+ languages, and a wide range of specialties. This lets you offer culturally responsive care anywhere, with real-time global insights at your fingertips.

Sustainable pricing, proven value

Our pricing model is as flexible as our care. Choose between PEPM or usage-based pricing to meet your financial goals while delivering measurable outcomes across your population. Because your mental health program should be scalable—and sustainable.

Proven partnership and support

From onboarding to incident response, our expert client success team is by your side. With deep experience and time-tested processes, we help you launch confidently, adapt over time, and deliver real impact for your workforce.

Proof that mental health care pays off

A third-party analysis of 13,000+ members shows how Modern Health’s adaptive care model drives down costs by supporting the whole workforce—not just those with severe mental health concerns.

A People-Centric Partnership

"For me, and for so many of my colleagues, Modern Health has been a game-changer. We’re not all looking for the same kind of support, and that’s what makes Modern Health so powerful. It’s flexible, it’s easy to use, and support is there when you need it."

Alice Vichaita Senior Director of Global Benefits

The Future of Smoothie Automation is Here.

Meet Replenish ®

The Replenish ® Genesis™ Blender transforms flash-frozen, whole-food ingredients into smooth, delicious, and nutritious frozen beverages in about 60 seconds.

Modern life forces us to choose between food that is healthy and food that is convenient.

Make healthy eating effortless and enjoyable by bringing delicious, functional, frozen smoothies to every place people live, work, and play.

A revolutionary, fully integrated countertop blended-beverage system.

Rehydration with natural electrolytes and other critical vitamins and minerals.

Sleek, compact countertop design allows side-by-side Replenish ® Genesis Blender units to increase throughput without expanding the footprint.

Patented mid-cycle blade inversion and pressure-controlled blending create consistent texture, taste, and product quality.

name: Oximy
brief:
Product: Oximy
One-liner: Take command of the AI your company already runs on.
Description: Oximy is one platform to see every AI tool and dollar across your company, run your team’s work in an app you own, and route every request to the right model.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
target:
Take command of the AI your company already runs on.

See every AI tool and dollar, give your team an AI app you own, and optimize every request across the models you already use.

The shift

Frontier models. Without becoming a tenant.

Every technology shift runs the same way. Things fragment, then they consolidate. AI is consolidating now, and the model companies are climbing from the model into the app your team opens every morning.

When one provider owns both the model and the application, your company is a tenant in its own work. Keeping the map, the app, and the routing yours is what keeps that from happening.

Three products

See it. Run it. Route it.

See every AI tool, account, model and dollar you run on.

One live map of your whole AI estate, kept current as it changes. No SDK and no code change.

Give your team an AI app the company owns.

Multiplayer threads where people and agents work together, on any model, with your keys and your connectors.

Send every request to the model that fits it.

Routing across cost, quality and latency, proved on your own traffic before anything changes.

Why it compounds

Each one works alone. Together they teach each other.

Most tools only see the traffic that goes through their SDK.

That misses the browser, the desktop app, the terminal and the agent, which is where most AI work actually happens. A router trained on that partial view is guessing about the rest.

The record

Visibility watches every AI interaction across the estate and keeps itself current as tools, accounts and models change.

It trains the routing

Relay's routers learn from that traffic, including the web and coding-agent work that SDK-based tools never see, so routing decisions fit how your company actually works.

It finds the people

When someone is doing company work in a consumer AI tool, Sidekick can offer them the company app at that moment, instead of a policy email a month later.

And the loop tightens

More work in the company app means more signal, which sharpens the routing and the offers again. Each product is useful alone. Running them together is what compounds.

name: EdgeTrace
brief:
Product: EdgeTrace
One-liner: Describe It. Find It. Act On It.
Description: EdgeTrace unifies your entire camera network into a single, powerful intelligence platform–helping public safety teams detect threats faster, respond in real time, and protect the community.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, GovTech, Computer Vision, B2B, Video
target:
Every camera, searchable in plain language.

EdgeTrace’s Vantage VMS turns hours of footage into seconds of evidence. Ask in natural language. Find the vehicle, person, or moment your investigation needs, across every camera you operate.

Cameras everywhere. Time, nowhere.

Agencies have more video than ever: every patrol cruiser, every public camera, every business that shares footage. But reviewing it is still done one frame at a time, by hand, by people who should be working the case.

Three steps. No model tuning.

EdgeTrace runs alongside your existing VMS, then phases it out when you’re ready. Connect the cameras you already operate, index in place, and start querying: no separate camera fleet, no proprietary hardware, no labeling.

Connect

Plug into your existing VMS, NVR, or shared cloud: Genetec, Milestone, Avigilon, S3. Indexing runs on-prem on an EdgeTrace appliance. Footage never leaves your network.

Ask

“White Tacoma, ladder rack, between 2 and 4 a.m.” Query in plain English across the full camera fleet and time window. Results return ranked with match scores and timestamps.

Hand off

Export clips with full chain-of-custody metadata. Auto-redact bystanders. Share to detectives, prosecutors, or partner agencies with a single link that respects your data-sharing policy.

The radio call you’d expect from someone on the floor.

Behavior search: describe an action, not just an object. EdgeTrace flags it the moment it happens and follows the subject camera to camera.

One tool. Four operating tempos.

EdgeTrace adapts to the question being asked: live, retrospective, strategic, or cross-jurisdictional.

Live intelligence during the call.

Match suspect descriptions against the live feed while patrol is still en route. Push matches to mobile in under a second.

Retrospective case work.

Pull every appearance of a vehicle, person, or object across a multi-day window, without watching a frame.

Strategic posture.

See pattern-of-life trends across districts. Quantify camera coverage gaps before the next budget cycle.

Cross-jurisdictional review.

Run the same query across partner-agency feeds with role-bounded access and a full audit trail per viewer.

Real work, in real rooms.

EdgeTrace lives in the places the work already happens: the watch floor, the crime center, the investigations bureau. On agency hardware, on the agency network.

EdgeTrace found evidence in seconds that would have taken us hours to discover, if we found it at all.

Match suspect descriptions against the live feed while patrol is still en route. Push matches to mobile in under a second.

Retrospective case work.

Pull every appearance of a vehicle, person, or object across a multi-day window, without watching a frame.

Strategic posture.

See pattern-of-life trends across districts. Quantify camera coverage gaps before the next budget cycle.

Cross-jurisdictional review.

Run the same query across partner-agency feeds with role-bounded access and a full audit trail per viewer.

Real work, in real rooms.

EdgeTrace lives in the places the work already happens: the watch floor, the crime center, the investigations bureau. On agency hardware, on the agency network.

EdgeTrace found evidence in seconds that would have taken us hours to discover, if we found it at all.

brief:
Product: Autosana

name: Mytos
brief:
Product: Mytos
One-liner: Robotic human cell manufacturing
Description: Mytos builds robots for manufacturing human cells. Operators input stem cells, and our platform turns them into specific cells such as neurons and heart cells over multiple weeks. Last year, patients were cured of Parkinson’s, vision loss, and Type 1 diabetes using stem-cell derived cells. We need 1000x the global capacity to produce these cells, and treat millions of patients. But today these Regenerative Medicines are produced by hand, meaning they’re too expensive and don’t scale.
Industry: Healthcare / Industrial Bio
Tags: Hardware, IoT, Biotech, Automation, Biotechnology
target:
Scaling Regenerative Medicine to Millions of Patients

The Automated CDMO For Regenerative Medicine

Powered by Mytos' iDEM™ automation technology, Mytos CDMO enables scalable, consistent production at low cost per dose. Site 1 is housed within CGT Catapult's 80,000 sqft site, with plans in place for a series of global sites.

Avoid long hiring and training delays during scaling, with scalable automated manufacturing

Between our team and our partners, Mytos handles every part of Manufacturing - from Process & Analytical Development, to Regulatory Support

No suite fees, no iDEM device purchases, no hidden costs

Save up to 50% compared with manual CDMOs

iDEM™ Automates All the Unit Operations in Cell Culture

iDEM uses the same 2D T flask format as manual culture, enabling manual protocols to be rapidly ported to closed automation - without affecting the biology

iDEM reduces labour per batch by up to 10x compared to manual culture - and reduces cleanroom footprint per batch by another 10x

Reliably scale at the quality of your best operator - and avoid expensive operator-related batch failures

Unlike large robotic arm solutions, our iDEM fleet doesn't have a single point of failure - reducing the risk of production delays

The Automated CDMO for Regenerative Medicine

Mytos's CDMO, powered by IDEM, delivers unmatched costs, scale, and efficiency.

50% Lower Batch Costs

Up to 50% cost reduction in batch prices compared to manual CDMOs.

Preserve Runway

No suite fees or iDEM purchases required.

Avoid Delays

Reduce tech transfers and hiring delays with iDEM-powered manufacturing that enables rapid scaling.

“The Mytos iDEM system—together with our bioinformatics and other enabling technologies—allows us to scale out for Phase 3 and ultimately commercialization, making more product at lower cost.”

CTO | Aspen Neuroscience

"Mytos offered a unique and practical bridge from manual to automated production, even at an early stage."

CEO | Stemsight

"With Mytos, we have the opportunity to seamlessly automate our existing process without having to change the biology."

CTO | Rinri Therapeutics

"Mytos enables us to increase the output of our existing facilities, without having to delay scaling to build out new capacity."

CTO | Novadip

brief:
Product: Synnax
One-liner: Unified Hardware Control and Data Processing Software
Description: We build software that helps hardware teams quickly and clearly evaluate how a component (engine, battery, valve, etc.) or process (assembly line, manufacturing plant) performs. We prevent mistakes, reduce costs, and accelerate time-to-market. Our platform unifies industrial control with sensor data storage and automated post-processing, delivering an end-to-end operations and observability stack.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
target:
Unified mission control and data review for hardware operations

Arc, the modern standard for writing automations

See everything, control anything

Build real-time dashboards, plot live telemetry, and command your hardware from a single, unified console.

Your system, at a glance

Millions of points, zero lag

Close the loop on hardware automation

Synnax unifies test automation and production control into a single platform. Write reactive sequences, deploy to real-time hardware, and transition between automated and manual operation seamlessly.

Write sequences, not boilerplate

Built for the Systems That Matter Most

Predictable Execution

Seamless Control Handoff

Understand what happened, and why

Review test data, compare runs side-by-side, and drill into anomalies without ever leaving the platform.

The only deeply integrated control system and database engine

Name it, tag it, find it later

Process data at the speed it arrives

Build real-time data pipelines that transform, aggregate, and alert on live telemetry. No infrastructure to deploy.

Sensor voting in 10 lines, not 10 services

Define alarms visually, monitor everything at a glance

Plug in your hardware, start streaming

Synnax ships with native drivers for the most popular data acquisition and control hardware, and a setup workflow that gets you from unboxing to streaming in minutes.

Works with your existing hardware

Streaming in three steps

Connect your hardware to the Synnax cluster. Our drivers automatically detect and establish communication with your devices.

Define your channels, set sample rates, and map physical signals to logical names. All from a single interface.

Stream live telemetry, build dashboards, and send commands to your hardware in real time with microsecond precision.

Build on the platform

Use Synnax as a framework to build advanced industrial systems. Connect AI models, embed real-time processing, and interface with external controllers through native client libraries in Python, TypeScript, and C++.
