name: Venta AI
brief:
Product: Venta AI
One-liner: The compliant AI colleague for sales teams in Europe
Description: Venta AI supports sales teams in Europe with targeted outreach. Our AI employee can access the best companies and contact details and carry out automated outreach in compliance with EU regulations.
Industry: B2B / Sales
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Sales
target:
The AI platform that leaves no revenue on the table.

Win new customers, grow existing accounts, revive cold deals. Personalised, GDPR-compliant, built for Europe.

3 reasons European sales teams rely on Venta AI

Outbound in Europe stands or falls on three things: whether you reach the right companies, whether your message feels written for them, and whether it holds up legally. Venta AI covers all three.

Venta AI combines GDPR-compliant data providers with live web research and qualifies every company against your own criteria - not just industry codes and job titles. Your team gets a list worth reaching out to instead of thousands of contacts to clean up.

Every message is built from real research: the company website, recent news, job posts and product pages. Choose full AI personalization or your own templates with AI-filled variables - across email, LinkedIn, phone and letter.

Venta AI is developed in the EU and hosted in Germany, and every data source we use is vetted for GDPR compliance. Outreach follows the local rules of each country and channel, so your team can scale without legal risk.

“With Venta AI we reach our target audience far faster and save an enormous amount of time - without any loss in quality. At the same time, we keep full control over every message.”

Book more meetings in less time

Whether you win new accounts, grow existing ones or act on a buying signal - Venta AI does the research and drafts the first touch, so your team spends its time in conversations instead of spreadsheets.

Win new customers

Describe your ideal customer in plain language. Venta AI searches more than 70 million companies, qualifies each one against your criteria and finds the right decision makers - then reaches out on the channel that fits.

Grow your existing accounts

Your existing customers are the fastest revenue you have. Venta AI keeps their data current, spots reactivation and cross-selling moments, and drafts the follow-up - written back to your CRM automatically.

Reach out at the right moment

Timing decides whether outreach lands. Venta AI watches website visits, job posts, trade fairs and company news, and alerts your team the moment an account shows real intent.

“As a provider of GDPR-compliant e-signatures, data protection is our top priority – and that applies to our marketing too. In Venta AI we found a European partner that shares these values.”

What customers achieve with Venta AI

brief:
Product: Infiuss Health
One-liner: 2 sided Marketplace for accelerating medical research
Description: We are building the world's first community of patients eager to contribute to and advance medical research. Our patient community platform offers health management, patient support and patient health data aggregation. We offer researcher's and life science companies with the opportunity to connect with these patients for their medical research needs. They recruit real patients for clinical trials, for bio specimens sourcing and to obtaining real world patient data.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Marketplace, B2B
target:
We're building the simulation layer for Randomized Controlled Trial design.

Infiuss Health is transformingn Randomised control trials by removing the biggest barriers that slow studies down.

With the ability to simulate real patient response before study kick off, we offer complete AI-powered ecosystem with project management, our platform Probe, streamlines time-consuming tasks so you can focus on groundbreaking discoveries and achieve results faster than ever.

Erasing the gap between lab-tested potential and real-world patient outcomes.

The Challenge in Modern Healthcare

Research protocols are developed from animal data which doesn’t always translate to real human response. Finding and keeping research participants is hard. Constantly adjusting research protocols to fit human response is expensive and time consuming.

Reactive Care

Treatment begins only after symptoms appear, missing prevention opportunities

Trial & Error

Generic protocols often require multiple adjustments to find what works

Fragmented Data

Critical health information scattered across multiple systems and providers

Your Complete Virtual Health Profile

A Digital Patient Twin is a comprehensive, dynamic virtual representation of you that integrates all your health data, powered by advanced AI to simulate, predict, and optimize your health outcomes.

Comprehensive Data Integration

Medical records, genomics, imaging, labs, wearables - all unified in one place

AI-Powered Predictions

Simulate disease progression and treatment outcomes before they happen

Personalized Research Models

Research protocols designed for diverse patient populations and biological variations

Powerful Capabilities

Advanced features that transform how healthcare is delivered and experienced

Personalized Health Modeling

Individual patient simulation based on comprehensive health data with predictive analytics for disease progression and customized risk assessments.

Data Integration & Interoperability

Seamless integration with EHR/EMR systems, wearables, and IoT devices with HIPAA-compliant security and real-time synchronization.

Clinical Research Insights

AI-powered simulation tools to support clinical researchers in protocol design and trial planning based on evidence-based data.

Predictive Analytics & Simulation

Advanced forecasting with "what-if" scenario modeling, early warning systems, and risk stratification for proactive care.

Real-Time Monitoring & Alerts

Continuous health tracking with automated anomaly detection, proactive intervention triggers, and care team coordination.

Patient Engagement Tools

User-friendly health visualization with personalized recommendations, adherence tracking, and shared decision-making support.

Transformative Benefits

Value for every stakeholder in the healthcare ecosystem

Improved Research Accuracy

AI-powered simulations help researchers identify optimal trial designs and reduce protocol errors

Enhanced Study Efficacy

Optimized research protocols lead to better study outcomes and faster discoveries

Reduced Adverse Events

Predict and prevent complications before they occur with proactive monitoring

Time Savings

Automated analysis and recommendations free up valuable clinical time

brief:

One-liner: Gen-AI Designed Enzymes for Pharmaceutical Innovation
Description: Pando is an AI-driven synthetic biology company revolutionizing enzyme engineering for the pharmaceutical industry. This empowers our generative AI to efficiently optimize enzymes across multiple properties, delivering high-performing, tailored enzymes that reduce costs and enhance efficiency.
Industry: Healthcare / Industrial Bio
Tags: Generative AI, Synthetic Biology, Biotech, Diagnostics
target:
Gen-AI Designed Enzymes for Pharma Manufacturing and Life Science Tools

Enzymes play a crucial role in driving market growth and profitability in the pharmaceutical industry. Developing industrial-grade enzymes that possess a balance of key properties becomes a top priority but remains challenging and time-consuming. Pando is here to solve that with AI and its internal screening platform.

Pando is an AI-driven synthetic biology company

Revolutionizing enzyme engineering for the pharmaceutical manufacturing and life science tools industry. Our ultra-high-throughput screening platform screens 1000-fold more enzymes 75% faster and 80% cheaper than traditional methods. This empowers our AI models to efficiently optimize enzymes across multiple properties, delivering high-performing, industrial-grade enzymes that create and capture new market value.

The power of AI-guided iterative enzyme improvement

Every design–build–test–learn round feeds real wet-lab data back into our models, so results compound: each round finds more winning variants and pushes their performance higher than the last.

More winning variants every round

The number of validated hits jumps roughly 10× from the first to the second round — the model learns from each screen and proposes far better candidates next time.

Gains that random mutagenesis can’t match

Starting from random mutations (no AI), each AI-guided round stacks large, consistent activity improvements — well beyond what untargeted screening delivers.

Products

Pando leverages AI and its unique screening platform to engineer enzymes with supreme properties. We currently offer several proprietary engineered enzymes for molecular biology applications.

Services

Pando utilizes its advanced technology and innovative platform to deliver tailored enzyme solutions, helping clients cut costs, improve efficiency, and boost profitability.

Supported by

Product: Taiga
One-liner: Autonomous medical billing
Description: Taiga automates medical billing for doctor's offices. A doctor uploads their visit data, our AI figures out the right billing codes, checks the claim for errors, and submits it to insurance, dealing with any denials. Faster billing, fewer rejected claims, less busywork. We're Nanda and Adam, friends since 3rd grade. Both of our parents are doctors with their own practices, and billing was always a source of stress and lost revenue for them.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare Services
target:
The medical billing partner you want to work with.

Taiga handles coding, claims, and appeals end-to-end. You treat patients, and we handle medical billing, denial management, and patient statements.

EMRs we work with

We grew up in our parents' practices, watching them frustrated by the amount of time lost to admin work. So we built Taiga to handle billing end-to-end, helping practices spend less time on paperwork and more time with patients.

“Taiga has been exceptionally easy to work with, with a responsive team always available to provide support. They've successfully secured payments on several previously rejected claims by resolving complex issues that had persisted for months. ”

“This has been a very smooth implementation. Our last major system rollout was so stressful I think I lost hair — so this has been a huge relief. Shoutout to you guys. Well done. ”

Where regular billing breaks down

Claims go out too late

Payers are slow enough on their own. When coding, charge entry, and review sit in manual queues, the payment clock starts days later than it should. Oftentimes Monday's encounter is sent out Friday.

Claims fail first pass

Payers use AI to approve clean claims fast, but only when the claim satisfies their vast web of plan-specific rules. Miss a modifier, authorization, or documentation signal, and it drops into manual review, turning a simple claim into weeks of delay.

Small denials compound

When every appeal takes staff time, small underpayments get written off because spending more to recover $50 does not make economic sense. Over time, that leakage compounds.

How Taiga handles the whole billing loop

From EHR access to reconciliation, each step feeds the next so payer rules are caught earlier over time.

Taiga plugs into your EHR, including DrChrono, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, and more, so we can read patient, visit, and documentation data directly. Your team does not have to send charts, exports, or anything manually.

Sarah Cohen returns with a moderate asthma exacerbation during an established patient follow-up . She reports daily rescue inhaler use and nighttime symptoms; exam shows diffuse wheeze without distress. Plan is to start prednisone burst and adjust controller inhaler, with recheck in two weeks.

We work with every payer you bill

Commercial carriers, regional plans, Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, and specialty networks, Taiga handles the full payer mix your practice already sees. Search to confirm yours.

Built for modern practices

EHR integrated

The medical billing partner you want to work with.

Taiga handles coding, claims, and appeals end-to-end. You treat patients, and we handle medical billing, denial management, and patient statements.

EMRs we work with

We grew up in our parents' practices, watching them frustrated by the amount of time lost to admin work. So we built Taiga to handle billing end-to-end, helping practices spend less time on paperwork and more time with patients.

“Taiga has been exceptionally easy to work with, with a responsive team always available to provide support. They've successfully secured payments on several previously rejected claims by resolving complex issues that had persisted for months. ”

“This has been a very smooth implementation. Our last major system rollout was so stressful I think I lost hair — so this has been a huge relief. Shoutout to you guys. Well done. ”

Where regular billing breaks down

Claims go out too late

Payers are slow enough on their own. When coding, charge entry, and review sit in manual queues, the payment clock starts days later than it should. Oftentimes Monday's encounter is sent out Friday.

Claims fail first pass

Payers use AI to approve clean claims fast, but only when the claim satisfies their vast web of plan-specific rules. Miss a modifier, authorization, or documentation signal, and it drops into manual review, turning a simple claim into weeks of delay.

Small denials compound

When every appeal takes staff time, small underpayments get written off because spending more to recover $50 does not make economic sense. Over time, that leakage compounds.

How Taiga handles the whole billing loop

From EHR access to reconciliation, each step feeds the next so payer rules are caught earlier over time.

Taiga plugs into your EHR, including DrChrono, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, and more, so we can read patient, visit, and documentation data directly. Your team does not have to send charts, exports, or anything manually.

Sarah Cohen returns with a moderate asthma exacerbation during an established patient follow-up . She reports daily rescue inhaler use and nighttime symptoms; exam shows diffuse wheeze without distress. Plan is to start prednisone burst and adjust controller inhaler, with recheck in two weeks.

We work with every payer you bill

Commercial carriers, regional plans, Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, and specialty networks, Taiga handles the full payer mix your practice already sees. Search to confirm yours.

brief:

One-liner: Turning the web into a structured database of real world events.
Description: CatchAll by NewsCatcher is a recall-first web search API built for queries where the results are spread across hundreds or thousands of pages on the web. Instead of returning the top ranked links like traditional search engines, CatchAll retrieves a large candidate set from the web, validates which pages actually match the query, and extracts structured records of real-world events.

Our products

CatchAll Web Search API

86% recall across 2B+ web pages. Find every relevant event across the open web — not just top results. Built for AI agents that need complete coverage.

News API

Search and stream news from 140k+ sources worldwide. Filter by language, country, entity, and topic. Built for AI agents and enterprise teams.

Company Monitors

Track a defined list of companies and surface every event that matters — deduplicated, structured, and continuously updated. Built for teams monitoring markets, competitors, and risk.

Event Monitors

Set a query once and receive new matched events continuously — scheduled, deduplicated, and pushed to your webhook. Built for always-on tracking, pay per result.

Global coverage

Actionable insights from thousands of credible sources across 100+ countries.

name: Accord
brief:
Product: Accord
One-liner: The Revenue Excellence Platform
Description: Accord is the AI-Powered Revenue Excellence Platform that transforms what top sellers do naturally—multi-threading, mutual action plans, and CFO-proof business cases—into unavoidable playbooks for every rep. Accord Intelligence handles the busy work by automating account research, stakeholder mapping, and more so your team can focus on selling.
Industry: B2B / Sales
Tags: SaaS, B2B
target:
Make excellence the only option

Accord transforms value-selling methodologies like MEDDPICC into playbooks that make winning behaviors unavoidable. Every rep performs like your best, while AI Agents handle the work that takes your team off the field.

This is a sales execution tool that the team tells me they can't live without. They would be so upset if we took Accord away from them—which I never hear about tools.

You need to be easy to sell for

And even easier to buy from. The legacy way of disparate tools, expensive value-selling consultants, one-off training sessions, inspection documents, and manually filling out (and re-filling out) CRM fields is making your sales process too hard to follow. For your sellers and your buyers. It’s time for a new approach.

Set, enforce, execute, and score

Turn your methodology into the standard for every rep and AI agent.

Build playbooks based on what wins

Define your standard of excellence by translating value-selling requirements into easy-to-follow playbooks and AI agents — multi-threading, CFO-proof business cases, mutual action plans, and instant delivery of supporting resources.

Embed excellence into every deal

Build discipline around the behaviors that separate top performers from the rest. Sellers and AI agents work inside playbooks that put every next step, resource, and objection talk track directly in their flow of work. Deals only advance once clear criteria tied to real customer engagement are met.

Offload what takes reps off the field

Accord Intelligence listens to signals across your GTM stack and turns them into proactive actions and agents that follow your methodology. The high-value work between customer calls happens consistently, at the same standard, across every rep and deal.

Objectively evaluate performance

All activity (or inactivity) is automatically captured and synced to Salesforce and Hubspot. Your sellers don’t need to waste time on CRM and scorecard updates. Managers get proactive and actionable insights on who's following the process and who needs coaching.

Built for the era of ultra efficiency

“We displaced People.ai and one other platform. The content management piece, deal-level execution, and ability to surface internal components like approval matrices or quoting instructions at the right time—for every deal—was a game changer.”

Ready to set a new standard for your team?

Description: The US Warehouse industry spends $75bn on labor each year. Yet, only 10% of US warehouses have any form of automation, because existing robotics are too expensive and hard to integrate. Integration in hours. No upfront costs. No retrofitting. No need to rebuild the operation around the robot. Our mission is to make it easy for any warehouse to adopt robotics.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Hardware, Warehouse Management Tech, Robotics, Logistics, Supply Chain
target:
Autonomous robots for the warehouse, deployed like labor.

On-demand robotic labor for warehouses

Manifold deploys autonomous warehouse robots that handle picking, loading / unloading, and palletizing — priced by pick. No upfront costs. No retrofitting, no long integration time, and no need to rebuild the operation around the robot.

Case picking

Trailer loading and unloading

Deploys in hours

Priced by pick

No upfront costs

Minimal upfront infrastructure changes.

Usage-based pricing

Warehouse labor is expensive, inefficient, and difficult to manage.

How Manifold works

Seamlessly deploy our robots into your existing warehouse.

Arrives at your site

We deploy into your current warehouse without a large retrofit or long integration project.

The system learns racks, floor-loaded inventory, pallets, containers, and the task constraints already on the floor.

Handles physical cases

Supervises exceptions

Remote operators resolve edge cases while the autonomous policy improves from real operating data.

Connects to warehouse systems

Manifold Orchestration System routes work through existing ERP, WMS, and WES workflows.

Pricing tied to output

You can price capacity by the pick, tying robotic labor spend directly to throughput.

Spatial understanding

The robot builds and updates a working map of the warehouse as it moves.

Manifold turns racks, pallets, floor-loaded inventory, and pick zones into a live operational layout that updates in real time.

brief:
Product: Orca Aerospace
One-liner: AI spacecraft operators that lives onboard the vehicle
Description: At Orca, we are focused on creating the future of spacecraft operations by moving control onto the vehicle. By allowing LLMs to control the satellite using deterministic tooling, we are able to achieve the same holistic, high-quality decisions on "what" to do to carry out a mission while maintaining the safety of systems that decide "how" to execute it.
Industry: Industrials / Aviation and Space
Tags: AIOps, Space Exploration, Satellites
target:
Mission Control, Onboard

Orca Aerospace builds the AI spacecraft operator that flies with the vehicle. It understands the mission, watches the systems, and acts when the ground can't.

Space Is Scaling Faster Than The People Who Fly It

Constellations grow by thousands of vehicles a year. Each one is flown from the ground, through scheduled passes, narrow links, and light-lag no console can beat. Every anomaly waits for a human to notice. Ops rooms do not scale the way launch manifests do.

Orca Lives Onboard

An AI operator on the flight computer. The AI decides what to do next. A deterministic planner decides how to do it. Guardrails approve or deny every command before it reaches the vehicle. The ground sets the mission. Orca flies it.

Meet the founders →

Put An Orca Onboard

Tell us about the platform. We'll tell you what it can do on its own.

name: Veria Labs
brief:
Product: Veria Labs
One-liner: Continuous AI pentesting that finds and fixes vulnerabilities
Description: Veria Labs is developing AI agents that hack better than the best human hackers. Founded by members of the #1 US competitive hacking team, we've already found critical bugs in AI tools, operating systems, fintech and billion dollar crypto exchanges. Now we're scaling that expertise through AI-native security tooling that operates faster than human researchers while finding deeper, more complex vulnerabilities that traditional tools miss.
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: Security, Cybersecurity, AI
target:
Leave nothing to chance.

Backed by Y Combinator From the #1 US hacking team

Veria AI is an autonomous pentester: it maps your entire attack surface, proves real exploits, and drafts the fix.

Veria runs where mistakes are expensive

It finds what the annual security review misses, in hours instead of weeks.

See it work

What Veria finds, how it proves it, and how it helps you fix it.

Everything in one feed

Every finding across your repos in one live view, ranked by what's actually exploitable.

In your workflow

Findings post to Slack and file to Linear, with status kept in sync.

Verified exploits

Every finding comes with a working exploit, run against your staging environment.

Automatic fixes

Veria writes the patch and opens the PR with checks passing; all that's left is review and merge.

Security review on every PR

Veria catches the flaws that slip past human review, and leaves the fix inline.

The python -c invocation retains the current repository directory on sys.path immediately after tools/owners. An attacker can land an unprotected root-level yaml.py or yaml/__init__.py, then have it imported instead of PyYAML by a future pull_request_target run and read the app token from GITHUB_TOKEN. Run Python in isolated mode so the working directory and environment-provided import paths are excluded.

AuthMode.OAUTH is accepted anywhere a route lists AuthMode.JWT, but OAuth scopes are only enforced when handlers later build org/project permissions. A delegated token with empty or unrelated scopes can still call JWT-only user routes such as GET /api/v1/user/me/totp to read TOTP recovery codes, DELETE /api/v1/user/me/totp to remove MFA, or session revocation endpoints because those handlers trust authentication alone.

MCP URLs can carry credentials in the path, including formats such as /mcp/. Because this value is persisted in mcp_tool_call_metadata, a user can invoke an allowed tool, read the resulting request log, and recover the upstream credential. Log only the origin unless there is a credential-aware path sanitizer.

Real reviews on public open-source PRs.

Research

Real vulnerabilities found and disclosed by our team, and what we learned along the way.

Know before an attacker does.

See what Veria finds in your code.

One-liner: Modernizing Chip Manufacturing Infrastructure
Description: We are building the future of chip manufacturing. Chips are more advanced than ever, and the features inside them keep getting smaller. But the cleanroom infrastructure supporting their manufacture has not scaled at the same pace. Intel, TSMC, Samsung, and others spend billions building and operating massive cleanrooms, only to isolate their most advanced wafers from the surrounding facility as much as possible. We think that architecture is backwards.
Industry: Industrials
Tags: Hard Tech, B2B, Manufacturing, Semiconductors
target:
Fabs of the future.

Point-of-use contamination control

Eliminating the need for cleanrooms in semiconductor manufacturing.

Every defect has a cost.

Corrosion. Hazing. Residue. Yield loss that conventional controls never see, because it happens in the gaps between process steps.

Point-of-use contamination control, engineered as a modular system: a reactor that destroys airborne contamination wherever wafers sit exposed.

name: Prometheus
brief:
Product: Prometheus
One-liner: We use solar and wind power to make zero net carbon electrofuels
Description: We remove CO2 and water from the air and use electricity from solar and wind power to turn them into zero net carbon electrofuels. These are gasoline, diesel, and jet fuels that work in existing cars, trucks and planes without requiring modification of their engines, and don't contribute to global warming because they don't add any new CO2 to the atmosphere. Each gallon of our electrofuels means a gallon of fossil oil left in the ground forever.
Industry: Industrials / Energy
Tags: Energy Storage, Climate
target:
REDEFINING THE FUTURE OF ENERGY .

Next Gen Energy Storage

Prometheus stores electricity as low cost clean diesel, jet fuel, and methanol through direct air capture and advanced electrochemistry.

About us

Prometheus fuels has developed a breakthrough new way to store electricity as fuels: synthesizing kerosene through direct air capture and a 100% electrochemical process.

Though this process can utilize any source of electricity: when utilizing low-cost, off grid solar, our zero-net-carbon fuels are competitive with commodity fossil fuel prices.

One process, limitless energy applications .

Applications

Data Center Power

Our Ultra Long Duration Energy Storage (ULDES) systems can shape and firm renewable energy seasonally, by storing it as liquid fuels when renewables are abundant, for months at a time, and using them when needed to provide firm, dispatchable power.

Transportation

Utilizing low cost off-grid solar energy, we can create carbon neutral fuels at prices competitive with commodity fossil fuel prices. This enables energy security, by ensuring the availability of fuels to power aviation, shipping, and anything else the economy needs.

Defense

Using power from a portable SMR, we can create diesel and jet fuel in a containerized system that can be transported by cargo aircraft. This enables the distributed creation of critical fuels in temporary or remote locations

On site or on grid

One technology platform, no infrastructure prerequisites.

From central grid infrastructure to the most remote operating environments.

On grid

Seasonal shaping and firming of renewables makes grids resilient. Our systems offer spinning reserves and inertia that high reliability requires, using conventional generators for peaking and baseload capability.

Off grid

Our ULDES and Fuel Forge systems are designed to operate with intermittent renewable energy and grid power is not required. They simply run when the sun shines and wind blows storing energy as liquid fuels, and they sit idle when power isn't available. This allows for remote electrification for any purpose.

Investors

BACKED BY THOSE SHAPING THE FUTURE .

brief:

target:
The presentation is where it starts, not where it ends.

Prezi helps you hold the room, make ideas click, and keep them alive after everyone leaves, so what you say is what they remember.

What lands in the room stays with them after.

Bring the deck you already have, or describe what you need and Prezi drafts it.

name: Robocurve
brief:
Product: Robocurve
One-liner: Evals for robots
Description: Robocurve builds open-source tools and independent benchmarks to measure how well robots can do real-world jobs. Instead of relying on unverified demo videos from frontier labs, we score their models on reproducible benchmarks that anyone can trust. Today there are no well-run, standardized robotics benchmarks. Labs evaluate in-house, and no independent group has stepped in to run continuous benchmarking as a service.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Hard Tech, Hardware, Robotics, Open Source
target:
Real - world evaluations of physical AI

We measure and report frontier robotics capabilities to the public.

Opus 5 and the Tower of Hanoi

Test-time scaling in robotics capabilities

LLM inference speed over time

Opus 5 on block stacking

Lift the finished slice out of the toaster and set it on the plate.

Independent analysis of robotics capabilities

Astra placed the block in the bowl in 19 of 20 trials, versus 8 of 20 for Fable 5.1, at less than half the estimated cost per run.

A technology this big must be measured in the open

Source: METR, Task-Completion Time Horizons of Frontier AI Models

Robotics capabilities are progressing rapidly

Frontier labs are racing to develop general-purpose robots in the next two years.

No one knows where the frontier is

The Internet is filled with cherry-picked demo videos. No continuous, standardized evaluations for robotics exist.

We are an independent evaluator for robotics

We measure robotics capabilities in the real world, independent of any agenda.

We build open-source tools to help society understand robotics progress

Open-source evaluation framework

Inspect Robots is released under the open-source MIT license. Free to use, modify, distribute, and sell.

Inspect Robots

Run any model on any embodiment on any benchmark, with full trace logs and live Rerun visualization. If you know Inspect AI , this is that for robotics.

Robocurve is a Public Benefit Corporation helping society understand the frontier of physical AI.

Our mission

Robocurve is a Public Benefit Corporation bound by law to serve the public good. General-purpose robots may arrive within years, with profound implications for the economy and the labor market.

We build open-source tools and independent benchmarks to measure robotics capabilities. We report progress to the public rigorously and neutrally.

Words from the experts

Researchers, engineers, and forecasters on Robocurve.

We work with labs of all sizes

name: Windmill
brief:
Product: Windmill
One-liner: Open-source platform to turn scripts into internal apps & workflows
Description: Windmill is an open-source developer platform that turns scripts into workflows, internal tools, and full-stack apps. Write scripts in Python, TypeScript, Go, Bash, Rust, SQL - Windmill auto-generates UIs from their parameters, handles dependencies, credentials, permissions, and scheduling so you focus on business logic, not infra. Open-source alternative to Airflow, Temporal, Retool and n8n. Chain scripts into flows with branching, parallelism, retries. Build dashboards with the app builder.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Developer Tools, SaaS, B2B, Workflow Automation, Open Source
target:
Code-first orchestration platform for internal software

Trusted by 4,000+ organizations, including 300+ EE customers at scale:

Build and orchestrate all your internal software

In the AI era, every team can now build their custom apps and workflows, from engineering and data to sales, support and marketing. Windmill gives you one platform to build, share and orchestrate them all, with the governance and observability needed at enterprise scale.

The starting point for most internal work. A single file of TypeScript, Python, Go, Bash or 20+ other languages becomes an API, a triggerable job and an auto-generated form, with no boilerplate in between.

From the Windmill UI or locally

Windmill provides built-in script editor , flow editor and app builder to build directly from the browser.

To build locally with Claude Code or Codex, use the CLI and built-in AI skills. You can then deploy your work to your remote workspace with wmill sync push .

Self-hosting? Deploy with Docker or Kubernetes first .

Running a script on the Windmill UI

From scripts to infrastructure, everything lives in code

Your entire workspace is versioned in Git . Teams can build from the UI or locally, while engineers manage infrastructure, deployments and environments with full code flexibility.

Your workspace as a file tree

Shared workspaces to orchestrate, scope and secure your team's work

Everything your team builds lives in workspaces with granular permissions, shared resources and built-in databases.

Roles and permissions

Built-in roles from operator to superadmin. Organize with groups and folders, control who can build or execute thanks to path-based ACLs .

Resources

Share API keys, credentials and connections across your team. Encrypted at rest, scoped by folder, accessible only to authorized users.

Databases

Set up PostgreSQL databases at the workspace level so team members can build scripts, workflows and apps on top of shared data.

Full observability on every execution

Every execution is logged, tracked and searchable . Real-time logs, granular filtering, audit trails, and alerts on Slack, email or Teams when things go wrong.

The fastest orchestrator in the industry

We engineered Windmill to be the fastest orchestrator in the industry, ensuring your most demanding workloads never bottleneck. From a single-node VPS to 1,000-node K8s clusters, auto-scale on demand or isolate critical tasks with dedicated worker groups on Kubernetes and Docker.

Our core principles

The foundational beliefs that guide how we build Windmill.

No lock-in

name: StableBrowse
brief:
Product: StableBrowse
One-liner: Building the Data Infrastructure layer for Physical AI.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Robotics, AI
target:
The data infrastructure layer for physical AI.

[ STABLEBROWSE / PHYSICAL AI DATA INFRASTRUCTURE ]

Backed by

We build multimodal physical-world datasets for robots and embodied agents, from real task capture to post-processed depth, hand pose, tactile signals, camera motion, action labels, and reviewable training outputs.

[ 01 / THESIS ]

Physical AI needs an infrastructure layer, not scattered clips.

The internet does not contain enough examples of hands using tools, objects changing state, bodies moving through space, and people recovering from messy physical interactions. Physical AI needs data collected in the world, not just scraped from it.

StableBrowse handles the full data layer: capture protocol, sensor synchronization, calibration, depth, hand tracking, hand mesh, camera trajectory, tactile streams, temporal labels, and reviewable delivery.

[ 02 / CAPABILITIES ]

From raw physical capture to model-ready data.

Multimodal capture

We collect real physical tasks with egocentric RGB, stereo depth, IMU, audio, hand pose, tactile gloves, tool state, and environment context.

Post-process

We turn raw recordings into aligned outputs: depth, hand tracking, hand mesh, camera trajectory, object state, action boundaries, and sensor QC.

Validate and deliver

Every episode ships with synchronized timestamps, calibration, schema-valid labels, review UI assets, manifests, and provenance your team can audit.

[ 03 / THE STANDARD ]

Post-processing is the product.

We do not just collect footage. We convert multimodal capture into structured signals that a model team can actually use: aligned sensor data, calibrated geometry, physical action labels, and artifacts that can be inspected frame by frame.

[ 04 / TRUST ]

Built for multimodal physical data.

Before StableBrowse, co-founder Jay Mehta co-authored MDD , an ICCV 2025 paper introducing a benchmark multimodal dataset for text-controlled and music-conditioned 3D duet dance generation.

MDD comprises 620 minutes of high-quality motion-capture data performed by professional dancers, synchronized with music, and detailed with over 10K fine-grained natural-language descriptions. That same discipline in synchronized sensors, motion understanding, and dense human-readable labels is what we bring to physical AI data infrastructure.

We design collection protocols for embodied tasks, then turn raw capture into structured training data: video, stereo depth, IMU, tactile gloves, hand pose, hand mesh, camera motion, object state, and temporal captions aligned to the task.

[ 05 / DATA LAYER ]

Multimodal physical capture

First-person recordings of real people doing real physical work, captured with RGB, stereo depth, IMU, audio, tactile gloves, hand pose, and tool context.

Manipulation and tool-use episodes

How are file transcoding minutes calculated?

Minutes refers to the length in minutes of an output video. So, if you encode the full length of a 10 minute video, your total minutes is 10. If you are using multiple outputs and encode your video into 2 different formats, your total minutes for that encoding job is 20.

FUSION BUILT TO POWER OUR WORLD

Magnets accelerate particles toward each other

From atoms to electricity

HOW FUSION WORKS

CLEAN, SAFE, SCALABLE POWER

Unlimited energy

always on

name: Ophelia
brief:
Product: Ophelia
One-liner: Medication & support to beat opioid addiction from home
Description: Ophelia helps people quit opioids without going to rehab. We offer online doctor’s visits, withdrawal medication prescriptions, and support for long-term recovery, using a protocol 6x more effective than most rehabs (2/3rds of which don't have doctors). More than 3 million Americans are addicted to opioids, but 80% are not getting help, due to jobs, families, and privacy concerns.
Industry: Healthcare / Consumer Health and Wellness
Tags: Mental Health Tech, Healthcare, Telemedicine
target:
Reduce opioid cravings and manage withdrawal with Suboxone®

Get the gold standard of treatment at home with medication and support that fits privately into daily life.

Most patients pay less than $10/month

These are just some of the many insurance plans we work with

Find out if your treatment might be covered with our free insurance checker.

No judgment. No stigma.

Treatment that fits into real life

Schedule a free welcome call to learn more about our program and ask questions.

The most effective treatment for opioid use disorder

Medications for addiction treatment (MAT) is the gold standard of care for opioid use disorder according to the UN, CDC, NIH, SAMHSA, and AMA.

What our patients are saying

The proof is in the features

Care from people who get it

Our clinical team consists of clinicians, nurses, care coordinators, and peers, who have either struggled with addiction, or who have worked closely with people who have.

Frequently asked questions

People regularly using opioids who want to control or stop their use as well as those who don't need a higher level of care for acute medical or psychiatric issues.

At the moment, Ophelia clinicians primarily prescribe Suboxone or the generic buprenorphine + naloxone combination. We can also prescribe medication for symptoms related to withdrawal during induction, such as nausea or trouble sleeping, and medication for depressive, anxiety, and insomnia disorders. Learn more about Suboxone here .

Ophelia is 100% committed to your privacy and confidentiality. We will never share your information with anyone without your permission, including your employer. Read more about our Notice of Privacy Practices here .

Suboxone is a combination medication of Buprenorphine and Naloxone. It’s a partial opioid that binds to the same receptors in the brain as traditional opioids and reduces cravings and withdrawal symptoms but does not produce the same “high” at a therapeutic dosage, so you can feel physically healthy and remain clear-headed all day. Learn more about Suboxone here .

We accept many major insurance plans, including Medicaid. Most patients pay less than $10 a month for care, which includes all clinician visits via video calls, Suboxone management, and ongoing support from the dedicated care team. Cash pay also available. Learn more about insurance and pricing here .

Ask what you actually want to know

You’ve got questions. We’ve got answers.

We provide affirming care for all identities and communities

2026 Delivery Platform of the Year

2026 Marketing Automation Platform of the Year

Direct Mail Delivery Engine

Dashboards & API's

Postal IQ

Print Delivery Network

– Abby Warner, Chief Experience Officer

DATA-DRIVEN MAIL

name: SubImage
brief:
Product: SubImage
One-liner: The Open-Core Security Graph
Description: SubImage builds maps of your infrastructure to give you visibility on what assets you have and how they relate to each other. This enables any security team to deeply understand their environments and reduce risk. SubImage is a managed offering built around the Cartography open-source project, and is founded by members of Cartography's original team.
Industry: B2B / Security
target:
Map your cloud and secure everything .

SubImage (from the team behind Cartography ) maps your entire cloud and on-prem infrastructure, so you know exactly what’s exposed, what’s misconfigured, and what to fix first.

The modern cloud is too complex for security teams.

Attackers only need to win once. You have to win every time. Where the heck do you even begin?

Software that maps your infrastructure.

Agentless, Zero Maintenance

SubImage connects via a secure read-only API. Fully managed and agentless—no installs, no performance impact, no upkeep.

Asset Inventory

Continuously discover and map all your assets—across cloud, SaaS, and on-prem—into a single living graph. Gain instant visibility into resources, relationships, and ownership without manual effort or fragmented spreadsheets.

Flexible Integrations & Open APIs

Validate raw data, see how findings were derived, and adapt rules without opaque pipelines or lock-in. Query directly, connect with SIEM, SOAR, or ticketing systems, and automate your workflows.

AI-Powered Detective

Cut down on security theater with conversational interfaces that explain why something matters and what to do next.

The Open-Core Advantage.

Buy confidence, not tools. SubImage delivers a managed CNAPP built on open foundations you can inspect, extend, and trust.

Polished experience, open foundations. Built on Cartography—the open security graph we built at Lyft—every rule and relationship is visible and reproducible. Fix, extend, or introspect instantly if something breaks instead of being blocked on vendor tickets or hidden schemas.

Other CNAPPs make vendors pay to appear in your dashboard. SubImage connects to anything—no gated ecosystem, no blind spots.

Exploitable and actionable findings are table stakes. SubImage adds what ’ s missing: relevance . Our graph and AI surface issues that actually make sense for your architecture, maturity, and risk profile.

A shared open foundation that moves fast. Build, connect, and understand anything. Need help? We ’ re here.

Every integration you need.

Coverage across all the tools you use, out of the box.

SaaS

Networking & Edge

Cloud Services

Security Threat & Vuln Management

CorpSec Solutions

Identity & Access

AI Providers

Meet the upgrade.

Give your security team an unfair advantage.

Attackers think in graphs. You should too.

name: rekursiv.ai
brief:
Product: rekursiv.ai
One-liner: Scale AI scientists whose own breakthroughs accelerate the next.
Description: We're scaling self-improving AI scientist teams to ideate/experiment/discover, generating new knowledge autonomously. Their discoveries reduced ARC-1/2 costs by 10,000× while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy and yielded material advances on combinatorial ML problems. We believe that AI is bounded not by compute, but ideas.
Industry: B2B / Productivity
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, Machine Learning
target:
Autonomously create knowledge.

We're building autonomous systems of models that form hypotheses, design experiments, and arrive at discoveries no one has made before. Our systems have already invented new ML methods and algorithms that significantly beat the state-of-the-art on different ML problems at a fraction of the cost.

Not just agents, but scientists.

Today's AI agents are capable at orchestrating and executing complex tasks. But the hardest part of building new software isn't writing the code. It's knowing what to build and why.

At rekursiv.ai , we're working on a more capable form of intelligence which doesn't just follow orders, but acts as a scientist by hypothesizing, designing experiments, running them, interpreting results, and discovering new knowledge.

Our AI Scientists have already surprised us many times. They've discovered novel algorithms to real problems through thousands of experiments and at a fraction of the cost of human research.

And we're working to scale this up to millions of scientists, producing billions of discoveries.

Read more about the first AI Scientist system and the algorithm it discovered →

A cockpit for autonomous research.

Define a problem. We'll dispatch a fleet of AI Scientists that hypothesize, set evals, experiment, review each other's work, and push leaderboards. Every claim is traced to its evidence.

News from the Lab.

Discover what we're building, and what we've learned.

Pushing the Limits of Autonomous ML Science on ARC-AGI

AI Scientists raised the ARC-AGI Pareto frontier with stronger accuracy at dramatically lower cost.

Learning 100% Sudoku Accuracy with a Neural Network

An autonomous AI team discovered a neural approach that reaches exact accuracy across the full Sudoku set.

I Built Copybarista in a Day to Open-Source Code Safely

How a private monorepo sync problem became an OSS tool for clean exports and verified imports.

Built by researchers, for researchers.

Our founding team brings almost 30 years of combined research experience at Google, DeepMind, and Luma AI. Between us, we built TensorFlow Probability, led the models powering Dream Machine, and developed VideoPoet (ICML 2024 Best Paper). Now we're applying that experience to a harder problem: AI that discovers on its own.

name: Kabilah
brief:
Product: Kabilah
One-liner: Agentic AI for Nursing Workflows
Description: We reduce burnout, enhance system efficiency, and enable high quality care.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Generative AI, Digital Health, Healthcare, AI
target:
GENERATIVE AI FOR NURSING WORKFLOWS

Kabilah is the most trusted enterprise-grade AI platform designed specifically for nursing workflows. We alleviate burnout, enhance system efficiency, and enable high quality care.

Join the movement with Kabilah

The Kabilah Platform

Kabilah's features are designed to solve the most pressing issues for inpatient nursing workflows.

Consistent & Complete Verbal Handoff

Kabilah offers a proprietary solution for all transitions of care - from the ER, all the way to discharge. This system guarantees every verbal handoff is thorough and accurate by notifying nurses of any missing critical information and providing corrections for inaccuracies, ensuring reliable and effective communication.

Simple Digital Report Sheets

Kabilah revamps fragmented paper report sheets into a clean digital format that saves time and eliminates the risk of lost or incorrect information. Nurses no longer need to rewrite all patient details at the beginning of each shift by hand, and everything they need is consistently in one place.

Guided Task Management

Kabilah streamlines task management by generating a context-aware ToDo list that prioritizes urgency and organizes tasks for optimal efficiency. Our platform simplifies workflows, ensuring the highest degree of patient safety while making the day more manageable for each nurse.

Efficient Charting & Flowsheet Completion

Kabilah integrates with your health system's tech stack, eliminating the need for redundant charting. Nurses can export their report sheets to various note types and flowsheets within the EHR, reducing documentation burden and allowing more focus on patient care.

Every superhero needs their sidekick.

Nursing is demanding, and you deserve tools that make your life easier. Kabilah is your HIPAA-compliant, AI-powered assistant, designed to support verbal handoff, automatically generate your report sheet, and reduce the time you spend clicking and charting. You save lives, we handle the rest.

Nursing Schools

We believe empowering nurses begins with education and training. From the very start of their journey, nurses should feel supported in learning how to work with AI as a tool that strengthens their practice.

That is why we bring our technology into simulation labs, giving nursing students the opportunity to engage with AI in a hands-on environment.

An Enterprise-Grade Solution

Kabilah comes with everything you need for a successful deployment.

Kabilah is compatible with all major EHRs over standard FHIR protocols. Go live in 2-4 weeks.

Kabilah's enterprise-grade technology is 100% HIPAA Compliant with multiple layers of security controls.

Our team of expert educators and engineers are available 24/7 to support on-site deployment.

Kabilah integrates with your health system's tech stack, eliminating the need for redundant charting. Nurses can export their report sheets to various note types and flowsheets within the EHR, reducing documentation burden and allowing more focus on patient care.

Every superhero needs their sidekick.

Nursing is demanding, and you deserve tools that make your life easier. Kabilah is your HIPAA-compliant, AI-powered assistant, designed to support verbal handoff, automatically generate your report sheet, and reduce the time you spend clicking and charting. You save lives, we handle the rest.

Nursing Schools

We believe empowering nurses begins with education and training. From the very start of their journey, nurses should feel supported in learning how to work with AI as a tool that strengthens their practice.

That is why we bring our technology into simulation labs, giving nursing students the opportunity to engage with AI in a hands-on environment.

An Enterprise-Grade Solution

Kabilah comes with everything you need for a successful deployment.

Kabilah is compatible with all major EHRs over standard FHIR protocols. Go live in 2-4 weeks.

Kabilah's enterprise-grade technology is 100% HIPAA Compliant with multiple layers of security controls.

Our team of expert educators and engineers are available 24/7 to support on-site deployment.

name: Kita
brief:
Product: Kita
One-liner: Automate credit assessment for lenders in emerging markets
Description: In emerging markets, open finance is still nascent. Most of the population is traditionally unbanked, banking APIs don’t exist, and a borrower’s financial history lives in documents: e-wallet records, bank statements, utility bills, and more. Because this data is unstructured, credit and risk teams are forced into manual review. This slows decisioning, increases costs, and caps lending volume. Kita is the AI platform for global lending operations.
Industry: Fintech
Tags: Fintech, Computer Vision, Lending, Emerging Markets
target:
Underwrite borrowers anywhere in the world, in minutes.

AI-native credit assessment built for lending globally. Kita superpowers underwriters by turning messy borrower applications into decision-ready files. Your team always keeps the final call.

Legacy lending breaks

in three places.

Data stays trapped in documents.

Raw figures and hundreds of risk signals sit locked inside messy documents legacy tools can't read.

Files stay incomplete.

Wrong documents, missing pages, round after round of messaging the borrower to chase what’s missing.

Underwriting stays manual.

Reconciliation and memos written by hand. Hours per file before a single decision.

Three AI assistants.

End-to-end underwriting.

Vision AI for messy financial documents.

Ingests any document your borrowers actually send (photos, scans, screenshots) and extracts raw data and hundreds of potential risk signals.

The 24/7 agent that closes the loan file.

Engages borrowers on WhatsApp, SMS, or email, in their preferred language, until the file is complete.

Drafts the memo. Your credit officer decides.

Runs the full financial analysis against your own lending policy. Then drafts a decision-ready credit memo.

One stack. Every kind of lending.

Microfinance & small-ticket consumer

SME & commercial lending

CDFI & community lending

Extract alternative data signals from your borrower documents that measurably separate risk and strengthen your underwriting model.

Transform legacy lending processes with

AI-native underwriting.

For decades, underwriting resisted automation. Documents too varied. Too messy. Too inconsistent.

AI changes that. Software can now read a paystub, a bank screenshot, or a financial statement with the fluency of a human analyst, thousands of files an hour, with citations. It's giving a new class of lenders a real edge.

Credit review that once took a team now takes seconds, and the lenders who adopt this layer early will lead on speed, cost, and risk.

Built for the markets where lending is hardest.

Active in the Philippines and Indonesia.

GCash, Maya, OVO & GoPay statements, payslips, CIBI / CRIF reports, bank statements, audited financials.

Active in Mexico.

CFDI, constancia de situación fiscal, INE, poder notarial, acta constitutiva, estados de cuenta.

Live with CDFIs, community banks, and SMB lenders.

Business tax returns (1120, Schedule C, K-1, 1065), commercial bank statements, income proof.

Designed with security and trust

at our core.

A platform that fits inside your credit policy, your systems, and your compliance posture, without slowing the decision.

Customer-specific deployments

Mito is used by thousands of business analysts, data scientists, and automation engineers at some of the world's largest banks, private equity shops, and consulting firms. Private by design

Jupyter-native

Built for every skill level

The complete toolkit for turning data into insights

Jupyter Agent

Your coding assistant that understands your data, and updates your notebook for you. Like ChatGPT in Jupyter.

Excel-like Spreadsheet

One-click fix and explanation for any error.

Any Model

Any Provider

Connect through your existing contracts. LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI Enterprise, AWS Bedrock, Microsoft Copilot.

No Spying

Made with Mito

Connect to your stack

Mito works with the databases and data warehouses your team already uses.

Ready to write Python code 4x faster?

Mito is an open source project, and the codebase is available on Github .

Outside contributions are welcome and encouraged!

Mito Open Source is free. You can install Mito by following the install instructions here .

For individuals automating spreadsheet processes or creating more advanced Python scripts, we offer a Pro version. Mito Pro includes unlimited AI completions, disabling all telemetry, and additional formatting and transformation options.

For enterprises looking to accelerate Python adoption, Mito Enterprise includes advanced functionality like admin controls, database and LLM integrations, and training programs.

See more at our plans page.

name: Okteto
brief:
Product: Okteto
One-liner: Cloud Development Environments with one click
Description: At Okteto, we are working hard at creating the next-generation development experience for teams of all sizes. Have you ever seen how long it takes a developer to set up everything they need before working on a feature? We are fixing that. We want developers to focus on building value for their teams instead of wasting time setting up local environments or trying to debug "production only" issues.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Developer Tools, SaaS, B2B, Open Source, Kubernetes
target:
High quality code requires realistic environments.

Okteto is the environment platform for agentic development. Every agent task gets an isolated, production-like environment on your infrastructure to build, test, and verify against real services and data.

The world’s leading companies ship faster with Okteto

Works with the Agents you already use

Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, or your own internal agents: if it can run a command, it can use Okteto. Agents get a real environment through the same CLI and APIs your developers already use. No proprietary framework, no lock-in. And because everything runs on your infrastructure, your platform team keeps the governance, observability, and resource control a fleet of agents actually requires.

Most agents just guess. With Okteto, your Agents know .

Give your Agents the right environment to prove their work.

Every task gets a real environment.

When an agent picks up work, Okteto spins up a full-stack, isolated environment on your infrastructure in seconds. No mocks, no shared-state collisions, no waiting in a queue.

The agent runs and verifies.

It builds, runs, and tests its changes against real services and data, proving the work before a human ever looks at it.

Your platform team stays in control.

Resource limits, governance, and observability across the entire fleet, so a hundred agents don't become a hundred surprises.

Your agents only spin up what they need

Okteto connects each environment to shared instances of everything else so you can run a fleet without the infrastructure bill to match.

Where agentic development breaks down

Agents testing against incomplete dependencies miss the bugs that matter

Lightweight sandboxes work for isolated changes. They fall apart when the service graph spans dozens of dependencies, and the code only breaks when real services interact.

The feedback cycle wasn't built for agent velocity

Every change still goes through a pipeline designed for humans working at human pace. Agents don't slow down for it. The feedback loop does.

Without a real environment to validate in, testing happens in production

Agents route around unreliable or missing environments. One mistake reaches every user.

Agents generate. Verification still falls on a developer

The loop was supposed to be autonomous. Without a real environment to close it, a human is still in the middle.

Every failed change gets paid for twice

Once in tokens on the way out. Once in engineering time on the way back.

A complete environment , ready to run.

Self-serve environments

Provision environments directly from a preconfigured catalog.

Poll Everywhere engages everyone at conferences, town halls, training sessions, marketing events, and everyday meetings. Engage Your Audience

10m+

200m+

40m+

Presentations Given

Made for People Who Present

Whether you’re in a classroom, a meeting room, or online, Poll Everywhere helps you stay in the moment. It trims down the setup time, reduces the clicks, and makes it easier to keep your audience engaged without worrying about the tech.

Experience a more streamlined way to teach with intuitive tools built for modern classrooms. Deliver engaging lessons, collect real-time feedback, automate attendance, and ensure every student has a voice—without adding to your workload.

Present smarter with a more intuitive experience. Whether you're leading an all-hands or a team training, use streamlined tools to gather live feedback, check understanding, and reveal insights in real time. It's a faster, smoother way to engage and make better decisions.

brief:
Product: Onshore
One-liner: AI for corporate tax
Description: Onshore uses AI to prepare corporate R&D tax credits. With our technology, anyone can prepare an R&D Tax Credit accurately and fast. To provide some background, the R&D Credit is often cited as the most complex and audited tax credit in the United States. With that in mind, we set out to create software to achieve two primary objectives: 1. Ensure that any credit computed with our software is exactly what the IRS is asking for in terms of quality. 2.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
target:
You build America's future. We make sure you get the credit for it.

You did the hard part. Claiming what you're owed should be the easy part. We find it, document it, and defend it.

Free assessment · Real experts on every return · SOC 2 Type II

Three steps between you and the R&D Tax Credit.

Connect or drop your docs

Link the systems you already have or just drag and drop your documents. No prep, formatting, or spreadsheets required. We take them exactly as they are.

Agents process it

Our AI agents read everything against the full tax code and surface every dollar you've earned.

Experts verify & deliver

A credentialed tax pro verifies every number, amends your returns, and delivers the whole audit-ready package back to you.

AI speed. Human judgment.

Our AI agents read every line of your data, and a credentialed tax pro reviews it all before filing. You get AI speed with an expert who picks up the phone.

Money back where it belongs: in the hands that earned it.

Built for how your industry works.

Qualifying R&D looks different on a farm than in a machine shop. We have AI models and professionals for each industry we serve, so we catch what generic software misses.

Documentation that holds up.

Every filing ships as a complete packet: forms, calculations, and source files, sealed and ready. If a question comes, the answer is already in the box.

Built for people who can't afford surprises.

SOC 2 Type II

Independently audited controls, with reports available on request.

Your data stays yours

Encrypted end to end. Never sold, never used to train anyone else's models.

A real person to call

Software does the work, but a credentialed expert owns your account and answers the phone.

Questions, answered.

A credentialed tax professional reviews every number and signs off before anything is filed. The software does the legwork; a real expert owns your account and answers the phone.

The assessment is free. If we find credits worth claiming, our fee is a share of what we recover, so you only pay when you save.

Yes. We're SOC 2 Type II compliant, your data stays in the United States, and we never sell it or use it to train anyone's models.

One-liner: We find where AI agents fail, then train better models to run them.

Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, Machine Learning, Analytics, Monitoring
target:

Backed by Y Combinator

See what broke before users leave.

See Agnost AI in action.

Click any insight in the live demo. No signup needed.

Ship what users want.

See what frustrates users, what they ask for, and what to improve across every conversation.

Find user frustration.

See where your agent fails, users get frustrated, and churn begins. Every pattern links to the exact conversations and traces so you can fix it fast.

Auto-cluster conversations.

Turn thousands of chats into the recurring problems that disappoint users, ranked by impact and ready to investigate.

Prevent costly failures.

Catch hallucinations, broken promises, and policy violations with the exact conversation and trace behind every failure.

Fix what matters.

name: Milliray
brief:
Product: Milliray
One-liner: Technology to detect and track small drones
Description: We make radars that can see small drones. As drones evolve faster than air defenses, detection has fallen behind. Even $50 drones now present a major threat to airports, critical infrastructure, and front-line defense. We solve this by building high-frequency radar systems, designed from the ground up to detect even the most challenging low-signature targets. This allows us to identify and track nano drones like no other solution, letting you know what's truly in your airspace.
Industry: Industrials / Drones
target:
Detect what other radars miss.

Airspace intelligence

Millimeter-wave radar engineered to detect, track, and classify the small drones other systems miss: from $50 quadcopters to autonomous swarms.

Programmes & backers

NATO DIANA

Royal Acad. of Engineering

Y Combinator

Live detection

Drones, birds, and clutter — separated in real time

The technology

Know what's in your airspace.

Most counter-UAS systems were built for the threats of a decade ago. We rebuilt the stack from first principles — sensors, fusion, and classification — for the small, low-signature drones now showing up at airports, substations, and forward bases.

A sensor stack purpose-built for small UAS.

Deployed standalone at a single site or networked across a distributed perimeter. Scalable from a single tower to a multi-site detection grid, with onboard compute for low-latency detection in real-world environments.

Where Milliray deploys

Stop the next Gatwick.

A single small drone can close runways and cost airlines millions. Conventional radar wasn't designed to see them.

Protect the grid, plant, and pipeline.

Substations, refineries, water treatment, and data centers are the highest-value soft targets in the country. Drone intrusions are routine.

Field-grade radar for forward sites.

Front-line teams need cost-aligned detection for the new asymmetric threat: $50 quadcopters and improvised weaponized UAS.

Chief Executive Officer

Dr Matthew Moore

Chief Technology Officer

Dr Thomas Doherty

Chief Operating Officer

Dr Jordina Frances de Mas

Talk to the team

Responsible for countering drone threats?

We work with airports, critical infrastructure, defense operators, venues, and VIP protection teams. Send a note — we'll get back the same week.

name: Frizzle
brief:
Product: Frizzle
One-liner: AI Grading for Teachers
Description: Frizzle uses AI to grade handwritten math assignments for teachers and transform them into rich analytics and differentiated assessment to help personalize instruction for every student. Teachers spend over 10 hours a week or 25% of all their work grading - Frizzle does it in minutes. Frizzle is the most valuable piece of software for teachers ever, as it eliminates the most time-consuming part of their workflow so they can focus on teaching.
Industry: Education
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Education, SaaS, B2B, Productivity
target:
The operating system for math classrooms

Students keep working on paper. Frizzle reads every page in real time - turning handwritten work into the granular data K-12 math has never had: who's stuck, which misconceptions are spreading, what each student needs next.

Already at work in districts & universities

From paper to insight in three steps

No new workflow for students. No tablets, no logins, no migration. Frizzle slots into the way teachers already teach.

Snap a stack

Phone, doc cam, or scanner. Frizzle reads handwritten work, ingests classroom photos, and links every page to the right student automatically.

Frizzle reads everything

Computer vision parses each step of student work - not just the final answer. It understands multiple solution paths and tags every misconception.

See the whole class

Live dashboards show who's stuck, which mistakes are spreading, and what to teach tomorrow - for one period or the whole district.

It's not grading . It's seeing.

Most tools mark answers. Frizzle understands thinking - every step, every approach, every misconception, in handwriting.

Snap once. Read a class.

Stop spending Sunday on grading. Photograph a stack of papers and Frizzle reads every page in seconds - recognizing handwriting, multiple solution paths, and partial credit.

Trained on the way kids actually think.

Frizzle's model was built with 1.4 million pages of K-12 student work. It recognizes the messy, partial, beautiful ways real students arrive at answers - and surfaces what's underneath.

A live nervous system for math.

One classroom is a window. A whole school is a map. Frizzle aggregates anonymized signal across periods, grades, and buildings - so coaches and admins can see where to invest, what to reteach, and which curricula are actually working.

Privacy isn't a checkbox. It's the foundation.

Student work never trains our model. Data stays yours.

Federal compliant

Full FERPA & COPPA compliance. SOC 2 Type II audited annually.

End-to-end

AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit. Student PII never leaves your district.

Your data, always

One-click export, deletion on request. We don't train on student work. Ever.

The questions teachers ask first

See your first class before lunch tomorrow.

Sign up with your school email. Snap a stack of papers. Get your first dashboard in under 5 minutes - no setup calls, no procurement, no IT.

Phone, doc cam, or scanner. Frizzle reads handwritten work, ingests classroom photos, and links every page to the right student automatically.

Frizzle reads everything

Computer vision parses each step of student work - not just the final answer. It understands multiple solution paths and tags every misconception.

See the whole class

Live dashboards show who's stuck, which mistakes are spreading, and what to teach tomorrow - for one period or the whole district.

It's not grading . It's seeing.

Most tools mark answers. Frizzle understands thinking - every step, every approach, every misconception, in handwriting.

Snap once. Read a class.

Stop spending Sunday on grading. Photograph a stack of papers and Frizzle reads every page in seconds - recognizing handwriting, multiple solution paths, and partial credit.

Trained on the way kids actually think.

Frizzle's model was built with 1.4 million pages of K-12 student work. It recognizes the messy, partial, beautiful ways real students arrive at answers - and surfaces what's underneath.

A live nervous system for math.

One classroom is a window. A whole school is a map. Frizzle aggregates anonymized signal across periods, grades, and buildings - so coaches and admins can see where to invest, what to reteach, and which curricula are actually working.

Privacy isn't a checkbox. It's the foundation.

Student work never trains our model. Data stays yours.

Federal compliant

Full FERPA & COPPA compliance. SOC 2 Type II audited annually.

End-to-end

AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit. Student PII never leaves your district.

Your data, always

One-click export, deletion on request. We don't train on student work. Ever.

The questions teachers ask first

See your first class before lunch tomorrow.

Sign up with your school email. Snap a stack of papers. Get your first dashboard in under 5 minutes - no setup calls, no procurement, no IT.

Get more from every workout

See how each class helps you progress

name: Stellar Sleep
brief:
Product: Stellar Sleep
One-liner: We help people with chronic insomnia sleep better, using psychology.
Description: 25 million Americans with chronic insomnia are getting inadequate and superficial care advice (e.g. cutting coffee, meditation etc.), when in reality, their sleep problems are often driven by deeper psychological challenges like unresolved anxiety. Stellar Sleep uses psychology to help these people break the insomnia cycle.
Industry: Healthcare
target:
Learn how to sleep again.

Stellar Sleep is the largest insomnia care organization in the US* — home of the #1-rated insomnia app and a nationwide network of insomnia specialists.

Start tonight with the app

The #1-rated insomnia app, built on CBT-I — start seeing results in 2 weeks.

Purchased separately; HSA/FSA eligible.

How we run at this scale

Being the largest takes new infrastructure. We built Rhythm — AI agents handle the routine work, so our clinicians can focus on you, not paperwork.

We were insomniacs, tired of waiting for solutions that came too late. Stellar Sleep was born from that frustration. We worked with sleep experts, converting our shared experiences into a digital solution. In 2021, we started as a venture at Harvard Innovation Labs to make our solution available to the world. Today we operate the largest network of insomnia clinicians in the US.*

Solve your sleep problems at the root

Insomnia is often a symptom of deeper challenges like anxiety, stress, or other things going on in your life. That’s why things like cutting coffee, and meditation aren’t enough.

How Stellar Sleep works

Take our free sleep quiz

Help us understand the current state of your sleep and life factors that might impact your sleep

Get your path

A personalized app program, or a matched insomnia specialist covered by insurance

Sleep well again

The app supports your care between sessions

We specialize in insomnia therapy

Our program is deeply rooted in proven behavioral therapy for insomnia techniques. We've distilled this rich clinical heritage into a convenient and accessible format, so you can harness the power of these techniques to experience sleep as it should be.

Example techniques:

SRT: Sleep restriction

Paradoxical intentions

Cognitive restructuring

Sleep anxiety

Why people love Stellar Sleep

Actual Stellar Sleep customer reviews

Stellar Sleep has truly been a game-changer for my insomnia! It does take some time to get going, but the app's cognitive behavioral therapy techniques have helped me develop healthier mental habits and manage my anxiety at night. I literally went from 6 hours being a "good" night to regular 7 to 8 hours nights.

name: Amika
brief:
Product: Amika
One-liner: Infra to build your own software factory
Description: Amika is infra to build your software factory. We give your team sandboxed AI coding agents in the cloud: the same infrastructure Ramp, Coinbase, and Stripe built in-house. Kick off work from a web UI, CLI, Slack, or API. Use your preferred coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, etc.). Each agent understands your codebase, runs autonomously, and ships real PRs with live previews of the apps it changed. Use it as your daily driver or plug it into your own code-gen pipeline via API.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Machine Learning, B2B, Infrastructure, AI
target:
Multiplayer cloud workstations for coding agents and humans

Backed by

3 ways to use it

One platform, three ways to put it to work

It's the same sandbox and agent underneath, so you can move between all three without starting over.

engineering : devboxes

Cloud devboxes with SSH and VPN access, preloaded with your stack.

team : cloud background agents

Interactive cloud agents anyone can drive from Slack, Linear, or the web.

automation : APIs + agentic workflows

Programmatic background agents and workflows that run on their own.

devboxes

Give every developer a cloud devbox that mirrors production. SSH straight in or put it on your VPN, and code against your real services and seeded data.

Preloaded stack

Shared with

cloud background agents

Let engineers and non-engineers spin up agents from the tools they already use, and collaborate with them in a multiplayer chat as the work happens.

APIs + agentic workflows

Control sandboxes and agents directly via API, CLI, and SDKs, or run higher-level workflows that trigger on events and schedules. Auto-fix incidents, keep docs in sync, or run a software factory that ships verified code.

on: sentry.alert

Examples of what you can build

A few of the workflows teams stand up on Amika. Each one is an agent (or a fleet of them) wired into your tools, your data, and your stack.

Run your software factory

Background agents pick up tickets in a sandbox with every tool and service they need to implement and verify the work, then loop until checks pass and open a PR.

Auto-fix production bugs

Background agents watch Sentry, pull matching logs from GCP or AWS, reproduce the issue in a sandbox, and open a GitHub PR with the fix.

Standardized cloud dev environment for humans and agents

One person sets up the whole stack, dependencies, services, and tools, plus agent hooks, skills, and MCP servers, and the whole team (humans and agents) boots the same environment.

An agent across all your tools

Start an agent in Slack, dive deeper on your computer, then share results for a teammate to inspect on their phone.

Agents for non-technical teammates

Ops, analytics, and customer-success agents (and more!) that connect to your data and build dynamic dashboards, no engineer required.

Run agents on the machine in your closet

Message agents and sandboxes running on hardware you own, even the desktop in your closet, from anywhere.

Why it works

Everything that makes in-house agents powerful

Use any agent and model
