name: Graphify Labs
brief:
Product: Graphify Labs
One-liner: On-device Knowledge Graph engine for Enterprise Software
Description: Graphify builds a queryable knowledge graph from your codebase, docs, and Jira. The open-source engine has 105K+ GitHub stars and ~5M downloads, and is used in production by engineers at Rootly, Geotab, Tweddle Group, and Superagent. On top of that graph, our enterprise layer reviews every pull request and formally verifies each code change: it proves the new behavior matches the old, or hands back the exact input that breaks it.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, Open Source
target:
The knowledge graph control plane for enterprise software.

Free plan, no card · run the open-source engine yourself

One map of the code

One graph across every repository and team, built once and kept current. Nobody re-learns the codebase by hand, and what one engagement learns carries into the next.

Answers with proof

Every answer is a path through the graph you can open, spanning code, docs, wikis and contracts. Evidence rather than opinion, for audited and regulated work.

See what breaks

Before the merge, the graph follows every edge to what a change breaks. The agent reads the graph instead of the repo, so the token bill buys answers.

Used by engineers at

Structure your assistant can walk.

One run maps the repo. Here’s what you get to work with.

Interactive graph

The graph maps your repo into communities, god nodes, and click-to-inspect symbols.

Fully on-device

Run the open-source engine and parsing stays on your machine: 36 tree-sitter grammars, no uploads, no telemetry.

Query, don’t grep

Your assistant follows real paths with query , path , and explain , not re-reads.

17 assistants

Your assistant queries the graph over MCP, in Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and 14 more.

Cross-repo graph

One persistent graph across every repo, so answers follow owners across services.

PR review

graphify prs triages CI, review, and merge-conflict risk, learning from each merge.

Formal verification

Enterprise checks verify every change at the merge gate with graph-aware review.

Graph, chunks or grep.

Four tools an enterprise shortlists. Here’s what each one can actually do.

As each vendor documents it, September 2026. CodeRabbit and Greptile review pull requests and Sourcegraph searches code; the rows are what enterprise teams asked us for, not the whole of any product.

Try it on your own repo

$ uv tool install graphifyy

Run it on your machine, or let us run it.

The open-source tool never sends your code anywhere. The hosted product is a choice, not the only way in.

On-device

The command-line tool parses locally on 36 tree-sitter grammars and writes the graph to a file on your own disk.

No telemetry

The tool sends no usage pings, no crash reports and no analytics. Nothing to opt out of, because nothing is sent.

Apache 2.0

The whole source is Apache 2.0 on GitHub. You need not trust this page; read what the code does.

Yours to host

Immigration, Made Effortless

Full-Service U.S. Work Visas for Your Growing Team

Immigration on your terms

Your immigration journey, simplified

Your dedicated team gathers your information, organizes documents, and handles the details so you don't have to.

Our attorneys prepare your complete application in days — built to USCIS standards and optimized for approval.

Dr. Smith's original contributions have been implemented by major institutions globally...

Quality You Can Rely On

Just Sign & Send

name: Trake.app — Turn your music into motion
brief:
Product: Trake.app — Turn your music into motion
Description: See how Trake works: drop a track, pick from 11 reactive visualizers and 11 effects, and export a 1080p MP4 for TikTok, Reels and YouTube. Free to start, no signup, rendered in your browser.
target:
Free music visualizer. No signup.

Export MP4 video _

Trake is a free music visualizer that turns any track into a 1080p MP4 for TikTok, Reels and YouTube — no upload, no install, rendered right in your browser.

From track to video in three steps.

Drop a track

Any MP3, WAV or OGG. It loads straight into the page — no account, no upload, no queue.

Pick a look

Choose a visualizer, stack effects, add a background and a title. It all reacts as you tweak.

Download the MP4

Rendered at 1080p on your own machine, ready to post. No watermark on Pro.

Free forever. Pro when it matters.

Pro 2 months free yearly

$6 /mo

No. Decoding, drawing and rendering all happen inside your browser. Your audio, images and the finished video never reach us or anyone else — there is no server involved.

Yes. You keep every right to what you load and what you export, and we claim no license over any of it. You do need to hold the rights to the music you use — that part is on you, and since your files never reach us, we could not check it even if we wanted to.

Any audio your browser can play — MP3, WAV, M4A and FLAC all work, and OGG does in most browsers. For the background you can add an image or a video, and everything is read straight off your disk, so there is no upload and no size limit beyond what your machine can hold.

A 1080p MP4 at 30 frames a second, with H.264 video and AAC audio — the combination every platform and editor accepts. You pick the shape before exporting: 9:16 for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, 1:1 for feed posts, or 16:9 for YouTube. The export is always full resolution no matter how small the preview is on your screen.

Exporting needs WebGL2 and WebCodecs, including the audio encoder. Chrome and Edge have had it for years, and Safari has it from version 26 on. Older Safari and Firefox can preview but not export. If your browser cannot, the app tells you when you open it rather than after you have done the work.

brief:
Product: Marblism
One-liner: AI Employees who love overtime
Description: We've built several businesses over the years, and each time, we faced the same challenges. We knew we needed to send sales emails, post regularly on social media, keep an eye on Google Ads, or simply manage the endless flood of emails—but somehow, these tasks always slipped through the cracks. The intention was there, but reality always got in the way. That's why we created Marblism: AI Employees who seamlessly handle the tasks you keep putting off.

target:
AI Employees to Scale Your Business

Get an AI Team who run your inbox, socials, SEO, lead generation, calls, and support

You want to scale your business, but...

You start your day with 100+ unread emails

Your social media hasn't been updated in weeks

Everything keeps getting pushed to "next week"

You're wearing too many hats: CEO, marketer, sales rep, operations manager...

Stop juggling.

Meet your new AI Team

AI Employees run your inbox, socials, SEO, sales & calls

Executive Assistant

“ I craft email replies, filter out junk emails, manage your calendar and take meeting notes, so you never miss a beat. ”

Social Media Manager

“ I turn your social media into a lead-generating machine, without you having to dance on camera. ”

Lead Generation

“ I find leads, run outreach and follow-ups, and turn ’not interested’ into ’where do I sign?’ ”

Website Builder

“ I build your site, then fine-tune every headline, photo and button to convert more customers. ”

SEO Expert

“ I write SEO-optimized blog posts that make Google happy, your audience obsessed, and your competitors jealous. ”

Receptionist

“ I’ll answer calls while you hide in the back pretending to be busy. ”

Legal Assistant

“ I draft your contracts, answer your legal questions and clarify the fine print, so you can stop pretending you read it. ”

Eva organizes your inbox and prepares replies

The day begins. You open your inbox, ready for the usual flood. But it's quiet - organized. Eva's already been here. She's filtered the noise, flagged the real conversations, and drafted replies in your voice.

You haven't posted today, but Sonny has

Your feeds are alive. A new carousel drops on Instagram - 'Five Hidden Costs Every First-Time Homebuyer Should Know.' Sonny posted it an hour ago. Next week's lineup is already scheduled. All you do is approve and move on.

Your site's climbing the ranks, Penny's behind it.

Your phone buzzes. Penny's message lights up: 'We're on the first page of Google for Top 10 Neighborhoods Investors Are Overlooking in 2025.' You smile. She didn't just write the post: she found the keywords, shaped the story, and timed the publish perfectly.

name: Mindstate Design Labs
brief:
Product: Mindstate Design Labs
One-liner: Programmable biology company for psychoactive effect design
Description: Mindstate Design Labs is building the closed-loop science & engineering stack for rational psychoactive effect design. Our molecular-experience interface links molecular biology to the human psychopharmacodynamic profile to convert informal constructs like clarity, presence, or motivation into high-dimensional design targets.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Hard Tech, Neurotechnology, Biotech, AI
target:
Experience is an engineerable output of biology.

What we do

We're building the closed-loop science + engineering stack for rational psychoactive effect design.

Osmanthus

A molecular experience interface

Our molecular-experience interface links biology to human experience, transforming effects like clarity, presence, and motivation into quantitative design targets.

Osmanthus extends rational drug design to psychopharmacodynamic effects by mapping molecular structure, polypharmacology, and pathway signaling onto high-dimensional drug-effect readouts derived from free-form first-person narratives and represented in a shared, continuous experiential latent space.

Read our paper about how LLM embeddings can reconcile subjective phenomena with objective measurement in neuroscience.

Research + development programs

Our clinical programs are a sequence of human demonstrations that psychoactive effects can be decomposed, recombined, and synthesized. Our primer + probe fixed-dose combinations provide iterative testing of target psychoactive effect profiles and advance directly to human trials.

Program timeline

* GLP safety pharmacology; GLP single-dose toxicity/TK studies in rat and dog; genotoxicity; DMPK/ADME; MRSD achieved † Fixed-dose combination safety/PK trial in healthy normal volunteers ‡ Placebo-controlled trial in patients powered for primary efficacy endpoints

The first controlled study of primer MSD-001 decomposed hallucinations and other effects from the broader hallucinogen profile. The next human study of the first primer + probe combination is designed to selectively upregulate aesthetic salience to treat anhedonia in major depressive disorder.

Additional parallel programs are designed to demonstrate de novo synthesis of novel psychoactive effects.

Discovery-stage programs optimize for single-molecule, multi-target action producing a broader range of psychoactive effects.

News

Follow along as AI and psychedelics become the tools for bioengineering human experience.

Experience becomes an engineering discipline

Turning psychoactive effects into a design system

Silicon Valley backs the rational design of mental states

name: REPROSENT
brief:
Product: REPROSENT
One-liner: Activating an overlooked force in medicine - the patient.
Description: REPROSENT is a patient-driven care system that harnesses patients' time to relieve overburdened medical teams. With an app that elevates the role of both patients and their loved ones, REPROSENT helps patients stay on track, capture previously untapped data about their lived experience, and receive timely triage that improves their health outcomes.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Biometrics, Consumer Health Services, Digital Health, Healthcare, Oncology
target:
Turning patient symptoms into computable signal.

REPROSENT captures the day-to-day treatment experience and makes it usable for dose, safety, and development decisions.

We deploy as an observational overlay on top of existing trials and care programs – EHR-agnostic, non-interventional, and aligned with current safety reporting – so teams can finally see how patients are actually living on therapy.

Infrastructure for real-time human response

REPROSENT sits alongside existing systems as a lightweight data engine – capturing patient experience, aligning it with dose and timing, and returning a clean signal that development and clinical teams can act on.

Patient-side capture

Patients (or caregivers) complete a 1–2 minute check-in from home, describing their actual experience in plain language mapped to structured scales.

Clinician context

Treating teams review concise views in-flow, confirm grading where needed, and keep standard AE and safety workflows unchanged.

Computable dataset

The platform turns this stream into longitudinal, dose-aware, AI-ready data that can be reused across trials, programs, and models.

Advanced therapies without advanced tolerability data

Antibody–drug conjugates, immunotherapies, and other next-generation agents can be life-extending – but they also create complex, day-to-day toxicities that are largely invisible between visits.

Blind spots between visits

Most oncology programs still rely on intermittent clinic check-ins and retrospective recall, missing how symptoms evolve in real life.

Dose and safety decisions

Without high-resolution tolerability data, teams are forced to make dose, schedule, and escalation decisions using partial information.

Future-proofing development

Regulators and medical teams are asking for stronger evidence on how patients actually live on therapy. A reusable human-signal layer makes that feasible.

Built for the teams advancing cancer therapy

REPROSENT works with organizations that need higher-fidelity tolerability signal without slowing development or changing core systems.

Biopharma development & medical teams

Cooperative groups & cancer centers

If you’re exploring dose optimization, tolerability signal, or patient-centric models in oncology, we’d be glad to connect.

[email protected]

United States — working with oncology teams globally.

name: Simplify
brief:
Product: Simplify
One-liner: Helping a billion people build their dream career
Description: Simplify is building the AI-enabled infrastructure to power the next generation of hiring – reimagining how people discover and secure their next career opportunity. We believe that everyone deserves an all-star talent agent helping them plan, manage, and accomplish their career goals, no matter their background, location, or education.
Industry: Consumer / Job and Career Services
Tags: Generative AI, Machine Learning, Marketplace, Recruiting
target:
Get hired 3x faster with your AI job search partner.

Simplify proactively matches better-fit roles, customize your resume, and applies for you.

90% of your job search automated with one profile.

5+ hours

Saved on job applications each week

Higher interview rate with applications tailored by Simplify

People have joined Simplify to find their next job

Fresh roles, added hourly

Job searching is busywork. Your Simplify agent takes it on.

Your own AI job search expert

Simplify reads your resume the way a recruiter would — scoring it, naming the skills and keywords you're missing, and surfacing the people you already know at the company. You get a personalized plan for every role, not generic advice.

Optimize your resume with AI

Drop in your resume once. For every role you open, Simplify reads the job description and rewrites your bullets in your own words — accept the suggestions you like, line by line.

Track every application in one place

Everything you send lands in your tracker automatically — status, dates, contacts, and what to do next. No spreadsheet to maintain, nothing forgotten between the first email and the offer.

Helping 2 million job seekers move forward.

Where Simplify users got hired this week

Everything else your job search needs

Got questions?

Everything people ask us before they sign up.

Is Simplify free? How do you make money?

Simplify is free for job seekers — matches, autofill, and the tracker included. We make money from Simplify+ subscriptions and from employers who hire through us.

How does Simplify work?

Build one profile. We match it against millions of openings, autofill applications with the Copilot extension, tailor your resume per role, and track every application in one place.

How does Simplify handle my data?

Your profile is yours. We share it with employers only when you apply or choose to make it visible, we never sell your data, and you can export or delete it at any time — see our privacy policy for the full picture.

How does Simplify get the job postings it recommends me?

We index postings directly from 50+ job boards and company career pages daily, then rank them against your preferences and experience.

Do I need the Chrome extension?

No, but it saves the most time — Copilot fills repetitive application questions for you on any site.

Where can I subscribe to Simplify+?

Observability, Quality, Governance, and Discovery under one control plane.

Siloed tools fragment information and erode trust. Our unified control plane is built on a context engine, bringing metadata, lineage, logs, validations, and health signals together to power every workflow and every AI agent with reliable data.

Discovery

Make data easy to find, increase adoption & trust.

Governance

Set and enforce policies for compliance & security.

Quality

Guarantee trusted input for every dashboard, model and AI workflow.

Detect and resolve issues before they impact downstream assets.

Shared context on every dataset and event across your stack.

Pipelines scale faster than people

Thousands of data sets and infinite changes outgrow human capacity. You need AI to manage, monitor, validate, and triage data at scale, and reliable data is needed to power AI products.

AI for data reliability -> reliable data for AI

AI agents are the only way to keep up

AI-first data quality, discovery & governance

Bring tests, rules, and metadata into your codebase so you can prevent drifts and scale AI reliably.

dbt-Native by design

The Elementary dbt package seamlessly integrates your tests and artifacts with your data warehouse.

Any pipeline. Any data. End-to-end.

One-liner: Turn your ideas into full-stack apps
Description: Skip the complexity, high costs, and limitations of no-code tools—our AI-powered platform lets you create scalable, modern full-stack apps using natural language, all while keeping full ownership of your code.

target:
Text to App in Minutes.

Codev helps your app idea come to life, and deploys it to your domain.

Choose Your Model

Built with Tools Developers Love

The Code is Yours

Deploy to Your Custom Domain

Join 40,000+ Builders ★★★★★

Our rapidly growing community of developers and creators building over 45,000+ apps with Codev

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Codev?

Codev is an AI-powered platform that converts text descriptions into full-stack Next.js web applications. It helps developers and non-developers alike bring their app ideas to life quickly and efficiently.

How does it work?

Simply describe your app idea in natural language, and Codev will generate a complete Next.js application with all necessary components, styling, and functionality. The AI understands your requirements and creates production-ready code.

What technologies does Codev use?

Codev generates applications using Next.js (a popular React framework), and Supabase (a PostgreSQL database with real-time data sync). The apps are built with best practices and are fully customizable after generation.

Do I need coding experience to use Codev?

While coding experience is helpful, it's not required. Codev is designed to be accessible to both developers and non-developers.

Can I customize the generated code?

Yes! The code generated by Codev is yours to modify and customize. You have full access to the source code and take it with you when you leave Codev.

What are the limitations?

Codev can generate full-stack applications with CRUD operations and database integration. However, more complex applications like web crawlers or apps that need to handle high traffic and scalability are not currently supported. Also, we are currently only supporting web applications, so mobile apps and Chrome extensions are out of scope.

Can I deploy and go to production without any developer?

While Codev generates production-ready code, we highly recommend having a developer review the application before going to production, particularly to address security considerations and scaling requirements.

Can I make mobile apps (iOS/Android)?

No, Codev only supports making web apps at this time.

Description: hiloop helps teams train agents for tasks where general models are not good enough. Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, Machine Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Infrastructure
target:
Autoresearch as a service.

Hi, we're hiloop

We turn a measurable target into thousands of directed experiments, and return a better model or algorithm. You bring the metric and a way to score it. We run the loop.

What we've worked on

If you can measure it, we can climb it.

Post-training

A model that has to score higher on an eval you own. We run the loop against that metric and return the weights.

Optimization

Inference and kernel work where cost and throughput are the target: quantization, scheduling, speculative decoding.

Synthetic RL environments

The environments an agent trains against, generated and scored by the loop instead of hand-built one at a time.

Signal processing

Detection and decoding against a labelled corpus, where accuracy is measured the same way every run.

Get in touch

We'll run autoresearch on your problem.

Mailing list

Get occasional updates.

name: CB Therapeutics
brief:
Product: CB Therapeutics
One-liner: Fermentation-derived natural products to solve health problems
Description: CB Therapeutics engineers microbes to produce high-value ingredients for medicines, supplements, and other wellness products through sustainable biomanufacturing.
Industry: Healthcare / Industrial Bio
Tags: Cellular Agriculture, Biotech
target:
Rare compounds. Real biology.

A BIOLOGICAL SUPPLY CHAIN

Not foraged. Grown in yeast.

100+ compounds generated

One platform. 100+ molecules.

Alkaloids · Cannabinoids · Peptides · Designed analogs

Plan . Build . Test . Iterate .

Every molecule CB Therapeutics produces travels the same loop. Each round sharpens titer, purity, and consistency, until the compound reaches what the program needs.

Every plan starts from a target compound. Phylogenomic and proteomic search surfaces the enzyme candidates; retrosynthetic work wires them into a coherent pathway.

The platform is AI-guided .

The platform learns from itself. Lab experiments generate training data; agentic AI closes the loop back into the next plan. Research and production compound on every round.

Every class, one platform

One platform, eight compound classes. Phytocannabinoids, terpenes, tryptamines, rare alkaloids, ergolines, peptides, plus novel analog tracks for tryptamines and cannabinoids. The same biosynthetic logic runs across all of them.

Phytocannabinoids

CBD, CBG, CBC, CBN, and THCV produced via precision fermentation. No crop extraction, no harvest seasonality.

Cannabinoid analogs

Novel chemical variants designed through enzyme engineering. Not naturally occurring, purpose-built for target profiles.

Terpenes

Geraniol, linalool, myrcene and the full aromatic palette. Fermentation-derived at consistent composition.

Tryptamines

Baeocystin, 5-HTP, and the broader tryptamine class. Pathway runs end-to-end on engineered yeast for neuropsychiatric research.

Tryptamine analogs

Designed-novel compounds inspired by natural tryptamine scaffolds. New structural space for mental health applications.

Rare alkaloids

Mitragynine, ergolines, and MIA pathway intermediates from Voacanga and Catharanthus sources. Rare alkaloids outside the tryptamine family.

Food Tech

Animal-free casein, collagen analogs, fats, and vitamins. Identical function, fundamentally different origin.

Novel food additives

Yeast-derived colorants, flavors, and aromas. Functional food ingredients built from the same biosynthetic stack.

8 patents. 100+ compounds. 12 years of yeast.

Eight granted US patents span the precision fermentation platform: yeast strains, biosynthetic pathways, downstream chemistry, and enzyme and gene mining. More applications pending.

What's new.

Program launches, talks, and features. Inbound press welcome at [email protected] .

“ A cleaner question for kratom-class pain biology. ”

The Man Teaching Microbes to Dream

Synthesizing Psychedelics: Unpacking the Options for Psychedelics Production

Breaking ground on sustainable ergoline biosynthesis

Introducing sustainable retinol production

Rare cannabinoids at 99.6% purity

Enabling Psychedelics Research with Precision Fermentation

Momentum .

Recent government and industry moves in mental health therapeutics, peptides, non-opioid pain, and precision fermentation.

Executive order fast-tracks psychedelic review.

Accelerating Medical Treatments for Serious Mental Illness directs FDA Priority Vouchers, $50M ARPA-H to state research programs, and DEA rescheduling review on Phase 3 completion.

target:
Scale Your AI Transformation

Capture how work really happens across your organization—in weeks, not quarters. Turn operational knowledge into the foundation for AI, automation, and measurable business impact.

You can’t transform what you can’t see.

Strategy decks show where you want to go. System logs show what happened. Linc connects both to the human decisions in between—so your roadmap starts with evidence, not assumptions.

Surface the decisions logs miss.

AI-led interviews capture the exceptions, workarounds, and unwritten judgment that determine how work actually gets done.

Preserve the “why” behind the work.

Connect every step to its intent, policies, handoffs, risks, and definition of a successful outcome.

Turn evidence into a living model.

Link people, processes, systems, documents, and dependencies so AI can operate with the full picture.

From operational evidence to production AI.

Linc keeps context intact from discovery through design, so teams can choose the right opportunities and ship solutions that work.

See how work really happens.

Build an evidence-backed AI roadmap.

Design the workflow before you deploy it.

Turn validated processes into governed, implementation-ready workflows for people, agents, and systems—with value attached.

Invoice exception triage

Ground the agent in policy and evidence while finance keeps the decisions that matter.

Built on the systems your teams already use.

Connect process knowledge to the ERPs and operational tools already running your business—without a rip-and-replace migration.

Proven in production. Built for enterprise.

Build the foundation for your AI-native enterprise.

Stop trying to understand how work happens—start transforming it.

Linc gives your teams one operating system to turn how work really runs, not just how it’s documented, into AI you can trust. Start with a single priority and prove ROI in weeks, not quarters.

name: GoGoGrandparent
brief:
Product: GoGoGrandparent
One-liner: A concierge service for seniors’ rides, meals, meds, home and more.
Description: GoGoGrandparent is a virtual retirement community that offers rides, meals, medication, groceries, home maintenance & community for older adults living at home. All services are accessible via regular phone call (no special technology required) and all service providers are vetted & screened. All requests are monitored for greater than 99% reliability, many of our clients rely on us to live years longer in their home.
Industry: Consumer / Home and Personal
Tags: Assistive Tech, Consumer Health Services
target:
Rides, groceries, meals & more: Built better for older adults and people with disabilities.

Services Offered By GoGo Tailored for Seniors

What To Expect When You Call Us

Plans & Memberships That Fit Your Life

Basic

For guardians & family members looking to use the service occasionally.

Value

Our most attractive plan! For guardians & customers who look for great value in our services.

Premium

For guardians & customers planning to use many of our services.

Total Care

For customers & guardians looking for a comprehensive suite of services as an alternative to long-term care.

Highly Trusted by Our Peers

Get the Best GoGo Experience

Frequently Asked Questions

What Is GoGoGrandparent?

How Does GoGoGrandparent Work?

Is GoGoGrandparent Safe?

How to be a Driver for GoGoGrandparent

Is GoGoGrandparent only for seniors?

Where is GoGoGrandparent Available?

What Services does GoGoGrandparent offer for seniors and people with disabilities?

What do I do when my mom or dad can’t drive anymore?

Start with a simple independence plan: rides to appointments, groceries, meals, and prescriptions. GoGo lets an older adult or caregiver request these services by phone, without needing a smartphone.

Dad can’t grocery shop anymore—what are our options?

Common options include family help, local senior services, store delivery, and phone-based concierge services. GoGo can help coordinate grocery delivery and other errands over the phone.

My parents can’t live at home unless groceries and meals are delivered. What can we do?

Many families combine grocery delivery, meal delivery & rides to appointments. GoGo helps coordinate these basics by phone so daily needs can be covered without apps.

Can I use Uber or Lyft if I can’t use an app?

Yes. GoGo can request rides through major rideshare networks when you call—no app required.

Grandma doesn’t have a smartphone—how can she get an Uber?

She can call GoGo and request a ride by phone. GoGo handles the app-based side for her.

Can I talk to a real person for help?

Yes. If you prefer not to use menus, you can speak with an operator for support.

Can I schedule a ride ahead of time (like for a doctor appointment)?

Yes. You can set up rides in advance for appointments, errands, and planned outings.

Can I set recurring rides (like every Tuesday at 10 a.m.)?

brief:

One-liner: Education, Employment, Loyalty verification. Global & Compliant.
Description: Reclaim Protocol provides best in class conversion rates (45%+) on education, employment and retail loyalty verification. Global coverage, secure and privacy preserving. - Global coverage : Unlike most other vendors we are global by default. No matter where in the world the user is, we can verify. - It is 100% private : Neither you, nor us, see any private information about the user. So you carry no liabilities. No risk of your database getting hacked.
Industry: B2B / Recruiting and Talent
Tags: Identity, AI
target:
Education and Employment verification under $1.

Advances in AI and cryptography help slash prices by up to 99.9%. You are probably being overcharged right now.

The price is the point.

No need to jump through sales calls just to get a price. You can get started without even talking to us.

* 99.9% savings as compared to incumbents listed here ↗

Cut the legacy tax. Keep the margin.

Employment & income

Verify current employer, title, and gross income across 90+ countries. One global flow instead of a US-focused verification stack.

Education enrollment

Verify students at 29,000+ institutions worldwide. Expand beyond national clearinghouses whose listed self-service prices run $4.95 or $19.95 per result.

Not a theory. Already in production.

Reclaim Protocol powers verifications for several Fortune 500 companies.

Conversion after replacing document verification

Observed in one customer deployment: a student platform expanded into hard-to-verify geographies while moving verification conversion from 7% to 44%.

Verifications processed

Reclaim-reported platform total as of July 2026 across education, employment, loyalty, and other verification categories.

The mechanism changed. The price should too.

Old verification economics were built around proprietary databases, country-by-country coverage, and manual exceptions. Reclaim uses AI-assisted connectors and cryptographic verification to automate more of the standard path.

One global source layer

Use the same integration across employers, universities, airlines, hotels, and countries instead of stitching together regional vendors.

Connectors scale like software

AI accelerates how source connectors are created and maintained. Adding coverage no longer needs a traditional data partnership for every source.

Proof replaces routine review

The returned fact is verified cryptographically. Client-side computation and fraud impossibility slash costs.

SOC 2 Type II · ISO 27001 · GDPR ready · Open-source cryptography · Independent audits

Live source. Software proof. Lower bill.

Connect to the live source

Your users log in to the actual portal—not a phishing widget.

Extract only the answer

AI creates a connector that identifies what to verify, without requiring manual development work beforehand.

Verify it automatically

Verification happens on the client side, making it secure, privacy-preserving, and cost-effective.

Global coverage without vendor sprawl.

name: Flok
brief:
Product: Flok
One-liner: End to end company retreat planning
Description: Flok offers end to end company retreat planning. Flok combines a planning dashboard with human retreat designers to provide your team with the best retreat possible. From booking hotel room blocks to planning and executing the ideal itinerary, Flok has you covered.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Marketplace, Travel, Remote
target:
The destination gets them there. The design decides what they carry home.

We design and run corporate retreats for remote and distributed teams. Each one built around your team's goals. The venue, the structure, the conditions for real impact. You're there to lead it, not manage it.

We start With One Question:

What does this retreat need to accomplish?

Everything follows from the answer. Down to who sits with whom. ‍ To reconnect a distributed team , we mix small groups across location, function, and tenure, then reshuffle them across meals and sessions. ‍ To get a team aligned on what's next, we mix seniority and function so the real disagreement surfaces early, while there's still time to work it through. ‍ One element. Two designs. Because the goals are different.

Three ways to work with Flok

Whether you need just the right venue or want us to design and execute the whole thing, we work at whatever level makes sense.

Venue Sourcing

Expert venue sourcing and contract negotiation, saving you time and money. With backgrounds at Marriott and Four Seasons, Flok brings insider knowledge that translates into better contracts and smoother operations.

Average 10-20% savings

Tell us your dates, headcount, and budget. We source the shortlist and negotiate the contract. Our hotel relationships mean better rates and fewer surprises.

Custom Designed Retreats

Your unique vision transformed into an unforgettable retreat experience. Every retreat is designed with extraordinary care, strategic focus, and operational rigor from concept to completion.

End-to-end design

We design your retreat around what your team needs. Connection, clarity on what's next, or both. The venue, the structure, the conditions for the work. We execute the whole event. You're there to lead it, not manage it.

Strategic Escapes

Our most comprehensive offering: blending expert-designed and facilitated workshops into your custom retreat. Strategic retreats align teams better than 6 months of meetings with measurable ROI.

Measurable ROI

Our most comprehensive offering. We start with a purpose session: what needs to be different when your team gets back, specifically. The venue, structure, and every condition is designed around that answer. We execute the whole event.

Three retreats from the last twelve months

What kind of retreat are you planning?

Company Retreats

Planning your annual all-hands or full-company offsite? We handle the venue, the structure, and the on-site operation. You're there to lead it, not manage it.

Executive Leadership Offsites

Duoseq

Seamless Integration with EPIC/EHR

Built for Automation, Engineered for Speed

name: Aidy
brief:
Product: Aidy
One-liner: Mobile app helping people better manage chronic health conditions
Description: Aidy is a mobile app that helps people live fuller lives with chronic health conditions, beginning with Inflammatory Bowel Disease (Crohn’s Disease and Ulcerative Colitis). Our app lets users easily log their symptoms, diet, and treatments, then uses clinical indices to track disease severity and trends over time.
Industry: Healthcare / Consumer Health and Wellness
Tags: Consumer Health Services, Digital Health
target:
Personalized support for living with Crohn's & UC

Aidy helps people with IBD stick to treatment plans, discover and avoid triggers, and better communicate with care teams. All free.

Get started via text

A companion for wherever you are on your IBD journey

Seeking a diagnosis

Keep a clear record of symptoms, meals, and questions, so your first conversations with a GI start with the full picture.

Newly diagnosed

Learn the language of IBD, build a baseline, and keep the next steps from your care team in one manageable place.

Starting a first biologic

Remember doses and infusions, log how you feel, and watch for changes as a new treatment becomes part of your routine.

Between appointments

Capture the small day-to-day details and turn them into trends you can understand without letting tracking take over your life.

Switching biologics

Follow a new schedule and compare your symptoms and routines before and after the switch, one day at a time.

Preparing for or recovering from surgery

Organize questions and prep beforehand, then keep up with medications, symptoms, energy, and recovery once you’re home.

Whatever today looks like, Aidy can meet you there.

Everything in one place

Stress less. Understand more.

What Aidy captures

Symptoms

Easily track key symptoms for detecting flares along with whatever else is bothering you, all with just a few quick taps.

Diet

Just snap pics or describe what you eat, then we'll figure out what foods set you off over time.

Treatments

From pills, injections, infusions, and whatever else, Aidy will help you stay on top of your treatments.

What you get

Trend Analysis

Our powerful models show you how your condition is trending over time, helping you figure out what works for you.

Doc-Ready Reports

Aidy lets you easily export physician-friendly reports to keep your doctor up-to-date on how you're doing.

Personalized Learning

Aidy feeds you bite-sized nuggets about your condition, new research, and what people are finding works for them.

Log, then learn

Make sense of your Crohn's or UC, one daily check-in at a time

Aidy makes it simple to monitor your condition and helps you figure out what works and what doesn't.

name: Conductor Quantum
brief:
Product: Conductor Quantum
One-liner: AI that operates quantum computers for scientific discovery
Description: Conductor Quantum is building quantum superintelligence: AI that operates quantum computers to make scientific discoveries beyond human reach. Quantum computers let us understand the world at its most fundamental level, the path to new drugs, new materials, and discoveries no human can reach alone. A quantum computer is the perfect simulator of nature: it encodes the logic of reality into a programmable machine, atom by atom, electron by electron.
Industry: Industrials
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Hard Tech, Machine Learning, Quantum Computing, Semiconductors
target:
Build Something Quantum, |

What we do

We build the software infrastructure to make quantum computers work today.

At the top, Coda is our natural language interface for quantum computing. Describe what you want to do, and Coda generates the quantum program, executes it, and returns the results.

At the bottom, Control brings quantum computers online and keeps them operating reliably.

Together, they unify the entire quantum computing stack.

The quantum computing stack

The traditional stack has many layers between the user and the hardware. Conductor condenses it into three.

Hover over a layer to see the mapping

An AI-powered natural language interface for quantum computing.

What would you like Coda to do?

Automated calibration software for quantum computers of any size. Built-in gate tune-up, readout optimization, and crosstalk mitigation.

Software that Scales

Designed from the ground up to operate large-scale quantum computers, from tens of qubits to billions. Parallelized architecture with no bottlenecks.

ML-Powered Analysis

Machine Learning models for automated analysis, extracting insights in milliseconds. Classify qubit states and detect anomalies without manual inspection.

Hardware Agnostic

Not locked to any single qubit type or vendor. Supports superconducting, spin, trapped-ion, and photonic systems through a unified interface.

Questions & Answers

Try our New Product, Coda.

We build the software infrastructure to make quantum computers work today.

At the top, Coda is our natural language interface for quantum computing. Describe what you want to do, and Coda generates the quantum program, executes it, and returns the results.

At the bottom, Control brings quantum computers online and keeps them operating reliably.

Together, they unify the entire quantum computing stack.

The quantum computing stack

The traditional stack has many layers between the user and the hardware. Conductor condenses it into three.

Hover over a layer to see the mapping

An AI-powered natural language interface for quantum computing.

What would you like Coda to do?

Automated calibration software for quantum computers of any size. Built-in gate tune-up, readout optimization, and crosstalk mitigation.

Software that Scales

Designed from the ground up to operate large-scale quantum computers, from tens of qubits to billions. Parallelized architecture with no bottlenecks.

ML-Powered Analysis

Machine Learning models for automated analysis, extracting insights in milliseconds. Classify qubit states and detect anomalies without manual inspection.

Hardware Agnostic

Not locked to any single qubit type or vendor. Supports superconducting, spin, trapped-ion, and photonic systems through a unified interface.

Questions & Answers

Try our New Product, Coda.

name: Mass Magnetics
brief:
Product: Mass Magnetics
One-liner: USA-made magnetics for robotics and defense.
Description: Mass Magnetics turns recycled rare-earth scrap into high-performance permanent magnets, made in America. The materials we supply are the backbone of electric motors, sensors, speakers, hard drives, and electronics. Our process enables DFARS-compliant magnets for defense, aerospace, and industrial manufacturers who demand domestic supply without compromising on quality. Operations in Greater Boston, MA (Greentown Labs) and Columbus, IN.
Industry: Industrials / Defense
Tags: Hard Tech, Robotics, Drones, Manufacturing, Defense
target:
Domestic Rare Earth Magnets

Rebuilding the American supply chain

The answer to vertically integrated, capital-light domestic motors.

Backed by & featured in

Are you compliant yet?

If you hope to sell anything that walks, drives, or flies to Uncle Sam in 2027, you're going to need some magnets. We're accepting preorders from customers seeking DFARS 252.225-7052 compliance, with delivery expected by year-end.

"Effective through December 31, 2026, the Contractor shall not deliver under this contract any covered material melted or produced in any covered country, or any end item, manufactured in any covered country, that contains a covered material."

Compliant by construction

A neodymium-iron-boron magnet manufactured from recycled material, where the milling of the recycled material and the sintering of the final magnet take place in the United States.

Performance without compromise

Grades up to N52. Domestic supply doesn't mean settling for less powerful magnets.

You want high Curie points. We have them.

HREs without the cadmium. It's already refined and alloyed. Mass keeps it from being thrown away. We sell DFARS-compliant RE/HRE alloys to domestic metallurgists while we develop the capacity to sinter them ourselves.

A new way to manufacture powerful magnets in the United States.

Mass Magnetics rapidly produces high-performance magnets from domestic and recycled feedstocks, decreasing dependency on foreign-sourced rare-earth materials.

Rapid sintering

Sintered in seconds. Our proprietary process takes recycled powder to a fully densified bulk in as little as 60 seconds. A conventional furnace takes hours and burns far more energy.

Advanced recycling feedstocks

Twice is nice. We source magnet material from recycled waste streams like end-of-life electric motors, hard drives, and industrial equipment.

Magnet intelligence

Not all magnets are made equal. Each possesses a unique chemistry and microstructure. We use machine learning to sort scrap not by geography, but by exact magnet grade and chemistry.

Reduced footprint

Less is more. Sintering fast uses less energy, and recycled material yields fewer heavy metals than rare-earth refining. We're building in lockstep with the green electrification movement.

Every rare-earth magnet leaves a radioactive shadow.

Rare-earth ores carry thorium and uranium oxides. During refinement of the neodymium and praseodymium required for magnet manufacture those radioactive elements concentrate in the tailings and process water left behind.

Estimated radioactivity released from Nd/Pr magnet refinement alone. Much of it is uncontrolled, water-soluble dispersion into groundwater across East Asia.

Estimated total radiological footprint of the global rare-earth mining industry from long-lived thorium-232 and uranium-238 decay chains.

Estimated radioactivity released from Nd/Pr magnet refinement alone. Much of it is uncontrolled, water-soluble dispersion into groundwater across East Asia.

Estimated total radiological footprint of the global rare-earth mining industry from long-lived thorium-232 and uranium-238 decay chains.

name: Cerenovus
brief:
Product: Cerenovus
One-liner: AI that finds value creation opportunities across enterprise…
Description: We are building an AI operating partner that reads every record a company produces to find and prioritize value creation opportunities, including costly operational inefficiencies no one is tracking. Cerenovus warns leaders before small problems become expensive and turns weeks of manual investigation into evidence-backed answers in minutes. Every claim links to its source, and every finding is ranked by impact.
Industry: B2B / Operations
target:
Institutional intelligence and decision infrastructure

Cerenovus is your AI operating partner. It reads every record your company produces, finds the operational inefficiencies nobody is tracking, and warns you while problems are still small.

What Cerenovus does

Oversight over the operations.

Cerenovus finds the operational inefficiencies draining margin, identifies where systems and processes can be improved, and gives early warning when something begins to break. Questions that took weeks of digging get an evidence-backed answer in minutes.

It finds the inefficiencies

Duplicate payments, missed discounts, zombie software seats, dormant vendors, stalled receivables. The quiet leaks every business accumulates.

It also finds what no report shows. Approvals that reject nothing but add two weeks. The same process run three different ways. Work that always waits on one person.

Every finding arrives ranked by impact, with receipts and a named owner.

Foresight, with receipts

Cerenovus gives early warning when systems begin to break: the promise past its deadline with no fulfilling event, the account whose rhythm just broke, the renewal approaching at last year's usage, the process that quietly stopped running.

And before you commit a move, it pressure-tests the plan against everything the record knows.

Who we serve and solutions

Start with the problem on your desk.

Six kinds of buyer, eight jobs Cerenovus does. Pick one; each stands on its own.

Enterprise

Standing oversight over the whole operation: inefficiencies found and priced, early warnings when systems begin to break, answers in minutes with the evidence attached.

Four guarantees

Built to be checked.

Every line Cerenovus produces can be audited, by you, on demand. Four guarantees make the record worth acting on.

Every claim opens to its source

A citation never ends at another summary; every claim opens downward until the original document. A quote that cannot be found in the source never enters the record.

The record is time-aware

What we believed in March and what was actually true in March are different questions with different, correct answers. Last quarter's company is still in the record.

Findings are challenged before they reach you

Every finding is checked against its sources before it reaches you. Anything that cannot be resolved goes to a person for review; nothing is silently dropped.

Every number shows its work

brief:
Product: Type
One-liner: AI-native storytelling studio.
Description: Type.ai is the AI-native storytelling studio for independent authors and creators. We help people craft books, novels, screenplays, and other types of long-form, creative fiction.
Industry: Consumer
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, SaaS, Consumer, Productivity
target:
The intelligent editor for storytellers.

Finish your next book, screenplay, or story with the AI editor for professional storytelling.

Trusted by 300k+ writers

Meet your new creative partner.

State-of-the-art intelligence inside a deep workflow for writers.

remember everything

Write and chat in one place.

Your draft and AI assistant are deeply integrated in Type. No more copy-pasting between tools.

Deep AI integration

Save rich details about your story.

Save your characters, settings, and scenes so Type can give you delightfully specific suggestions.

Feature-Rich editor

Write in your style.

Create custom writing rules to help amplify the quirks that make your writing unique.

Multimodal Publishing

Get to publish-ready faster.

Export a draft as a DOCX, PDF, or view-only URL. Or pick a voice and generate a high-quality narrated track.

All inside a modern word processor

Offline mode. Keyboard shortcuts. Version history. Type goes beyond the basics to deliver a complete workflow for professional storytellers.

Write anywhere, anytime, even without an internet connection.

No AI models are trained on your data, ever.

Embed images, tables, code, and math blocks.

Navigate the entire app without leaving your keyboard.

Frequently asked questions

What kind of writing is Type.ai best for?

Type.ai excels at writing books, novels, screenplays, stories, or any type of creative long-form writing that requires careful crafting, editing, and review.

Does Type.ai train on my data?

No, Type does not train any AI models on your data. All of your uploads and documents in Type remain private to you. You can read Type's full privacy policy here .

What exactly is Type.ai?

Type.ai is the most popular alternative to ChatGPT and Claude for long-form creative writing tasks that require a deep editing process. Type.ai has a feature-rich document editor with deeply embedded AI features for generating, revising, and reviewing documents. You'll also find tools for easily organizing your work.

Can I edit an entire book in Type.ai?

Yes, you can edit an entire book or novel in Type.ai. Type's editing and writing features are designed to work on documents as long as 150,000 words. For manuscripts longer than 150k words, we recommend breaking it up into multiple documents.

Can I edit and generate Word documents in Type.ai?

name: Payna
brief:
Product: Payna
One-liner: AI Licensing Agent for Regulated Industries
Description: Payna is building the AI licensing agent for regulated companies. We automate the filings, renewals, amendments, and regulator follow ups required to get licensed and stay licensed across jurisdictions, so teams no longer have to manage compliance through spreadsheets, email threads, and expensive outside firms.
Industry: B2B
target:
From the first license to the hundredth.

One system for every application, renewal, and seat. Payna runs licensing and compliance for regulated companies and the people they license, in every US state and beyond.

THE PLATFORM

Four products. One system of record for everything a regulator can ask about.

Apply

New state license applications for regulated companies: mortgage, insurance entities, lending, debt collection, and money transmitter. From first filing to approval.

Seats

Per-person licensing, managed at roster scale. MLOs on NMLS: MU4 filings, sponsorships, CE, the renewal window. Adjusters and producers on NIPR: multi-state licensing and deployment readiness.

Maintain

Ongoing compliance for every license a company holds: renewals, amendments, call reports, exam preparation, and regulatory change monitoring.

API

Real-time, programmatic access to license status, sponsorship state, CE completion, and regulatory actions. Wire licensure into existing systems.

Company licenses and individual seats in every US jurisdiction.

Payna drafts every application and renewal. The compliance team approves before anything goes out.

A timestamped record of every filing, approval, and change, ready when the examiner asks.

THE PROBLEM

The most regulated part of the business, managed with spreadsheets and prayer.

Renewal deadlines buried in spreadsheets no one updates. Regulatory changes that surface from outside counsel, weeks late.

The month before every state exam spent in survival mode. A roster of licensed people tracked by hand, one missed renewal away from unlicensed activity.

Compliance teams are sharp. They’re just doing manual work that a system should handle for them.

The current system of record

WHAT PAYNA DOES

Does the paperwork. The team approves it.

Pre-fills applications and renewals. Drafts BSA/AML policy updates. Generates call reports from ledger data. Routes documents for e-signature. Files on completion. The 80% that is mechanical gets handled. The team stays in the loop for everything that matters.

Knows every rule, in every state.

All 50 US state statutes, NMLS and NIPR procedures, and FinCEN requirements, monitored continuously. When a state changes a bond threshold or a CE requirement, the change surfaces the same day.

Keeps a perfect record of everything.

Every action is timestamped into a structured, queryable, audit-ready history. When an examiner walks in, the package assembles in seconds.

See everything Maintain covers →

WHERE PAYNA WORKS

50 US states. Companies and their people.

One system.

Mortgage · Insurance · Lending · Collections · Fintech · Crypto · Money Transmitter · MLOs · Insurance Adjusters · Insurance Producers

We are audited, too.

Our hope is that people will feel more connected at work if there is greater transparency in how they are rewarded for their efforts. We partner with amazing companies like Carta, Intercom, Gong, and Newfront Insurance to simplify their commissions. Since launching in 2017, we have raised $63M and are backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Accel, S28 Capital, Amity Ventures, and Y Combinator.

target:
Sales Performance Management

A unified platform that connects compensation, planning, and AI in a way legacy tools can't replicate.

Revenue resilience, delivered.

CaptivateIQ is built for agility.

name: Bizmark
brief:
Product: Bizmark
One-liner: AI employee for manufacturers
Description: Bizmark agents do the daily management work in factories. Think OpenClaw for manufacturing. Bizmark agents learn how each factory is managed, then automate the daily work. They learn from the results to make better decisions over time. Founders are cousins Rodrigo (grew up in a factory; CS & MBA at UChicago; built a distribution business 0→$60M) and Oscar (Engineering, Stanford; deployed AI for the US Air Force and machine learning at Amazon, Johnson & Johnson, and Intel).
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Manufacturing, Automation, AI
target:
Systems of Applied Intelligence

Built by engineers from:

Your data is in ERPs / CRMs / SCMs / XYZs. Most operating decisions still run on Excel. Bizmark automates and optimizes those decisions.

How it works

Data layer

Bizmark unifies commercial, financial, and operational records in a governed ontology. People, applications, and agents work from the same operating state.

Logic

Rules, forecasts, and optimization models determine the decision. Stochastic models interpret context; deterministic constraints govern execution.

Execution

Bizmark’s agents carry governed decisions through the administrative workflow— coordinating teams and counterparties, updating systems, and escalating exceptions.

Partnering with the best.

Where is Bizmark deployed

Bizmark is deployed in factories, retailers, universities, and distributors—from $10M businesses to organizations with billions in revenue.

Procurement

Bizmark determines what to buy, when, and from whom under inventory, service, cash, and compliance constraints. It runs the workflow from supplier outreach through approved purchase orders and fulfillment exceptions.

Capabilities

Impact

Production planning

Bizmark converts orders, routings, material availability, finite capacity, and changeover costs into executable production plans. It releases ready work, monitors execution, and replans when operating conditions change.

Labor scheduling

Bizmark converts demand, availability, skills, labor rules, and payroll targets into a feasible staffing plan. It publishes schedules and manages the workflow required to preserve coverage as conditions change.

Revenue operations

Bizmark keeps CRM and pipeline data current, assembles forecasts, and prepares specification-heavy quotes from cost and capacity inputs under deterministic pricing rules. It routes approvals so salespeople spend less time administering deals.

…and 100+ additional enterprise workflows

Built to Work With Your Systems

Bizmark operates across your existing tools, connecting data, workflows, and systems through a shared operating layer. No system migration is required.

name: Apollo
brief:
Product: Apollo
One-liner: Apollo helps engineering teams accelerate delivery
Description: Apollo GraphQL is the leader in open source and commercial GraphQL technologies. Apollo’s open-source GraphQL client, server, and gateway are downloaded more than 17M times per month and used in production by over 30% of the Fortune 500. Customers like Walmart, Expedia, Glassdoor, Audi, and PayPal, use the Apollo Graph Platform to unify their GraphQL efforts, collaborate on graph development, and safely iterate on their graphs.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Developer Tools, Open Source, GraphQL
target:
The API Orchestration Platform for AI Agents, Web, and Mobile Apps

Connect agents and apps to GraphQL and REST APIs with proven infrastructure trusted by enterprise leaders

Trusted by enterprise leaders

Apollo Connectors

Accelerate app development with Apollo Connectors. Bring all APIs together in minutes on a declarative query-based GraphQL platform. Power any app with real-time data. Build, debug, and deploy faster than ever.

Get hands-on with Apollo Connectors with an interactive tutorial .

Get started with Apollo Connectors

Building Intelligent Experiences on GraphOS

Gain secured and dynamic access to any data and context using GraphQL - built for rapid AI iteration. Start with low code, deploy fast, and govern AI workflows with confidence.

Building intelligent experiences on GraphOS

Deliver tomorrow's roadmap today with Apollo

The GraphOS platform enables backend teams to build a self-service, self-documenting graph that can power any number of applications.

Define data once, deliver anywhere

Eliminate accumulated technical debt from backends-for-frontends or experience APIs. GraphQL federation provides a secure source of truth for the data that powers your business.

Backend teams contribute to a unified and composable platform instead of building one-off backends-for-frontends or experience APIs.

By introducing composability, your teams only have to define core entities and business logic once. Then ship anywhere, across any interface.

Deliver features faster

GraphQL enables teams to deliver feature improvements and experiments faster by decoupling the backend and the frontend. GraphOS provides teams with the tools they need to deliver these benefits at any scale.

Provide a central registry and standardized workflows for backend teams to work better together.

Apollo’s architecture enables frontend teams to fetch all of the data they need from a single endpoint, no matter where it is stored.

Improve performance across applications

GraphQL reduces latency by enabling frontend teams to fetch all of the data they need from a single request. Optimize GraphQL's performance gains even more with Apollo GraphOS.

GraphQL reduces unnecessary network calls that slow your apps down. Take advantage of these benefits at a broader scale using GraphOS Router.

GraphOS provides GraphQL-native metrics to improve performance. Export these numbers into DataDog or OpenTelemetry for further analysis.

Enterprise teams trust Apollo

Enterprises rely on Apollo to unify their APIs into a single, discoverable, and reusable platform that adapts to any use case. Product development teams can work independently, reuse APIs, and deliver new features lightning-fast while benefiting from modularity, optionality, and autonomy.

Matt Sexton

Solutions Architect at Booking.com

name: Risotto
brief:
Product: Risotto
One-liner: Risotto auto-solves IT support requests using AI
Description: Want to apply AI to your IT Helpdesk queue? Risotto helps you grant software access, limit access/permission grants by time, serve knowledge, and get approvals from people like managers. All using natural language directly in chat (AKA "ChatOps") IT teams spend too much time manually provisioning software and answering the same question repeatedly. We help them improve resolution times, reduce SaaS spend, and enhance security with 24/7 automated software access and IT support.
Industry: B2B / Operations
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B, Compliance, Security, Enterprise
target:
AI support. Built by IT, loved by employees.

Automate up to 60% of internal service issues with an AI agent that understands context, not just keywords. Smart routing, instant answers, and help that actually helps for every department in the organization.

Trusted by lean support teams with big hearts (and bigger ticket queues).

55% IT tickets auto-resolved

See how Gusto did it

11.7× Faster time to resolution with AI

See how Jobber did it

79% Reduction in avg resolution time

See how ThoughtSpot did it

Manual, repetitive support is no fun. Let Risotto bring joy back.

An AI ITSM agent that resolves even complex requests.

Risotto’s AI goes beyond FAQs. It captures context, resolves requests end-to-end, and only escalates requests that absolutely need IT intervention.

“Risotto started answering complex product questions even I didn’t know off the top of my head.”

Peter K.,

IT Lead, Hazel Health

No new interfaces, no lost time.

Turn Slack into your help desk, so employees don’t need to switch to another portal.

Erik Van Dijk,

Senior IT Manager at Jobber

Minimize change management. Integrate with ticketing tools, IAM platforms, Confluence, Jira, Notion, Fresh Service, Zendesk, and more.

Jason Huey,

Senior IT Systems Administrator at Thoughtspot

Request, approve, and provision access from your comms tools using simple no-code workflows.

“Risotto intelligently understands the intent behind the request. It confirms existing permissions, coordinates necessary approvals proactively, and automatically provisions access upon approval.”

Phillip Rickett,

Head of IT, Retool

Risotto doesn’t stop at IT. We’re game for all internal support questions.

IT

Automate tier 1 support on your comms channel. Get full visibility and audit-ready access provisioning.

Learn more

HR

Deliver fast answers to PTO, onboarding, and policy questions. Build a self-updating HR knowledge base in the process.

Securely route and respond to sensitive legal queries using existing policy docs. Keep every exchange tracked, compliant.

Finance

Engineering

Security

name: Noora Health
brief:
Product: Noora Health
One-liner: Training patients and their families with health skills
Description: Noora Health trains patient families with high-impact health skills that improve outcomes and save lives. Our model provides basic yet vital care knowledge through trusted providers by creating a scalable program for caregiving education and training within the established healthcare system.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Consumer Health Services
target:
The desire to help the people we love is universal .

Access to caregiver training and support is not. For more than a decade, we've been building Noora Health to address this gap.

At Noora Health, we believe no one should suffer because of a preventable medical condition.

What drives us

There is a power imbalance in our global healthcare system where those who care most for patients — their loved ones — are left out of patient healing. Families and their patients often leave healthcare facilities anxious, confused, and ill-equipped to care for their loved ones, leading to preventable complications and, in some cases, death.

It takes a family

We support the healthcare community in acknowledging loved ones as caregivers and provide essential training and education as a fundamental right of healthcare.

We're partnering with the WHO to support and recognize family caregivers globally

Learn More

Our big idea was named as an Audacious Project Grantee

Watch the Video

A decade of caring together

On our tenth anniversary, we celebrate the power of family caregivers, reflect on our impact, and imagine the future of care across India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal.

We are all caregivers

How it works

By creating a scalable program for caregiving education and training within established healthcare systems, our model provides basic yet vital care knowledge through trusted providers. This model expands the care umbrella to include those closest to the patient — their family and community.

Our progress & outcomes

Since our start in 2014, we have expanded across India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal to train more than 58 million caregivers and patients, impacting millions of lives.

Health workers trained

Caregivers and patients trained

Partner facilities

Decrease in cardiac complications

Increase in skin-to-skin care among new parents

Reduction in newborn mortality

featured in

Every contribution counts

Every donation entrusted to us goes directly towards building programs that equip and train caregivers.

brief:

One-liner: Serverless Infrastructure Platform for AI
Description: Cerebrium is a serverless infrastructure platform for AI applications. We make it easier for companies to build and deploy AI based applications. We offer Serverless GPU's with low cold start times, over 12 varieties of GPU chips, allow you to run large scale batch jobs, run realtime voice applications and much more. We are used by the teams at Tavus, CivitAI, Twilio and many more.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Machine Learning, Infrastructure, AI
target:
Real-time AI infrastructure that scales with you

Deploy voice agents, video models, LLMs, and any AI workload with sub-second cold starts and instant autoscaling. Built for teams that need reliability at scale.

Production speed without the production complexity

Built for teams, pushing boundaries

Why Cerebrium

Cerebrium (with snapshots)

Cerebrium

Provider A

EKS/GKE

Low-latency from the first request.

Launch containers in seconds with memory and GPU snapshotting for fast restores. Cerebrium handles sudden bursts and scale-outs automatically, without compromising performance or user experience.

No reservations, no lock-ins.

Instant access to thousands of GPUs across multiple clouds and regions. Cerebrium scales your workloads in real time - no capacity planning, no reservations, no infrastructure management required.

Bring your own code. We’ll run it.

No rewrites, no decorators, no custom SDKs. Point us to your entry point or Dockerfile and we’ll run your application exactly as is - versioned, reproducible, and ready to scale.

End-to-end Observability for every workload.

Get full visibility into every request. Logs, metrics, scaling events, and system performance, all in real time. Native support for OpenTelemetry makes it easy to plug into your existing monitoring stack.

Security

Stable, secure and compliant

SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO

Built to meet strict security and privacy standards, including giving you a compliant foundation for sensitive and regulated workloads.

Data Residency

Deploy workloads in specific regions to meet regulatory or contractual data privacy requirements. Cerebrium ensures your data stays exactly where it needs to be.

We run each workload on top of gVisor in a hardened, isolated environment to provide strong container isolation without compromising performance.

99.999% Uptime

We have multi-region failovers so if one region or cloud goes down, we will route traffic to the next best alternative within your constraints

target:
Manage your claims with AI agents for RCM

Trusted by forward-thinking healthcare teams

Backed by exceptional health-tech investors

Get claims approved on the first-pass.

Chloe, our LLM Agent for claims processing, scans through your clinical notes, payer policies, real-time eligibility data, coding rules, and more to make sure every claim is compliant and ready to be reimbursed!

Manage your denials in seconds.

Dennis, our AI Agent for denials management, streamlines the resubmission & appeals process by automatically retrieving ERAs from payers, analyzing claim issues, and generating a revised, ready-to-submit 837. Maximize A/R collections & prevent leakage.

Together, our AI agents detect underpayments, missed opportunities, and claim errors in real time, ensuring full reimbursement. They monitor your payer contracts and historical claims data to prevent leakage and minimize write-offs.

We'll integrate your data & make sure it's safe.

Your data is secure with us.

The Cair platform is HIPAA & SOC 2 compliant and none of your data will be stored, shared, or trained on by LLMs.

Our platform works with 80+ Integrations.

Seamlessly sync your EHR or claims data via easy-to-use APIs. We can work with raw notes, x12 EDI files, FHIR resources, or directly with your EHRs API either through pre-built or on-demand integrations.

Revamp your claims pipeline in 2 weeks.

Integrate your claims data

Within a few days, the Cair team will develop a hassle-free way to automatically sync your claims & clinical data with the Cair platform, and kickoff EDI enrollments.

Description: ZiffyHomes is a living solace for young professionals with beautiful living spaces, vibrant community, excellent services and full time support to all our customers. We work towards providing the highest standards of living for young professionals and saving them from woes of house hunt. We wish to provide a space for them where they can flourish.
Industry: Real Estate and Construction / Housing and Real Estate
Tags: Real Estate, India
target:
The quiet future of Indian rentals.

Track rent, onboard tenants, generate agreements, handle maintenance. The entire rental lifecycle , in one calm dashboard built for Indian homeowners and brokers.

Eleven years inside Indian rentals. Fifteen thousand tenants served. Two acquisitions. One hard lesson: don't own the real estate, just run the software . Now rebuilt the way it should have been from the start.

Less paperwork. More rent in the bank .

Tenant onboarding , without the forms.

Invite via a branded WhatsApp link. They open a page with visit details, terms, photos, and neighbourhood highlights. No signup needed until they accept.

Rent tracking that chases itself .

Know exactly who paid, who's overdue, and when to nudge. AI drafts every reminder so you never write the same message twice.

AI agreements

A legally-sound rental agreement in 30 seconds. Edit inline, regenerate any clause, export as PDF.

Maintenance, triaged

Tenants submit with photos. AI ranks priority, routes it. No more midnight calls about leaky taps.

WhatsApp first

Every message, invite and reminder goes out where your tenants actually read. No app to download.

From handshake to handed keys, in one honest flow.

We follow the real Indian rental lifecycle, not an American template. Visit, feedback, offer, agreement, moved-in dashboard. All of it, one tap at a time.

Add the property

Google Places autocomplete. AI enriches with bedrooms, landmarks, transport, schools.

Invite for a visit

WhatsApp link → tenant opens a personalised page with details, terms, map, photos.

Share the offer

Rent, deposit, lock-in, broker charges. One page, one tap to accept. Agreement generation comes next.

Generate the agreement

AI drafts from your property data. You review, edit, and both parties download a PDF.

Run the rental

Rent auto-tracks, maintenance flows in, lease reminders go out. Everyone, same dashboard.

Designed for the people who actually run rentals.

name: Stream
brief:
Product: Stream
One-liner: The AI Claims Workbench automating insurance claims
Description: At Stream, we’re on a mission to modernize the insurance industry. Our product—the Stream AI Claims Workbench—uses custom AI agents to turn a constant stream of PDFs into automated workflows and high-value signals. This helps claims teams focus on the human work—getting people the medical treatment they need and the benefits they’re owed—while reducing costs for insurance companies.
Industry: Fintech / Insurance
Tags: Fintech, SaaS, B2B, Insurance
target:
The AI Platform for Modern Claims Teams

Purpose-built AI for claims experts to drive better outcomes and eliminate leakage

Over $250 billion in P&C claims leakage each year comes down to what gets missed.

Stream closes the gap.

Clarity Across the Entire Claim.

Every document and data point — medical records, demand packages, correspondence, bills — ingested and organized into one structured, dynamic view.

Catch the Signal That Changes the Outcome.

Cross-referencing the full claim record set to surface inconsistencies, flag risk indicators, and identify the patterns that claims teams need to see.

Every Fact Verified. Every Source Linked.

All data points traced back to the source — no hallucinations, no gaps, full auditability across the entire claim file.

Your Experts Lead. Stream Delivers.

One-click settlement analyses, reserve recommendations, and IME packets — generated from the structured claim, delivered into your existing systems.

Integrates directly into your core system

Trusted by claims teams managing billions in exposure.

Built for Enterprise ‍ Deployment

Stream is designed for the security, scale, and compliance requirements of the largest carriers.

Leading Insurance Reasoning Model

AI agents trained by the most sophisticated adjusters, SIU investigators, and AI researchers

Zero-Integration Rollout

Live in weeks, not months. Stream runs standalone with no integration required. Core system integration, API, and batch SFTP also available.

Your Data Stays Yours

Single-tenant architecture. Customer data is never used for model training. Full isolation, full control.

Built for Enterprise ‍ Secure by Design

See what's hiding in your most complex claims

Description: Streamline your expense management with Coast. Issue cards by job or team, capture receipts on site, enforce spending rules instantly, and close books faster.
target:
The smartest card for fuel, field, and office expenses

Your fuel card, corporate card, and expense management are now in one place. Businesses with fleets save an average of $30,000¹ a year when they use Coast to control spending and eliminate manual admin processes.

Thousands of businesses trust us

Average savings based on a survey conducted by Coast in October 2025, with a total of 132 respondents working in businesses operating 10 vehicles or more. Coast customers cite savings resulting from limiting fuel card abuse through better security, better visibility into expenses, rebates on fuel, and streamlined admin and accounting processes. Your actual savings may vary.

One card program for everything your team needs

Whether it’s fuel at the pump, supplies in the field, or inventory in the warehouse, Coast gives you a smarter way to manage every dollar.

Fuel card

Powerful controls make fraud virtually impossible.

Corporate card

Close your books 1.5 days faster.¹ Control, review, and reconcile expenses effortlessly.

Works for businesses like yours

"We're saving an average of $10,000 a year on our fuel bill and at least 10+ hours of admin time per month. We love how easy and user friendly the system and cards are to use."

Roddy Gato

Support Operations Manager, Dynaserv Landscaping

Coast connects to your tools

Connect Coast with the systems you already use to run your business, from telematics to accounting tools. Get real-time insights, stay on top of spending, and uncover new ways to save.

Stop misuse. Prevent overspend.

Protect your business with smarter controls. Set custom rules, block suspicious activity, and get peace of mind with guaranteed protection.

Choose America's top-rated fuel card

Works where you do. Use your card everywhere Visa is accepted.

Responsive support. Our knowledgeable, 100% US-based team will solve your problem during the call, not after multiple call transfers.

No personal guarantee. Coast doesn’t require a personal guarantee, and won’t affect your personal credit score, either.

Frequently asked questions

Have some questions? We’ve got you covered!

How do I apply for a Coast card?

We offer a fast, simple, online application. In some cases, your application can be approved in minutes. We may need to review more information or documents from you, which may add time to the application process. Once your application is complete, we will get back to you by email within 3 to 5 business days.
