brief:
Product: Pelago
One-liner: The world's first digital clinic for substance use management
Description: Pelago, formerly Quit Genius, is the world’s leading virtual clinic for substance use management. We are transforming substance use support—from prevention to treatment—delivering education, management skills, and opportunities for positive change to members struggling with substance use, most commonly tobacco, alcohol, or opioids. Our solution gives employers the means to offer on-demand, personalized support to workers seeking to live healthier lives.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare Services
Tags: Healthcare
target:
Specialty substance use care, built for real life

Personalized, virtual-first support for tobacco, alcohol, opioid, cannabis, and stimulant use.

Trusted by hundreds of organizations

For employers

Reduce your healthcare spend, boost workforce productivity, and help your employees manage substance use

For health plans

Clinically proven care backed by peer-reviewed research and designed to reduce costs across your membership

Meeting people where they are

Digital tools, live counseling, and medication-assisted treatment, with same-day access nationwide. Designed by substance use experts to engage people early, reduce use, and support stigma-free care built around personal goals.

Alcohol

Members reduce alcohol use by 62% within 30 days, and drink an average 70% less on drinking days.

Tobacco

44% of members report no tobacco use within 12 months.

Opioids

67% of Pelago members are opioid-free for at least three months after starting treatment.

Cannabis

40% of adult SUDs and 60% of adolescent SUDs are linked to cannabis.

Stimulants

9M people report using stimulants in the past year.

The hidden cost of substance use

Substance use impacts more employees than most organizations realize and drives higher medical spend across entire populations. Pelago helps turn that hidden cost into predictable savings.

Structured Report Preparation

AMA-Compliant Impairment Ratings

Report Templates for Every Case Type

Docura Health saves me hours on every report. Instead of reviewing hundreds of pages manually, I get a clear summary with key findings already organized.

brief: Product: Intercom
target:
A complete system for human and AI customer service

Intercom is the only helpdesk with a natively integrated AI Agent , Fin . , meaning every customer conversation improves the next one, enabling perfect experiences that were never possible before.

Two products, one seamless experience

Intercom is a fully-featured AI-powered helpdesk

With an omnichannel inbox, AI-powered ticketing, and real-time assistance from Copilot, your human team has everything they need to onboard faster, work more efficiently, and deliver better customer experiences.

Maximize productivity with an AI-enhanced inbox

Give every agent an AI assistant that provides expert guidance, automates repetitive work, and translates conversations in real time.

Ticketing, built for collaboration

One ticketing system for customer issues, back-office collaboration, and tracker tickets that resolve widespread problems, keeping everyone aligned and customers informed.

Support for customers, before they need it

Onboard, educate, and notify your customers with in-context, automated messages that cut support volume and keep customers happy.

Fin is the highest-performing AI agent

Fin has industry leading resolution rates, averaging 76% across 12,000+ customers, with many seeing over 85%. It’s trusted by many of the most forward-thinking businesses in the world, including Anthropic, Clay, Lightspeed, Rocket Money, Gamma, and many more.

Train and test Fin to handle complex queries

Start with the knowledge you already have, then train Fin on your processes and policies. Use AI-driven Simulations to test fully simulated customer conversations from start to finish, so you can confidently resolve increasingly complex, multi-step queries before going live.

Deploy across every channel

Deploy Fin across phone, email, chat, Slack, and more so every customer receives accurate, personalized responses, wherever they reach out.

Analyze performance with AI-powered insights

Monitor performance, spot trends, and optimize with AI-powered Suggestions, then use those Insights to retrain Fin and continuously improve your customer experience.

Together, they deliver better support experiences

Intercom and Fin are built together, sharing the same record, knowledge, and inbox. That means every conversation your team has teaches Fin something new, every gap gets spotted and closed, and support gets better for everyone, every time.

Work together, seamlessly

Self-improving system

Centralised Knowledge Hub

Product: Rasyn
One-liner: Making chemicals 100,000x faster
Description: We builds foundational AI models for chemistry. Almost nothing you buy is a single chemical. Products like datacenter coolant, GPU thermal paste, paint, and glue are formulations, which are mixtures of around ten ingredients each, and demand for them has grown quickly because of AI and EVs. name: Strand AI
brief:
Product: Strand AI
One-liner: Multimodal foundation models to predict uncollected patient biology
Description: Strand AI develops foundation models to generate missing bio-data about patients. With this imputed data, pharmaceutical companies can select better patients for their drug trials and shave months from their drug launch timelines. We’ve already trained a multimodal foundation model that integrates spatial biology modalities, beating SOTA at a fraction of the cost.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
target:
Spatial proteomics from H&E

Lattice predicts spatially resolved protein-marker maps from routine H&E, delivered as virtual mIF channels. It is the first model in our missing data layer for biology.

Spatial proteomics from a slide you already have.

Each model output is a virtual multiplex immunofluorescence channel predicted at the resolution of the underlying image. Pan-cancer and pan-tissue.

No extra tissue

The prediction is computational. Precious archival blocks stay intact and go straight back on the shelf.

Whole cohorts

Runs across an entire archive, not a handful of chosen sections, so retrospective studies become viable again.

Pan-cancer

Trained across a broad span of tumour and tissue types rather than a single indication and a fixed marker panel.

Validated at every scale.

Lattice was developed on thousands of tissue regions and millions of image patches, drawn overwhelmingly from cancer tissue and spanning more than a hundred protein markers. Pan-cancer and pan-tissue by construction, rather than tuned to one indication and a fixed panel.

Pixel

Predicted intensity against the real stain, pixel for pixel, on tissue the model never saw during training.

Cell

Cells segmented and typed from the prediction, then matched against the same cells typed from real multiplex.

Region

Marker composition and tissue organisation across a whole slide or tissue core.

Population

Predicted phenotypes carried across entire cohorts into stratification and survival analysis, where the readout is a population-level outcome.

Send slides. Get answers back.

We run this end to end as a dry lab. There is nothing for your team to install, validate, or staff.

You send H&E

Digitised slides from a trial cohort or an archive, straight from the scanner you already run.

We run Lattice

Predicted spatial proteomics across your cohort, then cell segmentation, phenotyping and tumour microenvironment characterisation on top of it.

You get a readout

Structured spatial data and a written analysis aimed at the biomarker question you actually asked.

For cohorts that cannot leave your institution, we deploy and run Lattice entirely within your environment.

What partners use it for

Retrospective cohorts

Archives that were never intended for spatial work, profiled without consuming a single section.

Patient stratification

Group a cohort by spatial phenotype and see how the tumour microenvironment differs between them.

Target and mechanism

Look at expression and tissue organisation across a population where the assay was never run.

Triage before the wet lab

Decide which samples justify the cost of real multiplex work, instead of guessing at the shortlist.

Beyond Lattice

name: Helonic
brief:
Product: Helonic
One-liner: Automatic Construction Drawing Clash Detection
Description: We help construction teams eliminate rework, delays, and drawing confusion before construction starts. We analyze PDF plans, detect clashes and inconsistencies across disciplines, and create draft RFIs so teams can resolve issues early. This saves construction companies hundreds of hours and millions of dollars.
Industry: Real Estate and Construction / Construction
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Construction, B2B, Workflow Automation, Architecture
target:
Analyze d r a w i n g s automatically

Helonic is an AI construction drawing analysis platform for architects, engineers, and general contractors who review 2D PDF plan sets.

Trusted by leading construction teams, including:

What impact does Helonic have at preconstruction scale ?

Helonic has reviewed more than 1 million drawing pages and flagged more than 2 million issues before construction, with teams using those findings to avoid an estimated $500 million in rework.

How fast does Helonic go from upload to issues ?

Helonic reads the uploaded PDF set and returns coordination, code, and missing-information findings in minutes instead of a multi-day manual pass.

Upload your drawings

Drag and drop PDF drawings, or pull them directly from your Procore or ACC projects with one click.

AI analyzes every page

Helonic cross-references every page across 10 issue categories, pinpointing each issue with exact page coordinates, severity, and category.

Collaborate with your team

Share detected issues with your team, assign action items, and track resolution across drawings and disciplines in real time.

Review issues and push RFIs

Helonic automatically places issue clouds on the drawings at the exact locations. Your team reviews the issue, then pushes it back to Procore or Autodesk as an RFI in a single click.

What questions do teams ask about Helonic ?

Teams usually want to know what Helonic checks, how findings get into Procore or Autodesk, and whether the AI replaces their reviewer. It does not; it covers the sheets the reviewer never reaches.

Helonic analyzes uploaded PDF construction drawings on every page for coordination conflicts, code compliance issues, constructability concerns, and 7 other categories. Each issue comes back with a description, why it is a problem, a recommended action, and precise page locations.

Helonic detects 10 categories of issues: coordination conflicts, code compliance violations, missing information, structural concerns, MEP clashes, fire safety gaps, accessibility issues, constructability problems, dimension discrepancies, and QA/QC items. Each issue includes a severity rating (low, medium, high) and exact page coordinates.

Helonic connects to Procore or Autodesk Construction Cloud with one click so teams can pull drawings from existing projects without a manual upload. After analysis, findings can be pushed back as RFIs with issue details and page references.

name: Chatter
brief:
Product: Chatter
One-liner: Dead simple LLM testing and iteration
Description: Chatter is Postman for LLMs. Our platform helps companies and developers test their LLM models. Iterate on prompts, run them across model families and evaluate them against test cases – all in one place. With collaboration features, engineers can design LLM chains while QA can write test cases.
Industry: B2B
Tags: AIOps, Developer Tools, Generative AI, SaaS
target:
LLM Products

Chatter is a single platform to build, evaluate, and version LLM deployments.

Complex chains

Build complex chains using a variety of models and configurations. Function calling, chaining, data manipulation, and more supported out of the box. Integrate your Chatter chains with code in seconds.

Automatic evaluations and prompt versioning

Build and maintain a testing suite, with automatic evaluation across almost a dozen commonly used metrics including LLM-based evaluation, semantic similarity, and regex matching.

Collaboration and additional non-technical interface

Build and maintain a testing suite, with automatic evaluation across almost a dozen commonly used metrics including LLM-based evaluation, semantic similarity, and even basic regex matching. Keep everything versioned and logged in one place for each comparisons, with a separate viewer for non-technical users.

Build and test LLMs with your whole team

Build confidence in your LLM products by bringing in all stakeholders and iteratively testing your models. View differences on key metrics.

SDK & Code Export

Separate your iteration from your codebase, for maximum speed and prompt security.

Jinja2 templating engine

Perform intermediate data transformations right in your prompt, using Jinja2.

Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)

In seconds, set up your RAG pipeline, whether from a vector DB or other data source. Build and maintain document repositories.

API Key Vault

One place to keep all your LLM API keys. Manage token usage and costs over time or even per call.

Analytics

Get insight into every call. Know how long they take, how many tokens are used, how much they cost, how they perform and more

Observability

Look into every call within a chain. Know exactly how information is being passed down and debug fast.

Function builder

A dead-simple interface to build out and maintain a library of function calls. Plus, easy configurability per API call.

Routing

Have complex routing flows involving multiple sets of functions and system prompts for a single query? We've got you covered.

Chat testing

Have chats you need to test at specific points? We support multiple roles within a call, give you a seamless chat import, and let you easily run evaluations on specific messages.

name: Canary
brief:
Product: Canary
One-liner: The first AI QA engineer that understands your code
Description: AI coding tools have made developers 100x faster but customer-facing incidents are up 43% YoY, QA hasn't kept up. Canary is the first AI QA engineer that understands your codebase. Instead of relying on flaky DOM scraping or screenshot analysis, Canary reads your source code directly to understand developer intent and catch broken user flows before they hit production. Engineering teams go from weeks of manual testing to 90%+ coverage in days.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
target:
Claude Codex Cursor Devin Copilot Claude writes your code. Canary breaks it.

An army of adversarial agents hunts, breaks, simulates and verifies your app across every surface and every environment. Before your users do.

Release the flock.

One loop. Every pull request.

Canary reads the diff and your codebase, then works out which flows it can break, before a human review even starts.

Every failure arrives with proof.

Four breaks a diff review waves right through .

See what it catches on your code.

'Done' is a guess. Until it holds .

Canary is the adversarial quality gate for coding agents.

Reviewers read the diff. Canary runs the code, simulates real users , and reports only what actually broke.

Code, attack, fix. You only ship what survives .

Works where you work.

Canary reads the context you already have, and files every break back to your coding agent.

Field notes from the frontier.

We publish what we learn measuring AI against real, messy codebases.

QA-Bench v0: measuring how AI models handle code verification

Given a real pull request on a production codebase, can a model find every affected user flow and catch what breaks? We put a purpose-built agent against the frontier models across 35 PRs on four production-scale repos.

Break it before they do.

Put the flock on your next pull request. It runs on every one after.

target:
Build credit with confidence.

The credit card built for first-timers — with a money app that actually helps. Instant decisions, manageable limits, real bureau reporting.

Everything working in your favour.

Two cards. One journey.

A real Mastercard to spend anywhere, plus a Store Card that saves you up to 5% — together they build your credit faster.

Repay in full, every week.

On the Bits credit card, clear your balance in full each week to stay on track and build regular repayment habits.

Every payment, reported.

Every payment — whether it's missed, on time, or late — is reported to all bureaus, every month.

Credit and money. Now in one app.

The card that builds your credit and the tools that help you understand your money — all in one place.

Your whole money life, in one place.

Your credit journey, step by step.

Check eligibility

A soft check that won't affect your credit score — see if you're approved in seconds.

Get your decision

Fully automated, in under 60 seconds. No phone calls, no long forms.

Spend & build

Use your card day-to-day. Every payment — whether it's missed, on time, or late — is reported to all bureaus, month after month.

From your first card to a stronger score.

Loved by 1,000,000+ users.

Questions, answered.

Everything you need to know before you apply.

No — checking eligibility is a soft search that's only visible to you. A hard search happens only if you formally accept an offer.

Bits is a monthly subscription. The card has no hidden fees and no FX fees when you spend abroad.

You get two lines of credit. Your credit card starts between £50 and £100 and can grow over time as you show you can manage it. Your store card limit depends on the plan you choose.

When you sign up you get two lines of credit — a credit card and a store card — and both are reported to the credit bureaus. Every payment, whether missed or on time, is reported. Having these lines of credit and making regular repayments on them is what contributes to your score. A score increase isn't guaranteed, and there are also many free ways to build your credit.

name: SafetyKit
brief:
Product: SafetyKit
One-liner: AI agents for risk, compliance, and safety
Description: SafetyKit's AI agents do the dirty work for big tech and finance companies so humans don't have to. Today companies rely on armies of low-paid outsourced humans to protect their platforms from fraud, harassment, and crime. It’s super important work, but the jobs are difficult and sometimes traumatizing, and it’s impossible to keep up. Our mission is to end this manual toil.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Fintech, Compliance, Trust & Safety
target:
Stop bad actors as they emerge

SafetyKit's AI agents evaluate all of the user activity on your platform and investigate cases end-to-end to stop scams and abuse.

Bad actors are constantly evolving their behavior and tactics. As a result, your team is stuck in a reactive cycle mitigating damage that’s already happened.

AI agents to stop bad actors at scale.

SafetyKit provides platforms with the data infrastructure and AI agents to evaluate all of their user activity and investigate any cases that warrant it – from start to finish.

Ingest

SafetyKit ingests every user action via a lightweight SDK and API.

Connect

SafetyKit's models map the connections across every user, action, interaction, and content item.

Evaluate

Behavior models analyze user behavior for signals of fraud and abuse, recalibrating in real-time as new signals arrive.

Investigate & Act

Agents automatically investigate cases – resolving the majority and escalating only what needs human judgement.

Built for constantly changing threats.

Evaluate the whole user, not just the event

SafetyKit evaluates the whole user across every action with full context to detect harmful behavior that is often hidden or missed.

Get ahead of new bad actors and patterns

Models are fine-tuned to your platform and recalibrate in real-time, proactively surfacing bad actors and patterns – even ones you weren't looking for.

Decisions you can trust

Every agent decision comes with a clear, reviewable explanation. Chat with agents to dig deeper, provide feedback, or manage what you want to be escalated.

Putting network intelligence to work

New attacks and patterns detected anywhere across SafetyKit's network automatically become protection for your platform.

One set of agents. All types of bad behavior.

SafetyKit's agents learn what good and bad behavior looks like on your platform, so they can identify, investigate, and act on a wide range of unwanted activity.

See how SafetyKit performs on real platforms.

Learn how leading platforms deploy SafetyKit to automate their reviews and keep their users safer at scale.

Upwork scales to global platform coverage with SafetyKit.

See how Upwork automates the review of all job posts with SafetyKit before they go live, improving quality while reducing costs and manual review load.

Eventbrite supports new products and expands regions with SafetyKit.

See how Eventbrite leverages SafetyKit's AI agents to monitor all events and activity on their platform.

name: Revyl
brief:
Product: Revyl
One-liner: The Mobile Development Platform
Description: Revyl is the mobile development platform for agents, developers, product, and design. It brings development, build infrastructure, verification, and application intelligence together in one platform, giving teams and agents a shared source of truth for every mobile application. Teams can build and run mobile applications in the cloud, understand how their applications work, collaborate across functions, and verify changes against the running app.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, B2B, Infrastructure
target:
Build mobile with confidence.

The mobile development platform that helps teams build, verify, and ship mobile applications with confidence. Every change is validated against the real application, not just the code, and every release is backed by evidence.

Build. Develop. Test. Understand.

Agents opened a new way to build mobile software. The Revyl mobile development platform brings the entire loop together on shared infrastructure, with runtime evidence carried through every step.

Build

Build mobile software in the cloud without depending on one local machine.

Develop

Iterate against the live, running app instead of a static tree of assumptions.

Test & verify

Prove changes through the same visible workflows your users experience.

Understand

Turn every observed screen, flow, change, and result into living product context.

Agents write mobile code. Now they can tell you if it works.

Revyl gives agents dedicated compute, a live application, and visual understanding of the screen: the missing runtime between a code change and a confident result.

Give your coding agent an iPhone.

Add Revyl to Cursor and every agent gets cloud iOS and Android devices to run, inspect, and verify the mobile changes it writes.

Built for the whole team.

Developers

Move from “the code looks right” to evidence that the change actually works.

Product & design

Review the design running as a real app, not an outdated mockup or isolated screenshot.

QA & testing

Test the experience users actually encounter and keep the proof of every result.

Enterprise

Dedicated infrastructure that unlocks cloud device and autonomous agent capacity at enterprise scale.

Atlas: a living source of truth.

Every build, test, and verification your team and your agents run feeds Atlas: a continuously updated map of what your app actually does, what changed, and what is covered.

Not documentation that goes stale. The same runtime truth everyone is looking at.

Put the platform to work.

Adopt Revyl from the decision your team needs to make today. The shared runtime and Atlas context are there when you expand.

AI agent development

Mobile test automation

Pull request validation

Release readiness

App exploration

Cross-platform testing

Ready to ship with confidence?

Give every mobile team one platform to build, test, and understand what ships.

name: Star
brief:
Product: Star
One-liner: Make games with AI - no coding required
Description: Star makes game development accessible to anyone with an idea. Using AI, you can create complex, playable games without writing code - just describe what you want and iterate. We're building the future of creative tools for the next generation of game makers.
Industry: Consumer / Gaming
Tags: Consumer, Gaming, No-code, Creator Economy, AI
target:
You've played thousands of games. Time to make one.

Describe it, and it's a real game: hosted, multiplayer, playable at a link. Built by a gamer, for gamers.

Play a Star game right now

DEEPSMOKE — two goblins in steam-powered drill-suits, digging into the deep. Full 3D, multiplayer, live leaderboard. A creator described it; Star built it. Click in and play.

What's behind every Star game

Say "make it multiplayer."

Star spins up the rooms on our servers. No backend, no netcode. The match keeps running when the host closes their tab.

An agent that has shipped thousands of games.

Every game built on Star taught it something about game feel, collision, and difficulty. First versions play better, and edits land where you meant.

Leaderboards in one sentence.

"Add a leaderboard" gets you a live, hosted one. No database, no setup.

Tune it without prompting.

Drag sliders to adjust gravity, speed, and spawn rates while the game runs. Open the map editor and reshape the world by hand.

Controls that just work.

Touch, keyboard, and gamepad ship with every game. Your friends play on their phones without you lifting a finger.

Your game isn't trapped here.

Publish to a link instantly. Export to itch.io, a Windows .exe, or your files whenever you want.

Our heaviest users have every AI tool out there. They still build their games here.

From First Prompt to Final Boss

Watch your simple idea transform step-by-step into an amazing game

🌱 Watch Your Ideas Grow

" Create a platformer game with a character that can jump "

Basic movement, jumping, collectible coins

" Add moving platforms and double jump "

Dynamic platforms, advanced mobility

" Add patrolling enemies and an invincibility power-up "

Strategic challenges, exciting gameplay

Great games take shape over multiple prompts. Start simple, then keep adding. Try “Add enemies” or “Make gravity stronger” once you have a first version.

Featured Games

Built, hosted, and playable at a link. Tap one.

" A cinematic first-person 3D moonwalk with low gravity and Earth in the sky "

" A gory stick figure fighter where enemies explode when defeated "

" A vampire survivors-like autoshooter with abilities and enemy waves "

365 games

Description: We believe that finding the right data shouldn’t require a technical background or hours of digging. That’s why Secoda applies AI to transform messy, siloed analytics into a searchable, intuitive knowledge layer—so every question gets a fast, useful answer. Our vision is to become the AI search engine for your company’s analytics, making data discovery as seamless as finding a website on Google.
Industry: B2B / Analytics
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, SaaS, B2B, Analytics, Data Engineering
target:
The AI platform for data and analytics

Powered by enterprise data governance and context across your entire data stack, Secoda delivers trusted answers fast and at scale.

As seen on TV

Meet Secoda AI

Build AI analytics around trusted data governance

Secoda connects directly to your data sources to understand lineage, documentation, and metadata and deliver context-aware AI built to scale.

Powered by your metadata control plane

Secoda is uniquely built on a foundation of governance, metadata, lineage, and documentation to power context-aware outputs. Use AI agents for accurate, secure answers at scale.

AI agents built so you can focus on data insights

Analysis Agent

Transforms raw data into actionable business insights

Automation Agent

Automatically enriches data assets with critical metadata

Search Agent

Instantly finds the exact data assets and insights you need

Memory Agent

Remembers context to deliver smarter data insights

Observability Agent

Monitors data health with intelligent alerts and nsights

Governance Agent

Enforces data policies while enabling team productivity

Documentation Agent

Generates clear descriptions for all your data assets

Visualization Agent

Transform raw query results into visual insights

Cataloging Agent

Organizes your assets into a searchable data glossary

Supercharge your data team with Secoda

Consolidated, automated, and customizable — Secoda integrates directly with your stack and grows with you.

Easily add context to your data

Organizes and enrich metadata to ensure your AI outputs are precise, useful, and actionable. Secoda consolidates metadata into one actionable, always-updated control panel.

Generated lineage from end to end

Gain clear visibility into the usage, performance, and dependencies of every query in your data stack. Catch slow-running queries before it’s too late, freeing up resources and cutting costs.

Monitor your data at scale

Detect issues across your data to safeguard analytics and ML outputs. Create comprehensive monitors for proactive visibility into anomalies, costs, job performance, and more.

Automate tasks and workflows

Easily scale your governance program. Perform bulk updates, tag PII data, manage tech debt, build custom integrations, identify the least used resources, and more.

Data analysis just got faster. Our customers are proof.

Integrates with your entire data stack

Strong, scalable, secure

Secoda upholds industry-leading security standards while being user-friendly, fast, and intuitive.

You're invited to Secoda AI office hours

See live demos of how anyone on your team can create dashboards in seconds. Stay for Q&A with the team.

target:

Stop doing the work. Start directing agents.

Your personal AI operator. Ask it to investigate, use your tools, take action, or delegate work to external agents.

name: Alex
brief:
Product: Alex
One-liner: The Cursor for Xcode
Description: Tired of switching tabs to cursor every time you're building your iOS app in Xcode? Worry not! Alex is a sidebar app that works directly with Xcode, and has the same Cmd+L, Cmd+K, and Apply Code commands as Cursor. And, it's super fast. Check it out: https://alexcodes.app
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
target:
The Most Powerful AI Agent for Xcode

Automatically build projects and fix bugs, add Swift packages, add file errors, run your app in Simulator, and more.

25,000+ developers used Alex to 🚢 faster

🛠️ Autofix Errors with AI

Click once and let Alex automatically fix your Swift errors and Xcode issues with AI-powered debugging.

⇥ The Best Autocomplete for Xcode

Boost your Xcode coding speed with Alex's AI-powered autocomplete. Just type a few characters and hit Tab!

✨ Inline Code Replacements (⌘+K)

Replace lines of code inside your file with a simple command.

⌨️ Add Lines from Xcode (⌘+L)

Select text in Xcode and instantly chat with it. Just like Cursor.

📦 Auto-Add SPM Packages

Alex will navigate the Xcode interface & UI to add Swift SPM packages for you.

🔀 Run Local Models

Alex can run local models for free (e.g. from Ollama and LM Studio)

📲 AI Image-to-Code Generator

Drag any image into Alex, and let AI generate Swift or UIKit code for iOS development instantly.

🔎 Find Anything Instantly

Search your entire Xcode project semantically using Alex. Find functions, variables, and files in seconds!

🌐 Web Search Agent

Alex can search Google for coding answers, just like you do!

💻 Run Terminal Commands

Alex can run Terminal commands for you in your project.

🚀 Launch World-Class Apps

Just a few of the awesome apps built with Alex 👇

Granola: AI Meeting Notes

The best AI note-taker, right in your pocket.

Voice dictation that actually works.

❤️ Loved by iOS Developers

Join tens of thousands of developers building amazing iOS apps with Alex.

🔒 Private & Secure

Alex doesn't relay your code through our servers, so your team can use it with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint—including local models for maximum privacy.

Code Embeddings

Your code is embedded by VoyageAI and stored locally on your computer. We don't store it, or train on it.

Hosted Chat Inference

You can override all our AI models' endpoints. If you choose to use our hosted inference, we opt out of data retention and training from our AI providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Fireworks AI, Cerebras, and Gemini) so they don't store or train on your data.

Your Data, Your Device

name: Webiny
brief:
Product: Webiny
One-liner: Open-source framework for building serverless applications
Description: When the public cloud appeared migration was easy. Existing apps running on physical servers could just be moved to virtual machines running in the cloud. The cloud is now moving towards serverless, and serverless is not backward compatible. New tools need to be created and existing apps need to be rewritten. Webiny provides developers with everything they need to build those serverless apps. We are a 100% remote team.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, B2B, Open Source
target:
The AI-Programmable CMS

Loading...

Most CMS platforms use AI to generate content. Webiny lets developers use AI to build the platform itself — creating APIs, automating workflows, and extending the CMS with prompts.

Ready-made apps, so you start ahead

Headless CMS, Website Builder, and File Manager included, so you customise instead of building from scratch.

Programmable with AI and code

Build on the platform itself with the MCP server, not just generate content.

Yours to run and own

Self-hosted or managed, on your own infrastructure, no vendor lock-in.

Built with TypeScript and React. Delivers to Next.js, Nuxt, or any other frontend.

Production-ready apps, built to be extended

Webiny comes with ready-made apps like Headless CMS, Website Builder, and File Manager — giving developers and AI real systems to customize instead of starting from zero. These aren’t just starter kits. They’re battle-tested foundations used in projects with hundreds of millions of records, petabytes of assets, and demanding security requirements.

Engage millions of fans in real-time experiences

Run a global campaign with local precision

Search and manage thousands of research datasets securely

Stay online during national-scale traffic peaks

An automatic work journal that helps you work more meaningfully.

Open source for transparency. Designed to empower you.

Implementing OAuth token refresh to prevent unexpected user logouts

Watching videos on studio apartment interior design on YouTube

Deep dive into researching GPT-5.4 and Opus 4.6 and compared coding benchmarks

Responding to questions from Jeff and providing team standup updates

Trusted every day by people who build world-class products

Your open source work companion

Dayflow understands all the work you do, helping you reflect on your progress and chart the way forward.

It is open source under the MIT license. It is auditable, transparent, and you own the code. Read Dayflow’s open-source vision.

See your work at all fidelities

See everything you’ve worked on and what you’ve spent time on in a day. See your progress and never wonder where your day went.

Purpose-built to help you achieve your ambitions

Keep yourself accountable

Commit time to the work that matters. Dayflow tracks your progress and transforms effort into tangible accomplishments.

Provide updates in one click

Dayflow automatically summarizes your progress so you can instantly write updates without relying on your memory.

Privacy by default

We care deeply about privacy and designed Dayflow to work securely across both personal and enterprise use cases. Learn more on our Privacy page.

Open source

See and modify the code, build it yourself. Dayflow is open sourced and licensed under the MIT License.

Local storage

Full recordings and databases stay stored locally on your Mac.

Local AI

Local AI keeps analysis on-device. BYO cloud providers and Dayflow Pro can receive selected screenshots for analysis.

Frequently asked questions

Dayflow does what people want from an automatic time tracker for Mac: a truthful record of where your time went, with zero manual timers or tags. But instead of charts of app usage, you get a readable story of your day. Think of it as a time tracker that grew into a work journal. It’s free and open source (MIT), and full recordings stay on your Mac.

name: Jutsoo
brief:
Product: Jutsoo
One-liner: All your corporate bank accounts connected under one platform
Description: Jutsoo is a modern treasury management platform that helps finance teams work smarter by having efficient, reliable, real-time visibility and control over their financial data across their different banks and bank accounts. We do this by unifying data from internal systems, integrating directly with banks for your money movements, and reconcile them automatically. Money movements, reconciliations, cash forecasting, and identifying liquidity trends will be a breeze using us.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
Tags: FinOps, Fintech, SaaS, B2B, Enterprise Software
target:
Let AI handle the books. You handle the growth.

Jutsoo is the AI bookkeeper you chat with. Upload a statement and it captures, codes, and reconciles every transaction. You review and sign off.

Bookkeeping isn't the problem. The busywork is.

Most of the month disappears into data entry, categorizing, and reconciliation. Mechanical work that crowds out the analysis, the advice, and the decisions that actually move the business.

The mechanical hours go to Jutsoo. The judgment, the advice, and the relationships stay with you.

It works ahead. You sign off.

Four steps, the same every time. Jutsoo does the first two. You own the last two. Nothing posts to your books without your approval.

Upload Jutsoo

Drop a bank statement, a bill, a receipt, or a whole folder. Any format, any bank, no integration to set up.

Capture & code Jutsoo

It reads every line, extracts vendor, tax, and totals, and posts a proper double-entry journal coded to your chart of accounts.

Review You

Each entry is queued with the reason it was coded that way, traceable to the source document. Approve, edit, or ask why.

Close You

Books stay continuously reconciled, so month-end is a quick review instead of a two-week scramble.

One chat. Your whole back office.

Records, Reports, and Messages in a single workspace. No new software to learn. You just talk to it, the way you would a junior bookkeeper, for one company or hundreds of clients.

AI does the work. You keep the judgment.

Every entry is a proposal, not a posting. Explainable, traceable to its source document, and queued for your approval. You stay the final word, the client relationship, and the credit.

This looks like an inter-account transfer to BCA Savings . Match to that account rather than book it as income?

Clean books. Real standards. Zero busywork.

Proper double-entry books an accountant would sign off on, ready the moment you need them. For tax season, a board update, or a due-diligence request.

Categorization accuracy

Every entry verified and traceable to its source document, so the books hold up to an audit.

Days to close, not weeks

Continuous reconciliation means month-end is 90% done before the period even ends.

Tax-ready

VAT and withholding prepared, the moment you need to file.

Real-time books

P&L, balance sheet, and cash position, always current.

Multi-entity, multi-currency

One workspace for one company or a hundred client books.

Audit-ready. Compliant. Bank-grade secure.

name: Multifactor
brief:
Product: Multifactor
One-liner: Zero-trust authentication, authorization, and auditing for AI agents
Description: The agentic era is here, but its foundation is dangerously insecure. A growing number of high-profile "AI agent gone rogue" security incidents make headlines each week. As enterprise adoption of agentic software has far outpaced the development of applicable cybersecurity solutions, CISOs have loudly voiced a growing need for verifiable, fine-grained security controls on complex multi-agent systems. That's why we built Multifactor.
Industry: B2B / Security
target:
So much more than a password manager

Share online accounts with humans and AI agents, just by sending a link.

Free forever

Cross platform

Easy to switch

Backed by

👋Goodbye Password Managers. Hello Multifactor.

Password managers are broken. We changed the game with secure one-click sharing, instant revocation, and powerful agentic integrations.

Password Managers

The World's Best Account Manager

Multifactor redefines zero-trust account management with fine-grained sharing, detailed audit trails, and a world-class security architecture.

Unified Secure Platform

Multifactor puts all of your online accounts at your fingertips in one secure, easy-to-use vault, available on any device you need it.

Instant Access Control

Because actual passwords are never shared, access changes take instant effect—no password resets required.

Multi-Factor Management

What's in a name? Multifactor lets you manage passwords, passkeys, 2FA codes, and more in one secure, unified vault.

Fine-Grained Permissions

Don't just share full access—share specific permissions, like “read transactions” but not “make transfers.”

Detailed Event History

See not only who accessed which accounts, but also what they did with them , paired with a digital signature that provides non-repudiable cryptographic proof.

Zero Trust Cryptography

Our zero-trust architecture uses advanced post-quantum encryption techniques to ensure that nobody else (not even us) can access your credentials without posessing all of your root authentication factors.

Early Access

Multi — The Secure Account Using AI Assistant

Multi is an AI agent that can securely access your own accounts when asked, just by storing them in Multifactor. Strong access controls ensure you remain in control throughout the process.

Natural Language Commands

Chat with Multi just like your favorite AI assistant. Watch as it securely uses your own accounts to automate tasks and provide personalized answers.

Cross-Account Access

Multi can securely log in to any online account you have stored in Multifactor. No additional configuration needed.

Secure Account Use

Multi loads your accounts in a secure, isolated cloud browser. Raw credentials are never visible to the AI or transmitted to third parties.

Strongly Enforced Permissions

Multi can only access the specific account features you allow. You'll know as soon as it tries to do something new, so you can approve or deny the request.

Powerful Automations

Create reusable playbooks that combine natural language commands and pre-configured permissions to automate complex tasks with a single click.

A Foundation of Innovative Research

brief:
Product: Runtime
One-liner: Build and run internal agents, without managing the infrastructure
Description: Runtime (runtm.com) gives engineering teams control and visibility to enable anyone in their org to use coding agents securely. Eng leaders rolling out coding agents have no way to see what's happening, set boundaries, or safely let non-engineers use them. We provide sandboxed environments, session-level observability, and configurable guardrails so anyone on your team can ship with coding agents without breaking prod.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
target:
Financial operations, run by AI agents

Fintechs, banks, and funds use Runtime to build agents that take a case, investigate it with real account data, and resolve it with a full audit trail.

Looking into it now.

One-liner: Restaurant Loyalty Using Quiz
Description: Bobidi runs Upswell, a platform that brings new guests to local restaurants and helps turn them into regulars. We transform restaurants’ promotional videos on social media into engaging quiz campaigns based on the video content. Winners receive cash rewards that can be redeemed at the restaurants.
Industry: B2B / Marketing
Tags: Generative AI, Machine Learning, Human Resources, AI
target:
Make every day a Grand Opening

Restaurant growth partner

Engineered lines, not lucky ones. One client re-opened with us and grew sales 7× .

Grow your business the way we did. The exact playbook, free, no email required.

Social proof

Proven, not theoretical.

Real restaurants. Real crowds. Real numbers.

Re-opening · Rice Junky. 1.7M views in two weeks, leading to a 7× daily sales bump on the busiest day.

New momentum · New Tandoori Cafe. About 500K views in two weeks, leading to a 40% sales bump over the weekend.

Grand opening · My-O-My Shawarma. Three hours of nonstop lines with 400 customers.

What we do

The only way to grow is more regulars.

To turn a stranger into a regular, three things have to happen. We do all three.

Drive the crowd

Local creators and hyper-local ads pack your room, all tracked.

Make it flawless

We prep your team so every first visit is a great one.

Bring them back

Personalized follow-up turns first-timers into regulars.

How we do it

We do everything except cooking. Keep your weekends.

True white-glove. We handle strategy, creators, posting, and ads end to end. You just watch the crowd show up.

Strategy. We sit down with you to build a strategy. Not every solution fits every concept, so we learn about your business first.

Influencer party. We invite local creators to taste your best dishes. They post Reels at the same time.

Amplify. We run hyper-local Instagram and Facebook ads to reach the customers around you.

Data. We capture the people walking in with a promo code or a special ordering link.

Retain. We re-engage the creators and guests who loved you. They become your ambassadors.

Why Upswell

Built specifically for restaurants, nothing else.

Momentum, not a moment

One night isn't enough. We keep you in the feed.

A single viral post fades fast. We keep fresh creators cycling through your dining room, so the buzz and new faces keep coming month after month.

vs. creator marketplaces

A marketplace is useful if you have time. Upswell is for owners who don't.

Behind the scenes

Hire experts at the cost of interns.

A full growth team most restaurants could never afford, running your growth for less than you would pay a part-timer.

Built by a team from

From real openings

When the strategy works, you can see it.

Free playbook

The exact system we use, yours for free.

name: Osmosis
brief:
Product: Osmosis
One-liner: Reinforcement Learning (RL) for AI Agents
Description: Osmosis is a post-training platform that helps companies fine-tune language models using reinforcement learning. We work with fast-growing AI companies to train task/domain-specific models that beat foundation models on performance, cost, and latency. Our platform handles compute orchestration, reward modeling, and training run observability as a CLI-based product usable by developers and agents.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Infrastructure
target:
Forward Deployed Reinforcement Learning

Announcement: Osmosis Update

Osmosis helps companies create task-specific models that beat foundation models at a fraction of the cost.

Use Cases

Build domain-specific extraction models to capture the exact structure and content for any document. Osmosis offers the schema precision to get data from point A to B.

Teach AI agents to use the exact tools they’ll have in production. Osmosis powers AI agents that stay reliable, even in the most complex multi-step, multi-tool tasks.

Use Osmosis to train specialized coding models for blazing fast generation of domain-specific languages, front-end components, and context-aware tests.

Platform Details

Hands on Deployments

We work directly with customers to support the entire post-training workflow - from feature engineering to reward function creation. We ensure model performance and adherence to customer specifications through being hands-on with the model training & serving process.

Reinforcement Fine-Tuning

Osmosis is a comprehensive post-training platform that allows engineers to leverage cutting-edge reinforcement learning techniques (GRPO, DAPO, etc.) and capabilities (multi-turn tool training) without any of the infrastructure headache.

Continuous Improvement

We integrate with your evaluation solutions to monitor performance and automatically start re-training runs whenever - without the need for an engineer in the loop. We can ingest real-time data and update your models in as little as every hour.

One-liner: AI that audits AI — catching hallucinations before you ship them.
Description: Every AI tool will confidently hand you a wrong number — and in engineering and finance, a wrong number is expensive. Energent.ai is an AI teammate that does your data work on a secure desktop: reading documents and engineering drawings, cleaning messy data, writing code, building charts.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Productivity, Big Data, Enterprise Software, Automation, AI Assistant
target:
Catch AI hallucinations before they cost you

The Autonomous AI Quality Control Agent

Energent.ai verifies every AI output against your source documents and flags what doesn't hold up — so you're not the quality control.

Powering workflows for 100,000+ clients worldwide

Watch the auditor catch one

A live audit, start to verdict

The auditor opens the finished file and re-derives every figure from the source documents. This is a month-end close, mid-audit.

Auditor trace

How the audit works

An independent auditor — separate from the AI that did the work — checks every deliverable before it reaches you.

You give it a job

Drop in the AI outputs you want checked (e.g. plain text, PDF, any format). Then drop in the source documents it should hold up against.

An independent auditor checks it

A separate agent with fresh context opens the finished file and re-derives the result — recomputing totals, re-counting rows, and tracing every number to its source.

You get a verdict, with evidence

Failures are caught and fixed before delivery. You read a pass/fail verdict and its evidence trail — not the whole deliverable from scratch.

Why the numbers hold: the auditor

Energent.ai outperforms leading AI agents in accuracy score on complex data analysis tasks.

Accuracy

on HuggingFace (validated by Ayden)

more accurate than the 2nd best alternative "Google"

Core features

An independent auditor on every job — so you read a verdict, not do the checking.

Stop being your AI's quality control.

Save it once. It runs forever — and gets sharper every run.

Built to run anywhere, on any file, in your brand — and audited every step.

Start at your desk, check your phone, resume next week—long jobs keep running in the cloud and return verified.

150+ file types, at volumes chat tools can't handle

Your logo, template, and stakeholder-ready output

Provide one exemplar; every run matches your brand and is audited against it.

brief:
Product: Pairio
One-liner: AI mobile app that helps factory technicians fix broken machines
Description: Pairo is an AI mobile app to help technicians fix broken equipment in factories. Users just take a picture of the broken machine and we search thousands of pages of manuals to find the right solution.
Industry: B2B
target:
From breakdown to solution — faster with AI

Our AI assistant surfaces information, identifies spare parts, creates reports, and analyzes maintenance intervals so your technicians can spend less time clicking and more time fixing.

The challenge

No time for real maintenance work

Knowledge gets lost

Work performed is documented poorly or not at all. This is often caused by time pressure, cumbersome processes, or language barriers.

Lack of transparency

Analyzing historical maintenance data from machine logbooks or ERP systems is complex, time-consuming, and rarely done in practice.

Painful information search

Technical documents such as wiring diagrams or manuals can often only be searched by keyword. Knowledge from previous repairs remains unused.

Long onboarding times

New employees need a lot of time to learn processes and workflows. Creating work instructions is a manual and time-intensive task.

Solution

With Pairio, maintenance becomes a competitive advantage

Pairio identifies the issue, actions taken, and spare parts, then creates a structured report so the knowledge is available to everyone during the next downtime.

Pairio searches the entire technical documentation and delivers the right answer in seconds, including the relevant references.

Pairio helps uncover patterns and optimization potential in historical maintenance cases so intervals can be used more effectively.

Pairio automatically creates work instructions or interactive training videos from recordings captured with smart glasses.

Pairio integrates smoothly with common ERP systems and document management systems.

Benefits

Higher productivity in maintenance

Latest from Pairio

Knowledge in people's heads, work orders without context, and years of CMMS data that still doesn't help during a breakdown. The same story showed up at almost every plant I visited.

name: Clustrix
brief:
Product: Clustrix
Description: Clustrix provides the leading scale-out relational database engineered for the cloud or data center. ClustrixDB is a drop-in replacement for MySQL and an ideal solution for high-transaction, high-value workloads typically found in businesses such as ad tech, e-commerce, gaming, and large web and mobile businesses. Our customers use ClustrixDB for critical business applications that support massive transactional volume.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
target:
Scalability with MariaDB

Scalability for Mission-Critical Data-Intensive Applications

MariaDB supports all scalability needs – whether there are ten or tens of millions of users. Scale up with more cores, memory and storage with MariaDB Enterprise Server and scale out reads, writes and storage with hundreds of instances.

Why Choose MariaDB when Enterprise Scalability is Required

Compression

Reduce the size of data on disk by 33-66% using InnoDB or MyRocks table compression, or compress only specific columns.

Partitioning

Partition large tables by range, list or hash to improve query and index performance, and use multiple disks/different disks per partition.

Parallel query

Use multiple threads to execute aggregates, sorts, joins and more on multiple partitions at the same time – scale up linearly with cores.

Read replicas

Add read replicas using asynchronous and semi-sync replication, or use MaxScale as a replication server for hundreds.

Sharding

Spread table partitions across multiple database instances to scale out reads, writes and storage transparently to applications.

Read Scalability with Read-Write Splitting and Multimaster Node Clustering

With MariaDB Enterprise Server and MaxScale , multimaster clustering is used for both high availability and read scalability, the database proxy can assign the role of primary to a single node (and route writes to it) while assigning the role of replica to the remaining nodes (and load balancing reads across them). In multi-primary clusters, routing all writes to the same node prevents deadlocks and write conflicts.

name: Mindoo, the AI operating system for hospitals.
brief:
Product: Mindoo, the AI operating system for hospitals.
Description: AI agents that talk with patients and run care workflows on data your hospital owns, deployed on site.
target:
The AI operating system for hospitals.

AI agents that talk with patients, prepare consultations, code medical files and run the workflows around care. On a data foundation your hospital owns, deployed on-site by our engineers.

See an agent at work.

The intake agent talks with the patient over the phone, in their own language, and hands the clinician a clinical note, coded in SNOMED CT and ready to review.

Headache , present for two weeks and progressively worsening .

Right-sided , throbbing pain, accompanied by photophobia and morning nausea . No vomiting reported.

Self-medicating with ibuprofen 400 mg; relief is declining.

Symptom pattern flagged for Dr. Johnsson to assess at the consultation.

Backed by a €5M raise · built with hospitals across Belgium & Germany

Most of care happens around the record. That’s where Mindoo works.

Calls, intake, scheduling, documentation, follow-up, coordination. A hospital’s day runs on work no single system was built to carry. Your EHR stays the system of record. Mindoo is the system of action around it, and takes that work on.

Its agents capture structured, coded data at the point of care. SNOMED CT and ICD-10, across 25+ specialties and 50+ languages. So coding, billing and analysis start from data you can trust.

One system. Five layers. Yours.

Mindoo builds the whole stack with you, and your hospital owns it.

Software doesn’t transform hospitals. People do. Our engineers deploy on-site, redesign workflows with your teams, and train your people to run it. Then we hand over the keys.

Agents that talk with patients, and agents that work silently: coding files, drafting notes, completing workflows. Built on a harness with guardrails, continuous evals, memory and human oversight. Your team configures new ones in plain language.

The plumbing that connects to your existing systems and speaks the required standards, so agents have context, can write back to your systems, and you stay ahead of upcoming regulation like the EHDS.

A hospital-owned data store that works alongside the record. Clean, queryable, yours. And it gets better over time, not just bigger.

Compute where you want it. We provide it, run it in your private cloud, or optimize your own hardware. Every option comes with evals, so you know exactly how your agents perform on the stack you chose.

Backed by a €5M raise · built with hospitals across Belgium & Germany

Most of care happens around the record. That’s where Mindoo works.

Calls, intake, scheduling, documentation, follow-up, coordination. A hospital’s day runs on work no single system was built to carry. Your EHR stays the system of record. Mindoo is the system of action around it, and takes that work on.

Its agents capture structured, coded data at the point of care. SNOMED CT and ICD-10, across 25+ specialties and 50+ languages. So coding, billing and analysis start from data you can trust.

One system. Five layers. Yours.

Mindoo builds the whole stack with you, and your hospital owns it.

Software doesn’t transform hospitals. People do. Our engineers deploy on-site, redesign workflows with your teams, and train your people to run it. Then we hand over the keys.

Agents that talk with patients, and agents that work silently: coding files, drafting notes, completing workflows. Built on a harness with guardrails, continuous evals, memory and human oversight. Your team configures new ones in plain language.

The plumbing that connects to your existing systems and speaks the required standards, so agents have context, can write back to your systems, and you stay ahead of upcoming regulation like the EHDS.

A hospital-owned data store that works alongside the record. Clean, queryable, yours. And it gets better over time, not just bigger.

Compute where you want it. We provide it, run it in your private cloud, or optimize your own hardware. Every option comes with evals, so you know exactly how your agents perform on the stack you chose.

name: Ubicloud
brief:
Product: Ubicloud
One-liner: Open source alternative to AWS
Description: Ubicloud is an open source cloud that can run anywhere. Our cloud services include elastic compute, block storage, virtual networking, managed Postgres, K8s, AI inference, and powerful IAM. You can self-host our software or use our managed service to reduce your cloud costs by 3-10x.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Cloud Computing, Infrastructure, AI, Databases
target:
Open source alternative to AWS

Ubicloud raises $16 million in seed round

Ubicloud provides cloud services on bare metal providers, such as Hetzner, Leaseweb, or AWS Bare Metal. You can set it up yourself or use our managed service

Why use it?

Public cloud providers like AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud made life easier for start-ups and enterprises. But they are closed source, have you rent computers at a huge premium, and lock you in. Ubicloud offers an open alternative, reduces your costs, and returns control of your infrastructure back to you. All without sacrificing the cloud's convenience.

Use cases

Ubicloud PostgreSQL

Managed PostgreSQL that costs 3x less than comparable solutions. Open source and portable solution that helps you avoid cloud vendor lock-in.

GitHub Actions Integration

Managed Ubicloud runners reduce costs by 10x. You change 1-line in your workflow file. You get isolated, clean, and ephemeral VMs for each job.

Ubicloud Compute

Dedicated Virtual Machines (VMs) that cost 3x less. Encryption at rest and in-transit. Ideal for compute or memory heavy data processing needs.

Services & Features

Ubicloud provides IaaS cloud features on bare metal providers, such as Hetzner, Leaseweb, or AWS Bare Metal. You can set it up yourself or use our managed service.

Elastic Compute

Provision, use, and delete isolated VMs on bare metal

Virtual Networking

Public and private networking. IPv4 and IPv6. Flexible firewall rules. Network load balancer. Encryption in transit

Block Storage

Block devices (non-replicated) with encryption at rest

Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC)

Define roles for different users. Provide fine-grained access control

Managed PostgreSQL

Latest PostgreSQL versions. Automatic backups, point-in-time-restore (PITR), and high availability

Our biggest question was, ‘What’s the catch?’. But there wasn’t one. Ubicloud gave us the same CI functionality, with newer CPUs, at a fraction of the cost. We kept waiting for a downside that never materialized.

Ubicloud eliminated our IOPS bottlenecks and is already saving us $300k a year, with $500k projected as we migrate more workloads.

We had three challenges before Ubicloud: high AWS costs, finding a provider that can beat RDS performance, and the complexity of migration. Ubicloud turned out to be the perfect fit for all three.

Reduce costs. Avoid lock-in. Win back your infrastructure.

name: InVision Medical Technology
brief:
Product: InVision Medical Technology
One-liner: AI Diagnosis of Heart Disease
Description: At InVision, we use AI to help streamline the interpretation of ultrasounds and identify diseases that may have been missed by human readers. Our models have been tightly integrated into the clinical workflow to allow easy usage by clinicians. Our work has previously been peer-reviewed and published in several top medical venues, including Nature (2020), Nature Medicine (2021), Lancet Digital Health (2021), JAMA Cardiology (2022).
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Health Tech, Diagnostics
target:
A decade of research. Built for every echo lab.

InVision delivers clinically-validated AI for the most common cardiac imaging exam in the world — streamlining interpretation, standardizing measurements, and surfacing disease that today goes undiagnosed.

Echo AI that earns its place on the enterprise roadmap.

Reimbursement is live, not hypothetical

Paid on both sides of the house. Outpatient: CPT Category III code 0932T (effective January 1, 2025) covers adjunctive AI analysis supporting heart failure subtype classification — Precision Cardiac Amyloid is in scope when LVEF is 50% or above , and Precision LVEF establishes that threshold in the same pass. Inpatient: CMS has approved a Medicare New Technology Add-on Payment of up to $2,275 per eligible stay, on top of the MS-DRG, effective October 1, 2026.

Measurable workflow gains

Echo interpretation consumes over an hour of physician and technician time per exam . Precision LVEF has been shown in a blinded, randomized trial to reduce sonographer and cardiologist effort while improving measurement consistency.

Regulatory-grade from day one

FDA 510(k) clearance for both Precision LVEF and Precision Cardiac Amyloid. Cardiac Amyloid was previously granted Breakthrough Device Designation and enrolled in the FDA's Total Product Lifecycle Advisory Program (TAP).

Standard DICOM in. Any scanner, any PACS.

Vendor-neutral by design: GE, Philips, Siemens, Canon, and handheld POCUS . InVision reads the standard DICOM your lab already produces, so there is no new hardware, no new views, and no acquisition change — it deploys alongside your existing PACS, CVIS, and Epic EHR. Typical implementation is about four weeks from kick-off to go-live .

Cloud or on-premise. Your choice, not ours.

InVision runs in your data center or in our validated cloud. PHI never has to leave your network , and on-premise no image data is retained once processing completes. Customer data stays in the United States either way — the deployment model is a procurement and security decision, not a product limitation.

Surface the diseases you're missing

Cardiac amyloidosis is rare, under-diagnosed, and now treatable. Our algorithms analyze every routine echo at zero marginal clinician burden — turning your existing imaging volume into a population-health instrument.

A roadmap, not a single product

LVEF and Cardiac Amyloid are live. Precision Cirrhosis holds Breakthrough Device designation, and Precision Reporting — powered by our Nature-published foundation model — is in active development. A single deployment path that grows across your cardiovascular service line.

One integration. A growing suite of cleared algorithms.

InVision Precision LVEF

Product: InVision Medical Technology
One-liner: AI Diagnosis of Heart Disease
Description: At InVision, we use AI to help streamline the interpretation of ultrasounds and identify diseases that may have been missed by human readers. Our models have been tightly integrated into the clinical workflow to allow easy usage by clinicians. Our work has previously been peer-reviewed and published in several top medical venues, including Nature (2020), Nature Medicine (2021), Lancet Digital Health (2021), JAMA Cardiology (2022).
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Health Tech, Diagnostics

A decade of research. Built for every echo lab.

InVision delivers clinically-validated AI for the most common cardiac imaging exam in the world — streamlining interpretation, standardizing measurements, and surfacing disease that today goes undiagnosed.

Echo AI that earns its place on the enterprise roadmap.

Reimbursement is live, not hypothetical

Paid on both sides of the house. Outpatient: CPT Category III code 0932T (effective January 1, 2025) covers adjunctive AI analysis supporting heart failure subtype classification — Precision Cardiac Amyloid is in scope when LVEF is 50% or above , and Precision LVEF establishes that threshold in the same pass. Inpatient: CMS has approved a Medicare New Technology Add-on Payment of up to $2,275 per eligible stay, on top of the MS-DRG, effective October 1, 2026.

Measurable workflow gains

Echo interpretation consumes over an hour of physician and technician time per exam . Precision LVEF has been shown in a blinded, randomized trial to reduce sonographer and cardiologist effort while improving measurement consistency.

Regulatory-grade from day one

FDA 510(k) clearance for both Precision LVEF and Precision Cardiac Amyloid. Cardiac Amyloid was previously granted Breakthrough Device Designation and enrolled in the FDA's Total Product Lifecycle Advisory Program (TAP).

Standard DICOM in. Any scanner, any PACS.

Vendor-neutral by design: GE, Philips, Siemens, Canon, and handheld POCUS . InVision reads the standard DICOM your lab already produces, so there is no new hardware, no new views, and no acquisition change — it deploys alongside your existing PACS, CVIS, and Epic EHR. Typical implementation is about four weeks from kick-off to go-live .

Cloud or on-premise. Your choice, not ours.

InVision runs in your data center or in our validated cloud. PHI never has to leave your network , and on-premise no image data is retained once processing completes. Customer data stays in the United States either way — the deployment model is a procurement and security decision, not a product limitation.

Surface the diseases you're missing

Cardiac amyloidosis is rare, under-diagnosed, and now treatable. Our algorithms analyze every routine echo at zero marginal clinician burden — turning your existing imaging volume into a population-health instrument.

A roadmap, not a single product

LVEF and Cardiac Amyloid are live. Precision Cirrhosis holds Breakthrough Device designation, and Precision Reporting — powered by our Nature-published foundation model — is in active development. A single deployment path that grows across your cardiovascular service line.

One integration. A growing suite of cleared algorithms.

InVision Precision LVEF

name: Unifold
brief:
Product: Unifold
One-liner: Multi-chain deposit and payment infrastructure
Description: Launch crypto deposits in minutes. Unifold is a developer-first API + SDK that makes it easy for any app to accept on-chain deposits – across any chain and token – with less than 10 lines of code. We handle the full deposit flow so teams can ship faster and give users a smooth experience that actually works. If you’re building a consumer-facing on-chain product and want best-in-class deposits (or want to support more chains fast), we’d love to work with you.
Industry: Fintech / Payments
target:
Multi-chain deposit and payment infrastructure for consumer apps.

Instant crypto and stablecoin deposits across every chain — any token, any chain, any stablecoin.

One stack. Every chain. Zero complexity.

Stop stitching together point solutions. Unifold is one integration for deposits, payouts, and settlement across every chain — so you can focus on your product.

One API, all chains

Orchestrate deposits across Ethereum, Solana, Bitcoin, and more with a single programmable interface.

Built-in compliance

Users deposit directly from exchanges where they're already verified — no duplicative KYC, no failed checkouts, zero chargebacks. Unifold connects to major exchanges to access existing verification and initiate transfers instantly.

Automatic deposit addresses

Provision dedicated deposit addresses per user in seconds while keeping routing logic, approvals, and settlement under your control.

The complete stablecoin & crypto payment stack

From deposits to payouts, checkout to treasury — Unifold handles the full lifecycle so your team ships faster.

Deposit

Accept crypto and stablecoin deposits across Ethereum, Solana, Bitcoin, and more. Provision unique addresses per user, auto-confirm on-chain, and route funds to the right destination — all through one API.

Payout

Send stablecoins to any wallet on any chain via a simple API call. Programmatically pay out to hundreds of recipients, auto-convert to their preferred token, and track every payout on-chain.

Orchestration

Orchestrate stablecoin and fiat payments across regulated partners and payment service providers. Route through compliant gateways, bridge fiat on- and off-ramps, and settle instantly from a single integration.

Checkout

Drop in a one-click checkout that converts any token to your target currency. Accept major tokens and stablecoins across 10+ chains while receiving exactly what you want.

Plus more tools to power your stack

Treasury

Unified management for treasury wallets across chains. Automate sweeps, set spending policies, and get full visibility.

Connect Exchange

Let users pay directly from centralized exchanges like Coinbase, Binance, Kraken, and more — no separate integrations needed.

Connect Wallet

Accept payments from MetaMask, Phantom, Coinbase Wallet, and every major wallet with a simple one-click flow.

Everything you need, built in.

One integration gives you the full stack. No stitching together point solutions.

Smart routing

Route deposits to the right network and treasury destination based on policy, liquidity, and final fees.

Gas sponsorship

Sponsor every transaction so end users complete deposits without holding gas tokens or worrying about network fees.

Enterprise security

Detailed logs for every routed execution alongside continuous monitoring give ops teams the oversight they expect.

Multi-token support

name: Pingo
brief:
Product: Pingo
One-liner: AI companion that helps you learn languages
Description: Pingo is an AI language learning app that helps users build fluency through speaking. It immerses learners in realistic conversations and personalized lessons with an AI tutor who sounds like a native speaker. Our goal is to make learning a language as simple as talking with Pingo — a companion who understands your goals, remembers your progress, and keeps you motivated.
Industry: Consumer
target:
Finally. Someone to speak with.

Learn a language by talking with Pingo.

Three minutes to your first conversation

Talk to Pingo about your goals

Tell Pingo your level, goals, and the situations you actually care about. Pingo starts building a path around you.

Learn through real conversations

Talk with Pingo about everyday moments, upcoming trips, interviews, hobbies, or whatever you want to practice. Pingo teaches what you need, corrects you as you go, and helps you keep talking.

Pick up where you left off

Pingo remembers your level, mistakes, words, and goals, so every session builds on the last.

Made for moments like these

Some prepare you for real life. Some pick up from yesterday. All help you say what you actually mean.

Day one in Korean

“ 반가워! Let's start simple: how to say hello, who you are, and why you're learning. We'll go 천천히 — slowly. ”

Saying what you like in Spanish

“ Today let's practice saying what you like. Start with: Me gusta… Now tell me one thing you like. ”

Picking Italian back up

“ Yesterday the congiuntivo got you a little. Let's pick it back up — con calma . ”

Before Rio in Portuguese

“ Que bom! Let's practice asking for directions first: Onde fica a praia? Now you try. ”

Talking about your day in French

“ Good. Now let's make it sound more natural: Je suis fatigué parce que ma journée était longue. What made your day long? ”

A Tokyo interview in Japanese

“ では、自己紹介をお願いします。 ”

Join 6,000,000+ learners getting fluent with Pingo

A few of them, in their own words.

“I've only had it for an hour and I've already spoken more than I have in a year with Duolingo.”

“How I went from A2 to B1. Pingo helped me break past a 6-month plateau in French. The conversations are natural and really challenge you with different scenarios.”

“Only 34 days in, and it's increased my speaking ability and confidence in ways I couldn't have imagined.”

“Pingo excels at the last mile of language learning — making you feel comfortable and confident in another language. It's like having a foreign friend available to you 24/7.”

“I needed to practice actual conversations. It understands my broken Spanish and corrects me when I try to cheat. I'm leveling up.”

Product: Clawvisor
One-liner: The Authorization Layer for AI Agents
Description: Clawvisor lets AI agents use apps like Gmail, Slack, and Google Drive without going rogue or ever seeing your credentials. You approve tasks once. Clawvisor enforces them on every request.
Industry: B2B / Security
target:
Your agents act. You stay in control.

Your AI agent needs access to your email, calendar, and code—but not all of it. Clawvisor gives each task only the tools, actions, and data it needs, then revokes access when the work is done.

The problem

Today, every way to run agents is a bad trade.

You get one of three options. Not one of them is fast and safe.

Run fast, unsafe

Skip the prompts, hand over the keys, and let the agent rip.

One confused agent, and the damage is irreversible.

Approve everything

Put a human in the loop on every single call the agent makes.

Approval fatigue sets in. You rubber-stamp, so you approve nothing.

Lock it down

Scope the agent so tightly it can barely touch a thing.

Now it's safe, because it's useless.

Run fast and safe.

Approve the task, not the tools. Access binds to the task, so agents move at full speed and still can't step outside what you approved.

That's Clawvisor.

Why Clawvisor

Your agent doesn’t need the whole account.

MCP and OAuth can give agents broad, standing access. Clawvisor grants only what each approved task requires.

Broad tool access

MCP

The agent can call every tool the connected server exposes.

Broad account access

OAuth

The agent can use everything the token's scopes allow.

Need-to-know access

Clawvisor

The agent gets only the tools, actions, and data this task needs.

Things you can finally hand an agent.

Approve the task once, and every request the agent makes has to match it. That turns each of these from a permission you'd never grant into a capability you can hand an agent today.

Hand over a task, not the keys

You approve a task, not a standing permission. Every request the agent makes is checked against the purpose you approved — a calendar read for your morning briefing goes through, an expense audit across all history does not.

See exactly what your agent did

Every request, every purpose declaration, every decision, every credential injection. A complete record of what your agent asked for and what Clawvisor allowed.

Connect real accounts, keep your tokens

Your API keys and OAuth tokens live in an encrypted vault. Clawvisor injects credentials server-side and returns sanitized results, so a leaked prompt or transcript can't leak a token.

Catch injection before it runs

Every request is scored for risk before execution. Clawvisor flags anomalous parameters, unusual access patterns, scope creep, and prompt-injection attempts hiding in tool arguments.
