name: Agency Tool Company
brief:
Product: Agency Tool Company
One-liner: Reliable infrastructure to build, deploy and manage real-world robots.
Description: Agency Tool Company ships software to robots in the field 20x faster than a Docker pull with ATC Deploy, sending only the bytes that changed and resuming when the network drops. Deployment tooling is the connection between the lab & the field that continually bottlenecks robotics scaling and lacks a strong robotics-native solution. Deploy is live today with 3 launch partners across ag, construction, and logistics robotics.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Developer Tools, Robotics, Automation, Infrastructure, Self-Driving Vehicles
target:
Field Robots Faster.

Agency Tool Company gives robotics teams reliable infrastructure to build, deploy, manage, and operate real-world robots, so your team can focus on the things customers care about.

00 — THE PROBLEM

Existing build and deployment systems weren’t built for robots.

Robots are more like pets than cattle. Cloud and IoT tooling assumes disposable, identical, always-connected machines. Fielded robots break those assumptions.

Deployment challenges bottleneck developer iteration and field rollouts alike. The friction and risk make operations and customer teams wary of shipping updates.

THE SOLUTION

We build tools for the reality of robotics.

01 — ATC DEPLOY

Built alongside teams putting robots into production environments.

IN BETA TODAY WITH

Over-the-air updates for one robot on your bench or thousands in the field.

EASY TO START

One line to install

No agents to babysit, no infrastructure project. Install on a robot and ship your first update in minutes.

$ curl -fsSL ⣒⡷⡩⢌⡓⡮ | sh

Install link coming soon

LIGHTNING FAST

20x faster than a docker pull

Smart delta updates and compression move only what changed, so even 10GB+ images update in a fraction of the time.

Works with your setup

Smart defaults out of the box but flexible to suit the reality of robotics.

With fast CLI tools for engineering and an ergonomic web UI for operations, ATC Deploy is the over-the-air update tool that works from a single robot to thousands of machines across the world. Put down the duct tape and use Deploy.

WHO IT’S FOR

You need ATC Deploy if

Your engineers are up after midnight SSH’d into robots to upgrade the fleet.

Your devs and test techs could take a lunch break every time they update software.

Flaky network connections and intermittent uptime make it difficult to keep a synchronized fleet.

You’ve got a spreadsheet managing per-robot and per-group configurations and calibrations that go alongside your software.

Sound familiar?

ATC Deploy is rolling out to more teams soon

02 — ATC BUILD - COMING SOON

CI on the hardware you actually ship.

ATC Build is a CI runner backed by our hosted specialized embedded compute infrastructure. Your continuous integration executes on the same platform you use in production, so you can evaluate hardware accelerators, timing, and system performance long before code reaches a robot.

ORIN NANO · NX · AGX · THOR

Get started with a single line

name: ToDesktop
brief:
Product: ToDesktop
One-liner: All-in-one platform for building & releasing desktop apps
Description: ToDesktop is an all-in-one platform for building and releasing desktop apps. We save companies months of development time by handling code signing, auto-updates, and native installers for Windows, Mac and Linux.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: SaaS, B2B
target:
Release, Secure and Scale your Electron App

Effortless deployment, robust security and seamless auto-updates.

Powering the world's most popular Electron apps

The Electron ops stack

ToDesktop is your end-to-end Electron partner — everything you need to run Electron apps at scale.

Eliminate developer frustration by letting us handle the infrastructure. Build your Electron app on Mac, Windows, and Linux with confidence.

We analyze your Electron app’s source code to find and rank issues by severity. Quickly resolve vulnerabilities with confidence.

Ensure your app runs flawlessly on all platforms. Our Smoke Tests automatically test app launches, updates, and performance on.

Keep your customers' apps up-to-date and safely test new releases on a subset of users before rolling out to everyone.

Our guided process makes purchasing and using certificates a breeze. Our secure hardware storage and expiry notifications give you peace of mind.

Understand your customers better with our comprehensive download analytics, tracking downloads across Windows, Mac, and Linux.

Our universal download link intelligently detects and serves the right platform-specific installer. All this is served from our CDN and hosted on your domain.

Measure launch time, memory, and CPU usage. Compare across versions and other industry-standard Electron apps.

Streamline your Electron App Infrastructure

ToDesktop automates your Electron app development, deployment, and updates. You write the application. We do the infrastructure.

Choose a plan that fits your needs

All of our plans include a 7-day free trial .

For simple desktop apps and solo developers.

For sophisticated desktop apps and small teams.

For advanced features and dedicated support.

Customised to suit your needs.

Questions & answers

Yes , if you are developing Electron apps and want to streamline the process of deploying, securing, and updating your app across multiple platforms (Windows, Mac, and Linux). ToDesktop helps eliminate frustration by handling much of the infrastructure, such as code signing, automated updates, and analytics.

If you don't want to write Electron code and you already have a web app then you should check out ToDesktop Builder instead.

Yes, we offer a 7-day free trial for all our plans. If you're not satisfied with the product, then just cancel before the trial ends and you won't be charged.

Check out our comparison page .

Industry: B2B / Sales

The GPS for enterprise deals

Automatically map stakeholders. Expose blind spots. Get turn-by-turn directions to Closed Won.

Free for reps. No credit card. First account map live in minutes.

Navigate every account like you've worked it for years

See key stakeholders, especially who's missing

An org chart that builds itself from your CRM, email, and calls. Who's engaged, who's gone quiet – and who you haven't met yet, surfaced before they vote no.

Know your next move

Win together

Built for every stage of the deal

name: Olam Labs
brief:
Product: Olam Labs
One-liner: Building multi-agent simulations for model evals and training.
Description: Multi-agent environments let us evaluate and train models in complex, simulated worlds. We work with researchers on both evaluations and training for character and agentic performance typically difficult to assess for using current popular datasets. Play one of our first releases, Multi-Agent Arena (https://olamlabs.ai/arena), where humans come play social strategy games against multiple AI agents. It's currently top 50 on OpenRouter and has thousands of matches played each day.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Reinforcement Learning, Gaming, Data Engineering
target:
Multi-Agent Aren a

Measuring how AI agents perform and behave in competitive, social environments

How the Arena works

Play matches of social multiplayer games against frontier AI models!

Your opponents are randomized from a large pool of models, and could be any set of frontier LLMs like Claude, GPT, Gemini, or DeepSeek. They're in generic agent harnesses and remember, hold grudges, and socialize just as a human player would.

Everyone, both AIs and humans, only sees anonymized, generic names like “Ryan” or “Milo”. The AIs do not know if you are a human; they are just participating the same as you.

The AIs and humans have the exact same primitives for actions and information. There is nothing within your UI that you can do or know about the game that an agent is not also aware of within their own play. What the harness is to the AI to make them an agent has parity with what the UI is to a human.

You and the agents’ play feeds our benchmarks, letting us derive measurements of social and agentic behaviors across long-horizon multi-agent and human environments. These kinds of multi-agent simulations, run at scale over large sample sizes, let us look into the qualitative behaviors that models show: deception, social intelligence, preference, performance, and many more evaluations that are typically difficult to quantify.

Internal Multi-Agent Simulations

Our large-scale internal research simulations, with hundreds of agents running concurrently. We publish notable runs from them.

Tokenshire

Simulated town of AI agents running autonomously for long horizons socializing, running their government, economy, and more under resource constraints.

name: Zitara Technologies, Inc.
brief:
Product: Zitara Technologies, Inc.
One-liner: Predictive battery management software for electrified fleets
Description: Batteries have a big role to play in tackling the climate crisis, and it’s essential to make sure that they’re safe and reliable to operate. At Zitara, we build cutting-edge software solutions that empower companies to deeply understand their batteries, both in design and deployment. It’s all part of our work to enable a renewable energy revolution, powered by safer batteries, at a lower cost, with less waste.
Industry: Industrials / Energy
Tags: Climate, Electric Vehicles
target:
confidence in your battery energy storage system

Zitara is now part of Elysia - Battery Intelligence from Fortescue

Realize your storage asset's true capacity.

Zitara's real-time, on-premise solution knows exactly how much energy is available in your battery storage system and intelligently optimizes your operations.

More accurate signals. Smarter balancing. Up to 15% additional capacity unlocked.

Zitara’s accurate power and balance algorithms replace your unreliable signals, giving you visibility into your rack-level imbalance levels as well as reliable trading signals. This unlocks intelligent balancing programs and more aggressive trading strategies. Less downtime. More money.

Improved Availability

Zitara algorithms will accurately communicate the state of your asset, giving you confidence into how much power you have available and for how long. Now you can finally be more aggressive with your trading strategies.

Optimized Balancing

Zitara gives you visibility into the imbalance of your asset, down to the rack, or string, level. This visibility allows you to prioritize your balancing activities at a more granular level.

Reduced Downtime

Now that you know which racks to balance, and for how long, you no longer need to guess which racks to balance. Out-of-balance racks come down, in-balance racks do not.

Industry Challenges facing Utilities, IPPs, and Operators.

Batteries are complicated, and it's hard to know what to ask when investing in a new asset.

Factors like cell choice, environmental controls, and operating limits all impact the performance and longevity of your asset. Without a team of battery experts, knowing what to ask your OEMs and integrators is challenging.

Your onboard battery management system starts out wrong and gets worse over time.

Your system’s available energy is a more complex calculation than the state of charge. Even worse, a three-year-old battery is a different battery than it was on day one. Your built-in battery management system doesn’t adequately account for degradation, compounding errors over time.

Surprise shutdowns are avoidable, but not with data from a typical battery management system.

Unknown energy availability, cell imbalances, and thermal issues are some of the root causes of surprise shutdowns. Most assets come with fixed safety limits that don't account for these dynamic conditions. These assets fail to alert early enough, causing avoidable shutdowns.

We know your batteries, so we can tell you exactly what they’re capable of.

name: Spherecast
brief:
Product: Spherecast
One-liner: AI Supply Chain Manager for CPG
Description: Spherecast is building Agnes, the AI Supply Chain Manager for Consumer Goods. Agnes decides what to produce, where to make it, and how to move it through factories, warehouses, and channels – simulating thousands of options in seconds and executing the best plan. We are building Agnes to shape the physical flow of goods in the world, turning it into something as programmable as code.
Industry: B2B / Supply Chain and Logistics
target:
Agentic Supply Chain Planning for Omni-Channel CPG Brands

Turn planning and simulation into autonomous execution across purchases, transfers, and production. No spreadsheets. No extra headcount.

Supply Chain Planning & Automation Trusted By

You’re second-guessing forecasts, flying blind on which POs and TOs to place, while still justifying every overbuy or stockout. You’re firefighting every time a co-man misses a date or quantity. You’re not alone.

spherecast demo

THE FUTURE OF SUPPLY CHAIN IS HERE

release v2.0

Spherecast Demo Video Title

From Chaos to Clarity

Unify supply-chain planning, visibility, and execution in one AI platform. Focus on exceptions, not spreadsheets.

Increase your forecast accuracy with AI-powered S&OP.

An AI baseline forecast combined with human overrides in one view: one forecast, one team, one truth.

Reduce your inventory levels with optimized POs and allocations.

Spherecast projects what you’ll need across locations and suppliers, then recommends the best orders and transfers – before gaps show up.

Turn supplier emails into supply updates - eliminate manual data entry

Reads supplier updates, flags issues. No spreadsheet edits. Automatic update into ERP. Just approve and move on.

Make forecasting a team sport. One forecast. One truth.

Generate a baseline plan based on the newest demand-forecasting techniques. Reach consensus through an engaging process that unites sales, finance, marketing, and ops.

Get visibility into your future inventory needs.

Know what you'll need—POs, TOs, raw materials–weeks before you need it. Drill down by SKU, location and raw material.

Ask your supply-chain colleague anything.

Ask any ‘what-if’ in plain English—analyze complex scenarios in seconds instead of hours. From demand drops to co-man delays.

AI Agents that react to supply exceptions.

Read every update from your suppliers and co-mans. Stay in sync with the planning engine at all times. Get recommendations on how to handle any supply exception.

Try It in Your Sandbox. Free, Fast, and Effortless

Connect your data sources after one call with us; we’ll do the rest, and you’ll see your data in Spherecast in days, not months. Keep it only if you love it.

Connecting to Your Sandbox & Mail

We connect to your setup, load in sales, inventory, purchase- and transfer order as well as all supplier information and updates.

We Simulate Your Supply Chain

After we’ve synced all the information - we can visualise and map your supply chain within Spherecast - every comanufacturer, raw material, supplier and channel dependency included.

Your AI Colleague Get’s to Work

brief:

One-liner: The company brain for construction companies

Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Construction
target:
The construction system that’s

predictive

observant

reliable

organised

proactive

connected

Capture everything, connect it all and never double-handle again.

Alloovium is the multiplayer AI powering general contractors to take control of their disconnected systems. Capture everything, connect it all and never double-handle again.

Let’s make your systems flow

A unified operating system for questions, documents and drafts.

Enhancing construction operations

Bring hard earned knowledge out of your best people's head and project archives, into today's work.

Proactively weigh up risks and obligations to a project in less time.

With full visibility across connected systems, spend time running the project instead of letting systems run you.

Never write up another day

It rings like your best guy on site, and it picks up when you're out in the field.

Every project has its own number that you can ring.

Talk to it the way you would talk to someone standing next to you. There's nothing to fill in and no order to say it in.

The site diary written or the ITP filled out, in the words you used. There's nothing left to do except read it and hit approve.

Now launching with select customers. What do you want to capture?

We all know how much gets lost on site.

Time to build smarter

General contractors use it to...

Built with your privacy in mind.

Certified for SOC 2 Type I, ensuring the highest standards of privacy and security.

Rethinking construction

A team of civil and software engineers who believe general contractors deserve better tools — software that handles the unpredictable nature of construction so great construction teams can spend their time on judgment, strategy and driving a project forward.

We started Alloovium after watching brilliant builders lose their evenings to work a system should be doing — chasing the current revision, re-keying the same data into three tools, and rebuilding trackers that already existed somewhere in the company.

Construction runs on knowledge, but most of it is buried: in folders, in inboxes, in the heads of people who are already too busy. We're building the system that brings it back to the surface.

That means answers with sources you can check, records captured once and connected everywhere, and a memory that spans every project you’ve ever delivered — inside the tools your teams already use.

name: Relari
brief:
Product: Relari
One-liner: Building dexterous robots that learn from human biomechanics
Description: Relari is a robotics research company developing new ways for robots to learn dexterous manipulation from humans. We combine video with rich, scalable biomechanical data—including electromyography (EMG), motion, force, and touch—to train robotics foundation models for more capable, human-like manipulation.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Robotics
target:
Robot dexterity, learned from human biomechanics.

Human dexterity is guided by muscles that continuously regulate contact. Relari brings that biomechanical signal to robotics so machines can learn more capable manipulation.

Backed by

EMG captures force signals hidden in videos.

A hand can look still while its muscles continuously regulate force, contact, and stability. Surface electromyography (EMG) captures the muscle activity behind those adjustments. Once decoded, this biomechanical structure can be transferred across robot embodiments, enabling richer, more human-like physical interaction.

Measured Human Effort

EMG captures force timing, magnitude, and coordination.

Precise Robot Control

A force-aware control policy transfers that structure to the robot.

Non-invasive. Easy to scale. Rich in intent.

One lightweight armband adds interaction information to natural human demonstrations—without instrumented objects, gloves, or robot hardware.

Force supervision, at scale

Force-labeled demonstrations are tied to a robot, operator, and lab. We study whether wearable EMG can move that supervision to people—across more tasks and environments.

A foundation model built from human dexterity.

Biomechanically rich demonstrations at scale enable us to train more capable, force-aware models for general-purpose robotic manipulation.

Our work sits at the intersection of robot learning, human biomechanics, and hardware. We’re looking for people with deep expertise, intellectual range, and a desire to explore problems that don’t fit neatly within one discipline.

brief:
Product: Dime
One-liner: Dime automates administrative busywork at healthcare clinics
Description: At Dime, we automate repetitive administrative work in healthcare clinics, including insurance coordination, referrals, referring-provider communication, scheduling, and patient communication. We integrate directly with RIS and EHR systems, creating true end-to-end automation rather than adding another software layer. Our HIPAA-compliant AI agents eliminate paperwork bottlenecks, reduce errors, and restore hours of clinical time - enabling care teams to focus on patients.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Healthcare
target:
From Referral to Visit.

We turn referrals into scheduled visits in ~20 minutes.

Why DimeHealth?

Because great intake is what turns referrals into visits.

Inbound documents don’t just get routed. Dime creates orders, fulfills record requests, and prepares payor-ready documentation.

Authorizations are prepared with accurate clinical documentation, submitted across fax, phone, and payor portals, and tracked through completion.

Patients are called to schedule visits, and inbound calls are answered so no referral or call is left waiting.

Explore the DimeHealth Platform

DimeHealth handles documents, authorizations and patient calls in one intake platform to turn referrals into visits.

DimeHealth manages your text and phone lines to schedule visits, reschedule appointments, handle billing questions, or triage.

Processes documents from all sources; handles workflows like order creation, records fulfillment and chart maintenance.

Prepares authorization packets, submits them across payor channels, and tracks status through completion.

DimeHealth's Features

Everything needed to automate patient access.

Classifies inbound documents and routes them to the correct workflow.

Turns inbound referrals into structured, scheduled orders automatically.

Validates patient eligibility and coverage details directly from payor records.

Answers patient calls and books appointments without staff involvement.

Automatically updates referring providers as orders progress.

Prepares and submits prior authorizations across all payor channels.

How to work with us

Get onboarded and integrated in weeks, not months.

Confirm fit in a short discovery conversation focused on your workflows.

Lightweight integrations with your existing EHR, RIS, PMS and related tools.

Run DimeHealth on real workflows before committing long-term.

From Referral to Visit. And Everything In Between.

Powered by proprietary AI models purpose-built for medical documentation, healthcare workflows, with strict accuracy and security standards.

name: Dataland
brief:
Product: Dataland
One-liner: AI agents for customer support.
Description: Dataland is the applied AI lab for complex operations and customer support. In 8 months, we've grown to multi-million dollar ARR as just two founders and are highly profitable. We’re partnering with some of the fastest growing startups and public companies in the world.
Industry: B2B / Operations
Tags: B2B, Data Engineering, Data Visualization, AI
target:
AI agents like your best humans.

Dataland builds AI agents that deliver hard outcomes in the real world. We partner with major enterprises in sectors across healthcare, energy, marketplaces, consumer electronics, waste management, and logistics.

We own the outcome.

Most AI vendors sell you a platform and expect your team to do the rest: build the workflows, wire the integrations, maintain the logic, and staff the engineers to keep it running. They do 10% of the work and leave you with the other 90%.

We do the opposite. Our engineers embed with your team, learn your operations, build every integration, and ship a working agent. Then they stay, expanding to new workflows and maintaining the system as your business evolves. You only pay us for real work correctly delivered, and we stay on the hook for the outcome.

Our agents do the work that can't be templated.

Most "AI agents" do the trivial 20%. They deflect the simple cases, drop a decision tree on your team, and call it done. Your people still do the other 80%, the complicated work that actually matters.

We build AI agents that own the complete workload. A multi-national fraud investigation across KYC, payment rails, and risk signals. A prior authorization that touches an EHR, an eligibility API, and a 100-page policy doc. An offline IoT device diagnosed from telemetry, unstructured logs, and debugging a firmware codebase written in C.

The kind of ticket that takes a human anywhere from 12 minutes to multiple hours, requires deeply specific expertise, and is impossible to template.

Our agents plug into every tool your team uses.

APIs, data warehouses, CRMs, EHRs, internal dashboards, Confluence, Google Sheets, and the legacy admin tools that don't have APIs at all. If your humans can see it in a browser, our agent can too. Same credentials, same portals, same constraints.

Most vendors stop at the systems with clean APIs. We go further: browser automation, direct warehouse queries, and vision-based computer use against internal tools. The data your agent needs to actually resolve a ticket is almost never in one place, and half of it is locked behind a UI nobody built an export for.

What our customers say.

We embed dedicated AI engineers that stay for the long haul.

brief:
Product: GitLab
One-liner: A complete DevOps platform delivered as a single application.
Description: GitLab is the first single application for the entire DevOps lifecycle. Only GitLab enables Concurrent DevOps, unlocking organizations from the constraints of today’s toolchain. GitLab provides unmatched visibility, radical new levels of efficiency and comprehensive governance to significantly compress the time between planning a change and monitoring its effect. This makes the software lifecycle 200% faster, radically improving the speed of business.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, DevSecOps, Open Source
target:
Speed you can trust, all the way to production

Agentic software engineering for your entire team

What's new in GitLab

60+ improvements across AI, Security and much more

GitLab Duo Agent Platform

AI-powered DevSecOps across the entire software lifecycle.

Security built in

SAST, DAST, and compliance in every pipeline.

Built for how you work

Join the 50+ million people already using GitLab.

Define how teams and AI agents work together

Customize workflows for development, testing, security, and deployment. Teams orchestrate from above the lifecycle while agents execute within it, automating repetitive tasks based on the rules and guardrails you set. Agents turn issues into merge requests, remediate vulnerabilities, and review code while your team stays in control.

Your end-to-end delivery process in one place

From planning to source control to CI/CD, everything you need to build and ship software faster in one platform. Projects, releases, and code share one data plane so your team and agents work from a single source of truth.

Be proactive with security built in, not bolted on

Build secure products with fewer security products. Consolidate scanners like SAST, SCA, Secret Detection, and DAST into one platform. Security findings appear directly in merge requests and IDEs. Apply controls for compliance and collect audit-ready evidence automatically in every pipeline.

Commit once, adjust anytime with flexible pricing

Organizations that need pricing flexibility can make one annual commitment and steer their spend across seat-based licenses and usage-based credits without re-procurement.

Built to meet your industry’s demands

Every industry faces unique security, compliance, and delivery requirements. GitLab adapts to your regulatory environment while maintaining the velocity your teams need.

Meet strict regulatory requirements without sacrificing delivery speed. Maintain audit trails, access controls, and comprehensive security testing.

Build software that meets federal security standards. Deploy in air-gapped environments, maintain government compliance, and secure software by design.

Scale network infrastructure with confidence. Support complex deployment pipelines, strict uptime requirements, and distributed edge environments.

Accelerate the automotive software lifecycle. Automate compliance workflows for safety standards, speed embedded development, and coordinate global teams.

Empower students and researchers while protecting institutional data. Choose from flexible deployment options and enable research collaboration.

Accelerate development from flight-critical firmware to customer applications. Maintain safety standards, track SBOMs, and deploy in airgap environments.

name: Skymerse
brief:
Product: Skymerse
One-liner: Autopilot for Flight Operations
Description: Skymerse is building one AI system for airline flight operations: from planning and monitoring in the operations center to real-time support in the cockpit. It is developing specialized aeronautical models that understand the data, constraints, and procedures behind each flight, replacing fragmented tools and manual interpretation. Notamify, its first product, already serves airline customers and thousands pilots and aviation professionals.
Industry: Industrials / Aviation and Space
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Airlines, Aerospace
target:
3 hours of flight planning per flight. Automated.

Backed by Y Combinator

Your schedule flows in. Every flight is matched against live NOTAMs, weather, and operational limits: aircraft type, runway, RFFS. You don't monitor. You receive decisions.

2 NOTAMs at EPWA: RWY 15, 33 closed. RWY 29 below length, RWY 11 exceeds wind limits.

Impact analysis

The decision layer for flight operations.

Your schedule goes in; flight-ready decisions come out. Every flight is checked against live NOTAMs, weather, runway constraints, aircraft limits, and company procedures, in seconds.

Every flight stays monitored, every alert tied to its operational impact. Each decision says what changed, which flight is affected, why it matters, and what to do next.

Straight from your OCC feed

Impact and decision

Airlines moved from paper cockpits to electronic flight bags. The next step is no-chart operations.

Legacy providers put aeronautical information on screens, but crews and dispatchers still have to interpret it. Skymerse turns that data into flight-ready decisions for every flight.

One stack, from raw aeronautical data to the decision.

Where every flight decision is made. How to plan the flight, answered without human input.

Automated NOTAM processing via Notamify. Data extraction agents. A custom Large Aeronautical Model for ops labeling and decision-making. The operational data layer for autonomous flight operations.

AIP, NOTAM streams, weather, client-specific data sources (OPS manuals, MELs, etc.).

Already in production.

Our first product already serves airline customers and thousands of users daily, turning raw NOTAM data into flight-dedicated briefings, summaries, and operational signals.

NOTAMs processed to date

See Skymerse run on your operation.

A focused walkthrough on your routes and your fleet: see how flight planning and OCC monitoring run when the decisions arrive on their own.

name: Regbase
brief:
Product: Regbase
One-liner: Automating Corporate Compliance, Worldwide
Industry: B2B / Legal
target:
The AI research tool that turns 100-hour projects into 1-hour tasks

Regbase uses industry-leading AI agents to identify regulatory changes other platforms miss: draft bills, obscure local websites, non-English sources, and the opportunities hiding in them. Make your regulatory tracker in minutes, not days.

Launch Announcement

Critical sources live in places traditional search and LLMs can't reach.

Teams that need to track new laws still rely heavily on manual research. The updates that matter most are often posted to obscure local websites, draft bill portals, consultation pages, social media accounts, and other sources search engines and language models never see.

Local & niche portals

Draft bills, consultation pages, and municipal compliance notices posted to obscure government sites, never indexed by traditional search engines.

Regbase found a regulation that required visitors to watch a video advertisement before loading the page.

Non-English sources

Laws published only in the original jurisdiction's language — Japanese, Arabic, Portuguese, Korean — and untranslated by media.

Regbase tracked dozens of emerging rules across APAC and LATAM that never appeared in any English-language publication.

Informal channels

Regulators increasingly post updates to LinkedIn, X, and Facebook before — or instead of — publishing them officially.

Regbase discovered one country's new employment rule announced only via a minister's LinkedIn post and nowhere else.

Hidden behind access gates

PDFs behind QR codes, consultation portals that require registration, and documents delivered by email only to specific mailing lists.

Regbase uncovered a compliance requirement embedded in a QR code printed on a regional ministry flyer.

If a regulation isn't in English, isn't covered by the media, or applies only at the local level, it can be nearly impossible to find. ”

Any source, worldwide.

Regbase uses an AI-driven approach to search for and analyze original government sources no matter the language or jurisdiction. Traditional databases miss what they don't already know about.

Search

AI Agents search the web for relevant results.

The Regbase agent uses many search providers to build an complete database. Each result is matched to the official legal text. Results are filtered based on natural language and understanding of the regulatory environment.

Country, State, Local · Any language

Analyze

Ask questions about all laws included in the database.

Regulations can be automatically analyzed to answer key questions. Ask questions about deadlines, penalties or anything else. The official text is used to ensure accuracy and answers cite specific sections of the document.

Natural language questions · Citations

Track

Receive automatic updates in your inbox.

name: Suiteness
brief:
Product: Suiteness
One-liner: Book guaranteed connecting rooms and suites at hotels
Description: Suiteness is the first online booking platform with access to an inventory of thousands of exclusive luxury hotel suites. Suiteness is carving a niche for itself in the international travel industry as the leading website dedicated solely to luxury suites and finding success with group travelers and families looking for a nice place to stay together.
Industry: Consumer / Travel, Leisure and Tourism
target:
The rooms hotels don't put on their own website.

Suiteness books the suites and connecting rooms hotels hold back from the big travel sites. All the space of a vacation rental. None of the stripping beds and hauling trash on your way out.

Tell us about your trip in a sentence.

Two families, a toddler who naps at seven, someone who insists on a kitchen? That's a hard thing to type into a filter and an easy thing to say out loud. Our concierge model reads every floorplan we carry and answers with actual rooms — connecting pairs, lock-offs, adjoining doors, the works.

Vegas in March, my parents plus our two kids. We want our own room but need a door between us — not a hallway.

You want a true connecting pair, not adjoining. Here are two where the second room has its own bath and the door can't be seen from the hallway:

A connecting room is two hotel rooms joined by a private interior door. You walk between them without entering the hallway. That is different from adjoining rooms, which are merely next to each other, and different from a suite, which is one room with separate living and sleeping areas.

Hotels rarely let you book a connecting pair online — front desks hold them back to solve problems at check-in. Suiteness contracts them directly, so the door is confirmed before you pay.

Where the good doors are

Cities with the deepest connecting-room inventory this month.

A rental's square footage. A hotel's Sunday morning.

The case for the vacation rental was always space. Two bedrooms, a kitchen, somewhere to put the kids at eight o'clock. The case against it is everything that happens after: the lockbox, the four-page manual, the trash schedule, the strip-the-beds checkout at ten.

A connecting pair or a two-bedroom suite gets you the same footprint with a front desk, daily housekeeping, and a pool someone else cleans.

Booked most this week

Real availability, real rates. Dates open in search.

Read before you book

Common questions

Guaranteed. Every connecting pair on Suiteness is contracted with the hotel and confirmed on your reservation — not noted as a preference the front desk may or may not honor.

name: Inviscid AI
brief:
Product: Inviscid AI
One-liner: Real-time Physics Simulations for Industrial Facilities & Data Centers
Description: Inviscid AI builds physics-informed AI solutions that transform how buildings and data centers operate. By combining real-time IoT sensor data with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) modeling, we create digital twins that simulate building performance in real time and autonomously optimize operations. Our platform optimizes airflow patterns and ventilation strategies to eliminate dead zones, improve air distribution, and reduce the load on mechanical systems.
Industry: Industrials / Energy
target:
Agentic physics simulation for |

Backed by Y Combinator W26

Simulation that sets itself up, runs, and answers questions. 1000× faster than traditional CFD.

The Problem

You simulate once a quarter. Physics changes every second.

Physics simulation is slow, expensive, and needs a specialist to set up every case. So engineering teams run it rarely, and act on answers that went stale months ago.

One engine. Two ways to run it.

Reynolds

Sets up the case, runs the solver, checks convergence, and answers questions in natural language. Solver-agnostic by design.

Control

The same engine pointed at live telemetry. Buildings, data centers, HVAC.

Same engine. Run it once and it is analysis. Run it every fifteen minutes against live data and it is control.

Data center thermal twin. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom.

Digital Twin

Physics-informed AI, built for the real world.

One example of what the engine produces: a thermal twin you can rotate, query, and interrogate. Every field you see is a real numerical solution from an open source solver, not an approximation, so every answer can be inspected down to the case setup.

Where the engine runs.

Buildings

Agentic design for buildings: floor plans in, regulation aware blueprints out.

Subsurface and energy

Reservoir simulation on OPM Flow, rate transient analysis, history matching.

Thermal systems

Chiplet and package thermal, cold plates, liquid cooling loops.

Flow assurance and pipelines

Multiphase velocities, flowing gradient analysis, erosion limits.

News & Insights

Discover the latest from Inviscid AI

Why we don't use lattice Boltzmann for general-purpose CFD

Government MOU with MPSEDC

Kajima / The GEAR: Smart Building Pilot

YC W26 Demo Day

Data Center World 2026

SEMI-THERM 2026

Get in Touch

Ready to simulate something new?

Schedule a 30-minute call with our team. Bring a problem description or a CAD file, and we'll set up a case and show you a live run.

brief:
Product: Clerky
One-liner: Makes legal paperwork easy for startups and their attorneys.
Description: Clerky builds software to make legal paperwork easier for startups and their attorneys. From formation to fundraising to hiring - everything a startup needs. Thousands of top startups use Clerky to get legal paperwork done safely and efficiently.
Industry: B2B / Legal
Tags: Documents, Legal, LegalTech
target:
How the Best Startups Get Legal Paperwork Done

Clerky is the only online legal service obsessed with helping startup founders get legal paperwork done safely. Get your legal paperwork done with confidence, so you can get back to building your startup.

Form & Go Further

Glide through the startup formation process safely. Get important features that online legal services typically miss.

Incorporation

Incorporate as a Delaware C corporation, the standard for high-growth startups. Typically processed by the Delaware Secretary of State within 1-3 business days.

What if you need to change something later?

Use our Maintenance products to change your corporation's name or increase authorized shares. Separate fees apply.

Post-Incorporation Setup

Issue stock to founders with customizable vesting, elect directors, appoint officers, adopt bylaws, and protect your startup's intellectual property.

Use our Maintenance products to change officers and directors, add new co-founders, and more. Separate fees may apply.

By forming your startup on Clerky, you're setting it up with lifetime access to best-in-class software, products, and support.

Every startup is different. Our software makes it easy to customize the key terms of the legal paperwork you're working on. If you need, you can even customize the underlying form language for nearly complete flexibility.

We're much more than fill-in-the-blank forms. With Clerky, you can easily loop in your attorney to have them review and comment on the information you're entering. Add your co-founders to your team so you can all stay on the same page and get legal paperwork done together.

Trusted by Experts

"We keep close tabs on the services our clients use, and Clerky is uniquely focused on making sure that things are done correctly — that's really important for avoiding expensive problems down the line ."

"When Y Combinator funds an unincorporated startup, I send the founders to Clerky and know everything will be done correctly."

" Clerky is the highest quality online solution for standard company documentation I've seen , especially for startups that are looking to get set up in a way that is ready for financing."

" The difference between clients who arrive to us having used a shitty lawyer v. those who used Clerky is night and day. Well done @darbyw and @chrisfield5. Public service."

name: Midplane
brief:
Product: Midplane
One-liner: The safety layer between AI agents and your database
Description: Companies are connecting AI coding agents like Cursor and Claude directly to their databases — where one wrong command can delete data or leak customer records. Midplane sits in between and controls what each agent is allowed to do: it blocks dangerous queries, hides sensitive data, and keeps a record of everything the agent touches. It’s open source, and runs either as a hosted service or on your own servers.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Generative AI, B2B, Productivity, Data Engineering, AI
target:
Let your agent touch production. Without the postmortem.

Midplane sits in front of your Postgres as an MCP server and decides what each query can do — parser-level, audited, denied before it runs.

Production gone in nine seconds.

Denied before it runs.

See what it allows. And what it stops.

Pick a query an agent might run. Flip a table's access level. Watch the policy decide — live, right here.

tap a value to change it · guardrails still apply

Writes to users aren’t allowed — users resolves to read. Flip it to read + write on the left to permit this exact statement.

Every decision is written to an append-only audit log before the query runs.

The agent broke nothing. Just every email and SSN, in a context you don't control.

Table access decides whether a read runs. Masking is the layer underneath — it decides what each column returns , redacting sensitive values before they ever leave Postgres.

One layer. Six guarantees.

Where your data lives, who can decrypt it, how agents get in — and how you'd leave .

Audit trail

Every query on the record before it runs — denials included.

Data residency

EU or US, chosen once. Your data never moves .

Tenant isolation

Your keys, your rows — no path between accounts .

Scoped agents

Least privilege per agent, revoked in one click.

One endpoint

Any MCP client , OAuth sign-in, nothing to install.

Self-host

The whole product, MIT , on your infrastructure.

Three ways in. Pick your door.

Read how it works

Concepts, the policy model, masking, audit, self-host — the full reference, from the cloud quickstart.

Read it on GitHub

MIT-licensed, top to bottom. Audit every line, or self-host the full product on your own infrastructure.

Paste a database URL, get an MCP endpoint, point your agent at it. One project and one seat, free — no credit card.

Rolling this out to a team, or want it in front of production first? Talk to the founders →

brief:
Product: Angle Health
One-liner: Health Insurance for Startups
Industry: Fintech / Insurance
Tags: Health Insurance
target:
The Modern Level-Funded Health Plan

Angle Health is built for today’s employers. We provide flexible level-funded health plans designed to be simple to manage and use.

A True Partner In Health Insurance

Angle Health is an AI-enabled health insurance plan delivering comprehensive employee health benefits. We help employers offer group health insurance that supports their teams while simplifying administration and access.

Easy Procurement: Rapid Level-Funded Quotes

Angle offers level-funded plans that simplify how employers purchase health insurance. Quotes and plan designs are generated using a streamlined process built to reduce delays, with firm pricing available using a member-level census. This helps employers and brokers move forward faster with flexible group health insurance options.

Modern Management: A Platform That Just Works

Angle supports employer health insurance through a modern platform designed for everyday use. With integrations across 100+ payroll, HRIS, and benefits administration systems, employers can manage employee health benefits, eligibility updates, reporting, and plan access in one place.

Elite Engagement: A Better Member Experience

Angle focuses on the real experience of using health insurance. Members have access to a dedicated care team and support designed to help them understand their benefits, navigate coverage, and access care. This approach helps reduce confusion and supports engagement throughout the health insurance journey.

Better Insurance Requires A Better Infrastructure

Angle is built as a full-stack health insurance plan that connects data, partners, and plan customization into a unified experience. This infrastructure supports employer health insurance and group health insurance needs at scale.

Members Love the Angle Care Experience

Angle is designed around the real experience of using employee health benefits. Members have support navigating their coverage, understanding their options, and accessing care when they need it.

Angle is designed to create a more usable experience for members. Coverage support, answers to benefits questions, and help navigating care options are always available when and where members need them.

Press

Find Angle Health in the news as we continue modernizing employer health insurance.

Experiences with Angle Health

name: Alloy
brief:
Product: Alloy
One-liner: AI prototyping tool for product managers
Description: Alloy is an AI prototyping tool for product managers. Clone any page of your live product with the Chrome extension to turn ideas, wireframes, and Figma designs into interactive, high-fidelity prototypes your team and customers understand. Alloy's Cloud Agent connects to your codebase and takes changes from prototype to production, and its AI chat can redesign any existing website. Design to code, no engineers required.
Industry: B2B / Productivity
Tags: Design Tools
target:
AI prototyping with your real product

Capture your product from the browser and make changes with chat

Build and prototype using your real product

Use your existing codebase, components, and pages to explore product ideas.

Build ideas instantly

Alloy is the easiest way to make changes to your product. Just prompt, share, and push production-ready code.

Start from your real product

Connect your codebase or capture pages from the browser extension.

Preview live in the browser

Alloy runs your app in a sandbox and lets you view changes as you prompt.

Share 'Notifications panel'

Share with a link

Every session lives in the cloud. Share it with your team or customers instantly.

Connected to where your ideas live

Use ideas, insights, and customer requests – from over 20 integrations – and build them directly in Alloy.

Skip developer handoff

Changes are built on your codebase. Push to a Pull Request at any time.

Get feedback

Share a link and get feedback from comments.

Push code

Raise a Pull Request and roll your change out to customers.

Ship faster

Stop spending time wrangling local developer environments.

Enterprise Ready. Built to Scale.

We view security as an engineering standard, not a list of badges. Every part of the platform is designed to keep your data secure.

Feature launches

Libraries and components

Upload your design system as a library and save parts of prototypes as reusable components. The Alloy agent builds with your real components, tokens, and assets.

Bring your own subscription

Use your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription to power Alloy sessions. Connect your account once, and prompts on supported models run through your plan instead of Alloy credits.

MCP connectors

Connect the Alloy agent to the SaaS tools your team already uses. Authorize a provider or add any compatible remote MCP server, then use its tools across Alloy sessions.

Inline comments

Pin feedback to the exact part of an Alloy prototype you mean. Each comment stays attached to its element and page, so your team can review feedback in context.

Frequently asked questions

How do I use my existing product in Alloy?

Either connect your codebase or add the browser extension. Using your codebase lets Alloy run your entire app and write production code, while the browser extension helps with instant visual prototyping.

How is Alloy different from Claude Code?

Cloudanix unifies CNAPP, identity, and AI security on a single asset graph. Every finding arrives with the owner, blast radius, and fix path — so your team acts in minutes.

Trusted by over 100+ customers worldwide

Cloudanix achieves AWS Security Competency

Recognized by AWS for demonstrated technical proficiency and proven customer success in cloud security — validating our CNAPP+ platform and Just-in-Time access engine that replaces standing privilege with time-bound, identity-stamped access across seven surfaces.

One platform. Every surface.

Cloud accounts secured

Events & threats detected

Every source in. Every tool out.

Cloudanix ingests from your sources and routes context to where your team already works.

SAST, SCA, Secrets, and IaC — from PR to production.

Full API + custom dashboards. Your graph, your automation.

name: MindFort
brief:
Product: MindFort
One-liner: Autonomous Security Agents
Description: MindFort is building fully autonomous AI agents powered by their in-house models that can find, exploit, and patch complex vulnerabilities in web applications at massive scale. MindFort agents use the same principles as human penetration testers to understand their target and figure out the best ways to work together to exploit it. We can do fully autonomous AI web pentesting and bring offensive security to teams out numbered.
Industry: B2B / Security
target:
Autonomous Security Agents

Background agents that continuously pen test your live products and services, safely fixing vulnerabilities and keeping your organization secure.

How the agents work

Add your targets

Add a target, credentials, and guardrails. The agents only attack what you authorize.

Find validated vulnerabilities

Agents pen test your running apps and prove every finding with a working exploit.

Patch and retest

Each finding ships as a fix in a pull request, re-tested to confirm it holds.

What the agents do

Continuous penetration testing of the products you ship, then the work that follows every finding.

Continuous Pen Testing

Agents pen test your live apps and APIs around the clock, proving every finding with a working exploit.

Patching

Security Code Review

Security agents in Slack

Investigate, triage, or explain any finding without leaving Slack.

PR Review

A security review on every pull request, posted inline before merge.

+ more

Agents do the work. You merge the fix.

MindFort runs the loop that used to take a pen test firm, a triage queue, and an engineer's sprint.

Agents attack everything you ship

Every auth flow, API, and business-logic path in your live product, probed around the clock.

Every finding comes with an exploit

Findings arrive severity-ranked with a working exploit attached. No scanner noise to triage.

The patch is already written

Agents open the pull request with the fix, then re-test after you deploy. You just review.

The agents get better over time

Agents learn each target with every run: your stack, your auth flows, your defenses. And because they test the live product instead of scanning the repo, every finding is real, proven, and cheaper to get.

MindFort’s performance across internal benchmarks (2026)

See results today

Setup takes minutes. First findings land in hours, each one proven and ready to fix.

First Results

False Positives

Deploy your autonomous security agents

brief:
Product: Caretta
One-liner: Realtime AI for Sales Calls
Description: Caretta is a Sales Intelligence for revenue teams. It joins reps in live calls, helping them handle information requests, questions, and objections in real time. Caretta lives in Slack to join the team conversation. Caretta gets smarter automatically: every call expands its knowledge base and objection library, turning conversations into compounding organizational advantage.
Industry: B2B / Sales
target:
Crush every call of the day

For a highly technical product like ours, Caretta provides the technical insights needed when speaking with CTOs and other technical stakeholders.

It starts before the call: not just a morning brief, but a tailored gameplan for every single call.

Upcoming call today · 30 min

Briefing 30min with Kayra (Caretta) (Maya Chen)

Questions to ask

How has onboarding progressed for the four pilot users, and what feedback have the SDRs and AEs shared so far?

What did you and Daniel decide about data permissions and connecting Gong or Granola versus using public documentation?

Is procurement's involvement a signal that a commercial decision is close?

Know who you’re talking to

Position yourself perfectly in the call by knowing who they are and how you fit them

Lead the call with

Replacing manual account research and giving managers visibility across every deal.

Watch for

Pricing was the open thread last time. Procurement joining today usually means a commercial decision is near.

Set the gameplan

What to lead with and which discovery questions are still open, tailored to this account

Follow in-call

The brief sits in the notch while you talk, so nothing is lost the moment you join

Win the moment during the call: answers, research and next steps without leaving the call.

Caretta totally changed the game for my customer calls; and everything after. The notch bails me out when curveballs come flying from heavy hitters.

It doesn’t end when the call does: notes, CRM, Slack and the follow-up, handled before you stand up.

It's just really helpful to have that safeguard and not have to rely on that follow-up email to deliver information.

Built for the most complex industries

Compute & Inference

Sell technical infrastructure with precise answers.

Voice AI

Explain complex voice products with confidence.

Insurance

Navigate nuanced products and buyer questions.

I use Caretta for sales, hiring, and even personal calls. I don’t have to prepare for meetings—Caretta has context about everything. It’s perfect for founders and their teams.

Startups

Build a repeatable sales motion from day one.

Cybersecurity

Handle technical security questions with confidence.

You aren’t here?

Caretta learns any product from your own material.

The leader’s command center: your team’s sales intelligence.

Caretta Demo | Marcus Feld & Dana Whitfield

Marcus sees value for AML and compliance questions, and will assess internal interest before a Monday follow-up.

Doing well. How's it going? Nice to meet you.

Sorry for coming in a couple of minutes late.

name: Mantis
brief:
Product: Mantis
One-liner: Digital Twins of humans
Description: Mantis is a digital twin company that combines LLMs with high-fidelity physics simulations in order to convert rare and difficult-to-access human behavior data into predictive models.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
target:
The last system without a digital twin is the human being.

Mantis builds living, predictive models of individual people — their physiology and behavior, forecast to the horizon where a decision still has to be made. Starting with medicine.

The twin: a living model assembled point by point from a person's record. Raw behavior tears away onto a strange attractor — chaotic, unforecastable — and the model pulls it back into form.

The record

A person is now measured continuously.

The average American spends roughly 40% of their waking life using a computer — nearly two decades of recorded interaction over a lifetime. Every one of those interactions is a measurement of a person's state. Fed into the right models, measurements of the state become forecasts of the trajectory.

The theory

Chaos at the bottom. Stability at the top.

Human behavior is a chaotic system — small uncertainties compound until any forecast decays into noise. The atmosphere's forecast horizon is about two weeks, which is why weather prediction dies there. Our thesis: raw behavior is chaotic, but the correct coarse-grainings of it are not. The same averaging that lets climate be forecast for decades separates behavior into three regimes:

Stable aggregates the target

Resting-heart-rate trends, sleep architecture, adherence rates, the slow drift of a cognitive baseline. Averages over the chaos beneath them — highly forecastable. This is where diagnostics live.

Stable routines reachable

Habit- and constraint-anchored patterns: where you sleep, your commute, your spending categories. Measured at up to 93% predictability in the Science mobility work.

Micro-chaos the long game

The next word you'll type, one impulse purchase, a momentary mood spike. Beyond today's models — and exactly where we're headed. The long-term goal is perfect prediction.

The questions worth answering today live almost entirely in the first two regimes — and that's where we start. Every model we ship pushes the horizon deeper into the third.

The company

A neutral layer, like OAuth for behavior.

Google, Apple, and Meta each hold a deep slice of the human record — but each sees only its own products, and each monetizes the data through one narrow business. A holistic model of the individual sits permanently outside every incumbent's mandate. The opportunity isn't too big for them. It's structurally incompatible with them.

name: Kalpa Labs
brief:
Product: Kalpa Labs
One-liner: Scaling Generalist Speech models
Description: We're building the next frontier of speech models. Generalist speech models that unlock in-context learning & strong instruction following for speech models alongside unifying existing speech capabilities like speech to text, text to speech, voice cloning, etc.
Industry: B2B
target:
Towards generalist audio models.

Kalpa Labs is an audio research lab working towards generalist audio models: models that follow instructions and learn new tasks in context. Our first conversational speech models are in beta today. Direct a scene in Studio, talk to a model live, or build on the API.

Direct the conversation.

Write the lines, cast the voices, set the mood. Studio performs the whole scene: multi-speaker dialogue with pacing, emotion, and voices that stay themselves.

Talk to it, live.

Open a call in your browser and just talk. Ask it anything and hear it answer in its own voice. The beta model, live and unedited.

Build on it.

The same models over a clean REST API. Docs written for humans and for models, where every page has a markdown twin, plus a playground that runs in the browser.

State-of-the-art performance.

Capabilities

Most voice cloning products only preserve speaker identity, and fail to mimic speaker delivery nuances. To stress test our voice cloning capabilities, we intentionally clone "meme voices" that say things in an exaggerated or distorted manner for a memetic effect.

Conversation first. The rest of audio, next.

Speech models today are roughly where language models were a few years ago: they can speak, but they can't really listen. They don't follow instructions about sound, learn a voice or a style from a few examples in context, or notice how something was said and not just what. Generalist audio models that close that gap is our whole mission. Read more →

If you want to build the next frontier of audio models, we are hiring.

name: Zentail
brief:
Product: Zentail
One-liner: We're making ecommerce simple connecting brands with sales channels
Description: Zentail makes adding online sales channels for ecommerce brands as simple as adding a friend on Facebook. Our mission is to make ecommerce simple and we do it with our ecommerce network that automates away all of the work getting a listing formatted for different marketplaces with different requirements.
Industry: B2B / Supply Chain and Logistics
Tags: SaaS, E-commerce
target:
More of your catalog live. More of your business in sync.

Launch faster, publish more accurately, and reduce manual marketplace work with automation built for multichannel sellers.

Built for ecommerce teams selling on Amazon, Walmart, Target Plus, and beyond.

publish rate

faster launches

faster time to list

hours saved monthly

profitability per SKU

Signing up for marketplaces is easy. Succeeding is hard.

Most marketplace launches fail in execution. Poor visibility, channel errors, and manual processes create delays and drag down results. Zentail removes that friction, making launches simple and successful.

Focused on the marketplaces that drive results

Why high growth teams choose Zentail

No templates. No mapping.

SMART Types tech structures your data automatically so you can list faster & easier.

Stay compliant automatically

Zentail monitors marketplace changes and updates your listings so they stay live.

Built for speed and simplicity

Get up and running quickly — and scale without adding operational overhead.

Real people. Real support.

Find listing, inventory, & marketplace issues before they cost you.

Spot catalog errors, inventory gaps, and channel-specific issues in real time — then fix them without waiting on support tickets.

List products faster with no manual mapping.

Zentail’s SMART Types technology turns catalog data into complete, compliant listings optimized for each marketplace. Publish single SKUs or your full catalog with less maintenance, fewer listing errors, and automation that helps you stay compliant as channel requirements evolve — without rebuilding mappings.

What sellers are saying

Hear from real customers who have transformed their businesses with Zentail.

Frequency asked questions

What is Zentail?

Zentail is a multichannel platform that helps ecommerce brands manage and grow across online marketplaces without all the busywork. It automates how your products are listed, updated, and maintained across channels so you can get products live faster and keep everything accurate as marketplaces change.

How does Zentail help with marketplace listings?

Zentail takes the work out of listing products on multiple marketplaces. Instead of manually formatting and updating listings for each channel, it automatically structures your product data and pushes it out in the right format – so your listings are accurate, consistent, and ready to sell everywhere.

What is automated change management in ecommerce selling?

Automated change management means you don’t have to constantly fix your listings when marketplaces update their requirements. Zentail automatically adjusts your product data to stay compliant, so your listings stay live and optimized without ongoing manual updates.

Who is Zentail built for?

brief:
Product: The Equator Company
Description: Interdisciplinary sustainability consultancy with 45 years of experience. Designed to provide a structured full-service ESG offer for your organisation and community.
target:
Enabling the Infrastructure of Change

Born from the merger of four companies with different skill sets, but the same shared values, expertise and decades of experience:

What emerged isn't just bigger. It is different.

It is designed to provide a structured full-service ESG offer.

It is a unique partner for organizations seeking change.

And it is here: meet The Equator Company

Sustainability, made to endure

We embed sustainability in the foundations of economies and communities - rooted in systems, strategies, and infrastructure that endure.

From energy, water and wastewater infrastructure to multiyear sustainability strategies.

Local legitimacy, global reach

Born from a merger of different organizations, we combine the independence of each to create a more dynamic structure for all.

Our trusted network of local partnerships across the globe aligns diverse interests, ensures delivery on the ground and delivers systemic change.

Vision grounded in reality

Bridging ambition and execution to make transitions work, moving institutions from objectives to results. We stay close to our clients to understand their long-term vision, and deliver it:

We blend curiosity with courage

Engaging every challenge with curiosity and openness, bringing in fresh ideas and perspectives to discover real-world solutions.

That’s how we’ve been helping turn sanitation data into better services and shaping journeys toward sustainability.

Making a difference and making it last

Our work doesn’t end at strategy handover or ribbon-cutting. We are committed to real-world impact: we design it, we implement it, and we monitor it.

45+ years of experience on and off the field have shown our transformations to be not only possible but practical.

Your partner for a sustainable transition

With experience and expertise in a wide range of areas, we’re here to design and implement high-impact, long-lasting change with your organization. Whatever the scale, scope, service or challenge.

Sustainability Strategy

We design ESG strategies, implement financially sustainable action plans, ensure transparency and compliance, and mobilize stakeholders — driving sustainable growth, resilience, and measurable value for your business.

Energy, Carbon & Biodiversity

We help you lead the energy transition. We design sustainable solutions, networks and hybrid systems, structure finance mechanisms, conduct environmental audits and support carbon credits certification.

Impact & Risks

Integrate sustainability into your risk management and investment decisions. We assess impacts, compliance, and risk mitigation to strengthen your organizational resilience.

Water & Sanitation

We promote sustainable investment in resilient infrastructure. We provide technical assistance, apply Nature-Based Solutions and ensure efficiency, safety and resilience in water and wastewater systems.

Crisis & Communications Management

name: Expanse
brief:
Product: Expanse
One-liner: Unlock wasted GPU capacity.
Description: Expanse unlocks wasted GPU capacity. We recover idle compute through three capabilities: resource prediction (right-sizing job submissions before they reach the scheduler), optimisation suggestions (code and config changes researchers can apply themselves), and failure prediction (catching jobs that will fail before they consume hours of GPU time). We’re four engineers. We ran HPC and GPU training workloads at the largest quant funds and national supercomputing centres.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Deep Learning, B2B, Infrastructure, ML
target:
Expanse gets you more out of the GPUs you already have.

Expanse delivers compute certainty.

We predict exactly what every job needs before it runs, so your cluster does far more real work with the same hardware.

Expanse analyses a GROMACS SLURM job, returns evidence-backed GPU, memory, runtime, and completion recommendations, then connects those recommendations to live cluster evidence.

Every workload starts with a guess.

A training run, an HPC simulation, an inference serving fleet: before any of them, an engineer has to decide how much GPU, memory and time it needs.

Today, that decision is a guess. Expanse replaces it with evidence.

The educated guess

A sensible plan by experienced engineers. Nobody could see it runs out of GPU memory.

with Expanse

The same job, analysed and re-planned in seconds.

Three steps to compute certainty.

Connect your existing cluster

One command installs Expanse on your existing SLURM, Kubernetes, or Nomad cluster. It automatically collects detailed telemetry alongside your workloads, bringing complete infrastructure visibility without changing your existing workflows.

Animated diagram showing Expanse model accuracy improving as it observes more workloads on your infrastructure.

Expanse learns your infrastructure

Expanse arrives pretrained on real HPC and AI workloads, then continuously adapts to your environment. Every workload improves future predictions, making the platform more accurate over time.

Animated execution summary revealing predicted GPU allocation, runtime, memory use, and completion probability.

Receive accurate predictions before every workload

Run Analyse before execution to predict GPU allocation, memory usage, runtime, and completion probability. Every prediction is presented as a confidence distribution, helping teams make infrastructure decisions with greater certainty.

Certainty for every workload.

Expanse learns from everything that runs on your cluster. The only difference is how predictions reach you: ask in the terminal, or have them applied behind the scenes.

You ask

HPC & Simulation

Use Expanse analyse before launching large-scale simulations to estimate resource requirements and reduce failed or overprovisioned jobs.

Animated command-line example running Expanse Analyse on a GROMACS HPC workload before submission.

Behind the scenes

Inference

Predictions happen automatically behind the scenes. Models are continuously right-sized, GPUs are utilized more efficiently, and workloads are optimized without changing developer workflows.

Animated Expanse inference workflow showing continuous workload prediction and GPU right-sizing.

Training

Run expanse analyse before you submit. Predict GPU allocation, memory usage, runtime, and failure risk before your job enters the queue.

Animated Expanse training workflow predicting compute requirements before the job enters the queue.

name: Mineflow
brief:
Product: Mineflow
One-liner: Mineflow predicts the shape and location of mineral deposits
Description: Mineflow is an AI platform for mineral exploration. We generate predictions for mineral deposit shapes and locations, empowering mining companies from initial exploration to advanced feasibility studies. Geologists need to know precisely where their deposits are because drilling is expensive. In early trials with a lithium mining company, we found that Mineflow predicts the shape of hard rock lithium deposits more than an order of magnitude more accurately than our competitors.
Industry: Industrials
target:
Mineflow emails you when…

Mineflow maintains the biggest public mineral exploration dataset in the world, updated every second. Create alerts for anything you want to know.

Every alert opens with the data extracted, the maps georeferenced, and a 3D scene ready to interrogate and export to your team.

Every public filing.

Every company website.

Every map.

Hundreds of new filings, surveys, and tenement changes every day — parsed end-to-end and routed against your projects. When something matches, the email goes out.

Look at historical data alongside your own in minutes.

Bring in your own drilling, maps, and project files, then line them up against Mineflow's public record on the same search surface without a separate GIS workflow.

Every map in every filing, georeferenced automatically.

No control points. No GIS workflow. Scanned plans, appendix maps, and cross sections arrive on the map next to the project they belong to.

Drill holes, terrain, geology, and the source filing — in one 3D scene.

The email gets you to a workspace, not a PDF reader. Color drill traces by assay against terrain and mapped geology before deciding what to follow up.

Search the largest public mineral exploration dataset in the world.

Drill holes, assays, geology, geophysics, maps, and tenements — all queryable from one search bar, alongside your own project data.

See what Mineflow has on your ground.

name: Virtualmin
brief:
Product: Virtualmin
Description: Virtualmin is taking on the lack of innovation in the server admin programs, like Plesk, by making a more accessable version for pages managed by the non-technical crowd. The program will feature simple installs of popular programs like content management systems that often cost extra on other providers. It will also let you administer your website from your desktop and mobile device.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
target:
Advanced web hosting under your control

Virtualmin is a powerful and flexible web hosting control panel for Linux. Built for developers, IT teams, agencies, and hosting providers, it runs on your own infrastructure, keeping your hosting environment and data under your control.

From one interface, manage websites, WordPress, containers, mail, databases, DNS, SSL certificates, users, and backups. The automated installer supports Debian and Ubuntu, AlmaLinux and Rocky Linux, and Red Hat Enterprise Linux. Choose the free, open-source GPL edition or feature-rich Virtualmin Pro.

Run Apache or Nginx, manage multiple PHP versions, use local or cloud DNS, automate SSL, operate a full mail stack with spam and virus protection, and schedule cloud backups.

Virtualmin Pro adds powerful container and WordPress tooling. The new Podman plugin deploys Docker-compatible images as per-domain containers and pods, with integrated networking, reverse proxying, logs, and browser terminal access. WP Workbench centralizes WordPress updates, plugins, themes, backups, cloning, and admin access. The CLI and authenticated remote HTTP API make it possible to automate server setup, routine operations, and bulk changes.

Virtualmin Features

Virtualmin gives you one place to manage websites, mail, databases, DNS, backups, and WordPress on your Linux servers. Built on Webmin, it adds hosting-focused tools for everyday operations, including automation, reseller and user management, and integration with popular cloud services.

The strength of Virtualmin is how it works with your OS, using the standard packages your Linux system already provides instead of building its own stack. name: Signadot
brief:
Product: Signadot
One-liner: Scalable validation infrastructure for AI agents
Description: Signadot is a Kubernetes-native platform that empowers AI coding agents to verify code at scale. Combining fast, scalable ephemeral environments with a validation framework built for complex distributed systems, Signadot ensures high-velocity code generation results in safely merged pull requests.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Developer Tools, Kubernetes
target:
AI writes code. We make sure it works.

Validate every code change

Ephemeral Environments

Scalable test execution

Your validation logic

Trusted by teams shipping faster

Feedback in seconds

Bugs caught pre-merge

Cut infrastructure costs

Fast feedback from local dev to pull request merge

Write Code

Agents and developers collaborate on features. Rapid iteration on every change.

Spin Up a Sandbox

Local agent connects to your live cluster via MCP or CLI. Sandbox ready in seconds.

Closed-Loop Validation

Agents run E2E and integration tests against the live cluster, debug failures, and iterate autonomously.

A Sandbox for Every PR

Every PR auto-provisions its own sandbox in the cluster. Same Signadot platform.

Run Comprehensive Tests

Plans and Jobs run integration, E2E, regression, and non-functional suites in Kubernetes.

Merge with Confidence

Validated in both loops. Ship code with high confidence in quality and behavior.

Built for how your team actually works

For Engineering Leaders

For Platform Engineers

For Developers

Start shipping validated code in minutes

Spin up your first sandbox on our playground cluster. No credit card, and no Kubernetes of your own required.

Everything your team needs to ship with confidence.

Local development with real services

Ephemeral environments for every pull request

Run E2E and integration tests pre-merge

Signadot Plans

Customer Success Stories

Your team is only as fast as your validation loop

Frequently Asked Questions

Unlike traditional ephemeral environment solutions that duplicate entire infrastructure stacks, Signadot uses a unique approach using sandboxes. This approach virtualizes environments within a single Kubernetes cluster by only duplicating the services needed, dynamically routing requests between the baseline and the sandbox. This allows you to efficiently run thousands of concurrent isolated environments for developers and agents without contention. Environments spin up in seconds, which is critical to enabling agentic workflows that demand fast feedback loops.

Signadot provides the runtime context and isolation required for agents to function as autonomous engineers. By connecting agent runtimes directly to your Kubernetes cluster via sandboxes, agents gain access to real dependencies and data without risking stability. This allows them to write code, run it against the live system, analyze errors, and self-correct in a tight feedback loop. Instead of just generating code, agents can deliver fully validated solutions that are ready to merge.
