name: Maven
brief:
Product: Maven
One-liner: Payments Infrastructure for Voice Agents
Description: We enable AI voice agents to collect payments over the phone through a single API call, handling card processing and PCI compliance across all payment gateways
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
target:
The Payments Layer for Voice AI Agents.

Add payments to any voice agent in minutes, not months.

Every voice AI company hits the payment wall.

Voice agents can book appointments, qualify leads, and handle support. But the moment a customer needs to pay, there's no infrastructure. Until now.

Voice Transcription Wasn't Built for This

STT models can't reliably capture 16-digit card numbers. We built custom digit extraction so you don't have to.

PCI Compliance Is a Minefield

Card data on your servers means quarterly PCI audits on your entire system. Maven keeps you out of scope.

Multi-Gateway Headache

Different clients, different processors. One Maven integration covers them all.

IVRs Are Dead

"Press 1, then enter your card number." Callers hate it. Maven talks to them like a human, not a menu.

Three steps. Zero card data.

Create a Session

Your agent calls our API with the amount, caller, and gateway. We return a phone number and SIP URI to transfer the caller to.

Collect Payment

Transfer the caller to Maven for secure card collection via voice or dial pad, or send a checkout link via SMS. Get real-time status updates. Card data never touches your servers.

Caller Returns

Payment complete. We automatically transfer the caller back to your agent. The conversation continues seamlessly.

"Great, your payment went through! Now, about your order..."

Your brand, your voice.

Maven doesn't sound like a third party. Configure every detail of the payment experience so it feels like a seamless part of your agent.

Custom Voice

Choose the voice personality that matches your brand. Male, female, tone, pacing. It's all yours.

Custom Messaging

Set your own greeting, transfer message, confirmation script, and error handling. Every word is configurable.

Multi-Language

Serve customers in their preferred language. Maven handles payment collection across languages.

Built for industries that get paid over the phone.

We're powering voice payments across verticals where phone-based transactions should be the norm.

Commerce

Order-by-phone, reorders, and upsells

Restaurants

Takeout orders and reservation bookings

Home Services

Deposits, invoices, and service payments

Debt Collection

Automated payment recovery at scale

Works with your stack.

Maven is platform-agnostic. Connect your voice platform and payment gateway.

Common questions.

No. Card data never touches your servers. Maven is PCI compliant and handles all card collection and processing. All you do is create a session and transfer the call. Maven handles the rest.

name: SigmanticAI
brief:
Product: SigmanticAI
One-liner: The Cursor for Chip Design - Delivering Silicon-Ready Chip Designs…
Description: SigmanticAI is building an AI-native hardware development assistant that automates the entire RTL design flow, from natural language to synthesizable HDL and testbenches, inside a seamless VSCode fork. Powered by fine-tuned Verilog LLMs, reinforcement learning, and real compiler feedback, SigmanticAI iteratively refines code until it compiles and passes synthesis, no matter how complex the design. It’s like the Cursor for HDL design.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Hard Tech, Hardware, B2B, AI, AI Assistant
target:
Ship verified RTL faster.

SigmanticAI is the AI teammate for chip design, accelerating every stage from RTL generation to verification to silicon.

Studio works alongside you. Polaris works on its own.

Together, Studio and Polaris enable the complete AI-native hardware development workflow—from collaborative engineering assistance to fully autonomous end-to-end chip generation.

Interactive AI engineering teammate

Works alongside hardware teams. Understands your codebase, generates RTL and verification IP, debugs failures, analyzes waveforms, interacts with EDA tools and FPGAs, and accelerates day-to-day engineering while keeping engineers in control.

Autonomous reasoning engine

Powers end-to-end chip development. Transforms specifications into verified hardware by exploring the complete design state space, generating RTL and verification, iteratively closing coverage, and driving designs toward production-ready implementations.

Which should you use?

You want to work with the AI

Stay in control, iterate faster, and get expert assistance. Best for day-to-day engineering.

Collaborate. Iterate. Accelerate.

You want the AI to work on its own

Hand off your spec and let Polaris deliver end-to-end. Best for full chip development with minimal input.

Specify. Hand off. Get results.

With SigmanticAI you get both — Studio to work together with the AI, Polaris to let it work independently, and a faster path to verified silicon either way.

Studio today. Polaris next. Then specification to silicon.

Studio is the interactive teammate shipping now. Polaris is the autonomous engine extending that same workforce toward fully autonomous specification-to-silicon engineering.

Agent-Assisted Engineering

Agent Collaboration

Specification → RTL

Specification → Verified IP

Specification → Silicon

Compatible with every major EDA vendor & open source

No vendor lock-in. Mix and match across projects — we auto-generate the right Makefiles, configs, and compile scripts for whatever you use.

About SigmanticAI

SigmanticAI is the AI operating system for semiconductor engineering. Companies use it to deploy specialized hardware design agents, automate verification workflows, and train private AI models on their own RTL and design history.

Behind a simple conversational interface, a hierarchical multi-agent system orchestrates every concern: UVM testbenches, SVA assertions, coverage models, register abstractions, RTL, Makefiles, and iterative convergence — executing against your real EDA stack. SigmanticAI Brain keeps all agents aligned on your design intent.

Our goal is not a better autocomplete. It is autonomous hardware engineering — agents that take a specification and return verified, manufacturable silicon, with your team's accumulated design knowledge compounding behind them. Get started with pip install sigmanticai .

Questions or need support? Reach us at founders@sigmanticai.com

Meet Our Founders

Rohil Khare

name: Zomma
brief:
Product: Zomma
One-liner: The AI BPO for financial servies, run by computer-use agents
Description: Zomma is building the AI workforce for financial services with computer-use agents that onboard like humans and scale like compute. Its agents handle KYC reviews, transaction alerts, and disputes on the same screens human analysts use, no integration.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Robotic Process Automation, Finance, B2B, Workflow Automation
target:
Computer-use agents for the financial back office .

Agents that work on the screens your team already uses and hand back a finished case file. Starting with compliance for payment companies.

Built by a team from

Works on your screens.

Portals, registries, PDFs, your case manager, your internal tools. Zomma reads them on screen, so there is nothing to integrate, and saves a timestamped screenshot of everything it reads.

How it works

Each agent gets a computer, your logins in a vault, and your procedure. It reads every screen the work needs, writes up the case with a screenshot behind every finding, and recommends what to do. Your team decides.

Data triage and analysis.

Portals, registries, PDFs, your internal tools. It reads them on screen and saves a timestamped screenshot of each, so the file shows exactly what it saw.

Recommendation and review.

It applies your procedure and recommends the outcome, with the reasoning under it. Start it on cases your team already closed, compare with your analysts' decisions, then let it run on new ones.

Starting with compliance for payment companies.

Payment companies run the biggest queues in the back office: screening hits, transaction alerts and periodic reviews, each one needing sources read and a file written. We start there.

In the product, Screening builds the case file and Your cases applies your procedure and recommends the outcome. The same agents also handle reconciliations and disputes for payment and fund operations teams.

Same team, more cases.

Zomma does the source reads and the first write-up. Your analysts spend their time on the decision.

Every finding, match and rejected match sits in the file with a timestamped screenshot. If a source was down, the file says so.

The recommendation, the reasoning under it, the sources it checked and the procedure step it applied, in a replay you can open a year later.

Zomma prepares the case. Your team decides.

It runs under your control and supervision, on your procedure and your thresholds, and nothing leaves your systems without a person approving it. Your data stays inside your organization.

Give your agent a computer.

Your team already pastes the hard cases into Claude or ChatGPT. Give that agent a computer: it opens the register, runs the search, reads the website, and hands back the screenshots with the write-up. Works with Claude, Hermes, or your own agent through our API.

Common questions

name: Darrow
brief:
Product: Darrow
One-liner: Bring Justice to Light
Description: Darrow is an AI-Powered Justice Intelligence Platform that scans real world data to detect harmful events, determine the number of victims, predict the outcome, and assess the financial value of a case. Using generative AI, Darrow detects impactful legal violations, matching plaintiff's lawyers with their next big case so they can stop spending valuable hours on business development and focus primarily on litigation. Darrow is based out of Tel Aviv and New York City.
Industry: B2B / Legal
Tags: LegalTech
target:
Legal Risk Doesn’t Begin with a Lawsuit.

By the time litigation starts, the window to act has already closed. ‍ Darrow is the leader in Legal Exposure Management - working upstream to surface hidden signals and transform them into structured legal intelligence, before harm compounds.

Who We Work With

The Legal System Has a Blind Spot.

Signals of legal risk are everywhere - in regulatory filings, incident data, market shifts, and litigation patterns. But the legal system has no structured way to read them. The result is a system that is permanently reactive, arriving after harm has already compounded. Darrow is built to change that.

Research at the Frontier of Legal Intelligence.

Darrow is an AI lab, studying how legal exposure emerges across the modern economy. At the core of this work is a structured knowledge base of legal exposure - connecting the laws that create obligations, the organizational weaknesses that emerge when they are not met, and the enforcement actions that follow. This research powers the system used by law firms, insurers, compliance teams, and other legal actors to detect emerging exposure and act with clarity and speed.

Most Legal Technology Arrives Too Late.

Workflow tools. Document platforms. Litigation analytics. Each one valuable - and each one designed to operate after risk has already materialized. Darrow works differently. We study how legal exposure forms in the real world - across industries, markets, and regulatory environments - and detect the signals that indicate where it’s heading before it fully surfaces. This allows organizations to move from reacting to acting with foresight.

The Intelligence Behind Darrow

Darrow is a multi-layer intelligence system designed to detect emerging exposure, interpret what matters, and put that intelligence to work across high-stakes legal environments.

Surface what's hidden

Raw signals exist in the world - in regulatory filings, incident reports, litigation patterns, and market activity. Darrow ingests them at scale.

Turn signals into legal understanding

Those signals are interpreted through deep legal context, transforming fragmented information into structured, meaningful intelligence.

Identify what matters

Advanced AI systems reason across the intelligence, identifying emerging opportunities, prioritizing signals, and orchestrating action autonomously.

Put intelligence to work

Darrow connects real time legal exposures forming out in the world to the teams responsible for managing them. An always-on legal red team at your fingertips.

Proof in Practice

in legal exposure surfaced

leading organizations across the legal ecosystem

signals detected monthly

legal professionals powered by Darrow’s intelligence

legal exposure categories covered

active matters connected through Darrow’s intelligence

Description: Darrow is an AI-Powered Justice Intelligence Platform that scans real world data to detect harmful events, determine the number of victims, predict the outcome, and assess the financial value of a case. Using generative AI, Darrow detects impactful legal violations, matching plaintiff's lawyers with their next big case so they can stop spending valuable hours on business development and focus primarily on litigation. Darrow is based out of Tel Aviv and New York City.
Industry: B2B / Legal
Tags: LegalTech

Legal Risk Doesn’t Begin with a Lawsuit.

By the time litigation starts, the window to act has already closed. ‍ Darrow is the leader in Legal Exposure Management - working upstream to surface hidden signals and transform them into structured legal intelligence, before harm compounds.

Who We Work With

The Legal System Has a Blind Spot.

Signals of legal risk are everywhere - in regulatory filings, incident data, market shifts, and litigation patterns. But the legal system has no structured way to read them. The result is a system that is permanently reactive, arriving after harm has already compounded. Darrow is built to change that.

Research at the Frontier of Legal Intelligence.

Darrow is an AI lab, studying how legal exposure emerges across the modern economy. At the core of this work is a structured knowledge base of legal exposure - connecting the laws that create obligations, the organizational weaknesses that emerge when they are not met, and the enforcement actions that follow. This research powers the system used by law firms, insurers, compliance teams, and other legal actors to detect emerging exposure and act with clarity and speed.

Most Legal Technology Arrives Too Late.

Workflow tools. Document platforms. Litigation analytics. Each one valuable - and each one designed to operate after risk has already materialized. Darrow works differently. We study how legal exposure forms in the real world - across industries, markets, and regulatory environments - and detect the signals that indicate where it’s heading before it fully surfaces. This allows organizations to move from reacting to acting with foresight.

The Intelligence Behind Darrow

Darrow is a multi-layer intelligence system designed to detect emerging exposure, interpret what matters, and put that intelligence to work across high-stakes legal environments.

Surface what's hidden

Raw signals exist in the world - in regulatory filings, incident reports, litigation patterns, and market activity. Darrow ingests them at scale.

Turn signals into legal understanding

Those signals are interpreted through deep legal context, transforming fragmented information into structured, meaningful intelligence.

Identify what matters

Advanced AI systems reason across the intelligence, identifying emerging opportunities, prioritizing signals, and orchestrating action autonomously.

Put intelligence to work

Darrow connects real time legal exposures forming out in the world to the teams responsible for managing them. An always-on legal red team at your fingertips.

in legal exposure surfaced

leading organizations across the legal ecosystem

signals detected monthly

legal professionals powered by Darrow’s intelligence

name: Traceloop
brief:
Product: Traceloop
One-liner: Know what your LLM is doing — and why it’s failing
Description: Traceloop gives you full visibility into every prompt, response, and failure. Track quality, detect drift, and stop hallucinations before they reach your users. Powered by OpenTelemetry, integrated in one line.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Developer Tools, Generative AI, SaaS, Open Source
target:
Ship LLM Apps - 10x Faster

Everyone's guessing No one's sure

Spreadsheets stuffed with ad-hoc scores and gut-check metrics leave every result in doubt, wasting hours hunting down context across tabs.

You can’t fix what you can't see

Model quality drops quietly — your users feel it before you do. Traceloop catches the failures before they hit production.

Take control of your LLM

Traceloop monitors what your model says, how fast it responds, and when things start to slip — so you can debug faster and deploy safely.

Start with raw data, end with real answers

Traceloop turns noisy LLM logs into clear insights — instantly

Start tracking in seconds

Just one line of code gets you live visibility into prompts, responses, latency, and more — no setup, no hassle.

Run quality checks with zero setup

Traceloop runs trusted checks like faithfulness, relevance, and safety using built-in metrics — applied automatically to your real data. Get a baseline understanding of model quality without writing a single test.

Define quality on your terms

Off-the-shelf metrics don’t always cut it. With Traceloop, you can define what quality means for your use case, annotate real examples, and train a custom evaluator that scores output the way you would.

Make quality part of the pipeline

Traceloop runs your standard and custom evaluations automatically — whether it’s on every pull request or in real time as your app runs. Catch issues early, enforce thresholds, and ship with confidence.

Traceloop is built for real-world teams

From startup to enterprise, cloud to air-gapped — we’ve got you covered.

Enterprise-ready by design

SOC 2 & HIPAA compliant. Deploy Traceloop in the cloud, on-prem, or air-gapped.

Open standards at the core

Traceloop is built on OpenTelemetry and ships with OpenLLMetry, our open-source SDK — giving you transparency without lock-in.

Works with every stack

Connect your LLMs in Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby using OpenLLMetry or our native OpenTelemetry-based gateway, Hub .

Compatible with the tools you actually use

Traceloop supports 20+ providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, Ollama), vector DBs (Pinecone, Chroma), and frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and CrewAI.

Proudly open source with OpenLLMetry

Check out our GitHub repository to see contributions and perhaps make your own!

One-liner: Consumer Optimized Insurance
Description: Coverage Cat, the AI-native insurance broker, fixes your coverage limits and finds cheaper premiums. We provide both AI and human support so you can get fast answers on your policy and quickly get a response from a human agent so you can protect you assets or close on a new home. The new way to shop for insurance

Coverage Cat is a licensed insurance brokerage that helps you compare home, umbrella, auto, and renters coverage side by side — with straight pricing, no sold leads, and a real broker on the other end.

Dub video and audio, without losing the voice.

Translate your videos and podcasts into 10 languages while keeping the original speaker's voice, tone, and background audio.

Voice preservation

name: Recover
brief:
Product: Recover
One-liner: Government-funded online addiction treatment
Description: Recover provides more effective and affordable addiction treatment via telemedicine. We partner with local governments to save lives and taxpayer dollars. More than 20 million Americans struggle with addiction, but less than 10% of people who need it receive treatment. For those that do, it usually does not work - only 8% get better. Most of this treatment is funded by governments, and goes to programs that are frequently predatory, and focus more on profit than people.
Industry: Healthcare / Consumer Health and Wellness
target:
Effective, on – demand substance use treatment

Call (858) 208-0121

Let ' s Recover

Recover provides effective, accessible, and innovative substance use treatment with a telehealth option. We partner with state and local governments to help combat substance use in their communities.

effective

Our methods have been shown to be effective for over 70% of patients

accessible

Through our telehealth option, services can be accessed by anyone with a smartphone, tablet, or computer

INNOVATIVE

We leverage data, technology, and novel clinical protocols to provide best-in-class treatment

Medical Care • Care Coordination • Counseling

COMPREHENSIVE Treatment

We provide comprehensive treatment featuring medical care, care coordination, and counseling. You will have a dedicated team to help with all aspects of your substance use and behavioral health challenges. Access to evidence-based care integrating medical treatment has been shown to improve outcomes for over 70% of patients.

Confronting an American Epidemic

20 M

Americans struggle with substance use

Over 20 million Americans struggle with substance use. Less than 10% get treatment, and even then, most methods are only effective for 8% of patients. Although medication-assisted treatment (MAT) can improve outcomes up to 10 times for substance use disorders, most treatment programs do not include medical treatment.

Recover is working to change that. We're an evidence-based, tech-enabled treatment program working to make best-in-class treatment available to everyone who needs it. We use scientific principles to expand access to treatment, reduce overdoses, and save lives. We are also committed to reducing the cost of treatment to save taxpayer dollars and allow more people access to recovery. That's why we're working to make substance use treatment effective, accessible, and innovative.

States can't meet demand for MAT

Enrolled With

One-liner: Cofactor closes the precision medicine gap with predictive diagnostics
Description: Cofactor uses RNA and Predictive Immune Modeling to build better biomarkers and improve patient outcomes. Led by Jarret Glasscock and a group of expert human genome scientists,Cofactor has built a new category of diagnostic technology powered by unique and powerful RNA data models built on terabytes of data.
Industry: Healthcare / Diagnostics
Tags: Medical Devices, Biotech, Diagnostics
target:
Predictive Diagnostics: Matching cancer patients to treatment

Predictive Diagnostics:

Matching cancer patients to treatment

Next-generation tools using the power of RNA

to predict patient response to immunotherapy

THE NEXT GENERATION OF PREDICTIVE DIAGNOSTICS

Cofactor has developed the first diagnostic that accurately predicts patient response to immunotherapy .

The national PREDAPT (Predicting Immunotherapy Efficacy From Analysis of Pre-treatment Tumor Biopsies) Trial is evaluating use of Cofactor’s OncoPrism assay to effectively predict patients’ responses to immunotherapy. To date, more than 24 healthcare systems have partnered with Cofactor in the trial that will ultimately study 11 solid tumor cancers.

Better tools are needed to provide clinicians and patients with a more accurate understanding of tumor response ahead of treatment decisions,” explained Douglas Adkins, M.D., who led the study. “The use of multidimensional biomarkers rather than single analyte biomarkers represents a promising new approach.

name: Lattice Health
brief:
Product: Lattice Health
One-liner: Monitoring and governance for deployed medical imaging AI
Description: Lattice Health monitors deployed medical imaging AI so hospitals can tell whether each model is still working, tracking agreement with the radiologist's read, drift, and performance across patient groups. It observes rather than controls and produces the evidence teams need for safety, governance and compliance.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Healthcare, Healthcare IT
target:
See every AI model running in your hospital, before it surprises you.

Hospitals are running clinical AI from a dozen vendors. Lattice watches all of it and delivers a signed report every morning: drift, fairness, safety posture, and what your radiologists actually think. Not another dashboard nobody opens.

Clinical AI is already in production. The oversight isn't.

A modern hospital runs imaging triage, sepsis prediction, and documentation models from multiple vendors. Each one quietly drifts, updates, and makes decisions a patient may one day question. Today, almost no one can see the whole picture.

Models you can't see

Vendor AI runs inside the PACS and EHR with no shared view of accuracy, drift, or how often it's wrong for specific patient groups.

Silent updates

A vendor can swap the model behind an API overnight. Performance shifts and the hospital is the last to know, until a reader notices.

Evidence on demand

When compliance, counsel, or a regulator asks "what was this model doing on that date?", the answer takes weeks to assemble, if it can be assembled at all.

A signed report in the right inbox at 7am.

Leadership doesn't log into SaaS; they read email. Lattice ships one PDF per role, sized for that role, cryptographically signed so it can be trusted three forwards deep. Anyone can verify it offline.

IT Director

CMIO & CIO

Compliance Officer

Three things no dashboard gives you.

Signed reports, not a dashboard

Leadership reads email, not SaaS. Lattice ships a per-role signed PDF every morning, and a missed day is an SLA event . The CMIO never has to scroll past the IT director's alert log to reach the clinical signal.

The radiologist's voice, built in

Every AI result carries a one-click thumbs-up / thumbs-down. That feedback becomes the next morning's "readers are pushing back on this model" finding, model-level aggregate only, so individual labor data stays private by design.

Verifiable offline, by anyone

Every signed artifact verifies with standard tooling against your institution's published public key. No Lattice infrastructure required. When a report travels three forwards deep, the signature is how trust gets re-anchored.

Sits beside your stack. Touches no PHI on the wire.

Lattice reads the signals your AI already emits, measures what matters, and turns it into evidence, without changing how your clinicians work.

Tap existing feeds

HL7 and DICOM signals from the models you already run, no rip-and-replace.

Drift & fairness

Continuous PSI, subgroup disparity, latency, and silent-update detection.

brief:
Product: Compresr
One-liner: LLM context compression for better accuracy
Description: Compresr provides an API that compresses LLM context without losing what matters. It’s a drop-in for agents and RAG that cuts token costs and improves accuracy.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
target:
Stop paying for context your model doesn’t need.

Your prompts carry far more tokens than the model actually reads. Compresr drops the rest: up to 90% fewer tokens, so you cut cost and latency. At light compression it matches or beats full-context accuracy on public benchmarks.

How it works

We keep the signal and drop the noise.

Keep the tokens that matter to your query.

What most teams are losing

Stop overpaying.

If you’re paying full price for your tokens, you’re leaving real money on the table.

Trimming / Truncation

Summarization

Question-agnostic compression

Question-aware compression.

Feed us the query and the context. We return only the tokens that actually move the answer. You pay less, the LLM responds faster, and answers get sharper.

GPT-5.2 + latte_v1

226× fewer tokens

Independent benchmark

FinanceBench.

FinanceBench, 128 questions over SEC filings. At light ~2x compression accuracy holds; push to ~10x when cost matters more than peak accuracy

Two ways to deploy

Pick the one that fits your stack.

Drop-in SDK. One API key.

Install, grab a key, compress any prompt or document before it hits your LLM. Pay per million tokens, no surprise bills.

Sign up, get $10 of compression free, no card needed.

Runs inside your VPC.

Your data never leaves your network. We deploy Compresr to your infrastructure, tune it for your workload, and support you directly.

Enterprise, finance, healthcare, regulated workloads.

No spam. Unsubscribe anytime.

name: Fuse
brief:
Product: Fuse
One-liner: AI-powered workflow automation for US healthcare providers.
Description: AI-powered automation for US healthcare provider workflows like patient intake, eligibility and benefits checks and billing using data-driven approaches. If you know senior execs in medical groups or partners in healthcare PE please do connect us. We won’t waste their time: +1 628 468 3232.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Fintech, Payments, B2B, Healthcare
target:
COMPLETE HEALTHCARE AUTOMATION FOR INSURANCE CHECKS, BILLING, AND REVENUE INTELLIGENCE

Fuse delivers end-to-end automation for CPT-level insurance verification, fee estimates, claims submission and revenue intelligence. We connect your insurance checks, claims, ERAs, EOBs and contracts into a single intelligent model that automates your workflows, makes sure you get paid, and gets smarter with every patient.

After a short onboarding call, add Fuse as a user to your existing EMR. We automatically pull the information we need, start analyzing your data, and automating workflows. No new software to install, no platform switch, no IT project.

Real-Time Insurance Checks

Eligibility & Benefits Verification at the CPT-Level

Patient Cost Estimates & Price Transparency

Smart Claims Model from Adjudicated Data

Automated Claims Submission

Revenue Intelligence

OUR IMPACT

We’ve helped hundreds of providers cut eligibility-related denials and automate the majority of claims and admin work, with zero IT changes required, all while improving price transparency for patients.

Prevent eligibility denials

95% of claims automated

90%+ less admin time

Zero IT changes

HIPAA-Compliant Healthcare Automation Platform

Transform Your Healthcare Operations Today

FAQs

What healthcare processes can Fuse automate?

Fuse automates patient intake, CPT (procedure code) level insurance verification including direct insurance payer calls, and patient cost estimates as one end-to-end workflow. Fuse has helped hundreds of providers cut insurance verification admin time and reduce eligibility-related claim denials, with zero new software required.

Are there insurance verification software platforms that let you search by CPT codes?

Yes. Fuse verifies insurance coverage at the CPT (procedure code) level through automated insurance payer portal checks and direct payer calls. Fuse confirms benefits for specific procedures before services are delivered, reducing administrative time by up to 95% and saving approximately 30 minutes per patient while preventing eligibility-related claim denials.

How does Fuse automate CPT-level benefits verification?

Fuse uses a four-step workflow: the practice adds Fuse as a user to the existing EMR (electronic medical record), Fuse checks insurance payer portals, Fuse calls payers directly to retrieve CPT code level benefits details, then Fuse adds the results back to the EMR as a short note on each patient account. This process reduces insurance verification admin time by up to 95%.

Can Fuse work with my existing EMR system?

Fuse works with most EMR systems with no new software to install and no platform switch required. After a short onboarding call, Fuse learns the practice’s existing workflows and customizes the automation to minimize disruption to the team.

How involved does my billing team need to be?

brief:
Product: Beacon Health
One-liner: AI Employees for Primary Care
Description: Beacon Health (YC W26) is building AI employees that double revenue for primary care practices while also reducing the total cost of care. Primary care is the primary source of care for over 200M Americans, but physicians don’t have the bandwidth to manage their patient panels. Beacon Health builds AI employees that automate tedious background workflows - preventative screenings, prior authorizations, referrals, and risk adjustment.
Industry: Healthcare
target:
The AI Workforce for Healthcare

Beacon Health builds AI agents that work in any EHR just like a human.

Beacon navigates and operates real EHR systems, just like a human, to automate complex tasks from end to end.

Trusted by physicians across the country

Backed by

How it Works

From workflow description to deployed AI agent — in minutes.

Define Your Workflow

Record any workflow in your EHR and turn it into an AI Agent. Beacon captures every step — navigation, clicks, data entry — and converts it into a reusable, deployable agent.

Deploy and Monitor Across Your Organization

Run agents at scale across your entire patient panel — inside AthenaHealth, Epic, ECW, and more. Full visibility into every agent's status, with controls to pause, review, or intervene at any time.

Chain Agents Together

Our agents can perform complex, multi-step workflows over long horizons on any EHR — chaining tasks across patient charts, care gaps, outreach, and documentation without any human hand-offs.

Quality Gap Closure

Integrate With Any EHR , Platform or Portal

Beacon works across EHRs, Payer Portals and Applications to securely and reliably execute any task or workflow.

Example Workflows

Track and improve performance across quality, utilization, and cost metrics to maximize shared savings and hit contract targets.

How Beacon handles it

Pull payer performance reports into EHR

Identify patients driving high utilization

Coordinate outreach and care plan updates

Document interventions to capture quality credit

What workflow do you want to build?

Describe your use case and we'll design a custom AI employee for it — typically deployed within days.

Join us in building the future of healthcare.

AI Workforce • HIPAA Compliant • EHR Agnostic

name: Talos
brief:
Product: Talos
One-liner: Predictive maintenance for power infrastructure.
Description: At Talos, we are building better, more modern predictive maintenance for the power industry with a focus on large transformers. Our devices continuously monitor critical power equipment and detect problems early on using anomaly-detection models. For each fault, we provide detailed analyses of the problem, exactly where and why it happened, as well as next steps teams should take.
Industry: Industrials / Energy
Tags: Deep Learning, IoT, Energy
target:
Detect problems before they cause equipment failures.

Exploded hardware view

When critical equipment fails, “later” can mean years.

Large transformers are expensive, custom-built equipment that are very difficult to replace and often operate well beyond their intended lifetime.

$ 5 M+

Typical replacement cost for a large generation-side transformer

150 + weeks

Potential replacement lead time

U.S. generation-side transformers are operating beyond their intended lifetime

Find the problem before your equipment breaks.

Talos continuously monitors critical power equipment, detects potential problems early on, and tells teams exactly what’s wrong, why it happened, and what actionable steps they can take to prevent costly mechanical failures.

Sense

Continuously capture equipment behavior using non-invasive sensors.

Understand

Learn what normal looks like for that specific machine.

Act

Detect any potential anomalies and tell teams exactly where to investigate.

Deep dive into how our technology works.

Talos attaches directly to existing equipment in seconds through our in-built magnets, learns the machine’s behavior, and alerts users when any anomalies are detected.

Hardware

Talos continuously captures how each equipment behaves by incorporating different types of sensors to monitor:

Magnetic / EMF

01 — Attach

Attach in seconds.

Talos retrofits onto existing equipment without requiring expert installation. Any user can easily attach our devices onto their machines in seconds by using the in-built magnets.

Quick. Easy. Low-effort.

Talos · attach / detect / analyze / insights

Mounted · operating equipment

02 — Detect

Know what changed.

Point a phone at the equipment. Talos identifies the asset and surfaces the condition.

Scout field rig

03 — Analyze

Locate the problem in 3D.

Talos identifies exactly where a problem occurs by localizing the fault on a 3D view of the equipment. Technicians can see where to look — not just that something is wrong.

Something changed.

Something changed. Here.

3D localization

04 — Insights

Know what to do next.

When an anomaly is detected, teams are notified with detailed information of what’s wrong, why the problem occurred, and actionable next steps.

Easily operate in the real world.

Our devices are very easy to use, installing in seconds through in-built magnets, and they continuously monitor your equipment.

Attach to existing equipment

Retrofit our devices onto any equipment in seconds using our in-built magnets.

Learn each machine

Talos establishes a baseline for every individual machine rather than relying on generic thresholds for accurate analyses.

Act before failure

When behavior changes, teams receive a clear alert explaining what changed and where to investigate.

Wireless sensor Magnetic mount

The team

Trusted by hundreds of global enterprises and growing teams .

Improve Your Win Rates by 30% with Letter AI's Revenue Activation™ Platform

And I can tell you from looking at Letter versus what (legacy platforms) had, I think the big difference was Letter is an AI native company. They really started solving and attacking this problem from the ground up, using AI-native solutions. Whereas some of the businesses in this space that have been around for a long time were trying to kind of bolt on AI to solve some of the challenges.

Engage your buyers while automating the busy work

name: Mezmo
brief:
Product: Mezmo
One-liner: Observability platform to control all of your log data
Description: Mezmo, formerly LogDNA, is an observability platform to manage and take action on your data. It ingests, processes, and routes log data to fuel enterprise-level application development and delivery, security, and compliance use cases. Mezmo was brought to life by three-time co-founders Chris Nguyen and Lee Liu and included in the Winter 2015 batch of Y Combinator. In 2018 the company partnered with tech giant, IBM, to become the sole logging provider for IBM Cloud.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Developer Tools, DevSecOps, SaaS, Kubernetes, Data Engineering
target:
Your infrastructure. Your rules. Your SRE agent .

Accelerate SRE work with AURA, an open-source agent that runs in your environment with your tools, telemetry, and operational context. Mezmo adds the governance, memory, and controls to scale trusted agent workflows in production.

Everything SRE teams need to trust agent workflows in production

Built for SRE work

Turn agent capabilities into operational outcomes.

Mezmo gives agents the workflows, tools, and production context they need to investigate, reason, and act on real operational work.

Governed for production & trust

Control what agents can see, recommend, and do.

Mezmo gives SRE teams workflow-level control over agent context, memory, approvals, authority, and execution so teams can operate safely in production.

Designed to scale

Expand workflows without losing context or control.

Mezmo supports coordinated SRE agents that investigate in parallel, validate findings, replan as conditions change, and operate across growing services, clusters, teams, volumes, and workflows.

The fastest credible path to an SRE agent in production

Start with a proven SRE workflow. Expand as trust grows.

Start with a common SRE workflow like investigating alerts, diagnosing deployment regressions, triaging an alert storm, producing an on-call handoff, or identifying a performance regression.

Deploy AURA with the tools, context, models, and policies needed to support the workflow in production.

Measure improvements in investigation speed, engineer time, consistency, context use, and execution quality.

Move trusted workflows from advisory to approval-based or more autonomous operation, then add more workflows across the organization.

brief:
Product: Newfront
One-liner: Modern insurance brokerage.
Description: Newfront is building the modern insurance brokerage. Transparent data delivered real-time translates into a lower total cost of risk and greater insights. We work with 20% of US unicorns, 100s of YC startups, and 150+ public companies on their Business Insurance and Total Rewards. Headquartered in San Francisco, Newfront has more than 800 colleagues and offices throughout the US.
Industry: Fintech / Insurance
Tags: Fintech, Insurance
target:
Newfront is now part of WTW

Newfront has officially joined WTW, combining a technology-native approach with global expertise to better serve our clients. Read more

It's official. This partnership expands our scale while staying true to a modern, tech-forward approach to insurance.

Clients Trust Newfront

With hundreds of veteran brokers and dedicated service professionals, we combine domain expertise with data-driven market intelligence to support our clients.

Impactful Innovation

Charting a New Course

We’re bringing advanced technology to an antiquated industry, fostering transparency, convenience, and optimized client outcomes.

Empowered Expertise

Talent Meets Tech

Technology should enhance human expertise, not replace it. By equipping our elite insurance talent with tech, we're creating a competitive edge for our people and clients. For example:

Paperless onboarding: our digital interface captures structured client data, providing more accurate submissions and saving time

Data-driven placement: armed with deep insights our experts find the right insurance partners for every client

Seamless service: convenient and continuous service, payments, and updates can be made through a secure platform, available 24/7

Intelligent claims advocacy: experienced claims advocates leverage proprietary analytics tools to resolve claims and reduce the total cost of risk

Galvanized for Growth

Built to Scale

Our highly-tenured team of experts support clients through their growth and business evolution at a variety of milestones with solutions that fit their needs—from early stage to mature enterprise.

From start-up to IPO: we have worked with hundreds of early-stage companies, navigating funding rounds, hockey-stick growth, IPOs, and more

Going global: enabled by the Worldwide Broker Network (WBN), we provide deep, country-specific risk assessments in 100 markets

Solutions that scale: our platform and extensive network of vendor partners meet you where you are

Client-first model: we put you first by operating as an extension of your team when you need it most

Using AI to Improve the Client Experience

Newfront is building breakthrough AI to drive client insights and free our teams to do the strategic work they were built to do.

By the Numbers

The data speaks for itself. From our large roster of established and growing clients to our stellar client retention rate—we build relationships that last.

name: Fazeshift
brief:
Product: Fazeshift
One-liner: AI agent for Accounts Receivable
Description: Fazeshift is an AI agent for automating Accounts Receivable. What used to take teams of people and hours of manual work can now be fully automated with Fazeshift. Caitlin and Timmy met while getting their MBA at Harvard. After graduating, they started a B2B marketing software startup, which is where they first experienced the pain of this process. The problem stems from fragmented data across software platforms like QuickBooks, Stripe, NetSuite, DocuSign, HubSpot, and Salesforce.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
Tags: Fintech, B2B, AI
target:
Your AI Agents for Accounts Receivable

Eliminate AR bottlenecks with AI agents that automate your existing processes, no rip-and-replace required.

AI agents for all your accounts receivable needs

The AR automation you need, the accuracy you expect

Cash Application

Tackle large invoice volumes and complex payment matching scenarios, including intricate parent-child company payer arrangements and cases where trade and business names aren’t always the same.

Collections

Automatically send statements or payment reminders, as well as craft responses with the right document attachments or even pause outreach emails while customers work out payment details with your team.

AI Contract Review

Analyze contracts, compare them to what’s actually getting billed, and reverse the review process for usage-based or variable billing.

Billing Agent

Turn sales contracts into subscriptions or invoices within your billing systems, including Stripe, NetSuite, and Sage Intacct.

Payment Portal

Create a frictionless self-serve process for customers by enabling them to view and pay invoices, as well as update billing information.

Credit Agent

Obtain credit reports from credit agencies, update information in your ERP, and set credit limits or holds.

Payment Dispute Agent

Track the status of invoices in accounts payable portals or emails and respond to payment disputes without needing to step in.

Onboarding Agent

Leverage customer onboarding forms to fill out billing details that sync with your ERP system, including NetSuite and SAP.

“With Fazeshift, we were able to custom-build our existing process into an automated software."

Agents integrate seamlessly with your existing systems

Leverage data from your ERP, CRM, billing, email, bank, internal communications, internal data, and portal systems.

The security-first AI platform

Security is built into every layer of Fazeshift. From SOC 2 Type II compliance to AI Zero-Data Retention Agreements and advanced encryption, your financial data stays private, protected, and under your control.

SOC 1 & 2 Type II compliant

Fazeshift is SOC 1 & 2 Type II certified by an independent auditor for the highest standards in security, availability, and confidentiality. Our controls are continuously monitored and tested to safeguard your financial data.

Single Sign-On (SSO) capability

Seamlessly connect Fazeshift with your organization’s identity provider. Our SSO support simplifies authentication, strengthens security, and ensures your team accesses Fazeshift through trusted enterprise credentials.

Advanced user-level permissions

Granular access controls keep sensitive financial information protected. Define who can view, edit, or approve within your Fazeshift workspace, ensuring every user has the right access.

GDPR compliant

name: X-Zell
brief:
Product: X-Zell
One-liner: Early, pain-free cancer detection.
Description: X-ZELL™ is a global start-up specialising in rare cell detection technology. Backed by Y Combinator and various high-profile angel investors from around the globe – among them Gmail creator Paul Buchheit – X-ZELL™ has developed a world-first platform technology capable of isolating and visualizing rare and abnormal cells such as Circulating Endothelial Cells (CEC).
Industry: Healthcare / Diagnostics
Tags: Medical Devices
target:
From limited cytology samples to multiplex digital insight.

X-ZELL advances cytology by connecting direct-to-slide cryofixation, multiplex cryoimmunostaining, and hybrid microscopy into data-rich workflows for minimally invasive samples.

No-obligation enquiry · Typical response within one business day

Regulatory note : X-ZELL's Cryosuite platform, Cryophore™ multiplex panels, and reagents are CE-marked under the EU In Vitro Diagnostic Regulation (IVDR).

A connected platform for next-generation cytology.

Cryofixation, staining, digital review, panels, antibodies, and reagent capability work together to help laboratories extract more useful information from limited cytology material.

Cryosuite Platform

Cryofixator™ and Cryostainer™ instruments enabling direct-to-slide cryofixation and automated multiplex immunostaining for cytology specimens.

Cryophore Multiplex Panels

Pleural fluid, ascitic fluid, and tumour-origin support panels designed for multiplex cytopathology workflows.

Verified Antibodies

Multiplex-ready antibodies, fluorophore conjugates, custom conjugation, and verification services for assay developers.

Reagents & OEM

Buffers, staining, and fixation reagents — and ISO 13485-certified Thailand-based OEM manufacturing for distributors and IVD partners.

From specimen to multi-channel image.

A platform workflow for cytology material: sample preparation, cryofixation, multiplex staining, digitization, and interpretation.

Specimen

FNA, pleural/ascitic fluid, brush, or LBC specimens collected via standard clinical protocols.

Cryofixator™

Direct-to-slide cryofixation preserves antigen integrity and avoids multi-hour formalin exposure.

Cryostainer™

Automated multiplex immunostaining with the Cryophore antibody panel of choice.

Imaging

Whole-slide multichannel acquisition at preserved spatial registration.

Interpretation

Cytopathologist review of multi-channel signature with optional AI-assisted cell identification.

Built around fluid cytology, FNA, and brush specimens — preserving epitopes for multiplex immunofluorescence on a single slide.

Multiplex panels designed for cytology.

Cryophore panels combine epithelial, leukocyte, mesothelial, organ-associated, and lineage-supporting markers — engineered for fluid cytology and FNA workflows.

Cryophore Pleural Fluid 1

GATA3 · Calretinin · TTF1 · CD326/EpCAM · CD45 · p40 · Synaptophysin

Cryophore Pleural Fluid 3

NKX3.1 · Calretinin · TTF1 · CD326/EpCAM · CD45 · p40 · Synaptophysin

Cryophore Ascitic Fluid

PAX8 · SATB2 · CK19 · CD326/EpCAM · CD45 · Calretinin · CK7

Antibodies built for multiplex confidence.

Validation-driven antibody portfolio with multiplex compatibility data, fluorophore conjugates, and custom conjugation services for assay developers.

Multiplex-Ready

Compatibility-tested combinations for spectral imaging and high-plex panels.

Fluorophore Conjugates

Pre-conjugated antibodies across common fluorophore palettes for multiplex IF.

Custom Conjugation

Conjugation services with QC documentation for development programmes.

Verification Services

Independent antibody verification on cell lines and cytology specimens.

ISO 13485-certified manufacturing in Thailand.

Buffers, staining and fixation reagents — manufactured under ISO 13485 in Thailand and available for OEM, private-label, and tender supply across South-East Asia.

Buffers & Diluents

name: Mesmer
brief:
Product: Mesmer
One-liner: The operating system for the 100x Engineering Team
Description: Mesmer is the operating system for agentic engineering teams. A few engineering teams are accelerating at breakneck speed, while most are stuck with incremental gains. Mesmer exists so that gap doesn't come down to who gets lucky with their AI experiments. We help founders and CTOs turn agents into real leverage across their organization: faster delivery, better quality, less bureaucracy, and a clear view of where the bottlenecks are and what to do next.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, SaaS, Productivity, Team Collaboration, AI
target:
Agents alone won’t make your team faster. Mesmer will.

Keeping your eng team state of the art is a full time job, we do it for you.

We find the bottleneck. We fix it. We do it again.

Every month

Mesmer maps your work to identify the largest bottleneck.

Our team implements fixes directly in your codebase.

You get faster, we remeasure, and tackle the next.

The Agentic Harness for Your Engineering Org

Skip the iteration

Reaching the top 1% takes months of iteration. By then the target has moved. We get you there this month.

Bottlenecks based on actual work

We read your code and tickets to see how work really moves, then rank every bottleneck by what it’s costing you.

Our engineers ship it

Our engineers open the pull requests themselves, in your repos, against your review standards. You greenlight each change.

Every stage, green .

This is what your pipeline looks like once it is running.

01 / 07 · In your tracker

Agents plan with full visibility, and know when to ask for help .

Your engineers make the business calls, and the agents never guess at them.

4 blocking questions

Leading teams use Mesmer

Rohlik Group’s AI efforts weren’t compounding. We connected to their data, found why, and put the fixes in place.

Measured over 5 months

One of our founders owns your results

Your account is owned by someone who can put our engineers on your problem this week.

This makes your lift about an hour a month, to learn what’s going on and greenlight fixes.

And you can talk to the person doing the work. In your Slack, same day.

Who you work with

We connect to everything

Mesmer plugs into every tool your team already lives in, and reads it as one picture of how your org really works.

Not on the list? It still connects. Anything with an API, a webhook, or an MCP server is in scope.

Deploy with confidence

Your data stays yours. No training. SOC 2 Type II. Clear access boundaries.

Your source code is never retained

We read it, measure it, and keep only the measurements.

Your data is never used to train Mesmer.

We’ve blocked every LLM provider we use from training on it too.

SOC 2 Type II Certified

Opalite is available instantly, 24/7, and replaces traditional interpretation services with software that’s more reliable and saves millions of dollars per year.

name: Congruent
brief:
Product: Congruent
One-liner: AI native radars for self-driving cars
Description: At Congruent, we build radars for end-to-end autonomous systems. The most advanced autonomous systems are trained as a single neural network from raw sensor data to navigation actions. For a sensor to be included in these pipelines sensor stacks requires two key properties: access to raw sensor data and a high-fidelity sensor simulator. Current automotive radars have neither, they output heavily processed point clouds and no raw radar simulator exists for driving scenes.
Industry: Industrials
target:
THE ONLY RADAR FOR END-TO-END AUTONOMY

Train with raw radar data, real or synthetic. Our radar connects to your vehicle and your world model through its digital-twin. Create infinite scenes, test edge cases, and evaluate closed-loop.

We use your details to respond to your request. Formspree processes the submission for us. Please do not include sensitive personal information. See our Privacy Policy .

Congruent , the only radar with raw data, real or synthetic.

The Paradigm Shift: End-to-end Training

Record real data.

Augment the scene in your world model.

Get synthetic raw data.

Congruent , the only radar with a generative simulator. that integrates with your world model. for end-to-end autonomy.

TEAM

Clement Barthes, PhD, Founder, CEO

Clement holds a doctorate in Structural Mechanics from UC Berkeley. Throughout his career, he has specialized in developing advanced sensor systems for automotive and structural health monitoring, integrated with sophisticated machine learning algorithms.

Evan Scope Crafts, PhD, Founding ML Scientist

Evan Scope Crafts earned his doctorate in computational science, engineering, and mathematics from UT-Austin in 2026. In his doctoral work, he developed principled methods for incorporating diffusion-based generative models into scientific inference problems.

name: Operate — A CRM designed for sales, built for founders
brief:
Product: Operate — A CRM designed for sales, built for founders
Description: Not Yet Another Sales Tool™. Operate is a precision-built tool designed to cut through the noise. Smart defaults 🎯, fast workflows ⚡, zero fluff 🚫.
target:
A CRM designed for sales, built for founders.

Let’s be real. As a founder, sales can feel less like a process and more like a black box. Or maybe a black hole? Whatever you call it— it’s dark. And for something that feels so opaque, sales tooling doesn’t seem to shed much light. ˖ ࣪ ⊹ ࣪ ˖

This is why we’re building Operate.

THE CRM YOU DIDN’T KNOW YOU NEEDED

Operate enters the picture at the moment when you are trying to wrangle the chaos of one-off sales. (Which is fine, by the way. Every founder starts there). But maybe you’ve been wondering:

“How did that introduction turn into a conversation? How’d that conversation turn into a sale?”

When you look back on them, these things can feel like magic (or, worse, like luck). With Operate, you’ll have the context you need to keep things on track, avoid unforced errors, and celebrate every win .

Momentum Matters

You crushed the intro call! Feels good, right? But...now what?

Hot take: most sales tools aren’t made for closing (let alone speed). They’re bloated Swiss Army Knives, promising to “do it all.” Operate isn’t that. We’re building a precision tool to take you from qualified to closed. Less guesswork, more signal. ✄ (Tiny, ineffective scissors not included.)

The team is leaning in especially with their FY2026 goals around operational efficiency

Open to Feedback

Every founder knows the script: talk to users, build product, repeat. ꩜

With Operate, Customer Feedback is a first-class object next to Deals, Companies, and People. Track upvotes, tie requests to revenue, and make sure you’re building what customers actually want (not what you scribbled down at 1 am ).

Because feedback isn’t just “nice to have.” It’s your cheat code.

Fast, Not Furious

If the best day at work is one where you make a sale, the second best day is when something took half the time you expected.

A CRM should feel like that. Light, fast, frictionless. Most tools bury you in clicks and drop-downs. We built one that gets out of your way so you can focus on what actually matters—moving deals forward.

TEAM OPERATE

We’re builders who care about the details. A few things about us:

We contain multitudes. Inspiration outside of work fuels the things we build.

WAITLIST

Request Early Access

brief:
Product: shortkit
One-liner: Media infra for consumer apps
Description: ShortKit lets any consumer app launch a TikTok-grade media expereinces. Michael, spent 6 years at YouTube building the infrastructure that powers YouTube Shorts. Neil, prev. scaled a SaaS company from 0 to $6M ARR as employee #1. We handle the full media stack, starting with short form video - client SDKs, video infrastructure, rec systems, and monetization - so product teams don't have to.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
target:
Short-form video systems that scale.

The SDK for vertical video, powered by enterprise-grade video infrastructure optimized for short-form content.

Are you a publisher? Check out ShortKit for News →

Integrate in minutes.

We obsess over every detail of short-form client architecture so you don't have to. Read the docs →

Optimized for short-form video

Feed-aware player mechanics

Player architecture designed for smooth, fast-swiping between videos with zero jank.

Next-gen codec support

Device-aware codec selection cutting delivered bytes by 2–3x on capable devices.

ML-driven buffer management

Dynamic pre-fetching and pre-buffering based on watch history and network conditions.

Long-tail network optimization

Video systems designed to support users on mobile data, not just wifi.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure.

Purpose-built for fast, reliable short-form delivery at any scale.

Transcoding & Delivery

Every upload is automatically transcoded into an adaptive bitrate HLS ladder and delivered through a global CDN. Your users get the best quality their connection supports, on any device.

Serverless & Auto-scaling

The shortkit platform runs on serverless compute that scales to zero when idle and handles traffic spikes automatically. No capacity planning, no infrastructure management on your end.

Chunked Transfer Encoding

Video delivered in precisely managed chunks for immediate decoding and rendering. Lower perceived load times and faster first-frame delivery across every connection type.

A complete video platform.

[ INTEGRATIONS ]

Integrations & APIs

ShortKit meets you where your content is. Pull from your existing CMS programmatically or push content through our REST APIs.

[ MONETIZATION ]

Ad Integration & Monetization

Native ad integrations built into your feed. Monetize without disrupting the viewing experience or rebuilding your ad pipeline.

[ ANALYTICS ]

Engagement Analytics

Every play, swipe, completion, and replay captured automatically. Watch time, drop-off points, rebuffer rates, and quality changes — understand how your audience interacts with every piece of content.

[ CONTENT ]

Content Management

Transform long-form video into short-form clips. Automated transcoding, thumbnail generation, and AI captioning in 50+ languages — your full content pipeline from ingest to delivery.

[ SUBMISSIONS ]

Content Submissions

Support participant and contributor submissions at any scale. Built-in auto moderation keeps feed quality high — whether you're running a marketplace, a newsroom, or anything in between.

Get started with shortkit.

Schedule a technical walkthrough with our team.

Next-gen codec support

Device-aware codec selection cutting delivered bytes by 2–3x on capable devices.

ML-driven buffer management

Dynamic pre-fetching and pre-buffering based on watch history and network conditions.

Long-tail network optimization

Video systems designed to support users on mobile data, not just wifi.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure.

Purpose-built for fast, reliable short-form delivery at any scale.

Transcoding & Delivery

Every upload is automatically transcoded into an adaptive bitrate HLS ladder and delivered through a global CDN. Your users get the best quality their connection supports, on any device.

Serverless & Auto-scaling

The shortkit platform runs on serverless compute that scales to zero when idle and handles traffic spikes automatically. No capacity planning, no infrastructure management on your end.

Chunked Transfer Encoding

Video delivered in precisely managed chunks for immediate decoding and rendering. Lower perceived load times and faster first-frame delivery across every connection type.

A complete video platform.

Integrations & APIs

ShortKit meets you where your content is. Pull from your existing CMS programmatically or push content through our REST APIs.

[ MONETIZATION ]

Ad Integration & Monetization

Native ad integrations built into your feed. Monetize without disrupting the viewing experience or rebuilding your ad pipeline.

[ ANALYTICS ]

Engagement Analytics

Every play, swipe, completion, and replay captured automatically. Watch time, drop-off points, rebuffer rates, and quality changes — understand how your audience interacts with every piece of content.

[ CONTENT ]

Content Management

Transform long-form video into short-form clips. Automated transcoding, thumbnail generation, and AI captioning in 50+ languages — your full content pipeline from ingest to delivery.

[ SUBMISSIONS ]

Content Submissions

Support participant and contributor submissions at any scale. Built-in auto moderation keeps feed quality high — whether you're running a marketplace, a newsroom, or anything in between.

name: Instant
brief:
Product: Instant
One-liner: The best backend for AI-coded apps

Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools
target:
The best backend for AI-coded apps

Give your AI a real backend. You get auth, permissions, storage, presence, and streams — everything you need to ship apps your users will love.

Backed by the best

Built for AI

Get a backend designed to be operated from the CLI. Your agent can do everything a human can do with a dashboard, and when things go wrong, undo is built in.

Never leave your terminal

Create an account, spin up a database, push schema, and build from the terminal. No dashboards. No clicking through UIs. Just you, your agent, and your code.

Easy for humans, perfect for LLMs

Instant has a tiny API surface. Modern LLMs already know it from their training data. And it takes only 1% of context for advanced features.

Here's what a real-time chat app looks like with Instant. Simple to read, and even easier for your AI to understand and generate.

End-to-end type safety

Instant comes with types for your schema, permissions, queries, and transactions. This makes it easy to catch errors early. Your AI can understand your data model and generate correct code on the first try.

Undo destructive changes

LLMs can make mistakes. For destructive actions like schema deletions, Instant comes with built-in undo. Restore deleted columns instantly.

Startups love Instant

Some of the best developers have bet their infrastructure on Instant. They do it because it helps them move fast and focus on wowing their users.

Batteries included

As your app grows, you start needing more services. Instant comes with a bunch of the fundamental ones built-in, and they're designed to work well together.

Auth

Magic Code emails, Sign in with Google, Apple, GitHub, and LinkedIn are all built-in with your app. Agents can set these methods up in minutes and they're extendable too.

Sign in

Permissions

Inspired from Google's Zanzibar and Facebook's EntPrivacy, get a permission system that lets you write both simple and complicated rules.

Storage

You don't need a separate service to upload images and videos. Storage lets you upload files, and they feel like any other row in your database.

Payments

Build apps that monetize. Easily add one-time purchases, subscriptions, or usage-based billing by telling AI to add Stripe to your Instant app.

Presence

Make your apps feel alive. You can use Presence and Broadcast services to share who's online, who's typing, or whose cursor is moving.

Streams

brief:
Product: Medplum
One-liner: API first electronic health record (EHR) that is open source
Description: Medplum makes it easy to build healthcare webapps that are compliant and interoperability ready. Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare IT
Tags: Developer Tools, Open Source, Healthcare
target:
Build and run modern healthcare apps

Medplum is the open source developer platform for shipping clinical software. Start with our production-ready apps, then customize them to fit your needs.

Trusted by Healthcare Leaders & Innovators

A platform built for healthcare complexity

Build what you need—without rebuilding the foundation. Medplum provides the core primitives required to ship and operate healthcare software in production.

API-first

Integrate with any partner, anywhere, in any way with data share options in a variety of formats.

FHIR-native

Anticipate nuances and avoid costly re-writes down the line with default FHIR-standard formatted data storage.

Automation-ready

Streamline your operations and automate any workflow to activate, track, manage, and measure tasks of any level of complexity.

Open Source

Medplum's core technology is open source (Apache 2.0 license) and freely available in GitHub, so there’s never a risk of vendor lock-in.

Secure & Compliant

Comes with HIPAA and SOC2 compliance out of the box, follows all OWASP security guidelines, and is verified by multiple penetration tests.

Scalable

From MVP to IPO—and every major milestone in between—Medplum’s technology backs you up and grows with you.

Solutions for all scopes and scales

Medplum powers a wide range of applications on a single, standards-based platform—giving your team the flexibility to ship and evolve your end-to-end care model.

Connect to the healthcare ecosystem

Medplum connects to common external systems while letting you build custom integrations when you need them.

Labs

Orders, results, and workflows that fit real operations.

Medications

Medication workflows and integrations designed for clinical safety.

Billing & RCM

Integrate financial workflows without duct-taping your system.

Health Exchange

Support data exchange patterns used in real-world interoperability.

Plugins & Modules

Third-party Tools

Connect CRMs, scheduling, imaging, and specialty systems.

Trusted infrastructure, to meet any future you build

Medplum lets your team skip the plumbing and ship what matters, getting you to market faster with a secure, compliant, and scalable foundation.

Operational reliability for mission-critical healthcare, backed by our enterprise SLA.

Handling massive scale with consistent performance across the platform.

Powering over 120 million custom workflow actions designed for your requirements.

From startups to enterprises, Medplum facilitates care for over 20 million patients.

Founders, directors, and developers on why they build with Medplum.

name: Egoist Machines
brief:
Product: Egoist Machines
One-liner: Your personal context, securely portable across every AI app.
Description: Egoist Machines is building infrastructure for a world where your personal context belongs to you, rather than to the apps and AI companies you use. Today, every assistant and consumer app builds its own version of you. We think that architecture is backwards. Your context should live with you, persist across products, and be available to any model, app or agent you choose. AI Passport is the first layer of that infrastructure.
Industry: Consumer
Tags: Hardware, Personalization, Privacy, Consumer Products, AI Assistant
target:
Egoist AI Passport

Personal context layer for carrying your preferences, history, and identity across the AI apps you use.

Claim your handle and create your AI Passport: one memory layer for every AI you allow.

How Egoist AI Passport Works

MAKE IT ALL ABOUT YOU

Carry your preferences, work, relationships, and identity across AI applications without starting over every time. Private by default, free for life.

Juno Kade

Electronic producer bending broken rhythms and neon synths into late-night dance music. Based in Berlin, playing loud everywhere else.

David Khachaturov

Aspiring skater with a taste for cooking.

ERIN MCGURK

Erin Meryl McGurk

I love curiosity-maxxing! @erinmerylstudy online and found here at EGOIST Machines :)

Theo Marchetti

Essayist and longform writer working the seam between memory and place. I write slow pieces about cities, inheritance, and the small rituals that hold a life together.

On writing

I believe an essay is a way of thinking out loud until the thought becomes honest. I write to slow the world down, to hold a single hour up to the light and turn it over until it gives something back.

Selected Essays

FEED YOUR EGO

Want a public page too? You'll get a site at ego.ist/i/you where you can share your interests and links, and people can share things with you if you wish. Think of it as a better, free Linktree.

Send it essays, videos, links, and half-formed thoughts. Everything you feed it becomes part of an identity that travels with you.

Conversations with Tyler

Tyler Cowen's high-density interviews ranging across economics, culture, and the wonderfully specific.

TURN YOUR EGO INTO AN AI PASSPORT

So you never have to start from scratch

CONTROL WHAT APPS KNOW ABOUT YOU

Your EGO travels with you, and you decide exactly what every application gets to see.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Everything you need to know about your EGO and AI Passport.

It is a permission-based context and identity layer for AI. Instead of reintroducing yourself to every assistant and app, your passport carries verified context like your preferences, goals, and connected apps, and shares it only when you approve.

Only the slice you grant. An app asks for a pass to a specific category, you approve or deny it, and every access shows up in your receipts. You can cut an app off at any time.

name: Atlia
brief:
Product: Atlia
One-liner: The AI-native property management company for short-term rentals
Description: We use AI agents to manage short-term rental properties by running operations completely autonomously. We cut traditional human management fees in half so owners take home 20% to 30% more revenue. And we operate with near-zero boots-on-the-ground so we can scale nationwide with software margins and at venture speed in a traditionally physical industry.
Industry: Real Estate and Construction / Housing and Real Estate
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Real Estate, Proptech, Big Data, AI
target:
Premium Short-Term Property Management

We manage your short-term rentals end to end for a flat 10% fee. And we do it very well.

Atlia is your full-service property manager

Atlia handles guests, cleaners, maintenance, pricing, owner reporting, and day-to-day decisions with experienced operators supervising the system.

You stay informed while Atlia takes the daily operational work off your plate.

Hosting is a weekly operating job.

Atlia coordinates guest communication, pricing, turnovers, maintenance, supplies, and property-specific decisions so owners do not have to manage every stay themselves.

flat management fee

staffed operations in Fort Lauderdale and San Diego

Who Atlia is for

Atlia is for short-term rental owners who want lower management fees and better guest operations without becoming full-time property managers themselves.

Local operators

A real operator stays close to your home and coordinates guests, vendors, and urgent property issues.

Owner control

Clear approvals, transparent reporting, and a flat fee keep the model simple.

Property memory

House rules, vendors, calendars, pricing, and operating details stay in context for every booking.

Common things owners ask us

What is Atlia?

Atlia is a premium full-service property management company for short-term rental owners. We combine professional STR management expertise and AI software to run bookings, guests, pricing, and day-to-day coordination.

How long does onboarding take?

After reviewing the property, listing status, access, and operating needs, Atlia provides a property-specific setup and onboarding timeline.

Does Atlia replace my existing tools?

Atlia can work around the tools owners already use, then consolidate workflows where it improves speed, quality, and visibility.

What kinds of properties are a fit?

We are focused on residential short-term rentals, especially owners who want professional operations without traditional 20-35% management fee scenarios.

How is Atlia priced?

Atlia manages short-term rentals for a flat 10% fee, designed to be materially lower than traditional percentage-based management models while keeping the owner experience professional.

Professional full-service STR management, rebuilt around owners.

Great hospitality should not require a dozen tools, constant coordination, or traditional management fees.

Product: Edviro
One-liner: AI That Operates Energy Infrastructure
Description: Edviro builds AI that operates energy infrastructure. We connect to meters, HVAC systems, batteries, solar, and other energy equipment and continuously handle the work required to keep them efficient: detecting and diagnosing problems to forecasting demand, simulating fixes, creating work orders, coordinating maintenance, and controlling equipment where authorized.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Deep Learning, B2B, Energy
target:
Find building problems. Get them fixed.

AI-powered facilities operations for schools

Energy, diagnostics, work orders, assets, and capital planning—connected from first signal to verified fix.

Use Edviro directly or connect your existing CMMS.

One platform. Five jobs.

Monitor energy

Track use, cost, and waste.

Diagnose problems

Find the likely cause.

Manage work orders

Assign, track, and verify.

Maintain assets

Keep history with the equipment.

Plan capital

Turn failures into priorities.

name: Heron
brief:
Product: Heron
One-liner: Underwriting automation for SMB finance
Description: Heron analyzes 60,000+ small businesses a day to make sure good deals reach your underwriters in minutes, and bad deals never do. We power underwriting across small business finance and insurance: MCA, term loans, SBA, and commercial insurance
Industry: Fintech
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Fintech, SaaS, B2B
target:
Deeper data, faster offers

“We really feel confident that when a deal makes it through the Heron process and we send out a yes, it's a high likelihood that it's an accurate approval. We can stand behind it.”

Nobody sees more of small business finance

Heron automates the hardest parts of small business underwriting based on patterns from analyzing a double-digit share of American businesses every year. You get speed, accuracy, and scale that scrubbers, BPOs, and DIY workflows can’t touch.

Give us the chaos. We give you decision-ready deals.

Give us the chaos. We give you underwriter-ready submissions.

Heron handles the full process from application to offer and delivers decision-ready deals to your CRM. Whether you’re processing ten subs a day or a thousand, Heron scales with you.

Heron handles the full process from application to quote and delivers underwriter-ready submissions to your PAS. Whether you’re processing ten subs a day or a thousand, Heron scales with you.

Emails come in as usual

Subs arrive just like they do now: forwarded emails, API, Portal, however you get your existing intake. No behavior change for your brokers, no new portal for your team.

Heron scrubs the deal

Heron scrubs the bank statement

Heron extracts submission details

Heron parses and verifies bank statements, applications, and external data. No-hopers and kickouts get flagged early. Stips are requested automatically. You get a full picture of the business while the file is still warm.

Heron parses and verifies bank statements, extracting revenue positions and key data points. You get a full picture of the business while the file is still warm.

Heron parses and verifies supplementals, presentations, and loss history with kickouts getting flagged early. You get a full picture of the business while the opportunity is still warm.

Your rules, your systems

Your rules, your decision

Heron declines junk and delivers decision-ready deals to the systems your team uses.

Decision-ready risks land in your PAS in minutes, not hours. The system prioritizes the best risks based on your rules, so your underwriters work the deals worth quoting.

Deliver the right deals to the right lenders

Each deal is matched to best-fit lenders based on your criteria and lenders’ rules. Deliver deals however lenders want them—via API, email, or portals, with no manual work.

This is an approval for $95,000 Tier 3 and 12 months term. $3,750.00 to ABC inc.

Thank you

Get decisions back directly to your CRM
