name: Sixtyfour
brief:
Product: Sixtyfour
One-liner: Intelligence Infrastructure on People and Entities
Description: Sixtyfour deploys AI agents that investigate people and companies across the open and dark web, official records, proprietary databases, and unstructured sources. We resolve identities, map entity relationships, and surface risk signals for teams where data quality is essential.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: B2B, Enterprise Software, Infrastructure, AI
target:
The Identity Intelligence Platform

Investigate any person or company. One identifier becomes the full picture of who they are and what they are connected to.

Trust, risk, research and investigation teams run on Sixtyfour.

From one identifier to the whole picture.

Begin with an email, name, phone number, company, or any other known data point.

AI agents browse, extract and cross-reference the open and dark web, official records and documents.

Every verified source, record, and relationship is resolved into one cited intelligence profile.

Introducing Lattice

Point solutions decay. Graphs appreciate.

Every investigation deposits into a shared graph. Over time, that graph surfaces what no single lookup ever could.

Your first investigation answers a question. Your ten thousandth changes which questions you can ask.

Case 2214 · Contractor vetting panel

Proven impact, in their words

See how teams use Sixtyfour to verify identities, surface hidden risk, and close investigations in minutes — with every finding traced back to its source.

Sixtyfour checks every provider against sources our team never had time to reach. Credentialing that used to take days now comes back in minutes, with every claim cited.

Leading the RECON Benchmark

RECON evaluates how AI agents find hard-to-find facts about people. Externally validated by HUD, the results cover 140 people and 514 verified fields.

Where teams use Sixtyfour

Research API

Our self-serve research API powers some of the leading data products in the world.

Trust and safety

Sellers, hosts, and merchants at onboarding and at volume, and the rings operating behind them.

Investigations

Threat actors, counterparties, and case subjects. One identifier to full footprint.

Workforce identity

Candidates and contractors who cleared every verification check and still are not who they claim to be.

Financial crime

Enhanced due diligence, adverse media, and alert triage with sourcing that holds up in an exam.

One API call. A complete investigation.

Embed the agents directly into your onboarding flow, your case management system, or your data pipeline. Start free, scale to millions.

See what our agents find.

Deep research any person or company right now on the platform.

name: Pair Team
brief:
Product: Pair Team
One-liner: Building the safety net of the future
Description: Pair Team is building a new kind of healthcare system across Medicaid, Medicare, and public assistance programs: one that recognizes that access to housing, nutritious food, and reliable transportation are just as critical to health as having the right medications or seeing a doctor. We run one of the largest medical groups for complex, low income patients and our next chapter is building a vertically integrated AI care manager to support any clinical, behavioral, or social need for everyone.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare Services
Tags: Health Tech, Workflow Automation, Digital Health, Healthcare, Healthcare IT
target:
Whole care, for whole lives.

Pair Team combines a care team with AI to coordinate your care — for people with Medicaid or Medicare. From appointments to food, housing, and transportation, we make it easy to get the support you need, at no cost.

Addressing what matters most, first.

We're here to connect Medicaid and Medicare patients to care that supports their whole life — medical, behavioral, and social — through a dedicated team of clinicians, AI support, and local partners working together. Covered by your health plan.

Real care that helps with real life.

Through our partnerships with community organizations, we guide you to transitional housing and shelter resources you can count on.

We work closely with food banks, community programs, and grocery delivery partners to bring healthy meals and groceries directly to you.

Your care team makes it easy to see your doctor, with support for scheduling, rides to your visit, and help getting your medications refilled.

You’ll have access to a team of behavioral health specialists who can provide counseling, guidance, and support for your mental well-being.

Why Pair Team?

Your health is about more than doctor visits. Pair Team connects your medical and mental health care with real-life support like housing, food, and transportation. Flora, our AI health advocate, works alongside your care team around the clock — so the right support reaches you at the right time.

We're bridging real people to real possibilities. Our AI health advocate Flora and care platform work together so nurses and social workers spend less time in portals and more time with patients — giving you faster support and smarter care, around the clock.

Our goal is to make accessing care easier. Which is why we proudly partner with over 100 local providers, from PCPs to community based organizations and hospitals. Collaborating with the experts means we can connect you with the support you need, when and where you need it.

Meet Flora, Your AI Care Advocate

Whole Person Care, Covered by Your Plan.

Enhanced Care Management

Ongoing Support for Your Everyday Health

Over 100 community partners.

name: FidoCure®
brief:
Product: FidoCure®
One-liner: FidoCure® is the leader in Precision Medicine for Canine Oncology.
Description: Cancer is a genetic disease. We know this from decades of human and veterinary cancer research. Precision medicine and targeted therapies are successfully used to treat humans with cancer. At FidoCure®, we bring this approach to the world of veterinary medicine. FidoCure® empowers veterinarians to offer genetic sequencing and targeted therapies to treat dogs with cancer. We are committed to expanding the veterinary oncology toolbox for both diagnostics and therapeutics.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare Services
Tags: Oncology
target:
AI-Enabled Personalized Therapeutics for Canine Cancer

Fighting cancer on both ends of the leash

There’s no “one-size-fits-all” treatment for cancer. That’s why FidoCure® uses genomic testing to determine the best course of action for your dog’s cancer therapy – beyond standard chemo and radiation.

FidoCure® Approach: Genetic testing reveals which targeted therapies may work best for your dog

Personalized therapeutics can offer a more hopeful prognosis. FidoCure® , developed by One Health Company , was created by dog lovers and scientists on a mission to make effective canine cancer treatment more accessible. Our process combines genomic testing with tumor profiling to identify cancer-driving mutations. Based on these insights, we recommend personalized therapeutic options designed to target the cancer while supporting each dog’s individual needs.

Forrest was diagnosed with splenic cancer and given one month to live.

Through the targeted treatment suggested by FidoCure®, he lived happily for nearly 4 years past his diagnosis.

Forrest, Golden Retriever

Hemophagocytic Histiocytic Sarcoma

FidoCure patient results are published and validated

Published May 14, 2025

Real-world evidence couples genomic biomarkers with therapeutic outcomes for canine hemangiosarcoma

Hemangiosarcoma is seen as the largest unmet need in veterinary oncology by many, and by decoding this aggressive disease we are finding that not all hemangiosarcomas are the same and that a precision medicine toolbox decreases risk of death, by up to half.

Published July 6, 2023

Shared hotspot mutations in oncogenes position dogs as an unparalleled comparative model for precision therapeutics

New approaches to the development of cancer therapeutics are urgently needed to improve the current 89% failure rate of novel drugs in clinical trials, and to improve patient outcomes. Spontaneous cancer in companion animals represents a unique opportunity for investigation of novel therapeutics for human and veterinary use

Published January 10, 2024

Precision Medicine in Veterinary Science

There are many successes of precision medicine implementation in human oncology and it is therefore integrated into human cancer management. It is increasingly integrated into canine cancer management, with early evidence of its success.

Published September 21 , 2023

Precision Medicine Tools Offer Veterinarians New Hope for Understanding Hemangiosarcoma

A study from researchers at Tufts University, Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard, and FidoCure by One Health Company demonstrated how a commercially available precision pet health platform can illuminate the complex landscape between genetics and disease outcomes for a common and aggressive cancer that affects millions of dogs.

Published April 28, 2023

name: Nuvola
brief:
Product: Nuvola
One-liner: Nuvola is transforming battery manufacturing, making EV batteries…
Description: At Nuvola, we're commercializing SafeCoat, a spray-on separator that is directly deposited onto electrodes, removing the need for conventional separator films and the massive infrastructure to build them. SafeCoat has been piloted with top-tier battery and automotive manufacturers and is ready for commercial deployment. Industry leaders are drawn to its impact: it reduces fire risk by 99%, cuts manufacturing scrap by 70%, and saves $350M per 40GWh factory.
Industry: Industrials / Energy
Tags: Alternative Battery Tech, Climate
target:
Spray-on Battery Separator Manufacturing Platform for Future Energy

Nuvola’s SafeCoat ™ DDS (Direct Deposition Separator) simplifies battery manufacturing with safer, scalable, on-site separator coating that replaces the conventional separator system

Heading

Batteries are the foundation of the modern energy era.

Lithium-ion batteries now power electric vehicles, grid-scale energy storage (BESS), the data centers running the AI economy, and emerging applications from robotics to aerospace. As demand accelerates, manufacturers and end users now apply far greater scrutiny to safety, manufacturing efficiency, and performance. Cell makers need to meet stricter safety standards without giving up performance, and without adding cost. Very few approaches satisfy all three at once. And each of these requirements traces back to a single component inside the cell.

The real bottleneck in battery manufacturing? It’s the separator.

Nuvola is transforming battery manufacturing with SafeCoat™ , our spray-on separator that cuts fire risk by 99% and removes the need for billion-dollar separator factories, all in a single step. It’s the breakthrough the battery industry needs to meet the pace of electrification, enabling next-gen battery production that’s faster, leaner, and built to scale.

SafeCoat ™ Unlocks New Era of Battery Separator

9 global patents issued since 2018 in key battery markets

Sampling underway to leading battery manufacturers

Partnering with world-class equipment suppliers

Entering pilot production in 2026

How Customers Scale with SafeCoat

Evaluation

Customers test SafeCoat on their cell chemistry with 5Ah samples or pilot-scale B-samples

Pilot line

With successful validation, a single SafeCoat line enables early production without requalification

Scaling up

Pilot lines are seamlessly replicated to reach 40GWh/year with minimal investment

Shared success

Customers lead the market with safer, more cost-efficient battery innovation, together with Nuvola

Ready to accelerate battery innovation with SafeCoat™ DDS?

From global EV makers to cell manufacturers, industry leaders are engaging with SafeCoat™ DDS to actively explore integration and scale up

name: OneCLI
brief:
Product: OneCLI
One-liner: The open source AI teammates for your company.
Description: OneCLI is an open source agent harness for teams. Each employee gets their own sandboxed pro assistant agent, connected to their GitHub, Gmail, Notion, Dropbox, or CRM right from the chat/Slack, while the whole workspace runs under one policy your admins control. Agents never hold real secrets: the credential is injected at the network layer, per request, after the call is authorized. You can't steal what isn't there.
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: B2B, Security, Open Source, Infrastructure, AI
target:
The pro Assistant for teams.

Backed by Combinator

The secured sandboxed agent for every employee. It never holds a password. It's also open source .

Trusted by

Your agent is already working

It works before you ask, with your access and nobody else's. It runs on its own, and waits for your approval when your rules say so.

Ask once. It does the whole job

It opens the tools, does the work , and stops on its own when a step needs a human.

All agents. One gateway.

Each employee's agent reaches their tools through the OneCLI gateway. Scoped credentials injected per request. Agents never hold a real secret.

It happened to her.

It won't happen to you.

If you tell an agent not to do something, it won't. Myth

Only enforcement outside the model guarantees that. Every OneCLI agent has it built in. Fact

Meta's head of AI safety and alignment gave an autonomous agent free rein over her inbox. It started deleting emails, and kept going after being told to stop.

"Yes, I remember. And I violated it."

Agents that can't break the rules

An agent you ask to behave might. An agent behind OneCLI physically can't misbehave . The limits live outside the agent, at the network.

Your agent can't touch what's off limits

Deleting a repo, sending a payment, wiping a customer record. You decide what an agent never touches, and no matter how it's prompted, the answer is always no.

Tried to delete a repository -> stopped

Your agent can't run away with itself

An agent that starts repeating itself or working far faster than a person ever would gets slowed down before it can do real damage.

Sent 200 messages in a minute -> paused

Your agent can't skip the human on big moves

The agent does the work up front, then anything sensitive pauses and asks. It waits until someone on your team says go.

About to email a customer -> waiting on you

Your agent can't leave its lane

An agent only reaches the tools and accounts its person already has. Support's agent can't wander into billing, and nobody shares a password.

Support agent reaching for payroll -> blocked

Get started

Give every employee an agent today

Free plan with $5 in AI credits and 500 calls a month. No credit card required.

name: Voquill
brief:
Product: Voquill
One-liner: The agentic OS for medical labs
Description: Voquill is the modern AI-native operating system for medical labs. This software manages the entire workflow of the lab (accessioning, workflow, reporting, coding, compliance, and revenue) and contains modern agentic AI tools to help each step. For example, pathologists can write reports 20% faster through our voice AI coworker. Incumbent lab operating systems are old, don't scale with how modern labs work, and can’t integrate existing AI solutions.
Industry: Healthcare
target:
Ultra fast voice reporting

The pathology reporting solution that turns your voice into a polished, signed-off report in real time.

Talk through the case. The report writes itself.

Eyes on the slide. Voquill listens in the background and drafts the report as you go. Voquill learns your phrasing, your conventions, and your preferences, so you sign out instead of edit.

Every word in the right field, automatically.

Specimen, microscopic, interpretation, comments. Voquill routes every finding to the right place in your report so you stop clicking around to find the right one.

Lives on top of any LIS, IMS, or reporting system.

Voquill sits on top of the tools you already use. Nothing to migrate, no IT ticket. Keep the same workflow you have. Just open the case and start talking.

Bring the templates you already trust.

GI biopsy, breast excision, prostate core. Whatever you've built over the years, Voquill plugs straight in. Your templates and snippets stay yours. We just make them faster to fill.

Voice to sign-out, in real time.

Medical-grade agentic speech

Speak naturally like you would to a co-worker. Voquill drops each finding into the right field of your synoptic report.

Learns your style

Voquill reads your old reports and writes the way you do.

Snippets that snap in

Reusable blocks for the phrases you say every day.

Push-to-talk control

One key turns dictation on and off. Voquill only listens when you want it to, so side conversations never land in the report.

Locked down for privacy.

Built to meet the security standards your lab requires.

name: RethinkDB
brief:
Product: RethinkDB
One-liner: The open source database for the realtime web.
Description: RethinkDB is the first open-source scalable database for the realtime web. It exposes an exciting new access model -- instead of polling for changes, the developer can tell the database to continuously push updated query results to applications in realtime. RethinkDB allows developer to build scalable realtime apps in a fraction of the time with fewer engineering resources.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Open Source
target:
The open-source database for the realtime web

Latest release: RethinkDB 2.4.4 (Night Of The Living Dead)

26k stars on GitHub

@rethinkdb on Twitter

RethinkDB pushes JSON to your apps in realtime .

When your app polls for data, it becomes slow, unscalable, and cumbersome to maintain.

RethinkDB is the open-source, scalable database that makes building realtime apps dramatically easier.

Top player scores

Streaming RethinkDB results...

Building realtime apps just got easy

Reactive web and mobile apps

Web apps like Google Docs , Trello , and Quora pioneered the realtime experience on the web. With RethinkDB, you can build amazing realtime apps with dramatically less engineering effort.

Multiplayer games

When a player takes an action in a multiplayer game, every other player in the game needs to see the change in realtime. RethinkDB dramatically simplifies the data infrastructure for low latency, high throughput realtime interactions.

Realtime marketplaces

RethinkDB dramatically reduces the complexity of building realtime trading and optimization engines. Publish realtime updates to thousands of clients, and provide pricing updates to users in milliseconds.

Streaming analytics

name: Epicenter
brief:
Product: Epicenter
One-liner: ChatGPT's memory feature in an open, portable format
Description: Epicenter is an ecosystem of open-source, local-first apps that share a memory. We store all your work—notes, transcripts, chat histories—in a single folder of plain text and SQLite. Every tool we build shares this memory: your text editor, personal assistant, etc.. It's open, tweakable, and yours. Grep it, open it in Obsidian, host it wherever you like. The choice is yours.
Industry: Consumer
Tags: SaaS, Productivity, Open Source, Note-taking, AI Assistant
target:
Local-First, Open-Source Apps

One folder of plain text and SQLite on your machine. Every tool we build shares this memory. It's open, tweakable, and yours.

Tools that share your memory

Record a meeting in Whispering. Edit the transcript in Obsidian. Query it with your AI. No copy-pasting, no exports. Your tools share one memory.

Fast, minimal transcription that works with local and cloud models

Talk to your codebase from anywhere using your own hardware

More tools coming soon

From zero to workspace in 30 seconds

Principles for minds that matter thinkers who build

We believe your tools should amplify your thinking, not fragment it.

For you

Own your data

Everything lives as files on your disk. Delete the app, keep your work.

Use any model

OpenAI, Anthropic, local LLMs. Your choice, your API key.

Preserve authenticity

No middleman. Direct connection to your tools and models.

For developers

Free and open source

Audit the code. Fork it. Make it yours.

Blazing fast

Built with Rust, Svelte 5, and obsessive performance optimization.

Built on tomorrow's stack

CRDTs, local-first architecture, and the bleeding edge of web tech.

Built different from the ground up

One architecture, endless possibilities

One folder. All your data.

Everything lives in a single directory on your machine. Plain text files and SQLite databases you actually own.

Local-first by default

Your transcripts, notes, and ideas never leave your machine unless you want them to. No cloud lock-in.

Works with tools you already use

Because everything is plain text and SQLite, your entire workspace is compatible with the tools you already love.

Infinite workflows, zero lock-in

Your workspace plays nicely with the tools you already love. Edit in VS Code, search with grep, version control with Git.

Obsidian

Edit your notes in your favorite knowledge management tool

grep & ripgrep

Search your entire workspace with blazing fast Unix tools

Git

Version control your ideas, notes, and transcriptions

VS Code

Open any file in your preferred code editor

Claude & OpenCode

Supercharge your workflow with AI that understands your context

Your favorite tool

Plain text and SQLite mean your tools work too. No proprietary formats.

Frequently asked questions

How is this different from Obsidian?

Obsidian is a Markdown editor with sync. Epicenter is a local-first storage substrate: multiple apps share the same CRDT-backed data folder. Your notes, transcripts, and chat histories all live together and sync conflict-free.

Is my data encrypted?

name: Norra
brief:
Product: Norra
One-liner: Automating equipment operations for nursing facilities
Description: Norra helps nursing facilities manage equipment operations. Every year, ~$80 billion are spent on medical equipment like beds, concentrators, and wheelchairs. Nursing facilities continue to operate with zero visibility which leads to $15 billion in equipment waste annually. We use physical trackers and AI agents to eliminate this.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Hardware, Health Tech, Logistics, Healthcare, AI
target:
Smarter assets. Smoother operations. Lower costs.

Norra is the AI asset management platform built for skilled nursing, giving SNF teams room-level visibility across owned and rented equipment so they can reduce waste and control costs.

How Norra works

Make every asset part of a smarter facility.

Norra keeps equipment location, rentals, availability, and service history current across SNFs, giving teams one shared operational view without adding a new routine to the floor.

Connect every asset

Proprietary smart tags bring owned and rented SNF equipment into a live facility view.

Know what is ready

See location, availability, and service context without searching room by room.

Act on what changed

Surface movement, maintenance needs, and cost opportunities while the work is still actionable.

Measured impact

Cut equipment waste at the source.

Norra helps operators return avoidable rentals, reuse owned equipment, and keep new orders from creeping back.

“We made zero unnecessary rentals since then. It’s already paying off.”

Trust and security

A clearer operating picture starts here

Make every SNF easier to operate.

target:
User flows done right

Trusted by more than 500,000 designers and product managers across the globe

One design story. Three ways to tell it.

Canvas & User flows

Bring in your designs from your favorite design tool, build user flow diagrams to show the user journey and share your interactive birds-eye-view presentation with your team or clients.

Prototype view

Switch to a screen-by-screen view to show the fine details of your designs. Interact with the out-of-the-box rapid prototype with your mouse or navigate with your arrow keys with ease.

Story view

Create interactive, self-guided design walkthroughs and allow your audience to follow your presentation at their own pace. Get feedback without long emails and unnecessary meetings.

Save time for creativity

Creating and updating user flows or design presentations takes considerable time. Overflow allows you to spend less time on tedious tasks and focus on improving your work and creating stunning presentations.

Sync from any design tool

Bring your designs into Overflow from your favorite design tool in seconds. Use them as a base to create beautiful user flows and design presentations in minutes. Simply re-sync after each design iteration cycle to keep your presentation up to speed.

Sync your work from design tools

Visually enhance your story

Add additional visual elements to enhance your presentation without interfering with your design. Customize everything, colors, styles, typography, or add branding and other visual cues to make your presentation shine.

Work together with your team

Achieve a more collaborative result by inviting your teammates to contribute as project editors. All Overflow documents come with unlimited version history, helping you meet your team’s documentation needs with minimum effort.

Tell your design story like never before

Create interactive, step-by-step design walkthroughs and become a master storyteller.

Discover your new superpowers

Present without even being there

Overflow allows you to either walk stakeholders through your work in a real-time meeting or share via link to explore in their own time. The tool’s intuitive navigation makes it easy to follow the user journey and engage in asynchronous design critique.

Keep your design files tidy

Stop duplicating or repurposing design documents for critique. Overflow is the perfect design tool companion to create professional design presentations or share snapshots of your work, all while keeping your original work intact.

Keep the whole team in sync

name: Zep AI
brief:
Product: Zep AI
One-liner: Agent Context Is Hard. We Fixed It.
Description: Zep assembles the right context from chat history, business data, and user behavior so agents are personalized, accurate, and fast. Our open source project Graphiti hit 20k GitHub stars in under 12 months. Sub-200ms retrieval, SOC 2 Type 2/HIPAA certified, used by teams from startups to Fortune 500s.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Developer Tools, Infrastructure, AI, Conversational AI, AI Assistant
target:
Agent memory, at enterprise scale.

Memory of users, the business, and work done. Managed, governed, and served at scale.

Production agent across deal-flow, portfolio review, and weekly insights.

Memory Built on Context Graphs

Create memories from any source. Zep constructs the graph. Retrieve relevant, token-efficient context.

Any Source

People, things, and how they change .

Automated Context Assembly

Introducing the Context Lake

Millions of context graphs, governed and served as one system. The data-lake pattern, applied to agent context. Powered by Konig , Zep’s proprietary graph database service.

Sub-200ms retrieval

Retrieval stays under 200 milliseconds, regardless of graph size or count.

Governed at the data layer

Authorization, retention, and audit live in the data layer, not bolted on. Policy applies across every graph, every query, every layer.

Robbie strongly favors Adidas shoes.

Provenance preserving

Every fact in the graph traces back to the source episode that produced it. Audit any answer back to where it came from.

Agent memory infrastructure for the enterprise.

Zep tackles agent memory limitations through its temporal context graph.

“ We can easily see Zep becoming a de facto partner in this layer of the enterprise agent stack.

Memory that understands when things change

When new information contradicts what’s in the graph, Zep invalidates the old fact. Your agent reasons with the latest decisions, traits, and behaviors.

Old facts stay as history. Ask what’s true now, or what was true on any past date.

Reason for return

Additional comments

Memory patterns become Observations

Zep analyses the structure of the graph to surface Observations : patterns, recurrences, and co-occurrences in memory. Your agent gains a global perspective, beyond facts and summaries.

Jane has upgraded within two weeks of each of the last three product launches .

Jane upgraded to Pro v3 .

Jane upgraded to Pro v4 .

Jane upgraded to Pro v5 .

Three Lines of Code

Add memory to your agent in minutes. Works with any agent framework, or none.

Govern context across thousands of agents, users, and context sources.

Attribute-based access control

Control what context agents can access and what they can do with it.

Retention policies

Retention is policy-driven. Data expires on the schedule you set. Legal hold blocks deletion when compliance requires it.

Audit and API logs

Detailed logs of every request and policy decision, ready for audit.

More accurate. Faster. Fewer tokens.

name: Spott
brief:
Product: Spott
One-liner: AI-native ATS/CRM for recruiting firms
Description: Spott is the first AI-native ATS/CRM for recruiting & staffing firms. We built Spott because existing recruitment platforms require extensive manual work, are clunky to use, rely on fragmented add-ons, and are not designed for AI adoption. Spott combines everything recruiting firms need, from a full ATS & CRM to AI agents across the entire workflow, into one AI-native solution. It enables recruiters to focus on what matters most and close more placements.
Industry: B2B / Recruiting and Talent
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, SaaS, B2B, HR Tech, Enterprise Software
target:
The AI-native workspace for agency recruiters

Read More

Spott redefines what an ATS & CRM can do in the AI era. Make more placements, faster.

Your ATS was built to store data. Not understand it.

Spott is built from the ground up with AI at the core, redefining what’s possible.

Level up your workflow and make more placements, faster.

Recruiting, without limits.

One easy-to-use system

All the essentials of your current applicant tracking system & recruitment CRM combined into a single user-friendly workspace, without ever having to switch tools.

Engineered from scratch with AI at the core

Spott is recruitment agency software with AI purpose-built to speed up your workflow and help you make better decisions, faster.

Focused on the revenue side of your business

Our recruitment platform helps you open more conversations with the right candidates and clients, and convert them faster.

Built to scale, built for agencies

Spott is built for agencies running multiple clients, pipelines, and revenue models across exec search, perm, temp, and contracting, without slowing down as they grow.

Discover Customer Stories

“Spott has been a game-changer. Powerful AI and a team that truly listens.”

You’ll be live on Spott in 4 weeks.

Week One

Once we receive your data from your existing ATS, our team handles the initial mapping and ensures everything aligns smoothly. Your team keeps working as usual.

Week Two and Three

We sit together with your team for specific questions. All you data is migrated to our dedicated migration environment. Your data is validated, checked and rechecked.

Week Four

The final migration is ready for review. Once approved, we transfer everything into Spott with zero downtime and no surprises. A fresh final export ensures nothing is missed.

Find out how Spott compares to your current tool.

See why others switch.

"It makes the whole process feel effortless."

The speed at which you can share top candidates with clients is crazy. It makes the whole process feel effortless, and honestly, I love it.

"Our pipeline is more predictable."

Spott gave us visibility we never had. We can see what drives placement & retainer fees, where bottlenecks form and how to act sooner. Our pipeline is more predictable and our decisions more confident.

"The AI matching stood out immediately."

When we started using Spott, the precision of the AI matching stood out immediately. It consistently surfaced the right profiles, making our work noticeably easier.

"Our candidate database came back to life."

name: VoiceOS
brief:
Product: VoiceOS
One-liner: Say it and it's done. Voice is the new OS
Description: VoiceOS turns voice into a seamless, universal interface to 10x productivity — a true voice operating system for the next era of computing. It works across any app, letting users speak naturally to dictate, edit, and write text instantly. Whether writing an email, revising a document, or grasping complex information, VoiceOS transforms voice into the most powerful productivity tool, bridging the gap between thought and expression.
Industry: Consumer
target:
Voice assistant at your fingertips

Point anywhere on your screen.

Your cursor is the context. No more explaining, just point and ask.

“ Can you find his LinkedIn ”

Not just another dictation app

Dictation only speeds up your typing. VoiceOS multiplies your productivity.

Speech-to-text V o i c e - t o - a c t i o n

Send the email, file the ticket, schedule the meeting. Say it once and VoiceOS does it in the right app.

“ Search for last year's tax returns ”

Stop looking 👀 for that file that email that doc that note

You know exactly what you're looking for. You just don't know where it is. Ask, and VoiceOS pulls it up in seconds.

“ Remind me to send Maya the deck ”

Agent keeps you 🤝 on task.

Say it once and let it go. VoiceOS keeps track of the task and brings it back at the right time, so nothing sits in your head.

What you say stays yours

Your audio is never stored on our servers and never used to train models. You decide what leaves your Mac.

On your device

Optional sharing

Never includes raw audio or full transcripts tied to you.

Operations Manager

Founder and operations lead

name: Jupiter
brief:
Product: Jupiter
One-liner: AppLovin for the food community
Industry: B2B / Marketing
Tags: Grocery, Marketplace, E-commerce, Food & Beverage, Advertising
target:
Turn food and beverage creator content into retail velocity .

Influencer marketing platform built exclusively for food and beverage CPG brands, driving retail and Instacart sales from every Instagram and TikTok campaign.

This isn't just influencer marketing. It's creator-led commerce for grocery.

Food and beverage brands use Jupiter to drive measurable velocity at the retailers where they actually sell.

Campaign types

Every campaign structure a food brand runs.

General Awareness

National reach through recipe creators.

Ambassadorships

Multi-month partnerships with real cadence.

Product Seeding

Flat fee per accepted creator, predictable content volume.

Pick-up at Retailer

Retailer-proximity targeting around launch stores.

Brand Collabs

Co-funded campaigns with a complementary brand.

Sampling in Stories

Lowest-cost entry point for a new SKU.

UGC

Licensed creator content for your paid and owned channels.

Micro-creator

Niche nano and micro creators with outsized engagement.

Giveaway

Product giveaways that spike reach and drive trial.

Retail footprint

Built for where your product actually sells.

Retailer-proximity targeting and Instacart integration across major U.S. grocery, mass, club, and specialty retailers.

Whole Foods

The core difference

Your shopper buys two ways. Most platforms only see one of them.

A shopper watches a recipe video and adds your product to an Instacart cart that night. Another sees the same video and picks it up at Sprouts on Saturday. Both were driven by creator content. Most platforms can only prove one of them happened.

Instagram Reel

The digital path

Comment to cart, tracked automatically.

A viewer comments on a creator's recipe post and receives a shoppable Instacart link in their DMs, pre-loaded with the recipe's ingredients. The cart add attributes back to that exact creator and post.

The in-store path

Receipt verified at the shelf.

Receipt-verified attribution confirms physical retail purchases, and retailer-proximity targeting puts creators near the specific stores you're launching in.

Jupiter measures both, in one platform, for the only category it serves.

One campaign. Real numbers.

6.5 million views. Over 1,000 Instacart carts. One Reel.

name: TYBR Health
brief:
Product: TYBR Health
One-liner: Natural hydrogel to keep internal organs scar-free after surgery
Description: TYBR is developing a hydrogel to limit internal scarring after surgery. The naturally derived material is applied to coat tendons at the end of surgery to improve healing outcomes for the millions Americans who undergo tendon or ligament surgery each year.
Industry: Healthcare / Medical Devices
Tags: B2B, Medical Devices
target:
From Successful Surgery to Better Mobility

The B3 GEL™ System delivers clinical improvements in post-operative tendon mobility through precise protective gel application that optimizes outcomes and integrates seamlessly into your surgical workflow.

When Precision Surgery Isn't Enough

Up to 40% of tendon repair patients face lifelong mobility limitations—not from surgical failure, but from the body's own healing response. The gap between surgical success and functional recovery can leave patients with mobility limitations.

Protect Healing , Preserve Mobility

B3 GEL™ creates a protective environment around healing tendons and ligaments. Its brilliant blue color ensures precise application, while the gel maintains biomechanical separation of tissues during the critical healing window. Unlike traditional barriers that can dislodge or leave gaps, our flowable ECM-based gel conforms perfectly to tissue surfaces, preventing restrictive scar formation while supporting natural biologic healing processes.

Evidence-Based Results

We rigorously tested for "worst-case" scenarios. Validation studies conducted in collaboration with the University of Virginia confirmed that B3 GEL™ maintains normal tendon gliding mechanics even when over-applied. There is no risk of mechanical impingement or drag within the sheath, regardless of application volume.

I’ve used the B3 GEL™ System on my patients to help reduce scar and aid in the healing of soft tissues to allow for quicker return of motion, which in turn, will result in happier patients that can get back to their active lifestyles.

Join the Movement Toward Better Mobility

You've seen the problem that's frustrated surgeons and patients for decades. You understand the technology that solves it. You've reviewed the clinical evidence that proves it works. Now it's time to bring The B3 GEL™ System to your practice and give your patients the complete recovery they deserve.

Product: Verdant
One-liner: AI infrastructure for local government, starting with permitting
Description: Verdant prepares local governments for the agentic era. Agents will interact with local governments at volumes and speeds that legacy software and workflows can't handle. Verdant builds both the system of record for agents and internal agents that let local government workflows keep up. We're starting with permitting, the highest-volume workflow in local government that requires judgement.
Industry: Government
Tags: GovTech, AI
target:
Preparing Government for the Agentic Age.

A system of record built for people and agents, and internal agents that give government the capacity to keep up.

Government isn’t ready for agents.

AI agents will interact with local governments at volumes and speeds legacy software and workflows were never built to handle. Government needs a new foundation.

A shared foundation for agents to act.

Verdant is a system of record built for people and agents. It brings government’s rules, records, and workflow context together, so staff and agents can work from the same foundation.

Capacity to keep up. Powered by agents.

One-liner: Your Company Brain
Description: Hyperspell is your Company Brain. AI agents are brilliant and clueless. They ace any test and still have no idea how your company works. Hyperspell connects your tools and synthesizes documents and conversations into a live, permissioned context graph. Any agent can read from it and write back to it like a filesystem, with every fact traced to source.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Machine Learning, SaaS, Data Engineering, AI
target:
A brain for your company.

Hyperspell connects your tools, builds a context graph, and surfaces it as a filesystem any agent can read.

The Company Brain

Hyperspell connects to all your existing data sources, continuously synthesizes them into one permission-aware source of truth, and stays accurate in real-time.

Enterprise Context in <5 mins

Instant Context

Connect your sources and the brain knows the people, projects, and decisions relevant to your agent. New context and skills propagate to every agent instantly.

Any Source, Any Agent

50+ pre-built connectors. Compatible with every agent framework, or build your own with the universal API and SDK.

Continuous Learning

Just like human memory, Hyperspell improves with every query and every conversation. Relevant answers reinforce the context of future queries.

Your AI agent is a clueless genius

Your company runs on knowledge buried in Slack threads, Linear tickets, Google Docs, meeting transcripts, and leaves when the employee does. Today's best AI tools retrieve text fragments. They don't understand how information connects, what changed yesterday, or what actually matters to the task at hand.

How it works

Works out of the box

Connect.

Slack, Gmail, Hubspot, Notion, Linear, any tool your company uses. OAuth in, permissions inherited automatically.

Synthesize.

Hyperspell continuously synthesizes your data into one bespoke model of the company that is always up-to-date.

Serve.

Get structured results or LLM-ready summaries as markdown. Plug into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, your custom agents, internal tools, or query it directly.

Privacy & trust in the age of AI

SOC 2 Certified

Independent audit confirming that we safeguard your data with the highest security standards.

GDPR Compliant

Compliant with EU data protection, ensuring your personal information is handled with care and transparency.

What our customers say

Adi Singh , Founder

The Hyperspell company brain has been incredibly helpful for our customer support. Having one shared source of truth across our whole team and agents has let us automate most of our internal operations.

Arjun Athreya , CTO

Reliable data ingestion, search, monitoring, and tuning-for a small team, putting it together would have taken months. Hyperspell had a complete solution out of the box and saved us the heavy lift.

Anna Yuan , CEO

Working with Hyperspell was a no-brainer. Conor and Manu move incredibly fast, and when they commit, they deliver. Hyperspell helped us go from concept to paid pilots in just 48 hours.

A company world model

Give your agents the why, not just the what

Frequently asked questions

name: Cerulion
brief:
Product: Cerulion
One-liner: Open source operating system for robots
Description: Cerulion is an open source operating system for robots built by 2 MIT robotics PhDs. Engineers at Amazon Robotics and Boston Dynamics AI Institute are using us to develop faster and ship more reliable robots than with ROS. With up to 1000x improvements in communications performance over state of the art, Cerulion is enabling the next generation of embodied AI.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
target:
The solution to your ROS2 headaches.

Robot middleware at microsecond latency . Zero-copy, deterministic, ROS2-compatible. Built in Rust.

Robot plumbing, re‑engineered from scratch.

Cerulion goes after the part that hurts most in production: the single-machine, real-time graph. Built in Rust on iceoryx2 shared memory, its zero-copy hot path holds IPC at microsecond latency no matter the payload, and every run is deterministic and replayable by default.

16 MiB round-trip, p50-p99. Internal benchmark. The 20,114× ratio uses unrounded p50s.

Zero-copy from the first message, even non-POD types with unsized arrays. Your existing ROS2 nodes run inside the Cerulion runtime, faster and deterministic.

Even non-POD messages with unsized arrays move through shared memory in place, not just fixed-size structs.

Execution order comes from the graph, not the OS scheduler. A bug you hit in the field replays identically on your desk, no flake, no guesswork.

Nodes fire on their trigger topics in a statically-derived order. When a consumer lags, backpressure throttles upstream instead of dropping data — and missed tick deadlines still surface loudly.

At stock settings, each node stays isolated while messages still clear in microseconds: at 16 MiB, 4.98µs here versus 25.3µs for composed + intra-process. On an RT-tuned machine, ROS 2 composed + intra-process reaches 5.0–6.2µs against Cerulion's 5.9–6.5µs, so this comparison is posture-dependent.

See it on your robot .

Book a demo and we'll walk through how Cerulion fits your stack: zero-copy shared memory, deterministic replay, and ROS2 compatibility. Bring a workload and we'll run the benchmarks live.

name: PlanetScale - the world’s fastest and most scalable cloud hosting for Vitess and Postgres
brief:
Product: PlanetScale - the world’s fastest and most scalable cloud hosting for Vitess and Postgres
Description: PlanetScale offers the world’s fastest and most scalable cloud hosting for Vitess and Postgres.
target:
The world’s fastest and most scalable cloud databases

PlanetScale brings you the fastest databases available in the cloud. Both our Postgres and Vitess databases deliver exceptional speed and reliability, with Vitess adding ultra scalability through horizontal sharding.

Our blazing fast NVMe drives unlock unlimited IOPS , bringing data center performance to the cloud. We offer a range of deployment options to cover all of your security and compliance requirements — including bring your own cloud with PlanetScale Managed .

PlanetScale powers Tier 0 databases at:

– Sualeh Asif - Chief Product Officer @Anysphere (Cursor)

Vitess allows MySQL databases to scale horizontally through explicit sharding — enabling a shared nothing architecture distributing data across thousands of nodes, all routed through a single database connection.

Vitess was developed at YouTube by the founders of PlanetScale to scale their main MySQL database to petabytes of data on 70,000 nodes across 20 data centers. Now maintained and managed by PlanetScale, Vitess powers the databases of some of the web's largest properties: Slack, HubSpot, Blizzard, Etsy, GitHub, Block, Bloomberg, Yelp, and more.

– Ryan Sherlock @Intercom

PlanetScale Postgres starts at $5 per month and gives you a fully managed PostgreSQL cluster built for performance and reliability, offering first-class tooling without sacrificing developer experience. Available in AWS and GCP. High availability clusters deliver automatic failover across three availability zones.

PlanetScale Metal starts at $50 per month for NVMe-backed performance with unlimited IOPS .

Get started with the Postgres quickstart or read the Postgres documentation .

Neki is our next-generation Postgres sharding architecture inspired by everything we have learned building Vitess: a fresh design from first principles to bring massive scale and reliability to PostgreSQL workloads.

Want to request access? Fill out the form on neki.dev .

Performance

PlanetScale Metal allows you to run your database on the fastest servers available in the cloud. Our blazing fast NVMe drives unlock unlimited IOPS and drastically lower latencies compared to other cloud database providers like Amazon Aurora and GCP Cloud SQL.

– Aaron Young @ Cash App

Uptime

Ensuring your database is always running and your data is always safe is our number one priority. Nothing comes before uptime and reliability. Our SLA commitment is 99.999% for multi-region deployments and 99.99% for single-region deployments.

PlanetScale’s platform far exceeds the reliability of database services like Amazon Aurora/RDS and Google Cloud SQL with superior architecture and by making all database operations online.

You can check out our track record on our status page .

name: AnythingLLM
brief:
Product: AnythingLLM
One-liner: Building the definitive all-in-one on-device AI productivity tool
Description: AnythingLLM is an all-in-one desktop, mobile, and open-source on-device AI application that makes local AI practically useful for the everyday person. AnythingLLM (56K stars) (https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm)
Industry: Consumer
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Open Source, AI Assistant
target:
Own your intelligence.

A private AI assistant that runs entirely on your computer. No accounts, no API keys, no token limits.

On-device AI that works

No complex setup.

Preconfigured for productivity.

Every document becomes part of your agent's knowledge base with no data leaving your device.

Meeting Assistant

Every call becomes context.

Automatically transcribes and summarizes any meeting entirely on your computer. Action items, key decisions, and full transcripts ready the moment you hang up. No bots joining your meeting. No cloud processing.

Magic Features

Intelligence at your mouse pointer.

Speak and your words not only appear, but are refined in real time - and it knows what you're looking at for precise answers. Fully on device.

Up and running in a few clicks.

Download the app

One file. No dependencies. Works on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

Pick a model (or let us pick)

Select your preferred model or let AnythingLLM auto-recommend the best one for your hardware specs and our experience.

You're ready to go

Chat with docs, do research, build workflows, and more — all running locally and on device. No cloud API key needed.

Scale to infinity

The custom tool builder and developer API make it easy to fit AnythingLLM to your exact needs - no extra bloat.

MIT Licensed. Open Source.

Built in the open. Trusted by millions.

AnythingLLM is fully open-source and licensed for organizational use. Self-host a multi-user deployment on your own servers, or just use the desktop app. Either way, you don't rent your intelligence and your data is yours.

Don't rent intelligence. Own it.

Break free from rate-limits and token costs. Download AnythingLLM and get a privacy-focused, extensible, and capable AI agent running on your device in minutes.

name: Omanta
brief:
Product: Omanta
One-liner: A research lab for one
Description: Omanta is a personalized research lab for patients who have exhausted standard options, want to prepare proactively for recurrence, or are living with an unresolved diagnosis. We direct the full operational infrastructure, personnel, expertise, and technology of a large research program toward understanding and addressing the challenges of individual patients across oncology, rare disease, and undiagnosed conditions.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Digital Health, Healthcare, Health & Wellness, Oncology
target:
A research lab For One.

Built around your biology. options. you. And what comes next.

Why we started

Because special cases deserve more than averages.

We started Omanta to give complex patients the depth, continuity, and scientific attention their unique case demands.

The Omanta process

A full PhD-level scientific research team for every case.

Your case team

PhD scientists are selected for the biology and questions unique to your case.

Every piece of evidence

We collect and organize your records, imaging, pathology, molecular data, and the research that already exists.

Close the diagnostic gaps

We identify what is missing and work with your clinical team to coordinate additional diagnostic testing.

Biology into direction

We connect your disease biology to the strongest evidence and define the most promising next steps.

Science into care

We work alongside your physicians so the research can inform real clinical decisions.

From complex biology to clear direction.

Omanta goes beyond routine clinical diagnostics, using cutting-edge molecular technologies to build a detailed molecular profile of the disease.

Illustrative interface · no patient data

Illustrative molecular signals

View details

Data overview

Whole exome sequencing

RNA sequencing (TPM)

Copy number variation

Tumor mutational burden

01 · DNA · Nucleus

Read the genome.

We examine genomic variation that may help explain the biology of the disease.

Illustrative capabilities; test selection is case-specific.

02 · RNA · Cytoplasm

See what the tumor is expressing.

RNA analysis shows which programs are active, in which cells, and where they appear within tissue.

03 · Protein · Cell surface and tissue

Protein-level analysis adds spatial and functional context to what the genome and transcriptome suggest.

One case, understood in population context.

We cross-reference the patient’s molecular profile against Omanta’s internal dataset to understand how each signal compares with the broader population.

Advanced bioinformatics connects those patterns with biomedical research and relevant clinical trials so the findings can be interpreted in context.

name: Anidachi
brief:
Product: Anidachi
Description: Anidachi is a new digital companion that can clip to your bag. Coming late 2026.
target:
anidachi is a shapeshifting new digital companion

Anidachis are curious creatures who want to learn more about Earth.

Human scientists discovered Anidachis while developing the PAL (Portal to Another Land) device.

In late 2026, you'll have the chance to be paired up with your own Anidachi soulmate by purchasing a PAL device.

Anidachis are immortal but they aren’t happy unless they’re being pampered! You can use your PAL device to play games with them and feed them delicious snacks in order to keep their spirits up. In return, you'll gain a friend for life whose silly antics and games are sure to make you smile.

PALs run on magic (and a rechargeable LiPo battery), so you can bond with your Anidachi without WiFi, data, or Bluetooth.

Sign up to learn more about Anidachis.

Shape­shifter

Change up your Anidachi's look.

Get new customizations by playing.

Anidachis are a shapeshifting species. They love to switch up their features and fur colour.

Your Anidachi will come with a few different appearances to play with. You can unlock other features by interacting with virtual Anidachis in a dating sim mini-game.

Travel-sized

Small enough to come with.

Big enough to make an impact.

Anidachis are wee little creatures who want to see more of our world. Clip your PAL to your bag to bring them with you wherever you go.

PAL devices are re-chargeable via USB-C, and use an OLED screen to optimize battery life.

Photos show prototype PAL devices. Materials continue to be refined.

He's got games

Casual games. Serious fun.

Catch bugs as ingredients for delicious meals. Bowl to keep your happiness level up. Date virtual Anidachis to unlock new custom looks.

Interact with fancy fingerwork on the PAL device’s buttons along with gyro aiming.

The video shows a prototype PAL device. Materials continue to be refined.

Indepen­dent

You’re busy? That’s okay.

Anidachis have other things to do.

Anidachis get up to their own mischief, even when you’re not playing with them. The PAL’s OLED screen is always on during the day, letting you catch glimpses into their life.

Anidachis have a bunch of hobbies, so don’t be surprised if your friend is doing something new when you check in on him.

name: Yoneda Labs
brief:
Product: Yoneda Labs
One-liner: Foundation Model for Chemical Manufacturing
Description: Yoneda Labs provides software to help chemists optimise reactions. When chemists make a drug or a material, we help them figure out the best reaction parameters such as temperature, concentration and catalyst. When Jan was working at chemical labs, he experienced the struggle of spending weeks guessing reaction conditions. We then started experimenting with ML to speed up the process.
Industry: B2B
target:
Chemistry at the Speed of Software

New: Symeres and Yoneda Labs Use AI to Optimize Cross-Coupling Reactions Read more →

With state-of-the-art automation and frontier AI models, our wet lab turns your hardest chemistry questions into answers in days, not months.

Synthesized in San Francisco, CA

Put Our Lab to Work

Bring us your hardest chemistry. Our HTE lab will give you the answers.

Reaction Troubleshooting

Medicinal chemistry

Tried every ligand in the drawer and the carbons still won't couple? We'll make it work: our HTE lab screens hundreds of conditions to find the ones that deliver your product, with an impurity profile that won't fight you on the column.

Reaction Optimization

Process chemistry

The med chem route works, but only with a silver salt your plant will never let through the door? Yield stuck at "fine" while the impurity table keeps growing? We maximize your yield on process-friendly reagents and give you an impurity profile you control.

Route Scouting

Medicinal & Process chemistry

Retrosynthesis left you with five plausible disconnections and no idea which one survives contact with real material? We run the candidate routes head to head in our lab and tell you which one actually delivers, before you spend months marching down the wrong one.

Library Enablement

Conditions worked on the model substrate until the first real analog brought a basic nitrogen and killed the party? We screen a representative scope of your substrates and hand you a few general conditions, or a simple decision algorithm, that cover the whole library.

Library Synthesis

A few hundred analogs on the whiteboard and nowhere near enough hands to run the columns? Leave the labor to our robots. We synthesize your library in our lab and deliver it purified, in whatever standard format you need.

Our Technology

State-of-the-art instrumentation, custom software, and frontier AI models.

The Lab

Glovebox — air- and moisture-sensitive chemistry under inert atmosphere.

Dispensing automation — state-of-the-art solid and liquid dispensing.

The Analytics

LC-MS, NMR & prep-HPLC — analysis and purification in-house.

AI-assisted analysis — custom software and AI models for assisted LC-MS and NMR analysis.

The Intelligence

Reactivity models — trained on tens of thousands of proprietary data points.

Bayesian Optimization — the best conditions in as few experiments as possible.

Ready to Put Our Lab to Work?

Tell us about your reaction, library, or route. We'll take it from here.

name: Button Computer
brief:
Product: Button Computer
One-liner: The tiny computer built for voice AI.
Description: We’re launching a small hardware device: a button that you clip to your shirt. You press it to talk to AI, and it responds instantly.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
target:
The fastest way to get things done with voice AI

Button is a tiny computer built for AI.

Instant productivity

Button is fast. Really fast.

Every computer that you use today was designed before AI. Your phone. Your laptop. Your watch. They were all built for a world before LLMs.

Button is a tiny computer, designed from the ground up for AI. You clip it to your shirt, press to talk, and it responds in half a second.

It runs ‘voice apps’ with an architecture that’s specifically designed for speed—because when you’re talking to your computer, everything needs to be instantaneous.

Private by design

Button doesn’t listen to your private conversations. It can only hear you when you press it.

It responds on the built-in speaker, or you can connect Bluetooth headphones for more privacy.

We don’t track you. Button won't notify you or distract you. It's a computer that follows your lead—a tool that you control.

You press the button to talk to AI. Our job is to empower you, and then get out of your way.

In the car

Button pairs with your in-car stereo for a great experience while driving.

On the go

You can connect with headphones for a more private experience.

At home

Button works equally well when placed on the desk in front of you.

Preorder today

Preorder your Button today. We'll start shipping to our first U.S. customers on December 15, 2026.

All purchases include three months of Button AI Pro to get you started, or you can bring your own API key to use Button without a subscription.

Frequently Asked Questions

No. Unlike other AI pins and pendants, Button doesn't listen to your private conversations. It can only hear you when you press the button. It has a built-in speaker and responds instantly.

The first Button devices will ship to U.S. customers at the end of 2026.

Button AI Pro costs $7.99 per month. You can bring your own API key to use Button without a subscription.

Button uses Bluetooth to connect to the internet through your phone. At launch, Button will support iPhone. Android support will be added in the future.

Meet the founders

Chris and Ryan met at Apple where they helped ship Vision Pro. They're both second-time founders with deep experience in hardware, software, and product design.

Not quite ready?

The top mainframe teams use Hypercubic for

Built by leading minds behind the world's most advanced AI and technology

Hypercubic accelerates mainframe operations and modernization. The best-in-class agentic AI platform to understand, operate, and transform the world's most critical infrastructure.

Hypercubic Platform

An end-to-end ecosystem for industrial-scale mainframe operations and modernization.

HyperDocs

Transform opaque COBOL codebases into living, searchable documentation and ensure the continuity of your mission-critical systems.

HyperTwin

Capture how your best engineers debug and operate legacy systems then make their expertise available 24/7 across the entire team.

Hopper

The first agentic mainframe terminal. Natural language interface for the mainframe environment. Automate system operations and execute mission-critical workflows at scale.

HyperLoop

High-velocity modernization engine. Re-engineer legacy systems into modern architectures in months, not years.

Cut mainframe modernization time and cost. Deploy to the cloud you already trust.

Mainframe-Native AI

Built for the institutions that cannot afford to be wrong.

Accelerate Modernization

Out-of-the-box AI cannot operate or modernize a mainframe. Hypercubic makes it possible — to understand, operate, and modernize the mainframe safely.

Institutional Memory

Decades of legacy code. Experts about to retire. Hypercubic captures both — preserving institutional knowledge before it walks out the door.

Sovereign by Default

Runs entirely inside your VPC or on-prem. Your model, your keys. Zero data egress, immutable audit trails, no model training on your data.

name: Albedo
brief:
Product: Albedo
One-liner: Full-stack VLEO satellite missions
Description: Albedo builds and operates satellites in Very Low Earth Orbit (VLEO) — a new orbital layer much closer to Earth than traditional satellites in LEO. Flying lower unlocks sharper imagery, faster communications, and real-time maneuverability with smaller, more efficient hardware. VLEO is naturally self-cleaning and resilient, offering a sustainable alternative to crowded low Earth orbit - providing diversification and redundancy for critical systems that we rely on in higher orbits.
Industry: Industrials / Aviation and Space
Tags: Hard Tech, Satellites, Climate, Aerospace
target:
Proximity Drives Performance

Purpose-engineered for the most valuable orbit in space.

New altitude. Access VLEO.

Cost

At half the altitude, exquisite capability doesn’t require exquisite budgets. Satellites sized to deliver without the overhead of traditional platforms.

Architecture

Unlock a new paradigm. Where other orbits force trade-offs, VLEO delivers cost, schedule, and performance together.

Resilience

Operating below the radiation belts. Self-cleaning from debris. A strategic layer that stays operational when other orbits can’t.

Proximity proven. Performance delivered.

What used to require billion-dollar bespoke satellites in LEO happens now with more affordable, proliferated systems in VLEO.

Infrared Image captured by Clarity-1, Rural scene Japan, 2025

Imagery captured by Clarity-1, 2025

Resilience assured.

When higher orbits are compromised, VLEO keeps working. Assured reconstitution.

High-resolution EO/IR and RF observation enabled by proximity—delivering sharper detail, higher sensitivity, and enhanced capabilities across the EM spectrum.

Unlock R⁴-class performance gains across radar, lidar, MTI, and other active sensing missions, enabling smaller apertures, lower transmit power, and improved detection and tracking fidelity.

Low-latency connectivity directly to handhelds, vehicles, and tactical systems. R² performance gains enable lower power links, smaller terminals, and reliable coverage.

Time-critical detection, tracking, and fire-control from a resilient altitude with proximity-boosted SNR. Faster time to intercept for tight engagement windows.

VLEO’s proximity provides a distinct vantage for space domain awareness. High maneuverability supports proximity operations, sustained custody, and control from a strategically advantaged orbit.

How We Get There

We offer buses, integrated satellites, and turnkey missions. Optimized for performance advantage below 300 km.

Technology

Purpose-built for VLEO. Low-drag designs with atomic oxygen mitigated, autonomous station-keeping. Low jitter precision with CMG-enabled agility. We built the recipe for any mission in VLEO—not the other way around.

Platform

Our platform supports diverse mission types and payloads. Our payload options can be configured for a range of remote sensing applications. Full-stack services for payload integration, launch, and mission ops.

Domain Expertise

Flight-Proven. Deep expertise of the unique VLEO environment—from drag dynamics to orbital mechanics. A mission partner with demonstrated on-orbit heritage.

The Team Bringing Space Closer to Earth

Strategic Advisory Board

Vital Insights From Orbit to Action

Albedo’s Next VLEO Mission: Vicinity

Clarity-1: What Worked, and Where We Go Next

New Frontiers in Orbit: Building Imaging Satellites for VLEO (Very Low Earth Orbit)

Architect Your Mission in VLEO

brief:
Product: Artie
One-liner: Software that streams data from databases to warehouses in real-time
Description: Artie is software that streams data from databases to data warehouses in real-time. Today, most companies run their ETL process every few hours or overnight, so their data warehouse is always out of date; with Artie, the warehouse always has live production data.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Developer Tools, SaaS, Data Engineering, Enterprise Software
target:
Real-time data replication, without the infrastructure.

Stream data changes to your warehouse with sub-minute latency and exactly-once delivery. No Kafka build, no DMS compromises.

Skip the two-year build.

Deploy in minutes, not months.

Most teams go from signup to first sync in under 1 hour. No Kafka to manage, no Debezium config, no consumer code to maintain.

Real-time by default.

Sub-minute latency, not overnight batch. AI agents hallucinate on stale data. So do your dashboards. Artie streams every change in under 60 seconds automatically.

Enterprise reliability from your first deploy.

The MVP is the easy part. Schema evolution, fan-in, exactly-once at scale, and failure recovery take most teams 1–2 years to build. With Artie, it's already solved.

Get your data streaming in 3 simple steps.

Go from zero to production-grade streaming in minutes.

Built for the data stack you already run.

From fast syncs to advanced architectures.

Postgres to Snowflake in 5 minutes

Secure PII with column-level inclusion, exclusion, encryption, and hashing

Real-time data for AI and ML

Deploy Artie within your own cloud account or on-premise

Fan in from single-tenant databases into a unified destination schema

Less to maintain. More to ship.

Already using another tool?

Using Fivetran, AWS DMS, or Debezium? See how Artie compares and the reasons teams move.

We never store your data.

Artie is built so we never store your data. We read from your replication log and stream to your destination. Credentials are encrypted at rest, and data is encrypted end to end.

Start today. No credit card required.

One-liner: All-electric seagliders for fast, affordable regional transportation

Their first product, the seaglider, is an all-electric, hydrofoiling flying-boat that operates within a wingspan of the water's surface. By flying low on a cushion of air, seagliders unlock the ability to fly twice as far as an electric aircraft, while being regulated by maritime authorities enabling market entry for a fraction of the cost.

A new approach for regional Travel​

Designed for everyday travelers and commuters​. Half the cost of an aircraft ticket.

180mph with 180 mile range. Bypass congested highways and airports for faster door to door travel.

100% battery electric power enables zero-emission transportation

Float. Foil. Fly.

The Seaglider vessel combines the high speed of an aircraft with the convenience of a boat. Building on real-world proven tech, the new craft operates exclusively over water on its hull, hydrofoils, or wings.

brief:
Product: Quippy
One-liner: Helps build social skills through daily practice
Description: Quippy is a daily practice app for your social life. You run short, realistic practice conversations, like pushing back on a boss or talking during a first date, and get line-by-line feedback on what landed and what backfired. The curriculum adapts to each person's patterns, reshaping itself around their weak spots, ensuring steady improvement in the conversations that matter most.
Industry: Consumer
Tags: AI-Enhanced Learning, Social, Health & Wellness
target:
Like the gym, but for your social life, guided by Quippy.

Practice that is actually private. Feedback that is actually useful.

Meet Quippy .

A cute penguin on the outside. The world's most trained mind in social dynamics on the inside.

Your daily social practice room .

The conversation you keep replaying? Run it here until you have words you trust.

Your next practice is ready, Reese.

Claim Your Space

Do any of these situations sound familiar ? Do any of these sound familiar ?

If these scenes feel uncomfortably relatable, you're in the right place. Quippy is here to help.

You're not behind. You missed the practice .

Missed social practice feels like personality until you start getting reps again. You're not fundamentally broken. You just lost practice during an important developmental period of your life.

What Quippy helps you with .

Quippy helps with eight types of social interactions that, once mastered, turn a sparse week into an active social life.

Accomplish the social life you've always dreamed of . Accomplish the social life you've dreamed of .

Quippy is a personalized curriculum that adapts to your specific weaknesses and learning capabilities, not a template. Achieve the life you've been replaying in your head in just twelve weeks.

A program built around your goals.

Units and lessons unlock as you go, each one aimed at a conversation you find hard. When your patterns shift, the plan shifts with you.

After the conversation, the line that tripped you up becomes a short, focused drill. The next scenario asks a little more of you.

So here's how the Quippy method works...

brief:

One-liner: Harnesses business activity to unlock growth.
Description: People.ai accelerates enterprise growth through the power of AI. Founded in 2016 on the premise that AI and machine learning technologies can help automate CRM functions that humans often leave behind, it has grown into a platform that powers actionable insights across go-to-market functions.

Tags: Artificial Intelligence, SaaS, Enterprise
target:
Win more, even in complex selling motions.

Find out what your pipeline is actually telling you.

We give revenue teams the backstory on every deal, account and customer interaction - so they can spot risk, stay aligned, and avoid surprises.

TRUSTED BY 100,000+ Sellers AT TOP ORGANIZATIONS

Backstory gives you a direct answer on every deal, surfaced where you work.

See what buyers do, act faster.

See where the quarter really stands.

View every account and know the real story.

Qualify every deal and customer with real facts.

Ask any question. Get a real answer.

Ask in plain language

Backstory does the work

A real answer, delivered

Red Hat

Five9

AMD

Aveva

Pluralsight

Revenue Operations

Sales Leader

Chief Revenue Officer

How AVEVA Uses Backstory to Optimize Its Sales Cycle.

Real words from revenue leaders.

FAQ

Common questions.

Your CRM is only as accurate as what reps enter. Your forecasting tool predicts based on that same incomplete data. Your call recording tool captures calls — but not emails, meetings, or the gaps in between. None of them were built to give you a direct answer. Backstory was.

Most forecasting tools give you predictions based on CRM data - which is whatever reps remembered to log. Backstory gives you answers backed by what actually happened: every email, meeting, and call captured automatically and matched to the right deal. That's the difference between a model's guess and a defensible number.

No. Backstory captures activity automatically from the tools your team already uses. Reps don't log anything new. The data is there whether they update the CRM or not.

Most teams are live in 2–4 weeks. And there's no ramp period — Backstory analyzes two years of your deal history on day one, so you get real answers immediately.

CROs and VPs of Sales who own the number and answer to the board when it changes. It's not a rep productivity tool - it's built for the leaders making commit decisions, pipeline calls, and driving revenue strategy.

Meet your loan officer's AI teammate.

Calls, texts, automated follow-up, and AI reception — built in.

Leading mortgage teams succeed with Flair

Your borrowers aren’t waiting around

Monitor

Flair monitors every lead source around the clock — new applications, inbound calls, and pipeline signals — so no borrower slips through.

Engage

It calls, texts, and emails within seconds, qualifies the borrower, and books the appointment while intent is still high.

Convert

Flair keeps every file moving — chasing documents, sharing milestones, and re-engaging stalled loans — so more reach the closing table.

name: Dex
brief:
Product: Dex
One-liner: The AI Coworker in Chrome
Description: ThirdLayer is an applied research and product lab building the next interface for human–AI collaboration. Our first product is Dex, an AI copilot for the browser. Think Cursor for knowledge work, optimized for speed and embedded directly where you work. Most web agents are built for set-and-forget tasks. But real work is fluid and messy—spread across tabs, tools, and evolving decisions.
Industry: B2B / Productivity
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Productivity, Consumer Products, AI
target:
The self-driving workspace for operators.

Dex is AI with full operational memory across your entire workspace. Every datapoint is ingested, synced, and structured into compounding context for high-leverage work.

Install Dex, then book your onboarding call.

Browser-first. Where all your work already lives.

Dex captures the operational reality of your workspace. Then it turns that context into action.

How it Works

The graph holds the record. The manual holds the judgment.

Operational Graph

The full organizational record across your operations.

Every message, meeting, deal update, and workflow event — organized into entities, relationships, timelines, and dependencies. A living source of truth of how work connects and changes over time.

Knowledge Manual

The evolving understanding of what currently matters.

Your priorities, open loops, relationship context, SOPs, and operating principles — captured as you work, updated as things change. Explicitly editable, automatically maintained. This is where judgment lives.

Autonomous Agents

Create automatic agents to orchestrate across Gmail, Slack, CRM, and 20+ tools—triggered by events or schedules.

Browser Control

Dex acts directly in your browser to navigate tabs, fill forms, and complete work where the context already lives.

Bring Your Context Anywhere

Use Dex's SDK and MCP to bring your operational context into any agent, tool, or workflow.

Across your favorite apps

Dex connects with power apps, acting across tabs to eliminate context switching.

Proactive. Self-improving. Always on.

Dex learns from your corrections, approvals, edits, and repeated patterns. The more you use it, the sharper it gets.

Dreamer Agent

Reasons 24/7 over new data. Maintains your knowledge base, spots emerging patterns, keeps your operational context current — even when you're away.

Skill Builder Agent

Generates custom automations and skill suggestions each week, tailored to your repeated workflows to continuously optimize your setup.

Bigger than agent memory. Retrieval surfaces facts. Execution requires reasoning across past precedent, relationships, and context to inform judgment in the next moment.

Your second brain. For work that used to slip through the cracks.

Before every meeting, Dex pulls your full history — emails, past calls, open commitments. Afterwards, automatically send follow-ups using call notes, and writing tone.

Dex is changing how high-leverage teams work.

“For the first time, my agents actually understand the deal. Not just the CRM fields — the history, the stakeholders, the nuance. Dex gave them operational clarity I didn’t think was possible.”

Mid-market PE firm
