name: Union54
brief:
Product: Union54
One-liner: Developers of ChitChat, an integrated messaging and payments wallet…
Description: ChitChat by Union54 is an integrated messaging and payments platform designed specifically for Africa's unique needs. Our app combines secure instant messaging with USD card capabilities and cross-border payments, making international money movement more accessible and affordable. We're tackling one of Africa's biggest financial challenges: the high cost of sending money across borders, where African senders often pay double the fees despite sending smaller amounts.
Industry: Fintech
Tags: FinOps, Fintech, Consumer, B2B, Messaging
target:
Issue virtual & physical debit cards

An API to issue debit cards without needing a bank or a third-party processor. Issue cards to customers, employees, stakeholders or just about anyone. From anywhere.

Everything you need to issue cards

We combine BIN sponsorship, authorization and fulfillment so you can focus on crafting the experience your customers remember.

Issue debit cards

Issue virtual and physical debit cards. Additional currencies coming soon.

Authorization

Have Union45 provide the store-of-value and authorize payments, or alternatively do that in your own system.

Your own brand

Design your cards and packaging to look and feel like your brand. We handle card production.

Issue cards with our developer-first API

Our platform is developer-first, not just developer friendly. We’ve made sure that your team doesn’t need to stitch together disparate systems or spend months integrating payments functionality.

Clean RESTful endpoints, informative responses and crisp documentation mean you can go from sandbox to production in weeks, not months.

What can you build with Union54 ?

Our APIs allow you to issue programmable virtual or physical debit cards. How will you use them?

Ledger based

Issue a companion virtual/physical card linked to customer ledger accounts for instant access across POS, ATM and online.

Acquirers/Gateways

Reduce settlement time by issuing cards to merchants so they access settlement funds instantly.

Buy Now Pay Later

Enable buy now, pay later with virtual or physical cards and flexible repayment schedules.

Credit Union

Move from analog to digital: issue cards for easy disbursements and collections.

Delivery companies

Issue cards to drivers with spending limits so you stay in control of every expense.

Digital banking

Accelerate time to market using our multicurrency ledger and card management platform.

Credit card

Issue cards to credit holders for real-time access to credit funds and run programs on your rules.

Corporate card

Issue cards for authorized business expenses with configurable team permissions and controls.

Start issuing cards

Union54 provides an API for any company to issue virtual and physical cards without a bank partner or processor. Our easy-to-integrate technology gives you access to card issuing and assists you in running a compliant card programme.

Tell us about yourself

Tell us what your business needs, and we’ll find the best solution for you. Our team partners closely with you from sandbox to launch.

brief:

target:
We make bio-based materials using renewable, low-carbon feedstocks.

Our programmable microbes turn ethanol into net-zero materials.

Industrial Microbes produces 100% bio-based acrylic acid. Read our press release to learn more.

It's time to change how we make things.

Consumers have spoken: They want sustainable bioproducts with reduced environmental impact across their lifecycle, and at an affordable cost.

The good news? Alternatives to petrochemicals in industrial manufacturing are becoming available and scaling quickly..

Scaling up bio-based solutions

100% bio-based acrylic acid

Like brewing whiskey

Discover how biotech and next-gen feedstocks are reshaping everything.

name: Embedder
brief:
Product: Embedder
One-liner: Hardware-Aware AI for Embedded Software Development
Description: Embedder is an AI agent for embedded software. It reads your datasheets and schematics, writes the code, flashes the board, runs the tests, and fixes its own mistakes. Testing is hardware-in-the-loop: Embedder drives the equipment your team already owns (debug probes, logic analyzers, power profilers, oscilloscopes) and validates firmware on real silicon, not just against a compiler.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, Hardware, B2B
target:
The Enterprise AI Platform For Embedded Software

Solve the firmware work that slows releases: board bring-up, hardware debugging, HIL testing, platform migrations, and performance optimization.

Working firmware in days, not weeks

Embedder reads your datasheet and schematic, drafts a cited implementation plan, writes part-specific drivers, and validates them on your hardware and existing bench equipment—cutting weeks of bring-up work down to days.

Datasheet Intelligence

Every register value, cited to the manual

Embedder reads the entire reference manual, from register maps to clock trees to errata, and cites the section behind every value it writes.

Schematic Ingestion

Drivers that match the board you built

Embedder resolves your netlist against the datasheet: pin muxing, pull-ups, bus addresses, errata workarounds. Nothing is assumed from the vendor's dev kit. Every driver is grounded in your actual design.

Hardware evidence attached to every conclusion

Embedder investigates firmware bugs across code, schematics, and live hardware. It drives the bench, tests hypotheses, and attaches hardware evidence—serial traces, register dumps, and schematic context—to every root-cause conclusion.

Serial & Debug

Diagnosed against what the chip did

Embedder reads serial output and drives GDB sessions, stepping breakpoints, inspecting registers and memory, and correlating runtime state with the code under review. Failures get diagnosed against what the chip actually did.

Signal Observation

Signals as reviewable evidence

Embedder turns logic analyzer captures and oscilloscope waveforms into structured data. Timing violations, protocol errors, and signal integrity issues surface as reviewable evidence, grounding firmware changes in electrical behavior.

Power Profiling

Every microamp traced to a line of code

Embedder drives power profilers to capture current draw across a workload, correlates the high-draw windows back to what the firmware was doing, and proves every low-power change by re-measuring on real silicon.

Catch regressions before they hit the field

Embedder generates tests from your hardware docs, runs them on real probes and instruments, and diagnoses failures against firmware and live signals. It proposes a fix, then reruns the test on silicon.

Parallel Testing Agents

Divide test work across specialized agents

Embedder splits a firmware test campaign across specialized agents that run cases concurrently and merge pass/fail results.

Closed-Loop Validation

Build, flash, test, and fix autonomously

The orchestrator chains compilation, flashing, runtime observation, and code repair into a tight loop. When a test fails the agent diagnoses the fault, patches the source, and re-validates without human intervention.

Security & IP Protection

name: RiskCube
brief:
Product: RiskCube
One-liner: AI insurance company
Description: RiskCube provides insurance for startups in AI, robotics, space & defense tech. When you're days from closing an enterprise or gov contract and procurement asks for a Certificate of Insurance (COI), a traditional broker can take weeks — and the deal stalls. RiskCube fixes that: we compare 40+ AM Best-rated U.S. carriers, pair that with licensed human broker review, and bind the right coverage and issue your COI within a day, not weeks.
Industry: Fintech / Insurance
Tags: Fintech, Insurance, Defense, AI
target:
Get vendor-ready insurance faster.

We compare startup business insurance from top-rated insurance companies, help you pick the right coverage, and get you the Certificates of Insurance (COIs) you need, often in about a day.

Startups lose momentum due to insurance requirements

Your deal is ready to close. The customer or investor asks for proof of insurance. Suddenly you're chasing brokers, filling out multiple forms, and comparing confusing options while the deal stalls and revenue slips.

Deal blockers

A missing Certificate of Insurance or an unmet contract requirement can stall your deal for weeks.

The exclusion gap

Insurance policies hide critical exclusions in complex language. Without expert review, you won't know what's not covered until it's too late.

The wrong coverage

Some founders buy a policy that doesn't meet the actual requirement. By the time procurement flags it, the deal is cold, and you're paying for coverage that doesn't help.

RiskCube: Enterprise-ready insurance at startup speed

RiskCube is an AI-native insurance broker for startups. We give you a wide range of coverages to compare and make the path smooth to get your Certificate of Insurance , often within one day.

One agentic platform to compare, buy, and manage startup business insurance

With RiskCube you can compare quotes from multiple carriers, purchase coverage digitally, generate Certificates of Insurance, and manage policies and renewals, all in one place.

Compare quotes & understand the tradeoffs

Buy digitally and get proof of insurance faster

Manage renewals and COIs in one platform

Comparing D&O quotes

Legally binding e-sign

From application to Certificate of Insurance (COI) , often in ~24 hours

Assess your unique risk profile

~10 min · one-time form

Complete a short digital intake form so we can understand your unique risk profile, your industry, stage, contracts, and exposures.

AI & brokers scan the market

Top-rated carriers compared

Our AI agents and licensed brokers scan the market's top-rated carriers to find the best quotes for your business.

Close the deal with proof of coverage

Vendor-ready in ~24 hours

We present the options that satisfy your vendor requirements and get you proof of coverage, so you can close the deal.

Who we insure

RiskCube is built for startups closing enterprise deals, raising capital, or passing compliance reviews.

brief:
Product: Saga AI
One-liner: Voice Agents for Healthcare Operations
Description: Saga AI deploys voice agents for healthcare practices, ACOs, and health systems to handle scheduling, patient intake, and care gap outreach. Agents connect directly to your EHR in real time.
Industry: B2B / Operations
Tags: SaaS, Healthcare, Operations, AI
target:
Read every document. Resolve every task. Run patient access on autopilot.

Saga deploys AI agents onto the back office of patient access — for practices, groups, and health systems. It reads every referral, fax, and form, then acts on it in the EHR.

A back office that's underwater.

Patient access runs on unstructured paper — faxes, charts, plan PDFs — and a team that can't keep up. Saga takes the repetitive, high-volume work off their plate, so the people you have focus on the patients and exceptions that need them.

The back office today

The back office on Saga

RE: New patient referral. Patient Robert Kim , DOB 03/14/1978 . Insurance Blue Cross PPO , member #BC4471902. Please evaluate for M51.26 lumbar disc degeneration. Referring provider Dr. A. Chen . Records attached for review prior to scheduling.

One live model of your practice. Every action runs on it.

Most tools turn a fax into a digital form and stop. Saga reads the document, reasons about it against the full chart, and completes the work — inside the EHR, systems, and SOPs you already run. Plug and play, no rip-and-replace, live in under a month.

Read anything

Faxes, referrals, PDFs, portal exports, handwriting — Saga ingests any format and extracts the key facts, structured and verified.

Reason against the chart

Every task opens with the complete record — history, meds, insurance, prior auths and care gaps, pulled live — so the agent decides what to do, not just what to file.

Governed by humans

High-priority and sensitive items wait in a review inbox for sign-off. Every resolved task feeds back into your protocols — so the agent improves as your processes evolve.

Fewer hours on paperwork. More capacity for patients.

Put patient access on a platform that acts.

Live in under a month · writes back to your EHR · your data stays yours

Deliver better at every level

Toolkit for product engineering teams

Improve the entire lifecycle of planning, executing, and reporting your deliverables

Trusted by 100s of companies

Haystack has been a game-changer for us. Unlike other tools, which can sometimes be misused in a top-down approach that reduces team trust and engagement, Haystack fosters trust across the organization. Haystack transformed my approach to planning and managing tasks. With clear capacity estimations and investment visibility, I no longer dread the quarterly planning process. My team’s efficiency has skyrocketed, allowing us to hit goals with confidence and ease!

We decreased our cycle time from 40 days to 3 days using the insights from Haystack

Haystack has become my go-to tool for monitoring and optimizing our engineering output. The way it simplifies complex data into actionable insights is phenomenal. It truly empowers our team to stay ahead of potential issues.

I’m impressed with how Haystack facilitated our delivery check-ins and improved our team’s delivery practices. It provides clear, actionable data that helps in making informed decisions quickly. It’s more than a tool; it’s a partner in enhancing our team’s efficiency and effectiveness.

You're in good company

brief:
Product: Chart
One-liner: Realtime Access to Verified Tax Records
Description: Chart's Unified Tax Record API provides a direct bridge to tax records from the IRS, state tax agencies, and major tax preparation platforms such as TurboTax and H&R Block.
Industry: Fintech
Tags: FinOps, Fintech, Finance
target:
Instant Access to Verified Tax Records

Unlock the most complete data on your clients’ financials from the ultimate source of truth - the IRS

Built for Modern Fintechs

Chart empowers innovative fintechs to automate income verification and client onboarding. From flexible integration methods to lightning-fast performance and high-touch support, we deliver an industry-leading experience.

Real-time Access

Access client tax records instantly. With Chart's direct connection to the IRS and leading tax preparation platforms, get the information you need within seconds !

Verified Documents

Eliminate uncertainty with official tax records. Chart directly connects to government sources and leading tax software, providing verified documents you can rely on.

Structured JSON

Chart transforms tax documents into clean, organized JSON data. Our automatic OCR processing parses records into well-formed JSON, making it easy to integrate to your tools.

Developer-Friendly

Chart provides a developer-centric REST API, complete with SDKs, sandbox environments, and top-tier documentation. Join leading fintech innovators who leverage our tools to build the future of finance.

Provide multiple submission options for your clients

Provide your clients with flexibility. They can submit their records by connecting to their IRS Online Accounts, linking their tax preparation software, or simply filling out official IRS forms.

Enterprise-Grade Security

Non-Persistent Credentials

We prioritize your users' security by never persisting their credentials. Every session demands re-authentication, keeping sensitive information transient.

SOC2 II Compliant

Chart is SOC 2 Type II compliant, ensuring the highest standards of data security and privacy. Reports available upon request.

Granular Access

Your users navigate a consent flow where they choose exactly which documents to share. Taxpayers have full control and can request the removal of their data at any time.

PII Reduction

Protect privacy without compromising functionality. Chart offers the option to anonymize and obfuscate PII and custom fields upon request.

SOC2 II Compliant

Chart is SOC 2 Type II compliant, ensuring the highest standards of data security and privacy. Reports available upon request.

Granular Access

Your users navigate a consent flow where they choose exactly which documents to share. Taxpayers have full control and can request the removal of their data at any time.

PII Reduction

Protect privacy without compromising functionality. Chart offers the option to anonymize and obfuscate PII and custom fields upon request.

name: Rimward
brief:
Product: Rimward
One-liner: Solar farm security software for existing cameras
Description: Rimward helps solar asset managers detect intrusions using the cameras already installed across their sites. It flags camera failures and coverage gaps, and gathers video evidence from multiple cameras to help their team or monitoring provider filter out false alarms and decide when to act.
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: Machine Learning, Computer Vision, B2B, Security, Enterprise
target:
Stop managing a portfolio one camera call at a time.

Rimward checks the cameras already on your solar sites, flags coverage gaps, and brings intrusion evidence together for your monitoring team.

Read-only CCTV access • No new hardware to start • Keep your monitoring provider

Live and in-discussion pilots

You paid for coverage. You got footage.

Different teams. The same unanswered security questions.

Does the moved camera still cover the fence?

Callout spend is up again. Which were real?

What has changed on site security since last year?

And theft is accelerating.

Copper reaching $14.5k/t in 2026 (+50%)

2,300 telecom cable thefts in 2024 (+35%)

Rail theft losses ~€20M in 2024 (doubled)

169 renewables offences (+59% in 2025)

From the whole portfolio down to one decision.

One portfolio, three views: what’s ready, what one site can still see, and what the operator does about an alert at 03:12.

Every site, one readiness state

See which sites need attention. Ready means their camera, coverage and processing checks pass.

One site, camera by camera

Coverage on the plan, not on paper. When a camera drops, the fence it was watching goes with it.

One event, one call

A person in the north yard at 03:12, with every camera that saw it on one timeline.

Two camera views. One event.

42 s · synchronized

Review evidence · Acknowledge, dismiss or escalate

Will it work on our sites?

How Rimward fits your cameras, connectivity and monitoring team.

We already have cameras, in a mix of brands and ages.

The normal case. Rimward starts with the cameras and recorders already on site and judges each one on what it delivers. Anything it cannot read is reported as unknown, never assumed ready.

Some of our sites have poor connectivity.

Cloud by default. Where connectivity is limited, an optional local gateway processes video on site.

A provider already monitors our sites.

Keep your monitoring provider. Authorized operators can review site events and evidence in Rimward.

What happens when it gets one wrong?

Every alert carries its reason, its confidence and the views it came from. A dismissal is recorded, not deleted, so a wrong call stays visible and reviewable.

Operator queue

Clear evidence. Clear responsibility.

Rimward detects, qualifies and records. Your team or monitoring provider owns the response.

Prove what the site saw.

Camera readiness

We tell you when a camera stops seeing what it was placed to see.

Qualified site events

name: Rindler
brief:
Product: Rindler
One-liner: The IDE for Tokenmaxxers
Description: We build Maxxwell, a desktop app for people who run several coding agents at once. Past two or three sessions, you become the bottleneck. Every session asks you something, most of it small, and you spend the day answering instead of deciding. It is also hard to tell which sessions are making progress, which are stuck on something trivial, and which have quietly started building the wrong thing. Maxxwell puts every session in one window and marks each one working, idle, or waiting on you.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, SaaS, Infrastructure, AI
target:
Stop babysitting your agents. Have an agent do it for you.

Run a dozen coding agents at once. Maxxwell keeps each one moving for you and brings you only what truly needs your attention .

the babysitting problem

Running agents is easy. Keeping them on track isn't.

More agents should mean more progress, not more windows to watch.

Keep agents on task

See what each agent is doing and give your managing agent the context to steer it back.

Catch context limits early

See when a session is filling up and compact it with one click.

Know what needs you

Review questions and blockers in one place instead of checking every terminal.

cut through the noise

All your agents. One place to follow their work.

See who is working, who has gone quiet, and who needs an answer. Open any session to pick up the conversation.

how it works

Keep your agents working together.

Run the coding tools you already use, including Claude Code and Codex. Add a managing agent to coordinate the work, with every session visible in Maxxwell.

See session activity, context usage, and requests for your attention.

Brief a managing agent to check progress and follow up with the others.

Review questions and blockers without hunting through every terminal.

Open any session to see its progress and continue where you left off.

get maxxwell

Put your agents to work.

Download Maxxwell for your computer and bring your coding agents into one workspace.

name: Rutter
brief:
Product: Rutter
One-liner: The Unified API for Business Financial Data
Description: Rutter is the unified API infrastructure powering the next generation of B2B fintech. We help tech-forward companies build seamlessly integrated financial products by connecting to their customers' systems of record, from accounting platforms to e-commerce systems. The financial operations landscape is fragmented across hundreds of platforms (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Shopify, Stripe, etc.).
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, Fintech, B2B

Integrations & AI Agents to ship financial products in days, not months.

Rutter powers financial use cases like Supplier Enablement, Agentic Commerce, Bank Feeds, and Accounting Automation for Fortune 500 companies and financial institutions

Everything you need to deliver best-in-class integrations

Product and engineering leaders prefer leveraging a Unified API in order to save millions of dollars of engineering cost, expand addressable markets, and improve product quality. The Rutter platform is designed with 3 product pillars in mind.

Rutter Link enables you to easily implement a white-labeled end-user authentication process. It handles permissions, data governance, and monitors consent.

Rutter APIs allow you to read, update, write, and remove data across 60+ accounting, commerce, payments, and ads platform used globally by your customers.

Rutter dashboard gives you full visibility into the integration lifecycle: authentication, data access, webhooks, and data syncs to easily debug and monitor performance.

“We’ve worked with many providers that weren’t reliable, which is a huge issue. Rutter is the only provider we’ve worked with that’s given us a 99.999% uptime so far. They’re more reliable than the Facebook API.”

Read & Write to multiple platforms with one API, one data model

Explore our integration coverage across Commerce, Accounting, and Ads.

AI Agents to grow commercial card spend and supplier enablement

Identify, score, and switch vendor payments to card. Rutter provides AI card acceptance analysis and AI agents to power card adoption at scale.

Designed to power best-in-class integrated financial products

Rutter’s API infrastructure is designed to power leading tech-forward banks and fintechs.

name: QuestDB
brief:
Product: QuestDB
One-liner: High-performance time series database
Description: QuestDB is a high-performance open source database for the most demanding workloads. Native support for Parquet, Iceberg and SQL keeps your data portable, AI-ready, without vendor lock-in. QuestDB is designed from the ground up to operate as close to the hardware as possible - eliminating ingestion bottlenecks and lowering overall hardware requirements. QuestDB powers mission-critical infrastructure for companies in Capital Markets, Crypto, Space Exploration, Energy and Robotics/Physical AI.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Developer Tools, Analytics, Open Source, Time Series
target:
The live stream and the complete record, unified.

Powering critical data workloads at leading companies globally

Capital markets

Modernize the market data stack. Never drop a tick.

Capture large volumes of market data and trades, act on them in real time, and query the same complete history for pre-trade signals, research, TCA, risk, P&L, surveillance, and compliance. Standard SQL and open formats keep every team connected to the record.

Capture every event once

Ingest ticks, orders, executions, and transactions at market speed. Durability, deduplication, and out-of-order correction are built in.

Act before the moment passes

Compute intraday risk and P&L, evaluate surveillance conditions, and publish results while the market is moving.

Investigate with the full record

Run TCA, markouts, post-trade analysis, compliance, and historical research in SQL, then open the same data through Apache Parquet, Iceberg and Arrow.

Critical market infrastructure runs on QuestDB

“ A time series database truly built by developers for developers ”

“ QuestDB enables exceptional transaction throughput performance ”

“ QuestDB has been an excellent fit for our production trading analytics ”

One engine. The full data lifecycle.

Act on what is happening. Learn from everything that happened.

Capture

Ingest millions of ordered and out-of-order events without pre-aggregation.

Compute

Transform, enrich, and aggregate events as they arrive, then publish results in real time.

Query

Run temporal SQL across live and historical data with predictable low latency.

Retain

Keep the complete record online across hot storage and object storage tiers.

Running in banks, exchanges, rockets, and power plants.

B3 powers Latin America's largest exchange with QuestDB

B3's Central Securities Depository platform runs on QuestDB for Capital Markets , processing every trade on the world's tenth-largest exchange.

“ We chose QuestDB for its speed and straightforward deployment, which fits cleanly into our cloud-native architecture. ”

Airbus monitors fleet data in real time on QuestDB

Airbus processes billions of data points a day on QuestDB, powering real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance for mission-critical components across the fleet.

“ QuestDB is used at Airbus for real-time applications involving billions of data points per day. For us, QuestDB is an outstanding solution that meets (and exceeds) our performance requirements. ”

One Trading runs regulated digital asset trading on QuestDB

One Trading's regulated crypto exchange runs on QuestDB for Capital Markets , ingesting billions of trades for real-time market surveillance and latency analysis.

name: Marble
brief:
Product: Marble
One-liner: The autonomous back-of-house for restaurants.
Description: Marble is the first AI-native operating system for the restaurant back-of-house. Restaurants, cafes and bars still run on a patchwork of disconnected point solutions, spreadsheets, clipboards and tribal knowledge, which costs the industry billions each year in stockouts, food waste, and lost profit. Marble replaces that entire stack with one system.
Industry: B2B
Tags: SaaS, Restaurant Tech, AI
target:
The autonomous back of house for restaurants.

Truffle is now Marble. Same team, same platform, new name.

The first AI-native operating system purpose built for hospitality. Designed to power the way you order, prep, schedule, and more — so your business runs more profitably.

Trusted by leading hospitality brands

Your back of house never ran itself — until now.

Review Required

Review Purchase Orders

5 POs pending approval · $4,545.50

Review Food Prep List

5 tasks assigned across 4 stations

Review Schedule Change

Nina P. covering Jake R. — Wed shift

Manage Inventory

Current Value of Inventory

Manage Labor

Top hospitality brands use Marble for

The Problem

What you were left with —

Manual Workflows

Hundreds of manual hours per month on inventory counting, ordering, scheduling, payroll, and more.

Food Waste & Stockouts

Preventable food waste due to unoptimized ordering, prepping, and portioning.

Labor Overruns

Significant labor overage due to unoptimized scheduling.

The Solution

Marble leverages AI to reimagine back of house functions — so your teams can focus on hospitality, not administrative work.

Computer Vision & Voice AI Counting

Count your entire inventory in minutes, not hours. Point your phone, speak the counts, and let AI do the rest — with object detection that verifies every item.

Marble Intelligence

Ask any question about your business or carry out any action. Update recipes, draft purchase orders, pull reports. Everything that took hours of training, done instantly, through conversation.

Marble Agents

AI agents that run your back of house on autopilot — inventory procurement, food prep, waste monitoring, and employee scheduling. Always preserving human in the loop for final sign off.

Demand Forecasting

Always-on machine learning models forecast daily demand per menu item. Know exactly what to prep, what to order, who to schedule, and when — before the rush hits.

Smart Scheduling

Generate optimized schedules that take into account demand forecasts, staff availability, labor laws, and any unstructured rules or preferences — with all compliance handled automatically.

Intelligent Document Extraction

Drop in any document — vendor invoices, recipes, prep sheets, or photos — and AI extracts the data, matches it to your inventory and menu, and reconciles automatically. No manual data entry.

Helping hospitality venues stay focused and see measurable results.

100K+

1M+

Loved by many

Run the audit 4. Keep everything up to date afterward Founders shouldn’t lose weeks to this stuff. Even one day is too much.

target:
Compliance, Done For You.

Our compliance officers run your program end-to-end. Stay continuously audit-ready without the overhead or complexity of traditional compliance platforms.

Trusted by leading teams

From chaos to confidence

Our compliance officers handle the entire journey for you - from setup and risk assessments to audit coordination and ongoing monitoring - so you can stay focused on building.

We start by reviewing your environment, completing the risk and vendor assessments, identifying gaps, and defining the right path forward. Then we create a compliance program tailored to how your team actually operates.

Once certified, we run your compliance program in the background - monitoring, updating controls, refreshing evidence, and maintaining assessments - so you remain continuously audit-ready with no extra effort.

Put compliance on autopilot

Run your entire compliance program with a blend of expert support and automation. Probo's compliance officers handle the work behind the scenes while the platform keeps everything continuously audit-ready.

Your dedicated compliance expert

A seasoned compliance officer becomes an extension of your team, managing policies, controls, reviews, and assessments on your behalf - real expertise, not ticket threads.

Compliance that runs in the background

Probo automates evidence collection, updates, and approvals, while our team keeps your entire program aligned and audit-ready. You're only notified when something genuinely needs your attention.

Leverage your compliance for revenue growth

Show customers and prospects you're trustworthy. Share a secure, branded trust page that instantly proves your compliance and helps accelerate deals.

Get stuff done on Slack

name: Oxus
brief:
Product: Oxus
One-liner: AI-powered automation for internal audit workflows
Description: Oxus automates internal audits for pre-IPO and public companies using AI. Companies including leading payroll providers, public biotechs, and social media enterprises work with us to streamline audit workflows and get audits done 10x faster. Learn more at: https://www.oxus-ai.com/
Industry: B2B
target:
The audit, accelerated.

Oxus automates the repetitive work behind every audit using AI—so your team can focus on judgment, risk, and decision-making.

Internal audit teams are drowning in manual work.

Audit work is largely manual and has been for decades. Tighter timelines, expanding scope, and most of the work still done by hand. High-value work gets squeezed by the time it takes just to execute.

High outsourcing costs

Inconsistent documentation

Evidence buried in documents

Low-value busywork

With Oxus, audit teams deliver more audits, faster.

Every audit engagement starts with understanding how a process operates and ends with determining whether controls actually worked. Oxus accelerates both.

Understand the process.

Audit teams spend weeks conducting walkthroughs, identifying controls, creating narratives and flowcharts, and reconciling competing versions of how a process works.

Oxus transforms walkthrough recordings/transcripts/notes, policies, and supporting process documentation into standardized flowcharts, narratives, control inventories, and risk mappings within minutes.

Flowcharts • Walkthrough Narratives • Control Inventories • Risk Mappings

Test the control.

Once a process is understood, auditors must select samples, gather evidence, evaluate attributes, investigate exceptions, and prepare workpapers.

Oxus executes testing workflows from evidence collection through conclusion drafting using AI, helping teams complete more testing with greater consistency and less manual effort.

Testing Workpapers • Redboxed Evidence Packages • Exception Logs • Draft Conclusions

How Oxus Works

Your team stays in control of planning, judgment, and sign-off. Oxus handles the repetitive work in between.

Get Started Immediately.

Instead of spending months configuring software, teams can begin executing audits immediately. Oxus works with the documentation your team already has: walkthrough recordings, policies, screenshots, evidence, and test procedures. A dedicated Oxus point of contact supports onboarding and helps your team get up and running quickly.

Oxus executes the work.

Oxus transforms raw documentation into flowcharts, narratives, controls, and risk mappings, then executes testing workflows from evidence collection through conclusion drafting. Teams' time shifts from documenting processes and assembling workpapers to reviewing results.

Your senior team signs off.

Managers review outputs, investigate exceptions, and make final decisions. Every AI-generated conclusion is linked to supporting evidence and preserved in a complete audit trail for easy review.

Build institutional knowledge.

Prior-year work, reviewer feedback, and engagement context improve future audits. Oxus helps teams build a durable record of how controls operate and how they have been evaluated over time. Next year's audit doesn't start from zero.

More than automation. A system built for audit.

name: Legacy
brief:
Product: Legacy
One-liner: Legacy helps you test, improve, and freeze your sperm
Description: **TL;DR:** Legacy (YC S19) is a startup focused on the fast-growing field of fertility and family planning. Founded at Harvard, the company has now raised $40M from leading investors like FirstMark Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, Section 32, Tribe Capital, and even celebrities like Justin Bieber, The Weeknd, and others. **What we're doing** We aim to change the outdated view that fertility is a "women's issue" by creating an accessible, affordable product for men & people with sperm.
Industry: Healthcare / Consumer Health and Wellness
Tags: Fertility Tech, Consumer Health Services, Digital Health, Healthcare, Health & Wellness
target:
Your sperm is your future

Affordably test and freeze your sperm from the comfort of home. Have the family you want, whenever you’re ready.

Not sure where to start?

Customized care starts here:

Trying to conceive

Vasectomy

Gender-affirming care

Testosterone therapy

Cancer treatment

Military & dangerous jobs

Save over $1400

As seen in

Fertility declines with each birthday

Past 35, you’re more likely to deal with infertility — and your child has a higher risk of conditions like autism.

Our sperm is not okay

Sperm counts have dropped over 50% since the 1970s, thanks to chemicals, plastics, and our modern lifestyles.

Clinics are awkward and expensive

With the old-school approach, you wait months for an appointment in the communal “collection room” (yikes).

Test your sperm. Preserve it at its peak. Without leaving home.

From checkout to lab in less than a week

10x faster than a traditional clinic. Get the data you need to get pregnant faster, faster — or freeze your sperm without delaying upcoming medical treatments.

Save over 33% compared to clinics

We’re making future family planning an option for all. Sperm freezing starts at $245 per year, and we’re in network with most major insurance plans and benefits.

Security and privacy at every step

Your kit arrives in discreet packaging, your results are available on a private virtual dashboard, and your sample is stored in multiple locations for redundancy.

You may be able to freeze for $0

We’ve performed over 75,000 analyses

Superior customer service. Prior to making a purchase, I spoke with someone who answered every question thoroughly and easily. She helped me make the right product choice for me, and made the purchase super-smooth. This company is the online leader in the space.

Danny B.

Proactive testing & freezing

Got my kit, followed the easy instructions, sent it off, and like clockwork got my results the next day. Quick, fast and easy! My wife and I are later in age and finally want to try and have a child. I'm so confident that we will conceive, thanks to Legacy.

Cleon I.

With Legacy, I was able to get my kit in 2 days, which meant I could start HRT much sooner. My customer service rep answered my questions patiently and completely and even helped me with payment options. You guys made everything easier for me during a really turbulent time.

Aya C.

I want the option for kids later

Employment Hero (formerly Humi) Employment. Intelligently Run.

Canada’s AI-powered Employment Operating System for Payroll, HR, Recruitment and Benefits – with intelligent agents to support your team. Or hand it all over to us with HeroForce – end to end employment, done for you.

We’re thrilled to welcome Humi to the Employment Hero family. Together, we’re delivering a smarter all-in-one platform that puts Canadian compliance, privacy, and care first – now strengthened with world-class innovation behind the scenes. It’s the Canadian experience you trust, elevated.

Customers rate us 4.5

Built on AI to take action, not just surface information.

Employment OS doesn’t just show you what to do next. It helps you do it.

Work smarter, not harder: AI matches you to roles, helps you stand out and gets you employed faster – without the friction.

HeroForce

End-to-end employment, done for you.

Automated payroll

Run accurate payroll in minutes, not days. Our platform automates CRA remittances and payroll compliance , handling complex provincial regulations with ease. Need extra support? We also offer managed payroll services to handle it all for you.

Transform your people data into a powerful Employment OS that triggers the next action the moment something changes. Maximise your SR&ED claim with seasoned consultants and technical writers who leverage your Employment Hero data to strengthen every submission.

name: Arpari
brief:
Product: Arpari
One-liner: Multibank treasury management
Description: Treasury management platform built for multibank finance teams. Seamlessly consolidate company finances, manage payments and financial operations from a single dashboard.
Industry: Fintech
Tags: Fintech, SaaS, Real Estate, Payments, Neobank
target:
The OS for multi-bank finance teams

Maximize efficiency with a single point of reference for all your financial data. Access real-time balances & transactions, analyze cash flow and send payments all from the Arpari platform.

Simplify your workflows: One platform connected to all your banks

Each day, finance teams utilize the Arpari platform as their system record to manage billions

Real-Time Cash Visibility​

Unified, real-time visibility into all bank accounts, balances, and transactions in one place.​

Centralized Invoice Operations​

Manage vendor bills and customer invoices with streamlined approvals, real-time status tracking, and variance insights.​

Multi-Entity Treasury Control​

Organize your entities, ownership structures, and reporting hierarchies with clarity and accuracy.​

Secure Multi-Bank Payment Execution

Initiate, schedule, and approve payments across all banks with streamlined workflows and role controls.​

Enterprise-Grade Access & Compliance

Ensure secure treasury operations with role-based permissions, segmented access, and unified bank entitlements.​

Connected Treasury Infrastructure​

Seamlessly sync banks, ERPs, and invoice systems to create a unified, accurate system of record.​​

Unparalleled bank and ERP connectivity to the data you need

Implement Arpari within 1 week

API-first connectivity reduces implementation timeline compared with legacy treasury softwares

Use Cases

Real Estate / REITs

Manage complex ownership structures, multiple bank accounts, and high transaction volumes. Arpari provides unified visibility and entity-level clarity.

Multi-Entity / Holding Companies

Seemlessly monitor cash across dozens of entities and banks. Arpari simplifies entity-level insight and centralized cash management.

Manufacturing

Manufacturing firms manage large vendor payments, long lead times, and multi-entity structures. Arpari helps centralize liquidity and vendor workflows.

SaaS

Granular control over runway, billing cycles, and cash forecasting. Arpari centralizes cash, invoices, and payments to provide accurate, real-time visibility into burn and inflows.

Marketplaces

High volume payments, variable revenue cycles, and inventory spend make cash unpredictable. Arpari provides consolidated visibility and forecasting tied to real cash movements.

Professional Services

Reliable insight into billing, collections, and cash timing. Arpari centralizes AP/AR and cash activity for predictable operations.

CFO

CFOs need a fast, reliable, consolidated view of cash across all banks and entities to steer liquidity and make strategic decisions. Arpari provides instant visibility, automated reporting, and trustworthy data without manual work.

Controller

Reconciling bank data, invoices, payments, and ledger activity requires heavy manual effort, increasing the risk of mismatches, delays, and inaccuracies in financial records.

Treasury Manager

Treasury teams must monitor liquidity, ensure timely payments, and manage banking operations across entities. Arpari delivers automated visibility, payment control, and bank-level governance.

FP&A

Marketplaces

Professional Services

Reliable insight into billing, collections, and cash timing. Arpari centralizes AP/AR and cash activity for predictable operations.

CFO

Controller

brief:
Product: Kitekraft
One-liner: Building flying wind turbines.
Description: Kitekraft systems consist of a tethered electric aircraft, a.k.a. a kite. The kite has 8 onboard (flying) wind turbines. It autonomously flies in figure eights and generates electrical energy from the wind. Our systems need 10x less construction materials compared to a conventional wind turbine and our systems cost half as much.
Industry: Industrials / Energy
Tags: Hardware, Climate, Renewable Energy
target:
Building Flying Wind Turbines.

Contact Us

Enabling the world's transition to 100% clean energy with 10x more efficient wind turbines.

Climate change is here

Human impact through the use of fossil fuels is causing a rapid increase in greenhouse gases in our atmosphere. This leads to an increase in temperature and sea level. If we do not limit this increase to 1.5 degrees we will face severe consequences.

Climate change is happening and it is threatening our ecosystem, our home.

But renewables are not expanding fast enough

Renewable energy solutions provide only around 10% of our primary energy consumption. To reach net-zero by 2050 we need to 10x the amount of renewable energy systems.

But the available solutions are too costly, cannot be installed due to their complex logistics and installation, or they face public opposition.

Next generation wind power

Our systems are a drastic improvement over existing wind turbines. Instead of a huge rigid tower and blades, we use a small tethered aircraft to harvest wind energy.

With only a fraction of the materials used we are able to provide low-cost electricity. Locations that were previously unfeasible are now within reach thanks to simpler logistics and setup.

At the same time, the landscape is less affected.

name: Anjuna
brief:
Product: Anjuna
One-liner: Anjuna enabled organizations to trust any infrastructure
Description: Anjuna makes hardware-grade application and data protection simple, fast and enterprise-ready. Anjuna software enables IT to “lift and shift” applications and data into the hardware-encrypted confines of a secure enclave, protecting them from malicious software, insiders, and bad actors. Available from every major chip, cloud, and system vendor, secure enclaves are the data security gold standard.
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: Cloud Workload Protection, Security
target:
Autonomous Agents Need a Supervisor

Agentic AI introduces a new kind of risk: autonomous digital actors operating with privilege beyond traditional controls. Anjuna's cloud data security and privacy preserving AI becomes the incorruptible supervisor, isolating agents in TEEs, enforcing policy at runtime, and preventing unauthorized actions or data exposure.

Cornerstones of Confidential AI and Data Collaboration

Easily create a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE).

Abstract the instantiation of a TEE (secure enclave) to isolate data, code, and secrets. Anjuna Seaglass virtualizes modern CPUs and cloud infrastructure services to offer hardware-enforced isolation that protects from unauthorized access by users or software, regardless of privilege level.

Encrypt data in all three states.

Use Anjuna's cloud data security and privacy preserving AI to secure sensitive workloads by ensuring that data is always encrypted. Anjuna Seaglass implements a confidential runtime to enable data-in-use encryption inside the TEE, and control at-rest and in-transit encryption to prevent vulnerabilities as data leaves the confidential computing environment.

Authenticate the identity of your code.

Create a high-trust environment by ensuring both your infrastructure and applications can be trusted before they are allowed to boot. Anjuna Seaglass uses a cryptographic attestation policy manager to orchestrate the secure distribution of secrets to applications inside the enclave.

Secure apps across clouds without rework.

Run and manage all applications, traditional and cloud-native, on all the leading public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) without requiring code changes and using a consistent operational model. Learn more about Anjuna Seaglass.

Get Started Free with Anjuna Seaglass

Try free for 30 days on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and experience the power of intrinsic cloud security.

Use Cases for Confidential Computing with Anjuna

The Trust Foundation for Agentic AI

AI agents now act with privileged access to data and systems. Without hardware-rooted trust, they are vulnerable to memory poisoning, tool misuse, and identity spoofing. Anjuna eliminates these risks with Confidential Computing.

The Path to Secure AI

Anjuna allows businesses to navigate the complexities of AI adoption with unparalleled security, compliance, and innovation, all while preserving data privacy and integrity.

Anjuna Seaglass: The Universal Confidential Computing Platform

Run any application with intrinsic security and always-on confidentiality—no code changes required. Built on hardware-rooted trust, Seaglass makes cloud and AI workloads provably secure.

Anjuna Northstar: The AI Data Fusion Clean Room

name: machine0
brief:
Product: machine0
One-liner: AWS for Agents
Description: machine0 is a CLI for agent compute: `machine0 new mybox` gives your agent a full cloud VM, billed by the minute, from small up to 60 vCPU / 240 GB and 8×H100s. Agents drive it themselves via CLI or MCP. Agent workloads are moving from ephemeral to always-on. A coding agent working on a hard feature runs 6-8 hours. Auto-research agents run for days. machine0 is the environment in which these agents run.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Developer Tools, Cloud Computing
target:
Powerful & Persistent Virtual Machines

Up to 60 vCPUs, 240 GB RAM & GPUs. Designed for agents using CLI or MCP. Billed by the minute.

Trusted by

Backed by

Get Started Now

NixOS or Ubuntu with tools pre-installed. Dedicated resources, static IPs, per-minute billing.

Designed For Long Running Agents

VMs remain on unless stopped or suspended. Reproducible builds with NixOS flakes or Ubuntu with Ansible. Dedicated resources, static IPs, per-minute billing. All images are open source: NixOS , Ubuntu .

99.99% uptime. 1–60 vCPU, up to 240 GB RAM. Optional GPUs: H100, H200, L40S, MI300X, RTX 4000/6000 Ada.

Every operation is a CLI command with --json . A remote MCP server lets agents drive everything programmatically.

Freeze a VM's state, stop billing, restore later. Create golden images from any VM and spin up clones.

Inject MCP servers, credentials, prompts and environment variables into your VMs using profiles. Claude Code and Codex will pick them up automatically.

Deterministic builds, one-command rollbacks, no drift. Ubuntu pre-installed with Docker, Node, Python, Claude Code, and Codex.

Every VM gets a public IP and HTTPS at .mac0.io . No NAT, no tunnels. Run VMs in US East, US West, UK, EU, and Asia.

Pricing

Pay-as-you-go, billed per minute. Same price in all regions. Suspend VMs to stop billing, resume anytime. CPU VMs from $0.013/hr. GPU VMs from $0.836/hr, up to 8x H200.

The -nvme sizes run on newer-generation CPUs with NVMe storage for significantly higher disk IOPS — same vCPU, RAM, and disk as their regular counterparts.

The -premium sizes are dedicated (not shared) vCPUs, the fastest single-thread performance we offer.

GPU sizes are available in us-east , uk , eu , and asia .

Suspend VMs to stop billing. You pay only for image storage ($0.078/GB/month) while suspended. Minimum top-up $5. Unused credits are refundable.

Examples

Powerful VMs on Demand

Create stable & powerful VMs in your region. They're ideal for offloading compute-heavy tasks like compilation or automated research.

Running Agents with Profiles

Run agents inside VMs. Use profiles to inject credentials, MCP servers, prompts and environment variables into the VMs so your agents have everything they need to hit the ground running.

Reproducible Builds with NixOS

Use the /create-machine skill to generate reproducible builds with nix code. It'll then create a snapshot for you to make as many clones as you want.

Hosting

name: Finch
brief:
Product: Finch
One-liner: Finch is the Employment Data Platform
Description: Finch is the API to access employment data systems. We allow admins to connect their company in a compliant and secure manner to trusted applications. Finch integrates across data providers enabling developers to access a previously closed system and are at the source of truth for employee data and money flow. Tags: Fintech, HR Tech, API
target:
Grow faster with HR and payroll connectivity

Unlock revenue and streamline operations with the payroll, HR, and benefits integrations you need to scale.

Serving startups, Fortune 500s, and everyone in between

Support more integrations, faster

Win more customers with the integrations they need––we handle build and maintenance work for you.

One, unified data format

Finch transforms the data from each provider into one, standard data format that’s easy to use.

Onboard employers in minutes

Replace manual uploads and SFTP with our easy connection setup flow.

Data on the whole organization

Never miss a new hire, termination, or address change with real-time visibility into HR and employee data.

No more payroll file uploads

Sync data directly from payroll systems for the most accurate view into individual and company financial data.

Modify contributions & deductions

Create and manage employer contributions and employee deductions in the payroll system.

Extract data from tax documents

Speed up onboarding and operations with access to W-4 forms and other tax documents.

Leaders in employment data security at scale

We follow enterprise-grade compliance standards and best-in-class encryption protocols to keep PII safe.

Why Finch?

A win-win for sales, engineering, and operations

Solutions

Don't let integrations be your bottleneck

Let us handle employee data connectivity, so you can focus on services that set you apart.

Unlock integrations that simplify onboarding, enrollment, and admin for employers and participants.

Onboard employers in minutes and use their payroll data to deliver richer insights for FP&A, benchmarking, and more.

Connect to sponsor payroll systems so you can automate 401(k) administration and keep plans running smoothly.

Use real-time employee data to streamline premium calculations and collections, claims administration, and audits.

Build your HRIS integration marketplace to enable powerful HR automations that set you apart from competitors.

Compliance & SaaS

Automate onboarding, offboarding, and provisioning with a real-time view into each customer's employee roster.

Something Else?

We build integrations so you don't have to. Have another use case in mind? We're happy to help get you started!

Testimonials

You'll be in good company

“Finch is the best API for writing payroll data, hands down. We implemented Finch even faster than the time they forecasted for us, which was a pleasant surprise.”

“Finch makes it easy to know what data we are getting and how to get it. Their data normalization has been a huge game changer for us and has cut down our development time significantly.”

name: Voicepanel
brief:
Product: Voicepanel
One-liner: Evals for products
Description: We help teams evaluate products with real people. New features. AI experiences. Websites. Apps. Ads. Messaging. Every evaluation builds confidence in what to build, what to launch, and what to improve next.
Industry: B2B / Analytics
target:
Measure what people think.

Evaluate your product with real users, buyers, and experts. Quantify what works, what doesn't, and what to build next.

Get a demo

Backed by Y Combinator

Building products has never been easier.

Building winning products has never been harder.

Knowing what people actually want has always been the hard part.

We help teams run scalable evaluations with real people, giving them the ground truth they need to craft winning experiences.

Feedback engine

One place for every kind of feedback

Surveys, interviews, and usability tests usually live in separate tools, so the full picture never comes together.

Voicepanel brings voice, video, screen, text, and tasks into the same study. Mix them however you need for a complete picture of what people say, what they do, and why.

Rapid recruitment

The right people, in minutes

Finding the right participants usually means days of screening, scheduling, and chasing replies.

Invite your own customers with a link, or reach 30M+ people across dozens of integrated panels. You decide who gets in with manual or automated screening.

Connected insights

Turn feedback into what gets built

Research reports fill with vague findings, then sit apart from the product work they are meant to shape.

Voicepanel turns responses into actionable measures and automated clips, then opens them to your tools through MCP and API so insight shapes what you ship.

Enterprise controls

Built for enterprise teams that need control

Most AI research tools hide prompts, rules, and spend, so teams cannot trust or govern what runs.

Voicepanel puts prompts, templates, branding, budgets, and guardrails in your hands. Nothing is a black box.

Hear it from our customers

See how modern product teams research, test, and improve what they ship.

Voicepanel isn't just replacing other methods. It's allowing us to conduct research in a new way that simply wasn't possible before.

Kendra Shapiro

Head of Consumer Insights & UXR

Read customer story

Hundreds of homeowners researched before the app launched—so Hint shipped with confidence from day one.

“ Such an incredibly useful tool! Voicepanel is going to completely change how companies gather user feedback. We use it to get detailed feedback from our subscribers, many of whom are international and non-English speakers. ”

Grant Lee

Co-Founder & CEO

name: Maywood
brief:
Product: Maywood
One-liner: The first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7
Description: Maywood is the first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7, working across your network, pipeline, and active processes, running constantly in the background and surfacing things you'd otherwise miss.
Industry: Fintech / Banking and Exchange
target:
The first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7

See what Maywood does for the banker . Make it yours.

Every senior advisor and investor carries hundreds of relationships and dozens of live deals. Today's AI waits to be prompted where we are the bottleneck. Maywood inverts that. It works in the background across your network and your deal book, surfacing moves, drafting replies, pushing process forward. You read. You approve.

Today the professional prompts the AI. We invert that.

Every other AI tool waits to be asked. The human is the bottleneck: typing, prompting, context-switching. Maywood works in the background across every relationship and every deal. The professional reads, edits, approves.

Hundreds of relationships. Dozens of deals. One chief of staff.

Relationships, mapped.

Reconciles Outlook recency, calendar history, CRM context, SharePoint notes into a live network view.

Deals, pushed forward.

Tracks every live mandate, buyer log, diligence, IOIs, term sheets, and drives the next step.

Work, already done.

Drafts replies. Updates CRM. Writes follow-ups. Prepares meetings. Reconciles numbers.

Five things Maywood does while you're in meetings.

Two tracks. Scheduled: morning brief, EOD wrap, weekly deal status, 30-minute inbox sweep. Triggered: counterparty announcements, LinkedIn signals, lateral moves, market news touching covered issuers, unusual reactivations from cold contacts. Events surface within minutes, not the next morning.

The floor, not a disclaimer.

Maywood is built to FINRA and SEC requirements from day one: autonomous within scope, human-approved at every external boundary, fully reconstructable in between.

Supervised at every external boundary

Autonomous within scope. Every external-facing action, send, file, transmit, execute, routes through explicit human approval. Tiered action model, configurable approval chains, firm-wide kill switch.

Discoverable by design

Every prompt, tool call, draft, and output preserved. WORM-compliant storage, hash-chained integrity, 6-year retention, one-click examiner export.

Information barriers in code

Deal-level and firm-level isolation. MNPI-tagged data with classification-enforced access. No cross-deal context, cache, or embedding leakage. Off-channel transmission architecturally blocked.

Built for the modern rule set

Amended Reg S-P from day one. AES-256, TLS 1.2+, MFA everywhere, 72-hour breach SLA. SOC 2 Type II. Aligned to FINRA's 2026 GenAI guidance and NYDFS Part 500.

Detailed control mapping, full domain architecture, and SOC 2 package available under NDA.

No new interface. No prompting.

Single-tenant container per professional . Runs inside the tools they already live in. Output lands where they already look.

name: Prenda
brief:
Product: Prenda
One-liner: K-8 microschools in your neighborhood
Description: Prenda makes it easy to open a K-8 microschool in your home, studio or office. We start with an adult guide who cares about kids and believes in the power of learning. Often this is the mom of one of the students. She recruits a class of up to 10 students, and we provide everything she needs to run a microschool - training, support, software, curriculum, and funding so she gets paid. In
Industry: Education
Tags: Education
target:
Become the grownup kids will remember for a lifetime

Prenda gives you everything you need to run your own microschool for K-8th grade learners.

Conventional education is no longer serving our kids

Microschools help kids love learning again

A microschool is a tight-knit community of 5-10 students designed to help every learner find their purpose and master skills at their own level and pace.

Prenda microschools drive engagement and academic growth

Become a Prenda Guide

We give you everything you need to start and run a microschool in your community:

Prenda prioritizes engagement and academics by leveraging evidence-based techniques in a four-mode learning day: connect, conquer, collaborate, and create. With projects designed to nurture each child’s personal passion and adaptive diagnostic tests in math and reading, Prenda provides a customized curriculum that makes sense for each child.

Easily set up your microschool with Prenda’s plug-and-play software platform. Manage enrollment, track students’ progress, process payments, even build your own marketing website with Prenda tools, advised by your microschool set-up specialist and a personal guide coach.

Year-round academic coaches provide on-call support to help you with learning, behavior, motivation, and more. Prenda also offers free ongoing training to help you understand the art and science of empowering young learners.

Easily set up your microschool with Prenda’s plug-and-play software platform. Manage enrollment, track students’ progress, process payments, even build your own marketing website with Prenda tools. Your dedicated microschool set-up specialist and personal guide coach will support you at every step.

Our Story

A few years ago, I noticed how traditional education was dulling my kids' love of learning. They seemed lost or bored - the conventional structure just wasn't set up to cater to their individual needs. But kids should naturally love learning! So, I invited seven neighborhood kids around my kitchen table to try a different way…

I wondered if there were other passionate people who might want to start their own microschools and help kids love learning again. Prenda has since grown into a full, K-8th grade learning experience. With a research-driven curriculum, real community and support, and plug-and-play software, you'll have everything you need to start your own microschool and help kids discover their love of learning again.

Kids (and Parents) love Prenda

We give you everything you need to start and run a microschool in your community:

Prenda prioritizes engagement and academics by leveraging evidence-based techniques in a four-mode learning day: connect, conquer, collaborate, and create. With projects designed to nurture each child’s personal passion and adaptive diagnostic tests in math and reading, Prenda provides a customized curriculum that makes sense for each child.

Easily set up your microschool with Prenda’s plug-and-play software platform. Manage enrollment, track students’ progress, process payments, even build your own marketing website with Prenda tools, advised by your microschool set-up specialist and a personal guide coach.

Year-round academic coaches provide on-call support to help you with learning, behavior, motivation, and more. Prenda also offers free ongoing training to help you understand the art and science of empowering young learners.

Easily set up your microschool with Prenda’s plug-and-play software platform. Manage enrollment, track students’ progress, process payments, even build your own marketing website with Prenda tools. Your dedicated microschool set-up specialist and personal guide coach will support you at every step.

Our Story

A few years ago, I noticed how traditional education was dulling my kids' love of learning. They seemed lost or bored - the conventional structure just wasn't set up to cater to their individual needs. But kids should naturally love learning! So, I invited seven neighborhood kids around my kitchen table to try a different way…

I wondered if there were other passionate people who might want to start their own microschools and help kids love learning again. Prenda has since grown into a full, K-8th grade learning experience. With a research-driven curriculum, real community and support, and plug-and-play software, you'll have everything you need to start your own microschool and help kids discover their love of learning again.

name: Navier AI
brief:
Product: Navier AI
One-liner: Agent-Driven Engineering
Description: Navier AI is building the first Agent-Driven Engineering platform. We believe engineers should focus on designing great products, not wrestling with simulation software. Navier AI makes it simple to run CFD simulations at scale through our web-based platform built on OpenFOAM, the industry-standard solver for CFD. Our AI agents autonomously handle the complex, time-consuming steps of simulation—from geometry cleanup and meshing to solver configuration and cloud resource management.
Industry: Industrials / Aviation and Space
Tags: Aerospace, AI, Automotive
target:
AI for engineers who build hardware.

Navier is an AI engineer for simulation. Describe the study and hand it the geometry; it meshes, solves, checks, and returns an engineering report you can inspect line by line.

Start from the design

Bring the CAD and describe the intent: geometry, operating conditions, what you need to learn. The agent inspects the model and turns the request into a plan you review before anything runs.

Simulation is bottlenecked on people, not physics.

The setup stops being the job.

See the case studies →

Integrations

Twelve open-source solvers run in the app, alongside the issue trackers, wikis, repos and dashboards your program already runs on.

FAQ

The whole loop, on every domain Prism drives: geometry intake, meshing, solver setup, cloud execution, post-processing, and reporting. Twelve open-source solvers run in-app today, covering fluids, structures, heat transfer, multibody dynamics, granular media, electromagnetics, circuits, and system-level models.

No. You describe the study in plain language and upload the geometry. The agent picks the solver, handles its setup, and shows you the plan before anything runs. If your team already has a preferred code, you can name it instead.

They're the same platform. Our forward-deployed engineers run it on your program during an engagement, and partner-tier customers get direct access to Prism, the agentic engineering environment we use internally.

Prism is the desktop environment our own engineers use to run agents against real cases: CAD, meshes, solver runs, and reports in one place. It's available to partner-tier customers.

Every run ships as a report with its assumptions, mesh, boundary conditions, and convergence history. Our validation case studies compare results to wind-tunnel measurements and state where measurement runs out.

Flight, space, and defense; ground vehicles and marine craft; data centers, power, and industrial equipment. If the question is about how hardware behaves under load, flow, heat, or field, it's in scope.

Still have questions? Read the documentation or email support@navier.ai .

Security you can verify.

Put an agent on your next study.

Request access to the platform, or talk to our team about an engagement.

name: Gridware
brief:
Product: Gridware
One-liner: Protecting the grid today, preparing the grid for tomorrow
Description: Gridware exists to enhance and protect the mother of all networks: the electrical grid. The grid touches everyone and makes our modern economy possible. But it’s also fragile. When the grid is compromised, everything grinds to a halt, and the consequences can be dire: wildfires burn, land is destroyed, property is damaged, progress stops, and lives are lost.
Industry: Industrials / Energy
Tags: Hardware, Climate, Energy, Enterprise Software
target:
Protecting the Grid Today, Preparing the Grid for Tomorrow .

You Can’t Fix What You Can’t Sense .

Electric utilities are expected to maintain near-perfect uptime, but they typically only learn of hazards like fallen limbs or damaged power lines after they cause outages or disasters. This gap, known as Hazard Awareness Delay, leads to expensive outages and public safety risks.

Pinpoint Hazards .

We’ve pioneered a new kind of grid intelligence—a platform that provides constant visibility into real-time electrical, physical, and environmental conditions by capturing information directly at the pole. This new class of technology is called Active Grid Response. It is defined by immediate detection, precise localization, detailed identification, and even monitoring during outages.

Developed in Partnership With Utilities .

Power companies need a partner. Using our platform, crews can get to the right location, with the right gear, armed with the right information. Together, we can make the grid safer, smarter, and more responsive.

Built by a Lineman for Linemen .

We understand the rigor required to do this work. We’ve met the men and women that work on the lines, and we know what they’re made of. They’re relentlessly committed to getting the job done. And we’re relentlessly committed to giving them the tools they need to do it.

Changing the Way You See the Grid .

With more than 90 million field hours and counting, Gridware is already detecting the small changes that lead to big problems. Together with utility companies, we’re preventing hazards from causing harm. We’re helping crews restore power quickly and safely. And we’re extending the life of assets in the field. Let’s create a smarter, stronger, more resilient grid—together.

Sign Up for the Gridwire Newsletter

Our monthly look into the innovations shaping a more reliable and responsive electrical grid. From field-tested pilots to real-time hazard intelligence, see how utilities are closing the Hazard Awareness Delay one insight at a time.

name: Capveon
brief:
Product: Capveon
One-liner: Turning infrastructure demand into action
Industry: Government
Tags: GovTech
target:
Operationalizing American infrastructure.

The operating layer for infrastructure

Capveon holds everything your business knows in one model: the feeds you buy, the systems you run, the machines in the field. It automates the work between them, from the funding action to the defect code, and the gain shows up in margin.

The premise

Your operation is fully instrumented. None of it is operating.

Your business already records almost everything it needs to decide anything. It sits in a dozen tools that can each answer a question and none of which can act on the answer, so the judgement that connects them lives in three or four people's heads. That is key-person risk, and it is priced into every bid you lose and every renewal you defer.

How it works

Everything reads in. One gate writes out.

Purchased feeds, the systems you already run, and the machines in the field all enter as the same kind of fact. Everything that leaves passes a person first: an opportunity in your CRM, a priced scope, a work order.

Purchased feeds

Dodge · ConstructConnect · GovWin · Citylitics · SAM.gov

Systems of record

Salesforce · HubSpot · your ERP · project files · every bid won or lost

Robotics and field telemetry

inspection crawlers · survey drones · SCADA and pressure · machine control · fleet position

The public record

board packets · capital plans · budgets · specifications · award tabulations

One governed model

Ontology

Assets, contracts, crews and documents, typed and linked

Agents

Named readers with a fixed grant. Every claim cites its document

Automation

Versioned workflows, with a trace per run

Approval queue

A person on every irreversible write

Your CRM

An opportunity, with the exact field changes spelled out

A priced scope

Routed to whoever can authorize the work

A work order

On the asset that produced the finding, in your CMMS

Reports and API

The monthly your CFO reads. The API your team queries

Where it runs

Built for the people who own the asset.

Two kinds of buyer: the people who own the asset, and the people who sell into it — including the distributors in between. The model changes shape by industry. The machine does not.

Owners and operators

Telemetry from the pumps, the survey flights, the work orders, the permits and the as-builts, held as one model. The renewal plan and the procurement packet get drafted out of it.

Capital programs

Public works and DOT

name: Cua
brief:
Product: Cua
One-liner: Give every agent a cloud desktop
Description: Give every agent a cloud desktop. Built for Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, and any computer-use agents.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Open Source
target:
Scale computer fleets for every agent

Run computer-use agent training, eval, and data-generation workloads in parallel on Linux, Windows, macOS, and Android machines. Fork from snapshots, reproduce failures, and turn agent activity into training data.

Cua ecosystem integrations

Where generic GUI sandboxes stop.

Run one rollout layer across four OS families.

Browser and code work.

Run Ubuntu containers or full VMs with browser, terminal, Python, and package installs.

Native desktop work.

Run Windows 11 and Server 2025 for native apps, legacy software, and file workflows.

Fleets on Apple Silicon.

Run Sequoia and Tahoe on Cua's patented virtualization stack, built to scale to thousands of machines.

Touch-first workflows.

Run Android VMs, install APKs, and automate taps, swipes, and multi-touch.

From one sandbox to coordinated fleets.

Open-source control and eval layers: Cua Driver · Cua Bench · Lume

It starts with Cua Driver, powering computer-use in Hermes, Clicky, H Company , and Factory Droid .

Cua Driver

The open-source background computer-use driver for native desktop apps. It lets agents click, type, scroll, inspect accessibility trees, and capture window state through the same MCP/CLI surface without stealing your cursor or focus.

Open-source and MIT licensed. One binary can run as an MCP stdio server, long-running daemon, or one-shot shell command on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

Train against the environments, or take the verified data they produce.

Two ways to consume the same fleet, and either way the hard part is verifying the data.

Scale computer fleets with usage-based pricing.

Run GUI Docker, QEMU, and Apple VZ sandboxes locally with the open-source Cua Sandbox framework. Use Cua Fleet when your workloads need more concurrency.

Local workspace on Ubuntu 24.04

One-liner: Petcube is on the mission to improve lives of pets and pet owners…
Description: Petcube is a company reimagining pet care, and using technology to keep people connected with their pets. Its first product, Petcube Camera, is an interactive pet monitor with real time video and built-in laser pointer. It allows pet owners to watch, talk to, and play with their pet from their smartphone, no matter where they are. Founded in Kyiv in 2013, Petcube was funded on Kickstarter and became one of the most successful crowdfunding pet products in history.

Smart AI-Powered Alerts Save Lives

Petcube Cam saved my dog from harm! One day, my pup knocked a mirror off the wall, shattering it on the floor. Petcube immediately notified me, and I saw the shards of glass everywhere. While I was at work, I texted my roommate, who quickly cleaned up the mess. Thanks to these alerts, my dog was spared from getting injured.

My cat, Ziggy Spice Williams, has asthma and needs constant monitoring. One day, while I was at work, Ziggy had a major asthma attack. Thanks to a Petcube Care sound notification and camera’s rotation function, I saw her coughing and wheezing behind the table. I rushed home, gave her medication, and took her to the vet.

Petcube's real-time alerts saved our dog's life. While me and my wife were out of town, we checked our Petcube Cam and noticed our dog acting strangely. Zooming in, we saw severe hives covering his body. We rushed home and found two sting bites on his neck. Thanks to Petcube, we were able to take him to the ER vet in time. Petcube's smart alerts truly make a difference in emergencies.
