name: Sidekick
brief:
Product: Sidekick
One-liner: AI agent that manages manufacturing operations over text
Description: Sidekick is an AI agent that manages manufacturing operations over text. Workers text problems, photos, or voice memos in any language; it answers from the company's own documents, creates and routes the work order, and syncs with the software the company already runs. No app, no login, works on any phone. It watches connected machine data and texts the right worker the moment something starts drifting, before it becomes downtime.
Industry: B2B / Operations
Tags: SaaS, B2B, Manufacturing, AI Assistant, Industrial
target:
Sidekick is an AI agent that manages frontline operations over text.

Workers text a problem, Sidekick handles it, and every fix is remembered. Managers save 6+ hours a week, and the knowledge that usually walks out with your best people stays. No app, no login, any phone.

How the agent runs

Connect your plant

Machine data and fault feeds on one side, SOPs and manuals on the other. Sidekick reads the documents and starts watching the readings.

It runs the floor

It flags drifting equipment, answers from your own docs, opens and routes work orders, and escalates to the right manager the moment it should.

It writes down what it learns

It records the know-how in your veterans' heads and keeps every fix, so nothing retires when they do.

It writes the business down while it runs it.

Sidekick does not file this away as a side effect. Every alert it raises, every answer it gives, and every workaround a supervisor texts back lands in a searchable plant history your company owns — and becomes documents on demand. When a veteran retires, their know-how stays.

A searchable plant history. Ask what worked last time and get the exact fix, who did it, and when — citing the document, page, and revision, or the supervisor who confirmed it. Nothing it tells the floor is untraceable.

Documents it writes for you. It drafts the handbook, the safety procedure, and the FAQ out of the work it just did, and translates them for the crews that need them.

It doesn’t wait to be asked. It watches the floor.

Sidekick connects to your plant systems and machine data. When a reading drifts out of range or a fault code appears, it reaches out to the right worker on its own — before anyone reports it, before it becomes downtime.

That is the difference between software your team has to remember to open and an agent already working when the shift starts.

Every issue, one thread.

Workers report problems in plain language: a broken freezer, a stuck door, a missing SOP. Sidekick triages it, opens the work order, routes it, and keeps everyone posted in the same thread. No forms, no tickets, no chasing.

It trains the floor as it goes.

It onboards new hires over text: bite-size modules, walkthrough videos, and quizzes delivered in the flow of work. It verifies each step and shows managers who is trained and certified at a glance.

name: Flux Auto
brief:
Product: Flux Auto
One-liner: Physical AI for Warehouses and Factories
Description: Flux is building physical AI to automate material movement in warehouses and factories on legacy vehicle fleets. Using Flux's solutions customers can reduce their dependency on human drivers, while also increasing productivity and reducing operating costs. Flux is currently deploying with customers like Walmart, Daimler, Bajaj, Cummins, Mahindra Logistics across warehouses, fulfillment centers and factories.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Autonomous Trucking, Hard Tech, Robotics, AI
target:
Your fleet, Fully Autonomous.

Zero new equipment. Live in a fortnight.

Flux retrofits your existing material handling fleet with Odin , AI-powered autonomy. No rip-and-replace, no infrastructure changes.

Warehouses & Factories are under pressure

Labor costs are surging. Turnover is high. New robotic forklifts cost $100K+ each. There's a better way - bring physical AI to your existing fleet.

Three steps to an autonomous fleet

No warehouse modifications. No months-long ramp-up. Just install, tune, and run.

Our engineers install the Flux ARK hardware kit on any forklift or material handling equipment you already own - pallet jack, reach truck, or tow truck. Two days per unit, with zero structural changes.

Lidar-based maps of your warehouse helps Odin learn your workflows, detects pallets, obstacles, and pedestrians in real time. No floor markings, stickers, tapes or infrastructure changes needed.

The fleet operates autonomously across multiple shifts, and multiple operation types. Your team gets a real-time fleet dashboard to assign tasks, track progress and generate reports.

Built for the floor

We deploy where work is hard, margins are thin, and uptime is non-negotiable.

Automate pallet movement from inbound dock to put-away and outbound staging - 24 hours a day without a driver.

Move raw materials, WIP, and finished goods between locations reliably - without tying up your limited workforce on transport tasks.

Handle peak surges, night shifts, and seasonal variations without adding headcount. Flux Bots scales with your operational load.

Pays for itself in days

One kit operating across shifts, achieve positive ROI within days. Without buying a single new machine.

See Odin on your floor

Thanks for reaching out. Someone from our team will email you within 48 hours with next steps and a personalised ROI estimate for your fleet.

name: herdr
brief:
Product: herdr
One-liner: building the open agent runtime
Description: Developers don't run one coding agent anymore. They run fleets of them — for hours, sometimes days — across laptops, servers, and sandboxes. Keeping track of that work is the new bottleneck: which agent is blocked, which one finished, which terminal is it in, and why did everything die when the laptop closed. Herdr is the open-source home for that work. A background server owns the agents' terminal sessions on each machine, so the work survives disconnects, closed lids, and dropped SSH.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, AI Assistant
target:
Run them anywhere. Leave them running.

Herdr is where your coding agents live. However many you run, across however many projects, each in its own terminal. Walk away and they keep working. Come back from any machine and they're where you left them.

Three workspaces, four agents, two of them mid-task. Nobody is attached to any of it right now.

Always running. →

Herdr isn't an app you keep open. It's a server running in the background, and the terminals live inside it. Close the lid or drop the network and the agents keep working; restart the machine and Herdr brings the layout back and resumes their sessions.

You never hunt for the stuck one. →

Herdr reads every pane and marks each agent working, blocked or idle. When one stops and needs an answer it says so, so you don't go pane by pane looking for whoever is waiting on you.

Agent-native. →

The CLI and the socket API are the same surface agents drive. They split panes, start each other, prompt each other, and wait until another agent is genuinely blocked instead of firing keystrokes and hoping.

Runs what you already run. →

Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode, Grok and the rest. Herdr doesn't wrap them or replace them, it just owns their terminals — one binary for macOS, Linux, and Windows.

All your machines. One Herdr. →

Your laptop, the desktop upstairs, a server you rent. Add them over SSH and their workspaces and agents sit alongside your local ones. Switch machines without opening another client. Disconnect and they keep working.

Same machines. No SSH setup.

Connect your own machines to Herdr without configuring SSH. We're building it next.

Give them somewhere to live.

One command, and nothing else about your setup changes — the agent CLIs you already run keep working exactly as they did, except now they don't stop when you do.

Product: Sunset
One-liner: Find and move money after a death
Description: Sunset can track down bank accounts, retirement accounts, investment accounts, property and more for families after losing a loved one. Sunset will close those accounts and move the money into a Sunset estate account to manage.
Industry: Fintech / Consumer Finance
Tags: Fintech, Consumer Finance
target:
Find what they left behind

Use Sunset's estate settlement platform to discover and secure all financial accounts and assets after a death, at no cost to the family.

Loved by families, trusted by financial institutions

Sunset helps families handle the financial side of losing someone. On average, families save over 200 hours by using Sunset to settle their estate.

Stress Free

"Simple and stress free from start to finish. Even the life insurance claim."

Easy Process

"Step by step made it easy to get things done without feeling buried."

Surprising Finds

"I found all of my grandma’s accounts in just a couple days, including one we didn’t even know about. I cried when I realized how much work it was going to take, but Sunset made it quick and easy."

Felt Cared For

"I felt cared for the whole way. Even when we had to handle my dad’s small business account."

Made It Doable

"Made something complicated, like probate papers, feel doable and not so scary."

Less Scary

"They made the hard parts less scary. I just answered a few questions and felt guided."

Clear Next Steps

"Clear steps, no stress. I always knew what came next, even for life insurance and car titles."

Felt Protected

"I felt safe the whole time. They kept an eye on things for fraud so I could focus on selling the house and being with my kids."

Guided the Whole Way

"They made a hard process simple and stress free. It felt like they were walking me through step by step."

Peace of Mind

"Nothing happened unless I said so. Knowing my dad’s retirement money was safe until I was ready gave me peace of mind."

Step by Step

Sunset works with all national and local institutions

Always know what comes next

Simple, expert-guided process

Just answer one question at a time, and Sunset takes care of the rest. Our estate settlement process removes the busywork while you stay in the driver's seat.

No out-of-pocket costs or fees

At your pace, in your control

Go as fast or as slow as you'd like. Nothing moves forward without your approval. Sunset keeps everything secure, organized, and protected from fraud.

name: Skyscrape
brief:
Product: Skyscrape
One-liner: Skyscrape makes temperature-responsive insulation
Description: Skyscrape makes temperature responsive fabrics for a new type of clothing. These fabrics literally change shape in response to a change in temperature: the fabrics become thicker and insulate more as the temperature drops, and they become thinner and insulate less as the temperature rises again. This "intelligent insulation" has no wires or sensors, and the fabric's shape-changing behavior comes from a natural materials response.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Smart Clothing, Sustainable Fashion
target:
COLDER DAY

THICKER JACKET

WARMER YOU

A New Type of Fabric

Skyscrape's insulating fabrics literally change shape when temperatures change.

With this environmentally responsive insulating fabric inside, your jacket could be both thicker when it's cold and thinner when it's warm.

Skyscrape is working hands-on with the best brands to create a new type of environmentally responsive apparel.

Changing With You

Inside, outside, day, and night, Skyscrape's fabric helps keep you comfortable in the wide range of conditions we all experience in our daily lives.

A morning or afternoon bicycle commute

Before and after sunset in the park

Walking to and riding the subway

Hiking as the fog rolls in

Traveling to new cities

Reinventing Comfort

Skyscrape's fabric is i ntelligent without wires and responsive without sensors. The structure of the yarns and fabric drive the lofting action of the insulating fabric.

As temperature changes, the yarns in the fabric expand and contract, causing it to bend, increasing or decreasing the thickness and insulation of the fabric. The fabric itself acts as a thermometer, with the thickness and insulation increasing in the cold and decreasing in warm weather.

Made By Us

Skyscrape was born out of a vision to create clothing that could respond to its environment, to create clothing so thermally comfortable that it would impact how we heat and cool buildings.

Pursuing this ambitious idea required an interdisciplinary team of scientists, engineers, designers, and weavers, all working together to design and build new machines and new processes. With funding from the United States Department of Energy and Y Combinator, Skyscrape was able to create the first temperature-responsive fabrics.

To move this invention from the laboratory to the factory, Skyscrape partners with a world-class brands that share the vision for environmentally responsive clothing.

Invented, Designed, and Made in America

Portland, OR

name: Humance
brief:
Product: Humance
One-liner: AI that keeps complex construction projects on schedule.
Description: Humance is building an AI-powered project management tool for the construction industry, where work is highly coordinated and delays are costly. Large projects involve dozens of interdependent workstreams where a single setback can cascade unpredictably through the entire timeline. Today, most project managers track this manually — tracing dependencies by hand, updating schedules, and notifying stakeholders one by one.
Industry: Real Estate and Construction / Construction
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Construction, B2B, Scheduling
target:
Construction, unblocked.

AI reviews the paperwork first, so your team can make faster calls. Catch conflicts and risks before they slow the job down. Take the quiz to find where to start.

AI doesn't build buildings. It reads paperwork faster than any human can.

Construction teams depend on accurate documentation to build safely, stay aligned, and protect the project. But submittal reviews, RFIs, change orders, and scattered email threads eat up valuable time and pull teams away from the field.

Humance works like the sharpest backup on your team. It makes the first pass through the paperwork, cuts through the noise, flags potential conflicts, and prepares the next action—so your team can review faster and decide with confidence. You stay in control while the AI agent helps preventing slips, mistakes, delays, and budget surprises.

Our approach

Built Around Your Workflow, Not Ours.

does not offer one-size-fits-all software. We work with you to integrate custom AI agents into your existing project workflows, documents, and tools. Combining world-class AI and digital expertise with construction domain knowledge, we help clients deploy AI agents that deliver value from day one, with minimal onboarding or training.

Discover

Map how your team reviews documents, makes decisions, and manages approvals today.

Connect

Bring together the documents, email threads, and systems your team already relies on.

Engineer

Build and tailor AI engines around your use case, requirements, and workflow priorities.

Deploy

Place the AI agent at the touchpoints where it creates the most value, and design the intuitive interface if needed.

Evolve

Launch in real workflows from day one and continuously improve the AI agent through team feedback.

When Construction Meets AI Agent

See how construction teams are putting AI to work through concrete examples from Humance. Explore honest lessons, and practical ideas you can apply.

Humance Leadership

Too much technology tells you how to work. We differ.

We’re engineers, designers, and data scientists. We listen first, then build. We take the time to understand your business's current strength and workflow, respect your unique challenges, and design solutions rooted entirely in your reality.

Sunny

Formerly at Google

"I build reliable, scalable systems, with a focus on the details that make them work in the real world."

Design & Strategy

Soy

Formerly at BCG Digital Ventures, Boston Consulting Group

"Design is how we turn powerful technology into something people can understand and act on."

Data & Intelligence

Yon

name: Estimote, Inc.
brief:
Product: Estimote, Inc.
One-liner: Location intelligence platform
Description: Estimote, Inc. is the creator of SpaceTimeOS, a revolutionary operating system installed directly on physical spaces to make them programmable and interactive. Small sensors are attached to walls and items. They talk to each other and communicate with with servers. A digital copy of the physical space is created in the cloud, allowing for inch-precise and real-time tracking of assets, people, and vehicles.
Industry: B2B / Supply Chain and Logistics
Tags: Developer Tools, Indoor Mapping, IoT
target:
Indoor location and sensing

Spaces should be intelligent and things should magically happen at the right place and at the right time.

LOCATION INTELLIGENCE SOFTWARE

Your digital twins brought to life

SpaceTimeOS

It is a next-generation operating system that you install on your physical spaces. It makes them intelligent and programmable. You can run apps and create prompts directly on your physical business.

NEXT-GEN SENSORS AND TAGS

Make your spaces truly smart

Use UWB for superior accuracy and intelligence or BLE for mass and rapid deployments

UWB DL-TDOA

Anchors

Install anchors on walls or ceilings to help compatible phones find their position indoors. Use them for directions through airports, hospitals and stores.

UWB anchors are fixed devices that send radio signals from known locations. A compatible phone compares when those signals arrive to work out its own position inside the building.

How the phone finds its position

The technique is called downlink time difference of arrival, or DL-TDoA. Signals from different anchors travel different distances. Their arrival times give the phone information it can use to calculate where it is.

Location stays on the phone

The phone does not need to send its position back to the anchors for this calculation. Your app can use the result for navigation, and people decide whether to share it. Many phones can listen to the same infrastructure.

UWB RADAR

Sensors

Detect presence and movement from reflected radio signals. Useful for room occupancy and automation, without asking people to carry phones or tags.

UWB radar sends short radio pulses and measures the signals that bounce back. Movement changes those reflections, so software can detect that someone has entered a room or approached an area.

Sense activity without a camera

Radar measures radio reflections instead of recording images. People do not need a phone or wearable, and the sensing does not depend on visible light.

For developers

Use signal processing or machine learning to turn the measurements into events your app can use. For example, occupancy could control lighting or help a team see which meeting rooms need attention. The detail you can detect depends on sensor placement and the software model.

Wearables

A wearable button for check-ins and requests for help, with a built-in connection to your software.

name: Prodigy Research
brief:
Product: Prodigy Research
One-liner: Training the world's best AI model for quantitative finance.
Description: Prodigy is the frontier AI trading research lab. We've trained the world's best foundation model for quantitative finance. We've already achieved more than 100% returns in live trading over the course of our YC batch, doubling our capital while major indices were flat. Our founders previously worked on a trading desk at Jane Street, trained frontier AI models at Google DeepMind and shipped cutting-edge AI at Apple to billions of customers. Join us as we use AI to solve the market.
Industry: Fintech
Tags: Reinforcement Learning, Finance, Investing, Trading, AI
target:
Frontier AI for quantitative finance.

Prodigy Research is an AI research lab training the world’s best foundation model for quantitative trading. We are trading live in the financial markets and have generated index-beating risk-adjusted returns.

Michael Wang

Co-founder, CEO

Trained SoTA foundation models including Gemini 3.1 Pro as a senior researcher at Google DeepMind. Previously worked at Jane Street, one of the world's most successful trading firms, where he held a Series 57 securities trader license.

Google DeepMind · Jane Street Capital

Yuhua Wang

Co-founder, CTO

Built cutting-edge AI at Apple serving models and agents to billions of users across the world. Previously scaled the flagship AI platform at Salesforce to millions of queries per day.

Apple · Salesforce

SoTA in live trading.

Our proprietary trading model and agent harness outperform Claude Fable and GPT-5.6 Sol on trading and financial-reasoning tasks.

Up +140% over our YC batch on delta-neutral strategies.

Our live systems more than doubled our capital over our YC batch, while major indices were flat or down. Thanks to our rigorous and comprehensive risk controls, we’ve never had a down week.

Why now

Going after the largest TAM on Earth.

Trading firms generated hundreds of billions in profit last year, and this number is growing quickly YoY. Global equities markets now exceed $150 trillion in capitalization, with average daily volume in U.S. equities growing more than 40% annually.

Want to learn more? Let’s talk.

name: Userlens
brief:
Product: Userlens
One-liner: Let agents talk to your customers
Description: Companies today are growing faster than ever with smaller teams. The best AI-native companies don’t just need more users - they need more of their users becoming power users. Userlens makes it possible for lean teams to drive product adoption proactively, at scale. Userlens is building the AI product adoption expert. Our goal is to help every user at every company get more value from the product they already use.
Industry: B2B / Productivity
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Productivity, Enterprise Software, AI Assistant
target:
Let agents talk to your customers.

Built for B2B SaaS product and PLG teams, Lumi turns each customer's product behavior into timely, personal guidance, so every user knows what to do next.

Product adoption at the speed of shipping.

As your product changes, Lumi finds the users falling behind and gives each one the guidance they need to catch up.

Lumi starts with a campaign: an adoption goal, and the audience that qualifies for it. Then guidance personalized for every single one.

True personalization that gets attention.

Lumi reads what each user has actually done, then writes the one message that makes sense for them.

Your pricing rollup, as a plan

From You, you@yourproduct.com, to Maya.

Hi Maya,

Tuesday you ran the pricing rollup six times before it landed.

Planning it first would have made run one the one that stuck.

Here it is as a plan:

Your 42nd session, as a plan

From You, you@yourproduct.com, to Arjun.

Hi Arjun,

You have run 41 sessions without opening plan mode once.

Planning first is the difference between steering and re-rolling.

The runs you walked away from, as a plan

From You, you@yourproduct.com, to Lena.

Hi Lena,

This week you abandoned three runs midway.

Planning it first would have shown the dead end before the run, not during it.

Your one-shots, as a plan

From You, you@yourproduct.com, to Theo.

Hi Theo,

Every session so far has been a single prompt, then a rewrite of the result.

Planning it first would move the rewriting to before the run.

Your 90-minute prompt, as a plan

From You, you@yourproduct.com, to Ines.

Hi Ines,

Tuesday you spent 90 minutes redoing one prompt.

Planning it first would have spent ten of those minutes, once.

The spec you paste every start, as a plan

From You, you@yourproduct.com, to Sam.

Hi Sam,

Every session of yours opens with the same pasted spec.

Planning it first would make the spec a saved plan you run, not a paste.

The migration task, as a plan

From You, you@yourproduct.com, to Rosa.

Hi Rosa,

Tuesday you retried the migration task five times.

Planning it first would have split one hard step from four easy ones.

Guidance instead of templates. The brief is yours. The words are Lumi's.

Description: The best way to know if someone is a good fit is to work with them on a project before you hire them full-time. At Pangea, we make contract-to-hire easy and painless. We'll work with you to provide a shortlist of top, interested candidates. Our talent have an average of 5-7+ years of experience in design, growth, ops, product, and engineering, and are primarily based in the USA (but also extend to 155 countries)

target:

Hiring fractionally is easier than you think

Anam

Jae

Arianna

Work with world-class talent

Top fractional design roles

Frequently Asked Questions

Why choose Pangea for your marketing and design needs?

At Pangea, we redefine how businesses connect with top-tier marketing and design talent. Our platform bridges the gap between organizations looking for world-class expertise and professionals who are ready to deliver exceptional results. Whether you're a startup, a growing company, or an established enterprise, Pangea provides access to a curated network of fractional talent, enabling you to scale your projects efficiently and cost-effectively.

We understand that finding the right talent can be a challenge. That’s why we leverage cutting-edge AI matching technology to ensure that every hire perfectly aligns with your project goals, company culture, and budget. Our platform is designed to take the guesswork out of hiring by connecting you with experts who specialize in everything from content marketing and graphic design to user experience (UX) design and social media strategy. This means you get more than just a freelancer—you gain a trusted partner invested in your success.

How does Pangea work for businesses?

Pangea is more than just a marketplace—it’s a talent ecosystem built around your needs. The process begins with your job posting, where you outline your project requirements, timelines, and desired outcomes. Our sophisticated AI instantly matches you with pre-vetted professionals who meet your criteria. From there, you can review candidate profiles, conduct interviews, and select the perfect match for your team.

Once the project kicks off, our platform continues to support you every step of the way. From streamlined communication tools to secure payment processing, Pangea ensures a seamless experience for both clients and talent. Need to scale up quickly? Our talent pool includes professionals who are not only skilled in their fields but also experienced in working remotely, enabling you to expand your team without the overhead of traditional hiring.

name: Entocycle
brief:
Product: Entocycle
One-liner: Automated factory to produce insect protein for farm animals.
Description: The Insect Farming Company. We’re developing the world’s most efficient and sustainable way to produce protein. Insects are rich in protein and are a natural component of the diets of many fish and free-range poultry. Our technology is significantly more efficient at producing protein than traditional methods of production as our insects are vertically farmed and not restricted to floor space or area.
Industry: Industrials / Agriculture
Tags: Food Tech, Agriculture
target:
WASTE TO VALUE

Powered by insects

Our Technology

Controlled Environment

Fully climate-controlled, modular facilities standardise production conditions allowing high-yield production to be deployed anywhere in the world.

Precision Agri-Tech

Real-time, AI-driven insect monitoring systems count and track insects over their lifecycle. It’s the data-driven predictability that powers our facilities.

Fully Automated Facilities

Efficient and scalable, automation means lower operational costs of facilities, driving higher business-model profitability.

Our Partners

Infrastructure Investors

A new class of high-margin de-risked circular economy projects, deployed at industrial scale.

Waste Managers

Converting problematic waste-streams into commercial value with demonstrable ESG benefits.

Food Producers

Generate diversified and predictable revenue streams with insect bioconversion.

For Plant and Crop Nutrition

Organic fertiliser (frass) is a co-product of insect farming, composed primarily of insect excrement. It’s a natural fertiliser that’s been proven to improve soil health and promote plant growth.

Our Industrial Proving Ground

UK Centre For Insect Technology

“CfIT is not a pilot facility, it’s our industrial proving ground. Every component of our solution spent two years being performance tested in real-world industrial conditions. That data and insight is the battle-testing that de-risks ramp-up and turns a biological process into an industrial-scale reality.”

James Millar, CEO - Entocycle

Partner with us on turnkey sustainable waste-to-value projects.

name: dili
brief:
Product: dili
One-liner: Automating Compliance for Construction
Description: Dili (YC S23) is building the most reliable AI automation for compliance in real-world industries. Across energy, infrastructure, datacenters, advanced manufacturing, and construction, Dili has run prevailing wage, apprenticeship, & other labor compliance to help customers secure over $1 billion in federal funding. Dili is building the AI system of record to help physical industries track compliance, analyze labor and spend, run payroll, and more.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
Tags: Fintech, B2B, Compliance, Energy, AI
target:
AI. Built for the Built World.

AI-powered compliance automation for developers and EPCs. The operating system for construction projects.

Billions of dollars in funding and tax credits are tied to prevailing wage and apprenticeship compliance. Dili is the platform EPCs and developers use to protect that funding, automatically.

AI That Understands Construction Energy Infrastructure Manufacturing

Five minutes a week per contractor. Drag-and-drop payroll uploads. Dili replaces the 32-hoop compliance gauntlet with a platform your subs will actually use.

From prevailing wage tracking to apprenticeship monitoring to project closeout, Dili integrates every layer of project compliance through a unified AI platform, with real-time synchronization across every stakeholder.

Built by the team that automated $2T+ in compliance across one of the most heavily regulated industries on earth. Now building frontier AI for energy, infrastructure, construction, and advanced manufacturing.

Built for Every Stage of the Project

Whether you need full-service monitoring, automated software, or a retroactive compliance review, we have you covered.

Full-Service Compliance Monitoring

End-to-end prevailing wage and apprenticeship monitoring backed by former DOL and EPC compliance experts. We handle everything so you can focus on building.

Look-Back Compliance Assessments

Retroactive compliance reviews that others won't touch. We audit historical payroll data and surface issues in days, not months. Before auditors do.

Automated Software Platform

Drag-and-drop payroll uploads, automated wage validation, and real-time dashboards. Five minutes a week per contractor.

Alterations & Repairs Monitoring

Specialized prevailing wage monitoring for A&R projects with unique classification and wage determination requirements.

Ongoing Monitoring

Continuous real-time compliance oversight with automated alerts, exception flagging, and weekly status reports across your entire project portfolio.

Compliance Training

Hands-on training for contractors and project teams on prevailing wage, apprenticeship requirements, and certified payroll, so compliance starts at the source.

End-to-End Project Intelligence

Automated Certified Payroll Review

Dili's AI engine ingests certified payroll reports from any format (PDF, Excel, CSV) and automatically cross-references them against prevailing wage requirements, flagging discrepancies before they become audit findings.

Intelligent Wage Determination

Direct integration with SAM.gov provides current prevailing wage rates across all 50 states and counties. Dili automatically maps the correct wage determination to each project based on location, trade, and project type.

Apprenticeship Compliance Tracking

Monitor apprentice-to-journeyman ratios, track registered apprenticeship hours, and ensure compliance with state and federal apprenticeship requirements across every project and subcontractor.

AI-Powered Audit Engine

name: Weave
brief:
Product: Weave
One-liner: AI to understand and then route engineering work
Description: Weave builds AI to understand engineering work from prompt to production. We show how much faster AI is making your team, how that impacts quality, and what it's costing. Weave then takes that data to route all of your tasks to the most cost efficient model without compromising speed or quality. Weave is used by over 500+ orgs from startups to public companies like Robinhood, Posthog and Telnyx.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: B2B, Analytics, AI
target:
Engineering and token intelligence to optimize the SDLC

Weave shows you the ROI of every AI dollar, benchmarked against thousands of engineering orgs.

Trusted by 500+ engineering organizations. Startups to Fortune 100

Engineering intelligence

Measure your SDLC from prompt to production

Weave combines LLMs and ML to analyze every action from prompt to production. Combining novel AI metrics with DORA, SPACE, surveys, and more into a single pane of glass that shows where your engineering team is getting stuck.

Know where your team stands

Tokens show consumption, not value. Weave scores cost, efficiency, and quality.

AI impact, engineer by engineer

Scroll horizontally to see all columns →

Token intelligence

Know where every token goes.

See how your return on token spend benchmarks across 1000+ orgs.

Prompt Router

Route to the most cost efficient model, without compromising speed or quality.

The Weave router looks at every prompt, classifies it and sends it to the right model. It learns based on your feedback as an individual and an organization.

Get your router key

Generate a bearer token. The token never leaves your device unless you choose to export it.

Run one command

The installer detects your clients and points them at the router. One env var per provider, written automatically. Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google.

Work as usual

Each request is now routed to the model with the best quality-per-token. The client is unaware of the proxy.

Agent Wooly

Wooly looks at all of your data and suggests where and how to improve. You can call on Wooly in the app or through an MCP.

What do you want to know?

Every answer is grounded in your own records, and cites them.

Customer Story

Built for teams that can’t afford compromise

SOC 2 Type II certified. Regular third party audits. SSO and role-based access. Your data stays secure, and your team is live before the end of the day.

brief:
Product: Blue Onion
One-liner: Financial data layer for AI-powered finance and accounting
Description: Blue Onion is the data backbone for tomorrow’s AI-powered finance teams — a subledger platform that transforms messy, scattered transactions into clean, reconciled, and automation-ready data.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Finance
target:
Turn e-commerce financial data into a business edge.

Blue Onion turns fragmented data into a clean, contextual source of truth - so your close runs faster, your margins are clear, and your AI actually works.

Connects to everything. Works on day one.

Whether you're on Shopify or a custom stack, Blue Onion plugs in natively - no engineering, no rip-and-replace.

Built for anyone who cares about the bottom line.

Every module runs on one source of truth.

Before any module runs, Blue Onion builds your source of truth - reconciled across every system and shaped by deep e-commerce expertise. Without it, AI agents hallucinate, margin questions go unanswered and reconciliation becomes an endless project. With it, your team and your agents operate from the same, reliable foundation.

See what automation could save you.

Estimate what a single source of financial truth could save you each year, automating time-consuming manual finance work and turning scattered transaction data into clean, reconciled books.

Cash recovery covers cash that used to slip through, miscoded fees, missing deposits, unmatched refunds that went unnoticed or surfaced too late to fix. Daily visibility means you catch it while you still can.

Your actual numbers depend on volume, channels, and setup.

Let us customize your ROI savings. See yours in a live demo.

Watch Blue Onion work.

Don't just close the books. Tell the whole story.

See how Blue Onion gives your controller, your CFO, and your data team one trusted source of financial truth - from day one.

name: Mentra
brief:
Product: Mentra
One-liner: Building the open source smart glasses operating system.
Description: Mentra is building the open source operating system for smart glasses. The smart glasses hardware is finally ready, so we're building the OS and app store to power the next computing platform.
Industry: Consumer / Virtual and Augmented Reality
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Hardware, Consumer, Open Source, AR
target:
AI Glasses for Frontline Workers

Mentra Live

Upgrade your workforce with point-of-view video calling, AI assistants, and automatic work documentation.

Backed by

Document work while it happens.

Capture structured documentation with photo evidence without stopping the job or reaching for another device.

Call an expert anywhere.

Let a remote expert see what the worker sees and guide the work in real time, hands-free, using your Microsoft Teams account.

Guide the next step.

Deliver instructions and AI assistance through audio while the worker’s hands stay on the task.

Deploy smart glasses software across your workforce.

Distribute Mentra applications to the people and devices that need them. Update software without replacing hardware or rebuilding the deployment.

The job becomes the record. Techs work normally while Mentra captures the job from their point of view. Photos, narration, and events become structured documentation while the work happens.

Sovereign AI, private data, full ownership.

Choose your AI

Use the models and AI services your organization chooses, including fully air-gapped deployments.

Run it on your infrastructure

Deploy on-premises, in your cloud, or across both. You decide where every workload runs.

Keep your operational data private

Keep video, audio, and workflow data inside systems your organization controls.

Own your software

Deploy private software and integrations without publishing them to a consumer store.

AI for the other 70% of the world's economy.

The Global Economy

AI has already transformed knowledge work. Software engineers, lawyers, and managers use AI all day to do their job better. Yet technicians, inspectors, delivery people, and other physical world jobs experience little impact from AI, because AI can't work alongside them in the physical world.

Mentra builds the interface that lets AI access the real world. Mentra Live captures what your best people know and puts it in the ear of the person doing the work. It confirms steps as they go and writes records back so the job is documented while it's being done instead of reconstructed from memory at the end of a shift.

Speakers, a microphone, and an HD camera on every worker's head puts them in a live feedback loop with AI. Let's collaborate to upgrade your workforce today.

The job becomes the record. Smart glasses watch while you work, combining photos, narration, and context into structured documentation while the work happens.

Deploy software across your workforce.

Mentra Live vs Meta Ray-Ban

In the News

“ Mentra is targeting openness, modularity, and utility. ”

Beyond whiteboards

Each Allume board is like a whiteboard that can hold even more whiteboards. Stay in the ideation flow, worry about organizing later. Your boards grow organically over time, as you develop an idea or work on a project.

Calm your mind and your eyes

Allume feels cozy and comfortable, whether you prefer the warmth of light mode or the focus of dark mode. A distraction-free environment designed to flow with your mind.

One canvas for anything

Developing an idea starts with collecting inspiration and stray thoughts. Allume lets you put everything on a single canvas: writing, scribbles, notes, images, videos, PDFs, web links, and any other files. Lay out all the raw materials, then connect the dots with ease.

The Inbox

Thoughts don't march in straight lines — they leap, spiral, and discover. Your cards can follow along, tucked into the Inbox at the left edge of your creative space.

Collaboration

Add collaborators to an Allume workspace to plan and strategize your next steps together. They'll feel right at home with live cursors, comments, following, and templates.

… and plenty less

name: BIOS Health
brief:
Product: BIOS Health
One-liner: Neural interfaces to understand and use nerve data in medicine.
Description: BIOS Health was previously called Cambridge Bio-Augmentation Systems (CBAS) and focused on prosthetic neural interfaces as a first market. Now we use
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Neurotechnology
target:
CODE THE BODY CAN RUN

BIOS IT4 DATASET

Visualisation by Andreas Nicolas Fischer

Decades ago, DNA sequencing opened up a new field of precision medicine. Now, AI is doing the same for the nervous system and BIOS is at the forefront, building the infrastructure on which future neural treatments will be discovered, developed, and delivered.

The brain sends our bodies vast amounts of information every second of every day, but when those signals are faulty it can cause our organs and systems to malfunction, causing disease. BIOS has developed neural interfaces and AI that, for the first time, can read and write the body’s neural data, or ‘code’, to understand and

correct those signals in real-time.

BIOS envisions a new field of digital health treatments that use this new data-driven insight from the nervous system to create better, more targeted medicine. Neural digital therapies will use our read/write software to understand the effects on the nerves, leading to more precise creation of pharmaceuticals and software-delivered treatments direct to the nervous system.

REAL-TIME INSIGHTS

With our proprietary neural interface and AI platform, BIOS has the unique ability to measure and analyse neural data in real-time in both acute and chronic settings.

NEURAL BIOMARKERS

BIOS has developed a programming language or 'code' for the nervous system that can be used for discovering groundbreaking insights into diseases, and creating new treatments.

PRECISION HEALTH

Neural digital therapeutics are created by using real-time feedback from the nervous system. This makes better, more targeted drugs, and opens the door for software-delivered therapies.

HUMAN TECHNOLOGY

We envision a future where we have control over our bodies and lives, enabling radically improved, seamlessly experienced healthcare. We want a better quality of life for everyone living with

lifelong conditions.

ECG

RESPIRATORY PRESSURE

BLOOD GLUCOSE

NEURAL CONTROL OF THE HEART

Cardiovascular diseases are responsible for a third of all deaths globally. BIOS has launched the Autonomic Therapy Initiative (ATI) to discover more about the causal links with the nervous system and to drive forward neural therapies and treatments that could help millions of people.

INTRODUCING BIOS NEURAL DOSING

Your response to a therapy is as unique as your DNA. BIOS’s Neural Dosing Platform combines high-quality neural recordings with powerful AI and ML techniques to personalise neural therapies in minutes.

PARTNER WITH BIOS

name: KorrAI
brief:
Product: KorrAI
One-liner: Traceable AI for billion-dollar infrastructure.
Description: We exist for the moments when the data is overwhelming, the timeline is unforgiving, and the decision can't wait, giving every stakeholder the clarity and confidence to act on high-stakes decisions across critical infrastructure, mining, and commercial insurance. TRAIL is the AI workspace for site risk assessments, investment decisions, hazard identification, and continuous monitoring across the full project lifecycle.
Industry: Industrials / Energy
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Construction, Insurance, Mining
target:
AI for mandated risk monitoring on critical infrastructure.

TRAIL monitors and analyses physical risk across an asset's life, from operation to closure. Every answer carries evidence an engineer can sign and a regulator can check

We present you how TRAIL & our team have been helping mining and infrastructure use cases.

TRAIL solves a real problem for operators: seeing risk in critical infrastructure early enough to act on it. That is what sets it apart.

Built for Every Step of the Risk Workflow

Site Due Diligence

Screen ground conditions, karst, settlement, and groundwater risk remotely before you commit to a site.

Hand owners, insurers, and lenders a timestamped, provenance-backed baseline.

Operational Monitoring

Monitor the signals that map to your site’s credible failure modes (deformation, water, and change, etc) so anomalies arrive with context.

Know where to focus inspection and capital first, down to zones and features on site.

Mine Closure Monitoring

Turn decades of fragmented records into jurisdiction-specific closure and dam-safety submissions.

Map site evidence to credible failure modes, immediately, to support proactive risk management

The Status Quo Leaves Risk Teams Exposed

Higher-stakes than ever

Hundreds of mines are entering closure, data centers are being sited quarterly, and power grids and heavy civil infrastructure are expanding exponentially.

Built for a climate that changed.

These critical assets now sit in conditions their original designs did not anticipate, exposed to highly dynamic weather, volatile ground behaviour, and other risks outside baseline assumptions.

Stretched too thin to stay ahead

Data is abundant, but broken. As the specialist workforce retires out, risk surfaces before anyone has the capacity to see it coming.

A workspace that understands your site and your workflow.

Site Ontology

For every project, TRAIL builds a digital site ontology that ties each feature, a tailings cell, a foundation, a corridor segment, to its instruments, imagery, design basis, and history. Context, not just documents.

Proprietary Data

Calibrated satellite InSAR (historical and ongoing), optical-imagery history, on-demand high-resolution tasking, geological models, an in-built elevation model, and hydrology risk models. Evidence layered on your map and fed into every assessment.

Human & AI Collaboration

Share TRAIL with your team

Explains how we help move mine risk management from reactive to proactive, what closes the gap and how we do it, with a case study.

Built For Complex Projects

Data Centers

Mines

Energy & Utilities

Civil Infrastructure

name: Nimble
brief:
Product: Nimble
One-liner: Data-driven teacher hiring
Description: Nimble uses predictive analytics to give every K-12 student access to excellent teachers. Our smart applicant tracking system (ATS) leverages a predictive model to help school districts identify and hire the best educators for their classrooms.
Industry: Education
Tags: Education, Machine Learning, SaaS
target:
Bright futures start with great teachers

Nimble brings clarity, speed, and confidence to K-12 hiring by partnering with states to connect schools and teachers

One connected platform for the people who power our schools

Access one hub to manage your job search and find your perfect fit.

Support districts and gain real-time workforce insight statewide.

Reach more great teachers and fill your roles faster.

Showcase your school and connect with qualified teachers.

Ensure all students have access to exceptional teachers

No one enters education because it’s easy. We do it to shape lives and futures. Yet too often, talent gets stuck in systems that slow progress: teachers can’t find the right roles, policymakers lack the data they need, and districts lack the modern tools to keep up. We’re here to change that. Built with districts, grounded in research, and designed for real-world constraints — Nimble brings real-time visibility, simple tools, and a ready network of educators. Because when schools can hire better, every student benefits.

From insight to hire, one platform for every step of the process

Track teacher vacancies statewide in real time. Nimble Insight gives education leaders the visibility to spot shortages early, understand trends, and direct resources where they’ll make the greatest impact.

Find and fill teaching roles faster. Nimble Discover connects teachers and districts in one simple hub — making every opportunity visible and every classroom easier to staff.

Open pathways into the classroom. Nimble Navigate makes it easy for future teachers to find the right licensure route, and for states and districts to strengthen their talent pool.

Match teachers and schools statewide. Nimble Connect uses intelligent matching to pair educators and principals in one network, helping classrooms find the right fit, faster.

Hire smarter, faster, and together. Nimble Hire brings districts and teachers into one connected system — helping schools reach more great candidates and helping teachers apply to every role with ease.

Trusted by leaders shaping the future of K-12 hiring

“In all the years and in using the different platforms, Nimble is, by far, the easiest to maneuver, the most user-friendly, and the best I’ve used in the search and hiring of candidates.”

“Wow, I’m speechless! I don’t think we’ve ever seen more than 90 applications in a hiring year and now to see more than 400 interested profiles. This is sleek and something we’ve been waiting for.”

John Witchel

CEO of King Energy Ex-CTO/Co-founder of Common Assets (acquired by Solar City)

Purpose-Built To Supercharge Your Projects’ Performance, Productivity & Precision

Integrated & Unified

Perl Street is the only market solution purposefully built for the financial needs of distributed energy and infrastructure assets. It is the much needed integrated and unified operating environment for developing and financing projects.

A singular, accurate and real time system of record

Easy to use, SaaS based cloud infrastructure

Scaleable

Perl Street gives comptrollers and analysts the tools they need to slash the time needed for repetitive and in-depth tasks, a superpower that only gets more impactful the larger the portfolio grows.

Fast & Easy Implementation

brief:
Product: Boya
One-liner: Corporate Expense cards and Spend management for businesses in Africa
Description: Boya Makes it easy for businesses in Africa to issue corporate expense cards instantly and great software to control and track spending. For example, if you run a pharmaceutical company, you can use Boya to instantly issue Visa cards to sales and marketing teams and get real-time visibility and control over their spending. 50M+ businesses in Africa have no easy way to streamline and track their employee spending in real-time.
Industry: Fintech
Tags: FinOps, Fintech, Payments, B2B, Neobank
target:
Business spend, made smarter.

We've made business spend smarter by combining cards, expenses and bill payments All-in-one with ultimate control and visibility for finance teams.

Trusted by thousands of companies across industries at scale

All in one spend platform

Corporate cards

Unlimited virtual and physical cards with in-built spend policies.

Corporate mobile money

Issue company mobile money wallets with dynamic controls. Finally, stop sending company funds to employees' personal phone numbers.

Expense management

Set spending policies with real-time approvals—Automate expense reports and taxes.

Bill payments

Collect, approve, and pay incoming invoices in one place while keeping stakeholders in sync.

Business accounts

Your own business workflow and bank account working seamlessly together as one.

Subscription management

Easily handle recurring payments with virtual cards and intelligent tracking in one central place.

Boya API

Easily connect Boya to your critical business tools.

Budgets

Stay ahead of costs with centralized budget visibility across the organization.

Policies & Workflows

Bring your company’s unique spend rules into Boya, then automate them across your organization.

Control card spend at scale

You’re in control. Set spending limits, track in real-time, and block merchant categories. Limit staff spending with inbuilt policies to ensure everyone is on budget and confirm transactions via SMS. The Cards are accepted globally at ZERO fees, from online marketing spend, transportation, subscriptions, supermarkets, hotels, and restaurants.

Issue expense mobile money wallets

Stop sending mobile money to employees' personal phone numbers. Enable your teams to make mobile money payments directly from corporate wallets with in-built control and policies. Limit staff spending by only using the amount allocated to their individual or team wallets.

Automate expenses. ‍ Save time

Automatically collect receipts compliant with tax laws and easily categorize with the right cost labels. Access every transaction instantly and know exactly who’s spending on what. Track your top-line spending or drill into any transaction in real-time on a single dashboard from any device.

Streamline vendor payments

Automatically collect vendor invoices and get them ready for payment with your custom invoice approval workflows to put budget owners in control of every transaction. With bank transfers, mobile money, and multiple currency support, you can make payments globally with a single tool.

Accurately close books ‍ 5x faster

Automatically reconcile transactions and receipts in one place. Receipts are captured in real-time on the mobile app, so you don’t spend days charging your teams for paper receipts. Boya will code and report the expense – no manual data entry is needed! Zero paperwork.

name: Airbyte
brief:
Product: Airbyte
One-liner: Context layer for production-grade AI agents
Description: Airbyte Agents is the context layer your AI agents query before they act. Features the Context Store, which unifies entities across Salesforce, Stripe, Zendesk and more. Use it from the UI, your LLM via MCP, or our SDK. 40% fewer tool calls, up to 80% fewer tokens. Airbyte Data Replication is the leading open data movement platform that empowers data teams in the AI era by transforming raw data into actionable intelligence. https://github.com/airbytehq/
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, Open Source, Data Engineering, AI
target:
The context layer for AI agents.

Connect once, and your agents get pre-indexed context with real-time read/write access to your CRM, support desk, code repos, and more.

AI agents

Why agents struggle in production

MCPs give agents access. They do not give agents a map.

Every answer becomes a live crawl across Salesforce, Zendesk, Stripe, and the rest. The agent burns tokens, hits rate limits, and can only find what it already knows to ask for.

Raw API responses pile up in the context window before the agent starts reasoning. It spends tokens cleaning data instead of answering.

Every source is another round trip. Five systems means five sequential API calls, each with its own rate limits, before the agent can begin.

APIs only answer questions you already know how to ask. The agent can't see what data exists or how it connects.

The architecture

One layer between your systems and your agents .

Airbyte connects your tools, builds your context, and serves it to any agent you run.

Governed context layer

AI AGENTS

Connect to your sources from our library of managed connectors with built-in OAuth.

Airbyte builds your context. Replicated, unified, and indexed before any agent runs. Always fresh.

Every agent queries one layer instead of crawling live APIs.

It's your context. Choose where your data lives, keep it portable, never locked in.

For developers

Your harness. Our data infrastructure.

Use the CLI, SDK, API, or MCP with any agent framework. Airbyte manages the connectors, OAuth, tool schemas, and action execution underneath your stack.

Description: We're a women’s health company making personalized reproductive health information more accessible, earlier in life. We make the same laboratory tests that were previously confined to fertility clinics more accessible for women at home. By arming women with powerful information about their reproductive health, Modern Fertility is closing the fertility information gap and enabling women to own the decisions impacting their bodies and futures.
Industry: Healthcare / Consumer Health and Wellness
Tags: Fertility Tech, Consumer Health Services, Women's Health
target:
Want kids one day?

Modern Fertility is now part of Ro. See more

Modern Fertility will guide you through your fertility hormones now, so you have options later, whether you want kids now or in the far-off future.

Modern Fertility Hormone Test

Best seller

Prenatal Multivitamin

Ovulation Test

Pregnancy Test

Physician expertise – we work with top fertility specialists to help you navigate your fertility journey

Affordable and convenient – we make it easy to get health insights at home

Learn about your fertility

Better understand and track where you stand when it comes to your fertility, from the comfort of your home

Get pre-conception support

Understand and prep your body while you’re trying to conceive.

Our Fertility Philosophy

Power in info

Understanding your fertility now gives you more options later. Healthcare can often feel reactive, and fertility is no different. But “just wait and see” isn’t good enough. As the fertility experts at Ro, we help you find power in being proactive. No matter where you are in your fertility journey, we meet you where you’re at and give you the info you need to plan ahead and build toward the future you want.

Access for all

Everyone deserves unbiased, clinically sound reproductive health info. We validated the fertility hormone test with clinical studies and every sample is tested in a CLIA and CAP accredited lab. We also offer free virtual events with fertility experts and medically reviewed articles you can trust. With Modern Fertility joining Ro, we are now also able to offer more clinical experts and reproductive health services to support you and your health journey.

Personalized results

We offer in-depth reports tailored for your hormone levels and goals, an app where you can get personalized predictions for your cycle and fertile window, and a free virtual community where you can meet people like you.

We’ll meet you where you are — because everyone’s reproductive journey is different.

Moving science forward

Most of what we know about fertility today is based on studies of infertile populations. (Plus, there’s a massive research gap ). ‍ We publish reports in peer-reviewed science journals and present our IRB-approved studies to the American Society for Reproductive Medicine.

We need more research to change reproductive health for the better — and we’re just getting started.

Get the real scoop

Hear it from our customers

Becca Kufrin

Want kids one day?

Modern Fertility is now part of Ro. See more

Modern Fertility will guide you through your fertility hormones now, so you have options later, whether you want kids now or in the far-off future.

Modern Fertility Hormone Test

Best seller

Prenatal Multivitamin

Ovulation Test

Pregnancy Test

Physician expertise – we work with top fertility specialists to help you navigate your fertility journey

Learn about your fertility

Get pre-conception support

Understand and prep your body while you’re trying to conceive.

Our Fertility Philosophy

Power in info

Understanding your fertility now gives you more options later. Healthcare can often feel reactive, and fertility is no different. But “just wait and see” isn’t good enough. As the fertility experts at Ro, we help you find power in being proactive. No matter where you are in your fertility journey, we meet you where you’re at and give you the info you need to plan ahead and build toward the future you want.

Access for all

Everyone deserves unbiased, clinically sound reproductive health info. We validated the fertility hormone test with clinical studies and every sample is tested in a CLIA and CAP accredited lab. We also offer free virtual events with fertility experts and medically reviewed articles you can trust. With Modern Fertility joining Ro, we are now also able to offer more clinical experts and reproductive health services to support you and your health journey.

Personalized results

We offer in-depth reports tailored for your hormone levels and goals, an app where you can get personalized predictions for your cycle and fertile window, and a free virtual community where you can meet people like you.

We’ll meet you where you are — because everyone’s reproductive journey is different.

Moving science forward

Most of what we know about fertility today is based on studies of infertile populations. (Plus, there’s a massive research gap ). ‍ We publish reports in peer-reviewed science journals and present our IRB-approved studies to the American Society for Reproductive Medicine.

We need more research to change reproductive health for the better — and we’re just getting started.

name: Astra
brief:
Product: Astra
Description: Astra is the vertically integrated payments platform designed for product teams and developers. Get started with a simple API integration and add unparalleled payments speed and security.
target:
Build instant payment experiences, not infrastructure.

Astra is the Payments Cloud: a vertically integrated, compliance-first platform that lets any company move money instantly across any payment rail. One integration, every use case.

Three ways to move money. One integration.

Your team integrates once. Every payment type after that is a setting you turn on, not a new build.

Push payouts to debit cards in seconds

Send funds to any US debit card over Visa Direct and Mastercard Move, with money available the moment it lands. Apply a transfer fee and payouts become a revenue line.

Fund accounts the moment users sign up

Pull money in instantly so the first deposit lands now, not in three to five business days. Activate users before the wait turns them into churn.

Run faster, lower-risk ACH

Same-day clearing and built-in screening on the rail you already use. Ship faster transfers and cut return risk without rebuilding a thing.

Gateways process transactions. Astra runs your money movement.

Processing is the small part. The real work is everything around it: KYC, AML, fraud, ledgering, reconciliation, disputes, and treasury. A gateway leaves all of it to you, and each piece becomes another vendor, another contract, another thing that can break. The cost shows up long before your first payment clears.

Astra does all of it, processing included, with one integration. Your team ships product instead of holding a payments stack together, and every new flow is a configuration, not another build.

Nothing to maintain

KYC, AML, ledgering, reconciliation, and fraud screening run as part of the platform. Your engineers move on to product work instead of holding the stack together.

Everything on one API

Every rail, plus compliance, controls, and treasury from the same foundation. With a gateway, each of those is a separate vendor you source and wire together yourself.

Live in weeks, not quarters

One API integration covers the building blocks a gateway would have you build from scratch, so a new use case is a setting, not a multi-month engineering cycle.

One Payments Cloud. Every part of money movement.

A gateway only includes one generic processing capability. A Payments Cloud natively supports many workflows, organized around a unified, integrated architecture’s single foundation. Hover over any layer or capability to see what it does.

Intelligent Routing

Picks the optimal rail and path for every transaction, tuning speed, cost, and success rate in real time rather than by static rules. Failover built in.

Cloud Services

name: Planet A Foods
brief:
Product: Planet A Foods
One-liner: Building the next generation food ingredient champion.
Description: Imagine a world without chocolate. Horrifying, right? But the supply of cocoa is endangered and chocolate is as bad as meat for our planet. We make future-proof chocolate using precision fermentation. Doing this, our chocolate is 10x more sustainable and 20% cheaper than conventional chocolate. In order to mimic the organoleptic properties of chocolate (tender, smoothly melting taste release) we are working on the flavor itself but also on replacing the cocoa butter.
Industry: Consumer / Food and Beverage
Tags: Climate, ClimateTech
target:
Future-proof, resilient food ingredients

We're building the next generation of ingredients for the food industry. Our scalable fermentation platform creates resilient, future-ready solutions for global supply chains – with exceptional taste, high cost efficiency & availability.

ChoViva No Added Sugar

The No Added Sugar trend is reshaping consumer expectations. With our latest ChoViva No Added Sugar recipe, brands and retailers can unlock new opportunities in a category where taste remains non-negotiable.

The food world is undergoing a transformation. Changing weather paterns, crop diseases, and shifting political landscapes are challenging traditional value chains. At Planet A Foods, our mission is to secure the supply of the future by creating a new generation of ingredients.

Portfolio

Chocolate alternative

Our chocolate alternative ChoViva offers the same flavor, snap, texture and versatility as chocolate. It can be processed in multiple ways and for a wide range of sweet creations. ChoViva is already produced at scale with more than 10,000 tons annually.

Cocoa butter alternative

Our cocoa butter alternative introduces a whole new dimension in the confectionery industry. This revolutionary innovation offers the same properties and application possibilities to traditional cocoa fat. It's currently in development.

Launch your next product with our game changing food ingredients

Our ingredient alternatives unlock a world of innovative recipes and inspiring food ideas, creating new opportunities to captivate and grow your customer base.

We provide premium-quality ingredient substitutes tailored to your recipes, brands, and manufacturing processes – for any kind of food application.

Our ingredients give you more independence from fragile supply chains, reducing your exposure to market disruptions and supply shortages.

Indulgent pleasures now and in the future – our ingredient substitutes maintain your brand’s quality promise also for younger target groups.

Join the world's leading companies and become a partner

Snacks & confectionery

Wide range of applications from coated nuts and bars to fillings and pralines

Bakery

Versatile usages for bakeries and baked goods, such as cakes, donuts, croissants and more

Plant-based sweets

Suitable for halal, kosher, vegan and vegetarian products

Cereals & Biscuits

Delicious alternatives for cereals, biscuits, and more

Seasonal Products

Hollow figures, fillings and more for celebrations such as Easter or Christmas

Ice Cream

Inspiring alternatives for ice cream creations

Our partners

Planet A Foods supports companies along the entire production process to jointly achieve the best outcomes.

name: Agent FM
brief:
Product: Agent FM
One-liner: One group chat to hear and steer your coding agents.
Description: Agent FM is a desktop app that gives engineers one group chat to hear and steer their coding agents. Instead of manually bouncing between different claude code and codex sessions, and combing through walls of text to monitor agents, engineers just tune in to Agent FM. Agents share important progress updates, blockers, assumptions, and decisions in the group chat. Engineers get live text and audio updates and respond right from the chat.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, Productivity
target:
AI teammates to hand off your busywork

Describe the outcome. Agent FM completes the work across your files, browser, and inbox.

Start free. No credit card required.

Drafted reminders for all 9. Review before I send?

42 sorted. Only 3 actually need you.

6 records updated, next steps logged.

Slides 4-7 refreshed with fresh numbers.

Flights + hotel held for your approval.

How it works

Say what you want done.

Agent FM plans the steps and works on its own. Follow along anytime.

Review and sign-off.

Finished work comes back to the same chat. Nothing goes out without your OK.

Works with your existing tools

Do your best work 10x faster

Data & spreadsheets

For turning directories, portals, and long pages into clean rows.

See what Agent FM can do for your whole team.

Get help with pricing and plans, schedule a walkthrough, explore use cases for your team, and more.

Frequently asked questions

Anyone whose work sprawls across tabs, files, and tools. Founders, chiefs of staff, operations and sales teams, team leads, and product and engineering managers are our power users. We are onboarding more professionals every day. If repetitive computer work eats your week, Agent FM is for you.

Describe the outcome you want. Agent FM plans the steps, works across your inbox, files, and the sites you already use, and brings back finished work for your sign-off.

Yes. It works wherever your work happens: Gmail, Outlook, Drive, Sheets, your calendar, Slack, and any other website, signed in or not. Nothing to migrate, and you decide what it can touch.

Yes. Agent FM works on macOS 14+ and Windows, in the apps where you are already signed in. It asks before anything is sent or submitted, and every step it took is there to review.

Consider it done.

Product: Andy AI
One-liner: Faster clinical documentation for home health nurses

Our software saves $8B a year; Tiantian was previously a PM at Google’s healthcare business and Max was a staff engineer on the health team at Apple. Andy benefits nurses and the agencies that employ them. Agencies that use Andy see up to 45% more detailed charts, 2x greater nurse productivity, and timely submission (no more billing delays!) With Andy, clinicians get their evenings back.

Tags: Artificial Intelligence, SaaS, Health Tech, B2B, Healthcare

Andy is the leading home health AI platform that handles documentation, quality and compliance — freeing up your team to focus on patient care.

Trusted by top performing agencies

Everything you need to get charts out timely

No more tedious back-and-forths. Andy’s all-in-one scribing, QA and coding delivers an accurate and defensible note every time.

Ambient scribing

Tap 1 button to record the patient visit. Andy listens and writes the narrative, meds, vitals, M0000 items and more, to help clinicians focus on the patient.

Get scribing, QA and coding for less than the cost of outsourced QA or coding

Capture every last clinical detail to justify higher functional impairment and higher comorbidity adjustments.

Clinicians get their evenings back and see more patients. Our most productive clinicians went from 3-4 SOCs prior to Andy, to 7 SOCs per day with Andy.

From SOC through discharge, Andy makes life easier for everyone on your team.

Live at US seafood distributors today, returning 40%+ of order-desk time to selling. Founded by a seafood distributor and a Gemini builder.

Save hours on manual order processing and eliminate costly mistakes.

From customer messages to accurate orders in your management system.

Asakana captures orders from the communication channels your customers already use , understands multilingual messages and complex order details, and creates an order draft directly in your existing ERP . Potential issues are flagged for review, and your team can edit and approve the order in the system it already uses.

Fewer mistakes. Faster order processing. Reliable order-taking—24/7.

Built for food distribution. Excels in seafood.

From produce and meat to specialty foods and seafood, Asakana processes the shorthand, product aliases, grades, pack sizes, units, and customer-specific preferences that make food orders complex. Seafood is one of the industry’s most demanding categories—and where our expertise runs deepest.

and ANY other food category...

Quick integration with your existing communication channels and ERP.

Asakana supports email, phone calls and voicemails, WhatsApp, text messages, WeChat, and sales rep free-text orders. Every channel is consolidated into a single, structured workflow.

name: Infera
brief:
Product: Infera
One-liner: Control lab instruments with natural language.
Description: Describe an experiment in plain English, and Infera turns it into a validated, instrument-ready run across the equipment your lab already uses. Infera handles the protocol logic, vendor-specific scripts, data, inventory, and institutional knowledge in one system. An AI-native compiler for the lab: one system from intent to execution.
Industry: Healthcare / Industrial Bio
Tags: SaaS, B2B, Biotech, Automation, AI
target:
The operating system for your laboratory.

A real 15-second capture of the current Infera demo. The product is early, but the core flow is concrete: describe the experiment, compile the run, and review what the lab should execute.

Infera turns an experiment you describe in plain English into a validated, instrument-ready run, on the instruments you own, or by hand at the bench.

Prefer to talk first? Book a 30-min call →

Your instruments aren't the bottleneck. Getting a run onto them is.

Labs hold millions in instruments that sit half-idle. Not because the hardware can't do the work, but because every run takes days of proving (by hand) that a protocol written for a person will actually run on the machine.

An AI can write the instructions (code or procedure) in seconds. But writing them was never the hard part. On real hardware, a wrong guess ruins the sample, so the real work is proving the run is physically possible, running it, and capturing data you can trust. That's what Infera does in your lab.

The model only reads. The rest is deterministic “An algorithm whose behavior can be completely predicted from the input.” NIST Dictionary of Algorithms & Data Structures ↗ .

Deterministic means fixed and checkable. The same description always compiles to the same run.

Less time. Less waste.

Infera fills every gap and shows you each fix before it runs. Nothing changes without your sign-off. From there it optimizes the run for less waste and faster runs start to finish.

When the run finishes, it pulls the data off the instrument and hands you a first read, already knowing the protocol that made it.

Even the parts you do yourself.

Infera spells out every setting and has you confirm it before the run, so you're never guessing at the dial.

Not every step runs on a robot. Some you do by hand, like pipetting, gels, and fermentation. Some you run on instruments you operate yourself, like a centrifuge, a vortex, or a plate reader. Infera walks you through all of it: what step you're on, what goes where, what to set, and what to confirm before you move on.

So a person at the bench never leaves a blind spot in the run.

Validated before it runs

Dead ends, timing conflicts, and deck collisions surface at compile, not halfway through a run.

Reusable by anyone

Stdout/stderr for every container, structured JSON parsed automatically.

On-CPU flame graphs per process, always on. Spot hot paths and memory leaks without redeploying.

K8s Events

Every event stored, indexed and queryable correlated to the workload they affected.

Deployments, ConfigMaps, CRDs, and more stored with full change history for point-in-time diffs.

Every rollout tied to commit, author, PR, and the workloads it touched.
