name: Biodock
brief:
Product: Biodock
One-liner: Cloud AI microscopy automation
Description: Biodock's cloud platform accelerates microscopy analysis, automating months of microscopy analysis and infrastructure to minutes with our end-to-end AI architecture. Scientists enjoy auto-scaling storage, GPU compute, and 30-50% more accurate analysis. We're building an amazing experience to translate microscopy images to therapeutic insights for academic and enterprise scientists.
Industry: Healthcare / Therapeutics
Tags: Deep Learning, SaaS, AI
target:
Deep AI for biological images.

Speed up scientific discovery with AI image analysis.

Join world-class researchers and scientists across the globe.

Train AI from your images, run in one click. No code required.

Biodock makes deep AI easy to train, run, and interpret, radically improving the accuracy and consistency of image analysis.

Create a model in 15 minutes of work

Biodock's AI-assisted labeling allows you to build and improve powerful analyses in a fraction of the time.

Label super fast with Click AI, powered by SAM

AI click allows you to identify cells, structures, or even entire tissue regions in an interactive format.

AI-assisted labeling and improvement

Use your previous models to automate 95% of labels to drive iterative improvement.

Activate and customize your metrics

Once finished, you're ready to run on new images. Customize metrics around area, intensity, colocalization and more.

Your model automates analysis in one click

Your AI pipelines run in a single click from our distributed platform built for scientists, delivering the comparisons you need at any scale.

Blazing fast at any scale

We run your images in parallel on large clusters to achieve up to 3000x acceleration on larger jobs. Start multiple jobs at a time.

Built-in comparison of experimental groups

Compare experimental differences with beautiful custom plots and object-level metrics. Filter subgroups like flow cytometry.

Interactive object viewer and editor

Our interactive viewer allows you to visualize detected objects with overlays and dive into quantitative metrics like area and signal intensity.

Easy to use and understand

No configuration, installation, or code. Biodock's clear online docs and intuitive interface makes onboarding easy for any scientist.

See the platform in a quick demo

See how Biodock works in a walkthrough demo, covering training a model, running it, and configuring it for different scenarios.

End-to-end deep AI platform for scientists

Connect data from anywhere, and easily label and train to create powerful quantitative AI modules. Our powerful compute execution and results dashboard help you run and interpret your analysis quickly.

Organize your files in one place and connect images in from cloud providers like S3, or Drive, OneDrive, Box, or Dropbox. Biodock allows for seamless zoomed viewing on multi-GB images and file sharing with one click.

Collaboratively label your images in our AI Model Dashboard to quickly put together a training set. Then, convert it into a versioned AI pipeline custom built for your images by clicking Train.

name: Invert
brief:
Product: Invert
One-liner: Data analytics software for biomanufacturing.
Description: We build software to manage, analyze, and optimize bioprocessing data. Our initial customers are bio-industrial companies, who produce various products in bioreactors.
Industry: Healthcare / Industrial Bio
Tags: Cellular Agriculture, Machine Learning, Synthetic Biology, Biotech
target:
Infrastructure and intelligence for bioprocess.

Invert connects your bioprocess equipment and data sources across process development and manufacturing. Do better science and move faster than ever, both upstream and downstream.

Tools to speed up science.

Save scientists from grunt work.

Bioprocess teams spend over 50% of their time managing data. Exporting data from instruments, aligning timestamps, normalizing units all costs precious time. With Invert, scientists can focus on the most important work.

Solve problems across unit ops.

Bioprocesses are complex, and no single team member can optimize the whole process. With Invert, data from all teams and sources are easily analyzed and learned from. Customers consistently gain process insights that would have been otherwise missed.

Turn experimental spend into data assets.

Every run represents a significant investment. Process data and learnings are often lost to time. With Invert, every experiment contributes to your team ' s institutional knowledge.

Accelerate your science manifold.

Invert users report doing in minutes what previously took months. Whether writing reports or training predictive machine learning, Invert ' s AI can help turn ideas into reality in minutes.

We’d invested over two million dollars and six months of data science work into a digital twin that couldn’t run. Invert had us live in three days. An AVEVA PI integration would have taken six months minimum — and still wouldn’t have captured everything Invert does.

Customer Stories

Compounding institutional knowledge.

Top-5 Biopharma with Active Digital Twin Program

Operationalized a $2M+ digital twin by closing the Ambr250 data gap.

Global Top-10 Biopharma and Biologics CDMO

Recovering 3,000+ FTE hours per program in CMC biologics development.

Clinical-Stage In Vivo Cell Therapy Company

Unified process data across process development and MSAT.

A fully custom and transparent platform integrated with your systems and ways of working.

brief:
Product: Your inbox is the inbound TMS. Live in 10 minutes
Description: Epoch reads the supplier and forwarder emails you already receive and rebuilds real arrival dates, line by line. No integration, no IT ticket, no supplier onboarding. Connect one mailbox and see your first real shipments today. Free to start.
target:
Your inbox is the TMS. Live in 10 minutes.

Visibility tells you where your materials are. Meridian tells you what it's costing you.

It knows what's inside it, what every day of dwell costs, and what to do about it: priced, ranked, and settled against what actually happened.

Meridian, built into Epoch

Keeps score on itself dismissals included

Meridian snapshots the do-nothing world. Sixty days later: where you were, where you'd have been without us, where you landed.

It learns your network, statistics decide

New detectors proposed from your own history, then five gates test them before bringing a recommendation to you.

Scenario planning your network real hubs, real impact

Close a port or forwarder from your in-transit book. See what strands, and where it breaks first.

Speaks only when it pays silence is the feature

Moves are ranked on expected value minus the cost of your attention. Most never reach you.

We don't need clean data. We need real data. Those are different things.

Your inbox. That's the integration.

Everything Epoch needs already lands in your mailbox every day. One person can connect it, alone, before anyone else needs to be involved.

Read as it arrives

Epoch reads the mail exactly as it arrives. A forwarder's forwarded thread. A supplier writing in their second language. A PDF scanned crooked. A spreadsheet with the part number in the wrong column. An ETA buried in the fourth paragraph of a reply-all.

Nothing to install no IT queue

No connectors, no EDI project. Connect your inbound mailbox in ten minutes. On Microsoft 365 that includes one two-click approval from IT; we give you the exact text.

Nothing to onboard suppliers keep emailing

Your suppliers don't log in and don't change how they write. Epoch adapts to them, not the other way around.

Nothing to clean real beats clean

No master-data project first. Epoch works on the mail you actually get, not the data you wish you had.

Already run a TMS? keep it

Epoch reads what structured systems never see: the exceptions, revisions, and reply-alls where the buffer hides.

One inbox. No integration. Start free today.

Your buffer isn't sized against demand. It's sized against doubt.

Most teams assume their safety stock exists because demand is volatile. It usually doesn't. It exists because nobody can say, line by line, when goods will actually land — so the buffer is set against the worst case, and the cash sits there financing an uncertainty problem.

name: Linzumi
brief:
Product: Linzumi
One-liner: Team chat to command all your company's coding agents
Description: Linzumi is the chat your engineering team uses to direct dozens of AI coding agents. Kick off work, review it, ship it. All from chat. See every agent's work. Unblock the agents that need you from your laptop, your phone, the coffee line. Your teammates see it too. Every decision your team makes compiles into a source of truth - what to build, why it changed, how your agents should act. That same source generates new work and verifies completed work.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, Chat
target:
A chat where work runs wherever it gets unblocked.

Channels your team already knows, with a fleet of coding agents running on your own machine. Talk a change through, watch the diffs land, steer every run — from your phone, your bus, your bed.

Apple Silicon

Now in beta

Watch a fleet of coding agents go to work.

See the chat in motion, then download the macOS app and take command.

Apple Silicon · or sign up on the web

Command your coding agents en masse and on the go.

Steer the fleet from anywhere — your phone, the bus, bed. Every run lives on your own machine and in the thread, watched and logged the whole way.

Linzumi is your codex commander.

Your team in the thread. The fleet on the desk.

Your team steering in the thread, agents building alongside — one channel, one launch, start to ship.

Eyes on every run — and code that runs where you actually ship.

That's the whole job. Today's tools make you pick one or the other.

Lonely Codex in your terminal

You start a 25-minute run, walk to lunch, come back to find it stalled at minute 3 on a yes/no question. Your teammate has no idea what's happening. Your eng lead has no idea what files it touched. The only way to redirect from the bus is to SSH from a terminal app like a maniac.

Sandboxed agents in someone else's VM

Hosted agents solve the watch-it half by running in their own cloud. But now "works for the agent" doesn't mean "works on your laptop." You merge the PR and find the gap at 4pm.

Linzumi gives you both: your fleet on your real machine, your team in the thread, every move logged.

More agents. More leverage.

One operator can steer many agents in parallel — without losing the team's eyes on the work.

You ship more.

Multiple humans steer multiple AI agents in parallel, in one thread. Throughput isn't bottlenecked by any one person's attention. The team you already have does the work of a team twice the size.

You catch problems early.

Teammates jump in mid-run with “wait, do it the other way” before the agent has solidified the bad approach. Problems get caught when they're cheap to fix, not after merge.

You trust the result.

Your team in the thread. The fleet on the desk.

Your team steering in the thread, agents building alongside — one channel, one launch, start to ship.

Eyes on every run — and code that runs where you actually ship.

That's the whole job. Today's tools make you pick one or the other.

Lonely Codex in your terminal

You start a 25-minute run, walk to lunch, come back to find it stalled at minute 3 on a yes/no question. Your teammate has no idea what's happening. Your eng lead has no idea what files it touched. The only way to redirect from the bus is to SSH from a terminal app like a maniac.

Sandboxed agents in someone else's VM

Hosted agents solve the watch-it half by running in their own cloud. But now "works for the agent" doesn't mean "works on your laptop." You merge the PR and find the gap at 4pm.

Linzumi gives you both: your fleet on your real machine, your team in the thread, every move logged.

More agents. More leverage.

One operator can steer many agents in parallel — without losing the team's eyes on the work.

You ship more.

Multiple humans steer multiple AI agents in parallel, in one thread. Throughput isn't bottlenecked by any one person's attention. The team you already have does the work of a team twice the size.

You catch problems early.

Teammates jump in mid-run with “wait, do it the other way” before the agent has solidified the bad approach. Problems get caught when they're cheap to fix, not after merge.

You trust the result.

Save. Read. Grow.

name: Gamgee
brief:
Product: Gamgee
One-liner: Curing cancer. Starting with dogs.
Description: ​Gamgee began with Rosie, founder Paul Conyngham’s dog. After surgery, chemotherapy and immunotherapy failed, Rosie was given months to live. Paul used AI and genomic analysis to identify targets in her tumour, then worked with scientists at UNSW to produce what is believed to be the first fully computationally designed mRNA cancer vaccine delivered to a dog.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
Tags: Biotech, Genomics, Oncology, AI
target:
The first personalized cancer treatment protocol for dogs.

Introducing our first product ze-ets-001

Hi, I'm Rosie and this is my dog dad Paul. Welcome to GAMGEE.

Gamgee was founded by Paul Conyngham after he designed a personalised mRNA cancer vaccine for his dog Rosie. Now, we’re bringing that hope to more dogs with cancer.

Currently running clinical trials in Australia and inviting registrations of interest worldwide.

From registration to treatment.

If selected, GAMGEE manages the entire process end to end.

Review & intake

We review the details you share and reach out to discuss your dog's case. If there's a fit, we move forward together.

Vet outreach & collection

We work with your vet to confirm the diagnosis, collect a tissue sample, and send it to our genomics lab.

Vaccine creation

We analyse the data, identify the mutations driving the cancer, and design a personalised protocol.

Treatment

Your dog receives their personalised treatment from a veterinary oncologist. We monitor response.

One breakthrough treatment later, two more years were added to Rosie's life.

In 2024, my dog Rosie was diagnosed with mast cell cancer. We tried surgery, chemotherapy, immunotherapy. Nothing worked. The vets gave her months to live. One breakthrough treatment later, two more years were added to Rosie's life.

Every dog deserves a fighting chance. The breakthrough already exists. Our Mission: make it available to all.

Stay informed

Get occasional updates on our research, clinical trials and progress in personalised cancer care for dogs.

One quick security check:

You’re on the list.

Thank you for joining. We’ll keep you updated.

If your dog has been diagnosed, we'd like to hear from you.

We'll help you determine whether GAMGEE is right for your dog and, if it is, get you connected with the right team.

Let's tell this story together.

Get in touch and we'll connect you with the right person on our team.

Quick security check

Message sent!

Thanks for reaching out. Someone from our team will be in touch within one business day.

Help us reach every dog that needs this.

Whether you're a vet, oncologist, lab, or researcher - we'd love to connect.

Enquiry received!

Our partnerships team will review your message and follow up within two business days.

Your dog's case could help thousands more.

Anonymised clinical data from canine cancer cases strengthens our models and accelerates the science.

name: Screenhero
brief:
Product: Screenhero
One-liner: Collaborative Screen Sharing — you each get your own mouse, and…
Description: Screenhero lets you screen share any application with anyone, no matter where they are. It's super simple and blazing fast. You each get your own mouse pointer, and you're both always in control. It's designed for collaboration, not just broadcasting your screen. It's like Google Docs for any application on your computer.
Industry: B2B / Productivity
Tags: Team Collaboration, Collaboration
target:
Work alongside your team with huddles.

Bring the feeling of working side-by-side to a virtual space that lets you collaborate and co-create live.

Gather ‘round with the flip of a switch.

Huddles happen right in Slack. Instantly connect over audio or video and share screens so you can get more done where you’re already working.

increase in productivity among teams that use huddles 1

Let your notes take themselves.

AI in Slack keeps you focused on the conversation by taking notes for you. Key takeaways, action items, and who said what are all neatly organized when the huddle ends so everyone can stay aligned.

Learn more about AI in Slack

Liven up the conversation.

Emoji reactions. Colorful backgrounds. Delightful effects. In huddles, teams can express themselves to make being together even better.

If it’s shared in a huddle, it’s saved in Slack.

Any links, documents, and messages shared during a huddle are automatically saved once the huddle ends, so you can easily jump back to them for reference.

"Huddles make a huge difference in terms of being flexible and responsive. We can hop on to address any challenge and innovate so much faster.”

Slack for new users

Introducing new ways to work side by side in huddles

From Huddle to Action: How to Take Effective Meeting Notes

Solve problems aloud with huddles

Frequently asked questions

Huddles are perfect for informal online meetings or spontaneous working sessions. You can start a huddle to ask a quick question, start a brainstorm, resolve an issue, or work together on slides or a document.

All huddles start as audio-only conversations. If you are looking to collaborate deeper with your team, you can turn on your video, share your screen, send messages in the huddle thread, and use fun reactions throughout the course of your discussion or working session.

All huddles start from where you are already doing your work – in a channel or direct message. Simply click on the headphones icon in the conversation header to start a huddle with your team.

Huddles are available on desktop, mobile and iPad so you can start (or join!) a huddle wherever you’re working.

name: Studio
brief:
Product: Studio
One-liner: Accurately simulate market response at scale
Description: Studio is a simulation lab studying how humans and societies respond to new ideas, and is building the first software models that can accurately predict that response. Instead of creating digital twins of survey respondents, Studio builds live market models of interconnected audience segments from real, traceable consumer-behavior data.
Industry: B2B / Analytics
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B, Analytics, Market Research, AI
target:
Simulate every future. Engineer the response you want.

Studio builds a living society of your market and plays every version of your decision through it, so you commit to the one your customers reward.

A thousand worlds, watched at once

Test every version of your launch: a price, a placement, a promotion. Watch the outcome each version creates, and commit to the one you want. Scroll to review 3 of them.

The display goes untouched. Shoppers walk past without slowing down.

Half the aisle notices. Interest without repeat visits.

The shelf empties by week 3. This is the future you green-light.

It starts by listening

Studio reads the record your market already leaves, public chatter, reviews, and press, alongside your own data: sales, loyalty, app events, and demographics. Everything lands as evidence about groups, never about a person.

Your market, modeled as a society

A whole market is too big to predict and one customer is too noisy. Studio models the groups in between, and the influence running between them, because groups behave in patterns you can trust.

Buy on habit. Moved by availability and routine, not ads.

Influences: deal-triggered, vocal skeptics . The dotted lines on the model show where this group moves first.

Cohorts are named for how they decide, never for who they are. The model holds hundreds more; these 5 carry most of a launch. Click any cluster to inspect a group.

Watch a decision play out before you make it

A streaming service weighs a theatrical opening for its next release. Studio plays 30 weeks of it, one version of the decision at a time, and returns the KPIs you already run: adoption, trust, repeat, revenue lift.

Week 2: empty rooms. The premiere price reads as a penalty.

Week 14: the bundled ticket starts filling matinees.

Week 27: the version you release. Full houses, and the subscription holds.

Where Studio runs

Insight and marketing teams point it at decisions like these. The board keeps moving; hover to hold it.

Price change

A quick service chain prices a $1 combo increase across 6 markets and rolls it out only where traffic holds.

4 of 6 markets hold

Cancellation save

A streaming service tests 5 cancellation flows and finds the pause offer keeps 3 times more subscribers.

best save of 5 flows tested

Launch timing

name: Salt Security
brief:
Product: Salt Security
One-liner: Protects organizations from getting breached through their APIs.
Description: Salt Security protects the APIs that form the core of every modern application. Its patented API Protection Platform is the only API security solution that combines the power of cloud-scale big data and time-tested ML/AI to detect and prevent API attacks. By correlating activities across millions of APIs and users over time, Salt delivers deep context with real-time analysis and continuous insights for API discovery, attack prevention, and shift-left practices.
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: Cybersecurity
target:
Most AI security stops at the model. Attacks don't.

Salt's Agentic Security Graph maps every agent, MCP server, and API in your environment, so you know exactly what your agents are doing and stop them when they overstep.

Trusted by global enterprises to deliver Agentic Security

AI agent anatomy

An AI Agent is like a digital employee.

And like any employee, what matters isn't what they think. It's what they do.

Agentic Security

Most AI Security stops at the model. Attackers don't.

The model security said everything was fine. Everything was not fine.

The agentic security graph

Visibility isn't enough. You need context.

Not every agent carries the same risk. Salt's Agentic Security Graph contextualizes risk across your entire environment, separating the agents that can cause real damage from those that cannot. That is the holistic view no other platform can give you.

The Agentic Stack has three pillars. All three must be secured.

If any one pillar is compromised, the entire stack is compromised. Most vendors secure one. Salt secures all three.

Assess your risk

See your Agentic Security Graph in minutes.

Most organizations are shocked by what Salt finds. See every agent, MCP server and API operating across your environment, including the ones you don't know about.

Salt agentic security Platform

From agent to API. The full agentic lifecycle, secured.

Most platforms secure a slice of your agentic environment. Salt was built to secure all of it. Eight years of API security research, applied across the full Agentic Security Graph, from the moment an agent is deployed to every action it takes at runtime.

Agentic discovery

You can't secure what you can't see. Salt automatically discovers every agent, MCP server and API across your environment, including the shadow and zombie APIs nobody knows are there.

Learn more

Posture management

Knowing what exists is only the first step. Salt analyzes every component in your Agentic Security Graph for misconfigurations, excessive permissions, and exposed credentials, before an attacker finds them.

Runtime protection

Agents move at machine speed. So does Salt. Real-time detection of abuse, anomalous behavior, and active attacks across the full graph, including the internal traffic your perimeter tools never see.

name: Shred Video
brief:
Product: Shred Video
One-liner: Shred Video builds automated video & photo systems that allow…
Description: Shred Video, a new startup launching out of Y Combinator, allows users to take footage from their iPhone, GoPro or drone and simply match it with a song from the user’s iTunes library. That’s all. Shred Video does the rest of the work. Taking into account the acceleration of the camera itself, Shred Video can pin-point the moments of action for surfers, snowboarders, skaters and other acceleration-based sports to highlight all of the coolest clips in your footage.
Industry: Consumer / Content
Tags: Travel, Video
target:
Automated Video for Adventure Tours

Sell Videos to Your Customers

Shred Video helps you create and sell cinematic, shareable videos to your customers effortlessly.

Shred Features

Increase Revenue

Drive more revenue selling your customers cinema quality videos (and photos) of their tour or activity.

Deliver Instantly

Your customers get their videos and photos immediately at the conclusion of their activity with zero wait time .

Save Time & Money

Shred Video requires no dedicated staff to operate. If you already have a photographer or videographer on staff, even better — we’ll turn them into a photo & video superhero. Like Tony Stark with a camera.

Theatre + Touchscreen Display

We’ll set up theatre and touchscreen displays so your customers can watch their videos in full cinematic glory , as well as interact directly with their media on personal touchscreens.

Cloud Delivery

No more hassling with USB sticks for you or your customers. Shred Video delivers media via the cloud, so your customers can immediately view and share right from their phones .

Social Media Sharing

We deliver customer videos + photos via a web experience designed and branded just for you, easily shareable on social media .

Custom Integration

Our system is customized to your operation , so you get the best experience for your staff and customers.

Ongoing Support

Our support team will make sure you’re never left high and dry or without a paddle.

Continuous Improvement

We’re constantly pushing system upgrades that you’ll get for free .

Try for Free

We’ll let you see Shred Video live before you pay us a dime. Take 10 seconds to sign up for a free demo now .

Shred Video’s automated video & photo systems work for any adventure tour or activity.

We use LiDar, GPS, smart camera technology, and proprietary algorithms to automatically capture, edit, and share cinematic videos & photos to your customers. Think of it like the technology of self-driving cars applied to adventure activity videos, with the cinematic flair you’d expect from Red Bull Media House.

We currently serve skydiving, bungy jumping, giant swing, river rafting, paragliding, and many other tours and activities. Check out our partner sites below to see us in action with current clients, and sign up for a free demo now to see Shred Video work for you.

Shred Partners

brief:
Product: Lumari
One-liner: AI Digital Workers for Supply Chain
Description: Lumari is the world's first AI-powered procurement automation platform purpose-built for direct materials and supply chain execution. Backed by Y Combinator, Lumari is a well-funded startup that deploys 100s of always-on AI agents that run sourcing workflows, manage RFQs, expedite purchase orders, and coordinate supplier communication end-to-end -- compressing cycle times and giving teams full visibility into active orders, RFQs, and supplier performance.
Industry: B2B / Supply Chain and Logistics
Tags: B2B, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, AI
target:
AI Platform for Supply Chain

Lumari streamlines direct procurement operations with always-on systems that monitor, coordinate, and take action from sourcing to delivery.

Direct Procurement, Automated

Purpose-built AI that handles the operational work across your procurement lifecycle, from sourcing to order management, and all the messy supplier collaboration in between.

Intelligent Email Processing

Parses and acts on supplier emails automatically, from quotes to shipping delays, without changing your workflow. Agents read and acts on supplier emails, from quotes to delays, directly in email

Supplier adoption. No portal required.

Reduction in manual touchpoints

Always-on monitoring across all records

Weeks required for implementation

SCALE FASTER

Your Process, Your Rules

AI that drives real impact, with the guardrails your team needs to trust it and stay in control.

@team Approval Required: RFQ - Industrial Valve Assembly

Hey, we're reviewing your RFQ for the industrial valve assembly. Could you confirm the material specification for the valve body? We want to make sure we're quoting the correct grade before finalizing pricing.

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for your question on the valve body material.

The spec is called out on Drawing DWG-4417, Rev C. The body is 316 stainless steel per ASTM A351.

Let me know if you need anything else to finalize the quote.

Integrated with your tools

Bring your company knowledge together from ERPs, Microsoft Suite, Google Workspace, emails, communication tools, and more.

HOW WE WORK

Why Teams Choose Lumari

A platform built for how direct procurement actually works, with hands-on support, fast onboarding, and AI that gets smarter the more you use it.

Continuously Improving

Lumari’s agents learn from your corrections and feedback over time, delivering more accurate and consistent results over time without any reconfiguration.

Adapts to Your Workflows

Every team runs procurement differently. Lumari molds to your approval chains, naming conventions, and escalation paths, not the other way around.

Dedicated Support Team

Direct support to ensure success. Lumari partners with your organization to ensure successful implementation and support.

Live in Weeks, Not Months

Fast, structured onboarding that maps to your existing processes. We handle the integration work so your team can focus on results.

Works Alongside Your ERP

Lumari layers on top of your ERPs and other platforms, so there’s no need for any migration or rip-and-replace. Your systems of record stay intact.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure

A dependable foundation for regulated, high-stakes operations.

Attack Capital is the only Y Combinator alumni founded AI venture studio designed for founders who want to build and invest with speed. We combine a disciplined 30-day build cycle with an accessible AI fund giving investors direct access to YC startups.

Understanding YC : The World's Most Valuable Startup Ecosystem

Y Combinator invests twice a year into early-stage companies through a 3-month program focused on rapid growth and fundraising. YC Demo Day access is restricted to a curated list of investors, making it difficult for most individuals to invest in AI companies or invest in YC companies at the earliest stages.

Attack Capital’s AI fund opens access to YC-backed startups, allowing investors to participate in Y Combinator backed companies through a transparent and accessible structure.

Build With the #1 YC Alumni Founded Studio

As a next-generation venture builder, Attack Capital works directly with founders, operators, and domain experts to create and scale AI SaaS products. As a leading AI venture studio and company builder, we offer hands-on support throughout the entire lifecycle.

Invest in YC Companies

Attack Capital operates one of the most accessible YC-focused investment vehicles. Investors gain rare access to Y Combinator backed companies and vetted AI startups.

Why Attack Capital?

Attack Capital is built for founders and investors who want velocity, precision, and a credible advantage.

Our YC advantage gives unmatched access to talent, network, and proven startup patterns.

We build AI products in just 30 days, enabling rapid iteration and early traction from concept to MVP.

Specialize in AI-first products across healthcare, legal, finance, logistics, and compliance.

We co-build AI companies and invest directly in YC startups, acting as both builder and VC fund.

name: Ossus
brief:
Product: Ossus
One-liner: Intelligence for cultural institutions
Description: We build intelligence for cultural institutions. Our first commercial product is for the literature industry with a focus on school and public libraries. It is a AI-native OS for libraries, that helps librarians save time on tedious tasks and lets them focus on their patrons.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Culture, AI
target:
Intelligence for cultural institutions

Ossus builds the software that runs a modern library, with intelligence that does the busywork and leaves the judgment to librarians.

Libraries are history’s oldest storage for intelligence. We are building it a new one.

Cultural flourishing has always been built on infrastructure. The first Renaissance rose on the printing press, the public library, and the catalogue. What comes next will rise on something we have not built yet.

Today libraries run on aging systems and manual work that swallows the hours meant for curation and connection. This is not cultural decline. It is infrastructural neglect, and Ossus exists to change that.

Give the best hours back

Ossus takes the admin off the desk, the hours that should belong to readers, and returns them to curation, connection, and craft.

Judgment stays human

AI will not generate culture. It reads the spines, runs the inventory, and matches the records, so the work only a librarian can do stays with the librarian.

Privacy by design

We do not train on your data and we do not sell it. Ossus reads catalogue metadata, never borrower records, so the intelligent parts touch the least personal data.

Built for the long term

Libraries are civic infrastructure. We build from inside the work, alongside the institutions that run on it, and to the standards they are held to.

Solutions

Two products on one foundation, built for where libraries actually live.

The complete system for a public library. Catalogue, circulation, and a discovery experience patrons actually enjoy, on one foundation.

Librar is Ossus for schools. Set up a library in minutes from a phone, and give school librarians their hours back for students.

Add-ons

Beyond the core ILS, Ossus adds a set of agents that take the slow, recurring work off the desk, from keeping the shelves accurate to buying well and funding the year ahead.

AI-assisted Inventory

Save 80% of time spent on inventory. Take a picture up to 30 books while they're still on the shelf, and AI automatically identifies the books by reading the spines. It does inventory and identifies misplaced books simultaneously.

Vendor Comparison Agent

Save 5-10% on all your book orders. Drop in a purchase list and the agent splits it across different book vendors. It weighs the price of the book, MARC records, processing and more—and tells you the cheapest way to fill the order.

Grant Agent

Ossus takes the admin off the desk, the hours that should belong to readers, and returns them to curation, connection, and craft.

Judgment stays human

AI will not generate culture. It reads the spines, runs the inventory, and matches the records, so the work only a librarian can do stays with the librarian.

Privacy by design

We do not train on your data and we do not sell it. Ossus reads catalogue metadata, never borrower records, so the intelligent parts touch the least personal data.

Built for the long term

Libraries are civic infrastructure. We build from inside the work, alongside the institutions that run on it, and to the standards they are held to.

Solutions

Two products on one foundation, built for where libraries actually live.

The complete system for a public library. Catalogue, circulation, and a discovery experience patrons actually enjoy, on one foundation.

Librar is Ossus for schools. Set up a library in minutes from a phone, and give school librarians their hours back for students.

Add-ons

Beyond the core ILS, Ossus adds a set of agents that take the slow, recurring work off the desk, from keeping the shelves accurate to buying well and funding the year ahead.

AI-assisted Inventory

Save 80% of time spent on inventory. Take a picture up to 30 books while they're still on the shelf, and AI automatically identifies the books by reading the spines. It does inventory and identifies misplaced books simultaneously.

Vendor Comparison Agent

Save 5-10% on all your book orders. Drop in a purchase list and the agent splits it across different book vendors. It weighs the price of the book, MARC records, processing and more—and tells you the cheapest way to fill the order.

Grant Agent

name: Tennr
brief:
Product: Tennr
One-liner: Fast, Transparent Patient Experiences
Description: Tennr is solving the black hole problem in healthcare by leveraging models to digitize the flow of paperwork between healthcare providers. -- Today, when you go to your doctor and need to be referred to a specialist (e.g., for sleep apnea), your doctor sends a fax (yes, in 2024, 90% of provider-provider communication is a 1980s fax). These are often converted into 20+ page PDFs, with handwritten (doctor’s handwriting!) notes, in thousands of different formats.
Industry: B2B
Tags: SaaS, Workflow Automation, Healthcare
target:
Move patients forward

RIGHT PATIENT. RIGHT CARE SETTING. EVERY TIME.

Tennr is an agentic patient orchestration platform built for policy-grade decisioning and patient flow at scale. Tennr helps providers navigate patients through complex payer requirements, countless engagements, and every step in between.

AT A GLANCE

With Tennr, patients flow

THE BOTTOM LINE

No delays. Fewer denials. Optimal patient journeys.

Move patients to the right places

Eliminate the operational friction that slows progression between consults, diagnostics, authorizations, and scheduling.

Slash first-pass denials

Turn a library of payer criteria into automatic operational decisions. Assemble proof, prioritize care plans, and avoid revenue loss.

Close the loop in care coordination

Coordinate patients, providers, and payers without endless manual follow-up calls or touch points.

WHO WE WORK WITH

Trusted nationwide

KEEP PATIENTS MOVING

Patient flow, optimized

Tennr automatically classifies and routes patient data from any source—fax, portal, internal order—into the right operational workflows.

Wherever charts and orders need to reflect changes, they'll be automatically updated.

Tennr can check eligibility, investigate benefits over the phone, and submit prior authorizations.

Your patients' authorization status and medical necessity criteria will directly drive Tennr's recommendations.

Finally, Tennr uses all of the data it touches to intelligently drive patient routing decisions, unblock what’s stuck, and get you paid faster.

Testimonials

What our customers say

“With Tennr, we’re able to do things so much faster, and it's just huge. It’s been a game changer. We’re able to reach out to patients so much faster.”

Alyssa Jakubowski Revenue Cycle and Compliance Manager at NEB Medical

“I call it the 'Tennr effect.' For every action, there's a reaction. As we speed things up at the front of the time, it's going to have downstream effects.”

Chip Holland President of Total Sleep Management

“We hit 260 faxes in one day… and were able to manage it.”

Amy Willis Director of Complex Rehab at King Drug

OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE AT SCALE

Tennr sets a new standard for healthcare ops

Patient care starts with unstructured documentation. Tennr pulls data from faxes, charts, and insurance plans faster than your best intake specialist, and can handle that volume without manual intervention.

Missing documentation is the #1 reason patients stall. Tennr identifies what’s missing for the specific patient and service, requests it from the right party, and tracks it through completion.

Select the correct payer and plan every time. Identify coverage changes early. Re-verify patients automatically. Tennr ensures active coverage is confirmed before care is scheduled.

name: Gaiascope
brief:
Product: Gaiascope
One-liner: SaaS that helps renewables & energy storage operate more profitably
Description: Software that simplifies electric grid forecasting and operations. Clients--hard assets like wind, solar and energy storage--get timely, unbiased information to improve revenues, reduce risk, and maximize the profitability of every megawatt. Gaiascope also manages a quant fund trading electricity; with this fund, the company builds additional credibility with clients and accelerates the continuous improvement of its software.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Climate, Energy, ClimateTech
target:
accelerate the future of energy, we make power more investable

Every day, Gaiascope forecasts more than 3.8 MILLION individual data points on the electric grid. Each hour we forecast over 700 price points, 967 generating units, 4,413 bus-level loads and 9,840 line and transformer flows.

For 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, that’s 1.4 BILLION data points forecasted each year!

This proprietary approach enables Gaia to provide its sustainable energy clients with superior insights for making strategic and actionable, trading and dispatch decisions.

AI-POWERED TRADING PLATFORM

Trading & Risk Management Software

Gaiascope’s Terra Platform revolutionizes optimization for renewable assets, as your foundation for mastering the art of trading and dispatch. Leveraging our distinctive approach to modeling the physical grid, powered by artificial intelligence, Terra empowers you to maximize the value of every MW of your solar, wind and battery projects.

Terra is your dynamic guardian, constantly evolving, with a commitment to perpetual innovation, meaning you are supported by the most advanced, up-to-date insights every hour of every day, all year round.

OUR MISSION

Maintaining planetary balance and combating climate change.

Gaiascope is dedicated to maintaining planetary balance, and we know the best way to drive investment in sustainable energy assets is to make those assets as profitable as possible. For every $1 million invested in a sustainable energy asset instead of fossil fuels, that’s 2 million metric tonnes of annual CO2 avoided. We do our part by providing clients the best possible tool to optimize returns of their wind, solar and storage assets.

Why Gaiascope?

Gaiascope brings its best-in-class software, the Terra Platform, combined with deep trading expertise to create value. We combine physical modeling, AI and trading acumen to serve you in an unparalleled fashion.

Proven Results via Affiliated Fund

As a demonstration of our software and trading capabilities, Gaiascope actively trades in electricity markets via its affiliate, Upward Leader Fund I LP. We have yielded remarkable results averaging 60% annual returns, with the the fund acting as a test bed for price forecasts, trading strategies, and risk management.

Customized Trading

Gaiascope’s experienced traders work closely with you to understand your assets, goals and risk tolerance. We combine the power of the Terra Platform with the knowledge of our team to provide forecasts and trading recommendations that maximize returns and minimize risk.

One size doesn’t fit all.

We work through a detailed evaluation and optimization process before live trading.

Building the Brain of the Grid

name: Wardstone
brief:
Product: Wardstone
One-liner: The Modular Interceptor Platform
Description: Wardstone builds a low-cost, modular interceptor platform for air and missile defense. Our platform enables the warfighter to right sizes their interceptors against the threat. This allows us to defeat air-breathing and ballistic missile threats at a fraction of the cost of exquisite interceptors, adding affordable magazine depth to existing air defense systems.
Industry: Industrials / Aviation and Space
Tags: Hard Tech, Satellites, Rocketry, Aerospace, Defense
target:
The Modular Interceptor Platform

Warfighters face a critical interceptor shortage in the mid-tier threat band, from Group 4 UAS to Medium-Range Ballistic Missiles.

Existing interceptors are oversized, overpriced, and outpaced by adversary offensive munition production. Using small numbers of exquisite interceptors against large numbers of cheap mass-produced weapons is unsustainable.

Wardstone builds a modular interceptor platform of right-sized, mass-producible interceptors that enable the West to out-produce, out-innovate, and out-perform its adversaries.

A modular architecture creates enduring advantages across performance, production, and technological evolution.

COST & PERFORMANCE ALIGNMENT

Match interceptor performance to mission requirements, reducing cost while preserving combat effectiveness.

INDUSTRIAL RESILIENCE & FLEXIBILITY

Diversify suppliers to reduce production bottlenecks and respond rapidly to changes in operational demand.

FUTURE-PROOFING THE PLATFORM

Integrate new technologies without redesigning the interceptor — continuous improvement over the platform's lifetime.

Intercept threats FROM the surface

See how Wardstone's surface-based interceptor stops incoming aerial threats.

FAQS

What problem is Wardstone solving?

Modern threats are evolving and arriving in greater numbers than the systems built to counter them can match. Traditional interceptors are expensive, slow to build, and hard to produce at scale, which leaves defenders outpaced and outnumbered. We're building a platform designed to be produced in volume, adapted quickly, and fielded at the pace the threat demands.

What does Wardstone mean by a "modular" interceptor platform?

Rather than a one-off system designed for a single threat, our platform is built from interchangeable components that can be configured for different missions, upgraded over time, and manufactured at scale. The same core adapts as threats change and can be produced across a resilient supplier base rather than a single bottlenecked line.

Why does a modular approach matter for modern defense?

Modularity does three things at once. It shortens the time from need to capability, it lowers lifecycle cost, and critically, it makes mass production practical. Standardized, interchangeable components can be built by multiple suppliers in parallel, so output scales with demand and isn't held hostage by any single factory, part, or supply shock.

How does modularity support mass manufacturing and industrial resilience?

Because our components are standardized and decoupled, they can be produced across many facilities and sourced from multiple vendors. That means production can surge when needed, absorb disruptions without stalling, and grow the industrial base rather than concentrating it. Resilience isn't just in the system, it's in how the system gets built.

brief:
Product: Valor Water Analytics
One-liner: Valor Water Analytics delivers a SaaS platform to utilities to detect…
Description: Today, water supplies are more scarce than ever before, requiring water utilities to operate more efficiently than anyone thought possible. That’s where we come in. Like water, the flow of data from water utilities is both measurable and manageable. Valor helps utilities transform complicated data into simple solutions that can make a big difference. Some call it advanced water utility analytics. We call it all in a day’s work.
Industry: Industrials / Climate
target:
The future of smart water is now

Xylem Vue transforms data into powerful insights to optimize decision-making and simplify digital integration in utilities

Xylem Vue is a secure, integrated, and vendor-agnostic software and analytics platform that can capture data from any source, including legacy solutions, creating a single, unified source of information.

This enables utilities to maximize investments already made in existing technologies, while moving further along their digital journey and breaking down data silos to provide a holistic, 360-degree view of their system.

Our comprehensive portfolio of modular applications, combined with Xylem Vue’s operational intelligence and AI capabilities, helps utilities unlock the power of their data and more efficiently address their challenges across the entire water cycle.

Read More

Smart water simplified

Unify data in a single software and analytics platform

Democratize system knowledge across networks and teams

Maximize digital investments to solve challenges sustainably

Optimize decision-making and increase operational efficiency

Specific applications for each area of the water cycle

Drinking Water

Streamline drinking water treatment plant and network management.

Wastewater

Optimize wastewater treatment plant and sewer network management.

Agriculture

Monitor and control irrigation infrastructure, including water loss control.

Water Resources

Early Warning System for controlling and managing extreme events in river basins.

Case studies

Hot Springs: Increasing system visibility and reducing non-revenue water

A collaborative project between Xylem and Idrica, Xylem Vue’s Leak Detection application was deployed along with Xylem’s digital solutions (Sensus Analytics, Revenue Locator, and Water Loss Management), the Sensus Flexnet communication network, and Sensus meters.

City of Richmond reduces CSOs by 180 million gallons annually and avoids $725M in capital costs thanks to decision intelligence

For decades, the City of Richmond’s Department of Public Utilities has been working to reduce combined sewer overflows (CSOs) and improve water quality in the James River. Despite making significant improvements, the City still experiences between one and three billion gallons of annual overflow and is actively working to reach Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ) water quality goals.

Unmatched experience

Xylem Vue is the result of the partnership between Xylem and Idrica, an international pioneer in water data management, analytics, and smart-water solutions. The journey to unlocking your system’s full capabilities starts here.

Constant support

From challenge assessment to implementation and training, technical and delivery experts are there every step of the way.

Domain knowledge

Our former utility leaders, decision scientists, engineers, and hydroinformatics experts work with your team to meet your goals.

“High touch” delivery

name: Perceptron ML
brief:
Product: Perceptron ML
One-liner: We make law firms AI-native.
Description: We build AI systems for law firms, trained on each firm's own matters and deployed privately in their environment: timekeeping, intake and matter monitoring, research, discovery, and drafting. Our grounding engine verifies every fact against a primary source before a model can cite it, which is why firms trust us with work that off-the-shelf legal AI keeps getting wrong.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B, Legal, Automation
target:
AI software built for your law firm .

We design and build bespoke AI systems for law firms, trained on your matters and deployed in your environment. Intake, discovery, drafting, and research, grounded in verified sources so the work holds up.

Legal AI that actually works. Because it is built around your firm, not sold off a shelf.

What we build

Software shaped to your practice.

Not another chatbot bolted onto your browser. We build custom systems around how your firm actually works. A few of the things we can build:

AI timekeeping

Capture billable hours automatically from your calendar, documents, and email. No more reconstructing your week from memory on Friday afternoon.

Client acquisition and monitoring

Watch dockets, filings, and news for the signals that matter to your practice. Standing alerts surface opportunities before competitors do.

Research that actually works

Grounded in primary law and your firm's own matter files, with citations you can open and check. Answers you can confidently put your name on.

Discovery and drafting

Review thousands of documents in hours instead of weeks, and draft motions and letters from your firm's own templates, in your firm's voice.

Why it holds up

Grounded, not guessing.

Every system we ship runs on our grounding engine. Every fact is derived from a primary source and checked before a model is allowed to use it, so answers arrive with citations, not confidence.

Expert testimony is admissible only where it rests on a reliable foundation and is relevant to the issues in dispute. Daubert v. Merrell Dow Pharms., Inc., 509 U.S. 579, 589 (1993) .

That gatekeeping duty is not limited to scientific evidence; it extends to technical and other specialized knowledge. Kumho Tire Co. v. Carmichael, 526 U.S. 137, 141 (1999) .

Exclusion is proper where the "analytical gap" between the data and the opinion offered is simply too great. Gen. Elec. Co. v. Joiner, 522 U.S. 136, 146 (1997) .

Citations verified

Daubert is a real case and supports the standard as stated 509 U.S. 579, 589 (1993), reporter checked

Kumho Tire extends gatekeeping to technical experts as cited 526 U.S. 137, 141 (1999), holding confirmed

Quoted "analytical gap" language appears in Joiner verbatim 522 U.S. 136, 146 (1997), quotation matched

Your matters never leave your control.

Client confidence is the product. We build for it from the first line of code, not as a checkbox at the end.

Deployed in your environment

name: Fly.io
brief:
Product: Fly.io
One-liner: Run full stack apps close to your users.
Description: We run app servers and databases close to end users. Developers deploy their apps to Fly.io (it's about the simplest place to deploy a Docker Image) and use our CLI to launch instances in regions that are most important for their application.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Infrastructure
target:
Computers for agents

Sandboxes aren't enough. Give your agent a real computer and get back to building.

Machines that Remember

Real hardware-isolated Linux computers for agents, evals, and tools. The bill goes to zero when nobody's home.

Coding Agents

Every agent gets its own Linux box. A Sprite checkpoints itself while the agent works, so harnesses like Claude and Codex find everything where they left it.

Personal agents

Hermes, Pi, Openclaw… whatever your flavour, an agent with access to your inbox and calendar shouldn't live on your laptop. Give it a Sprite that sleeps until it's needed and wakes up remembering everything.

MCP servers

Run every MCP server in its own Sprite, with persistent disk, and egress policy. Pay only for the tool calls you use.

Untrusted code

Run it in a hardware-isolated VM. A clean baseline per request, so no two users ever share state. Egress-locked and disposable.

Agent-built apps

Every Sprite has an HTTPS URL. The app your agent built stays exactly where it was created and goes live. Nobody migrates anything.

A Real Durable Filesystem

Everything's still there when you come back. The Sprite Block Device means Sprites can go to sleep without dying.

Sprites Block Device is currently in private beta. Sign up to receive early access.

Nothing to Manage

The agent does the setup, and you get your afternoon back.

No disk sizing

Your disk grows as you write it, up to 100 GB per Sprite, and you're only billed for the bytes you actually put there.

Automatic checkpointing

The Sprite checkpoints itself automatically, so there's always a recent one waiting.

Sprites Connectors

Connect a service once for your whole org, and every Sprite can reach it. Nobody pastes a token.

Sprites: where your agent runs. Machines: where you run what it builds.

Sprites

It sleeps when the agent stops, and wakes up with the filesystem, the running services and the installed dependencies right where they were. Checkpoint before a risky change, roll back in seconds.

Machines

The app your agent finished needs somewhere to live. Fly Machines are hardware-isolated VMs that boot in under a second, run close to your users, and scale out to tens of thousands when the traffic arrives.

Grow without drama

Scale from side project to production without rewriting your infrastructure.

Keep the same primitives at every scale: no rearchitecting when you grow, and no platform migration when you get big. The API you start with is the API you keep.

A Connection to Everything

name: Tusk
brief:
Product: Tusk
One-liner: AI agent that generates unit and integration tests
Description: Tusk (YC W24) is an AI agent that helps developers generate unit and integration tests with codebase context. Tusk sits in CI and provides automatic coverage whenever software engineers raise a PR. Engineering teams use Tusk to prevent critical regressions while increasing test coverage.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, Open Source
target:
AI verification layer for coding agents

Prevent bugs and quality issues with tests and reviews based on production traffic. Ship fast with coding agents confidently.

Trusted by engineering leaders at fast-growing companies

Cover thousands of edge cases in minutes

Tusk uses live traffic and business context to generate test cases that catch real-world regressions in 43% of PRs

Shift-left testing without the pain

Tusk enforces test coverage and code quality requirements without disrupting your engineers' flow

Optimized for agents

Run a single CLI command for initial setup and to add Tusk-generated tests locally or to an existing branch

Fully autonomous

Self-iterates on its tests if it encounters errors when running them. No back-and-forth with an AI copilot required.

Self-healing tests

Automatically maintains your existing test suites on every commit to make sure they reflect the latest business logic

Generate high-quality tests to reach your coverage goals

name: Fieldproxy
brief:
Product: Fieldproxy
One-liner: Retool for 20 Million Field Teams
Description: Fieldproxy is Retool for Field Teams. Our no-code SaaS application allows organizations to build internal mobile applications to manage field teams of any size. Fieldproxy's vision is to be the Operating System for Field teams.
Industry: B2B / Productivity
Tags: SaaS, Productivity
target:
AI rebuilds your field operations software. Then runs it.

We rip out the outdated system you are stuck on and rebuild your operation around how you really run. The AI shapes it, then its agents run dispatch, calls and invoicing inside it. Go live in weeks.

Trusted by 250+ field service teams

Add a warranty-expiry date to every equipment record, and flag jobs when it's close

We rebuild the operation. The AI runs it.

AI and humans, working together. AI takes the repetitive half: the calls, the triage, the data entry, the month-end invoice run. Your team takes the half that needs judgement.

Voice, text, video, vision, scheduling, dispatch, knowledge, and document agents. Each one trained on your data and wired into the same workflows your dispatchers and techs use every day. Turn them on individually or run them all together.

The Command Center

One bar that runs your FSM. Type a sentence and the right agent picks it up and begins the work.

Video Agent

One narrated walkthrough fills the form. What the camera saw and what the tech said, together.

Calling Agent

Answers and places calls. Books jobs, confirms appointments, recovers no-shows.

Text Agent

Answers inbound SMS and email against the real job record, and reschedules it.

Voice Agent

Your tech talks, the job record fills itself. No typing at the end of the day.

Dispatch Agent

Reassigns and reroutes in real time as cancellations, breakdowns, and emergencies hit.

Scheduler Agent

Builds tomorrow's board overnight, and weekly and monthly routes too. Skill, geography and SLA constraints baked in.

Watcher Agent

Watches every job for SLA risk, missing photos, idle techs, or stuck invoices, and flags it early.

Vision Agent

Reads site photos for damage, parts, meter values, and on-site safety violations.

Document Intelligence

Reads inbound POs, RFQs, and warranty claims. Pulls out the fields. Files the job.

Knowledge Agent

Pulls answers from your SOPs, manuals, and past jobs so techs never call in for help.

Custom Agent

When the workflow is yours alone. Describe the agent in plain English and we ship it into your environment.

Your operation. Rebuilt exactly as you run it.

One real request. Mike's world before Fieldproxy, and the system we rebuilt for him. Hit After and watch it reshape.

“I own Mike's Cleaning Franchise with 8 locations across Dallas and Houston. I need location-specific pricing, crew transfers between locations during busy periods, and consolidated reporting across all locations.”

target:
Your Frontline Operating System.

Elemeno is the first just-in-time microlearning solution built for workforce enablement and frontline ops. Easily customize to the specific needs of your hospital, and units, or clinical trial and sites. Streamline training, drive high reliability, and empower your staff with concise and actionable information, exactly where and when needed. Drive confidence, competence, and compliance. For frontline teams, Elemeno is a game changer.

Modernize your training. Help your team learn faster and perform at the top of their game through easy-to-digest, bite-size formats like short videos, images, and quick, simple job aids.

Microlearning for maximum impact.

Real-time support, when time matters most.

Your staff needs more than off-the-shelf content to do their best work. That’s why Elemeno supports nurses and frontline teams with actionable information specific to your hospital or unit. It’s your policies, your procedures, your equipment, customized for your team.

Your content digitally optimized.

Meaningful impact. Proven results.

Coming together to improve frontline healthcare.

KLAS scores Latent 94.5 in new Spotlight report

The first KLAS report on enterprise pharmacy intelligence, scored entirely from independent customer feedback.

Proven impact for patients, pharmacists, and leading health systems.

Latent's clinical agentic engine powers it all

Meet the leaders that are using AI to grow their Pharmacy programs

When you talk to our primary care providers, they will tell you it takes a skilled professional to dig through charts to complete a prior authorization. Latent’s real superpower is taking on that heavy lifting behind the scenes, so our top clinical talent can stay focused on what truly matters: caring for patients.”

Every January, we had to reauthorize thousands of patients—a process that used to stretch until mid-March. With Latent, we’ve cut that time by 50% and now finish within the same month."

Before Latent, the manual PA process could significantly delay therapy initiation. Now, we’re accelerating time-to-therapy and ensuring patients can start their medications as soon as possible.”

From day one, Latent has exemplified what it means to be a trusted partner, aligning with our long-term vision for success. It is a privilege to work with Latent, and we are excited to further strengthen this collaboration, building new efficiencies and setting new standards of excellence across our system."

Health systems talk about infrastructure like bridges and tunnels—we need the same mindset for technology. Latent supports critical infrastructure behind the scenes so our people can focus on patients."

Latent has transformed our collaboration into a true partnership, revolutionizing our prior authorization process and enabling us to expand into a comprehensive medication access and affordability team here at MetroHealth. Thanks to their innovation, we ensure that patients—regardless of socioeconomic status—receive the essential therapies they need."

Seamless integration across your Pharmacy ecosystem

Latent natively integrates with any EHR

Be part of the change

If you are interested in building the intelligence infrastructure for American healthcare, join us.

Mental health support to help every kid and family thrive

Daybreak partners with schools to provide therapy for kids and families, regardless of insured or uninsured. Our care programs are personalized to each individual’s unique needs.

A family story: Meet Clifford

" Daybreak saved my son's life!" - Clifford's Mom Watch this powerful story told directly by Clifford, his mom, and school counselor about how Daybreak improved his mental health and the trajectory of his life for the better.

Empowering kids to be their best selves.

When kids are mentally healthy, they can think clearly, pay better attention, and learn new skills. Our evidence-based teletherapy programs for K-12 students have proven to positively impact academic outcomes like behavioral improvements, better grades, and higher attendance.

Trusted by top school districts across the country, representing more than 1.5 million enrolled students

Daybreak partners with over 50+ health plans to ensure all children under Medicaid or Commercial insurance are covered

Proven outcomes

Our mental health programs

No two needs are the same. Daybreak’s evidence-based programs meet the unique needs of every school, student, and family.

Why Daybreak

When it comes to mental health care, one size does not fit all. That’s why Daybreak’s programs are designed for each student’s unique needs—with proven clinical and academic outcomes.

Your schools are successful when your students are. Our evidence-based teletherapy programs have proven to drive behavioral improvements, better grades, and higher attendance.

Full treatment cycle

Unlike other providers who offer short-term transitional care, our model treats students to a place of concrete improvement—symptomatically, functionally, and behaviorally—over the course of their 12+ week program.

name: Treasury Prime
brief:
Product: Treasury Prime
One-liner: Embedded banking software platform and marketplace
Description: Founded in 2017, Treasury Prime is an embedded banking software platform connecting enterprise companies to a vast marketplace of banks and product partners to launch next-gen payment ecosystems on their platform. Our banking API offers the quickest, most secure way for fintechs and banks to partner, integrate and build modern financial products and increase revenue streams.
Industry: Fintech / Banking and Exchange
Tags: Banking as a Service, Fintech, B2B, API
target:
Delivering the next generation of banking

Power fintech partnerships. Reach new customers. Grow your deposits. Accelerate your revenue.

Access the world’s leading bank operating system

Treasury Prime provides everything you need to build, launch and safely scale your business in ways that enhance the customer experience without changing how it is run.

The solution for scale. Simplify and enhance your existing technology stack through direct, real-time and seamless integration. Don’t rip and replace it.

Future growth - today. Easily expand your business offerings. Secure new technology partnerships/clients, supercharge your deposit growth, manage risk, and add capabilities with OneKey access to a network of peer institutions that can support large-scale, deposit participation programs.

Stay in control, stay compliant. Choose the clients and partners you want to work with. Control and manage the accounts and programs using your own systems and people. You’ll never have to worry about outsourcing program management to a technology firm.

Improve your oversight, processes, and controls. Enhance your compliance program, take action through an intuitive control center, and adapt to the evolving standards that regulators demand.

One banking software platform. Unlock new growth opportunities.

Don’t bank on growth continuing to come from your existing branches, website, or mobile app. Treasury Prime’s makes it easy for banks and credit unions to access customers and deposits well beyond their existing footprint with a modern, modular Bank OS.

Direct relationships between you, your bank partners, and other service providers. No middleman blocking your growth.

Connect with the industry's largest network of banks and partner only with those that match your business' values and growth goals.

Unlock state-of-the-art partner capabilities, ranging from KYC and compliance monitoring to instant account funding and more.

Prime numbers. ‍ Outstanding results.

Treasury Prime financial institution partners have achieved:

Build confidently with the Treasury Prime API

Spend your engineering time building your products, not building bank integrations. Banking is complicated, but our REST APIs are designed to be familiar, flexible, and easy to work with.

Get complete API access to your accounts, payment rails, and banking partners through our unified embedded banking API platform.

Build your own banking strategy

Treasury Prime puts you in control of your embedded banking journey. Choose the modular solutions most appropriate for your organization, and add new ones as your banking strategy and business needs evolve. We can help you:

If they never make above that threshold or don't get a job in the chosen field, they never pay us a dime.

target:

name: DiligenceSquared
brief:
Product: DiligenceSquared
One-liner: AI-powered market due diligence for investment decisions
Description: DiligenceSquared delivers AI-powered market due diligence for investment decisions - like the $500k McKinsey reports, but automated, auditable, and at a fraction of the cost. When Private Equity funds evaluate deals, they pay firms like McKinsey, BCG, and Bain $500K-$1M for market due diligence. The process takes weeks, and the output is a static PowerPoint that's impossible to audit. A single large-cap PE fund can spend >$30M annually on this and the total market is $10B per year.
Industry: B2B / Analytics
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Analytics, Market Research
target:
The AI-native consulting firm

Investment-grade market research & commercial due diligence. Powered by AI agents, led by senior consultants.

Consulting in the age of AI. Scalable, auditable, accurate — at a fraction of the cost.

Advisory for high-stakes decision-making.

Investor-grade commercial due diligence delivered faster and more cost-efficiently than traditional consulting — plus on-demand customer and market intelligence to create value across your portfolio companies.

AI agents + top-tier human consultants

Set up a call to discuss your research objectives. An experienced project lead — all with prior MBB experience — is assigned to your case and scopes the work.

The rigor of a premier advisory firm. The speed of a machine. A price that makes sense.

By domain experts, for domain experts

Our team brings experience from top-tier firms in finance, consulting and tech. We know what good looks like — and have designed workflows for investor-grade accuracy that stands up to an investment committee.

Human judgment, machine scale

AI gathers and structures evidence at a scale no team can staff. Senior consultants frame the questions that matter and challenge every finding before it ships.

Fully traceable

Data is captured and stored systematically, and every claim links back to the interview or dataset behind it. There is no black box — clients can interrogate findings live in the platform, or work with them in their own environment via MCP.

A fraction of the cost

Institutional-grade research for the many decisions that never justified a seven-figure consulting fee — without lowering the bar.

A new standard, built from first principles.

We are rebuilding premium consulting from first principles for the age of AI — leveraging the best of human and machine together, never at the cost of quality. Senior judgment brings the questions that matter. AI brings speed, scale and cost-efficiency. Together they unlock a class of research neither could deliver alone.

We are setting a new standard for investment research — every claim traceable, every engagement senior-led, and true rigor available for every decision, not only the ones that could justify a seven-figure fee.

Built by investors, consultants and engineers.

name: awen
brief:
Product: awen
One-liner: awen translates intent into exceptional visuals through conversation
Description: AI creative tools became powerful quickly. But they also got complicated. Most of them require creatives to do the engineering. Prompts. Parameters. Node graphs. Creative work doesn’t start there. It starts with thinking, exploring directions, and iterating on ideas. With Awen, we’re trying a different approach: A creative partner that turns intent into exceptional visuals through conversation.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Generative AI, SaaS, Creator Economy
target:
Create any visual from conversation

Watch the movie

No prompting. No AI engineering. No complexity.

5x more usable outputs.

Awen adapts to your context

Create images, videos, and visual assets from the way your team already thinks, briefs, and works.

Explore form, materials, and variations, from concept to visuals without friction.

Turn what's in your mind into images and videos.

Create commercial imagery and videos, adapt it across channels.

Stage products, dress models, and create sellable imagery and videos.

Create videos and visual assets by exploring scenes, rhythm, and direction before and during production.

Awen is built for privacy, security, and compliance

Enterprise-grade security

Awen is designed to meet enterprise security standards, including SOC 2 compliance. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with strict access controls and isolated workspaces.

Data ownership

Everything you import or create remains yours. Your data is stored in isolation and never used to train models. Nothing leaves your workspace without your control.

Traceability

In awen, each asset retains the full path that led to it (inputs, decisions, and transformations) captured as part of the process. With awen.zip, you can export both the final asset and its complete history in a structured format.

Compliance and auditability

Awen is designed for a compliant use of AI-generated content. Our lineage technology enables legal review, rights management, and auditability of any asset.

Customization, collaboration, and scale

Fine-tuning

Awen can be shaped to your way of working. Import knowledge, processes, and visual data. Refine behavior directly through chatting, over time, it reflects how you think and create.

Collaboration

From a single account to teams and departments, awen adapts to your structure. Teams and workspaces can be organized to reflect how your organization already operates.

Scale

Tasks can be executed in parallel through sub-agents enabling you to apply the same process across many assets at once.

brief:
Product: Archal
One-liner: API sandboxes, built for AI agents
Description: Archal provisions sandboxes with the API environments your CI, tests, and evals need. Your coding agent can start the sandbox & environments, connect to your API integrations, run tests, and inspect state changes. Sandboxes and environments are startable within seconds and take milliseconds to reset.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, API, Infrastructure
target:
Testing sandboxes, built for AI agents

Test API integrations without test accounts, rate limits, or dirty state. Each sandbox contains stateful environments that behave like the APIs you use in production.

Includes $20 in usage credits. No card required.

Use cases

Built for agent developers, connectors teams, and integration engineers.

Harness testing

Give every test run an isolated sandbox. Changes persist across tool calls, then reset to the same baseline.

Integration testing

Give every branch or CI job its own sandbox without shared test accounts, rate limits, or dirty state.

Agent training and RL

Give every rollout a sandbox with the same starting state while changes persist through the episode.

Each sandbox holds one or more stateful API environments. Changes persist between calls and reset to the same starting point.

Create, call, inspect, reset

Create a sandbox with one or more environments and a known starting state.

Receive isolated REST and MCP endpoints as each environment starts.

Use familiar API paths, payloads, and tools.

See requests, responses, mutations, timing, and usage together.

Restore every environment in the sandbox to its declared baseline.

Choose the environments your sandbox needs

Every environment is stateful and resets to a declared starting state.

Each environment is an independently built simulation of the service it represents, not the provider’s live service.

Let your coding agents set you up

Paste the skill below into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Devin. It starts secure signup, installs five verified skills, and checks access to every environment.

Get $20 in free usage

No card required. $5 arrives upon sign up and the remaining $15 when your first sandbox is ready.

Frequently asked questions

An Archal sandbox is an isolated, time-bounded runtime containing one or more stateful environments. Each environment exposes familiar REST or MCP interfaces, retains mutations for the life of the sandbox, and can return to its declared starting state.

No. One Archal API key creates and manages every sandbox and environment. Calls share one gateway while each environment keeps the familiar paths, methods, payloads, and response shapes your existing code expects.

State behavior varies by environment and operation. Available environments have a supported capability profile; environments in progress remain callable only where their documented behavior permits it. We do not claim complete upstream coverage without measured, dated evidence.
