name: Maximal
brief:
Product: Maximal
One-liner: Truckload Planning at Machine Precision
Description: Maximal is building autonomous systems to plan and move the world's freight. Our first product is a context-aware algorithmic load planning platform for full truckload (FTL) carriers. Our agents plug into a carrier's existing ERPs and communication channels, using that context to generate holistically optimized load plans. The result: carriers earn more revenue-per-mile while spending less time planning.
Industry: B2B / Supply Chain and Logistics
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Logistics, Supply Chain
target:
Agents for the physical economy

Save time and grow revenue with greater predictability and productivity.

Build, Plan, Ask, Collect. One system.

Maximal learns how your fleet runs. It works on the systems you already have.

Build turns the order email into the TMS order.

Orders arrive as emails, PDFs, and EDI. Build reads each one, matches sites and products against your TMS, and posts the record. A person sees only the exceptions.

Plan builds the day's dispatch in under a minute.

Plan learns your lanes, drivers, and customers, then assigns every load to the right driver. When a truck breaks down or a load cancels, it replans.

+ 58 more tractors

Ask answers questions from your own systems.

Type a question in plain English. Ask reads your TMS, ELDs, and spreadsheets, then shows the receipts. Deep Research agents find savings you haven't asked about.

SELECT lane, rev_per_mi - cost_per_mi AS margin

FROM orders JOIN stops ON … JOIN rates …

3 of 41 lanes

Collect gets your invoices paid.

Collect knows every payer's documents, format, and deadline. It builds the packet, submits it, follows up until payment arrives, and matches deposits to the invoices they cover.

How we deploy and support your fleet.

Every deployment starts with a model trained on your lanes, drivers, customers, and orders.

FAQ

No. Every fleet's data is a mess in its own way. Every deployment is whiteglove. We've built on heavily customized TMS installs and spreadsheet-run back offices.

Yes. Maximal is SOC 2 Type II compliant. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest on managed cloud infrastructure, under least-privilege access.

name: b12 Labs
brief:
Product: b12 Labs
One-liner: Making hard molecules for Pharma and Biotech
Description: b12 makes high-value molecules that are otherwise hard to make. We help pharma companies plan and make new drugs, accelerating early-stage drug discovery from years to months. Andres built the first AI agent that can autonomously think and make molecules in a robotic lab, published in Nature Machine Intelligence (1000+ citations), and won the best paper award at the NeurIPS AI for Science conference.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
Tags: AI-powered Drug Discovery, Robotics
target:
AI-Powered Chemical Synthesis

AI that designs, optimizes, and runs chemical reactions. Accelerating pharma R&D from years to months.

01 · From the lab

The ideas behind what we build

Launches, experiments, and lessons from building AI that can plan and run chemistry.

Agentic Synthesis: Making the molecules models want

Meet Selenium, b12's agentic retrosynthesis system for turning ambitious molecules into practical routes from purchasable starting materials.

Palladium: the planning layer for chemical synthesis

We are announcing Palladium, b12's HTE-ready plate designer for turning proposed chemical transformations into grounded experimental plans.

b12 labs at SLAS 2026

We brought our AI automation tools to SLAS 2026 in Boston, here's what we showed and what we learned.

02 · Planning

Design your synthesis, then optimize it

Two AI tools that take you from target molecule to optimized conditions.

Retrosynthesis

Describe a target molecule and get ranked synthesis strategies — each broken into concrete steps with model confidence.

Condition Optimization

Pick a reaction and screen catalysts, ligands, bases, and solvents in a single plate. AI designs the layout so every well counts.

03 · Automation

From plan to your lab

Use Cobalt to turn optimized conditions into automation-ready protocols for your instruments.

Run it in your lab

Translate optimized conditions into execution-ready protocols for Chemspeed, Opentrons, or other automation platforms, then run them in your own lab. No coding required.

04 · Benefits

Made for your lab , powered by AI

Fast Learning Curve

Master lab automation in hours, not weeks.

Scale Experiments Easily

Run diverse workflows with the same equipment.

Reliable Results

Reduce errors and improve reproducibility.

Focus on Science

Agents handle the technicalities; you make the discovery.

05 · FAQ

Frequently asked questions .

Selenium is designed for complex molecules, including multi-step targets, novel scaffolds, and compounds with challenging selectivity requirements.

Selenium plans synthesis routes, Palladium designs condition-optimization experiments, and Cobalt translates approved methods into automation-ready workflows for your lab.

Yes. Selenium, Palladium, and Cobalt are available as software tools at app.b12-labs.com, so teams can start with the part of the workflow they need.

Cobalt creates workflows for automation platforms including Chemspeed and Opentrons. Contact us to discuss support for your instrument stack.

No. All three tools are designed so scientists can describe intent in natural language. The AI handles protocol generation, plate layout, and workflow structure.

You can start using the platform immediately at app.b12-labs.com and bring your own target molecules, reactions, and automation workflows.

brief:
Product: Arzana
One-liner: The autonomous ERP for every manufacturer
Description: Arzana trains custom models on manufacturers' operational data to automate their quoting, order entry, invoicing, and other repetitive office work. We've saved our customers over $1.5M in avoided staff costs. In the future, we'll expand into shop-floor automation, sending instructions to machinery and robots to produce the orders that our office agents processed. By 2035, we aim to fully automate 10,000 American factories.
Industry: B2B / Operations
target:
Stop entering data.

Arzana trains custom models on a factory's historical data and uses them to deploy agents that automate their quoting, order entry, invoicing, and other repetitive office work.

We've saved our customers over $1M in avoided staff costs.

Trusted by leading industrial companies

Scale without adding headcount

Arzana's agents integrate with your email, ERP, and other systems to automate repetitive work across the manufacturing office.

Our customers treat Arzana like their last office hire.

Quoting

Receive RFQ emails, match parts against your catalog, validate pricing, and send professional quotes automatically.

Estimating

Train a custom AI model on your historical job costs. Generate accurate estimates that maintain target margins.

Order Entry

Read incoming POs from email and PDF. Validate line items against your catalog and customer pricing. Flag discrepancies.

One command center for your entire office

Every agent reports to a single dashboard. Quotes, orders, AP, AR, logistics, service, and prospecting at a glance.

Tired of your BlackBerry-era ERP?

Arzana ERP is infinitely customizable and comes with every Arzana AI agent pre-installed. The most innovative US manufacturers run on Arzana ERP.

Who we serve

Arzana is infinitely customizable, allowing us to serve manufacturers and distributors across various industries.

Tooling and Custom Parts

Job shops, mold makers, and make-to-order manufacturers handling diverse projects and specs

Industrial Components

Catalog-based manufacturers and distributors managing large product lines and repeat orders

Distributors

Paper Converters

William Alexander

We're building more than software. Alongside manufacturers across the United States, we're setting a new standard for how industrial offices operate. A future where AI complements human expertise, where teams work with confidence and efficiency, and where every employee has the freedom to focus on what actually grows the business.

Secure & integrated

Built for manufacturers who need reliability, security, and integrations that actually work.

name: Kaizen
brief:
Product: Kaizen
One-liner: Automate anything on the web.
Description: Kaizen uses browser agents to automate operational work across legacy web portals. We’re tackling the $300B business process outsourcing market by replacing the manual portal work that powers industries like healthcare, logistics, and financial services.
Industry: B2B
target:
Intake to payment, without lifting a finger.

You focus on care. Kaizen handles everything else.

Referral arrives by fax

Kaizen classifies the incoming fax and attaches it to the right patient.

Eligibility verified

Kaizen signs into the payer portal and confirms coverage and authorization requirements.

Evaluation completed

Kaizen books the evaluation and files the completed note back into the chart.

Evaluation reviewed

Kaizen checks the chart against the payer’s medical policy and requests what is missing.

Authorization submitted

Kaizen fills out the payer’s authorization form and uploads the supporting records.

Authorization approved

Kaizen posts the approval and authorization number to the chart.

The clinic of the future, powered by Kaizen.

Referrals worked the hour they arrive, benefits verified before scheduling, authorizations chased to a decision, and providers enrolled with every payer. Four workflows, run end to end.

Every referral converts, within minutes

Every referral gets instantly processed and immediately scheduled, increasing conversion rates by 100%

Verify every benefit detail before scheduling

Coverage, copay, deductible, visit limits and authorization requirements, all confirmed before the visit.

Every follow-up chased until the answer lands

Portal checks every day, calls placed and held through, records sent on request, peer-to-peer booked.

Credential every provider

Rosters and payer enrollments stay current, so no payment falls between the cracks.

Research every stale claim to an outcome

Kaizen finds the claim in the payer portal, reads the denial codes, pulls the remittance, and hands back a claim that is paid, appealed, or scheduled for follow-up.

Live in a week. Better every week after.

We connect to the systems you already run.

Your EHR, your payer portals, your fax line and your clearinghouse. Nothing is replaced and nothing is migrated.

We learn how your team works today.

We interview your team on how the work gets done — every payer quirk, every workaround — so Kaizen runs your process, not a generic one.

Kaizen works with your team like a real employee.

It has its own mailbox. It asks your staff when it needs a call made, answers when they ask where a case stands, and picks a case back up when a payer writes weeks later.

Track the metrics that matter to you.

Referrals processed, approval rates, hours returned and dollars collected, reported every week.

Roll Kaizen out across your entire back office.

Note audits, claims research, mail processing, records requests, bill generation — each workflow hands over the same way the first one did.

Note audits

Every referral gets instantly processed and immediately scheduled, increasing conversion rates by 100%

Verify every benefit detail before scheduling

Coverage, copay, deductible, visit limits and authorization requirements, all confirmed before the visit.

Every follow-up chased until the answer lands

Portal checks every day, calls placed and held through, records sent on request, peer-to-peer booked.

Credential every provider

Rosters and payer enrollments stay current, so no payment falls between the cracks.

Research every stale claim to an outcome

Kaizen finds the claim in the payer portal, reads the denial codes, pulls the remittance, and hands back a claim that is paid, appealed, or scheduled for follow-up.

Live in a week. Better every week after.

We connect to the systems you already run.

Your EHR, your payer portals, your fax line and your clearinghouse. Nothing is replaced and nothing is migrated.

We learn how your team works today.

We interview your team on how the work gets done — every payer quirk, every workaround — so Kaizen runs your process, not a generic one.

Kaizen works with your team like a real employee.

It has its own mailbox. It asks your staff when it needs a call made, answers when they ask where a case stands, and picks a case back up when a payer writes weeks later.

Track the metrics that matter to you.

Referrals processed, approval rates, hours returned and dollars collected, reported every week.

Roll Kaizen out across your entire back office.

Note audits, claims research, mail processing, records requests, bill generation — each workflow hands over the same way the first one did.

name: Precious
brief:
Product: Precious
One-liner: AI to curate your baby photos
Description: Precious is the iPhone app that tells the story of your children growing up. Using Artificial Intelligence, the app automatically finds the best baby pics on your phone, and then creates deliciously cute photo stories for you. Our vision is to help all families capture the joy of childhood. To do this, we are building the platform for preserving, enjoying & sharing your family's memories.
Industry: Consumer / Social
Tags: Artificial Intelligence
target:
The easiest way to turn your baby photos into cherished moments.

With two small children, it's not always easy to edit photos and throw in cute little extra stickers. This app makes it quick and simple; each picture I've done hasn't taken more than a minute, and I'm very pleased with the results. Even my husband is impressed!

I can honestly say that this app is everything it promises to be. I am very picky when it comes to ease of use and being time efficient and this app does everything for you. Super easy to use and has the best frames for your photos! It also makes videos of your special moments. I just love it all!!!!

If there was another name for the app Precious it would be Joy! I have a 7 week old baby (my first) and it’s so important to me to capture, share and save all the memories and milestones especially during the first year. Every day I look forward to the new frames and artwork for the photos I took from the day before!

Precious is such a fun and creative way to enjoy and remember the wonderful moments of your baby! It's also so helpful for mommy's who are busy because it creates picture art for you, so you don't have to think about it. Precious makes things easier by taking pictures and enhancing and embellishing them so you can just pick what you like and post them, it's super easy!

I am definitely enjoying the app. I really love the fact that the app creates photos, videos, animations, etc., for you but also gives you the opportunity to freestyle and use your own creativity. Another cool feature is the daily artwork, it's a cute surprise to look forward to.

As a busy new mom I’m able to capture photos on the go & they even prepare photos and videos for me, so I don’t miss any moment and get to enjoy motherhood!

Adorable Photo Art

Time Lapse Video

Automatic Albums

Photo Calendar

You don’t always have time to edit and organize your baby photos.

Open Precious each morning to see what new artwork we’ve created for you.

Industry: B2B / Retail
Tags: SaaS, Cannabis
target:
The Easiest Way to Sell Cannabis Across Every Point of Sale

From single-location operations to multi-location expansions, more dispensaries trust Meadow than any other platform to make cannabis retail growth simple and intuitive

Available Across the Country

It’s not just a California thing. Meadow is available in New York , New Jersey , Massachusetts , Michigan , Minnesota , and Washington D.C.—with more states to come.

A powerful platform augmented by integrations you already know and love

Meadow does it all— and then some . Our carefully curated integration partners help you operate your dispensary at an even higher level.

You don’t have to deal with compliance audits, constant turnover and a broken backend

Running your dispensary shouldn’t leave you permanently stressed out. Meadow is built to make running your cannabis business seamless.

“In 10 years in the business, Meadow is the best business platform I’ve ever used.”

Meadow gives you a single source of truth to manage sales channels, inventory and compliance – and make running your dispensary simple and intuitive.

Get lightning-fast, always-on support and get hours back every week.

Never sit waiting on a chat for 25 minutes again. Get all your questions answered by our team of cannabis retail experts in minutes—so you can get back to business

Modern dispensaries rely on Meadow to make business growth simple and intuitive

Manage your entire dispensary from one easy-to-use platform (yes, really)

Stop jumping back and forth between 17 different tools. With integrated logistics, delivery, and accounting, Meadow handles it all—so you can focus on your customers

A simple, intuitive interface everyone will love—from your budtenders to your business manager

Powerful, not overpowering. With Meadow, it’s easy for everyone on your team to stay on top of inventory, compliance, and reporting

name: Cashfree Payments
brief:
Product: Cashfree Payments
One-liner: Next-gen digital payments provider for India.
Description: Cashfree is a next-generation payments company for Indian businesses. Cashfree helps 50,000+ businesses collect and send money with solutions such as an easy to integrate payment gateway that supports instant settlements & refunds; Payouts - an API banking platform for bulk disbursals; a split payment solution for marketplaces; a Bank Account Verification API; a dedicated UPI stack for businesses and Auto Collect - a virtual account solution to match inbound payments to customers.
Industry: Fintech / Payments
Tags: Payments, India
target:
Get your business festive ready with India's Best Payment Gateway

CHOSEN BY ONE OF A KIND BUSINESSES

The whole payments stack, on one platform.

Every way your customer wants to pay. Online, in-store, on WhatsApp.

Cashfree Checkout

Loads in under 200ms, converts up to 10% more buyers, and lets returning customers pay in ten seconds flat.

Payment Gateway

180+ ways to pay across UPI, cards, EMI, netbanking and wallets. Built on payment infrastructure we run ourselves, so more of your payments go through. Never lose a sale to a missing option.

Subscriptions

Set up recurring billing in minutes. Customers approve once with UPI Autopay, cards or eNACH, and failed renewals retry automatically.

Payment Links (no-code)

Collect over WhatsApp, SMS or email with a shareable link. No website, no developer needed.

Payment Forms (no-code)

Custom branded forms that collect payments and customer details, with eSign and pay built in. No code.

Instant Settlements

Your sales money in your account in minutes, not T+2 days. Learn more

Go global, both ways.

International Payment Gateway

Accept payments from 170+ markets in 140+ currencies, settled in INR. Apple Pay and PayPal switched on from the dashboard.

Sell into India

Foreign businesses collect from Indian customers in local methods like UPI, RuPay and cards, with 80%+ success rates, settling to an overseas account in 100+ currencies at 0% FX, with no Indian entity.

Fraud loses. You win.

RiskShield

Real-time fraud screening on both directions of money movement, payments in and disbursals out, with chargebacks cut by up to 60%.

SecureID

360-degree identity verification: KYC, bank accounts, GST, documents and faces, verified in seconds, not days.

Mule Sentinel

Detect and block mule accounts and fraud networks before they move money through your business.

Payments, built for AI

Two ways AI is moving money for Indian businesses: taking payments inside AI, and running payment operations with agents.

Agentic Payments

Cashfree Here

Let customers pay with UPI, cards, QR or netbanking right inside AI chats like ChatGPT and Claude, with no payment details ever exposed to the AI. India's first in-chat payments, built on the MCP Apps standard with Mastercard and Swiggy.

Agentic Operations

Cashfree Relay

AI agents that run your back-office payment work: reconciliation, refunds, disputes, and COD checks. Pick a ready-made agent or build your own by describing what you need. You approve anything that moves money.

Payouts and refunds, done in seconds.

Payouts

brief:
Product: MinusX
One-liner: Open source agentic BI for founders
Description: MinusX is a state-of-the-art data agent that can build the best dashboards for your data, and notify you when something's up. You can interrogate all your data on our open source BI platform via Slack or MCP. Connect your data, and put agents to work.
Industry: B2B / Analytics
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Analytics, Data Science, AI Assistant
target:
Open source Agentic BI for Founders.

Your data stack , staffed by agents .

Every founder wants to do 3 things with their data

See MinusX in action

Your Business Intelligence tool is ironically the dumbest part of your AI stack. Let's fix that.

Product demos

Setup in seconds

Google Sheets to dashboard in ~5 mins

Use cases

Segments, channels, cohorts

P&L, burn rate, runway

Funnels, retention, adoption

SLAs, fulfillment, incidents

CAC, ROAS, attribution

Pipeline, deal flow, invoices

Why MinusX

We built a state-of-the-art [0] data agent that learns your business . Then built a BI platform around it.

[0] MinusX is SOTA and #1 (as of Jun 2026) on DataAgentBench , a realistic benchmark for data tasks from UC Berkeley's EPIC lab.

Where's my data?

Run MinusX OSS in your own environment, or use MinusX Cloud when speed matters. The core is source-available and inspectable. You can also BYO LLM keys to the cloud.

Your warehouse stays in your env.

Managed runtime, optional BYO keys.

Isn't this a text-to-SQL chatbot? Like < app > ?

Writing SQL is ~25% of analyst work. MinusX handles that, and everything else too. Built from the ground up for agents, not a chatbot bolted on to a BI tool.

Can I trust the answers?

Most data agents fail because they don't understand your company. What's ARR or how are active users defined? MinusX auto-learns context from every interaction, and you can test it with Evals.

#1 on DataAgentBench

A realistic benchmark for data analytics tasks, from UC Berkeley's EPIC lab.

Batteries included

Everything you need + best practices, out of the box

Slides & data stories

Narratives >>> Numbers. MinusX turns any analysis into a boardroom-ready deck or a scrollable data story, drafted end-to-end by the agent: charts, annotations, and takeaways included. Scrollytelling reports your team will actually read.

Beautiful viz, and a SQL GUI

Build rich visualizations: maps, funnels, GitHub-like heatmaps, and more. Tweak every detail in a full SQL editor or a point-and-click query builder, layer advanced filters, and drop charts straight into dashboards. Beautiful by default, editable down to the pixel.

Slack, MCPs, Skills

Ask questions from Slack or expose the MCP server for your AI agents. Analytics that fits into the modern AI workflow.

brief:
Product: Spot Health
One-liner: At-home diagnostics as a service
Description: Spot is building the infrastructure to support the future of at-home diagnostics. Our fully white-labeled platform helps brands offer lab-analyzed diagnostic tests using at-home collection kits. Companies simply order tests via our API, and we handle the rest—the collection kits, the logistics, physician authorization, and the lab integrations.
Industry: Healthcare / Diagnostics
Tags: Telehealth, Healthcare, Diagnostics
target:
Home Testing for Health Brands

Everything you need to offer your users lab-analyzed blood, urine, and saliva tests with at-home sample collection.

At-home testing is the future

At-home testing is fast, convenient, and more efficient than in-person lab visits. This is the future of diagnostics.

Your users, your brand

Launch with packaging and digital tools that match the brand your users already know and love.

Our Process

Order kits

We send an at-home collection kit to your user. Some states require a doctor’s order. We handle this for you.

User collects a sample

Get results

We make it easy to integrate results into your customer-facing app. We provide results, normal ranges, and medically-vetted interpretations.

A turnkey solution for home testing

Launching a testing operation is hard, but it doesn't need to be. Focus on what you do best, let us handle the rest.

Spot powers the brands transforming remote care

Whatever your connection to diagnostics, Spot is here to help you launch faster and better.

Tailor to a user's specific needs and track their progress - supplements, fitness programs, meal plans, and more.

Stop sending users to draw sites. Monitor chronic conditions and screen for cancers, STIs and more at home.

Promote your product with evidence-based claims. We help you run efficacy studies at a fraction of the cost.

Learn how home testing adds value to your brand

Let's work together to change the future of patient care.

Riveter's AI agents search the internet to find exactly what you're looking for.

Trusted by

Stop fighting with web data

name: Lapis
brief:
Product: Lapis
One-liner: AI that creates and runs ads, end-end
Description: Lapis builds, launches, and scales paid ad campaigns for DTC and SaaS businesses. Lapis agents handle every step of the paid ads journey: writing ad copy (headlines and descriptions), generating the static images used in ads, deploying campaigns across paid channels, creating a custom landing page for each ad, and feeding real user interaction data back into a self-improving ads engine that gets better every day.
Industry: B2B / Marketing
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B, Marketing, Advertising, AI
target:
Self-Improving Ads Engine For Modern Growth Teams

AI agents that create, launch, and optimize your paid ads, learning from every result to make them better each day.

Trusted by 1,500+ marketing teams including

A Fully Integrated Paid Ad Stack

From targeting and bidding strategy to creative and landing pages, Lapis creates, launches, and optimizes the entire campaign lifecycle as one connected system.

Meet buyers inside ChatGPT

Show up as a sponsored result when a conversation reveals real buying intent.

Creative built for the conversation

Turn buyer questions into headlines, offers, and visuals designed for the context around the answer.

Create better ads, faster

Transform your strategy and brand assets into campaign-ready creative in minutes.

Turn every direction into an experiment

Create variations across messages and creative directions, then learn from how they perform with real traffic.

Match the page to the promise

Give each campaign angle a complete, on-brand page aligned to the message and audience behind the click.

Learn from the whole page

Test complete page directions against the conversion you care about, then carry post-click learning into the next launch.

Lapis learns your brand from your site

Lapis reads your website to learn your logo, colors, type, voice, and products to deeply understand your product and target customers, and uses it to build ads and landing pages.

One idea, ready for every platform

Every platform wants creative in a different format. OmniSense uses the brand system and builds ready to deploy ads in every format for Meta, Google, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Reddit.

Show up when buyers ask ChatGPT

Buyers are asking ChatGPT what to buy. ChatSense places your brand in the answer as a sponsored result with an ad matched to their real query, making sure you can capture intent exactly when it's surfaced.

Put your best angles in front of buyers

Lapis performs A/B tests at rapid scale, testing ad variations on live traffic and weighing the results in real-time, making sure to only create and scale ads that truly convince buyers.

Give every click a page that matches

A good ad needs a great landing page. RapidDomain builds a full, on-brand page that keeps your ad's promise and context, making sure customers see website content tailored to their intent.

Every campaign makes the next one smarter

name: Common Paper
brief:
Product: Common Paper
One-liner: The SAFE for commercial contracts
Description: Common Paper is a contracting platform that helps startups close deals with their customers faster and with less risk. We create standard, open-source contracts for commercial transactions, including NDAs, DPAs, and sales agreements. These are analogous to the SAFE, but are between customers and vendors rather than investors and startups. The standardized format means that data within contracts is structured from inception.
Industry: B2B / Sales
Tags: SaaS, Open Source, Sales, Legal, LegalTech
target:
Contract system built for startups.

Contracts are a team sport. It all starts with a founder working with their first customer to close the deal. Before long, multiple stakeholders need to negotiate, agree on terms, and deliver on what was committed. Common Paper is built to help teams execute on contracts faster.

Trusted by:

Contract management for startups

The fastest way for a startup to close deals and execute on contracted commitments.

Activate contract data in downstream systems

Use structured contract data in your applications like Stripe and Zendesk.

Send a contract in one-click

Empower sales to send pre-approved contracts directly from the CRM, monitor the status of their outstanding contracts, and help them over the finish line.

Contract Lifecycle Management at startup speed

No multi-week enterprise implementation. Get your first contract out in minutes using a Standard Agreement or your custom template

Use Common Paper via our API or MCP

Review less, close more.

For teams who need to close contracts faster while controlling risk. Gerri redlines against your playbook in minutes, and brings in a human only when something falls outside the rules.

Scale legal expertise

Define your risk posture once with Smart Playbooks, then let Gerri apply it across every contract.

Accelerate your sales cycle

Gerri generates an updated draft of the contract in minutes, so deals stop waiting on manual review.

Coordinate contract review across your team

Smart escalation routes out-of-playbook items to the right owner in security, finance, or legal, with a full audit history.

Runs in Gmail. Works on any Word or PDF contract.

Start with standards used by 40,000+ companies.

Common Paper standard agreements are created and maintained by a committee of lawyers and used by 40,000+ companies. The standards are like the SAFE for sales contracts.

Cloud Service Agreement

Sell cloud software and SaaS products.

Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement

Confidently share information with another party.

Data Processing Agreement

Establish how personal data will be processed.

Service Level Agreement

Set performance targets.

Professional Services Agreement

Sell services and custom deliverables.

Free and open-source under Creative Commons. Maintained by a committee of attorneys.

Common Paper streamlined our commercial negotiations, freeing up our lawyers and contract managers to focus on more important matters. Our sales team is happy, and we’ve seen broad acceptance by our customers.”

name: spotLESS Materials
brief:
Product: spotLESS Materials
One-liner: Repellent coatings without PFAS
Description: Surface fouling is a costly challenge across industries, impacting medical consumables, diagnostic devices, and automotive components. Contamination from substances like mud, ice, and sludge can compromise performance and lead to frequent cleaning, repairs, and replacements. Our PFAS-free coating, which we first launched as a consumer product, has quickly expanded into industrial partnerships.
Industry: Industrials
Tags: Hard Tech, Nanotechnology, Advanced Materials
target:
The difference is clear.

spotLESS Materials is an advanced materials coatings company delivering the best-performing environmentally sustainable non-stick coatings to the market.

WHAT WE DO

spotLESS Materials provides leading anti-fouling coating solutions across industries. Tell us your application requirements, surface to coat, material to repel, and durability requirements, and we'll find a repellent solution for you.

THE TECHNOLOGY

Inspired by Nature

Our team is passionate about nature-inspired design and engineering. We especially love looking at plants and insects under a microscope and understanding how form is coupled with function. We also love making useful things. We’ll observe an interesting surface property in nature, understand the governing physics, and apply what we learn to make advanced materials.

Perfected by Science

Founded in May 2018, spotLESS Materials provides state-of-the-art solutions to address sticky problems common across various industries by developing and commercializing a liquid- and sludge-repellent bio-inspired self-healing surface coating. Known as a liquid-entrenched smooth surface (LESS), this technology addresses commercial needs related to fouling, icing, self-cleaning, and more.

THE NUMBERS SPEAK FOR THEMSELVES

spotLESS coated surfaces have

less sludge compared to untreated glass

less mineral deposits compared to untreated glass

reduction in water needed to clean

BEST IN CLASS

Key to the spotLESS coatings is the use of liquid-infused nano-brush technology, which forms a molecular-smooth, ultra-slippery layer that can repel sludge, liquid, mineral deposits and more. It has been demonstrated that our spotLESS coating technology is the best-in-class in repelling sludge-like substances as compared to other state-of-the-art hydrophobic and superhydrophobic coatings [1].

[1] J. Wang, et al., Nature Sustainability 2: 1097-1105 (2019).

WORK WITH US

When you choose to work with spotLESS Materials you choose to work with a team of world-class, award-winning scientists and engineers that will help you find the right coating for your product or process.

The spotLESS Advantage

PRODUCTS AND SERVICES

SMALL VOLUMES

LARGE VOLUME SOLUTIONS

CUSTOM INDUSTRY SOLUTIONS

spotLESS Industries

Medical

Solutions for patients, devices, and biomedical processing

Sanitation

Liquid- and sticky solid-repellent, durable coatings for sanitation applications

Automotive

Anti-ice, liquid- and sticky solid-repellent coatings for glass, sensors, and cameras

And beyond

spotLESS solutions can be rapidly applied to glass, metals, and plastics for uses across countless industries

Tell us your antifouling needs. We'll find a solution for you.

In the News

Support and Recognition

Contact us.

One-liner: We deliver personalized medicine for neurodegenerative patients
Description: Personalized virtual clinical care is finally here for neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and related Dementias (Cognitive), Parkinson's and Huntington's (Movement), and ALS (Motor neuron). We provide a novel approach to care in these diseases, centering a patient and caregiver around a coordinator who quarterbacks patients through our full Multi-Disciplinary Care Resources to local aid, PT/OT and home health support.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare Services
Tags: Health Tech, Telehealth, Digital Health, Healthcare, Mental Health
target:
Expert Neurology Care, Made Simple

Fast access to expert care for Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, ALS and more. Covered by insurance. Available in all 50 states.

Alzheimer's and other dementias

Focused on conditions affecting memory, thinking, and cognitive functions, providing specialized care to improve quality of life and manage symptoms effectively.

ALS and related diseases

Specialized care addressing conditions affecting nerves and muscles, enhancing mobility, managing symptoms, and improving daily living.

Parkinson's and other movement disorder diseases

Dedicated to conditions affecting motor control and movement, offering personalized treatment plans to maintain independence and improve functional ability.

Mental Health Care

Comprehensive support for mental and emotional well-being, providing targeted therapies and counseling for individuals and caregivers facing neurological conditions.

Your Path to Specialized Neurology Care

Meet Your Dedicated Care Team

See Your Expert Neurologist Over Video Visit

Receive Your Personalized Care Plan

24/7 Support and Collaboration with Your Local Doctors

Available in All 50 States and Covered by Most Insurance

We are available in all 50 states and covered by most insurance. Our telehealth clinic works with you and your existing care team seamlessly.

Patients and Caregivers Love Synapticure

We love the kindness and care from Rebecca and Dr. Jaimie Hatcher-Martin.Great service offered to ALS patients as well as Compassionate, help and understanding!!!

Great people all around. Taking great care of pALS and cALS. Predictable access and patient-centered support using a solid telehealth network.

Synapticure and support with speech therapy has been a true blessing in helping to care for my wife with Alzheimer's disease. Today Kylee was able to bring out her thoughts as she changes.

What could have been traumatic was actually very pleasant. Raven brought out the best in him—he was totally at ease and actually proud of himself after the session. You wiped away any fear or doubt and proved that Synapticure is the real deal.

Our PCP was so impressed with the thoroughness of the notes from Synapticure. He was very excited about the new treatment options you recommended, which were new to him. For the first time, I don't feel like we're fighting the system alone.

The willingness of my neurologist to prescribe off label has given me new hope in my fight with ALS. It allows me to try something new while waiting for a clinical trial. For anyone fighting ALS , time is of the essence and the speed that Synapticure is something other providers should strive for. Thank you for giving me hope!

name: Theorem
brief:
Product: Theorem
One-liner: The mission of Theorem is to make credit safe and available. We use…
Description: Theorem conducts independent underwriting of consumer loans originated by banks, credit cards companies and other lenders. We utilize this information to manage institutional capital and securitize loans
Industry: Fintech / Asset Management
Tags: Fintech, Machine Learning
target:
Hello World, We’re Theorem.

We build credit underwriting technology that’s powered billions in lending across our funding network since 2014

What we offer

Custom Loan Integration Programs (CLIP)

A pioneering machine learning powered underwriting program

Sustainably expand your origination volume with the Custom Loan Integration Program (CLIP) and receive instant, accurate interest rates on applications

Assess loan applications in seconds with our API

Use CLIP to approve previously declined applications or alongside existing underwriting processes

CLIP can help you offer new financing products to your existing customers on your platform

Theorem Securitization As a Service (SaaS)

Originators, meet capital markets

Our Securitization as a Service (SaaS) program packages loans into credit products investors can hold

Partner With Us

Our network connects partners with what they need

Our access to capital and automated underwriting technology means we can help our partners grow their lending businesses

Our Technology

We build infrastructure to power our credit underwriting platform and funding network

Theorem Loan Score (TLS)

Discerning risk in a way few others can

Our industry needed a new standard. We stepped up. The Theorem Loan Score is a tested, machine-learning driven evaluation of the default risk of a loan. Trained on millions of historical loan records and data points, it evaluates a loan instead of assigning a credit score to a person.

Models that love to learn

We marry machine-learning with human insight

Terabytes of data can do more harm than good without the ability to interpret them. We iteratively test and train models to quantify risk down to each projected cash flow.

Data at our heart

Good underwriting requires great data management

We depend on data to meet our underwriting standards. From application, servicing and collateral data to channel and source information — we’re all about the big picture.

Why we exist

Consumer credit markets have an efficiency problem

We’re here to fix it

Help us change a trillion dollar market

We're more than just number crunchers or developers. We want curious minds with the drive to find new solutions in old credit markets. If that sounds like you, we'd love to chat.

Featured Positions

name: Simplex
brief:
Product: Simplex
One-liner: AI agents to enroll providers with payors
Description: Simplex builds AI agents to handle provider enrollment end-to-end. We automate pulling provider data from CAQH, filling out enrollment forms + uploading licenses via payor portals/email/phone, updating applications when returned for corrections, and performing effective date follow-ups until a final determination is made, all autonomously.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Machine Learning, Robotic Process Automation, B2B, AI
target:
Automate provider operations.

From the minute you get your providers’ CAQH logins, Simplex sets up your providers’ CAQHs, enrolls them in national and regional payers, and flows effective dates into your RCM tooling automatically.

Simplex works inside your existing systems.

Payer portals

Fills out web forms, uploads and downloads rosters

PDFs

Populates and e-signs applications

Emails

Responds to follow-ups and automatically tracks effective dates

Frequently asked questions

We charge a flat fee per completed enrollment. We also charge per year if you'd like us to manage your providers' CAQH profiles.

We cover traditional Medicare (PECOS), Medicare Advantage, and commercial payers via portal, roster, email, and/or PDF submissions. Medicaid coming soon. We can provide a list of currently covered payers upon request, and we work with our customers to help get full coverage of their payers.

Yes. We sign a BAA before any data is shared.

CAQH logins for your providers, tax entity information, and practice locations. We can pull all necessary data for enrollments from these sources and state licensing boards.

Simplex doesn’t currently operate as a CVO. We integrate with wherever your data lives: Salesforce, Airtable, etc., in order to automate the ops work on top of your data.

Every run has a step-by-step log and a replay video of the agent's actions, tied to the provider and payer.

The fastest way to understand your users, market, and customers

Surveys, interviews, and tests with real and synthetic users. Made easy by AI.

May 8, 2026 · 47 interviews · 4 themes

Helping research, product, and design teams learn and iterate faster

One platform, multiple methods

We're happy you're here!

How Does SimpleCitizen Work

Our time-saving software makes doing/completing an immigration application easy! All you need to do is add your information and documents, then the software assembles the forms. Your entire application is then reviewed by our independent network of immigration attorneys. Afterward, we will guide you step-by-step through understanding the attorney’s recommendations. When finished, we can even print, assemble and mail your immigration application in a beautiful box right to your door so that you can submit it to the government!

Answer Questions

Answer questions about your situation and upload required documents. Our time-saving software then assembles all of your selected USCIS forms and supporting evidence.

Step 2:

Application Review & Updates

Gain peace of mind by having your application reviewed by SimpleCitizen’s independent network of immigration attorneys. That way you can submit to USCIS with confidence.

Step 3:

Printing & Shipping

Once you are ready, we can print, assemble, and mail your application right to your door! It’s all packaged in a beautiful box with instructions and important information showing exactly what you need to do next. Take a look inside the box!

We're in This Together

name: Paladin
brief:
Product: Paladin
One-liner: We deploy autonomous drones to 911 calls. Our software gives first…
Description: When a 911 call is received, our drone is autonomously dispatched from a fire station and flies to the scene. It streams a live video feed back to the first responders, providing them with key situational details, such as the size and exact location of a fire.
Industry: Industrials / Drones
Tags: SaaS, Drones, GovTech
target:
First Eyes on Scene Before Units Arrive

Get eyes on scene in under 90 seconds, delivering real-time aerial intelligence before first-responders arrive.

Real-Time Intelligence Before Arrival

Paladin autonomously deploys drones to emergency incidents, delivering real-time aerial intelligence before the first unit arrives. Built as infrastructure any department can use, regardless of city size, the platform integrates with dispatch workflows to provide immediate situational awareness and support community-led public safety operations.

Dedicated 24/7 Public Safety Support

Real-time aerial intelligence gives responders clearer situational awareness, helping them approach incidents safely and coordinate responses with confidence.

Plug-and-Play Deployment

An easy-to-deploy aerial response system that enables departments to quickly add aerial capability without complex aviation programs.

Stronger Community Trust

Early visibility helps departments manage incidents responsibly and transparently, strengthening trust between agencies and the communities they serve.

Real-World Operational Impact

Locations represent active accounts across public safety agencies in the United States.

Dispatch to Intelligence

Drone is Deployed

A drone is launched automatically from the department’s dock as soon as an incident is reported, giving teams immediate aerial visibility.

Drone En Route

The drone travels directly to the incident location while transmitting live data to command and responding units.

Drone Gathers Intelligence

Once on scene, the drone provides live aerial and thermal views, helping responders understand the situation before they arrive.

Drone Returns to Dock

After the mission, the operator triggers the return command and the drone autonomously flies back to its dock to recharge and prepare for the next deployment.

Proven in Real Operations

Ferguson PD implemented a Drone-as-First-Responder program with Paladin to modernize operations, improve response times, and increase situational awareness. The initiative has strengthened transparency, rebuilt community trust, and transformed how the department responds to incidents.

Forest Park PD deployed Paladin’s DFR system to achieve real-time aerial visibility across incidents and eliminate delays in situational awareness. The program now supports near citywide coverage, enabling faster response, safer coordination, and more efficient operations.

average aerial response time

incidents seen before ground units arrive

Murrells Inlet FD implemented Paladin’s DFR system to gain real-time aerial visibility for fire, EMS, and search operations. The program has improved situational awareness and enabled faster, more effective response during critical incidents, including search and recovery missions.

Elizabeth PD scaled Paladin’s DFR program from a single drone to a fully staffed 24/7 operation, transforming how they respond to incidents. The program has enabled faster response, increased coverage, and measurable impact across daily 911 calls and arrests.

brief:
Product: Armilla AI
One-liner: Liability insurance for generative AI and AI Agents
Description: Armilla AI (YC W22) is the first YC-backed MGA and Lloyd's Coverholder dedicated to insuring AI-related risks. Armilla's insurance policies cover developers and deployers of generative AI and AI agents for performance and liability -- from errors and hallucinations, to incorrect decisions, data leakage, regulatory violations and more.
Industry: Fintech / Insurance
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Insurance
target:
AI Insurance ‍ & Underwriting

Purpose-built AI insurance for generative AI and AI agents. Deploy solutions that are safe, secure, and insured.

Trusted and Recognized By

Affirmative Insurance Built for AI Risk

The traditional insurance policies most companies carry were written before generative AI, so they are silent on AI failure modes: they neither clearly affirm coverage for them nor clearly deny it. Armilla provides named, affirmative AI insurance that responds to those failure modes directly, so you can deploy with confidence and answer procurement questions in writing.

Sample Coverage Areas

AI Model Error Liability : Financial loss suffered by third parties arising from AI model underperformance (e.g. errors, inaccurate outputs, hallucinations).

AI Model Output Liability : Legal claims arising from the outputs of the underperforming AI system, including breach of confidentiality, trade secrets, defamation, libel, and slander.

AI Agent Mistakes : Legal claims arising from underperforming AI agents, including failure to escalate recommendations, incorrect decisions causing damages.

Non-Breach Privacy & Data Leakage Liability : Legal claims and regulatory investigations arising from unintended disclosures through model outputs, hallucinations.

AI Model Property Damage Liability : Damage to third-party property caused by the underperformance of an AI system.

AI Model Regulatory Violations : Defense costs and fines for actions or investigations into AI underperformance, including “high-risk” AI systems (e.g. Colorado AI Act, EU AI Act).

Brokers, Offer Your Clients AI Protection

Faster, Smarter Underwriting : Rapid quote turnarounds, driven by Armilla’s AI risk analytics.

Competitive Edge : Differentiate your brokerage as a trusted advisor with specialized AI risk solutions.

Dedicated Broker Support : White-glove resources, training, and co-marketing to help you succeed.

Businesses, Innovate Without Fear

Clear Compliance: Build confidence in your AI compliance with AI regulations and industry standards.

Risk Transfer: Offload the financial burden of AI disruptions, from non-breach security issues to performance failures.

Dedicated Expertise: We provide AI specialists to help with robust stress testing, red teaming, and more.

Risk Teams, Strengthen Your AI Risk Posture

In-Depth AI Assessments: Understand model weaknesses, compliance red flags, and recommended next steps.

Ongoing Monitoring: Continuous tracking and updates on evolving threats or regulatory changes.

‍ Incident Coordination: Expert assistance to manage and resolve any AI-related crisis swiftly.

Affirmative AI Insurance

Protection for Every Aspect of AI Risk

Respond to liability claims, lawsuits, and financial losses that can arise from AI failures.

Description: Moda is a harness engineering platform. The infra problems we actually take: transfer what a frontier model learned onto an open-source one without losing performance, and stand up a model router for your own system and task. Same loop both times. Name the layer that broke, ship the change, replay it on old traffic before it goes out.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
target:
Harness engineering that developers love

Moda turns production traces into verified improvements for your agent harness: prompts, tools, skills, evals, memory.

Teams shipping with Moda

From broken traces to validated fixes

A continuous system for finding failures, generating improvements & proving what should ship

01 Diagnose production failures

Find where each run broke, why it failed, and whether the issue came from the prompt, tools, workflow, memory, model, or product logic.

02 Generate concrete improvements

Turn repeated failure patterns into specific fixes your team can review: prompt changes, tool updates, workflow edits, verifier gates, eval cases, and reusable skills.

03 Validate what to ship

Test improvements against historical production traces, measure impact and regressions, then recommend the most reliable fix.

Find out where each run broke and why

Moda analyzes agent logs to separate prompt, tool, workflow, memory, model, and product-logic failures — across the whole trace.

name: Adaptional
brief:
Product: Adaptional
One-liner: AI-powered insurance claims review
Description: Adaptional is building agentic AI for insurance claims. Claims are 75% of every dollar in the $1T insurance industry -- and one of the most under-optimized areas, still managed by adjusters working hundreds of files by hand. We're changing this with AI claims review agents, already deployed at some of the major P&C carriers. In the future, claims will be powered by an intelligence layer that manages files and escalates actions to human adjusters.
Industry: B2B
Tags: AIOps, Artificial Intelligence, Insurance, Enterprise, Enterprise Software
target:
AI-powered continuous claims review

Audit 100% of claims. Catch compliance gaps, leakage, and reserve issues in real time.

The intelligence platform accelerating claims

The right insights at the right time, on every claim. AI-powered quality review and next actions that accelerate handling and improve outcomes.

Up and running in days

Connect your claims system, define a scorecard, and let Adaptional audit every file — continuously. No integration project required.

Feed data from Guidewire, Duck Creek, or any system. Adaptional ingests files, notes, and documents.

Define audit criteria that matter — compliance, coverage, reserves, leakage, service quality, and subrogation.

Every claim reviewed against your scorecard in real time. Surface issues as they happen, not months later.

Send alerts to managers on open files and monitor to ensure issues are resolved

Workflows transformed

Manual QA wasn't built for this

Teams sample 3-5 files per adjuster per month at <5% of total claims. The rest go unreviewed, and findings come too late to act on.

Every hour on QA is an hour not spent on claims

QA requires manual effort: pulling files, filling out scorecards, and writing action plans — all for a handful of reviews that barely scratch the surface.

Random samples miss what matters

Files are randomly selected with little strategic targeting. Many high-risk claims go unreviewed. Patterns across adjusters and teams stay hidden.

By the time you find it, it's too late

By the time a monthly review surfaces a missed deadline or reserve gap, the damage is already done. Leakage compounds every day you don't see it.

Six dimensions. Every file

Adaptional evaluates every claim across the dimensions that drive leakage, compliance risk, and policyholder outcomes.

Compliance

Deadlines, regulatory requirements, CMS reporting, time limit demands — flagged before they become violations.

Coverage

Policy terms matched against claim decisions. Catch coverage errors, missed exclusions, and incorrect limits.

Leakage

Identify overpayments, missed deductibles, and billing errors that silently erode your loss ratio.

Service Quality

Contact frequency, documentation standards, and policyholder communication — the metrics that drive retention.

Subrogation

Surface recovery opportunities buried in claims files. Catch missed subro potential before statutes expire.

Reserves

Flag stale or inadequate reserves and patterns that signal future development issues.

The real ROI isn't headcount

Even 1% better indemnity accuracy is worth millions. Add reduced leakage, fewer fines, and freed-up manager time — the case builds itself.

Built by people who know claims — and know AI

name: Convexia
brief:
Product: Convexia
One-liner: The world's first AI-maximalist pharma company
Description: An AI-maximalist pharma platform. We use agents to buy drugs, run clinical trials, and sell for a profit. 10x faster and 20x leaner than incumbents. Sourcing Agent: Mines public/private databases and unstructured global data to surface overlooked preclinical candidates. Scientific Agent: Runs comp bio models (ESM-3, RFdiffusion, Boltz-2, AlphaFold) to assess safety and efficacy in silico.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
Tags: AI-powered Drug Discovery, Biotech, Drug Delivery
target:
Uncover Drug Assets 10x faster

Find and evaluate drugs better than ever before.

Free to try. No credit card.

How Convexia Works

An end-to-end AI stack that replaces months of manual diligence with fast execution.

Asset Discovery Agent

We scan the globe for overlooked drug assets.

From preclinical biotech to abandoned pharma IP, our AI pulls in structured and unstructured data to find high-potential candidates.

Scientific Evaluation Stack

We run deep in silico simulations.

Over 50 custom-tuned models assess binding, toxicity, ADME/PK, immunogenicity, and mechanistic fit.

Specialist Human Review

Experts validate the science.

PhDs with domain expertise review each asset's biology, risks, and translatability before greenlighting it for development.

Market Insight Agent

Uncovers the strongest signals in the market

Every asset is ranked based on unmet need, competitive landscape, IP positioning, reimbursement signals, financial projections, and other market-shaping factors.

Operational Risk Agent

Digital twin simulations to score execution risk before trials start.

CRO fragility, CMC complexity, site readiness, and real-world disruption are modeled to flag trial fragility and avoid costly delays.

Probability of Success Model

Go/No-Go decisions anchored to historical benchmarks .

We predict success likelihood using a proprietary model and scoring rubric developed with VCs, pharma, and KOLs, aggregating outputs from all agents and benchmarking against analog deals.

Final Human Review

A live roundtable with KOLs makes the final call.

Scientific, regulatory, commercial, and clinical leaders align on risk, timing, and exit strategy before making a go/no-go decision.

Explore ConvexiaBench

Step inside the ConvexiaBench — a showcase of our AI agents in action. From sourcing overlooked molecules to predicting clinical feasibility, see how our tools compare to legacy tools and frontier LLMs.

Explore Our In-Silico Drug Evaluation Stack

We combine 50+ models to assess every asset across molecular, structural, and translational domains.

Binding & Mechanistic Coherence

Evaluates whether a molecule binds its target and drives the desired downstream effects, using structure-based docking and pathway-aware models.

ADME & Pharmacokinetics

Predicts absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion using validated ML models, flagging liabilities like poor bioavailability or rapid clearance.

Toxicity & Safety Profiling

Screens for general and organ-specific toxicity risks using multi-modal predictors trained on human and animal datasets.

Off-Target & Immunogenicity Risk

Scans for unintended interactions and immune triggers using structure- and sequence-based predictors to minimize adverse effects and immune rejection.

Why Our AI is Different

Built for real-world drug development, not just to say we use AI.

brief:
Product: VOYGR
One-liner: Real-world place intelligence for AI apps and agents
Description: VOYGR is a better maps API every agent and AI app will need. Google says '4.2 stars, open till 10 – VOYGR knows the chef left, wait times doubled, and locals moved on. Our intelligent local search combines accurate place data with fresh web context – news, articles, and events. We expand beyond 10-15 map attributes into infinite, queryable place profiles, enabling agents to reason and act in the real world. Maps are no longer browsed – LLMs/agents use them to reason and act.
Industry: B2B
target:
The real-world intelligence and action layer

Validate and enrich your POI data. Connect your AI to millions of businesses.

Trusted by

Location Freshness Validation

Confirm historical existence and current operating status. Detect discrepancies across key attributes.

Location Data Enrichment

Populate and continuously enrich place records using web, social, authoritative, and other data sources.

PlaceCall API

Reach tens of millions of businesses through a single API, directly from your AI assistant or application.

VOYGR takes a rigorous approach to location data quality, delivering outputs with exceptional precision. The team operates at high velocity, rapidly expanding into new categories and countries. This makes VOYGR a valuable partner for Overture's global location data initiatives.

Spatial intelligence is only as strong as the places layer underpinning it. For AR and real-world agents alike, you need more than just pins on a map - you need place understanding. Location data must be far richer than static attributes and remain continuously refreshed. VOYGR feels like essential infrastructure for making real world experiences that are actually useful.

VOYGR's location data is a strong foundation for sales optimization in retail. It makes it easier to build analytical models that organize sales efforts, visualize opportunities and whitespace, and prioritize accounts. It's also highly useful for site selection and expansion planning.

brief:
Product: MDalgorithms Inc.
One-liner: Democratizing Dermatology with AI
Description: MDalgorithms is revolutionizing dermatology by delivering convenient, effective AI-powered solutions for skin and hair care. Since pioneering machine-learning models for acne treatment in 2017, we’ve advanced to develop the world’s first AI-powered scalp analysis for hair regrowth. Our proprietary AI technology, built entirely in-house, analyzes blemishes, lesions, and hair conditions with unmatched precision, utilizing the largest global dataset of acne and scalp images.
Industry: Healthcare / Consumer Health and Wellness
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Consumer Health Services, Consumer, Healthcare, Telemedicine
target:
Democratizing dermatology with AI.

We deliver convenient, effective solutions in skin and hair for all.

Pioneers in AI-powered personalized care for all.

Since 2017, we have pioneered personalized over-the-counter skincare — first for people with acne-prone skin, then with the world’s first AI-powered scalp analysis for hair regrowth. With Nuvane, we bring that same precision to longevity skincare, using AI and next-generation peptide technology to help turn back the clock on skin aging. Every product is built around one principle: care tailored to each individual’s unique needs.

MDacne

MDhair

Nuvane

Our Philosophy

MDalgorithms continues to deliver cutting-edge acne treatment, hair regrowth, and anti-aging skincare solutions through a careful, extensive process.

Best-in-class AI

Our proprietary AI technology, built entirely in-house, sets the gold standard in personalized skin and hair care:

Customized treatment kits

Each individual receives a treatment kit customized to their skin and hair specific needs.

Superior results

We provide a targeted, effective solution that minimizes irritation while maximizing results — all in a convenient package that minimizes the hassle and guesswork of acne, hair, and skincare.

In addition, customers can track their progress, adjust treatments as needed, and access real-time support and guidance from our team of dermatologists and nurses.

Superior total care, tailored to You .

Clinical trials

MDhair Clinical Trial

MDhair’s treatment kits have been clinically validated. They were rigorously tested in a six-month study in the USA, which was approved by an Institutional Review Board. The study demonstrated statistically significant improvements in hair growth, coverage, and thickness. J Drugs Dermatol. 2025 Mar;24(3)

Nuvane Clinical Trial

In an independent, IRB-approved 12-week clinical study (n=38), the AI-personalized skin longevity regimen significantly reduced wrinkles, fine lines, and crow’s feet, while improving firmness, radiance, and under-eye bags — with over 94% satisfaction and visible results starting by week 4. Results were statistically significant (p<0.01). European Academy for Dermatology and Venereology, Athens, May 2026.

It doesn’t stop at clinical trials.

Explore more of our published research.

Computer vision AI-based androgenetic hair loss analysis using a novel direct to consumer mobile web app.

AI-based customization in hair loss treatment: a 6-month clinical trial with TEWL and scanning electron microscopy.

Electron microscopic analysis of 6-month customized, AI-based topical and oral treatment effects on hair strand quality.

AI-based customized treatments for scalp health: 6-month trial on transepidermal water loss.

AI-based personalization of treatment regimen for hair loss: a 6-month clinical trial.

Large-scale rapid and efficient acne research using a novel direct-to-consumer mobile app.

name: Control Seat
brief:
Product: Control Seat
One-liner: AI that runs factories.
Description: Control Seat builds the hardware and software that helps industrial teams see, understand, and run their operations. Our platform creates one clear source of truth across the plant. It connects the systems teams already use, brings control, monitoring, history, and machine health together, and adds an intelligence layer that continuously watches for meaningful changes. Teams can understand what happened, catch problems earlier, and act before they become downtime.
Industry: Industrials
Tags: Workflow Automation, Monitoring, Industrial
target:
A sensor knows the machine. Your plant data knows the situation.

Most condition monitoring never sees your plant.

Its own sensors, its own login, and no idea what the rest of the plant was doing.

Nothing works until hardware ships

The trial needs budget approval before it can prove it deserves one.

A fault and a busy week look the same

Vibration went up. Worn bearing, or a heavier product that week? A sensor alone can't tell, so it flags both.

Alerts nobody trusts

Enough warnings nobody can explain and people stop opening them. That is what kills these programs.

Some faults are already in your tags. Others need a sensor.

From tags you already have

Motor load and power factor drift, temperature above ambient, pump curves falling off, filters loading, cycle times creeping. Your historian has been recording them for years.

From a wireless sensor

Worn bearings, gear wear, dry lubrication, looseness, cavitation. These only show up in high-frequency vibration and ultrasound, which a historian never samples fast enough to catch.

From both

Every sensor finding is judged against load, speed, ambient, and what ran next to it. A machine wearing out stops looking like a machine working hard.

Point it at what you already run.

One box. Every sensor in range.

Sensors are found automatically. Assign one to a machine and its readings arrive as ordinary tags, next to your historian data.

It learns what normal is, then names what changed.

Every machine gets a baseline from how it actually runs, not a threshold somebody guessed at.

See the fault and the shift that caused it.

Most plants don't have a vibration analyst.

Findings you can actually check.

A verdict nobody can check is a verdict nobody acts on.

Every finding names its basis

A published limit, a frequency that points to one specific part, or a change from how this machine normally runs.

Weak evidence stays advisory

Nothing gets promoted to urgent because a number happened to be large.

No finding is a diagnosis

It's a ranked hypothesis with its evidence attached. New sensors page nobody until you've checked their work.

Not just the machines that spin.

Most condition monitoring is one accelerometer on one motor. We read your tags, and add sensors for vibration, pressure, flow, current, and temperature.

Rotating

Bearing wear, unbalance, misalignment, gear mesh. Motors, pumps, fans, gearboxes.

Fluid and process

Pump curve degradation, filter loading, heat exchanger fouling, valve stroke drift, leaks.

Electrical

name: Theseus
brief:
Product: Theseus
One-liner: GPS Denied Navigation for Drones
Description: Theseus builds visual navigation software for GPS-denied drone operations. Using onboard cameras, inertial sensors, and satellite reference imagery, our system computes position fixes entirely passively. The system is entirely self contained, can't be jammed and has no RF signature.
Industry: Industrials / Drones
Tags: Robotics, Drones, Defense
target:
GPS-denied visual autonomy

Software-first visual positioning for drones operating in GPS-denied environments.

Our mission is to keep humans far from the battlefield.

EW is standard. Mission failure cannot be. Theseus gives drones reliable position when GPS is jammed, spoofed, or gone.

Cyclops is software-only visual positioning built to integrate fast, hold up across terrain and lighting, and deploy at scale.

Cyclops

Software-first visual positioning

Cyclops compares live camera imagery against pre-generated reference maps to estimate vehicle position in real time. It outputs positions to the flight controller over standard MAVLink interfaces.

GPS-denied positioning

Reliable global position estimates when GPS is jammed, spoofed, or unavailable. Outputs over MAVLink for straightforward flight-controller integration.

Day and night

Cyclops is compatible with EO and LWIR cameras. Fly thermal at night, EO during the day.

Fast Integration

Typical integration starts with a short bench setup and validation flights, letting teams evaluate Cyclops quickly without major hardware changes.

Commodity hardware

Runs on NDAA-compliant, widely available compute and camera hardware, including platforms like Raspberry Pi 5 and Nvidia Jetson.

built for

Integrate GPS-denied positioning without building a new stack.

\ ArduPilot-native / MAVLink \ Commodity compute and camera hardware \ Scales without exotic sensors

Field reliable GPS-denied capability across fleets.

\ Resilient in contested environments \ Low SWaP-C deployment model \ Made in America, compliant, and scalable

Keep flying when GPS fails.

\ Dependable position in denied environments \ EO by day, thermal by night \ Lower cognitive load, higher mission continuity

Testimonials

Lt. COL

USAF

In the considered opinion of [our] AltPNT experts, Theseus offers a disproportionate value to the DoD in terms of its large potential and small investment request. Specifically, AltPNT has notoriously required robust processing enclaves and has a limited operational context due to SWAP considerations on fielded platforms. In that context, Theseus has demonstrated performance that rivals other technologies, but in a low-SWAP environment and with minimal processing requirements.

Capt.

USSOCOM

Having tested the Theseus’ VizNav system for a week, I am convinced that their technology presents the best solution for a current, and ever expanding, urgent operational need. Their system’s form factor and ease of integration allows for missions that are impossible otherwise.

name: Salesgraph
brief:
Product: Salesgraph
One-liner: Proactive revenue agents that move enterprise deals forward
Description: Salesgraph learns and automates 99% of the work that AEs do between calls with a dynamic context graph to give agents structure. Research briefs, call gaps, follow ups, committee mapping, business cases, pricing calculators, anything that moves a deal forward. We’re now building the context graph to power our agents for early partners at Mintlify, Tex, and Strala.
Industry: B2B / Sales
target:
Applied AI for enterprise revenue teams.

Today's agents can't carry context or sustain work through a nine month deal cycle. Salesgraph is building the governed execution layer to enable tomorrow's agents to finish long-horizon revenue work with company context and clear oversight.

Enterprise deals outlast today's agents.

An email, CRM update, or proposal is one step in a deal. Over a long cycle, the account changes, new stakeholders enter, requirements move, and earlier decisions still constrain what can happen next.

Today's agents can complete each step in isolation and still fail to carry forward what the earlier work established. We build agents that keep the current goal, history, decisions, and next action together as the deal moves.

Revenue teams need a gradual path to agent-run work.

Revenue context is spread across calls, CRM records, messages, documents, support, product, and finance systems. Salesgraph connects those records around the account, opportunity, buying process, and approvals.

The agent retrieves evidence for the current decision and retains what changed. People can review each action and keep control of pricing, contracts, and customer commitments.

Work continues between meetings.

A buyer may add a reviewer, revise a requirement, delay a decision, or return after weeks. The agent needs to update the plan, complete the next work, and resume later without restarting from the CRM record.

The work between those decisions depends on the current plan. Salesgraph carries that plan forward after each wait. The account team stays responsible for the buyer relationship.

Every result should make the next decision better.

A closed win and a closed loss are useful labels, but neither explains what happened. The buying group, sequence of approvals, long gaps, and buyer actions around the deal provide the evidence needed to review the result.

A reviewed outcome becomes part of the context used to evaluate later agent work. It can change which deal history is retrieved and which risks are checked.

Revenue is the outcome.

Time saved on a document is useful, but it does not show whether the agent advanced the deal. We evaluate its work against observable buyer decisions, stage changes, wins, renewals, and expansion.

The execution history ties the agent's work to the deal trajectory and commercial result. It does not claim which action caused the outcome.

name: Bot MD
brief:
Product: Bot MD
One-liner: AI Clinical Assistant for Doctors
Description: Bot MD is an A.I assistant for doctors. Our company's mission is to Empower Doctors around the world. Bot MD can be trained on any type of hospital content to provide instant answers to clinical questions.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare Services
target:
Humans for care. AI for everything else.

Bot MD builds healthcare AI Agents that automate patient engagement across WhatsApp, Messenger, Viber, LINE, Telegram, SMS, and Web — from inquiry to booking and care follow-up.

Trusted by leading hospitals and clinics across Asia

Proven in production

Real results from hospitals and clinics across Asia-Pacific.

Bot MD AI Agents are deployed in live hospital and clinic environments — not pilots. Here’s what they ship.

Our philosophy

AI shouldn’t replace care teams — it should give them leverage. We draw a clear line between what humans do best and what AI can safely handle at scale.

Why Bot MD AI Agents

Built for real hospital and clinic workflows, not generic chatbot demos.

Every Bot MD AI Agent is purpose-built for healthcare — designed with clinical teams, deployed across real hospital and clinic environments, and integrated end-to-end with the systems your hospital or clinic already runs.

Healthcare AI Agents

Specialized AI Agents. One unified platform.

Each agent is built for a specific healthcare workflow — multilingual out of the box, integrated with your stack, deployable independently or end-to-end.

Start with the outcome

What are you trying to improve?

Bot MD AI Agents are most often deployed against a specific KPI. Pick the outcome that matters most — we’ll show you how to get there.

Example workflows

Example workflows Bot MD can automate.

The agents are powerful on their own — and stronger together. Here are two of the most common workflows hospitals and clinics deploy end-to-end.

Channels & systems

Where your patients are. Where your data is.

Bot MD integrates with your existing systems — EMR/HIS, scheduling, CMS, CRM, QMS, payment gateways, and care team dashboards — and supports both standard integrations and custom hospital and clinic workflows.

Where patients chat

Where your data lives

Hospitals and clinics shipping real outcomes.

Healthcare-grade security and governance.

Bot MD is built for regulated healthcare environments — with the certifications, controls, and clinical safeguards hospital IT and compliance teams expect.

In their words

Bring us a workflow — patient inquiries, appointment booking, pre-admission, patient education, surveys, remote monitoring, or campaign conversion. We’ll show how an AI Agent can handle it across chat, integrate with your systems, and escalate safely to your team.
