name: iLabService
brief:
Product: iLabService
One-liner: AIoT monitoring, workflow, and evidence systems for regulated labs.
Description: iLabService builds real-time LabOps infrastructure for regulated laboratories. We help pharma, biotech, CRO/CDMO, testing, and enterprise R&D teams turn lab-floor signals into audit-ready operating evidence. Our platform connects environmental conditions, equipment state, sample risk, inventory movement, people response, workflow ownership, and compliance requirements into one traceable operating record.
Industry: B2B / Productivity
Tags: SaaS, IoT, Productivity, AI Assistant
target:
Turn lab signals into audit-ready operating evidence

Real-time LabOps infrastructure for regulated labs

iLabService connects environmental conditions, equipment state, sample risk, people response, and compliance requirements so teams can see risk earlier, act faster, and defend every operating decision with traceable records.

Active across pharma, biotech, CRO/CDMO, testing labs, and lab infrastructure teams.

Environmental, equipment, inventory, space, gas, and edge signals linked into LabOps context.

Evidence that the platform can support enterprise-grade laboratory service models.

Records are structured around attribution, contemporaneous capture, reviewability, and endurance.

Find your path

Start with the role closest to your daily pressure

See what iLabService changes for every role around the lab

Follow the value paths for Lab Managers, QA / Compliance, EHS teams, PI / Scientists, and Partners, then choose the scenario closest to your daily pressure.

For ecosystem and channel partners

Take audit-ready LabOps infrastructure into more regulated labs

Build joint solutions with iLabService across equipment, LIMS and ELN, validation, integration, regional distribution, and lab automation.

The 168-hour problem

A lab is staffed for about 50 hours. The other 118 hours still count

See how connected signals, response ownership, and review-ready evidence keep overnight and weekend events from becoming Monday-morning reconstruction work.

Product proof

See a live LabOps dashboard

Review a demo environment with live operational views for connected lab monitoring and LabOps context. Access opens inside this website after a short work-email request.

See how lab operating records become operational evidence

The missing operating record

Why existing systems still miss critical signals

Lab operations happen in rooms, freezers, cabinets, instruments, gas systems, and human workflows. When existing systems cannot connect those signals to the work, teams manage risk with partial evidence.

No shared operating record connects lab conditions, actions, and outcomes

The evidence may exist in devices, rooms, people, logs, and screenshots, but it is rarely captured as structured, time-aligned, audit-ready operating records.

Hidden disturbances

Drift, door, gas, power, and equipment changes appear before existing records connect the pattern.

Fragmented evidence

Logs, alarms, screenshots, LIMS records, and chat history are scattered during review.

Manual response loops

Existing workflows still rely on checks, calls, spreadsheets, supplier updates, and memory.

Disconnected root-cause evidence

Failed-run records often lack the physical conditions, operator actions, and timing needed for root-cause review.

Audit burden

name: Manifold Freight
brief:
Product: Manifold Freight
One-liner: Aggregating Spot Freight Opportunities for Carriers
Description: Manifold is revolutionizing the spot freight procurement process for Carriers, Brokers, and Shippers. Our inaugural product transforms the booking process for spot shipments, significantly reducing empty miles and increasing revenue. We do this by aggregating spot shipment opportunities from a variety of shipper and brokerage sources into a single location.
Industry: B2B / Supply Chain and Logistics
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B, Logistics, Automation
target:
A Better Way to Win Freight.

All your customer freight opportunities on one screen, with all the tools and automation you need to win more loads.

Trusted by leading carriers and brokers

The Problem with Spot Bidding Today

Your Team Is Juggling. They Should Be Winning.

Your team is jumping from screen to quote as many loads as they can while most of the loads you want slip through the cracks.

Without Manifold

Not because your team isn't working hard. Because no team can be in 18 places at once.

With Manifold

The challenge

Your Team Can't Quote Every Load. With Manifold, They Can.

Right now, loads are posting in your customer portals and landing in your email inbox that your team will never see. Not because of bad strategy. Because humans can't keep track of every portal and inbox fast enough to win. Manifold solves this.

The problem

Freight Moves Faster Than Your Team Can.

Your customer portals post loads constantly: early morning, late at night, between meetings. And on top of that, freight opportunities land in your email inbox and get buried under everything else. Your team can only cover so many portals and scan so many emails in a day. The loads they miss go to whoever quotes first.

It's not a strategy problem. It's a human bandwidth problem . No amount of hiring fully solves it. There will always be more loads than hours in the day.

Manifold sees every load in every portal, scans them instantly and without bias, and surfaces the ones worth quoting, faster and more accurately than any team can do manually.

How it works

Start Manual. Build Confidence. Then Automate.

Manifold isn't a black box that takes over your pricing. It's a platform you grow into, starting with the tools that give your team more control, not less.

Manual Bidding — Learn Your Lanes

Start with Manifold's manual bidding tools to quote faster and with better data than before. Use this phase to understand your lanes, test pricing, and build confidence , especially on new customers or complex freight where human judgment still matters most. Manifold captures opportunities from both customer portals and your email inbox — everything in one place.

Dial In Your Pricing Rules

name: MedMe Health
brief:
Product: MedMe Health
One-liner: Software for pharmacies to move beyond dispensing
Description: MedMe Health builds software for pharmacists to deliver paid clinical services like prescribing/adapting medications, point-of-care testing, giving vaccinations, and monitoring chronic conditions. Our web-based platform helps both independent pharmacies and large chains schedule appointments online, conduct virtual care, automate documentation, and flag clinical opportunities.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare IT
Tags: SaaS, B2B, Digital Health, Healthcare, Healthcare IT
target:
The end-to-end platform for pharmacy clinical services.

MedMe gives pharmacies the infrastructure to launch, scale, and get paid for clinical services. AI-native, modular, and API-driven, built for how pharmacy works.

Built for what pharmacy is becoming.

Dispensing keeps the lights on, but clinical services are where pharmacy grows. Patients already trust you as their most accessible place to get care. MedMe makes the shift practical.

Turn clinical services into dependable revenue

Scope of practice keeps expanding, and payers now reimburse pharmacists for more of the care they deliver. MedMe handles the scheduling, documentation, and billing behind every encounter, so the revenue actually lands.

Do more with the staff you have

MedMe's AI takes on the busywork around every visit, from note-taking to routine patient communication. Your team delivers more care in the same hours, without adding headcount.

Make it easy for patients to choose you

Patients go where getting care is simple. MedMe makes your pharmacy easy to book and easy to come back to, so more patients turn to you for their clinical needs.

One system for all your services

Scheduling, intake forms, notes, and billing all live in one place. When you add a new service or open a new store, you use the same system your team already knows, not another separate tool.

One platform. Built for how each pharmacy operates.

MedMe adapts to where you are: from a single store launching clinical services for the first time, to a national enterprise running standardized programs across thousands of locations.

For independents

Launch clinical services and start getting paid for them. Built for owner-operated pharmacies.

For enterprise chains

The strategic platform partner for corporate-owned pharmacy networks. Modular, API-driven, enterprise-grade.

For banners & co-ops

A platform your members will adopt, with network-level reporting that strengthens your value.

For specialty pharmacy

Built for high-touch specialty and payer/provider workflows, with the documentation and billing depth they require.

Everything you need to document and bill.

Pick the modules that fit your service mix. Medical Billing converts every documented encounter into a clean medical claim, the wedge that turns clinical scope into reliable revenue.

Medical Billing Add-on

Convert every documented encounter into a clean medical claim, capturing the 60 to 80% of clinical services that never get invoiced today.

Scheduling & Queueing

Multi-calendar booking with patient-flow visibility.

Clinical Assistant (AI Scribe) Add-on

Real-time notes and care plans drafted during the visit.

Patient Intake Form

Info, consent, and eligibility captured before the consult.

Assisted Documentation

brief:
Product: Overstand Labs
One-liner: Navigate any set of data - no matter how large - in minutes.
Description: Overstand is a data lab that allows our customers to navigate any set of data in just a few minutes. *Enterprise*: For enterprises, we we unify Slack, email, calls, and operational data, then surface the signals that matter — customer needs, risks, and revenue opportunities hidden in everyday conversations.
Industry: B2B / Analytics
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, LegalTech, Data Science, Data Engineering, Conversational AI
target:
Harness the power of your data.

New: Epstein Files — reasoning over the DOJ’s public document release. See how →

Unlike consultancies, we don't tell you what to do — we actually help you do it. Experienced AI and software engineers, embedded in your team to drive your AI transformation.

Organizations our team has worked with

How we work

We help you operationalize your data.

A simple system for turning scattered data into evidence, insight, and action.

Build a Unified Data Foundation

Our team of data scientists build out what we call the "unified data foundation" — pulling together all your emails, chats, and calls with your internal data tables, using the shared language of your business.

These data scientists come in and do this for you, but with your input, so we can get your data to accurately reflect your business.

Ask Questions and Reason Across Everything

Query your data with Overstand in the language of your business. It pulls together relevant evidence across all your data, explaining what's happening and why — without forcing you to know where to look.

This is where intuition meets evidence.

Carry Evidence Forward Into Action

Once evidence is clear, Overstand helps teams take the next step — whether that's understanding trends, synthesizing what's happening, or acting directly on what they've found.

Actions are grounded in evidence, not assumptions.

"...following up on Job #84721 — the customer called again..."

"We've raised this issue multiple times and haven't seen improvement."

Built for enterprise-grade security.

name: Ventura
brief:
Product: Ventura
One-liner: AI Workforce for Distributors and Manufacturers
Description: Ventura builds the AI workforce for distributors and manufacturers, starting with quoting and order entry. It plugs into your existing ERP, follows your SOPs, and learns your team's tribal knowledge - getting smarter with every completed task.
Industry: Industrials
target:
Reps should be selling, not entering data.

Ventura automates the manual work behind every quote and order so your reps can focus on what actually drives revenue.

Half your team's day disappears into back-office work.

Every quote, every order, every customer inquiry requires a rep to dig through emails, search the ERP, cross-check quotes, and type information manually into your systems.

That is not selling. That is data entry. And it is eating the majority of your team's day.

Automation built for your workflow

Start with one capability or deploy the complete platform. Everything connects to your existing systems.

Quoting

Generate accurate quotes instantly. Ventura reads incoming requests, matches products from your catalog, and creates professional quotes without manual lookup.

Order Entry

Turn purchase orders into ERP entries automatically. Ventura extracts line items, resolves part numbers, and pushes clean orders directly to your system.

Sales Intelligence

Understand what your customers buy, when they buy, and what they are likely to need next. Ventura surfaces insights your reps can act on today.

Phone Agent

Ventura joins your rep's calls as a silent note-taker, transcribes the conversation, and automatically creates the resulting quote or order directly in your ERP. No manual entry.

Real results for your team

Ventura delivers measurable improvements across productivity, revenue, and accuracy from day one.

Productivity gains

It's like tripling your rep headcount without the hiring cost. Your reps have more time for actual selling and serving customers.

AI handles 95%+ automatically. Your team simply audits and approves.

Higher win rate

Increase quote-to-order conversion by responding faster and improving customer service.

35% of deals go to whoever responds first.

Reduced errors

Fewer returns and re-deliveries caused by mistyped units of measure, wrong items, or incorrect quantities.

1–4% of manually entered orders contain an error.

A different kind of platform

Most automation tools need months of setup and break the moment a format changes. Ventura is built to understand, not to match.

Any format. No templates.

Ventura reads what your customers actually send: emails, images, and phone calls. No setup templates or field mapping required. Most teams are live within days.

Follows your procedures, exactly.

Define the exact steps you want followed and Ventura executes them on every task, consistently. From cross-referencing quotes in your CRM to applying freight charge rules, your procedures become the default.

Secure by design.

name: Clarion
brief:
Product: Clarion
One-liner: The AI communication layer for healthcare
Description: Clarion is building the most advanced AI communication layer for healthcare. Our AI agents handle the overwhelming volume of calls and messages that clinics face daily—from scheduling to billing to prescription refills—freeing staff to focus on patient care. We're an in-person company based in New York. Today, clinics miss 30-40% of inbound calls due to staffing shortages.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare IT
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Health Tech, Digital Health, Healthcare
target:
The front office that runs itself.

Try Clarion out

From answering every call to processing referrals and bringing patients back for care, Clarion keeps your practice running without adding headcount.

Scale your practice

Simplify everyday tasks so your team can focus on what matters most.

Capture

Answer every call, text, and message 24/7. No patients lost to hold music or after-hours gaps.

Convert

Turn referrals into booked appointments in hours, not weeks, and double your conversion rate.

Recover

Cut no-shows in half and automatically backfill cancelled slots to keep your schedule full.

One unified front office platform

Handles scheduling, rescheduling, refills, patient questions, and escalations using your practice's workflows.

Sorts incoming faxes and referrals, pulls patient and insurance details into your EHR, verifies benefits, and starts outreach to get the patient booked.

Handles reminders, confirmations, no-show rebooking, and overdue-patient outreach across voice and SMS — before patients fall through the cracks.

Your front office revenue engine

Everything your front office handles today, done automatically and at any hour.

Reduction in no-shows

Decrease in hold time

Referral conversion rate

Calls resolved end-to-end

Schedule management

Book, reschedule, and backfill cancellations automatically. Your team stays focused on patients, not the schedule.

Referrals

Every new patient referral gets a follow-up. Clarion reaches out, answers questions, and gets them scheduled.

Billing and insurance

Coverage questions and payments handled through natural conversations. No hold music, no back and forth.

24/7 patient support

Refill requests, post-visit check-ins, and after hours questions. Clarion handles them around the clock.

Built into the systems you already use

Clarion doesn't sit beside your EHR. It works inside it. Scheduling rules, provider availability, payer logic, and patient records all run through the systems you already use.

Compliance & security

Built to the highest standards in healthcare: HITRUST, HIPAA, and SOC 2 compliance across every interaction.

Implementation made easy

We do the setup and stay on the hook for the results long after you go live.

You only pay when a call is handled.

Priced on resolutions, not seats or minutes. If Clarion resolves the call, you're billed for it. If it hands off to your team or doesn't solve anything, you're not.

We set it all up for you.

Your scheduling rules, learned and built in. We map your providers' heads and sticky notes, build the agent, and test it against real calls. Your IT team writes nothing.

One platform, not just a phone bot.

One platform, not a phone bot.

One-liner: Autonomous trucks to fully automate long-haul freight shipping
Description: Mars Auto is building autonomous trucks to fully automate long-haul freight shipping.
Industry: Industrials / Automotive
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Autonomous Trucking, Robotics
target:
AUTONOMOUS TRUCKS

Mars Auto operates self-driving Class 8 trucks hauling commercial cargo across Korea and the United States today.

Superhuman AI driver

Most autonomous trucking systems depend on HD maps and can operate only on routes prepared in advance. Long-haul shipping requires flexible routing across constantly changing lanes. Mars Auto does not use maps. We built a vision-focused end-to-end AI driving agent that learns directly from real driving data. The vehicle is equipped with seven cameras, and the system interprets its surroundings from real-time visual input. It can operate on roads it has never seen before, similar to a human driver.

Moving real freight using supervised self-driving trucks

Miles driven autonomously

Better fuel-efficiency

Countries

Trusted by major carriers and shippers

Fleet data network

One of the largest truck driving data pipeline in the world

100K+

Miles driven daily

SHIP WITH US

We plan to deploy fully unmanned trucks by 2028.

If you want to move freight with autonomous trucks, contact us.

AUTONOMOUS TRUCKS

Mars Auto operates self-driving Class 8 trucks hauling commercial cargo across Korea and the United States today.

Superhuman AI driver

Most autonomous trucking systems depend on HD maps and can operate only on routes prepared in advance. Long-haul shipping requires flexible routing across constantly changing lanes. Mars Auto does not use maps. We built a vision-focused end-to-end AI driving agent that learns directly from real driving data. brief:
Product: Hook0: Free Webhook Platform, HMAC Signatures, EU Hosting
Description: Free webhook platform with HMAC signatures, configurable retries, and delivery monitoring. Self-host the SSPL code or use our EU-hosted cloud. No credit card.
target:
Webhooks As A Service

Hook0 is an Open-Source Webhooks-as-a-service (WaaS) that makes it easy for developers to send webhooks. Developers make one API call, and Hook0 takes care of deliverability, retries, security, and more.

Trusted by companies worldwide

These teams chose Hook0 over competitors because Hook0 publishes its full server source (SSPL-1.0) and also offers production-ready SaaS support. They gain a competitive advantage by embracing extensibility, reversibility, and future-proofness in their integration strategies.

Set up webhooks in 10 minutes

From signup to production in three steps

Register & Configure

Create an account, add your application, and list the event types your subscribers can receive.

Send Events via API

POST your event once. Hook0 delivers it, retries on failure, signs the payload, and encrypts over TLS.

Monitor & Debug

See every delivery attempt, inspect payloads, find out why a delivery failed, and replay events from the dashboard or API.

Out-Of-The-Box Webhooks

Everything you need to build a state-of-the-art webhooks solution in minutes

Open-Source

Unlike alternatives, Hook0 is fully open-source . No vendor-locking, we are here to stay, no investors, we are fully sustainable since day 1.

Easy Integration

Our JSON REST API , SDKs , and MCP Server for AI assistants make it easy to trigger webhook events from your application and let your users connect to every available SaaS.

Signed & Encrypted

All webhooks are TLS secured and contain a cryptographic signature to prevent forgery, replay, man-in-the-middle attacks.

Configurable Retries

Two-phase retry schedules configurable per subscription: fast retries with increasing delays, then slow retries at fixed intervals. Smart defaults included, full control when you need it.

Make Your Subscribers Happy

Give your users a primo experience with our mock payloads, webhook logs and subscriber portal.

Transparent Webhooks

All webhook attempts are logged so you and your subscribers can easily search, debug and replay old events.

Embeddable Portal

Give your subscribers a branded experience with a custom subdomain and your logo uploaded on the subscriber portal.

Precise Dispatch

Your users only receive webhooks they subscribed to. You can filter each subscription by business info (user ID, …).

Data & Sovereignty

Hook0 does not lock your data nor your software. If you subscribe to Hook0 SaaS version, all your data will stay in Europe. No GAFAM there.

All-in-one platform

Build a state-of-the-art webhooks solution in minutes using Hook0

Fine-grained subscriptions

Enable your users to subscribe to your events by setting up a webhook. They can choose which event types they want to receive.

name: Ångström AI
brief:
Product: Ångström AI
One-liner: Gen AI molecular simulations that reproduce wetlab results
Description: Angstrom AI builds GenAI-based molecular simulations to substitute wet lab experiments in the pre-clinical drug development pipeline. We are a team of 2 PhD's and 2 Professors from the University of Cambridge who decided to start a company together after we realised how to combine breakthoughs in our research in quantum-accurate models of physics and generative AI models.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
Tags: AI-powered Drug Discovery, Artificial Intelligence, Biotech, Drug discovery, AI
target:
Replacing Lab Experiments with Computation

Fast, accurate AI physics simulations for pharma. Compute solubility, lipophilicity, crystal structure stability and more with accuracy matching experimental error.

Team

Laurence Midgley

Cofounder, CEO

Miguel Hernández-Lobato

Cofounder, Head of AI

Gábor Csányi

Cofounder, Head of Science

Bálint Máté

Member of Technical Staff

Graeme Day

Our Science

DFT Accuracy on Crystal Structure Prediction with Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials

LI Midgley, C Lin, JH Moore, F Della Pia, J Antorán, SO Nilsson Lill, ESE Eriksson, FA Faber, L Tornberg, A Broo, G Csányi

We present an evaluation of CSP-MACE-Å, a machine learning interatomic potential intended to replace DFT in crystal structure prediction (CSP). By running multiple orders of magnitude faster than DFT, CSP-MACE-Å enables energy and free energy evaluation of far more candidate structures, providing greater confidence when derisking solid forms.

Computing Solvation Free Energies of Small Molecules with Experimental Accuracy

JH Moore, DJ Cole, G Csányi

We introduce an efficient alchemical free energy protocol that enables calculations of rigorous free energy differences in condensed phase systems modeled entirely by MLPs. Using a pretrained, transferable, alchemically equipped MLP model, we demonstrate subchemical accuracy for the solvation free energies of a wide range of organic molecules.

Flow Annealed Importance Sampling Bootstrap

LI Midgley, V Stimper, GNC Simm, B Schölkopf, JM Hernández-Lobato

We introduce FAB, a new method for training generative models to sample accurately from Boltzmann distributions of molecular systems using only the energy function, without requiring samples from the target distribution. We are the first to learn the Boltzmann distribution of the alanine dipeptide molecule using only the unnormalized target density, without access to samples generated via Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations.

SE(3) Equivariant Augmented Coupling Flows

LI Midgley, V Stimper, J Antorán, E Mathieu, B Schölkopf, JM Hernández-Lobato

We present a coupling normalizing flow architecture that preserves SE(3) and permutation equivariance while providing both fast sampling and density evaluation. We are the first to learn the full Boltzmann distribution of alanine dipeptide by only modeling the Cartesian positions of its atoms.

Reach out to us

Interested in seeing what Ångström AI can do for your drug discovery pipeline? We'd love to show you a demo.

brief:
Product: Opencall
One-liner: Practice admin run by AI
Description: OpenCall makes medical practices more profitable and enables owners and operators of their rollups to hit their KPIs.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Healthcare
target:
AI that talks, texts and gets it done

Trusted by practices across healthcare

You know the bottleneck. Let's break it.

Missed calls, voicemails, and manual follow-ups cost your practice patients and staff time. OpenCall answers instantly, books directly into your system, and kicks off the workflows your team usually has to chase.

Teams reclaim patient conversations that used to die in voicemail.

Automated follow-up fills overdue appointments without extra headcount.

Typical practice locations unlock about $20k in booked care once OpenCall is live.

A command center at your fingertips

See every call, text, booking, and workflow in one place. OpenCall plugs into your existing tools so front desk and back office stay perfectly in sync.

Voice AI answers, verifies insurance, and captures reason for visit across voice, SMS, and web.

Human teams step into licensed or sensitive moments with transcripts, next steps, and sentiment in the sidebar.

Appointments, reminders, and billing notes sync back into the stack automatically.

Home

Tuesday, March 31, 2026 · 72 locations

Today's Schedule

Tasks needing attention

Recent activity

Outreach results

Patients get answers in seconds, not hold music.

Night and weekend calls match daytime quality.

Lean teams stay focused on in-person care.

24/7 coverage that you won't have to think about

Select your specialty

Dental

Live Dental Experience

OpenCall replaces your high-churn call center roles with AI agents that answer calls and texts, follow your workflows, and connect directly to your system. Fast, accurate, and always on.

OpenCall books, reschedules, and cancels appointments across phone and text—directly inside your existing PMS. From new patients to multi-provider workflows, it handles it all.

OpenCall captures intake data, verifies insurance in real time, checks benefits, and pre-loads forms—so your front desk doesn’t have to. Patients arrive pre-qualified, ready to be seen.

Whether it’s a prescription refill, urgent medical issue, or billing call, OpenCall routes with intent. Simple issues are handled fully by AI, while complex ones are escalated to the right human—without breaking the flow.

OpenCall connects natively to Dentrix, Athena, Eaglesoft, eClinicalWorks, and more. It respects your protocols, keeps your records accurate, and never trains on your patient data.

Spin up OpenCall for your first location in under 5 minutes. Expanding to hundreds takes seconds—with no code, no downtime, and no disruption to your staff.

Our AI builder customizes complex medical flows—intake, scheduling, triage, billing—in minutes, not weeks. Works with your stack out of the box.

name: Infinia
brief:
Product: Infinia
One-liner: Move money programmatically
Description: Infinia enables fintechs, businesses, and banks to bridge stablecoins with local payment rails in emerging markets. Ianai, the CEO, was part of the founding team at dLocal, where he helped grow the company from $0 to $100M in ARR.
Industry: Fintech / Payments
Tags: Payments, Cryptocurrency
target:
Global Money Movement and Account Infrastructure

Connect traditional clearing rails with digital ledger technology to automate cross-border payouts, collections, and multi-currency virtual accounts.

Trusted by leading companies

Our numbers

9 + Markets with named virtual accounts

200 + Countries you can send payments to

100 % Real time money movement programmable

1 API Unified Infrastructure collect, convert, KYC, and pay in local currencies

Our Solution

Compliance and Regulatory Complexity, Solved Natively.

Every high-growth market operates under its own distinct KYC, KYB, and banking mandates. Navigating this fragmented landscape shouldn't mean drowning in operational overhead or slowing down your global velocity. Infinia’s infrastructure absorbs this friction with a unified API. We handle local regulatory guardrails and banking requirements natively, ensuring your enterprise remains bulletproof and compliant without the structural burden.

Built-in Compliance. Global expansion on a single API

Global Payments Infrastructure

Connect to real-time local clearing networks (like PIX, SPEI, and Transferencias 3.0) with embedded multi-market virtual accounts and automated on/off-chain FX netting engines. Collect and disburse 24/7 without trapped liquidity.

Virtual Accounts

Local Banking Infrastructure. Multi-Currency Power.

Deploy multi-country Banking-as-a-Service capabilities instantly without the friction, extreme costs, or legal delays of establishing physical local entities. Automatically issue and manage robust, multi-currency virtual accounts that allow your platform to hold local balances, orchestrate complex corporate treasuries, and seamlessly segment user wallets across emerging markets via a single unified API.

Disburse

Real-time Payouts at Scale.

Deliver high-throughput disbursements to merchants, partners, suppliers, or end-users in real time. Bypass traditional correspondent banking delays and hidden intermediary charges with automated, round-the-clock atomic settlement that optimizes cash flow.

Collect

Accept Payments Locally. Settle Globally.

Give your users the freedom to pay using their preferred local methods—from real-time instant bank networks (like PIX, SPEI, and Transferencias 3.0) to alternative digital rails. Collect local fiat currencies seamlessly without the friction, overhead, or time required to establish standalone local corporate entities.

Open Issuance Platform

Industries

Engineered for Global Scale

Fintechs & Neobanks

Embed multi-currency accounts, global liquidity networks, and programmable financial logic natively inside your application through a single software layer.

Global Marketplaces

Coordinate complex multi-sided payouts, automate 24/7 client reconciliation, and streamline cross-border vendor ledgering split-second fast.

Digital Wallets

Power frictionless, high-throughput digital wallet architectures with instant on/off-ramps, automated compliance, and real-time cross-border settlement.

name: Alter
brief:
Product: Alter
One-liner: Secure access control and authorization platform for agent workflows
Description: Alter is a zero-trust identity and access control platform purpose-built for AI agents. It wraps every tool call in strong authentication, fine-grained authorization, and real-time guardrails, so agents can move fast without breaking things. Each request is verified at the parameter level, authorized against granular policies, executed with least-privilege access, and fully audited in real time.
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: AIOps, Developer Tools, DevSecOps, Security, AI
target:
The auth layer for AI agents.

Scoped credentials for apps and AI agents. No tokens to store, no OAuth flows to build, no audit pipeline to run.

Give agents their own keys, not yours .

Without Alter

Keys scattered everywhere

Pasted into prompts, configs, and .env files across every repo.

One key does everything

Every agent borrows the same over-scoped credential.

No answers afterward

Nobody can say which agent did what, or on whose behalf.

With Alter

One vault

Stored once, injected per request, never exposed to your code.

Least privilege per agent

Each agent gets its own identity and scopes, with a human gate where you want one.

Every action on the record

A tamper-evident trail with a name attached to every call.

Alter authenticates, authorizes, and logs every request

One SDK call handles storage, refresh, policy, and audit for 137 providers. First-class LangChain, MCP, and AWS integrations.

One platform between your agents and every API

Four features on a single request path.

Credential Vault

Store credentials once. Agents use them without ever seeing them.

Policy Engine

Each request checked against your rules. Deny by default.

Agent Identity

Per-agent keys and scopes, traceable to a real person.

Human in the loop

Sensitive calls wait for a named person. Everything else flows.

Compliance & Audit

A record you can hand to an auditor, streamed to your SIEM.

See the whole platform

The full request path, end to end, on one page.

What teams build on Alter

Every card is a working guide with code.

Call APIs on behalf of users

Run OAuth, Connect, and identity-aware token retrieval end to end.

Give an AI agent scoped access

The agent gets its own identity, its user grants, and its own audit trail.

Provision secrets for backend services

Store API keys and service tokens in Alter instead of environment variables.

Expose credentials to Claude Code

Build your own MCP server that serves Alter-managed credentials as tools.

Partition agent memory by identity

Key memory, sessions, and channels by verified identity, never by what the LLM claims.

Build a multi-user server

Serve many users from one service without the credential entering your process.

Ready to secure your agents?

Book a 30-minute walkthrough with the founders.

name: Sequence Bio
brief:
Product: Sequence Bio
One-liner: Discovering the true signals of disease to power life-changing drugs.
Description: 90% of drug candidates fail, delaying help for those in need. We’re on a mission to change that. Better drug target discovery powered by the Newfoundland founder effect.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
Tags: Genomics, Therapeutics, Drug discovery
target:
Discovering the true signals of disease to power life-changing medicines

Better medicines, proven by genetics

90% of potential drugs fail, often because they lack the genetic evidence to prove they will work. Sequence Bio is on a mission to change that. By studying the inherited causes of disease, we aim to identify the right drug targets and predictors of disease and treatment response from the start—ensuring transformative medicines reach the people who need them.

The Newfoundland and Labrador advantage

In Newfoundland and Labrador, our research is powered by founder effects that bring the genetic drivers of disease into focus. By pairing these insights with deep clinical and family health histories, we can move beyond association to causal evidence—linking genes to disease with a level of confidence that pushes discovery forward.

Taking on inherited disease, together.

We are studying the genetics of families in Newfoundland and Labrador to understand how certain diseases are inherited, helping our search for better diagnostics, preventions, and treatments for people here at home and around the world.

Partnerships

Our partnerships unite local healthcare expertise with global leaders in life sciences to accelerate the path from novel genetic insights to life-changing medicines.

Select insights

Discover your future at Sequence Bio

If you’re ready to solve problems that matter for generations of patients, we want to hear from you.

Product: Doppler

Description: Your central source of truth from local development to production for every language, stack, and infrastructure. Doppler simplifies secrets management so you can automate security, eliminate config drift, and deliver reliable software fast.

target:
One platform. Every secret. Human or AI.

For every engineer on your team, there are now dozens of AI agents and automated workflows that need secrets, too. Doppler manages them all, whether you deploy on-prem or in the cloud.

Built for every identity

Developers, AI agents, MCP servers, and automated workflows all need credentials to access APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and internal services. Doppler gives every human and AI identity secure, centralized access to the secrets they need.

Doppler's MCP server lets AI agents request secrets natively without custom scripts or hardcoded credentials.

Deploy 10 agents or 1,000. Your Doppler cost doesn't change. User-based pricing was designed for this.

Every secret access, by human or AI, logged, traceable, and with a platform that's SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliant.

75B+ secrets read each month

One platform for your stack

Native integrations across cloud platforms, Kubernetes, CI/CD, webhooks, and SDKs connecting to the infrastructure tools your team already runs.

Secrets stay centralized, rotated, and auditable wherever they're used.

Why companies choose Doppler

Every engineer, pipeline, and non-human identity needs secrets without per-agent pricing that punishes you for scaling.

User-based pricing with no extra costs for non-human identities

Secure and audit-ready secrets management for teams of any size

OIDC-scoped service accounts give each AI agent its own access

49% of breaches involve credentials. Doppler centralizes every secret across your stack so there's nothing scattered, forgotten, or exposed.

Dynamic Secrets issue a fresh credential on every deploy and revoke it automatically. Nothing long-lived, nothing to steal.

Customer stories

How Doppler helped Paradox achieve 75% faster Kubernetes adoption and enhanced zero-trust security

Securing the world’s secrets

The secrets manager built for the agentic age

Protect secrets across your entire stack with centralized management, automated workflows, and the flexibility to deploy in the cloud or on-prem.

Photosynthesis — Lesson 4 (excerpt)

Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants and some other organisms use sunlight to synthesize foods from carbon dioxide and water. In plants, photosynthesis generally occurs within specialized organelles called chloroplasts, which contain the pigment chlorophyll…

The overall reaction can be summarized as 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + light → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂. This process is broadly divided into the light-dependent reactions, which occur in the thylakoid membranes, and the light-independent reactions (the Calvin cycle), which take place in the stroma…

Factors affecting the rate of photosynthesis include light intensity, carbon dioxide concentration, and temperature. Students should be able to describe each factor and interpret rate-limiting…

Drones deploy near the solar plant

Fly into low and mid-altitude clouds

Alter the cloud droplets

Reduce cloud reflectivity

Allow more sunlight to reach the solar panels

Team

Mete Karslioglu

Mete previously developed seawater spray nozzles to increase cloud reflectivity at the Cambridge Centre for Climate Repair. Before that, he built and deployed atmospheric measurement equipment. Eric Nilsson

Eric previously developed systems for droplet removal from LiDAR lenses and researched electronic chips that control small volumes of liquid. One-liner: Decision infrastructure for investment firms
Description: Benchmark is the trusted AI platform for investment firms. Today, leading firms use Benchmark to screen deals, extract insights from unstructured data, and automate workflows. Our platform combines cutting-edge AI with deep industry expertise to help investment firms make smarter, faster decisions across their entire deal lifecycle.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Fintech, Finance, AI Assistant
target:
AI for Investment Firms.

Benchmark puts your knowledge to work. Move faster, make better decisions, and never start from scratch.

Your firm's edge lives in the thousands of deals you've seen, the memos you've written, the models you've built. But that knowledge is locked inside disconnected systems and the heads of people who've been there the longest. Benchmark makes all of it actionable, for your team and your agents.

Connect & structure your data

Your data is scattered across data rooms, email, models, and legal docs. Benchmark connects to all of it, extracts what matters, and structures it into institutional knowledge your whole team can query.

Put Benchmark to work

Screen deals, draft memos, build comps, monitor portfolios. Real deliverables in your format, grounded in your firm's full history.

Every decision makes it sharper

Every decision, outcome, and correction tailors Benchmark to how your firm thinks and how each person on your team works. Your newest analyst gets the accumulated judgment of the entire firm from day one.

How firms are using Benchmark

Reduced new deal screening time by 80% with all new deals screened by Benchmark. Surface relevant comps, flag patterns, and draft preliminary memos — before your team even opens a data room.

Feeds all existing structured and unstructured data into Benchmark, making it the core of their tech stack. Teams work end-to-end within Benchmark across the entire investment lifecycle — from sourcing through monitoring.

Uses Benchmark to generate investment memos and deal artifacts in minutes instead of days — dramatically reducing time to act on new opportunities as they hit the market.

Normalizes data across fund reports and performance metrics to build a unified view of performance — enabling them to cut through messy structures and noise.

Enterprise-grade by design.

Zero Training on Your Data

Your proprietary information is never used to train models. Your edge stays yours.

Enterprise Grade Encryption

Data encrypted in transit and at rest. Only authorized users access your workspace.

Enterprise Controls

SSO, audit logs, data lifecycle management, and granular permission controls.

SOC 2 Type II

Independently certified with regular third-party penetration testing.

Put your firm's knowledge to work.

name: ZETA SURGICAL
brief:
Product: ZETA SURGICAL
One-liner: Next-Generation Surgical Navigation and Robotics
Description: ZETA SURGICAL is redefining the standard of care for image-guided surgery and targeted neuro-therapeutics. Its navigation and robotics platform applies advanced artificial intelligence and computer vision to enable high-accuracy image guidance across virtually any point of care in minutes, unlocking less invasive and more precise targeted therapies. The Zeta Navigation System and Zeta TMS Navigation System are cleared by the FDA and commercially available in the United States.
Industry: Healthcare / Medical Devices
Tags: Medical Robotics, Augmented Reality, AI
target:
NEXT–GEN neuroNAVIGATION

We redefine brain surgery and neuromodulation with real–time frameless navigation deployable beyond the OR.

navigation for every case, supercharged with ai

Live, continuous surgical guidance tracking patient movement 20 times per second

ZETA ensures pinpoint precision without cranial pins or general anesthesia, enhancing safety and outcomes

Compact, mobile, and fast to deploy — ZETA performs in operating rooms, emergency settings, and ambulatory centers

USE CASES

In our breakthrough clinical study, ZETA helped surgeons achieve exceptional accuracy in bedside external ventricular drain cases.

100% single-pass catheter placement (vs 81% freehand). 0% revision surgeries (vs 19% freehand). 0% adverse events (vs 28% freehand). 100% ideal placement (vs 32% freehand).

By eliminating the need for skull fixation and anesthesia, ZETA makes bedside brain biopsy a possibility, freeing up OR resources and improving surgery efficiency.

>2h estimated saving in procedure time.

ZETA brings neurosurgical level accuracy to TMS therapy, enabling clinicians to repeatedly target a precise point across sessions and improve treatment efficiency.

<1mm positional accuracy. <1° angular accuracy.

ZETA allows for tumor resections such as cavernoma resections to be performed without cranial skull fixation, in settings such as ambulatory surgical centers.

<1h estimated time to perform a cavernoma resection

We improve REAL-TIME NAVIGATION FOR PATIENTS HOSPITALS AND CLINICIANS.

BACKED BY LEADING HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS

World-class surgeons, psychiatrists and healthcare executives who shape how we build - and why

NEWS AND PUBLICATIONS

name: Peakflo
brief:
Product: Peakflo
One-liner: Agentic workflows that automate your back‑office operations
Description: Peakflo, with its Agentic Workflows and one-click ERP integrations, helps finance teams eliminate manual work across the entire invoice-to-cash, procure-to-pay, travel and expense reimbursement, and operations. 100+ businesses—from scale-ups to enterprises, use Peakflo each to: ✅ Save 1000 man-hours/month on finance ops ✅ Get paid faster on customer invoices by 15-25 days ✅ Cut vendor bill payment time by 50% ✅ Automate three-way matching
Industry: Fintech / Payments
Tags: Fintech, SaaS, B2B
target:
Agentic workflows that automate and execute your business operations

Peakflo's Agentic Workflows integrate seamlessly with your finance and operations processes, continuously learning from your workflows to automate tasks, enhance accuracy, and accelerate decision-making.

Trusted By Global Enterprises Across Industries

What businesses can achieve with Peakflo Agentic Workflow

4X

acceleration in process performance

reduction in operational cost

improvement in decision accuracy

Pre-Built Templates

Choose from a library of pre-built workflow templates fully loaded with domain specific expertise for finance, HR, procurement, and more that lets you get started in minutes.

Build Your Own Workflow

No need to map it all out manually. Simply upload a screen recording or describe the AS-IS flow of your business process, Peakflo AI will analyze it and generate a draft workflow for you. Fine-tune, optimize, and launch—your ops, your way.

Multi-Channel Process Triggers

Peakflo doesn't ask your team to change platforms, it meets them where they are. Connect your everyday tools—Slack, ERP, HRM, CRM, Calendly, and more— so workflows can start automatically, from any touchpoint.

AI Browser Agents

Peakflo AI agents can browse internal web apps and browser-based systems, makes decisions and takes action, just like a human would. AI agent just logs in and gets the job done.

Voice AI Agents

Automate calls without lifting a finger for collections, follow-ups, reminders, or survey responses powered by human-like voice agents.

Gen AI-Powered Reports

Forget dashboards that require manual input. Our generative AI creates reports from real-time data across your systems.

Knowledge Base Insights

Our AI agents can instantly search and understand vast data sources, turning static, complex information into actionable insights. Agents use this knowledge to make informed decisions and power workflows with confidence.

Self-Evaluation & Continuous Optimization

Peakflo's agentic system uses LLM-as-Judge, enabling agents to evaluate their own workflow output and optimize based on your success criteria. Agents test different workflow patterns, identify the best-performing one, and auto-apply it, making each execution smarter than the last.

See Peakflo’s Agentic Workflows in action below with a few real-world use cases.

Autonomous Finance Workflows, Tailored to Your Industry

Peakflo helps global businesses across industries eliminate manual finance work, accelerate receivables and payables, and streamline payment cycles—without changing how you work or increasing headcount.

Food & Beverage

F&B businesses face rising financial pressures and manual inefficiencies. Peakflo's AI-powered automation streamlines invoicing, payments, and reconciliation—cutting costs and boosting efficiency so teams can focus on growth.

Manufacturing

name: Global Employment Infrastructure
brief:
Product: Global Employment Infrastructure
Description: The intelligent infrastructure for global employment. EOR, global payroll, contractor management, and compliant payments — worldwide, on one system of record.
target:
Global employment runs on Remote

Hire and pay anyone in the world — with the compliance, reliability, and local expertise that only owned infrastructure delivers.

Global companies grow with Remote

How we do it

One system of record. Every employment need.

Employer of Record (EOR)

Need to hire anyone, anywhere? We handle the employment contract, taxes, benefits, and compliance — onboarded in hours, not months.

Global Payroll

Accurate, compliant payroll in every country you operate. Run by our in-house teams, no partner network.

Contractor of Record (COR)

Engage international contractors compliantly. Contracts, payments, and risk — all handled by our experts.

Contractor Management

Engage contractors compliantly, anywhere — and convert them to FTEs before misclassification risk becomes a legal problem.

Professional Employer Organization (PEO)

US hiring without the admin burden. Payroll, taxes, benefits, all taken care of.

Intelligent infrastructure

Owned end-to-end infrastructure, operated in-house.

We have our own legal experts, our own payroll specialists, and our own compliance teams in every market we operate in. And because it's all ours, everything lives in one place: every employment record, contract, compliance document, and payroll engine run accurate, current, audit-ready, SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, and ISO 27001 certified .

Hiring internationally, converting contractors, or consolidating payroll? Talk to our team.

Integrations, API, and MCP

Your workflows, your way, on our infrastructure

Deploy AI agents on real employment data

Remote MCP gives any AI agent a live, secure connection to payroll, contracts, compliance data, and org structure — no API keys, no exports, no custom integrations needed.

Plug Remote into your stack

Keep the HR tools your team already uses. Remote runs the payroll and compliance underneath, natively integrated with Workday, HiBob, BambooHR, Personio, and more.

Build on top of ours

Remote is API-first by design. Use our REST API, webhooks, and CLI to build custom workflows, embed global employment into your own product, or extend Remote however your business needs.

The global payroll backbone

The world’s best teams run on Remote

Remote is the infrastructure leading HR platforms trust to deliver global payroll, EOR, and contractor management to their customers.

A word from our customers

Join customers who trust Remote to transform their business.

“We see Remote as a leading and trusted partner in this space. The expert support they provide in local payroll, tax compliance, and HR operations has streamlined our processes and created more opportunities for growth and success on a global scale.”

name: Flott HQ
brief:
Product: Flott HQ
One-liner: AI-native operating system for vehicle fleet management
Description: Flott helps transport and logistics companies run leaner, smarter, and more profitable operations. Flott unifies everything transport and logistics teams need in a single, AI-powered control center—bringing planning, live tracking (gps, fuel, etc), invoicing, and payments into one place and delivering true end-to-end visibility.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Logistics, Transportation, Operations, AI Assistant
target:
Manage your fleet operations with more accurate and complete data

The only fleet management platform that helps you decide with confidence using the most accurate and complete fleet data.

Trusted by Leading Operational Teams

Connect, enrich, and automate your fleet operations

Flott connects your telematics and business systems, enriches raw signals into operational events and exceptions, and powers workflows across fleet, equipment, and sites

Fleet Management

Track your entire fleet in real-time. Monitor utilization, maintenance readiness, and operating costs simply.

Unified Visibility

One view across vehicles, drivers, sites, and systems; so exceptions and bottlenecks are visible immediately.

Enrichment Engine

Billing Accuracy

Equipment Monitoring

Monitor health, hours, and service intervals to prevent downtime, and improve utilization

AI Enrichment and automation

Automatically turn raw data into operational insights around business processes. Save 100s of hours of manual work and reduce errors

Make every operational decision with enriched, complete data

Dispatching

Example: Enriched dispatch view — status + HOS + cost + availability in one table

Manage your fleet without the complexity

See bottlenecks across fleet, drivers, and sites automatically

Sites Monitoring

Sites Monitoring: real-time queue time + active vehicles by location

High value use cases made simple and customizable to your business

Start fast with proven use cases and templates, customize for your business and deliver value from day one, with zero onboarding

Car Rental

Fix billing accuracy: reconcile contracts with real usage (time, mileage, location, events) to stop revenue leakage and disputes.

Logistics

Unify driver, route, dwell, and client-site signals to pinpoint bottlenecks, optimize trailer turns, and score driver performance.

Ride Hailing

Detect off-platform usage to reduce hidden losses, assess drivers, and fact-check any information against your fleet signals to prevent fraud.

Construction

Track true equipment hours, utilization by site, and maintenance readiness to redeploy assets and avoid downtime.

Waste Management

Prove route completion, catch missed pickups fast, and prevent mid-route failures.

Mining

Expose site bottlenecks (cycle time, queueing, idle) and improve shift efficiency.

For Security First Teams

Scale securely with confidence

Our products are designed with enterprise-grade security practices and compliant with global data protection standards.

We'd Love to Show You How It Works

We are ready to help transform your operations.

name: Mozart Data
brief:
Product: Mozart Data
One-liner: The easiest way to set up a modern data stack
Description: Mozart Data provides an out-of-the-box modern data stack that empowers anyone to easily consolidate, organize, and prepare their data for analysis. Spin up a data stack that’s built on a best-in-class data warehouse and ETL tool in hours, without any engineering. You can finally spend more time on generating insights and less time wrangling your data.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: SaaS, B2B, Data Engineering
target:
The modern data platform for growing businesses

Every tool you need to make the most of your data: ETL, data warehousing, data transformation, and more.

Trusted by data-driven companies

Our satisfied customers

Connect all the dots: organize your data more efficiently and make faster business decisions

With Mozart Data’s data platform, you can effortlessly simplify your data workflows with all the tools required. This all-in-one modern data stack allows you to:

Spend more time on data analysis and less time wrangling your data

Put insights in reach of every team

The benefits of our data management tool

EXTRACT TRANSFORM LOAD

Connect and sync different platforms within minutes

Connect your data sources and pull data automatically with reliable no-code integrations. Speed up your decision-making processes and propel business growth across the board.

DATA WAREHOUSE

Centralize scattered data and speed up business processes

One of the main advantages of a modern data stack should be that it can connect multiple data sources and answer intricate and complex queries by aggregating all of your data in a Snowflake (cloud-based) warehouse.

DATA TRANSFORMATION

Automating data preparation – leave less space for human error

A SQL-based transformation layer and dbt Core integration provide users with everything they need to automate data transformation, ensuring data is always analysis-ready — with minimal draw on internal resources.

Our experienced data consulting team is also available to help you prepare data for analysis and manage automation, allowing you to focus on insights and growth.

BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE

Uncover new insights – create more accurate growth strategies

Data Management

Learn to trust your data

Big data shouldn’t be treated as a challenge. It’s the most crucial asset in any organization’s toolset, and learning to use it ensures optimized business growth, better performance, and, overall, faster scalability.

Learn to trust your data through:

Data cataloging

Data observability

Data reliability

The point of using a modern data platform

Data management platforms have become essential in the processes of every business over the past years.

Simply put, not being able to make sense of your data can make navigating in the contemporary, digitized (business) world incredibly difficult or, in some cases, even impossible.

That said, small business entrepreneurs often think that data is only a necessity for corporate players – that can’t be further from the truth. SMBs can also make excellent use of their data, ensuring faster scalability.

Industry: Healthcare / Diagnostics
Tags: Hard Tech
target:
A new class of molecular diagnostics, built for urgent care

Molecular accuracy with antigen simplicity, designed to deliver answers in minutes. No lab, no trained operator, first-in-class pathogen coverage.

They are treated on limited information. VedaBio is designed to deliver molecular answers at the point of care, in under ten minutes.

One Instrument. One Cartridge. Under Ten Minutes.

A benchtop instrument pairs with a single-use cartridge to run a syndromic panel at the point of care. It is designed so you can collect, load, and read the result before the patient leaves, in a workflow as simple as an antigen test.

The Five Pillars of an Uncompromising Diagnostic Test

Decentralized testing has always traded these five against one another. Because our chemistry works without target amplification, we can design for all five in the same test.

The platform is designed to return a comprehensive result in under ten minutes, including hands-on time , so testing fits inside the length of a single urgent-care visit.

Possible Because We Removed Target Amplification

Conventional molecular detection copies the target until there is enough signal to read, which is what makes it slow and lab-bound. Our CRISPR platform is designed to detect the target directly and amplify the signal, so speed, breadth and molecular accuracy stop trading against each other.

Target recognition to signal, without target amplification

Our leadership spans commercialization, science, engineering, quality, and intellectual property, with repeat experience carrying diagnostics from start-up to global scale.

name: Unsiloed AI
brief:
Product: Unsiloed AI
One-liner: API for parsing multimodal unstructured data
Description: AI teams spend 6+ months building document workflows, yet fewer than 10% ever reach production. Generic LLM parsers and OCR collapse on multimodal documents with text, tables, images, and charts. Poor parsing and suboptimal chunking cripple RAG pipelines and downstream automation. Unsiloed AI has built state-of-the-art vision models which serves as the infrastructure layer for turning unstructured data into structured, queryable, and LLM-ready assets.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B, Infrastructure, APIs
target:
Document Layer for Enterprise AI

We turn PDFs, images, and spreadsheets into JSON and Markdown your LLMs and AI agents can reason over. Built on our proprietary dual-stream vision models.

Enterprises run on documents, not databases.

of enterprise data is unstructured. Most of it sits in PDFs, scans, and spreadsheets your LLMs can't read.

AI teams spend stitching parsers, OCR, and post-processing. Pipelines break the moment a layout changes.

of in-house document pipelines reach production. The rest stall in the pilot.

LLMs exploded the use cases for unstructured data. Agents underwrite claims, copilots draft credit memos, RAG retrieves across thousand-page filings. Generic OCR and DIY pipelines are too static. You need a more dynamic interface, so we rebuilt the stack with vision models that read documents the way humans do.

Three capabilities. One document layer.

Parse, extract, and split. Use them standalone or chain them end-to-end. The same API runs a quick prototype and a production pipeline at scale.

The quarterly report highlights consistent growth across all divisions...

Parse

Convert PDFs, scans, and images into LLM-ready Markdown. Vision models read text, tables, figures, and hierarchy in a single pass, preserving structure that OCR loses.

"vendor": "Apex Industries",

"date": "2024-02-14",

"amount": 4200,

"currency": "USD",

"invoice_id": "INV-0042",

"payment_terms": "NET_30",

"confidence": 0.98

Extract

Pull the fields you need into JSON. One schema, every layout, with domain-awareness that knows a freight charge isn't a line item.

Split

Break multi-document files into individual docs and long ones into retrievable chunks. Parent-child indexing keeps clauses with their preambles.

State-of-the-art document processing.

#1 in terms of accuracy against the leading frontier labs, IDP vendors, and open-source vision models.

olmOCR Overall Performance

Unsiloed Parser vs. leading document parsing platforms and OCR-capable VLMs

Source: olmocr==0.4.27 scorer (unmodified) on allenai/olmOCR-bench · Scores as of May 2026 · Higher is better

Logos and trademarks are the property of their respective owners. Use does not imply endorsement.

How the document layer is built.

Attention-guided Heatmaps

Reads pages like a human, breaking them into typed regions: tables, figures, signatures, handwriting. Attention-guided heatmaps focus compute on pivot zones: numerical columns, merged cells, section headers. Multi-page tables stay whole, split rows rejoin, and clauses keep their hierarchy.

Dual-stream vision model

Two streams process the document in parallel. A data stream captures tokens, numbers, and entities; a layout stream captures image tokens, bounding boxes, alignment, and indentation hierarchy. A cross-attention layer fuses both, so the model reasons over content and structure together.

Domain-specific decoder

name: Locus
brief:
Product: Locus
One-liner: Payment infrastructure for AI agents
Description: We make your agents pay. As agents evolve from tools into dependable, autonomous actors, they’ll need the ability to execute open-ended workflows end-to-end. This inevitably means payments: accessing paywalled data, transacting for services or with other specialist agents. But autonomy requires guardrails. Businesses and developers will need a way to ensure their agents only spend how much and on what they’re supposed to.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Finance, AI
target:
Every tool your agent needs. One account.

One balance across 57 reviewed providers and 3,906 catalog services

Your agent can only use the tools it knows exist.

One search box.

Useful for public pages. Blind to proprietary sources and specialist tools.

“Find the most reliable source for this task.”

Your agent never has to stop for another API key.

One agent goal. The right data source at every step.

Turn one ICP prompt into a verified prospect list.

“ Find AI infrastructure companies hiring senior GTM leaders, identify the right buyer, and return only deliverable work emails. ”

Build a filing-backed company brief before market open.

“ Prepare a current growth-and-risk memo on a public company using reported financials, recent filings, and live market context. ”

Use Locus Pro directly—or bring the catalog into your product.

Every paid tool through one account.

Connect an MCP client once and let your agent discover and use paid capabilities from a single balance.

Instant capabilities for every user.

Put the full tool catalog behind your product so every user can access specialized providers without leaving your experience.

Better tools create more capable agents.

Keep the workflow moving

The agent adds the next capability without waiting on account setup or a key.

Replace subscription sprawl

Pay for actual calls from one balance instead of funding every provider upfront.

Go beyond basic web search

Unlock proprietary research, enrichment, finance, voice, and verification data.

The short version.

Locus Pro gives an AI agent one connection to a catalog of paid APIs and proprietary data sources. The agent can discover the right capability for a task and use it from one balance instead of relying on separate provider accounts, subscriptions, and API keys.

It searches the Locus Pro catalog by the outcome it needs—not by a provider name it already knows. That lets it discover specialized capabilities for research, enrichment, verification, finance, voice, and more while the workflow is still running.

No. You connect the agent to Locus Pro once. Locus Pro handles access to supported providers, so the agent does not have to stop and ask you to create another account, choose another plan, or copy another API key.

brief:
Product: Inversion Semiconductor
One-liner: Manufacturing the most powerful chips, 15x faster
Description: Inversion Semiconductor is developing the next-generation chip fabrication machine, to create the most powerful chips 15x faster. Our vision is to reshore advanced chip fabrication capabilities in the West. We're building a lithography machine. Lithography uses light to pattern circuit features on silicon. We're scaling transistors to their physical limits by shrinking particle accelerators 1000x, to create a high power light source.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Hardware, Manufacturing, Semiconductors
target:
Scaling Chips Down to their Physical Limits 15x faster ‍

We are building the next-generation semiconductor lithography platform, by shrinking particle accelerators 1000x.

Inversion Semiconductor’s revolutionary particle accelerator is smaller than any particle accelerator.

transistor density

100% increase in transistor density for the same numerical aperture (NA)

High power light source

Enabling 3x higher throughput per scanner and the capability to power multiple scanners

Tunable wavelength light source

Capable of generating 13.5nm EUV light needed today, and scaling transistors down to their physical limits.

critical dimension uniformity

> 25% improvement in critical dimension uniformity, significantly improving fabrication of high aspect ratio features for novel transistor architectures and compute paradigms including quantum & reversible...

Meet our founders

Rohan Karthik

Rohan worked in the systems group at Arm, specializing in automating system architecture and testbench generation. Previously, he built vision software for surgical robots at CMR Surgical and led the Karman Space Program, to develop and launch record-breaking rockets. He holds an MEng in Mechanical Engineering from Imperial College London.

Daniel Vega

Daniel conducted research for Run 2 of the CERN AWAKE project, applying novel machine learning techniques to infer and predict beam dynamics for plasma wakefield acceleration. Prior to this he worked on the development of particle accelerators for cancer treatment at Lumitron Technologies, engineered color changing skin for satellites and implemented Shor's algorithm on early quantum computing platforms.

Reserve yours today

name: Your Finances — made simple
brief: Product: Your Finances — made simple
target:
Your Finances — made simple

Actual Budget is a super fast and privacy-focused app for managing your finances. At its heart is the well proven and much loved Envelope Budgeting methodology. You own your data and can do whatever you want with it. Featuring multi-device sync, optional end-to-end encryption and so much more.

Be involved in your financial decisions

Meticulously designed for speed

Unabashedly local-first software

Powerful budgeting made simple

The fastest way to manage transactions

Oh my, the reports

So many features!

Everything in one place

Add all of your accounts and track everything in one place. Get valuable information like net worth from all your accounts together. Learn more

Syncing across devices

Self-host our syncing service. It's easy to set up, but uses sophisticated distributed systems technology to sync changes across any number of devices. Learn more

Bank Sync

Actual has built in support for bank syncing using goCardless (EU/UK) and SimpleFIN (US/Canada). Learn more

Envelope Style Budgeting

Use the power of envelope budgeting to get on top of your finances. You can only budget cash you have on hand, which means your budget stays realistic and you don't make numbers up. Learn more

Transfers

Manage transfers easily by creating transfer transactions. Actual will link the transactions on both sides and update them together. Learn more

Importing Transactions

Import transactions from the most popular financial files: QIF, OFX, QFX, CAMT.053 and CSV. Learn more

Undo & redo

A robust undo system allows you to rollback any changes you make, and redo them if desired. Never worry about making mistakes. Learn more

Migrate your data

We provide builtin YNAB4 & nYNAB importers that keep all of your history. There are many more available from the Actual Community. Learn more

Dark Mode

Choose your own style with a built in dark mode and dynamic theming using your system default.

API

If you're a developer, we got you. Use our fully-featured API to write custom importers or build your own features. This API simply runs on your local data. Learn more

Own your data

* PikaPods donates 20% of fees people like you pay to run Actual on their servers to our Open Collective . Regardless of this relationship, we believe PikaPods is the easiest way to get started with Actual.

brief:
Product: RetroFix
One-liner: Automate any workflow using plain english
Description: RetroFix is an automation platform designed to be extremely intuitive to use, making it much easier and faster to automate manual work. To create or modify workflows you can describe them in natural language and our agent will create them end-to-end for you. We allow you to connect with 2000+ applications and use our pre-built actions for your workflows. In the case we don't have a pre-built step, our agent can instead write code to access the full APIs of all the apps we integrate with.
Industry: B2B
target:
Build Automations Using Plain English

Tell RetroFix what you want done, and our AI writes, tests, and monitors the workflow for you. Connect 2800+ apps in minutes.

The best are already here

Build with RetroFix

Explore AI tools, workflows, and agents built for real automation tasks.

Describe what you want, RetroFix builds the workflow for you.

Your Everyday Tasks, Automated

Real workflows written exactly as you would describe them on RetroFix

No templates here yet

We're curating the best examples. Check back soon or tell us what you want to automate.

Who is RetroFix Built For?

Different builders, same goal. Build automations that actually work.

Freelancers

Prototype faster. Deliver more.

Build client-ready automations in plain English, connecting to 2,800+ tools instantly.

No configuration headaches, no trial-and-error just describe the task and our AI builds it.

AI Agencies

Scale your automation services, not your headcount.

Replace offshore dev costs with RetroFix’s AI builder and self-healing workflows.

Deliver faster, manage more clients, and keep dev margins high with scalable pricing.

Growing Teams

Collaborate, adapt and scale easily.

Share automations across teammates, edit them using natural language, and keep every workflow up to date as your processes evolve.

Change processes by telling the agent what's new. No rebuilding from scratch.

name: ProcIndex
brief:
Product: ProcIndex
One-liner: AI-powered accounting automation for construction and manufacturing
Description: ProcIndex uses AI to automate accounting operations for the construction and manufacturing sectors. It connects to your existing ERP and operates in the background while giving you full visibility into its actions. By automating accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliation, and vendor management, ProcIndex helps accounting teams improve efficiency by 33%.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
Tags: Fintech, Finance, B2B, AI
target:
AI accounting agents for construction & manufacturing.

Your ERP has the records. Your team still does the stitching.

Construction teams contend with project coding and progress billing. Manufacturers contend with invoice volume and PO variances. Both need clean entries, clear exceptions, and control before anything posts.

Agents execute. Your policies decide.

AP, vendor, AR, and reconciliation agents work from the same ERP data, policies, and audit trail. Routine work moves forward; exceptions stay with your team.

Accounts Payable

Reads incoming invoices, matches them to ERP purchase orders, applies coding, routes approvals, and posts approved transactions.

Vendor Management

Answers routine invoice-status questions from live AP data and sends ambiguous requests to your team with the conversation attached.

Accounts Receivable

Follows up on overdue ERP receivables, tracks promises to pay, and keeps disputes requiring human attention visible.

Account Reconciliation

Matches account activity to supporting transactions, surfaces discrepancies, and keeps unresolved items visible for review.

Accounting workflows, not generic automation

ProcIndex runs AP, vendor, AR, and reconciliation work against the same ERP data, policies, and audit trail.

Partial invoices

Match split deliveries and partial billings line by line while tracking the quantity and commitment still open.

Progress billing review

Review pay applications against PO lines, prior billing, and the remaining commitment in one comparison.

Status responses

Answer routine supplier questions from live invoice, approval, and payment data without interrupting the AP team.

Collections and promises

Run consistent follow-up, structure customer replies, and keep promises to pay tied to the correct receivable.

Dispute escalation

Collect the customer reply, invoice context, and supporting evidence before routing the dispute to your team.

Transaction matching

Match account activity to ERP transactions and keep unexplained differences visible for review.

One invoice, two very different weeks.

Follow the same supplier invoice through AP the way it runs today, and the way it runs with ProcIndex.

Connect ERP. Set the guardrails. Expand with confidence.

Sync POs and accounting dimensions, configure matching tolerances and approvals, then validate ProcIndex on real invoices and pay applications.

Connect your ERP

Sync the vendors, purchase orders, projects, dimensions, and transaction data each workflow needs.

Configure your controls

Define matching rules, payable entities, variance tolerance, and approval paths.

Process and review

ProcIndex captures, matches, codes, and routes invoices; uncertain cases go to the shared work queue.

Approve and post

name: Foster
brief:
Product: Foster
One-liner: A better way to write.
Description: Community-powered writing workflow driven by some of the internet's best writers, editors, and experts.
Industry: Consumer / Home and Personal
Tags: Productivity
target:
Find your writing tribe

Hi, we’re Foster. We’ve cultivated a way of writing together that leads to truer expressions of creativity and self. It’s fun, it’s interesting, and it makes writing easier, less lonely, and more fulfilling. Curious? Come try our signature Writing Circle and see what we’re all about.

Foster in the Words of the Collective

The Foster Way

Foster combines community, consistency, and self-inquiry to help writers get into flow and unlock our truest, most authentic expression. Here’s how we do it.

How We Practice Together

Weekly Writing Circles

Coming together on Zoom to write each week is our foundational practice. Writing Circles are artfully-crafted, 90-minute containers for writers to drop into what feels most alive and write from that place.

Our facilitators play with meditation, somatic experiencing, breathwork, and other modalities to help writers drop into embodied states of flow and unfettered expression.

After a dedicated period of focused writing, we circle back and share our experience, perhaps even reading something we’ve written.

Bi-annual Retreats

Twice a year we get together in person for a few days to go deeper into our writing practice, our relationship with ourselves, and our relationships with each other. In the summer we convene in upstate New York, but in the winter we like to visit warmer locales (Mexico and Costa Rica, so far).

We also make sure to have a little fun, going on excursions specific to the area we’re visiting. We mix it up with a little bit of practice and a little bit of adventure – some of our favorite activities have included yoga, cacao ceremonies, sound healing, aquahara, hiking to waterfalls, surfing, and more.

Community Support

WhatsApp

We love to trade links and discuss all the things worth discussing, and we do that in dedicated WhatsApp channels.

Professional Editing

Leverage the professional and editors in the Foster collective for thoughtful feedback and edits.

Reasons You Might Want to Join Foster

A Co-Operated Collective

We are a collective of writers, editors, coaches, technologists, metamodern magicians and more who are united by our belief in the transformative, life-affirming power of the written word. You’ll find writers of all skill levels in Foster. From published authors to newsletter writers to people who just started writing, our collective contains multitudes. The core team here currently consists of five Stewards, with the support of sixteen Contributors.

Check out CoAuthored , Foster’s co-written Substack

Join our mailing list

Get the latest posts from CoAuthored and news from Foster

FAQs
