name: Deep Interactions
brief:
Product: Deep Interactions
One-liner: Collaborative AI app builder for teams
Description: Deep Interactions is a collaborative AI builder. We don't leave you with a spaghetti mess of a code. We bring product intelligence and power the context layer that enables your team to build in sync - saving companies tokens, time, and nerves. You give us a problem and we ship a working AI product in the same afternoon.
Industry: B2B
target:
Deep Interactions

Collaborative AI builder for teams.

Deep Interactions works within your environment and in tandem with your stakeholders to help you scope, design, build, and deploy products people actually use. Not ideas. Not prototypes. The real thing.

Watch our launch video

Claude Code is made for lone wolves. Real products are created by teams.

Most AI coding agents exist for a single person in a single editor. But real products are shaped by founders, designers, engineers, domain experts, and operators — all with different context, constraints, and priorities.

That's why a solo AI brainchild is often a half-baked idea, broken demo, or a product no-one can use.

Deep Interactions gathers context on what your team is building — then builds it. Yes, just like that.

Solo AI builds

Typical handoffs

From vibes to value

AI can generate screens and code. What it still struggles with is shared intent.

The problem isn't speed. It's that most AI products lose the thread between business goals, design decisions, technical execution, and real-world use.

Deep Interactions keeps that thread intact. We help teams move from idea to design to build to deploy to iterate in one connected process — so the end result is not just fast, but coherent, usable, and ready for production.

How it works

From first conversation to deployed product, we keep the thread intact.

Understand the business

We capture business goals, constraints, and stakeholder context — not just prompts in a chat window.

Build inside your environment

Deep Interactions works across the tools your team already uses, so the workflow stays connected from concept to release.

Ship something real

You get an integrated AI product — not a prototype, not a broken handoff, not another "we'll circle back."

What that means in practice

Working products fast

Not "here's a prototype." Not "here's a Figma." A real thing, on a real timeline.

Design that doesn't look AI generated

Products should feel considered, not assembled from defaults.

Built for actual use

We come from human-centred computing, so we don't just ask whether the model can do it. We ask whether the product should exist this way — and whether people will trust it when it does.

Better for teams

Deep Interactions is built for the way products are actually made: across people, tools, and decisions.

Where your team works

brief:
Product: Quetzal
One-liner: Simple, LLM-first translation and internationalization for software
Description: Quetzal is the first fully LLM-powered translation and internationalization suite, enabling companies to translate and internationalize their software and content instantly with minimal setup. We also handle all of your internationalization issues, from managing all of your stakeholders to bringing your product and marketing to market. No more waiting days or even weeks for translated content! Deliver a perfect experience to your users in any language, instantly.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, SaaS, Enterprise Software, International
target:
Localization is solved.

or do it manually via our docs

Keep your codebase localized, without the constant upkeep.

Link your repo once. Quetzal learns from your codebase and keeps every string translated, current, and in place — so your engineers never have to.

Updates arrive ready to merge

Quetzal improves your translations, adds the ones you're missing, and wraps strings that slipped through — then publishes it straight to your repo. You review, you merge.

Sync translations & wrap untranslated strings

quetzal/sync → main

3 files changed + 3 − 1

Context-Aware Translations

Ship accurate translations with confidence. Quetzal draws rich context straight from your codebase, so every translation lands as precise and consistent as one written by your own team.

Code context

We read the code around each string — components, props, comments — so the model knows whether it's translating a button, a heading, or an error.

Similar & surrounding text

Neighboring strings and prior translations come along for the ride, so new copy reads like it belongs next to everything already shipped.

Key terms

Brand names, product nouns, and domain jargon stay intact — your glossary is enforced instead of helpfully mistranslated.

Consistent voice

Tone and register are inferred from your existing language and held steady across every locale, every release.

Switch on what you need

Quetzal can perform your translations outright, or work to improve their quality and coverage.

Translation

Translates the strings in your code, reading the surrounding context to catch nuance a glossary can't.

Translation Audits

Already localized? Quetzal reviews existing translations and proposes fixes — catching errors even when another tool did the work.

Code Updates

Finds user-facing text that was never hooked into localization and wraps it — so missed strings never reach production.

Compatible with your stack

Quetzal isn't another translation library to adopt — it's a layer that plugs into what you already run. No rewrites, no migrating your pipeline.

First-class support today. The underlying engine isn't bound to this list — most languages just work.

Any translation framework

Nothing is locked to a single pipeline. Quetzal works with whatever i18n setup you already have.

20+ languages

Translate into any language the models support — and the list only keeps growing.

We don't train on your code.

Conversational AI for financial institutions

OmniAI is now Monumint. Read our launch announcement. →

Book a Demo

what we do

Conversations that build momentum

Conversational AI built for regulated financial institutions. Agents that hold a real conversation, plug into the systems you run, and show their work.

Meet customers where they are

Reach customers through the channels they already use, with one agent that carries the conversation from first touch to resolution.

GET STARTED

Built on the right data foundation

Agents read and write to the systems that matter – CRMs, loan platforms, cores, credit data, and document stores – so every conversation drives real work, not a handoff.

Audit-ready at every step

TCPA-safe windows, fair-lending language scoring, and one-click evidence packs give every message, decision, and system update a clear audit trail.

What are the use cases?

Built for every stage of the customer journey

Account opening

Greet, qualify, and verify applicants 24/7 across every channel. Funded accounts in minutes not days of back-and-forth. A branch-quality experience without the branch wait.

Loan origination

Pre-qualify, nurture, and collect documents end-to-end. Warm hand-offs to loan officers at the moments that matter. Every promise the agent makes is policy-bounded.

Servicing

Answer balance, payment, and account questions instantly. Full borrower history follows the conversation, every channel. Intent signals like refi or hardship route straight to the right human.

Collections

Empathetic, policy-bounded outreach in TCPA-safe windows. Hardship signals route straight to a human, with context. Every interaction logged and scored for fair-lending language.

Real People, Real Results

Lendio has helped over 520,000 small businesses access $17B+ in financing by providing transparent access to the best credit options. To scale our mission, we partnered with Monumint to eliminate operational bottlenecks. By automating our application gathering motion, Monumint slashed manual intervention and drove a 4x increase in ADR productivity. That speed translates directly into a superior customer experience—getting critical capital into the hands of business owners faster than ever before

name: OneTriangle
brief:
Product: OneTriangle
One-liner: The cheapest, fastest inference cloud
Description: Inference has surpassed training as AI’s largest compute cost, accelerated by increasing demand for AI and agents. By using proprietary KV cache transfer tech, OneTriangle has cut inference costs by 20% and time by 40% compared to present standards.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Open Source, Infrastructure
target:
Cheaper & Faster Inference

By using frontier research on KV cache transfer between models, cut your inference costs and time by 20%. Prefill runs on a small model, and decode on a large one.

Backed by Combinator

Faster first responses, smaller bills

Measured result 100k-token context

Time to first token

16.9s → 2.7s

$46.9k → $7.5k

The first KV cache-aware inference engine

Prefill cost scales with the size of the model doing the reading, which means today you pay large-model rates before the large model has produced a single word. On long inputs, that's most of the bill.

We prefill on a small model instead. Its per-layer K/V tensors are stripped of source rotary embeddings, projected head-wise into the target model's attention space, and re-embedded at target positions. The large model enters decode against a populated cache it never computed.

Prefill small and decode large. Transfers are gated on held-out quality and latency for every model pair. Ordinary prefill takes over whenever a pair doesn't clear, so the target model uses its usual inference path.

Serviced open-weight models

Description: Inference has surpassed training as AI’s largest compute cost, accelerated by increasing demand for AI and agents. By using proprietary KV cache transfer tech, OneTriangle has cut inference costs by 20% and time by 40% compared to present standards.

Cheaper & Faster Inference

By using frontier research on KV cache transfer between models, cut your inference costs and time by 20%. Prefill runs on a small model, and decode on a large one.

Backed by Combinator

Faster first responses, smaller bills

Measured result 100k-token context

Time to first token

16.9s → 2.7s

$46.9k → $7.5k

The first KV cache-aware inference engine

Prefill cost scales with the size of the model doing the reading, which means today you pay large-model rates before the large model has produced a single word. On long inputs, that's most of the bill.

We prefill on a small model instead. Its per-layer K/V tensors are stripped of source rotary embeddings, projected head-wise into the target model's attention space, and re-embedded at target positions. The large model enters decode against a populated cache it never computed.

name: Agent-Ready Sanity Kit for Next.js & Astro
brief:
Product: Agent-Ready Sanity Kit for Next.js & Astro
Description: The agent-ready Sanity kit for Next.js and Astro. Six years of decisions committed: page builder, fetch layer, AGENTS.md, skills, MCP servers, llms.txt. Buy once, own it forever.
target:
The stack agents don't reinvent.

Full-stack kit for Next.js and Astro.

The page builder alone costs you days. Every single time.

Every decision already made. So you can skip to the actual work.

001 / Agent-native

AGENTS.md and a dozen scoped skills load the conventions before the first prompt, so Claude Code or Cursor builds inside the decisions instead of proposing a new architecture per run. Two MCP servers ship in the repo: one reads the running app, one drives a real Chrome. The agent checks its own work.

002 / Agent-ready in production

The shipped site stays legible to agents: an editable llms.txt drafted from your content, and a token-light Markdown twin of every page on the same URL. A feature you can put in your own proposals.

003 / Schema as a system

Document roles, factory functions, singletons. Every schema looks the same, so every editor knows where to go. You never model the structure from scratch again.

004 / The hard fields, already built

The three fields nobody gets right the first time. A link field that handles every kind of link. A media field that returns image, Mux, Rive, and Lottie in one shape, dimensions included, so layout never shifts. A page builder with guardrails. Typed, composed everywhere.

005 / Fetch layer, solved

CDN bypassed in production, Data Cache doing the work, webhooks invalidating on publish, draft mode wired in. Stale content after publish stops being a midnight problem.

006 / A Studio editors actually use

Every document type where editors expect it. Pages own their routes, singletons stay locked, no hunting. Clients stop emailing to ask where their homepage lives.

007 / SEO, done not deferred

Per-page metadata from schema, sitemap driven by Sanity, OpenGraph with auto-cropped images, robots.txt included. Nothing bolted on the week before launch.

008 / Production-ready from day one

Basic auth, spam-protected forms, redirects managed in Sanity, analytics, view transitions. The plumbing you reconfigure every project, already wired.

009 / Wired up, not just cloned

An interactive setup script provisions the Sanity project, mints tokens, wires CORS and the revalidation webhook, and writes your .env. Migration scripts back up production and move content between environments. The first run is handled, not documented.

The work that gets remembered.

name: Asimov
brief:
Product: Asimov
One-liner: Real-world human movement data for humanoid robots
Description: Asimov collects real-world human movement data from households and businesses to train humanoid robots. Unlike factory datasets that capture the same tasks in the same environments, we deliver the full diversity of real human environments, thousands of hours a day to leading labs.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
target:
Human intelligence for robotics

We collect diverse real-world human data at scale to power the next generation of robots.

Robotics has a data problem

AI has made enormous progress by scaling data. Language models learned to reason by training on the collected text of the internet. Vision models learned to see from billions of images. But robotics has nowhere near enough.

Most robot training data comes from teleoperation: a human remotely controls a robot while it records. This produces thousands of hours at best, collected in controlled lab settings with limited variety. Meanwhile, 8 billion people generate 16 hours of real-world physical activity every day. The gap is massive.

For robots to learn how the physical world works, they need to see how humans move through it. Not in a lab, but in real kitchens, offices, hotels, and homes. The messier and more diverse the data, the better the models.

That is what we do. We collect human activity data at scale from real environments across multiple continents, and turn it into clean, annotated datasets that teach robots to understand the physical world.

Real-world data from diverse environments

We handle everything end-to-end: hardware distribution, data collection, quality assurance, and post-processing. Your team gets clean, annotated datasets ready for training.

Diverse environments

Kitchens, offices, hotels, warehouses. Organic behavior, not scripted demos.

Egocentric video

First-person perspective capturing natural hand-object interactions.

Rich annotations

3D body pose, depth maps, semantic labels, activity segmentation.

Managed pipeline

We ship hardware, train collectors, run QA, and deliver clean datasets.

Get paid for tasks you already do

Cook, clean, organize, run errands. Your everyday activities are exactly what robots need to learn from. Use a lightweight phone head mount, follow assigned tasks, and get paid for approved data.

Apply

We'll match approved collectors to assignments based on phone model, availability, and task demand.

Record assigned tasks

Use a phone head mount, follow the app instructions, and preview the recording before upload.

Get paid after QA

Approved recording time becomes eligible for payout after review.

We make your labor free

Restaurants, hotels, cleaning companies, warehouses. If your workers perform physical tasks, we want to capture that data. In exchange, we cover their salaries. For larger partnerships, we offer revenue sharing from the data we sell.

Zero-cost labor

We pay your workers' salaries while they do their normal jobs wearing lightweight recording equipment.

Non-disruptive

No workflow changes. Your operations continue as usual. The equipment is unobtrusive.

Revenue sharing

Most robot training data comes from teleoperation: a human remotely controls a robot while it records. This produces thousands of hours at best, collected in controlled lab settings with limited variety. Meanwhile, 8 billion people generate 16 hours of real-world physical activity every day. The gap is massive.

For robots to learn how the physical world works, they need to see how humans move through it. Not in a lab, but in real kitchens, offices, hotels, and homes. The messier and more diverse the data, the better the models.

That is what we do. We collect human activity data at scale from real environments across multiple continents, and turn it into clean, annotated datasets that teach robots to understand the physical world.

Real-world data from diverse environments

We handle everything end-to-end: hardware distribution, data collection, quality assurance, and post-processing. Your team gets clean, annotated datasets ready for training.

Diverse environments

Kitchens, offices, hotels, warehouses. Organic behavior, not scripted demos.

Egocentric video

First-person perspective capturing natural hand-object interactions.

Rich annotations

3D body pose, depth maps, semantic labels, activity segmentation.

Managed pipeline

We ship hardware, train collectors, run QA, and deliver clean datasets.

Get paid for tasks you already do

Cook, clean, organize, run errands. Your everyday activities are exactly what robots need to learn from. Use a lightweight phone head mount, follow assigned tasks, and get paid for approved data.

Apply

We'll match approved collectors to assignments based on phone model, availability, and task demand.

Record assigned tasks

Use a phone head mount, follow the app instructions, and preview the recording before upload.

Get paid after QA

Approved recording time becomes eligible for payout after review.

We make your labor free

Restaurants, hotels, cleaning companies, warehouses. If your workers perform physical tasks, we want to capture that data. In exchange, we cover their salaries. For larger partnerships, we offer revenue sharing from the data we sell.

Zero-cost labor

We pay your workers' salaries while they do their normal jobs wearing lightweight recording equipment.

Non-disruptive

No workflow changes. Your operations continue as usual. The equipment is unobtrusive.

Revenue sharing

brief:
Product: GreaseBoss
One-liner: GreaseBoss verifes industrial machinery is greased correctly
Description: Our hardware and software product verifies industrial machines are greased correctly. Incorrect greasing is the number one cause for machinery failure and costs $21bn per annum.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Hardware, IoT
target:
Right Grease . Right Amount . Right Time .

lubricate with confidence

Eliminate the risk of grease related failures

Visibility over planned vs actual greasing

Prevent critical equipment failures.

Remote visibility of how equipment is being greased.

Automatic alerts enable efficient prescriptive maintenance.

Systemise manual greasing to enable staff with minimal training and safeguard against staff turnover.

GREASEBOSS SYSTEM SUMMARY VIDEO

Fixed or mobile? We’ve got you covered

Harsh environments demand robust, reliable performance. Get the basics right and get the most from your machines.

FixeD PLANT

Fixed plants contain a mix of equipment, each that have different lubrication needs. Generally, fixed plants require a lubrication strategy that combines both manual and automatic lubrication and traditionally it has been impossible for maintenance managers to verify that equipment is being greased correctly.

The GreaseBoss system provides solutions to monitor both manual and automatic lubrication, providing maintenance managers and their teams with full visibility over their plant’s lubrication, ensuring that every grease point receives the right grease, in the right amount, at the right time.

HEAVY MOBILE EQUIPMENT

Huge loads, high impact, vibration and dust expose heavy mobile equipment to extreme operating conditions. Reliable and regular grease application is critical for preventing pin and bush failures in these harsh conditions. However, these HME automatic lubrication systems often experience sudden component failures of injectors, distributors and pumps which go unnoticed, leading to undergreasing and equipment failure.

The GreaseBoss HME Solutions provide HME fleet managers with visibility and certainty that their critical assets are being correctly greased to maximise uptime and productivity.

key industries

we’re probably already overhauling yours…

GreaseBoss is revolutionising every major industry that relies on effective greasing solutions. By integrating advanced technology and innovative design into our greasing systems, GreaseBoss enhances equipment reliability and reduces downtime, ultimately driving productivity and efficiency.

Verify your machinery has been greased correctly, prevent unplanned downtime and reduce maintenance costs with GreaseBoss.

Manufacturing

With continuous and increasing demand for asphalt products from industry and government, keeping plant operating and drum mixers rolling is essential for both business and society.

Proven in the Toughest Conditions.

Trusted by the Best.

name: XTraffic
brief:
Product: XTraffic
One-liner: Technology for cities to automate and manage their traffic lights.
Description: XTraffic is at the intersection of advancements in sensor technology and affordability. This means entire cities can affordably upgrade their infrastructure - and some already are. We are live in multiple cities, with both ongoing and successful pilots, corridors of multiple intersections, and soon to be entire cities. Our customers enjoy less traffic, better safety, and data on which to build their future.
Industry: Government
target:
Direct AI control for traffic signals.

Continuous AI signal control

XTraffic senses traffic demand and directly controls signals in real time, using existing agency infrastructure where possible.

Designed for public-sector corridors where timing plans are too rigid, hardware refreshes are expensive, and operators need results they can defend.

Continuous Signal Control

See demand sooner. Control continuously.

XTraffic evaluates traffic demand continuously, allowing signals to respond while vehicles are still approaching the intersection.

Sense

Fuse available camera, detector, and signal data into a real-time traffic state.

Predict

Estimate arrivals, queues, platoons, and safety constraints before the stop bar becomes the first useful signal.

Control

Select signal actions against agency-defined goals: movement, coordination, preemption, and safety.

Same traffic. Earlier decisions.

The same traffic, controlled continuously.

The same demand enters a corridor. A traditional controller only sees the stopbar zone and a timing plan. XTraffic's AI tracks every vehicle, learns traffic patterns, and shares relevant data across intersections so the corridor can respond before queues form.

Built for public agencies

Simple to understand. Serious underneath.

Designed for traffic and public works teams that need modern control, defensible operations, and a practical path from pilot corridor to larger deployment.

Works with existing infrastructure

Use current signal systems and available sensor feeds where possible, rather than asking agencies to start with a hardware replacement.

Respects existing safety systems

Keep cabinet safeguards and approved controller interfaces in place while applying agency-defined operating constraints.

Data as a byproduct

Generate real-time and historical traffic insights from the same system that controls the signal.

Focused on outcomes

Optimize for agency priorities such as efficiency, coordination, emergency response, and safer movements.

Start with one corridor

Bring continuous signal control to your network.

XTraffic helps cities, counties, and public agencies move from fixed timing to live control without forcing a full infrastructure reset.

brief:
Product: Freeport Markets
One-liner: Trade Anything
Description: Freeport is a trading platform for pre-IPO shares, equities, crypto, and perpetual futures. Our AI analysts turn trusted social and financial media into a real-time feed of market-moving news and actionable trade ideas.
Industry: Fintech / Consumer Finance
Tags: Fintech, Crypto / Web3, Investing, Consumer Finance, AI
target:
Trade anything, track everything

$175M+ traded on Freeport

20K+ wallets

Global Access

Every market. Always open.

Stocks, crypto, commodities, FX, rates, and pre-IPO, open 24/7 including weekends.

Capital Efficiency

Up to 50x. Long or short.

Cross or isolated margin, no KYC, and full self-custody.

Smart Money

Every signal. One feed.

Track insiders, politicians, hedge funds, other smart money, and trending tweets.

Why Freeport

Market Intelligence

Follow the feeds you trust. Freeport tracks X, Substack, media, plus hedge fund, politician, and insider filings.

Smart Analyst

AI connects your sources into themes, then pings you on upcoming catalysts and notable events.

Optimal Execution

Trade 24/7 with 50x leverage, instant settlement, and execution routed to the exchange with the best pricing.

Premium Access

Tap into pre-IPO exposure, private credit, catastrophe bonds, and other formerly institutional markets.

Frequently asked questions

Fund your account in seconds with Apple Pay, Google Pay, a debit or credit card, a bank transfer, or by sending stablecoins. There is no minimum to begin, so you can start with as little as you like.

No. If you can use a banking app, you can use Freeport. You sign in with Apple or Google, add money with a card, and trade, while the blockchain rails that make it fast and global run quietly in the background. There are no wallets to set up and no jargon to learn.

Stocks, crypto, and perpetual futures on stocks, indices, commodities, currencies, and crypto, plus pre-IPO exposure to private companies, all from one account, 24/7.

Anytime. Because your assets are genuinely yours, you can withdraw them to an outside wallet whenever you want, with no lock-ups, no waiting periods, and no approval needed. The freedom to walk away with your funds is the whole point of self-custody.

You do. Freeport is self-custodial, so your assets live in a wallet only you control, never on Freeport's books. Their safety does not depend on Freeport staying in business: even if the company vanished tomorrow, your funds would still be yours and withdrawable. There is no seed phrase to write down. You just sign in with Apple or Google.

name: Hilstart
brief:
Product: Hilstart
One-liner: Autonomous Hardware Testing
Description: We build physical agent harnesses to enable AI to debug, validate, and ship functional hardware and software.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Developer Tools, Hardware
target:
Hardware development, on autopilot.

Automate your electronics bring-up, validation, and firmware development. Connect Tracer to your hardware, and let Hilstart write firmware, run validation tests, and debug while you sleep.

Agent driven, human verifiable.

Design context is converted to a specification and strict test limits that you approve. Our agent writes hardware tests for board bring-up, firmware development, or design validation. Once approved, Tracer runs tests autonomously, on real hardware.

Single source of truth.

Inferred from your design files, confirmed by you.

Hilstart reads the schematic, layout, netlist, BoM, I/O summary and your requirements into one specification. Once approved, this context becomes the source of truth for everything downstream, setting the constraints for hardware interaction.

Generate hardware tests.

Hand over a requirements document, an existing test plan, or simply ask for bring-up. Our agent writes out automated hardware tests accordingly, grounded in the specification and board context.

Read them, change a threshold, delete what you don't want. Tests remain in the project for future runs, and can even be triggered during a CI process on a firmware change.

Run tests on real hardware.

Reading is always allowed: scopes, logic analyzers, meters, etc. Anything that drives an output needs approval in the test plan. Tracer drives its own channels alongside the USB and networked instruments you already own.

Each report links the exact test scripts that produced it. Reports push into your tracker over the API, tied to the test file and the firmware build.

The hardware interface.

Flexible and powerful hardware test equipment supporting timing-critical execution, with no setup required.

Protection On every external pin:

Run it in our cloud, or from your own environment.

Both reach the same hardware layer, with the same capabilities. Use whichever one fits how you already work.

Everything in the browser.

Bring your own design files, or link to a repo. The environment is already set up, the agent can drive the bench, write & flash firmware, and bring up boards - all in your browser.

Your editor, your agent, your build.

Reach the same hardware from your own machine over an API. Probe a net, enable a rail, author and run a test, pull earlier runs.

Either way Hardware is read-only by default; actuation asks for your grant. Everything durable lives against the board, versioned. Every report is written back against the test file and the firmware build that produced it.

Will this work for my setup?

Close the loop on your hardware.

name: Mindset Health
brief:
Product: Mindset Health
One-liner: Building AI therapeutics for physical health conditions like IBS.
Description: We help healthcare providers treat their gastrointestinal patients with AI-delivered therapy. Using machine learning and large language models, we learn from therapy data, outcomes, and physiology to deliver adaptive, scalable treatments for conditions like IBS - without the waitlist.
Industry: Healthcare / Medical Devices
Tags: Health Tech, Telehealth, Digital Health, Women's Health, Mental Health
target:
Mind over matter.

What the brain does, the body feels. Clinically validated programs for the chronic conditions drugs weren’t built for.

Where current care runs out.

Chronic pain, IBS, menopause, and anxiety affect about one in four adults. Most are already in care. Most still have symptoms. Years of medications, specialists, and elimination diets move the needle a little, and leave most of the burden on patients, the clinicians who treat them, and the systems that pay for the cycle. For these conditions, the body follows the brain. Drugs don’t reach the wiring.

Programs built on techniques that address the nervous system , not just the symptom.

How we think and feel changes how the body functions. Gut motility. Pain perception. Autonomic regulation. For the chronic conditions where pharmacology under-performs, this brain–body axis is the dominant pathology. Behavioral techniques can engage it. We turn them into software. Adapted to each user. Run from a phone. Measured against the same endpoints as a drug trial.

A growing pipeline of conditions .

Each program is built with the academic centre that wrote the original protocol, tested in randomised trials, and run from a phone. Same brain–body approach. Different conditions.

Brain–body techniques at the speed of software .

Validated symptom tracking

The model meets each person where they are. Symptoms, history, goals, signals.

A program shaped to you

Every audio session, lesson and exercise adapts to your progress. No two programs run the same.

Outcomes you can measure

Continuous feedback drives the model, and clinically meaningful improvement, week over week.

Clinically studied outcomes measured against active controls .

of participants experienced clinically significant abdominal pain reduction at 6 weeks, vs. 35% on active control, in a peer-reviewed gut-directed hypnotherapy trial. 1

Stories of change

Partner with us to expand access to care .

name: Tailscale
brief:
Product: Tailscale
Description: The connectivity platform for devs, IT, and security teams. Zero Trust identity-based access that deploys in minutes and scales to every resource. Start free.
target:
The best secure connectivity platform for the AI era

A Zero Trust identity-based connectivity platform that replaces your legacy VPN, SASE, and PAM and connects remote teams, multi-cloud environments, CI/CD pipelines, Edge & IoT devices, and AI workloads.

Business VPN

40,000 businesses choose Tailscale

hours saved with fewer connectivity issues.

headcount growth without dedicated IT resources for config or onboarding.

reduction in internal support requests.

Easy, secure, identity-based access to anything

Tailscale deploys quickly and enables Zero Trust access to any resource on your network. From CI/CD runners across multi-cloud environments, to SaaS tools and infrastructure, Tailscale connects it all, seamlessly.

Installation takes minutes

Get started in minutes. Integrations apply policies to your teams at scale.

Switching is easy

Cross-platform and infrastructure agnostic to give the flexibility you need.

Bridge hybrid environments

Across clouds or on-prem, Tailscale’s mesh overlay network connects it all.

Developer approved, But don’t just take our word for it.

Setting up a mesh VPN on all my devices was so damn easy thanks to @Tailscale. A tightly sealed network of remote devices with almost no configuration and also ease of adding a new device to the mesh is just what I wanted. Amazing work @Tailscale!

Uhh this is sweet! Redirecting SSL authentication to Tailscale to handle it for you eliminates the need to manage PKI at scale, or go through the nightmare of changing keys out when someone leaves. And, EVERYTHING is protected, regardless of where the workload lives. AWESOME!

After installing @Tailscale on a bunch of machines on my home network (Linux x86 + aarch64, MacOS, Windows) I've just ventured out. Had to restart the process but holy moly, just SSH'ed into my boxes, building code and pushing configs around like I'm home. Amazing. Converted

Just paid for @Tailscale. Installed it on our robots; so far so good. Compared to OpenVPN: * Serverless * Always on * Same config in office & field * Scales to large # devices * GUI-based ACL w/SSO * Fixed IPs, DNS-friendly * Dead simple config+use

The beauty of @Tailscale is that they enable people to make their own personal internet, for free in most cases. It’s this weird paradigm shift, since you have to actively work to make applications insecure rather than the other way around.

If you deal with servers in any way drop everything and get this. VPN nirvana. @Tailscale https://tailscale.com

name: Lumius
brief:
Product: Lumius
One-liner: Fast, smart, accessible 3D ultrasound that anyone can use
Description: Ultrasound today is still mostly 2D. Clinicians have to imagine the 3D anatomy in their head while also moving the probe at the same time. This makes procedures like vascular access hard to learn and perform consistently, especially for beginners. ~50% fail on their first attempt. Hospitals also spend millions each year on 2D ultrasound training. Meanwhile, existing 3D ultrasound devices can cost >10× as much.
Industry: Healthcare / Medical Devices
target:
Make ultrasound ubiquitous.

We are a startup pushing the boundaries of ultrasound in both clinical care and everyday health.

Two directions, One goal

Accessible 3D Ultrasound

Fast, smart, acessible 3D ultrasound - a 3D camera for the body.

Wearable Ultrasound

The most accessible way to look deep into the body, currently in development.

The Future of Ultrasound is 3D

A fast, smart, accessible 3D ultrasound, assisted by AI and mixed-reality. Start with intuitive vascular access guidance.

True 4D

Real-time 3D ultrasound with wide FOV (4×4×4 cm).

Intuitive

No more guesswork and probe-coordinating struggle from 2D images.

Affordable

Costs 10 times less than a traditional matrix-array 3D probe.

The Future of Ultrasound is Wearable

Wearable ultrasound that anyone can use. A new way to look deep into the body.

Coming soon...

Why ultrasound

The most accessible window into the body.

Ultrasound is fast, safe, and portable by nature. We believe it should be a routine interface with our health, both in clinical settings and in daily life.

Partners & supporters

Research, clinical, and venture communities helping us move ultrasound forward.

A first look at Lumius

See Lumius’ 3D ultrasound in action

name: ARC Prize Foundation
brief:
Product: ARC Prize Foundation
One-liner: AI benchmarks that measure general intelligence and inspire new ideas
Description: ARC Prize builds AI benchmarks that measure general intelligence. Our benchmark, ARC-AGI, has been used by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and xAI. Founded by Mike Knoop and Francois Chollet, we inspire open source artificial general intelligence (AGI) research through benchmarks (the ARC-AGI series), global competitions, research grants, community, and content, we exist to guide researchers, industry, and regulators on the path to AGI.
Industry: Industrials
target:
The North Star for AGI

ARC Prize Foundation is a nonprofit advancing open-source artificial general intelligence research through benchmarks & prizes.

Enter ARC Prize 2026 Now $2,000,000 in prizes!

Top AI Leaders and Partners

ARC Prize is a provider of AI benchmarks to NIST’s Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI)

Low-Noise, High-Signal AGI Benchmarks

We build scientifically grounded benchmarks that reveal the gap between what's easy for humans, hard for AI.

ARC-AGI has repeatedly identified key inflection points in AI progress, including the emergence of reasoning systems and the rise of capable AI agents.

New ideas still needed for AGI.

While AI has made tremendous progress, ARC-AGI shows us scaling alone will not reach AGI.

Our mission is simple: guide research, accelerate progress, and ensure the path to AGI remains open and accessible to all.

We define AGI as a system that can match the learning efficiency of humans.

Introducing ARC-AGI-3. The world's only unbeaten benchmark that measures agentic intelligence.

ARC-AGI Benchmark Series

Trusted by the world's leading AI labs and top academic researchers, explore the only benchmark that measures fluid intelligence. It's easy for humans, hard for AI.

Big ideas. Big money.

Get rewarded for open sourcing novel progress. In partnership with Kaggle, over $2M is up for grabs.

Founder Message

“AGI is the most important technology humanity will create, and we believe it is achievable in our lifetime. But ARC shows us we still need new ideas. Maybe they'll come from you?”

Mike Knoop (Zapier, Ndea ) & François Chollet (Keras, Ndea, ARC-AGI)

name: CodeNow
brief:
Product: CodeNow
One-liner: Our mission is to diversify the talent pipeline of students who…
Description: CodeNow is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit transforming high school students into coders, designers, and product managers. By helping students unlock their intrinsic motivations, they are learning to solve meaningful problems in their communities with software.
Industry: Unspecified
Tags: Education
target:
Every governance model you run assumes humans are the slowest actor. That assumption is already wrong.

The slowest actor in modern delivery is no longer the engineer — it is the governance process that was designed around them. AI agents are non-human team members — generating, testing, and shipping code across services, environments, and teams at machine speed. Without governed execution, that velocity produces drift, inconsistency, and loss of control — silently. CodeNOW® is the governed execution layer — the control plane that determines how software moves through your SDLC, regardless of who or what wrote it.

Non-human team members now ship code at machine speed. Your governance model was built for the slowest actor in the room. That actor has changed.

The gap between execution speed and governance speed is where failure compounds — configuration drift, ungoverned deployments, accountability gaps that surface as incidents, not warnings.

This is what breaks — in delivery, in operations, and in risk — when execution outpaces governance. And what becomes possible when governance is structural.

Delivery scales. Risk doesn't have to.

The delivery surface is expanding at machine speed. Governance models built for human-speed execution cannot absorb the difference. The gap produces cost, risk, and unpredictability — proportional to the speed of adoption.

In CodeNOW, delivery speed and operational control are the same architecture. Not a tradeoff. A structural property.

Autonomy inside boundaries. Not freedom inside chaos.

Platform teams define the organizational physics — the laws under which all actors, human and non-human, are permitted to operate. Those laws are self-enforcing. No approval queues. No policing. No ticket machines.

Delivery teams and AI agents move independently within those boundaries — building, releasing, and iterating at their own speed. Every action is constrained by the same structural laws, defined once, applied universally.

Authority without friction. Standards without bottlenecks. Ownership without constant intervention.

Control that doesn't create queues.

Every action — human or machine — is logged, attributable, and immutable. Audit evidence is produced structurally, not reconstructed before a review. Policy enforcement happens at execution time, not after.

One governance model. One audit surface. No separate control plane for non-human actors. No ungoverned execution paths.

Governance that shrinks the risk surface — without constraining the delivery surface. Cloud, on-prem, hybrid, air-gapped.

name: Typewise
brief:
Product: Typewise
One-liner: Customer service AI that resolves requests end-to-end.
Description: Typewise resolves customer service requests end-to-end. Someone sends a request; it reads the message, looks up the real order or account in your own systems, takes the action, and replies. Anything it shouldn't touch goes to a human. It works across email, chat, WhatsApp and social, and is MCP-native. Until now, that took a proper setup project, which is why it was mostly larger companies using it. Nova does the setup for you.
Industry: B2B / Productivity
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B, Productivity, API
target:
First class customer experience. experience . Zero busywork.

Our Nova launch gift: 1,000 resolutions and 3 months on us.

Effortless, self-improving, in control.

No credit card. First agent live in 15 minutes.

End-to-end resolution without losing control.

Boost customer satisfaction and reduce costs with next-gen AI you can trust.

It resolves.

Looks up the order, applies your policy, closes the ticket.

You decide.

Your rules. Every action logged. Pause anytime.

It learns.

Quality is watched, fixes are proposed, and nothing ships untested.

AI agents, human agents, one workspace.

A supervisor routes each request to the right specialist. It works across your systems, brings in a person when it matters, and picks the ticket back up.

Meet customers where they already are.

Customers can start anywhere, switch channels freely, and keep context end to end.

A resolution engine, not another chatbot.

What best describes you?

Set it up by talking to Nova.

Nova is your AI operator. Describe what you want in plain language, and Nova builds it, tests it, and takes it live in about 15 minutes. No flowcharts, no code, no waiting on IT.

Real teams. Real numbers.

Questions, answered.

What is Typewise?

Typewise is an AI customer experience platform. Businesses use it to run AI agents that resolve customer service requests end to end across email, chat, WhatsApp and social, set up and improved in plain language, with no code.

Is Typewise a chatbot?

No. Typewise is a resolution engine, not a chatbot. It completes the whole request — looking up the order, applying your policy, closing the ticket — and hands anything needing judgment to a person with full context. Chatbots mostly deflect; Typewise is measured on resolution.

Isn’t Typewise a keyboard app?

Not any more. Typewise started in 2019 as a consumer keyboard app, but that chapter closed in 2022 when the company joined Y Combinator and moved to business software. Today it is solely an AI customer experience platform for businesses.

How does Typewise pricing work?

Pricing is success based: a monthly plan plus a per-resolution rate that drops as your volume grows. A fully resolved request counts once, a partial hand-off counts half, and unresolved requests are free. See the pricing page for current figures.

Is there a free trial?

brief:
Product: Red Barn Robotics
One-liner: A Roomba for weeds on a farm.
Description: We are building an autonomous robot to precisely eliminate weeds and leave crops untouched. Despite $100 billion being spent annually on weed control, weeds still cost the US economy $46B/year. Weeds steal sunlight and nutrients from crops, forcing farmers to choose between higher costs and lower yields. Moreover, many farms still rely on hand labor to control weed growth.
Industry: Industrials / Agriculture
target:
Weeding Made Easy

Red Barn Robotics provides autonomous intra-row weeding services to help farmers increase yields and reduce their labor costs

Meet the Field Hand

The reliable, tireless worker your farm has been waiting for. Our autonomous weeding robot is built to keep your fields weed-free and is ready to start working on your farm.

Eliminates intra-row weeds typically reserved for hand weeding crews with no human intervention

Navigates under its own power and does not require any additional equipment or guidance to navigate between fields

A modular design allows us to choose the tools that best fits the unique constraints of your farm

A lightweight design prevents compaction while mechanical cultivation preserves soil health

Our Weeding Service

Schedule a Consultation

Schedule a time for you to tell us about your farm, crops, and weeding needs so we can assess how to help

Get a Custom Weeding Plan

We map your fields and create a tailored weeding schedule based on your crop type, bed configuration and growth cycle

We Handle the Operations

Our robots arrive at your farm and get to work removing weeds according to your custom weeding plan

Stay Weed-Free All Season

With regular service throughout the growing season, we keep your fields weed-free—no extra labor or equipment required.

Tired of hand weeding?

Labor shortages and rising costs are making hand weeding more expensive than ever. At Red Barn Robotics, we’re changing the game with our autonomous weeding robot—built to eliminate weeds efficiently, reliably, and at a lower cost than manual labor.

full transparency when it comes to our practices

We take great pride in our sustainable farming practices. By using natural methods of pest control, crop rotation, and organic fertilizers, we ensure that our produce is not only safe to eat but also rich in flavor and nutrients. Our commitment to sustainability extends beyond our fields; we strive to reduce waste, and protect the local ecosystem.

Products

Our mission is simple: to bring the freshest, most nutritious produce directly from our fields to your table. Our relationship with our customers goes beyond the transaction.

building relationships based on trust, integrity.

name: IMPACT Drones
brief:
Product: IMPACT Drones
One-liner: Air Defense as a Service for Civilian Infrastructure.
Description: IMPACT builds autonomous interceptor drones that ship in sealed containers. The box sits at the site it protects, data centers, power grids, airports, bases, with no crew on the pad. When sensors cue a hostile drone, an interceptor pierces its own frangible lid, launches, and rams the target, guided by onboard vision that keeps working when GPS is jammed.
Industry: Industrials / Defense
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Hardware, Drones, Swarm Robotics
target:
ADaaS . Air Defense as a Service

Small airports.

The math of air defense is broken

Hostile drones are cheap, fast, and everywhere. Legacy air defense was never built for this: million-dollar effectors against low-cost threats, one shot against many. Defending the sky now demands an answer that scales.

1x legacy effector $1,000,000+

x20 hostile uas <$50,000 each

There are 125,000 sites to protect worldwide.

Use the left and right arrow keys to rotate the globe. Hover or tap a marker for details, or browse the full incident list below.

Drones detonate at presidential event in Caracas

Avenida Bolivar, Caracas · Venezuela

Two explosive-laden drones detonated near Maduro during a Caracas parade, injuring seven soldiers and halting the event.

Airport shut 33 hours by drone sightings

Gatwick Airport · United Kingdom

About 1,000 flights cancelled or diverted and 140,000 passengers hit over 33 hours. No one was ever charged.

Departures halted after drone sighting

Heathrow Airport · United Kingdom

Takeoffs stopped about an hour as a precaution weeks after Gatwick; police opened a full criminal investigation.

Drone sightings halt flights at Newark

Newark Liberty Airport · United States

Drone spotted 3,500 ft over nearby Teterboro halted Newark takeoffs and held arrivals; one pilot reported a 30 ft near miss.

Drone halts Germany's busiest airport

Frankfurt Airport · Germany

Operations suspended about an hour; 143 flights cancelled and 48 aircraft diverted after pilots reported a 1.5 m drone.

East-West pipeline, Afif · Saudi Arabia

brief:
Product: The Forecasting Company
One-liner: Foundation models for time series
Description: The Forecasting Company builds planning systems based on our in-house foundation models for time series.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B, Supply Chain, Enterprise Software, AI
target:
Timing is at the heart of right action.

We’re a research lab building systems that understand time. Starting with forecasting: one model to predict all the futures.

“There is timing in everything.” Miyamoto Musashi — The Book of Five Rings

The input

It starts with what already happened.

Hours or quarters, grid load, prices or demand for SKUs — the model reads raw history and the state of the world around it. You describe your data once; the API does the reshaping. No feature engineering, no fine-tuning.

The output

And returns what happens next.

Get your first forecast in seconds — a calibrated distribution you can plan against, from t0-alpha .

Join people at Engie, Netflix, Shake Shack, MIT and OpenAI playing with t0-alpha.

The check

See it for yourself.

Drag the forecast start back in time. t0-alpha only sees what came before — the dotted line is what actually happened. And at up to 200,000 forecasts a second , a backtest covers every series you have — not a sample.

Use cases

Wherever the future has a shape.

One model, unchanged, everywhere — no per-domain training, no per-customer variant. Play with each of these, or your own data, in Retrocast™ .

Hourly grid load. Two weeks of context, forecast 48 hours ahead.

Latest from us.

A foundation model in your browser

Describe your data, don’t reshape it

From ARIMA to Foundation Models

Made with ♥ in Paris

name: Metaplane
brief:
Product: Metaplane
One-liner: Data observability for modern data teams
Description: Metaplane ensures everyone trusts the data that powers your business. Data teams at Bose, Ramp, and Klaviyo use our data observability platform to prevent and detect data issues — before the CEO pings them about weird revenue numbers. We do this with ML-based anomaly detection, end-to-end column-level lineage, and tools to help prevent incidents before they occur. You can monitor your entire data stack within 30 minutes.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, SaaS, Data Engineering
target:
Be the first to know about data incidents

Metaplane is an end-to-end data observability platform that catches silent data quality issues before they impact your business.

Explore the platform

Monitor data quality from source to BI

Quickly add and configure monitors without writing code, monitor by different dimensions within a table, all with the most accurate modeling available.

End-to-end column-level lineage

Get the full picture of your data stack, from sources to BI tools and everything in between—no manual setup required.

Data insights

Find and optimize how your data is being used, by whom, where, and how frequently so you can reduce data debt and prioritize only the most useful queries.

Data CI/CD

Prevent data quality issues in PRs when merging pull requests by running automated regression and impact tests.

Automated alerts

Targeted notifications that give you the context to resolve issues quickly and productively.

Get the full picture of your data stack, from sources to BI tools and everything in between--with no manual setup required.

Catch data issues that other tools miss

Account for seasonality and trends

Machine learning accounts for seasonality and trends—something custom tests are too rigid to do.

Fast setup and training

Other data observability tools take weeks to set up. We’ll have you set up in 15 minutes, and you’ll see alerts in as soon as 3 days.

A smarter approach to monitoring

Suggested monitors

Leverage Suggested Monitors to monitor only the tables that are important.

Merge confidently with Data CI/CD

See downstream impact before making changes

Forecast which downstream tables and dashboards will be affected by your code changes.

Understand how objects are impacted

Compare data changes between production and your PR branch to catch regressions.

Works with dbt Core and Cloud

We support CI/CD with both GitHub and GitLab, along with dbt Core and Cloud workflows.

Pricing for teams of all sizes

Pay for what you use

Other data observability tools make you monitor every table in your warehouse, driving up costs. With Metaplane, you only monitor (and pay) for what you need.

Pricing that scales with you

Metaplane pricing scales up and down with usage. Plus, you can pick and choose which add-ons you need and which you don’t.

Enterprise ready

We happily provide annual contracts to save you money.

Built for enterprise scale and security

Enterprise-grade security

target:
A custom AI operating system for your business.

Soren builds each company its own AI operating system — the platform, the tools, and the agents that run day-to-day operations.

Supported by a team from

Every company runs on operations no off-the-shelf software was built for. Soren builds the operating system that runs yours.

Financial Operations

Soren runs billing, collections, budgeting, invoice review, and financial reporting so the business has a live view of revenue and spend.

People Operations

Soren coordinates recruiting, onboarding, performance reviews, policy workflows, and employee requests so people processes move forward consistently.

Client & Project Operations

Soren handles intake, onboarding, document routing, status updates, and follow-up so every engagement starts clean and keeps moving.

Process Improvement

What the system runs

One system across the whole operation.

Start with one workflow or connect the full operating cycle. Soren’s platform and agents work across the tools and policies your company already relies on.

Intake & routing

Capture requests from email, forms, and chat, identify the type of work, collect missing details, run initial checks, and route each one to the right owner without manual handoffs.

Built for companies that have outgrown spreadsheets, ticket queues, and generic SaaS, but do not want to stand up an internal software team to fix it. Soren builds the system, runs it alongside you, and keeps extending it as the business changes.

What drives us

Every company is held together by work no one bought software for.

Description: Casey is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage. Our insurance brokers focus on client relationships and closing business, whilst our AI handles all the operational work behind the scenes.
Industry: Fintech / Insurance
target:
Business insurance that has your back.

How Casey works.

Tell us what you do

One conversation, in plain English. A specialist takes time to learn about your business, tell you what coverage you need, and build the application for you.

We shop the market

We compare more than 100 insurance companies and get quotes from the ones that fit your business best. No gaps, nothing you don't need.

Matched at the best rate

Compare real quotes side by side and bind the one you want. From then on we handle certificates, claims, and every renewal.

What our customers say.

Industries we serve.

Trucking

Auto Liability, Motor Truck Cargo, Physical Damage — priced by carriers that want OTR business.

Contractors

The risks other brokers surcharge, we place every week.

Restaurants & bars

Property, liquor liability, and workers' comp shopped together.

Lawn care

General liability, equipment, and commercial auto for crews in the field.

And many more

Tell us what you do — we'll take it from there.

Risks we cover.

General Liability

Slips, falls, property damage — and the certificate your landlord asks for.

Commercial Property

Buildings, equipment, and inventory, at what it costs to replace them.

Commercial Auto

One work truck or a full fleet, with limits your contracts accept.

Workers' Comp

Employee injuries, payroll-based, required in most states once you hire.

Liquor Liability

Required almost everywhere alcohol is poured, sold, or served.

Motor Truck Cargo

The load you're hauling, covered from pickup to delivery.

Garage Liability

For anyone who services, stores, sells, or moves customer vehicles.

These are the most common — not the full list. Not sure what you need? That's the point of the first conversation. Ask us →

Why Casey is different.

Casey is an independent insurance agency, which means we work for you, not an insurance company. We compare coverage and rates from more than 100 carriers to find the right fit for your business. Our technology takes care of the busywork, so quotes, certificates, and policy changes happen faster and your dedicated agent has more time to focus on you.

Claims advocacy

When something goes wrong, your broker works the claim on your side — not the carrier's.

Re-shopped every renewal

Most renewals are defensive. Ours aren't — we work the market ahead of time so the best terms find you every year, automatically.

Certificates, instantly

Self-serve COIs the moment a job site or landlord asks. No calling, no waiting, no office hours.

Answers before you start.

Price History

The same questions for every collector, every day.

name: Arroyo
brief:
Product: Arroyo
One-liner: Cloud-native stream processing
Description: Arroyo is a serverless stream processing platform built on top of the open-source Arroyo streaming engine. We allow companies to transform, filter, aggregate, and join their Kafka streams in real-time just by writing SQL. We charge purely based on usage, with no fixed costs or clusters to manage. In 2025, Arroyo was acquired by Cloudflare and now powers Cloudflare Pipelines
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Developer Tools, SaaS, Open Source, Cloud Computing
target:
cloud-native stream processing

Trusted by teams from

Built by streaming experts from

Get started

Arroyo ships as a single, compact binary. Run locally on MacOS or Linux for development, deploy to production with Docker or Kubernetes.

Arroyo is a new kind of stream processing engine, built from the ground up to make real‑time easier than batch.

Analytical SQL

that just works

Designed for the

modern cloud

Scales easily

to any workload

Analytical SQL that just works

Arroyo was designed from the start so that anyone with SQL experience can build reliable, efficient, and correct streaming pipelines.

Data scientists and engineers can build end-to-end real-time applications... without a separate team of streaming experts.

Designed for the modern cloud

Your streaming pipelines shouldn't page someone just because Kubernetes decided to reschedule your pods. Arroyo is built to run in modern, elastic cloud environments, from simple container runtimes like Fargate to large, distributed deployments on Kubernetes.

In short: Arroyo is a stateful stream processing engine that behaves like a stateless one.

Scales easily to any workload

Arroyo is for everyone who needs to process data in real-time. Small use-cases can run with just a few MBs of RAM and a fractional vCPU.

For larger streams, Arroyo can rescale vertically and horizontally to process tens of millions of events per seconds while maintaining exactly-once semantics.

Incredible performance

Arroyo is fast. Really really fast. Written in Rust, a high-performance systems language, and built around the Arrow in-memory analytics format, its performance exceeds similar systems like Apache Flink by 5x or more.

Features

Time windows

Process data using sliding, tumbling, and session windows with watermark processing to determine when all data for a window has arrived.

Joins

Arroyo SQL covers a full set of streaming joins, including left, outer, inner, and full, which can be windowed or operate over updating data.

SQL Functions

Arroyo ships with over 300 SQL window, aggregate, and scalar functions, covering math, arrays, regex, json, and more.

Exactly-once

Exactly-once processing means no duplicated or dropped events, even with out-of-order data and machine failures.

Formats

Arroyo can natively read and write JSON, Avro, Parquet, and raw text and binary. Custom formats can be implemented with UDFs.

UDFs

Extend the built-in SQL by writing Rust user-defined scalar, aggregate, and async functions, with Python coming soon.

Web UI

Manage connections, develop and test SQL queries, and monitor pipelines from the powerful Arroyo Web UI.

REST API

Pipelines can be created, operated, and managed with the REST API, offering declarative orchestration at scale.

name: Outerport
brief:
Product: Outerport
One-liner: EDA for Industrial Control Systems
Description: Building out new LNG plants, HVAC systems, or semiconductor processes rely on hundreds of iterations of feasibility testing (through simulation or real-world lab tests) where different designs (combinations of equipment) and parameters are validated. The parameters are often locked in PDFs (datasheets, wiring diagrams, PFDs/P&IDs) which take thousands of hours to convert into CSVs / JSONs, and the simulators don't have an easy API to work with.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Hardware, Manufacturing, Semiconductors, Industrial
target:
Electrical and control systems, built as code.

Outerport / AI agents for electrical and control design

Outerport’s agents turn specifications and existing drawings into structured electrical designs. CAD drawings, BOMs, and engineering calculations come from the same model, and the control logic runs in simulation.

Outerport Studio

Design the control panel for a drainage pit: duty and standby pumps, automatic level control, high-water alarm.

Panel set compiled

4 sheets · 0 open checks

Trusted by the companies that build the world’s machines

The design is the source. The drawing is an output.

Outerport builds the components, connections, ratings, and control logic as one structured design. The drawing set, BOM, engineering calculations, and simulation all use that design.

Structured design for control panels and P&IDs.

Start with components, connections, ratings, and logic. Produce the drawing set from that model.

Electrical & control panels

Outerport selects and sizes components from the load list, lays out the panel, and produces single-lines, main and control circuits, terminal tables, and the BOM.

Piping & instrumentation

Outerport assembles P&IDs and line lists as connected process systems, then checks continuity, tags, and instrumentation coverage.

From specification to a checked drawing set.

Build the design model from the spec

Give the agent a requirements document, datasheet, or written instruction. It selects the components, sizes them against the loads, and assigns the connections and wire labels.

Generate the drawing set and BOM

The model produces CAD drawings and a bill of materials in your company’s drafting conventions, ready for an engineer to review.

Test the control logic

The simulator executes the control circuit. Design checks test continuity, sizing, and interlocks again after each revision.

Smart CAD promised this a decade ago. It stalled on the ramp.

Rule-based configurators only produce a drawing after your senior engineers spend months encoding a macro library, and only pay off on designs you repeat. Custom-order work never clears that bar, so the tools sit unused and the drawings stay manual.

Outerport’s agents extract reusable patterns from past work and apply them to each new specification. Engineers describe the requirements and review the resulting design.

Reuse approved circuits from past projects.

Panel schematics, single-lines, and P&IDs are parsed into components, connections, ratings, and tags.

The resulting library contains the interlock circuits and breaker selections your team already trusts. Reuse them in Outerport or export them to your existing electrical CAD, with ratings recalculated for the new loads.

name: Agentic Fabriq
brief:
Product: Agentic Fabriq
One-liner: The control plane for AI agents.
Description: Agentic Fabriq helps companies securely manage what AI agents can access and do across business tools, data, and teams. We give each agent an identity, scoped permissions, approval flows, and audit logs, so employees and customer-facing workflows can use agents without relying on shared API keys, overbroad service accounts, or one-off integrations.
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B, Identity, Cybersecurity
target:
Agent identity, governed & secure.

The secure hub for agent identity, governance, and visibility. Control what your agents can access and do — for every user.

Where will your agent run?

Same hub, same controls — where it runs decides whose accounts it reaches.

Inside your company

Agents that act on behalf of your employees. Each person connects their own accounts, and the agent gets only what that person is allowed — every call logged.

Inside your product

Developer · self-serve

Agents that act on your customers' accounts. Each customer connects their own, and their credentials stay vaulted — your product never holds a token.

AI agents are starting to do powerful things

But your current tools can't handle this

The existing identity infrastructure was never designed for autonomous, non-human actors.

Every agent implementation reinvents the wheel. Teams waste months building proprietary authentication systems instead of shipping agent capabilities.

Without a unified identity layer, agents are treated as service accounts or raw tokens. You can't distinguish between different agents, their roles, or their permissions.

Agent actions are invisible. Security can't audit what agents accessed, who they acted on behalf of, or what went wrong when something breaks.

Impersonation logic is scattered across codebases. Teams can't reliably grant agents user-scoped permissions without major refactoring.

API keys, OAuth tokens, and secrets live in env files, vaults, and databases. Rotating them, revoking access, or tracing usage is a nightmare.

These aren't edge cases. They're blocking every AI-first company from moving fast.

Agents need their own control layer

Instead of agents directly connecting to every system, they route through Agentic Fabriq. We handle the auth, credentials, and governance.

One connection to hook up all your agent tools and data.

Define what agents can do — per agent and per user.

See every action, every user, every agent in real-time.

Every action checked against policy.

Fabriq evaluates each request — which agent, acting for which user, against which resource — and allows or blocks it in real time. No agent gets blanket access.

Connects with the tools your agents already use

Everything your agents need to run safely.

One platform. Every capability you need for secure, governed, observable AI agent deployments.

Agent & User Identity Management

Create and manage unique identities for every AI agent in your stack. Agents act on behalf of specific users while constrained to their permissions.

Fine-Grained Authorization & Policies

Built for hardware work

Adam has built-in skills that make it an expert in CAD, research, sourcing, and engineering documentation.

Prepare a design review

Pull the latest build notes, open issues, and CAD screenshots into a design review brief for tomorrow.

Compare supplier options

Find three suppliers for this anodized aluminum enclosure and compare cost drivers, lead times, and risks.

Review this BOM, fill missing manufacturer part numbers, flag long-lead items, and prepare it for sourcing.

Request supplier quotes

2 dims revised · 3 affected items

Message Adam from wherever you already work: Slack or email. “Thicken the sinking boss,” “build the v3 BOM,” “detail the baseplate drawing.” Adam does the work.

Model edit · Boss draft fix

Branch ready · 2 features changed

Get the finished work

Adam hands back the real output: a branched model edit, a reconciled BOM, an updated drawing, a render set, each linked to its source, ready to ship or adjust.

Works with your stack

Adam connects to the CAD, PLM, suppliers, and tools your hardware team already runs on. No migration, no exported copies of your IP.

Geometry, BOMs, sourcing, renders, docs, vendors. Adam does the recurring work across your CAD and your stack, and hands back the finished output, from model to BOM to drawing to render.

name: Voker
brief:
Product: Voker
One-liner: The Agent Analytics Platform
Description: Voker is the Agent Analytics Platform for monitoring and improving your AI agents. Companies like Dutch.com use our SDK to build better agents. Alex and Tyler met at a high-growth E-Commerce startup where Tyler was running Technology & Data. Together, they built AI products that bootstrapped the company profitably to $100MM in Revenue.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, Generative AI, Analytics, Big Data, AI
target:
Make sure your AI agents are helping, not just responding.

Install via AI

Voker is analytics for the agentic era, so you can build the best agents possible.

Do you really know what your agents are saying to your users?

Scanning traces doesn't tell you if agents are helpful, accurate, or hitting walls. You only find out when customers complain or attrition skyrockets.

Every stakeholder needs data. Every request pulls engineers away from building. Nobody can self-serve insights.

Product and business teams need to quantify AI investments. You have usage stats, but struggling to connect agent performance to conversion, retention, or revenue.

One platform. Complete visibility. Better Agents.

Voker transforms AI agent interactions into structured analytics that anyone on your team can use.

PMs, analysts, and business teams get digestible insights they need without tickets, bottlenecks, or delays.

Track what AI agents are saying, identify knowledge gaps, detect abnormalities, and measure improvement over time.

Connect agent metrics to outcomes that matter by correlating conversational data with user data you're already collecting.

Identify what your user wants. Voker automatically classifies user goals from natural conversation.

Detect when your user isn't getting what they want. Surface friction before it becomes churn.

Recognize when your agent solves a user's intent. Measure success rates across every interaction.

Made for teams building best-in-class agent products

Works with your stack. No vendor lock-in. Own your data.

Voker supports any LLM framework or model, with seamless integration for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini.

Get to insights with just a few lines of code

Lightweight integration. No infrastructure changes required. Start free and scale as you grow.

See Voker in action

Watch how teams use Voker to monitor and improve their agents.

Everything you need to understand your agents

Powerful features built for teams running high-volume conversational AI.

Trusted by product teams that require the best

“When customers flood our Slack with the same agent issue, we're scrambling with what's going on, how widespread, how bad? We gave up on building evals: it's an endless reactive battle you can't win. Voker shows us agent performance and emergent user behavior before it lands as a customer complaint.”

"Data drives all of our decisions at True Classic, but we didn’t have a way to track AI performance. Voker made it possible to monitor and optimize our AI features quickly."

Patients on dual bronchodilators and patients on triple therapy both remained candidates. Quinn outlined a prospective study to resolve the choice; a complete study design and new evidence were still needed.

FEV₁: air exhaled in the first second of a forced breath. CI: confidence interval.

name: Birch Biosciences
brief:
Product: Birch Biosciences
One-liner: We recycle plastic using engineered enzymes
Description: Birch Biosciences engineers enzymes for plastic recycling using synthetic biology and machine learning. Our enzymes function as high performance “molecular scissors” that efficiently break down plastic polymers into chemical building blocks that can be used to manufacture high quality recycled plastic products. Today, plastic manufacturing is unsustainable and a major driver of climate change.
Industry: Industrials / Climate
Tags: Machine Learning, Synthetic Biology, Biotech, Climate, ClimateTech
target:
We Are Revolutionizing Plastic Recycling

We are an AI native company developing engineered enzymes that act as ‘molecular scissors” to recycle plastic, enabling manufacture of economical, 100% recycled plastic products in a circular economy.

Birch Biosciences is developing novel plastic recycling technologies using generative AI and advanced enzyme engineering to bring plastics into the circular economy.

9% Of Plastic Is Recycled. We’re Fixing That.

The 9% US plastic recycling rate hasn’t improved in 15 years. Most recycled plastic is lower quality and higher cost than virgin plastic manufactured from fossil fuels. Today, manufacturing new plastic is responsible for 7% of global carbon emissions.

The Science Behind Enzymatic Recycling

We use generative AI and proprietary high-throughput screening techniques to redesign enzymes with transformational recycling properties. These high-performance enzymes are integrated into a proprietary recycling process that breaks down plastic polymers, enabling the production of 100% recycled content plastics. This eliminates the need for fossil fuels in plastic manufacturing.

High Quality

Low Emissions

Better Economics

Enzymatically recycled plastic matches the quality of new plastic manufactured from fossil fuels

Greenhouse gas emissions for plastic manufacturing are reduced >70%

Improved process economics enable competitive pricing of high quality enzymatically recycled plastic

Enzymatically recycled plastic Greenhouse gas emissions for plastic manufacturing are reduced >70%

Our Enzymatic Recycling Process

Bottles, clamshells, and polyester textiles are shredded to small particle sizes

Enzymes break down plastic polymers into chemical monomers by breaking chemical bonds

100% recycled plastic resin is used to manufacture high quality plastic products

Chemical monomers are repolymerized into 100% recycled plastic resin

Chemical Monomers are repolymerized into 100% recycled plastic resin

We believe that collaboration and community are key to driving meaningful innovation. We partner with businesses, government agencies, and universities to accelerate innovation and commercialization of recycling technologies.

brief:
Product: Formal
One-liner: Take control of your data in real-time.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Cybersecurity
target:
Least privilege, enforced at the wire-protocol level — on autopilot.

A programmable reverse proxy that parses 15+ wire protocols and enforces security policies inline — query-level, every identity, sub-10ms.

Deploy a single stateless binary in your VPC via Terraform, Kubernetes, or Docker. Point connection strings through Formal instead of directly to your datastores. Every identity — engineer, BI tool, CI/CD pipeline, AI agent — hits the proxy, where policies evaluate in real time. No app changes, no SDK.

See the full architecture →

One stateless binary in your VPC via Terraform, Kubernetes, or Docker. Most teams route first traffic in under an hour — Notion secured hundreds of datastores in days.

Use the no-code editor or write Rego policies. Set masking rules, access controls, and approval workflows. Test with dry-run before going live.

Every query, every protocol, evaluated in real time. Full visibility, automatic compliance, least privilege on autopilot.

Security as Code

API-first. Choose your IaC, pick your VPC, deploy a single distroless image to protect your entire stack.

Protocol-native

Not a network-layer firewall. Formal understands Postgres wire protocol, MySQL protocol, MongoDB wire protocol, and more — enabling query-level decisions.

Zero application changes

Point your connection string through Formal. No SDK, no agent, no code changes. Works with every ORM, driver, and client library.

Deployed in your VPC

Data never leaves your infrastructure. Single stateless binary in your cloud account. Zero exfiltration risk.

Sub-10ms p50 overhead

Single-digit milliseconds at p50. Compiled Go, stateless, with connection pooling and protocol optimization built in.

Ready to secure your AI, data and infra?
