name: Valence
brief:
Product: Valence
One-liner: Unified prediction markets trading platform
Description: Valence is a unified trading platform for prediction markets. We provide infrastructure to aggregate and execute contracts across Kalshi, Polymarket, and other platforms, surface arbitrage and mispricing opportunities in real time, and give systematic traders the API and backtesting tools they need to build and execute data-driven strategies on anything.
Industry: Fintech / Consumer Finance
target:
Seamless cross-venue trading

Trade across prediction markets from one place. Valence gives you the tools, speed, and infrastructure to win — no matter how you trade.

Your workspace, your way

A fully customizable terminal built for how you trade. Drag, resize, and arrange every panel — orderbooks, blotters, positions, charts — into the layout that fits your workflow. Monitor everything in real time.

Unified execution across every venue

Orders are automatically routed across Kalshi, Polymarket, and other liquidity sources. Quantities are sharded to achieve the best execution prices at each exchange.

Smart Routing

Orders are automatically routed across every exchange with intelligent quantity sharding — always getting you the best price available.

Lowest Latency

Colocated servers at exchange data centers. Direct connectivity for fast order execution and real-time market data.

Customizable Terminal

Drag, resize, and arrange every panel to build the workspace that fits your trading style. Save layouts and switch between them instantly.

Real-Time Monitoring

Live P&L, position tracking, order status, and market data streaming — monitor your entire portfolio across every exchange at a glance.

Market Intelligence

Consolidated orderbook visualization, spread analysis, and depth monitoring across all active instruments on every venue.

Risk Infrastructure

Exposure management, settlement tracking, and automated risk controls to keep you protected as you scale.

One interface for every major exchange

Trusted by traders

Volume-based fees

No monthly minimums. Pricing is tailored to your trading profile.

All plans include access to Kalshi and Polymarket. Contact us for a custom quote.

Start trading

Tell us about your trading and we'll get you set up. Priority access for high-volume traders.

name: Cranston AI
brief:
Product: Cranston AI
One-liner: AI Tax prep and accounting software for CPA firms
Description: Cranston is AI tax prep and bookkeeping for CPA firms. Our tax agents prepare returns the way a strong staff accountant would: they read the source documents, work the return in your tax software, and hand your reviewer a return that holds up, with workpapers attached. Our bookkeeping agents keep client books current all year, so tax season starts from clean numbers instead of cleanup. Prep and books are the start.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
target:
Tax prep and accounting software that runs itself

Cranston works with QuickBooks, Drake, CCH Axcess, and the rest of your stack. AI prepares the work. Your reviewers make the calls.

What Cranston does for your firm

It prepares the work inside the software you already use. Your team reviews and approves it.

Cranston prepares the tax return for you

It reads the client documents and enters the return in Drake, Lacerte, CCH Axcess, or UltraTax. Your preparer checks a finished draft instead of typing it in.

It catches missing and wrong documents

Cranston compares each document package against last year's return. It flags the missing 1099 or the wrong-year statement, then writes the client follow-up email. You approve it before it sends.

It does the monthly bookkeeping

Cranston classifies transactions, reconciles accounts, and drafts journal entries in your existing QuickBooks. Your reviewer gets a short list of exceptions to check.

Track every client's status on one board

See which returns await documents or review and which are complete. Cranston updates the board when a return changes stage.

AI prepares. Your reviewers make the calls.

Cranston prepares the work. Your reviewer must approve it before Cranston sends or files anything.

Start with a complete file

Cranston finds missing documents before prep starts. It drafts one client request for every missing item.

Your reviewer has the final say

AI drafts the work. Nothing posts, files, or reaches a client until your reviewer approves it.

Close the books faster

Cranston matches bank and credit card activity to QuickBooks, flags what doesn't line up, and drafts the fixes for your review.

All your work, working together

name: Savant
brief:
Product: Savant
One-liner: Company brain every AI-native enterprise runs on
Description: Savant is the company brain every AI-native enterprise runs on. We plug into the tools you already use, capture the written knowledge / undocumented procedures, and serve them to your employees and agents at decision time.
Industry: B2B / Productivity
target:
The Operational Memory Layer

Savant connects to the tools your team already uses and turns scattered company knowledge into structured, searchable operating context for people and AI.

Every company has two versions of itself.

One is documented. The other is how work actually gets done. Savant brings them together — consolidating what's written, capturing what isn't, and turning it all into a single operating layer.

Written down — and scattered.

Searchable across the tools your team already uses, but rarely complete.

Lived — and decisive.

Never recorded, but determines how work actually gets done.

For your team. For your AI.

Your operating knowledge, accessible to every teammate.

Eliminate the time teammates spend searching threads, repeating explanations, and reconciling context across multiple tools. Your organization's expertise becomes accessible, current, and reusable.

The context layer between company data and reliable automation.

AI agents can't operate a business from raw data alone. Savant gives them the policies, workflows, constraints, and judgment to act correctly inside your business.

Savant is not another…

Savant consolidates your scattered data and captures the operational context behind it — the procedures, decisions, dependencies, and edge cases that determine how work actually gets done.

Every company is about to become an AI company.

Not because every company will build foundation models — but because every business will need AI to move faster, serve customers better, and make better decisions.

But AI cannot operate a business from raw data alone. A company's most important knowledge is scattered across docs, Slack threads, emails, tickets, CRM notes, spreadsheets, and the judgment of the people doing the work. It lives in exceptions, handoffs, edge cases, and unwritten rules.

Humans can navigate that mess. AI cannot — not without operational context.

Every company will have to adopt AI. The winners will be the ones whose AI understands them.

Make your operating knowledge accessible to every teammate.

The procedures, decisions, exceptions, and judgment behind how work gets done shouldn't depend on which expert happens to be available. Savant surfaces your organization's expertise — current, reliable, and ready when teams need it.

Connects to the systems your work already lives in.

Nothing to migrate. No new place for people to live.

The same context layer, working for your AI.

name: Aviator
brief:
Product: Aviator
One-liner: Google-level engineering productivity suite
Description: Aviator is a developer tool that automates merge workflows and keeps builds healthy. Engineers save up to 5 hours a week and avoid frustration of broken builds. Our users include Slack, Square, Benchling, Figma, Doordash and many others. Our goal is to become the leading brand for developer experience.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, SaaS, B2B
target:
AI made code easier to write, not easier to ship.

Ship AI-generated code at velocity you trust. Shared context, faster reviews, deterministic verification, and merge-to-deploy automation built for the volume AI creates.

From startups to Fortune 500s, the world's most effective engineering teams ship with Aviator.

Review

Stay on top of reviews. Verify before you merge.

AI writes code faster than humans can review it. Aviator gets the right PRs to the right reviewers — and proves the code does what was asked.

A smarter PR queue, auto-grouped by what to do next.

Route PRs to the right reviewers based on expertise and load.

Deterministic verification against acceptance criteria with audit trail.

Ship

Merge fast. Deploy without the war room.

Keep main green at any PR volume. Move code to production with guardrails, not paging.

Parallel queues, intelligent batching, and fault tolerance for flaky tests. Built for monorepos merging 1,000+ PRs a day.

Deployments, cherry-picks, and rollbacks in one dashboard. Tracks every PR across every environment.

Start free. Scale with your team.

Free tools for individual developers. Full platform for teams shipping at volume.

Free for developers

Track every PR that needs your attention, across repos and teams.

Open-source. Break large changes into reviewable chunks.

Aviator's PR workflows inline on github.com — no context switch.

Per-channel rules so PR pings stop drowning out everything else.

For engineering teams

Smart routing, SLOs, and team dashboards.

Deterministic pre-merge verification.

Keep main green at any volume.

Deployments, rollbacks, and cherry-picks in one dashboard.

Why Aviator

Built on engineering fundamentals.

Trunk-based development. Small PRs. Monorepos. Continuous deployment. The practices that worked before AI still work — we just make them scale to AI volume

CI/CD-agnostic.

Works with your existing toolchain. No lock-in.

On-prem and SOC 2 Type II.

Deploy in your cloud. Meet your compliance bar.

Dedicated CS and real-time Slack support.

You'll know the team.

At enterprise scale.

1,000+ teams, from 10-person startups to Fortune 500 monorepos.

Trusted by engineering teams everywhere

Aviator's merge queue finally fits how we ship in a monorepo: it supports stacked PRs and parallelizes queues by affected target instead of forcing everything through one serial bottleneck. As our AI tooling increased throughput, Aviator made merging fast and reliable again at our volume — we've cut time-to-merge for p50 of all PRs by 40%.

Erdem Alparslan

Head of Developer Experience , Notion

One-liner: The data layer for scientific research
Description: Labric is building the data layer that makes AI work for science. We capture messy lab data from instruments and tools, clean it, and connect it—so researchers can actually use AI to accelerate discovery.
Industry: B2B / Analytics
target:
Turn scattered lab data into structured insights

Labric automatically captures and structures your instrument data, giving researchers AI-ready datasets and decision-makers complete visibility.

Deploy in 1 week

Works across all disciplines

AI-powered insights

Designed for how labs actually operate

Automatic ingestion

Instrument data streams directly into your platform the moment it's generated. No manual exports or file transfers.

Context preserved

Every measurement automatically links to its sample, protocol, and experimental conditions. Knowledge stays intact when team members move on.

Team-wide visibility

Everyone works from a central source of truth. Cross-experiment analysis becomes simple with one, easy-to-use structured database.

How it works

From instruments to insights, automatically

Sync

Connect to all your lab instruments

Connect to your lab equipment, regardless of manufacturer or type. Data streams directly into your platform the moment it's generated, without manual exports or file transfers.

Structure

Data tailored to your lab’s workflows

Your data is automatically organized to match how you work, keeping relationships between samples, measurements, and protocols. Incoming data is validated at ingestion, catching errors immediately instead of months later.

Run

Workflows that trigger automatically

Pipelines execute when new data arrives or experiments are completed. Run analyses, build complex workflows with simple triggers, and access your structured data programmatically through our Python SDK.

Analyze

AI that understands your experiments

Ask questions in natural language and get answers directly backed by your data. Generate visualizations, build dashboards, or bring your own LLM. AI works because your data is structured and contextual.

20x

faster experimental cycle times vs. traditional solutions

One-liner: The cloud-native, operational database built for speed and scale.
Description: MemSQL is The No-Limits DatabaseTM, powering modern applications and analytical systems with a cloud-native, massively scalable architecture for maximum ingest and query performance at the highest concurrency. MemSQL envisions a world where every business can make decisions in real-time and every experience is optimized through data. Global enterprises use the MemSQL distributed database to easily ingest, process, analyze, and act on data in order to thrive in today’s insight-driven economy.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
target:
Answers Included.

AI starts with the database.

The answers your users and AI agents need are already in your data. Which makes the database the most important decision in your AI stack.

Feature Flags

Activity Store

Which customers are trying the new feature right now?

347 active users on Smart Search. Enterprise accounts are 62% of adoption, session time up 28%.

People ask. Agents act. Both need live answers.

People ask what’s happening.

AI agents make decisions.

Before AI can answer, it has to understand.

Aura Intelligence gives people and agents the context they need to reason over your business. Analyst lets users ask questions in plain English. The Context Engine teaches every user and every agent how your data fits together.

The answer’s ready. Ask the question.

You ask a question — not a query, but a question in plain English.

Meet Analyst, part of Aura Intelligence. Analyst receives your question, plans the query, then executes against your live database. Not a copy or a warehouse refreshed while you slept, but the data as it exists right now.

Spend fewer tokens. Get more answers.

The Context Engine gives agents a shared map of your data, reducing the queries and tokens they spend rediscovering schemas, relationships, and definitions at runtime. Paired with a database built for speed, that advantage compounds across thousands of agents and dependent tool calls.

Fast context makes AI faster — and less expensive to run.

AI success depends on choosing the right HTAP database.

SingleStore shipped it first.

One engine for operational and analytical data without copies.

One-liner: AI co-pilot for building plan review and building code compliance
Description: City building departments are understaffed and overworked. Meanwhile, builders lobby to remove power from building departments. Because building departments are usually the only profitable/self-sustaining branch of a local government, this is problematic. Permitify allows city build-plan reviewers to 10x their productivity covering the labor shortage, reducing the time required to issue a building permit, and allowing the city government's only profitable branch to stay intact.

Tags: Generative AI, GovTech, Computer Vision, Construction

Pangea is the AI notetaker that thinks in projects, not meetings.

For land developers, engineers & architects

It records your meetings — no bot in the call — reads the project email and files you connect, and keeps a living file for every job. Nobody types a thing, and nobody chases a status again.

Free for two weeks no credit card — nothing to cancel, ever live before your next meeting

Cedar Hollow — Phase 2

City wants the detention pond outlet moved before mylars

Framing passed inspection — drywall starts Thursday

Bighorn wants the updated pro forma by Friday

Works with Zoom Google Meet Microsoft Teams or a phone on the table for meetings that happen in person

How it works

Not another notetaker. Here's the difference.

Every notetaker you've tried stops at a transcript filed by date. Pangea starts by learning your projects — so the work files itself to the job it belongs to. Everything else follows from that.

It learns your projects

Connect your project folders — Drive, OneDrive, Egnyte, Box — and Pangea maps every job your firm has going.

It listens

Your meetings — with no bot in the call — and the project email you connect. Nobody takes notes, nobody files anything.

Projects update themselves

When a job comes up — in any meeting, any email — its file updates: minutes, tasks, deadlines, decisions, filed to the right project.

Why that matters

A meeting lasts an hour. A project lasts years.

Notes filed by date die in a feed. Notes filed by project become the project's memory — and every capture below feeds it.

Meetings, email, and files — one project file

“City wants the detention pond outlet moved before mylars.”

RE: Cedar Hollow — city fee schedule attached: park impact fees are $2,410 per unit.

C-301 Grading Plan r4.pdf added to Cedar Hollow / Civil.

And when one Monday call touches three jobs, its notes file into three project files — each with a receipt back to the moment someone said it.

Silent desktop app

Records with no bot in the call — no waiting-room guest, no attendee spam. It just starts.

Phone on the table

Record in-person meetings — site walks, city counters, conference rooms.

Notetaker bot — if you want one

Prefer a visible guest? Send the bot to Zoom, Meet, or Teams with one click.

Upload a recording

Any audio or video file — same notes, same automatic filing.

name: Releaf Earth
brief:
Product: Releaf Earth
One-liner: Turning food waste into Biochar to remove CO2 from the atmsophere
Description: Releaf Earth is a climate tech startup pioneering carbon removal and agricultural solutions leveraging biochar (BCR). Expanding from our roots in food processing technology, we now specialize in producing premium biochar from palm kernel shells. Biochar Carbon Removal (BCR) is a powerful tool for carbon sequestration and a key technology for economic development in Africa. African farmers already experience a 150% global mean temperature rise from a climate crisis they didn’t cause.
Industry: Industrials / Climate
Tags: Carbon Capture and Removal, Climate, Supply Chain, Agriculture
target:
Empowering Africa's Farmers, Restoring Earth's Climate

By merging sustainable farming with economic opportunity, we're building a future where African agriculture nourishes both communities and the planet.

We transform organic waste into valuable soil amendments, increasing farmer productivity

Releaf Earth is pioneering large-scale biochar production across Africa. Our biochar delivers a triple benefit: significant carbon sequestration, enhanced soil fertility, and increased economic opportunities for rural communities.

As Nigeria's first industrial biochar producer, Releaf Earth is leading the way. Our biochar delivers a triple impact: enriching soil fertility, permanently sequestering CO₂, and creating sustainable industries in rural Nigeria.

We are convinced that biochar carbon removal provides the fastest, most cost-effective path to large-scale carbon removal

Releaf’s Biochar Process

Releaf leverages its own proprietary tools and partners with leading biochar technologists to deliver verifiable, cost-efficient, and community impacting carbon removal.

Building a Greener, More Prosperous Future

Releaf's Roadmap

Metric Tons of CO₂e removed by 2030.

Metric Tons of waste biomass recycled annually.

Metric Tons of biochar produced annually.

Jobs created in the carbon removal industry.

Of all carbon removal jobs filled by women.

Production sites planned by 2030.

Targeted position as the world’s largest carbon removal company by 2030.

Increase in crop yields for rural smallholder farmers

Africa’s Strong Advantage

We are confident that Africa's unique combination of rich biomass, expansive land, and dynamic economies will establish it as the global leader in affordable biochar.

Abundant Raw Materials

Africa generates an impressive 1.4 billion tons of biomass annually, providing a sustainable and readily available feedstock for biochar production. This ensures a consistent and scalable supply chain for global carbon removal needs.

Affordable Labor

With labor costs 50-80% lower than in other regions, Africa offers a significant economic advantage in biochar production. This makes large-scale operations not only feasible but also highly cost-effective, driving greater accessibility to carbon solutions.

Self-Sufficient Infrastructure

Biochar production in Africa leverages a unique advantage: it generates its own energy during the manufacturing process. This eliminates the need for grid electricity, enabling decentralized operations even in remote areas, while reducing dependence on fossil fuels.

Africa’s Unique Carbon Removal Potential

Time is running out. To meet global climate goals, carbon removal must scale 14,000-fold, reaching 10 billion tons annually in the next 25 years.

Ready to Build a Sustainable Economy?

Connect with us to explore collaboration and investment opportunities.

target:
We’ll help you find a role that shapes the future

We help people find fulfilling careers that make a big positive impact. Our career guide, 1-1 advising, and other resources can help you:

Our resources are based on over 10 years of research, plus advising thousands of people 1-1 on their careers. We’re a nonprofit, and you can access all our advice for free.

We’re a nonprofit that helps people build careers that tackle the world’s most pressing problems.

Our new book pulls together 15+ years of research into a practical guide to finding a fulfilling career that does good. And our free online resources, 1-1 career advising, and high impact job board will help you put it into action.

If you’re worried about wasting your life, read this book.

author of Humankind

Our new career guide

We’ve released a new edition of our career guide with Penguin Random House, revised and updated for the age of AI.

It covers why “follow your passion” gets things backwards, why many ‘safe’ careers are among those most exposed to automation, and why the world’s most pressing problems are the ones almost nobody is working on.

It’s also full of practical tips and tools. You’ll come away with a plan to use your 80,000 hours in a way that’s rewarding and fulfils your potential to make a difference.

Every college grad should read this.

creator of Wait But Why

If you're worried about wasting your life, read this book.

If this had been published a decade earlier, it'd have saved me many restless nights.

It helps to focus on issues that are large in scale, tractable, and unduly neglected by the rest of society.

We help people find fulfilling careers that make a big positive impact. Our career guide, 1-1 advising, and other resources can help you:

Our resources are based on over 10 years of research, plus advising thousands of people 1-1 on their careers. We’re a nonprofit, and you can access all our advice for free.

We’re a nonprofit that helps people build careers that tackle the world’s most pressing problems.

Our new book pulls together 15+ years of research into a practical guide to finding a fulfilling career that does good. And our free online resources, 1-1 career advising, and high impact job board will help you put it into action.

If you’re worried about wasting your life, read this book.

author of Humankind

Our new career guide

We’ve released a new edition of our career guide with Penguin Random House, revised and updated for the age of AI.

It covers why “follow your passion” gets things backwards, why many ‘safe’ careers are among those most exposed to automation, and why the world’s most pressing problems are the ones almost nobody is working on.

It’s also full of practical tips and tools. You’ll come away with a plan to use your 80,000 hours in a way that’s rewarding and fulfils your potential to make a difference.

Every college grad should read this.

Description: Vaero's AI produces the most human sounding writing in the world. User's input their own writing, and Vaero automatically trains custom models to write exactly like the user. Vaero bolts on to any existing foundation model, such as GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 3.5, so you can always use the latest model in your writing style.

name: ClingNote — Notes that follow your work
brief:
Product: ClingNote — Notes that follow your work
Description: ClingNote is a local-first Windows notes app that keeps notes connected to the files, apps, and projects they belong to.
target:
Notes that follow your work.

Every file, app, and project can have its own note — and ClingNote brings it back when you return.

See it work in the apps you already use.

No new filing system to learn. Keep working in the apps you already use and let the note stay with the thing it belongs to.

The note changes when the work changes.

Your budget file can have one note. Your Power BI report can have another. Switch between them and ClingNote brings the relevant context forward.

Keep it small when you only need a thought.

A compact note can sit beside a contract, report, browser page, or document without turning your whole screen into a notes app. Open the full workspace only when you want more room.

Search the note, not your memory.

When you no longer remember which file, app, or notebook held the answer, search across note titles and full note content and jump straight back into the context.

Use the workspace when you want the whole picture.

General notes, attached notes, pinned items, archive, search, formatting, checklists, and multiple notes for the same context—without losing the lightweight side-note experience.

Notes that don't need a file.

Keep everyday writing, ideas, checklists, and reference notes in the same app.

Context when it matters.

Give a spreadsheet, report, PDF, browser page, or app the notes that belong specifically to it.

More than one “second page.”

Split risks, research, decisions, or follow-ups into separate notes without losing their shared context.

Not just scratch notes.

ClingNote gives you checklists, headings, bullets, links, highlights, and rich formatting so you can keep full working notes for spreadsheets, PDFs, reports, and project files.

Your notes don't need to become someone else's cloud.

ClingNote stores note content locally on your PC. It can reconnect notes to files, apps, and windows without uploading the contents of those documents.

Write for free. Add work context when you need it.

Free is a complete local notes app. Pro adds the context-aware layer that makes notes follow your work.

A local notes app you can keep.

Context superpowers.

Stop rebuilding context every time you reopen the work.

Download ClingNote for Windows. Free to start, no account required.

name: HEVN, inc
brief:
Product: HEVN, inc
One-liner: Cross-border payments for exporters of physical goods.
Description: HEVN is a B2B financial platform built for global commerce. We solve the last-mile problem in cross-border payments by working with licensed local payment service providers and settling transactions through domestic payment rails instead of relying on international bank transfers. HEVN helps importers and exporters move money between jurisdictions with fewer intermediaries and faster, more predictable settlement.
Industry: Fintech
target:
Fast and Reliable Payments for Global Commerce

Multiple payment rails with one KYB. Fewer intermediaries. Low FX fees. Fast settlement. Automated payment compliance and documentation.

Tell us what your business needs. We’ll show you how HEVN can help.

Manage multiple rails in one dashboard

See your account details, fiat and stablecoin balances, and payment history in HEVN.

Automate your payments and paperwork

HEVN provides bank confirmation letters, invoices, contracts, and infrastructure your CFO will love.

Preparing secure form...

Controlled business spend

Issue USD business cards, set limits, and track spending.

Create invoices

Generate invoices for your customers and suppliers, and send them via email or chat.

Accounts in your name

Run payments from accounts under your company name with SWIFT, ACH, SEPA, UAE FTS and more

Use with Claude or Codex

Connect HEVN to Codex or Claude to control your accounts, cards, balances, and statements with AI agents.

Move money globally

Move money between your accounts in different currencies and jurisdictions using hevn internal transfers .

Onboard all your entities

Share access with your legal and accounting teams, set spending limits, and control permissions for each user. Onboard your related and partner entities, manage them from one dashboard, and move money between them with HEVN internal payments.

Role-based access

Decide who can view, request, approve, and execute payments.

Multi Entity

Connect multiple entities to your account and switch between them with a single click.

Start with a question

Get a free consultation with our account manager, who will review your case and recommend the payment rails and banks that best suit your needs.

Questions before you move money

No. HEVN is not a bank.

HEVN is a B2B financial platform that works with licensed banks and EMIs across multiple jurisdictions. Through these partners, we provide named virtual bank accounts* and cross-border payments.

Book a call

Seamless international settlements in seconds using our global rail network.

Acting as an always-on operational brain, it coordinates across people and systems, improves every decision, and grows more capable with every task.

Tags: B2B, AI
target:
Applied AI for the physical world .

Redapto is the agentic AI platform for the critical operations behind manufacturing, logistics, energy, and defense.

AI leaves the demo when it can act in the real world.

Critical industries run on live operations, fragmented systems, and high-stakes decisions.

Redapto connects context, agents, and operators in one governed system.

This is Redapto.

The agentic operating platform for the physical world.

Build, deploy, and govern AI that understands real operations and acts with human oversight.

From live signal to trusted action.

Redapto OS brings agents into the systems your teams already use, turning operational context into coordinated action across sites, fleets, suppliers, and workflows.

See the whole operation

Signals from sensors, documents, systems, and teams—connected into one live operational model agents can reason over.

Coordinate every decision

Specialized agents plan and act across procurement, production, logistics, field service, and support without losing shared context.

Autonomy with accountability

Operators define policy, review exceptions, and stay in command while trusted workflows execute continuously at machine speed.

One AI platform for work that cannot stop. Built for the real world.

Redapto connects fragmented systems, unstructured data, and frontline decisions in one governed operating layer—without replacing the tools your teams already trust.

Governed operations AI

Deploy production agents with traceability, permissions, evaluations, and human control built into every decision—especially where safety, uptime, and compliance are non-negotiable.

Intelligence that leaves the screen and changes the real world.

We build AI infrastructure for critical industries—connecting software intelligence to the people, machines, and decisions that keep physical operations moving.

Physical by design

Redapto is built for live operations, where latency, exceptions, safety, and real-world consequences matter as much as model quality.

Context that compounds

Every workflow adds to a living operational model, helping agents reason with the same systems, policies, and edge cases your best teams understand.

Governed in production

Evaluate continuously, set clear permissions, keep operators in command, and move from prototype to dependable production outcomes in weeks.

Build intelligence for the real world.

brief:

One-liner: AI Accountant for Accounting Firms
Description: End-to-end accounting workflows executed by AI agents. - Invoice capture + upload to ERP/POS - Invoice payment + reconciliation - Tax filings - CFO insights on demand
Industry: B2B / Operations
Tags: FinOps, SaaS, AI
target:
The agentic engine for accounting

Agents that process invoices , reconcile , and keep you compliant.

Designed to run the finance function of every company, everywhere.

Trusted by 3.5k+ companies

In most companies, accounting still runs on manual data entry, the exact work an agent can now do.

Our agents are already impacting companies

The agents run the accounting workflows. Nothing here is a projection. It's what Cifrato does today.

The agent does the work. Your team keeps the judgment.

Cifrato reads, classifies, and reconciles, then hands you only what needs a human eye.

Pulls invoices straight from the tax authority and email automatically, as they arrive.

Classifies and posts each document against the right accounts, taxes, and cost centers.

Only the entries that genuinely need a human decision are surfaced for your review.

Posts the finished entries straight into the ERP your team already runs.

Turns the closed books into live reports and signals leadership can act on.

The engine built for the work.

Anyone can wrap a language model. Very few can run a country's accounting and be trusted with the books.

Legacy ERPs, connected

Mapped the connection path for every major accounting system. We write straight into the systems companies already run.

Teach it, then trust it

Nothing posts without human sign-off. Every entry is traceable to its source, audit-grade trust, not a black box.

Learns from what it sees

Every invoice booked makes the next one more accurate. The more we run, the harder we are to catch.

Built to be trusted with the data

Your data never trains public models. The engine learns patterns, never your books. Every entry traceable to its source.

Built for the businesses that carry the most manual load.

EMG - Asesorias contables

Esmeralda Ruiz

Grow your client base, not your team.

Firms doing manual bookkeeping for dozens of clients. The agent handles the volume; your staff handles the clients.

The AI accountant for every company

Data at the source

The information is already there, scattered. We pull it from the source and give it shape, structured and secure.

See the agentic engine run your accounting workflows

name: Candor
brief:
Product: Candor
One-liner: Protect your data and stop insider risk
Description: Candor is agentic data loss prevention (DLP) and insider risk management. Employees share sensitive data with third parties and email source code to personal inboxes every day. For fast-moving companies, protecting these crown jewels and customer trust is core to closing deals. Legacy DLP tools can cross off compliance checkboxes but flood security teams with false positives.
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: Cybersecurity, AI
target:
Stitch the story, stop insider risk. data loss. alert fatigue.

Candor replaces endless rules and alert triage with DLP that learns how your organization works, understands the person behind each action, and surfaces only the insider risks that matter — so your team finally sees the full story.

Legacy DLP doesn't solve the insider risk problem.

Static rules bury real threats in false positives.

Data movement shows the act, not the motive.

A lone event looks harmless — the risk is in the pattern.

The insider risk solution for modern enterprises.

The story, not the alert.

Candor's AI agents weigh the entire timeline of a user's activity and escalate only the cases that genuinely warrant attention, with the full context already assembled.

We don't rely on baselining or static detection rules to determine risk, allowing your team to stay on top of new threats.

Identify data movement that matters.

Write rules in plain English, and Candor evaluates it with full behavioral context. Instead of a flood of alerts, you surface the data movement that actually matters

Gain unprecedented visibility into critical data movements, without burdening your team.

Investigate in minutes.

Triage and verify in minutes, not days. Candor behavioral profiles stitch data sources into a single view to help quickly assess risk.

Context-aware AI serves as your investigation copilot and highlights relevant risky behaviors across sources.

Trusted by security leaders.

Common Questions

Candid Answers.

Let's solve insider threats together.

name: Pina Earth
brief:
Product: Pina Earth
One-liner: Unlocking carbon markets for European forest owners
Description: Pina Earth is building a suite of digital tools for data collection, monitoring, and certification of forest carbon projects. EU forests are at high risk due to climate change. With Pina Earth, forest owners can start high-quality carbon projects on their properties and use the new income stream to prepare their forests for a changing climate.
Industry: Industrials / Climate
Tags: Climate, ClimateTech
target:
Protecting the forest at our doorstep with carbon credits

Pina Earth offers high-quality carbon credits from local forests in Europe, including Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. For long-term stable, biodiverse, and climate-resilient ecosystems.

These companies trust us with their sustainability goals

Why do Europe's forests need our support?

Join us in shaping Climate Impact

Our technology as the foundation for high-quality carbon credits

Experiences of our customers

Over 100 renowned companies in Europe already trust our climate protection projects and see Pina Earth as a reliable partner for regional climate impact.

"Our voluntary climate contribution program is a central component of our commitment to sustainability. It underlines our responsibility as a company and contributes directly to the positive impact of our initiatives."

"Pina Earth enables us to achieve a high level of transparency regarding the effectiveness of our climate projects by creating digital twins and climate simulations, which we can view in visual dashboards."

"It is important to make positive changes visible on our own doorstep in order to generate enthusiasm for climate protection. The climate contribution with Pina Earth is a concrete measure that we are implementing together with our customers."

Insights into our projects

The Schlegel project will convert 471 hectares of pure spruce stands in Thuringia into a future-proof mixed forest over a project period of 30 years. Activities such as promoting natural regeneration and planting new species will make the forest more resilient to the effects of climate change, such as storms, drought, and beetle infestation.

A diverse, climate-resilient mixed forest is being created over 30 years on 1,277 hectares in the Dornbirn city project. Through natural regeneration, targeted reforestation and careful maintenance, suitable growing conditions are created so that young trees thrive and the forest remains robust in the long term.

In FSC- and PEFC-certified forest areas, pure pine stands are mixed with silver fir, sycamore maple, small-leaved lime, black locust, and beech, among others, so that they can better withstand dry summers and climate risks such as forest fires and pests in the future.

We protect and strengthen the forest ecosystem

We use data-driven technology to measure the climate protection performance of forests. This enables companies to invest in climate protection and supports forest owners in managing their forests sustainably.

Featured in leading media outlets

Want to learn more?

name: Vest
brief:
Product: Vest
One-liner: Bringing wider access to financial derivatives.
Description: Vest, on a mission to bring wider access to financial derivatives, manages investment products worth $70+ billion (as of 6/30/26). Backed by private equity, the firm has a strategic partnership with Cboe Global Markets, Inc. (NASDAQ: CBOE), and First Trust, a global asset manager. Vest created Target Outcome Investments in 2013, which target a defined return profile, with an allowance for a specific level of risk, at a particular point in time.
Industry: Fintech / Asset Management
Tags: Fintech, Investing
target:
Engineering Investment Outcomes

Assets in Target Outcome Investments®

Products with engineered precision

Years pioneering the defined outcome category

Philosophy and a proven track record of delivery

*As of July 6, 2026 $56.6B assets under management, $13.8B non-discretionary assets under supervision.

Strategies that seek to deliver more certainty to modern portfolios

Our Target Outcome Investments® seek to unlock the benefits of derivatives—turning market uncertainty into more portfolio clarity and precision. With a proven track record spanning over a decade, we engineer strategies designed to deliver what they target.

Our Featured Strategies:

Target Buffer®

Seeks to participate in market gains while buffering losses up to a defined level—helping investors stay the course through volatility.

Here’s an example of the outcomes the strategy would seek over the outcome period under different scenarios for returns of the reference asset with an Upside Cap of 12% and a Buffer of 10%.

Target Growth

Seeks to amplify market upside above a specified deductible threshold with unlimited growth potential—without enhancing your downside risk.

Target Income

Seeks to deliver consistent income from any tradable asset by monetizing risk through derivatives—an alternative to fixed income.

Here's an example of how the strategy would work using a simple basket of stocks, selling calls monthly. Target Income Strategies® are available on a variety of underlying asset classes with varying frequency of call writing and income distribution.

Target Financing™

Seeks to provide investors with an alternative way to access capital – without selling assets or compromising their investment strategy.

Simple Onboarding Process

Borrowing through the options market bypasses the need for traditional loan applications or approvals.

Portfolio-Based Borrowing

Use your existing portfolio as collateral, avoiding the need to liquidate assets and trigger tax events upfront.

Competitive Rates

Borrow at attractive rates compared to traditional loans or margin.

Fixed Terms

No surprises, no hikes.

Use it your way

Usage flexibility. Fund a large purchase, seize a market opportunity, or more.

Targeting Growth with Built-In Protection

Built for outcomes

Engineered Precision

Define growth parameters, protection buffers, and income targets upfront. Know your targeted outcomes before you invest.

Outcomes that Seek to Deliver

Every product seeks to provide the outcome that it’s designed to produce and offer the additional certainty that comes from defined parameters.

Derivatives Made Simple

Sophisticated strategies packaged into accessible investment products; available in various wrappers so you can choose what works for you and your clients.

Portfolios Built to Bend, Not Break

name: IntelCue
brief:
Product: IntelCue
Description: Monitor markets and competitors 24/7 across newsletters, blogs, patents, Google Ads and more. Weekly briefings and post-ready angles in Claude & ChatGPT MCP.
target:
Stop searching for intel. Let it come to you.

For founders, marketers & leaders who can’t afford to miss a signal, fall behind their market, or run out of things to say.

Only $8.99/month

Cancel anytime, no lock-in

Name your company or market. IntelCue discovers the relevant competitors and sources.

Monitors all your sources

Your market changes faster than you can track and your AI can see.

The signals are scattered

Competitor moves and market shifts live across websites, ads, newsletters, filings, patents, etc. By the time you piece it together, the story's already old.

There's no ongoing watch

Research happens in bursts, before a board meeting, a launch, or a report, then stops until the next fire drill. Nobody tracks it in between, so you start over every time.

Your AI can't see your market

ChatGPT and Claude are where you already think and write, but they're blind to what's actually moving in your market right now.

IntelCue discovers the sources. Reads them continuously. You ask your AI, or get it in Slack.

No dashboard to live in, no analyst to hire, no program to run. Point it at your market once, and the context comes to you.

Discover Source

Point IntelCue at a company or market. It automatically discovers relevant sources: websites, newsletters, blogs, news feeds, YouTube channels, patents, SEC filings, Google Ads, subdomain logs, and more.

AI Analyzes

IntelCue reads everything continuously, detecting trends, moves, and signals the moment they surface.

Get Insights

Ask Claude or ChatGPT ‘What’s trending?’, or let a brief land in Slack. No dashboard to check, no analyst to hire.

Here’s what changed this week: a company just cut pricing 20%, another just made a big move,…

Real analysis, running on your real market.

Everything you need to stay ahead

IntelCue monitors competitor and market signals, then turns them into alerts, briefs, and live context for ChatGPT, Claude, and Slack.

Works Where You Work

Bring live competitive intelligence into ChatGPT, Claude, and Slack. Ask questions, get alerts, and use fresh market context without opening another dashboard.

Front Page Brief

Get a weekly newspaper-style market briefing that turns scattered competitor and market signals into clear, readable stories, delivered by email, Slack, or straight to your iPhone's mobile wallet.

Competitive Alerts

Get notified when competitors change messaging, launch campaigns, publish content, update pages, or make visible market moves, ranked by importance so you focus on what matters.

Market Momentum

Product: Blitz
One-liner: Lovable for non-tech users: Build no-code internal and customer apps
Description: Blitz is a no-code platform to build internal applications and automate manual tasks. Quickly build a database, integrate your logic, and scale your operations. Alternative to Google Sheet and Airtable, Blitz is not limited by a number of lines of records or by an API rate. Create your data model and set up data validation rules. Use our interface builder to create dynamic forms, and quickly onboard customer and partners.

target:
Build apps with zero code

Flexible and intuitive platform for operations and product teams to turn processes into apps with zero code.

Create apps with your business logic

Leverage Blitz no-code platform to build your own internal apps adapted to the needs of your business.

Fast Development

Build apps adapted to the needs of your business in just hours.

Drag-and-drop

Define your data model and integrate your business logic.

High Performance

Harness the power and scalability of graph databases.

Industry Templates

Use our industry best-in-class templates for every usage.

Build business apps with no code

No more shared spreadsheets or single-use SaaS—with Blitz, you can easily define your data model, build custom apps and create roles and permissions for each user—with one single database.

A no-code platform to ‍ scale operations

Blitz reduces the dependency to developers and monolithic tools. Build the tools you need, adapted to your business.

Stop being dependent on devs. Let the people who know the business logic build it.

Build fully functional business apps, customized to your own processes, in just hours!

name: InLoop Robotics
brief:
Product: InLoop Robotics
One-liner: Robotic arms that pick and pack your orders.
Description: We are building AI-native fulfillment powered by robotics. Warehouses without human labor that get better, faster, and cheaper with every order. Most robotics companies wait until their system is perfect before deploying. We don't. We ship imperfect policies into real warehouses, detect failures in real time, recover automatically when we can, and bring in a remote human operator when we can't. Every failure becomes training data. Every intervention makes the system better.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
target:
Automate Manual Labor from Day One.

Meet Loop V1, our intelligent bimanual robot system built to handle manufacturing, assembly, and logistics tasks. No facility redesigns needed, just plug it in and let it work.

Run the Full Labor Workflow.

Reliable execution of dexterous tasks.

Box Assembly

Our robots reliably fold and assemble boxes of any size, handling structural packaging tasks with precision.

Kitting

High-speed, multi-item order fulfillment. Our robots pick, sort, and pack items from diverse inventory into outbound orders.

Visual Inspection

Real-time quality assurance and item verification using vision-based AI to detect defects and ensure accuracy.

Prepare Content

Automated content preparation including labeling, wrapping, and staging items for the next step in the fulfillment pipeline.

Unpackaging

Advanced unpackaging and content extraction, handling diverse packaging materials with precision.

Zero Downtime

Zero downtime. Infinite learning.

Our system architecture guarantees performance. When our confidence-aware AI encounters an edge case, it automatically pauses and alerts our remote human operators.

Autonomous Execution

Maximum impact. Minimal investment.

Why buy a robot when you can hire one? For a flat monthly fee, you get the hardware, continuous AI updates, and 24/7 teleassistance fallback. It's cheaper than human labor, with zero turnover.

Traditional Automation

InLoop RaaS

Take a look around.

Loop V1 at work.

Frequently asked questions.

I have multiple types of boxes. Can your arms assemble all of them?

Yes. Once our robotic arms have assembled enough variations, our System 2 intelligence can easily differentiate between them and assemble each one properly.

We are interested in the kitting solution. We deal with a high number of different objects that change every few months. Can your solution adapt?

Yes, that is the exact purpose of our robotic workforce. Because they have seen so many objects during pre-training, they can handle the pick-and-place of diverse and changing items quite reliably.

What happens if a robot breaks?

We will send you a replacement immediately. So far, none of our deployed robots have broken. Since most of our customers use multiple robots in the same facility, we also recommend keeping one redundant arm on standby that can be easily swapped in if something happens.

I am interested. What is the deployment procedure?

I was looking for a place near my office in Whitefield and didn't want to go through brokers. A friend recommended FlatX, so I gave it a try. I spoke to two flatmates—one of them was also remote, which made things easier. We've been sharing the flat for a month now and it's been great. No brokers, no unnecessary flat visits.

name: Aspect
brief:
Product: Aspect
One-liner: Intelligent media storage for creative teams.
Description: Aspect helps creative teams consolidate 5 media tools into one platform. We provide everything a media team needs: file ingest, local file streaming, review and approval, sharing, and archiving. Aspect workspaces come with an agent that has complete understanding of your asset library including comments and revisions. Ask the agent to complete any task in the background: searching for files, setting up folder structures, labeling and organizing footage, and much more.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
target:
Intelligent media storage for the whole team.

Upload multi-media files, collaborate and review, stream video locally like a NAS, and automate media gruntwork with AI, all in one unified platform.

The Aspect Platform

The power of Dropbox, Lucidlink, and Frameio, all in one place.

Why pay for 3+ tools when you can pay for one? Consolidate tools across your entire media stack and automate media gruntwork with AI while you work.

One shared file space for the whole team, streaming like a local drive.

Aspect connects to your computer like a shared network drive, syncing your whole team to one file space.

Instead of downloading full files from the cloud, Aspect streams what you need on demand , just like Youtube. No need to mail hard drives or wait for media to download.

One platform, one process

From ingest, to editing, to review and delivery, Aspect keeps the whole team in sync.

Permission and access

Start with secure upload links for external collaborators. Manage access with controls like upload, comment, download, password, and expiry date.

Intelligent file streaming

Mount a project or folder and drag files into your editor to start working immediately. Aspect prefetches and caches bytes you need instead of downloading the whole file.

Edit with the whole team

Aspect is just like a local shared NAS , optimized for global collaboration. Any changes you make show up instantly for everyone on your team with built-in versioning and rollback.

Customize delivery

Export rough and finished cuts directly to Aspect and send them for review with collections . Customize views with versions, branding, metadata, and more.

Battle tested

Flexible enough for creative chaos, durable for global enterprise demands.

We are committed to providing the utmost security and data reliability, with the flexibility to work with existing on-prem and S3 storage.

Organization Security

Your data is safe and recoverable with SSO/SAML, audit logging, snapshots with rollback, and multi-region replication.

On-Site Shared Cache

Deploy an on-site cache node so your entire team streams from one fast local copy without redundant cloud pulls.

Intelligent Cold Storage

Archive assets and projects with one click for long term storage and preserve previews, metadata, and AI access.

Use cases

Designed to power media workflows across every industry and use case.

See how teams today are using Aspect to ingest, edit, and deliver content.

Smooth start

Our team is here for you from migration to training and beyond.

Code understanding for humans and agents

Stop overpaying for Sourcegraph

Code context layer for agents

name: Saldor
brief:
Product: Saldor
One-liner: Making procurement easy
Description: Saldor is the AI-native procurement and accounts payable platform that takes every purchase from request to paid.
Industry: B2B / Supply Chain and Logistics
Tags: B2B, Procurement
target:
Purchasing shouldn’t require a dozen emails.

Saldor helps companies approve, order, and reconcile everything they buy. AI handles the busywork, letting your team move faster.

A rough ask is enough

Say what you need where the need comes up. Saldor reads the thread, works out the spec, and has the RFQ in front of five vendors before you'd have finished writing it.

Rack 3 is out of headroom. We need 12 more compute nodes before the Q3 migration.

Same spec as the last batch — dual socket, 512GB. Last ones ran about $14k a node.

Let's not single-source it again. Can we get quotes from a few vendors?

From awarded quote to renewal notice

Saldor writes the purchase order the moment you pick a quote, then watches the contract it creates until the day you can still walk away.

Purchase orders write themselves.

Pick the quote and the PO is already drafted — items, terms, and ship-to pulled from the event. You send it.

Nothing renews by surprise.

Saldor tracks every notice date and warns you while cancelling is still an option — with last year's price next to this year's.

A copilot for what you can't afford to miss

Saldor watches every open PO — promise dates, late shipments, quiet vendors — and drafts the chase before it becomes a problem.

Heads up — the 12 bearing housings on PO-2318 from Acme Industrial were promised Tuesday and still haven't shipped. I drafted a follow-up. Send it?

Drop the invoice. It’s already coded.

Forward it, scan it, or let the vendor email it in. Saldor pulls out every line and codes it the way your team would.

Thousands of invoices in seconds.

PDFs, scans, and email attachments come back as structured line items. No templates to maintain.

Coded the way your team codes.

Saldor learns from your history and applies GL, department, and location across hundreds of lines.

Overbilling caught on arrival.

Duplicate bills, off-contract rates, and quiet price creep get flagged before anyone is asked to approve them.

Bills match themselves

Saldor matches every invoice to its PO and its receipt. Clean ones post on their own, so close doesn't wait on AP. Only the exceptions come to you — with the fix already worked out.

Encode your process. Move faster.

Approvals, routing, and notifications — defined once, then run on every request without anyone chasing a signature.

Approval flows that just flow.

name: Mobius Materials
brief:
Product: Mobius Materials
One-liner: The spot market for semiconductors
Description: Mobius is the safe spot market for electronic components like microcontrollers and capacitors. We help electronics manufacturers buy and sell chips quickly, safely & at market prices.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Hardware, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Semiconductors
target:
Get certified electronic parts in under two weeks

Mobius is a B2B marketplace for hardware manufacturers to save up to 70% on parts by matching them with sellers with excess.

Manufacturers and Parts

We sell verified ICs from reputable manufacturers.

Hardware sourcing is hard

Sourcing is one of the riskiest parts of bringing a hardware product to market.

Underbuy

Underbuy and you could need to quickly source more components to meet demand

Mobius

Allows you to quickly buy and sell bulk electronic components.

Overbuy

Over-source and you could waste millions of dollars on parts that you can’t sell back

Mobius solves electronic component inventory issues

"As the head of operations for an IoT module manufacturer, every year I was throwing away hundreds of thousands of dollars of new excess components and then turning around and paying out the wazoo for other similar components. At Mobius Materials , our mission is to fix this breakdown by helping manufacturers improve P&L and getting these parts back into the supply chain."

Margaret Upshur

Founder and CEO

Why buy from us?

We only take parts from vetted suppliers and we comprehensively test the authenticity of our parts.

Get 10–70% off common parts by buying at market rates. Discounts vary by component grade.

Shortage in the market? Get access to rare stock other hardware manufacturers stockpiled.

Hundreds of OEMs, Millions of parts sold

With partners who say things like:

Hailey N.

Chief Executive Officer

Kendell W.

Manufacturing & Operations Leader

brief:
Product: Confident AI
One-liner: The LLM Eval and Observability Platform for AI Quality
Description: Confident AI provides enterprises an all-in-one platform to evaluate, observe, red team, and govern AI applications. Built by the creators of DeepEval (16k stars, 8m monthly downloads), Confident AI is able to offer battle-tested, open-source evaluation algorithms while providing the infrastructure needed for teams to stay confident their AI systems.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, Generative AI, Open Source, AI
target:
Where AI Quality is Standardized. Not Improvised.

Standardize how different teams turn live traces into test cases, validate with evals, and catch vulnerabilities before they ship.

One eval standard. Enforced across every team.

Align every team to the same evals and quality bar — no matter who ships the release.

“We hit a point where every AI team was building their own eval stack. That’s fine for one product. With five, ten, fifteen AI initiatives across the portfolio, it’s never going to live up to our high standards of AI governance.”

Where product, QA, and engineering align.

One platform that gives engineers, product owners, and QA teams a shared source of truth.

LLM Tracing

Trace UUID 6d63ad3c-8083-fa75-93dd-82e36b52996a

How can I improve my credit score from 670 to 700?

Improving your score from 670 to 700 is achievable. A few strategies to start with:

“Before Confident AI, a single improvement cycle took 10 days — I'd create a task, assign it to an engineer, wait for availability, and go back and forth. Now the same cycle takes three hours, and our product managers can run it themselves.”

For AI that has to be safe. Not just useful.

Purpose built for industries where a perfectly functional AI is not good enough.

OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026

A comprehensive list of the most critical security risks associated with agentic AI applications.

Attackers manipulate agent goals, plans, or decision paths through direct or indirect instruction injection, causing agents to pursue unintended or malicious objectives.

Agents misuse or abuse tools through unsafe composition, recursion, or excessive execution, causing harmful side effects despite valid permissions.

Abuse of delegated authority, ambiguous agent identity, or trust assumptions leading to unauthorized actions.

Compromise of external agents, tools, schemas, or prompts that agents dynamically trust or import.

ASI01:2026 Agent Goal Hijack

“Confident AI increased our speed to market by 200%. For us, compliance and trust aren’t optional—they’re required. Confident AI helps us deliver both.”

Built for every step of the AI lifecycle.

Alert on monitored traces

Inspect every trace in production, monitor quality and latency over time, and get notified immediately when regressions or incidents occur.

Dataset auto-curation

Turn observability traces into evaluation datasets automatically, then auto-categorize failures and edge cases so dataset operations scale with your product.

name: Gilgamesh Pharmaceuticals
brief:
Product: Gilgamesh Pharmaceuticals
One-liner: Gilgamesh Pharmaceuticals, a Clinical stage biotechnology company…
Description: Gilgamesh is a pioneering, clinical stage mental health science-focused biotechnology company. We have a disciplined focus on developing innovative new chemical entities (NCEs) leveraging a unique combination of medicinal chemistry, intellectual property strategy, neuroscience & neurobiology, and drug development expertise. We are an experienced team, with proven success in biotech exits and inventions.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
Tags: Therapeutics, Psychedelics, Mental Health
target:
An Epic Leap For Mental Health

Developing innovative new chemical entities that transform the treatment paradigm of psychiatric disease — moving beyond symptom management toward rapid-acting, durable therapies.

Beyond Symptom Management

Current psychiatric treatments often mask symptoms rather than addressing underlying neurobiological roots. Gilgamesh is building a new class of precision therapies that engage the brain's own plasticity mechanisms to produce lasting change.

Our deep expertise in medicinal chemistry, combined with an AI-powered translational platform, enables us to design and optimize novel molecules with unprecedented speed — targeting the mechanisms that matter most.

Five Therapeutic Frontiers

Bretisilocin (GM-2505)

Our first asset to advance to Phase 2 — a rapid-acting 5-HT2AR agonist with a 2-hour treatment window. Its acquisition by AbbVie validates our NCE discovery platform.

Blixeprodil (GM-1020)

An orally bioavailable NMDAR antagonist with rapid antidepressant effects and low dissociation — enabling potential at-home use and removing the IV monitoring burden of ketamine.

Neuroplastogens

A novel series of non-hallucinogenic neuroplastogens promoting structural and functional brain plasticity — developed in partnership with AbbVie for depression and anxiety.

GM-3009

Structurally optimized ibogaine analogs with improved cardiac safety and maintained efficacy — addressing opioid use disorder, PTSD, and traumatic brain injury.

M1/M4 Agonist

A single oral agent with refined M1/M4 selectivity and a significantly reduced peripheral side effect profile, offering a cleaner therapeutic window for schizophrenia.

Multi-Modal Discovery Behind Every Program

Deep medicinal chemistry expertise combined with computational modeling accelerates our NCE pipeline from concept to clinic.

Program Status

Five programs spanning depression, anxiety, addiction, and schizophrenia — all novel chemical entities designed in-house.

Where Chemistry Meets Intelligence

Our discovery and translational platform integrates medicinal chemistry expertise, neurocircuitry science, and deep neuroscience knowledge to accelerate the creation of novel precision psychiatric therapies.

The result: faster NCE identification, richer SAR data, and a compounding competitive advantage — as validated by AbbVie's acquisition of Bretisilocin.

World-Class Scientists & Leaders

A team of medicinal chemists, inventors, and drug development veterans from top academic and biopharmaceutical institutions, tackling the hardest mental health challenges facing the world today.

25+ years in drug development at Pfizer and J&J. Assistant Professor of Psychiatry, Columbia University. Founder of Perception Neuroscience (acquired by ATAI Life Sciences). Research at Harvard and NIH.

Medicinal chemist with 15+ years synthesizing and patenting psychedelic and ibogaine analogs. Discovered MOA of antidepressant Tianeptine. Founder & CSO of Kures Therapeutics (acquired by ATAI).

brief:
Product: Zoios.
One-liner: Help start- and scale-ups excel at People, Culture and Performance.
Description: Are you looking for a platform that can help you overcome people and culture challenges? We combine human expertise with advanced data analytics to help you achieve the results you dream about. Our platform helps organizations build a great culture, hire the right talent and lead their people. There is no need to be guessing, and worrying all the time. Use Zoios to get real-time actions that will help you create an organization where employees thrive.
Industry: B2B / Human Resources
Tags: Mental Health Tech, SaaS, B2B
target:
Listen to how your people really feel.

Zoios collects and analyses employee feedback so you can combat dissatisfaction and tackle de-motivation with tailored, in-time actions.

People & Culture teams that lead with Zoios

Questions backed by science.

Our surveys are built on scientifically validated questions, battle-tested and benchmarked across 1,000+ teams in 47 countries. You're not measuring fluff; you're working with real data.

Honest feedback, because it's anonymous.

Responses are end-to-end encrypted and aggregated only when teams are large enough to protect identity. Employees speak freely; you hear what they actually think.

No manual work. Runs on auto-pilot.

Sync your team, send the survey, and Zoios handles the rest: reminders, segmentation, anonymization, benchmarking, analysis, and a tailored report for every team. End-to-end on auto-pilot.

Catch problems before they grow.

Run pulse surveys at the cadence that fits your team, monthly or quarterly. They surface drift weeks before an annual survey would. Spot the early signal, like optimism in Engineering dipping after a strategy shift, and act before it becomes a people problem.

AI that finds the root cause.

Trained on thousands of teams, our models cluster open comments, attribute the underlying causes, and recommend concrete actions you can take this week.

See which teams need attention.

Every team gets a live engagement and strain score, along with trend lines. Themes sorted by urgency. Drill into the root cause behind the issue, and walk into your next 1:1 already knowing which conversation matters most.

Useful for every role.

Executives get the org-wide picture. Managers get a report tuned to their team. Teams get a conversation guide for their next retro. One survey, three audiences, each with exactly what they need.

Numbers that move.

Across customers who adopt Zoios and act on the signals.

Built for speed and clarity.

Honest feedback

Because anonymity isn't a setting. It's enforced at the data layer, with a minimum group size before anything is shown. Employees speak openly, and you get unfiltered signal.

Easy and intuitive

Purposeful design and ruthless focus. Your leaders open Zoios and understand their team in 30 seconds. No training, no manuals.

Actionable insights

Benchmarks across 1,000+ teams, patterns from years of pulse data, and AI trained on thousands of teams. You get ranked actions, not data dumps.

Plugs into the stack you already run.

Sync employees from your HRIS, sign in with SSO, send pulses through the channels your team already opens. Minutes to set up, no IT project.

Numbers that move.

Across customers who adopt Zoios and act on the signals.

Built for speed and clarity.

Honest feedback

Because anonymity isn't a setting. It's enforced at the data layer, with a minimum group size before anything is shown. Employees speak openly, and you get unfiltered signal.

Easy and intuitive

Purposeful design and ruthless focus. Your leaders open Zoios and understand their team in 30 seconds. No training, no manuals.

Actionable insights

Benchmarks across 1,000+ teams, patterns from years of pulse data, and AI trained on thousands of teams. You get ranked actions, not data dumps.

One-liner: International banking infrastructure for global startups.
Description: Jeeves is an all-in-one corporate spend and expense management platform for businesses in global markets including North America, Latin America, Europe, and the UK. Cash, corporate cards, and cross-border payments all run on the Jeeves proprietary infrastructure which allows companies to spin up their finance function within minutes. Jeeves can handle multiple currencies for payback. More than 3,000 companies across the world trust Jeeves with their financial payments tack.
Industry: Fintech
Tags: Fintech, Payments
target:
Power Over Your Money.

Unlimited Cards Instant Payments Full Control

Built for Financial Teams Who Move the World.

Jeeves combines real-time visibility with global ease so you can control every transaction, every budget, every market.

FAQs

Jeeves is an all-in-one financial platform built to empower businesses in over 30 countries with efficient, cost-effective global payment solutions. Issue corporate cards, pay local and international bills and vendors, and manage expenses in real time with smart controls — all designed to support the healthy growth of your business.

Jeeves serves active businesses operating in over 30 markets worldwide, including Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, the United States, Canada, the UK, and the European Union.

Jeeves stands out by offering corporate cards - both physical and virtual - with greater flexibility, lower fees, and better rewards. Powered by Mastercard or Visa depending on the region, it gives businesses more control, security, and autonomy. Its platform enables real-time expense management, allowing companies to seamlessly adjust limits, manage users, and optimize financial operations with maximum efficiency and transparency.

Jeeves simplifies accounts payable with fast, automated bill payments and global transactions in up to 40 currencies and across 150 countries. Businesses can schedule payments, pay vendors in bulk, and enforce approval flows - all-in-one platform. Smart automation reduces manual work, ensures compliance, and integrates seamlessly with several accounting platforms for faster month-end closing.

Jeeves is the leading expense management solution, providing a smart platform that centralizes financial control. With real-time expense tracking, automated reporting, and integrated policies, it ensures efficiency and compliance. Users can manage limits, approvals, and reimbursements seamlessly, while ERP integrations simplify accounting and boost productivity.

Power Over Every Dollar.

Jeeves provides a powerful suite of financial tools designed to simplify operations, save time, and reduce costs so your business can focus on growth.

brief:
Product: Truebill

It enables people to optimize their spending, manage subscriptions, lower their bills, and automatically set aside money to reach their savings goals. Truebill has saved members more than $100 million since 2016 and is headquartered in Silver Spring, Maryland, with offices in San Francisco.
Industry: Fintech / Consumer Finance

The money app that works for you

Managing money is hard, but you don’t have to do it alone. Rocket Money empowers you to save more, spend less, see everything, and take back control of your financial life.

Scan to download the app

Join 10 million+ members

Featured in

Get control over your subscriptions

Rocket Money instantly finds and tracks your subscriptions. We’re there when you need us to cancel services so you don’t have to.

Stay on top of your everyday spending

Get an effortless breakdown of your finances to see where your money is going and how to improve. We’ll notify you of important events that need your attention so you’re never caught off guard.

Put your financial goals on autopilot

Turn on autopilot to save money without thinking about it. Rocket Money learns your habits and saves the right amount at the right time while helping you avoid overdraft fees.

Premium is more than just software features! You’ll also get real access to humans who can help you cancel subscriptions, lower your bills or help with questions about your personal finances.

without Premium

with Premium

Reach your financial goals with ease.

Our concierge will identify bills that can be lowered and negotiate on your behalf for the best rates available.

Lower my bills

Set up a budget that automatically monitors your spending by category and keeps you on track towards your goals.

Description: BlueHill replaces the patchwork of tools you use to manage clients. Instead of bouncing between a project management app, a shared inbox, a portal solution, and a spreadsheet to track onboarding — BlueHill brings it all into one platform. Kanban, Gantt, and Table — your team picks the view.

name: Probably Genetic
brief:
Product: Probably Genetic
One-liner: Patient Intelligence Platform for Genetic Disease
Description: Probably Genetic is changing the lives of patients living with severe, complex diseases. Our data platform is used by drug developers and patient advocacy groups to develop and launch treatments for these patients. Our technology discovers undiagnosed patients online, analyzes their disease state using machine learning and at-home testing, and enables compliant communication with patients. In doing so, we help patients access diagnoses, clinical trials, and treatments as early as possible.
Industry: Healthcare / Diagnostics
Tags: Health Tech, Biotech, Genomics, AI
target:
The diagnostic odyssey ends here.

Complex symptoms deserve clear answers. We use AI and genetics expertise to help families end their diagnostic journey through free testing, accessible insurance-billed care, and research advancing rare disease diagnosis.

Patients

Over 200,000 patients already use the Probably Genetic platform.

Patient Advocacy Partners

We're partnered with over 50 patient advocacy groups to help connect patients with support & community.

More about testing

How does testing work?

If eligible for a testing program, you'll receive a clinical-grade test kit delivered right to your door, offering both convenience and accuracy. Simply provide a small saliva or cheek swab sample, and our advanced technology will handle the rest, revealing valuable genetic insights.

Just a few easy steps...

To be eligible for one of our testing programs, patients (or caregivers on behalf of patients) must complete an online assessment. If approved, you will be asked to confirm your shipping address and a genetic testing kit will be delivered right to your door.

Complete our health and diagnostic assessment to build your personalized profile. We’ll gather brief details about your current and past diagnoses, family history, and essential personal information to offer genetic testing and counseling.

Once you have completed your assessment and profile, you will be notified of your eligibility status via email, but you can also view it on your profile.

We make it easy with convenient, at-home saliva sample collection. That’s right, we send your testing kit right to your door which means no extra trips to a doctor or lab.

check eligibility

What patients say about us

Find out more about Probably Genetic

We are a leading company in the field of genetics, specializing in the detection of rare genetic diseases using simple DNA tests. We offer customized solutions for patients and doctors, simplifying diagnosis and helping to find answers.

deeply integrated to automate commitments, change orders, invoices, and the financial data entry connecting them.

Centralize
