name: ProvenMetal
brief:
Product: ProvenMetal
One-liner: AI-native electronics manufacturing for the American industrial base
Description: ProvenMetal manufactures the fastest circuit boards in the United States. Domestic circuit board manufacturing is slow and expensive, and while reshoring is happening, the supply chain isn't there yet. We automate the bottlenecks - part procurement, DFM review, and assembly - delivering circuit boards in days instead of weeks.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Hardware, Manufacturing, Electronics
target:
We build circuit boards fast.

One team sources every part, manages fabrication through qualified domestic or overseas partners, then assembles and tests your boards in the US. Fully domestic builds are available when required.

No account required. Review scope, price, and ship date before approval.

Speed you can plan around.

A four-week turn breaks your schedule. Ours run five to seven days.

Source & verify

We buy every part against your BOM and verify it before the build starts.

Fabricate & assemble

We run fab and assembly with vetted partners we manage ourselves, fully domestic when you need it.

Test & ship

We test every board and ship it with a full quality record.

Common questions

Standard turns run seven days; five at the quickest. Your quote shows the exact ship date before you commit.

Then we build the other way: a longer turn at a lower price. You pick the tradeoff on every order.

No. We start from your last revision, so later revs come back faster.

One team owns the whole build.

ProvenMetal sets the build plan, manages each facility, and remains accountable from the first sourcing decision through final test and delivery.

Parts stay controlled.

Sourced or consigned, parts are received against the BOM, kept lot-traceable, and handled under MSL and ESD controls.

Testing is planned up front.

Acceptance criteria and fixtures are agreed before production and available at the test site, so failures can be reworked before shipment.

One team owns the outcome.

We manage sourcing, fabrication, assembly, inspection, test, and delivery, then ship the build record with your boards.

One partner, start to finish.

SOURCE

Send your files. We source and verify every part to fit your spec and budget.

BUILD

We run fabrication and assembly across vetted partners, fully domestic if you need it, and manage the whole build.

VERIFY

AOI and X-ray on every board, plus functional test, bring-up, and firmware loading when you need it. Full quality record ships with the order.

Built for hard hardware.

High-layer-count HDI, RF, and rigid-flex, sourced and assembled on a supply base we manage. A slice of the sheet below.

HDI with blind, buried, and stacked vias.

BGA, µBGA, and flip chip down to 0.3 mm pitch.

Rigid, flex, and rigid-flex builds.

Rogers, Megtron 6, and polyimide laminates.

Inspected and tested before it ships.

ISO 9001 and AS9100 capabilities through qualified US partners.

name: Recurse Center
brief:
Product: Recurse Center
One-liner: The retreat where curious programmers recharge and grow
Description: The Recurse Center is a self-directed, educational retreat for people who want to get better at programming, whether they've been programming for three decades or three months. The retreat is free for all participants because we run an integrated recruiting agency and provide (optional) personalized recruiting services to anyone in our community considering a new job.
Industry: Education
Tags: Education, Community, Recruiting
target:
The Recurse Center is a retreat for curious programmers.

Rediscover the joy of programming

The Recurse Center is a programming retreat. People travel from around the world to spend 6 or 12 weeks coding together in our two-floor space in Brooklyn. (You can also attend remotely.)

You come to RC to become a dramatically better programmer, to learn and build new things, to find community and kindred spirits, and to advance your career.

Dedicated time for building and self-study

You set your own goals and how to spend your time. You can work on just about anything that sparks your curiosity, so long as it’s code you can share: that side project you never had time for? A silly hack or game? A new compiler? Figuring out how to code with agents?

RC is a place for joy and rigor: a place for you to work at the edge of your abilities, to build your volitional muscles, and to learn generously.

I created a programming language based out of emojis, and a Whac-A-Ghost game like Whac-A-Mole, except you whack online dating ghosts. That was good for my soul. I needed to rediscover my love for programming and to find joy in creating things for fun.

A community of like-minded programmers

You attend RC as part of a group, called a batch, alongside 30 or so kind and curious peers from a wide range of backgrounds. You and your fellow Recursers will pair, run and attend workshops, provide support and encouragement, and frequently become friends. New batches start every six weeks.

RC is for you if you are kind, curious, and ready to build and grow. We don’t care how long you’ve been programming, so long as you’ve done it enough to know you like it, can write short programs from scratch, and are intellectually engaged in your work.

After your batch, you join a community of over 3,000 alums from our past 15 years. We believe learning is a life-long process, which is why our motto is “Never Graduate.”

Lightweight structure and accountability

There are weekly 5-minute presentations to share what you’re building, and core batch events like Impossible Stuff Day (where you tackle things that feel impossible to you), Half-Baked Demos (extremely low-stakes demos, with a potluck of baked goods), and the Pairing Jam (a day-long pairing hackathon).

name: Pentagon
brief:
Product: Pentagon
One-liner: The control plane for agent-native work.
Industry: B2B / Productivity
target:
Stop running agents. Start running teams.

Pentagon is a workspace for your AI employees to communicate, coordinate, and get work done as a team.

Create a map.

Add your folders — as many as you need. Each map is a workspace where your agents collaborate across them.

Onboard agents.

Spawn them yourself, or spawn a Manager and let them hire the rest. Give each agent a clear purpose, operating scope, and the folders they need.

Lead your team.

See who's working, what needs your attention, and set guardrails. Your agents talk to each other, split the work, and get it done.

Agents that talk to each other.

They message each other, share context, delegate tasks, and coordinate - you're in the middle only when you need to be. A backend agent discovers an API change and tells the frontend agent directly. A manager agent assigns work to three specialists and synthesizes the results.

Real collaboration between agents that compounds as your team grows.

API schema changed — heads up, the /users endpoint returns a new field now.

Got it. Updating the type definitions and the profile component now.

I'll add regression tests for the new field once Frontend's PR is up.

Agents that grow.

Conversations, decisions, what worked and what didn't. Your agents build up tribal knowledge over time — compounding institutional memory that makes the whole team sharper with every task.

An agent that fixed a tricky deployment last week already knows the gotchas when it comes up again.

Completed initial codebase scan. Identified 3 services, 2 shared libraries. Set up branch and ran test suite — all green.

Auth module uses custom JWT implementation. Refresh token logic has edge cases around concurrent requests — flagged for review.

Deployments to staging require a manual approval gate. Last time I skipped it, the rollback took 20 minutes. Always wait for CI green + approval before promoting.

The /users endpoint schema changed again — third time this quarter. Added a regression test for schema drift. Notified Frontend directly so they can update types before it breaks prod.

Everything you need to run an agent team.

Spatial Canvas

A visual workspace where every agent has a place. See your whole team at a glance — who's active, who's waiting, who's idle.

Teams

Group agents by function. Engineering, ops, research. Shared context, clear boundaries.

Channels

Agents communicate through structured channels. Clear, typed messages that keep everyone in sync.

Group Chats

name: Definite
brief:
Product: Definite
One-liner: Build everyday back-office agents on one live model of your books
Description: Definite is where finance teams build everyday back-office agents on one live model of their books. We plug into your ERP, ledger, payroll, and payments read-only and compile everything into one clean model that stays current as money moves. Your back-office team then builds agents on top in plain English. We never write back and we never move money. The agents are yours, the plumbing is ours. We met in first year computer science at Waterloo and interned at Meta, Optiver, and BitGo.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Fintech, SaaS, Finance
target:
Make every dollar work harder.

Definite connects your financial stack, continuously finds opportunities to improve cash, margin, and runway, and gives finance the evidence and workflow to capture the value.

Most finance software helps you measure the business.

Definite helps you move the numbers.

Definite runs a continuous control loop over your financial stack. It works through every new financial event — whether or not anyone is logged in — and brings finance only the decisions that need judgment.

01 · Connect

One financial truth

Read-only connections to accounting, bank, spend, payroll, billing, and contracts resolve into one model. The same vendor in your ERP, card feed, and a signed PDF becomes one entity.

02 · Find

Plays run continuously

A standard library of plays tests expected state against actual state — on every new invoice, payment, hire, and renewal. Nobody has to go looking.

03 · Quantify

Priced, with evidence

Deterministic math prices every difference — contracted $84,000, invoiced $98,200, $14,200 unsupported — with the contract, invoices, and ledger entries attached.

04 · Act

Judgment stays human

Material opportunities arrive with the investigation already done. Your team accepts, assigns, or dismisses. Definite never posts entries or moves money.

05 · Verify

Impact, proven

Definite watches what actually changes — the credit lands, the renewal closes lower — and records verified impact only when the numbers confirm it.

AI INVESTIGATES · DETERMINISTIC CODE DOES THE MATH · HUMANS DECIDE

Four places teams start.

Close & reconciliations

Match balances, investigate breaks, assemble support.

FP&A & planning

Explain variances and trace results back to the underlying drivers.

Billing & revenue

Investigate billing, payment, settlement, and customer discrepancies.

Tax & compliance

Validate reporting populations, collect evidence, and surface unsupported items.

Identified value is not verified value.

Definite is conservative by design. A found number is a claim, not a result — an opportunity has to survive finance's review, get resolved, and show up in the subsequent financial state before it counts. Every entry traces back to source records.

FROM CLAIM TO PROOF

ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE · NOT CUSTOMER DATA

EVERY DOLLAR, LABELED

Frequently asked questions

Still deciding? Bring the numbers you suspect are leaking, and Definite will show its work.

No. Definite operates above the systems and files already involved in the workflow. Those systems remain the source of record, while Definite standardizes the procedure, evidence, exception handling, and review experience across them.

Description: Become a more productive you, one card at a time. Available for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac.
target:
A more productive you, one card at a time

Get the reminders app made for better habits.

A simple way to build better habits and get things done

Swipe your way to success

Gestures transform your entire screen into a button. Select your tasks for the day and enjoy flicking them off your todo list. Without even having to look.

Made for speed

Doo uses a set of custom keyboards to keep controls within reach. Create one-off tasks or future appointments with ease. No interruption. No fuss.

Collaborate in style

Send grocery lists, chores, and other tasks to others with iMessage. Edits made by one person get sent to everyone so you can keep track of progress. Don’t forget the milk!

Adapts to how you work

Manage reminder notifications at the task level. Turn off notifications for date-based tasks, enable time zones, and repeat tasks from their completion date.

See what’s next

Manage tasks from the Apple Watch app or review from your watch face. Two complication options highlight what’s upcoming or your last due item.

Keeps your data private

No accounts. No trackers, no ads, and no personal data collection. Ever. Your data stays on your device and within your private iCloud account. Simple — the way it should be.

Big on features. Deceptively simple.

Get the app that’s changing productivity

brief:
Product: Hellometer
One-liner: Making fast food faster
Description: Hellometer helps fast food owners' grow same store sales using security cameras to improve customer wait times. Speed of service is fast food's core value proposition (it’s literally in the name) and owners currently don't have a reliable way to measure it. We show them when and where they have slowdowns and for every 7s they improve service times, owners see 1% increase in revenue.

Tags: SaaS, Computer Vision, B2B

Improve your restaurant's efficiency and guest experience with real-time measurement and insights that drive performance.

Trusted By

Comprehensive solutions to optimize every aspect of your quick-service restaurant operations.

Drive-Thru Timer

Real-time vehicle tracking and performance analytics to reduce wait times and improve customer satisfaction at every touchpoint.

Lobby Timer

Track door-to-dine service times and monitor guest wait times to ensure exceptional in-restaurant experiences every time.

Loss Prevention

HD video monitoring with advanced analytics to protect your business, identify issues quickly, and reduce losses across all locations.

name: Pulse
brief:
Product: Pulse
One-liner: Production-grade unstructured document extraction
Description: Pulse converts complex information into LLM-ready inputs. Our API supports all document formats, from PDFs to Word, Excel, etc. Pulse integrates seamlessly with any existing data pipeline in minutes without any training or complexity.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
target:
Document intelligence for trust and scale

Pulse uses OCR, layout, and vision models to produce high quality outputs from complex documents for enterprise and AI-native teams.

We’ve processed over 1 billion pages for teams from new AI startups to Fortune 10 enterprises

How Pulse processes unstructured data

From layout detection to table parsing, every layer is optimized for precision, speed, and context awareness.

Layout-Aware Understanding

Understands page structure before reading content, identifying tables, charts, and text with precision.

Fast, Specialized OCR

Low-latency extraction tuned for each component type, ensuring accuracy across complex layouts.

Reading Order Intelligence

Processes multi-column and irregular layouts in human-like sequence for better context retention.

Run Pulse securely from anywhere you need it

From private VPCs to on-prem servers, Pulse integrates with your existing infrastructure while maintaining full isolation and compliance.

Audit Process Automation

Run Pulse entirely within your secure VPC or on-prem environment in all the major hyperscaler networks. No external dependencies and full data isolation. Multi-cloud / hybrid cloud approaches also supported.

Enterprise-grade Security and Compliance

SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and HIPAA ready by default. Pulse meets the same standards used by Fortune 50 data infrastructure.

Custom Integrations and Control

Deploy using Docker, Kubernetes, or internal API gateways with complete control over data flow and model endpoints. Have full visibility with detailed logging / metrics over document type, latency, etc.

Scalable Performance

Process millions of pages with built-in load balancing and GPU acceleration. The same architecture powers our largest regulated clients.

Enterprise-grade security, verified and enforced

We ensure top-tier security and compliance, continuously verified by Oneleet and independent audits.

SOC 2 Type II

GDPR

ISO 27001

HIPAA

Certified for ongoing security controls.

Aligned with EU data protection laws.

Compliant with global ISMS standards.

BAA available for enterprise plans.

From Fortune 10 enterprises to the next generation of AI startups. Over one billion pages processed.

Read our latest updates

Pulse is now a connector in Claude's directory. Point Claude at any document by URL and get back clean, structured data without leaving the conversation.

Basin screening matrices invert the usual table shape, with rows as evaluation criteria and columns as assets, and most cells carry qualified language rather than clean values. Preserving that structure is what keeps a screening decision auditable years later.

Invoice capture stalls short of straight-through processing when line items break and routing data sits off the invoice. Calibrated confidence opens the bypass lane.

Description: Simplifyd enables businesses deliver their internet apps (websites/mobile apps) data-free, similar to toll-free telephone lines. We do this through our Zerodata app Founded in August of 2021 and based in Lagos, Nigeria and Nairobi, Kenya, Simplifyd through its Zerodata platform is a trusted marketplace for data-free internet apps. Businesses list their internet apps (websites/mobile apps) on the Zerodata platform so end users can access them data-free!
Industry: B2B
Tags: B2B
target:
Deploy fast. Ship datafree.

Datafree across mobile networks in Nigeria & Kenya. No data bundles. No drop-offs. No friction between you and the next million users.

Why Simplifyd

Everything you deploy. Nothing you don’t .

Built for African teams shipping to African users. No infrastructure to babysit. No data charges to explain. Just your app, live — and free for the people who open it.

How it works

From laptop to live in three steps .

No cluster to provision, no YAML to write. You bring a container image; Simplifyd runs it, routes to it, and meters it — all from your terminal.

Install the CLI and log in

One binary, edge. Log in once; the CLI remembers your workspace, project and environment.

Push your image

Build your container however you already do, then push it to your workspace’s private registry. The CLI fetches push credentials for you — no docker login.

Create the service and deploy

Point a service at the image and bring it up. The per-second meter starts when the container does, and stops when you take it down.

Data services

Your app and its data . One platform.

Databases, caches, queues and buckets — fully managed, billed by the second, and reachable from any service in your project over its private network.

Postgres, handled .

Production-grade Postgres clusters. Automated backups, point-in-time recovery, replicas, and a connection string — all in one CLI command.

S3-compatible buckets .

Drop-in replacement for S3. Point your existing AWS SDK at our endpoint and keep shipping — uploads, static assets, backups, archives, all in one place.

Also managed for you

The platform

The parts you only notice when they are missing .

Deploying once is easy. Running the same service for a year — through config changes, new team members, a bad release at 2am — is the part that decides whether a platform was worth it.

Running it

Two-factor authentication on every account · secrets encrypted at rest with a per-project key · data stores private by default

Your users pay no data costs .

Traffic to/from your app to subscribers on partner networks is delivered without deducting from their mobile data plan. It’s called datafree. It’s how you win in markets where data is a barrier to use.

Usage-based pricing

Pay for what runs . Nothing else.

Rates at a glance

Fast deploys. #Zerodata access.

name: Ellipsis
brief:
Product: Ellipsis
One-liner: Cloud platform for coding agents
Description: Ellipsis is a cloud platform that allows engineering teams to deploy fleets of coding agents. Each agent gets an isolated sandbox, scoped permissions, and hard budget caps. Full observability included. Get started with a $100 credit at www.ellipsis.dev. You can deploy agents for feature development, code review, and workflow automation. Creating an agent is simple: simply commit a YAML file to Github. Spawn agents from Github/Linear/Slack/etc., or via a REST API or our CLI.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, Machine Learning, AI
target:
Move your coding agents t o t h e c l o u d

Run Claude Code and Codex in cloud sandboxes with your dependencies installed. Use for Development , Code Review , Background Agents , and more.

Free for individuals with a Claude Code or Codex subscription.

Reply to the agent...

Give every task its own workspace

Run Claude Code and Codex with your repositories, dependencies, and tools already configured. Build features, fix bugs, and run tests in isolated cloud sandboxes.

Code Review

Find bugs before you merge

Ellipsis reviews pull requests against your codebase and flags bugs directly on GitHub. Set review scope and instructions to match the way your team ships.

Graphic placeholder

A pull request diff with a review finding anchored to the affected lines.

Background Agents

Keep work moving in the background

Start agents on a schedule or in response to events. Let them handle fixes and recurring maintenance, then review the changes and session logs when the work is done.

Scheduled and triggered sessions with their status, recent activity, and resulting pull requests.

Start agents from anywhere

Start, steer, and review sessions from the terminal, the web app, the API, Slack, or GitHub. Same agents, same logs, same budgets everywhere.

Governance built in Every session logged, scoped, and capped

Agents are defined in YAML

One file declares the agent and the environment it runs in: repositories, dependencies, permissions, and budgets. Check it in, review it, and audit changes like any other code.

Credentials set before the session starts

Every session runs on credentials minted just for it: the repositories it may touch, the tools it may call, nothing else. Revoked when the session ends.

Budgets that stop the session

Cap spend per session, per developer, or over time, in the same YAML. A session that hits its cap stops, and the ledger shows where every token went.

Every step is recorded

Every thinking token, tool call, and diff is recorded and attributed. Logs are searchable by the whole team, if you want.

Secure, Managed Infrastructure that is very easy to use

Ellipsis is built with governance at scale in mind. Permissions are defined before a session starts. Every agent action is logged. You have full control over your data longevity.

Scoped credentials

Minted per session, scoped to the repos you allowed, revoked with the sandbox.

Zero source retention

name: Aurorin CAD
brief:
Product: Aurorin CAD
One-liner: Claude code for Mechanical Engineers
Description: There are 2 problems: The first, CAD software is slow and the second, designing with it is a tedious process with many steps. Aurorin solves both of these problems by being a CAD software built from the ground up on a modern tech stack with AI at its heart. Building the CAD kernel lets us fully leverage AI while modernizing execution speed. Almost all existing CAD software (Solidworks, NX, Creo, Catia, Fusion 360, Onshape etc) use the same couple of underlying CAD kernels built in the 80's.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
target:
The first modern CAD software

Fast. Thoughtfully designed. AI-native. Built for modern hardware and the way engineers actually work.

The problem

CAD software shouldn't fight you

CAD is how engineers design satellites, robots, cars, and everything in between. But today's tools make you wait on rebuilds, fight cluttered interfaces, and work around limits inherited from decades ago.

Engineers shouldn't wait on their tools

Complex parts and assemblies slow today's CAD to a crawl. Engineers spend more time waiting for the software to respond than actually designing — it should be the other way around.

Every edit shouldn't break something

In a complex part, almost any change is a breaking change. A single edit cascades into manual work repairing downstream features, constraints, and references — tedious, error-prone, and completely avoidable.

The solution

CAD that feels like modern software

Aurorin is a completely new CAD system — fast, thoughtfully designed, and AI-native from day one. Built for modern hardware and the way engineers work today.

Fast feedback

Engineers shouldn't wait on their tools. Aurorin takes full advantage of modern CPUs and GPUs, so parts that take hours to load elsewhere open instantly.

AI-native

AI is built into the foundation, not bolted on later. Seamlessly combine direct editing with a chat interface to design complex parts at incredible speed.

Thoughtfully designed

Powerful software should also be intuitive and enjoyable to use. Every interaction is designed to keep you moving — so large, complex parts stay fast and approachable no matter the scale.

See it in action

See Aurorin in action

Try CAD the way it should be

Download for free on Mac and Windows, or get in touch for your team.

brief:
Product: Telmai
One-liner: Automated data observability and quality for Data Lake
Description: Telmai is a Data observability and Data Quality platform designed for Open architecture. It monitors data stored/managed in any data system, such as a data lake or data warehouse, in its raw format at scale without sampling
Industry: B2B
Tags: Analytics, AI, ML
target:
Autonomous ready data for Agentic AI

Introducing Telmai’s Data Reliability Agents. Watch the product launch announcement!

Continuous data validation and quality signal within your data lake and lakehouse so every decision runs on reliable data.

Meet Your Data Reliability Agents

Orchestration Agent

Acts as the control layer for configurations, metadata, and integrations to automate & simplify your onboarding and configurations

Validation Agent

Continuously learns data quality trends to suggest and apply validation rules, reducing manual effort and keeping pipelines reliable

Incident Diagnosis Agent

Analyzes anomalies and incidents to identify likely causes, highlighting dependencies across the pipeline for faster resolution

Lineage Agent

Maps data flows across sources and targets, helping users trace dependencies and understand downstream impact

Data Insight Agent

Transforms raw data into actionable insights by generating charts and summaries that make complex data quality trends easy to interpret

Help Agent

Acts as your guide and delivers step-by-step explanations and context, ensuring teams always have the information they need at their fingertips

Routing Agent

Directs users to the right rules, incidents, or assets, reducing time spent searching across the platform.

Customers

Data observability leader

“Great Data Quality & Observability with granular details and easy to share summary”

“Accelerated our data validations and anomaly detection work-flow using Telmai”

“Telmai offers a top-tier SaaS-based data observability platform with no/low-code development”

“AI-based data quality monitoring and anomaly detection for complex data”

Real-Time, Continuous, AI-Ready Data

Telmai continuously validates structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data as it lands in the lake

Natural Language Interfaces to Decentralize Data Trust

With Telmai’s data reliability agents, both technical and business users can set up data monitors, query data quality issues and validations in plain English

Customer stories

Buying a home is one of the biggest decisions people make, and our customers rely on us for accurate, trustworthy data. But managing property data across multiple markets, with different systems, sources, and standards alongside a multi-cloud infrastructure, makes data reliability a complex challenge. Telmai has become a critical partner in helping us stay ahead.

Marek Tuchalski

Director of Engineering for Data, PropertyGuru Group

Autonomous Detection and Continuous Resolution

Telmai’s AI-powered assistants continuously monitor data pipelines for anomalies

name: Docker
brief:
Product: Docker
One-liner: Software development platform.
Description: Docker is the world’s leading software container platform. Developers use Docker to eliminate “works on my machine” problems when collaborating on code with co-workers. Operators use Docker to run and manage apps side-by-side in isolated containers to get better compute density. Enterprises use Docker to build agile software delivery pipelines to ship new features faster, more securely and with confidence for both Linux and Windows Server apps.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Open Source, DevOps, Enterprise Software
target:
Accelerate agent adoption, safely.

Docker Sandboxes

MicroVM isolation for every agent session. Network and filesystem locked down at the runtime.

Read more about our approach

Docker AI Governance

One console for sandbox and MCP policy. Identity-bound audit logs. Zero per-machine setup.

The case for agent governance

Docker Hardened Images

Minimal, signed, continuously patched images and MCP servers. SLSA Level 3. Audit-ready by default.

See why hardened images matter

Invisible to developers. Total control for security.

Developer view

Your laptop. One command.

Governance console

Your console. Zero checks .

The runtime under every agent

Isolation you can trust

Containers proved isolation is the foundation of safe execution. microVMs extends that trust to every agent. Secure by default. Scoped by design.

Nothing to rip and replace

Your images, registries, and CI already power your AI stack. No new ecosystem. No migration. The trust chain extends to agents on the same rails.

Start local. Scale anywhere.

Agents start where developers work, on the laptop. Docker has always been that environment. Now it's purpose-built for what runs on it.

No lock-in. Ever.

Built on open standards from day one. OCI-compliant, platform-independent. That’s not changing for agents.

Unlock the Autonomy of Agents, Safely

Lower cost through trusted autonomy.

Autonomy only saves money when agents can be trusted to act alone. Built-in isolation, signed components, and runtime policy mean agents do the work, and you don't pay for the cleanup.

Ship faster. Without the breach.

Every engineer can run agents and Claude at full speed, without the business inheriting the risk. Output goes up. Audit gaps go to zero. Engineering focuses on product, not plumbing.

Compliant by default.

Identity-bound audit. Policy enforced at every step, with every action signed and documented. Evidence your auditors will actually appreciate.

name: Luminal
brief:
Product: Luminal
One-liner: Making AI run fast on any hardware.
Description: Luminal builds an ML framework and compiler that generates GPU code. Our stack 10x's model speed while simplifying deployment and cutting idle GPU costs Github: https://github.com/luminal-ai/luminal Discord: https://discord.gg/APjuwHAbGy
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: AIOps, Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, Cloud Computing
target:
Inference at the speed of light .

Luminal compiles AI models to give you the fastest, highest throughput inference in the world.

Compiled inference, not interpreted

Unlike runtime inference engines that interpret models dynamically, Luminal compiles your model ahead of time into optimized native code for GPUs and ASICs, eliminating every layer of overhead.

Graph-Level IR

Models are lowered to a minimal graph intermediate representation, a pure dataflow graph with no framework overhead.

Hardware-Aware Optimization

The compiler applies fusion, tiling, memory planning, and scheduling passes tuned for each target, GPUs and ASICs.

Zero-Overhead Codegen

Final code is emitted directly to GPU kernels or ASIC instructions with no excess runtime overhead.

Hyperscale Inference OS

Luminal dynamically schedules and load-balances inference workloads at any scale, from single accelerators up to large clusters of heterogeneous compute nodes, minimizing latency and maximizing throughput by optimizing inference topologies on-the-fly.

Heterogeneous Compute

Inference across CPUs, GPUs, and ASICs deliver maximum throughput and superior TCO.

Dynamic Load Balancing

Continuously monitors utilization across every node and redistributes work in real time to eliminate bottlenecks and hotspots.

Lightning Quick Scaling

Nodes are dynamically booted and shutdown as workloads fluctuate, meeting peak loads without excess idle capacity.

Unmatched throughput

Our compiler-first approach eliminates runtime overhead entirely. Models compiled by Luminal consistently outperform existing inference engines by 2-3x on standard benchmarks.

Choose your deployment

Managed serverless inference. Deploy in minutes, scale automatically, and only pay for what you use.

Run Luminal on your own infrastructure with dedicated support and enterprise-grade security.

Ready to accelerate your inference?

Get early access to the fastest AI inference platform in the world.

target:
The AI-native CRM for debt settlement.

Sales, client servicing, negotiations, and management visibility in one modern CRM - with AI workers automating repetitive workflows end-to-end.

Leading debt relief companies use retape.ai products today

AI workers run intake, communication, negotiation, and reporting end-to-end. Your team makes the judgment calls — not the data entries.

Six AI workers, running every stage of the lifecycle.

From first inbound call to graduation, AI workers handle the volume work end-to-end. Your team handles the judgment calls.

Convert more leads without adding more reps.

Maya — AI voice intake

Handles after-hours calls, overflow, and missed-call recovery with a voice agent trained for debt relief intake.

Aria — guided self-enrollment

A chatbot-assisted flow with automated follow-ups that walks leads through self-enrollment end-to-end.

AI call scoring

Score every sales call for compliance, performance, objections, and coaching — not just a sample.

Keep clients engaged after enrollment.

Penny — outreach campaigns

SMS and voice campaigns for NSF recovery, additional funds, and settlement authorization.

Penny — inbound support

First line of response for common client questions, requests, and status updates.

Common inbox

Manage client conversations across channels in one place — no dropped balls.

Find and act on settlement opportunities faster.

Scout — bulk settlement automation

Scout runs scrub-to-settlement for bulk creditors end-to-end — zero manual work, zero missed offers.

Scout — real-time funds tracking

POA automation

Send and track POAs without manual faxing, follow-up, or spreadsheet coordination.

AI account match

Return file ready

Live ops dashboards

Roll up sales, servicing, and negotiation KPIs into one operator view.

We map every record

Contacts, payment schedules, account notes, documents, call history. Our team migrates from your existing CRM end-to-end — your team doesn't touch a spreadsheet.

Verified before you cut over

Digitize features in geologic maps, as-builts, aerial imagery etc. in half the time with our AI Vectorizer.

United States

United Kingdom

Filter and select without writing SQL

Scale Dependent

name: ByteAsk
brief:
Product: ByteAsk
One-liner: The AI coding agent for C and C++
Description: ByteAsk is an AI coding agent built for C and C++, the code that runs trading systems, cars, chips, and operating systems. It does not stop at a diff that looks right. ByteAsk builds, debugs, and tests every change with the real toolchain until the change holds. If the compiler, the debugger, or the tests can catch it, then ByteAsk catches it too. It runs from the terminal or inside VS Code, Neovim, and Emacs, and is available fully on-prem.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, Generative AI, SaaS, Enterprise Software, AI
target:
Writes C++. Proves it compiles, runs, and passes.

ByteAsk works in your terminal. It edits the code, runs the compiler, the sanitizers and your tests, and can drive the gdb session you already have open. You review the diff.

It joins the gdb session you already have open.

Linux allows one debugger per process. If your gdb is attached, an agent that shells out to gdb gets Operation not permitted. ByteAsk connects through a bridge you start inside your own gdb, reads the live state, and asks before it runs anything that changes it.

Your gdb is stopped on the bug, and you ask an agent for help.

Your gdb holds the process. A second debugger is refused by the kernel. ByteAsk goes through the bridge you started.

How a session is wired.

Check it yourself: while your gdb holds a process, run gdb -p in another shell.

An agent that shells out to gdb can run it in batch mode on a process nobody is debugging. It cannot join the session you are in, because Linux gives each process one tracer and that tracer is your gdb. ByteAsk connects through a bridge you start inside your gdb, reads the stop state, and proposes any command that would change it.

You get the tool's full output.

ByteAsk builds with your flags, runs the sanitizers, and runs your tests. It hands back the raw report with the frames, files and line numbers intact, so you can check the agent's reasoning against the same evidence.

Nothing in these two blocks was typed by hand. They are what the tools printed.

Use our models, your key, or your own server.

Sign in and use OpenAI, Anthropic and Google models through ByteAsk. No API key to paste.

Use your own OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini key. Traffic goes straight to the provider, not through ByteAsk.

Point ByteAsk at vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, TGI, SGLang or a LiteLLM proxy. Self-hosted models are not metered.

Reference documents it can cite

Seven built-in reference tools search these standards and datasheets and return the exact passage with a page citation. If there is no match, they say so instead of guessing.

Install.

One command on Linux, macOS or Windows, or a plugin for your editor. Sign in with a link sent to your email.

Install

One line on Linux, macOS or Windows, or an editor plugin.

Sign in

brief:

One-liner: Sourcify helps brands manufacture products in Asia.
Description: Sourcify is a profitable high growth sourcing platform that helps ecommerce brands and Fortune 500s manufacture products in Asia.
Industry: B2B / Retail
Tags: Manufacturing, Supply Chain
target:
Manufacturing Runs on Relationships

Your outsourced manufacturing team, in the regions where you need it

Used by 200+ brands across 40+ product categories

What is Sourcify?

Sourcify is the relationship-based sourcing partner for brands that need manufacturing. People who understand your product work with factories they know, backed by boots on the ground across 17 countries.

How it works · Fractional sourcing · Manufacturing regions

Boots on the ground across 17 countries

Local teams and partners support communication, quality, and escalation where manufacturing happens. This map shows presence, not a searchable factory directory.

Finding a factory is not the same as building a manufacturing relationship

Directories and AI tools can produce lists of factory names. They rarely tell you who communicates under pressure, who handles quality consistently, or who stays engaged when something goes wrong. That is the work Sourcify does.

How Sourcify works

We start with human knowledge. Local teams handle communication, quality, and escalation. Technology helps the team stay organized; it does not replace the relationship.

Understand your product and goals

We learn your product, stage, requirements, volumes, timing, and what success looks like before recommending a path.

Present manufacturing fit with context

Factories are introduced by people who understand capabilities, constraints, and commercial alignment, not scraped database rows.

Support execution on the ground

Local teams help with communication, production oversight, quality coordination, and escalation across manufacturing regions.

Stay involved as needs grow

From diversification and category expansion to Managed Manufacturing, we help the relationship progress over time.

Manufacturing support that matches how you operate

Four ways brands work with Sourcify. Each is grounded in relationship-based sourcing and leads to a Discovery Call when it fits.

Managed manufacturing

Sourcify's core offer: an embedded manufacturing operations partnership across factories, quality, logistics, and strategy — with boots on the ground.

Product manufacturing

Project support from factory fit and sampling through production oversight and delivery — a common ramp into Managed Manufacturing.

Fractional sourcing

Ongoing support for manufacturing operations without a full internal sourcing team — a lighter ramp that often expands into Managed.

Factory diversification

Structured work to reduce concentration and tariff risk: second sources, China+1 strategy, and relationship-based transitions.

Trusted by brands navigating real manufacturing complexity

Years of manufacturing relationships

Countries with boots on the ground

Brands supported

In sourced products

What our clients say

“There were no hidden costs. Just open communication at every stage. That level of honesty has built a trust that's hard to find in this industry.”

name: Zenflow
brief:
Product: Zenflow
One-liner: Medical device that provides a more effective, less invasive…
Description: Forty million men in the US and over 500 million worldwide suffer from urinary obstruction related to benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). The majority of men will experience symptoms of this disease at some point in life. BPH, also known as prostate enlargement, leads to urinary straining, frequency, urgency, and sleep disruption.
Industry: Healthcare / Medical Devices
Tags: Medical Devices
target:
Zenflow Spring ® Relief Without Regrets

Clinically proven, long-lasting BPH relief men can confidently say yes to.

Zenflow Spring is designed to prioritize men's comfort and deliver symptom relief that medications often can’t.

Gentle approach with a flexible scope

Opens the blocked urethra

Symptom relief beyond what medications deliver*

*Based on independent clinical studies; no head-to-head comparison has been conducted between the Spring and BPH medications.

The effects of BPH medications can extend throughout the body. 1, 2, 3

Until now, over 40 million men with BPH have been forced to choose between two unappealing options: a lifetime of medications that may provide limited relief with ongoing side effects or the trauma of invasive surgery. Because both invasive surgery and medications can negatively impact quality of life, many men choose to “wait and see” instead of taking care of their BPH. But over time, bladder symptoms can worsen. The good news? Zenflow Spring eliminates these compromises and provides relief that you can confidently say yes to.

How Zenflow Spring is Different

Freedom From Medications

96% of men treated with Zenflow report enjoying life entirely free from BPH medications one year later, and there were zero surgical retreatments.

Maintains Sexual Function

100% of sexual function is preserved and the procedure is reversible.

Gentle and Safe

A simple procedure that can be done in office with no cutting or piercing, where most men experience only mild discomfort and 99% do not require a post-procedure catheter. Get back on your feet in hours —not days or weeks.

Fully Reversible

Zenflow Spring can be removed by your doctor at any time with no lasting side effects.

Talk to your doctor about benefits and risks to see if Spring is right for you. All clinical data presented on this page are derived from the ZEST Pilot Study and the BREEZE Pivotal Study. Data on File.

Built by Listening to Men Who Refused to Compromise

Men told us they wanted:

Real relief without the systemic side effects of drugs

A comfortable procedure

A fast return to normal life

Confidence in their decision

No risk to their sexual health

So we built Spring around those priorities — a treatment designed to deliver meaningful relief without sacrificing what matters most.

Spring Relief Without Regrets

You don’t have to live with the symptoms. And you don’t have to sacrifice what matters most to fix them. With Zenflow Spring, you can move forward confidently, knowing you chose relief without regret.

brief:
Product: Palitronica Inc
One-liner: Detect cyber attacks on critical physical infrastructure
Description: Palitronica builds and deploys cutting-edge solutions to defend critical physical infrastructure and its supply chain. By using side-channel information from endpoints, Palitronica provides a safe attack detection capability retrofittable to critical systems.
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: Hard Tech, Hardware, Security
target:
Electronics testing platform rooted in physics and AI

QUALITY & CYBER IN ONE STEP

Our Solutions

Palitronica for Manufacturing Quality Control

Improve and simplify the testing of your products with a rapid, one pass test.

Palitronica for Cyber Supply Chain Assurance

Deal with increasing risk and required compliance through testing not trust.

Palitronica provides a platform to ensure the authenticity, integrity, and quality of electronics hardware.

Our solutions cater to the unique needs of the automotive, aerospace and defense industries.

Organizations we’ve worked with

Electronics Hardware Testing Platform

Non-destructive testing of assemblies, components or modules that uses Artificial Intelligence to identify critical differences from your established and verified (known good) profile or golden sample. Anvil Checkpoint uses a black box approach—you don’t need to expose your designs or IP—to identify potentially dangerous or expensive anomalies before components move into your supply chain. The broad-spectrum sweep automatically detects any anomaly, whether previously known or unknown. And the Anvil CheckPoint is flexible, using your connectors or integrated bed-of-nails, to connect to unit under test on the test bed.

Fully black box

No Prior Knowledge Required Skip the schematics, BOMs, and programming. No IP Leakage Keep your intellectual property secure—no reverse engineering, no data extraction, no risk.

Broad Spectrum

Detects Defects, Oversights, and Fraud Anvil Checkpoint flags anything that deviates from your expected baseline, even if you've never seen the issue before. Built to Catch What Others Miss Identifies electrical and structural anomalies even when they are invisible to traditional techniques.

Flexible

Multiple Interface Options Use existing connectors for quick, reusable access or deploy a bed-of-nails (BoN) fixture for boards without accessible interfaces. One Tool, Many Targets Anvil Checkpoint supports a wide range of assemblies, modules, and microcircuits. It’s a single solution for diverse hardware

Award Winning Technology

Founded on over a decade of research

Palitronica provides quality assurance and cyber security solutions for the Zero Trust Supply Chain. Using the most state-of-the-art physics based approach, Palitronica's technology helps guard against manufacturing defects, counterfeits and knock-offs, as well as malicious hardware and software attacks.

US patents 12,366,604 11,119,127 11,630,135 11,632,313 11,588,831

Patents Pending

EP 20870043.5A US 17/886,906 18/224,214 18/203,004

Industry: Fintech / Credit and Lending
Tags: Fintech, SaaS, API
target:
ONE STOP FINTECH SOFTWARE FOR BANKS & NBFCs - Powered by AI

Banks & NBFCs Have Trusted OneFin System to Manage Rs 20000 Crore+ Worth of Loans

WHY ONEFIN

End to End System

OneFin provides LOS (Loan Origination System), LMS (Loan Management System), Collection System, Accounting System etc for Banks & NBFCs, all seamlessly integrated with each other. Clients can also pick and choose any or all out of these systems. Within each of this system, the capabilities are exhaustive including Multi-channel Sourcing Module, BRE, KYC, Disbursements, NACH, Accounting, Banking Reconciliation, Customer Portal etc.

Low Code Configurable Software

OneFin’s Low Code Configuration Software allows extremely customizable workflows and configurations. You can enable different processes, rules and steps based on parameters like financial product, partner, program etc. All this can be done without lot of code changes - leading to quicker iteration cycles and faster business go-lives.

Powerful API Suite

OneFin Software comes with a powerful API suite that allows to and fro real time communication of information, statuses etc with internal & external systems. This could be for a fintech partnership or for other systems within your organization to connect in real time with the OneFin system. Check out our Exhaustive API suite below.

70+ External Integrations

OneFin LOS (Loan Origination System) & LMS (Loan Management System) have integrations with 70+ external services to empower you to unlock the potential of external vendors. These include Bureaus, Banking Analysis Providers, Anti-Fraud Tools, KYC Service Providers, SMS Gateways, eNach, eSign, Banking APIs, Payment Gateways, Accounting Systems etc.

Security You Can Trust

At OneFin, security is our top priority. We implement bank-grade security protocols, ensuring customer data remains protected at all times. Our platform undergoes regular security audits to maintain compliance with industry standards & proactively identify vulnerabilities. By leveraging powerful security tools, including advanced encryption & access controls, we provide a robust and resilient infrastructure. With a track record of zero data breaches , we are committed to maintaining the highest level of security. OneFin is also ISO 27001:2022 certified Verify certificate

PRODUCTS - LOS, LMS & more

OneFin system comes with multiple products to help you manage your end to end business requirements. These include Loan Origination Software (LOS), Loan Management Software (LMS) & many more. Our awesome engineers are constantly working on new additions, so do check this space out for cool new additions.

Named brokers on the hard files.

A simpler path between a retail agent and the right market.

Send us the submission.

Email, ACORD, screenshot, one sentence. We meet you where your workflow already is.

We go to the right markets.

Curated to the risk, not sprayed across a list. Admitted and non-admitted markets, Lloyd's, specialty MGAs.

Every thread, live.

Status, carrier responses, open questions. A running file note for the people working the account.

Terms compared side by side. Clean binders, policy checked, delivered.

Live, not a status email.

Everyone, same page.

Producers, managers, auditors, carriers all on one file. No PDF ping-pong, no stale attachments, no "forward the latest." The file is the latest.

Clean binders, delivered.

Policy checked against the quote. Subjectivities tracked through delivery. A clear file history stays with the account.

Wholesale coverage knowledge for difficult commercial risks.

Start with the coverage, class, state, forms, and decision facts. Hedge confirms current fit and the usable market route after reviewing the account.

Research the class. Build the packet. Then ask Hedge to review it.

Hedge publishes connected class, coverage, market, form, and submission resources for retail agents and their authorized software agents.

name: Perlara
brief:
Product: Perlara
One-liner: Perlara: building the YC for rare disease parents
Description: Perlara 1.0 (Feb 2014 - Feb 2019) launched early R&D joint ventures called PerlQuests with highly motivated rare disease families, companies or impact investors. We screened gene-edited patient avatars for repurposable drugs in order to build a predictive R&D engine called ArkBase. We planned to monetize programs based on ArkBase predictions by selectively spinning out asset-centric clinical development NewCos.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
target:
Novel medicines for underinvested inherited metabolic diseases.

Powered by rare disease biology. Built for targeted rescue.

We’re a full-stack drug discovery and development company for inherited metabolic diseases: congenital disorders of glycosylation, mitochondrial disorders, GPI-anchor defects, tRNA-synthetase syndromes, and the long tail of ultra-rare metabolic biology.

A category big pharma has systematically declined.

Inherited metabolic diseases (IMDs) are individually ultra-rare but collectively enormous — about 15% of the world’s ~10,000 rare diseases. Most have a single known causitive gene, a pediatric onset, and no approved therapy. They’re exactly the programs legacy pharma de-prioritizes, and exactly where a yeast-first, patient-partnered approach excels.

From 12 programs to ~600.

Our explicit goal: scale from a dozen active IMD programs today to several hundred over the next decade. That's a sizeable chunk of the addressable IMD universe, and a transformative expansion over the status quo.

Mitochondria. Glycosylation. GPI. tRNA.

Pharmacological deficiency models of every electron transport chain complex (CI–CV), N-glycosylation defects (PMM2, ALG11, DHDDS), GPI-anchor disorders (PIGN, PIGW), and aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases (NARS1, FARS2, MTAARS2).

Families are the platform.

Every program is anchored by a specific family or foundation. The yeast screen, the patient-cell validation, the 1-to-N protocol, and the registrational trial are all on one shared timeline.

Maggie’s Pearl — epalrestat for PMM2-CDG.

A parent-initiated N-of-1 study of a decades-old Japanese diabetic-neuropathy drug became a 38-patient Phase III at Mayo Clinic Minnesota in under three years for less than $5M. That cadence is the Perlara 3.0 standard. ‍

“We went from a single child on compassionate-use epalrestat to a registrational trial in three years on less than $5M in patient-foundation capital. This is what community medicine looks like.”

The REMIT engine.

R epurposing with E ngineered M odels of I nherited metabolic disease T argets. A four-stage engine: build the yeast avatar, screen a standardized library, validate in patient cells, advance through IND-enabling and trials.

Notes from the founder.

Our working notebook is Perlara’s Substack, Cure Odysseys, where each Cure Odyssey is a single disease, family, and yeast model moving together through the pipeline.

Yeast hits validated in patient fibroblasts

Six of twelve top yeast rescuers for SURF1 Leigh Syndrome reproduced in patient fibroblasts — the strongest yeast-to- human translation signal we’ve measured.

Restoring balance to the flux

In GMPPA-CDG, loss of GMPPA causes runaway GMPPB and hypermannosylation. Two wrongs make a right: dosing a GMPPB inhibitor restores flux.

Pharma Chameleon — epalrestat for PMM2-CDG

name: Enjamb Labs
brief:
Product: Enjamb Labs
One-liner: The AI Workforce for Biopharma
Description: I run Enjamb. We've worked with 130 life science companies, preclinical through phase 3, to deploy AI securely inside the systems they already work in. Pharma runs on decades of closed software like Benchling, Veeva, Medidata, and SAS. None of it has an AI layer or speaks MCP, so agents cannot reach the systems where the work lives. Enjamb is that layer. Our agents run on top of existing systems and data, with no migration, and they reach the lab systems and internal tools no other AI touches.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, SaaS, B2B, Biotech, Automation
target:
AI Workforce for Biopharma

Backed by Combinator Read more →

The world's largest pharmaceutical companies trust Enjamb with the work that brings a drug to market.

Enjamb is AI designed for biopharma. Put your science, systems, and expertise to work on one secure platform.

Built around the way your company works.

Enjamb works inside Slack and Teams, connects to your company's systems, carries what your team knows, and stays attributable end to end.

Channel setup

Where your team already works

Tag Enjamb in Slack, Teams or Google Chat and it works in the thread, as you, with your permissions.

Connected to everything you run

Benchling, Veeva, Medidata Rave, CDD Vault, Seqera and Latch, plus the LIMS and internal tools no connector gallery covers.

Why did we change the BX-2 buffer?

pH drift traced to the lot-3 excipient, not the process. Buffer changed ahead of the Q4 runs and the excursion did not recur. The original call was made by CMC, not by stability.

Answered 14 Mar · 4 sources

Which CRO ran the stability arm?

Institutional memory

What four people knew separately becomes one line the whole organisation can call, and it stays after they leave.

Every action attributable

The agent holds no credentials. It acts as whoever asked, and each call resolves to a named person and the run that produced it.

Enjamb works across the drug program

Measurable progress across the entire drug program.

Hours saved per month

Faster to a submission-ready first draft

Biopharma professionals using Enjamb

Biopharma companies using Enjamb

Scientific workflows completed in Enjamb

Compliant with the most rigorous security and safety standards.

Enjamb meets the highest industry standards for security and compliance. We include all the default controls enterprise teams expect: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, audit logs, IP allow-listing, data residency and lifecycle management, and more.

SOC 2 Type II

Independently audited controls for security, availability and confidentiality.

ISO 27001

Certified information security management across the platform.

HIPAA

Protected health information handled under HIPAA-compliant processes and controls.

Per-user attribution

The agent holds no credentials of its own. It acts as whoever asked, with their permissions, enforced below the model.

No model training

Your data is never used to train or fine-tune any model, by us or by any provider.

Certifications in progress.

Bring Biopharma-Class AI Into Your Company

name: Antigen
brief:
Product: Antigen
One-liner: Continuous offensive security for the enterprise.
Description: Antigen is an AI adversary for the enterprise. It maps, exploits, and secures your attack surface through nightly automated offensive testing and monthly human red team assessments. Every finding is delivered with traces, reproduction steps, and remediation directly in GitHub, Linear, or the Antigen Platform. We work with companies in financial services, healthcare, retail, and government where security is trust. We're backed by Lightspeed, DST Global, and Susa Ventures.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Cybersecurity, AI
target:
Antigen is the AI adversary that maps, exploits, and secures your entire attack surface.

Anyone can hack now. AI can now find and exploit vulnerabilities on its own.

Meet tCell, our offensive agent. It runs the same attacks on your infrastructure, first.

Chains exploits into working attacks

tCell links weaknesses the way an attacker would. One small gap opens the path to the next, until it reaches something that matters. Scanners see the pieces; tCell finds the route.

Probes your systems like an attacker

tCell signs into accounts, moves between them, and maps your full attack surface. It hunts for cross-tenant leaks, broken isolation, and misconfigured access. It tests like someone with intent would and not like a checklist.

Finds what point-in-time audits miss

tCell routinely finds vulnerability missed by years of point-in-time audits. Your engineering team ships new changes daily; tCell keeps up where ordinary pentests don't.

Security at the speed you ship.

Point-in-time testing and continuous testing

Point-in-time pentesting

Vulnerabilities frozen at audit time.

Continuous pentesting

Find, fix, verify

The lifecycle of a vulnerability

Discover vulnerabilities

Every finding comes with a working exploit

Antigen probes your live attack surface the way an attacker would, chaining weaknesses traditional security scanners report in isolation into paths that actually reach sensitive data.

Every finding arrives with a reproducible exploit attached, so instead of a backlog of hypothetical CVEs, you start with confirmed, exploitable routes.

Remediation and review

Antigen makes your team faster

Antigen writes the fix, opens a pull request with the patch, and updates your project management tool. But nothing merges on its own: the PR routes to your engineers, who review and approve before anything reaches production.

Integrates with

Verification by pentest

tCell reattempts the exploit to verify the fix

In security, fixing a vulnerability often surfaces a deeper, underlying problem. Antigen runs in a loop, so after deploying the fix, tCell reattempts the exploit. If new issues are surfaced, it reopens the vulnerability with detailed logs, and writes a new patch using what it learned.

Experts in the loop

Each customer gets a dedicated security expert.

In the platform with you A researcher works inside Antigen alongside your team.

Unsigned webhook endpoint ...

Hi Tyler, how can I help?

Abdullah Nauman

Your dedicated expert

Book office hours anytime.

Our researchers will hop on a call, walk your team through a finding, or think through your setup with you.

brief:
Product: RocketLit
One-liner: RocketLit is an adaptive learning and assessment platform.
Description: RocketLit gives all students better access to learning and educators access to the data they need to be most impactful. Our first product, RocketLit, is an adaptive and personalized learning platform that serves reading to students at their independent level. Students read the same content at different levels of complexity and fluidly move up reading levels as they improve.
Industry: Education
Tags: Education, Edtech
target:
Education tailored and adapted to each student's reading level

Reading Levels Diagnosed

We figure out what your students need and personalize reading to each student's own reading level.

Adaptive Reading

As comprehension improves, we constantly adapt student reading levels by moving each student up and down when they're ready.

Engaging Curriculum Based on Standards

Find tons of NGSS aligned non-fiction in one place, written in a fun voice students love, filled with analogies they can grasp.

name: Aemon
brief:
Product: Aemon
One-liner: The Forward-Deployed AI Research Engineer
Description: Aemon is the first autonomous research engineer that delivers state-of-the-art solutions to your engineering problems. It generates, tests, and evolves thousands of approaches at machine speed to discover optimal solutions beyond what human experts can find. Aemon already set a new world record on an NP-hard math optimization problem with <$10 of compute, beating the previous record set by Google DeepMind in 2025. Ray and Richard (twin brothers) dropped out of UWaterloo and UIUC to build Aemon.
Industry: B2B
target:
Your next breakthrough, found by AI.

Aemon is where Self-accelerating AI Research meets your hardest technical problems.

Proactive, self-accelerating research

One autonomous system that learns the frontier, experiments inside your codebase, and delivers validated technical breakthroughs that become your moat.

A world-record result, found by Aemon.

This replay visualizes one real Aemon research session: surpassing Google DeepMind’s 2025 AlphaEvolve result on Circle Packing, a classic NP-hard optimization problem, using under $10 of compute.

Replay visualization — not the product UI, and not the limit of what Aemon can solve.

of compute

Working with Us

From first call to technical breakthroughs in two weeks.

Eval Setup

We start with your hardest technical goal and define what success means: metrics, baselines, constraints, and the failure cases that matter.

Evaluation Locked

An Aemon engineer works with your team to harden the eval: datasets, production constraints, regression checks, and trusted success criteria.

Aemon Deployed

Aemon connects to your codebase and research context, then begins running self-accelerating research loops on your hardest problems.

Live & Running

Aemon continuously studies the frontier, runs experiments, learns from every result, and ships validated improvements back to your team.

Aemon is an applied research team focused on building the future of R&D. We’re building AI to bring frontier research into the real world.

name: Shiraz AI
brief:
Product: Shiraz AI
One-liner: Robots that learn on the job
Description: We deploy robots that learn new tasks from a single human demonstration in the factory. We're starting in contract manufacturing, where lines change every week and both traditional automation and today's VLAs fall over. Our founding team has 20+ years of experience in robotics. Navid was part of the core team that productized Spot at Boston Dynamics and led manipulation projects there. Before that, he was at Rethink Robotics.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Generative AI, Robotics, Manufacturing
target:
Robots that learn on the job.

Shiraz builds a robot foundation model that learns a new manufacturing task from a single human demonstration — delivered working on your line: hardware, model, and deployment.

San Francisco, CA · 37.7749° N, 122.4194° W · YC S26

Sec. 01 Field demonstration

Watch the demo

Sec. 02 Operating principle

What we do

Show

A person demonstrates the task once, on video. No programming, no CAD, no teach pendant.

Learn

Our foundation model adapts in context from that single demonstration — no retraining, no data-collection campaign.

Work

The robot runs the task on your line. We deliver the full stack: hardware, model, and on-site deployment.

Note Why now

High-mix manufacturing changes too fast for traditional automation. Factory owners tell us the same two things: they can’t hire enough people, and the automation they’ve bought is too rigid and too expensive — so it sits idle. We built Shiraz for lines that change every week.

Status — operational

Our robots are already operational at customer sites.

Sec. 03 Personnel

Team

Two decades of combined experience shipping real robots.

Navid Aghasadeghi

Co-founder & CEO

Part of the team that commercialized Spot at Boston Dynamics, where he led manipulation projects. Previously Rethink Robotics.

Mojtaba Mozaffar

Co-founder & CTO

Led whole-body control and bimanual manipulation at Amazon Robotics. Formerly Research Assistant Professor at Northwestern University.

Sec. 04 Open positions

We’re hiring world-class roboticists.

Foundation models, manipulation, and real-world deployment. San Francisco, CA.

Direct to the founders — no recruiters, no forms.

brief:

One-liner: Powering scientific outsourcing
Description: Science Exchange powers R&D outsourcing for the world’s top life sciences companies. Our marketplace gives scientists access to the innovation and research they need and our platform fully automates R&D outsourcing from source to pay so scientists can focus on what they love—science.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare Services
Tags: SaaS, Health Tech, Biotech, Enterprise
target:
Life Sciences R&D Moves Faster Without the Friction.

INTELLIGENT INFRASTRUCTURE FOR SCIENCE

When the operational friction disappears, science moves at the speed of discovery: not the speed of the process around it. Science Exchange's intelligent infrastructure is how life sciences organizations get there.

Trusted by industry visionaries

THE PROBLEM

Science has advanced. Its infrastructure has not.

Life sciences organizations are advancing faster than ever: new modalities, distributed research models, and increasingly specialized partners. But the systems supporting that work remain fragmented.

Finding qualified research partners takes weeks. Contracts require months of negotiation. Onboarding a new provider means starting a process that, on average, consumes more than 50 hours before any work begins. The problem isn't the people managing it. It's that the infrastructure around R&D was built for a different era. Generic procurement tools, siloed contracting processes, and fragmented payment workflows were not designed for the speed and compliance requirements of life sciences research.

When programs run behind, the cost is measured in delayed outcomes, missed opportunities, and time that can't be recovered.

WHAT SCIENCE EXCHANGE DOES

One Platform. Every Research Relationship.

Science Exchange centralizes R&D research operations: sourcing qualified partners, executing contracts, managing compliance, and processing payments, all under one platform and one master service agreement covering thousands of pre-vetted providers.

What used to take 50 hours now takes 6. That reduction is not a projection. It is what organizations running on Science Exchange experience.

Built for Everyone Who Touches R&D Operations

Scientists and R&D Leaders Access qualified research partners without the procurement overhead. Start projects sooner.

Procurement Teams Standardized processes, pre-negotiated frameworks, and visibility across every active research relationship.

Finance and Legal Compliance built in. Unified contract structure. Audit-ready documentation on every engagement.

Operations and Quality Onboarding automation, spend visibility, and consistent process across the entire research portfolio.

The organizations setting the standard for life sciences R&D run on Science Exchange.

name: Serna Bio
brief:
Product: Serna Bio
One-liner: Genetic Medicine with Small Molecules
Description: Serna Bio is developing small molecules to modulate RNA function, unlocking the potential to treat diseases driven by biology intractable by other modalities.
Industry: Healthcare / Therapeutics
Tags: Biotech, Drug discovery
target:
Precision Control of Protein Expression

Beyond inhibition. Beyond the proteome. ‍ Small molecules that control protein expression through RNA biology.

Shifting the small molecule paradigm from the proteome to the transcriptome

Our platform bypasses the inherent limitations of protein-centric discovery by targeting functional RNA motifs directly.

A new way to control biology.

Proteins drive disease. But controlling the production of those proteins has remained largely beyond the reach of small molecules. Serna Bio uses RNA biology and small-molecule chemistry to precisely regulate protein expression - opening therapeutic opportunities inaccessible to conventional drug discovery.

One Platform: Multiple Directions

Downregulate Protein Expression

Reduce disease-driving proteins by selectively modulating RNA translation.

Upregulate Protein Expession

Restore insufficient protein expression or amplify therapeutic proteins.

Modulate RNA splicing

Redirect isoform expression to correct disease-driving splicing defects.

An AI-native platform for RNA drug discovery

Serna Bio has built an AI-native discovery engine specifically for RNA. Our Discovery Platform combines proprietary data sets covering 200,000+ experimentally determined RNA pockets, 3M+ RNA–small molecule interactions, and an agentic AI system purpose-built for RNA drug discovery . Our platform integrates target discovery, hit identification, and lead optimization to systematically discover small molecules that modulate RNA biology.

Target Discovery

Identify clinically relevant, druggable RNA pockets using our atlas of 200,000+ experimentally determined RNA structures, 100× larger than the public domain .

Hit Discovery

Screen proprietary RNA–small molecule libraries to identify functional compounds, delivering 20× higher hit rates for compounds that can advance to lead optimization.

Lead Optimization

Accelerate potency and selectivity with an AI-driven chemistry platform purpose-built for RNA–ligand interactions, achieving 10× faster optimization in a single design–make–test cycle.

First-in-class programs for intractable biology.

Powered by proprietary datasets and machine learning , we are advancing a pipeline of first-in-class programs to address unmet needs unreachable by other modalities.

name: Multiply Labs
brief:
Product: Multiply Labs
One-liner: Robotic production capacity for the pharma manufacturing industry
Description: The traditional manufacturing process for individualized drugs is extremely slow and expensive, because it is based on manual labor. At Multiply Labs, we believe that robotics is the only way to truly scale the production of individualized drugs - finally providing these life-saving therapies to the millions of patients who need them. We develop cloud-controlled modular robotic systems that manufacture individualized drugs, and we deploy these systems in the facilities of our pharma customers.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Robotics
target:
Physical AI for biological manufacturing

Our robots are making sure that 'too expensive' and 'not enough' no longer stand between a patient and their cure.

Patients are waiting for advanced therapies. The factory floors are not ready.

The next generation of biological drugs is showing incredible promise in terms of safety and efficacy. The science is working. But the manufacturing stack, built decades ago for small molecules and large batches, was never designed for the complexity, precision, and throughput that advanced therapies now demand. What worked for the last generation of pharma can't work for the next.

Closed. Automated. Scalable.

Through imitiation learning, parallel orchestration, and real-time monitoring, our robots enable your existing instrument ecosystem to scale. When demand doubles, deploy another cluster, scaling throughput without increasing process complexity.

Your instruments. One autonomous system.

The Cluster connects your existing GMP instruments inside a closed, automated environment. Your process stays the same. Your throughput increases by up to 100x, and costs decrease by 74%.

Every unit operation. Fully automated.

Biologics manufacturing is made up of dozens of discrete unit operations, each one requiring a highly controlled, closed sterile environment and strong repeatability across every transfer, every dispense, every interaction. Multiply Labs automates the entire sequence inside a closed, GMP-ready system.

Each operation is orchestrated by robotic arms operating in sterile environments, significantly reducing contamination risk, and executing with precision run after run.

Fully integrated control, connected with your quality system.

Multiply Labs' software enables your manufacturing protocol to be robotically executed, collecting every sensor reading and every interaction in real time. We deliver complete electronic records directly to you and your quality system.

The fully robotic biologics factory is inevitable

Physical AI and robotics now make reliable closed-loop biomanufacturing economically viable. We build the technology that enables you to get there first.

Meet the Multipliers.

Roboticists, scientists, and engineers building the robotic future of biomanufacturing.

Experience the future of biomanufacturing.

Schedule a visit to our facility in San Francisco and see the robotic manufacturing platform with your own eyes.

name: Hoplite
brief:
Product: Hoplite
One-liner: Effortlessly deploy cloud software factories.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, Cloud Computing, AI
target:
Build with swarms of cloud agents

Hoplite turns ideas into built, tested, verified software at the speed of thought.

From Local To Cloud Agents In Four Steps

We import your local config, instantly set up automations, and run your projects in the cloud.

Connect a repository

Point Hoplite at any GitHub repo. We pull in your codebase and branch structure so your agents have full context from the first prompt.

Import your local setup

Your sessions, MCP servers, memories, and CLIs all come with you. Hoplite mirrors your local machine in the cloud — no painful setups or manual config.

Start an agent in a sandbox

Agents run in isolated sandboxes, meaning you can run hundreds concurrently without worrying about resource constraints.

Verify and merge

Hoplite prepares video recordings of all new features, out of the box. Easily confirm the agent's output without needing to juggle ports.

Use cases

Deploy Into Every Part Of The Development Lifecycle

With Hoplite, automate everything from issue triage to complex migrations.

Spin up threads as soon as new Sentry issues are created, and merge before they become real production incidents.

One-click share links mean threads can be easily handed off between engineers and stakeholders.

With deep integrations into Linear and Slack, you can spin up and monitor threads from your existing preferred tools. The agent picks up the context and gets to work.

Every pull request gets a full video walk through of the user flow -- before and after the change. Verify without needing to manually step through everything.

Scale To Infinity.

Run agents in parallel, each in its own isolated sandbox. Fan out a whole backlog at once and review the results as they finish.

Security & privacy

Built From The Ground Up For The Most Secure Workloads.

Every session runs in an isolated sandbox, and your data is never sold, shared, or used to train models—by us or anyone else.

Never trained on your code

We don't train on your data, and neither do the model providers you connect. Your codebase is used to do the work you asked for, and nothing else.

Encrypted end to end

Your code and credentials are encrypted in transit and at rest. Bring your own keys, and keep full control of what each agent can access.

Isolated by default
