One-liner: Let your users build their own features on top of your product
Description: Vendo is the customization layer that lets your users build their own features and micro-apps directly on top of your product. Rather than waiting on an ever-growing feature backlog, your users can personalize the product to exactly how they work, create their own automations, and integrate hundreds of external tools, all without your team writing a line of code.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B, Customer Success, Open Source
target:
Your product, shaped to every customer.

An open-source customization layer. Your users build their own features and micro-apps, right on top of your product.

The interface that builds itself.

Your customers describe what they need, and your product assembles it live. Not throwaway generated UI: real micro-apps with actions, automations, and state, theirs to keep. No ticket, no roadmap, no waiting.

“What did I spend when I should’ve been asleep?”

Any slice of your product, composed into a working dashboard.

“Every Monday at 7” becomes software that runs itself.

Gmail, Slack, GitHub, connected as themselves.

UI, data, and logic assembled live. The interface builds itself.

It learns your product. It never exceeds it.

One command reads your repo and learns everything: your components and colors, your API as callable tools, your permission rules. What it builds wears your brand, runs sandboxed as the signed-in customer, and never steps outside permissions they already have.

One app. Everywhere your customer already is.

Free where it matters.

The single-player agent is complete and open source, with the LLM judge and metering included. Cloud is everything multiplayer.

Embedded in an afternoon.

Two commands. Vendo reads your app, learns your theme, and shows you every change before it writes a line. Then it checks its own work.

Try everything, solo On Vendo Cloud

Everything multiplayer On Vendo Cloud

Governance & visibility For whole organizations

Air-gapped self-host For the strictest environments

Everything paid unlocks with one env var: VENDO_API_KEY

Ship the product that reshapes itself.

Embedded in an afternoon. Governed by you from the first render.

brief:
Product: Officely
One-liner: Office management software for hybrid workspaces
Description: Officely takes in every kind of workplace data — desk bookings, badge swipes, Wi-Fi logins — and turns it into one accurate record of how your offices are really used. Then everything your team needs runs on top, built around how your business actually works.
Industry: B2B / Office Management
Tags: SaaS, B2B
target:
Hybrid Office Management. Without the Chaos.

Say goodbye to complicated software or messy spreadsheets. Manage your desks, meeting rooms and car parking all from Slack and Teams.

No credit card required

Free to test with your team

Join the 1,000s of hybrid teams that have already made the switch

Real teams making hybrid work with Officely

"Officely helps us better manage our hybrid team. It helps us keep tabs on who's in when, encourages in-person collaboration, and just generally makes hybrid working a breeze!"

Freya McDonnell, People Operations Manager @ nPlan

"Super easy to use and made our lives 10x easier. It's nice to know when your colleagues are booked in so you can go in and see them."

Gabriella Crow, Workspace and Events Co-ordinator @ Genie Ventures

"The best thing about Officely is the easy integration into Slack. We had an immediate acceptance rate within our team and it makes desk sharing super easy."

Stefanie Buch, Head of People and Culture @ Swat.io

No More Desk Booking Chaos

Still managing bookings with Excel and Slack or Teams threads? It’s a daily mess—missed reservations, squatting, and “is anyone in today?” messages at 8am. ‍ Officely automates it. One-click booking, daily check-ins, and full visibility—inside Slack or Teams. Desks get used. Chaos disappears. You stop firefighting.

Don’t let your office go to waste

Usage data that justifies every decision. ‍ You’re asked to reduce office space. But you’re running blind. ‍ Officely shows you who booked, who showed up, and what’s underused. Back every office decision with real numbers.

Double-Booked Rooms? Fixed.

Manage meeting spaces directly in Teams and Slack. ‍ Outlook calendars don’t cut it. Teams show up to “reserved” rooms that aren’t—and blame you. ‍ Meeting Rooms by Officely shows live availability, simplifies booking, and reduces no-shows. You stay out of the drama. Meetings run on time.

Know Who’s In. At a Glance.

Real-time attendance. No detective work. ‍ You shouldn’t have to message around to figure out who’s coming in. ‍ Officely gives you instant visibility via daily prompts and live check-ins. Now you can plan cleaning, catering, and culture—with zero guesswork.

Track Policy Compliance Automatically

name: Locata
brief:
Product: Locata
One-liner: AI Referral Automation for Primary Care Clinics
Description: Locata is an AI referral management platform for Primary Care. We deploy AI agents to automate every step of the referral process that back-office staff face daily, from submitting prior authorizations to broadcasting updates and following up with patients. This frees up staff to focus on patient care. Primary care back-offices are severely understaffed and overburdened by administrative work associated with referrals.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare IT
target:
Automate Your Referral Loop

Backed by

Agentic automation for primary care providers.

Trusted by leading clinics

Supercharge your operations

Locata automates every step of the referral process, freeing staff to focus on higher-value work, supporting compliance, and giving providers the context to deliver better care.

Optimize Staff Resources

Keep staff focused on the highest-value aspects of patient care. We'll handle everything else.

Prevent Leakage

Keep patients within your network by providing a fast and seamless referral experience. Ensure no one falls through the cracks.

Stay Compliant

Compliance is built into every workflow. Standardize your processes for each patient and eliminate any errors.

Enable Better Care

Locata unifies patient records across fragmented data silos, giving providers the complete context they need to deliver better care.

By the Numbers

Results you can measure, outcomes you can feel

Our product isn’t a platform or a tool - it’s an outcome: referral operations that are fully automated and optimized to the highest level. Less burden for staff, more visibility for providers, and faster care for patients. It's a win, win, win.

Reduction in staff workflow

3.4x

Faster prior auth submission

2.2x

Increase in patient touchpoints

The complete solution to referral bottlenecks

There are dozens of steps between the PCP, payer, and specialist to get patients the care they need. Locata handles every one of them.

Authorization Submission

Locata's AI learns your submission rules around preferred specialists, CPT codes, and attachments. Our systems then automatically submit authorizations to payers. Process standardization leads to fewer denials and faster approvals.

Real-Time Updates

Locata retrieves authorization statuses and updates your EMR directly. No more manually logging in to check each auth. You'll know as soon as your patients are approved - and so will they.

Document Transmission

Locata automatically sends patient records to specialists via eFax, ensuring they have the full context needed to schedule the appointment. Once the visit is completed, we request the consult notes to close the loop.

Patient Communication

Patients receive calls and secure messages about their referrals. Our AI follows up across multiple touch points to ensure they schedule and complete their specialist visits, and alerts staff when support is needed.

Consult Note Retrieval

Locata retrieves consult notes from payer portals or directly from specialists. Our AI extracts key clinical data and routes the consult note into your EMR, giving providers full visibility into the patient’s care journey and ensuring every referral is closed.

Analytics

name: Yoshi Mobility
brief:
Product: Yoshi Mobility
One-liner: Making car ownership and management frictionless.
Description: We believe that the automotive industry will change more in the next five years than it has in the last 50. The gas station was invented in 1910 and has not changed substantially since then; traditional lube and mechanic shops have not evolved much either. To enable this industry transformation, the infrastructure required to fuel and service vehicles must evolve as well.
Industry: Consumer / Transportation Services
Tags: Autonomous Delivery, Mobility, Energy, Electric Vehicles, Automotive
target:
Keep Your Vehicles Drivers Network Platform Fleet Vehicles Moving

Yoshi is the live-video inspection platform for transportation networks. Inspections, driver qualifications, and contractor onboarding conducted virtually by qualified experts.

Live-Video Inspection At Scale

Uber, Turo, and major transportation networks already trust Yoshi to keep their assets and contractors compliant. AI-powered live video and API-ready signed results give networks the scalable inspection layer their networks demand. Our partners include:

For Transportation Networks

Marketplaces, franchise networks, brokers, and specialty transport operators use Yoshi to qualify assets and operators before they go to work — conducted over live video with signed, auditable results.

For Commercial Vehicles & Fleets

Yoshi helps fleets stay compliant without disrupting operations. Inspections are conducted over real-time video by ASE-certified inspectors and meet FMCSA standards for DOT annual inspections. Results are securely stored in your portal for easy access and audit readiness. Schedule in bulk, support multiple drivers, and manage everything from one platform built for fleet compliance. Set up your fleet account in seconds and get started.

For Rideshare Drivers & Hosts

Driving with Uber or hosting on Turo? Yoshi makes your required annual inspection fast and hassle-free. Compliant inspections are done over real-time video. We're officially integrated with Uber and trusted by thousands of earners and hosts. Just schedule online, join a quick video call, and receive a digitally-signed inspection form by email instantly.

How It Works

Schedule in Minutes

Individual drivers or contractors use our online form to choose a time and add vehicle details. Fleets can bulk-schedule inspections for multiple vehicles and drivers.

Join Your Inspection

At your scheduled time, the driver joins the video call on their phone using the link we send. Our inspector will expertly guide them through the inspection steps.

Get Instant Results

We will email the driver the signed document after the inspection is complete. Company accounts can also access results stored in their web portal.

Partner With Us

Whether you're onboarding a contractor fleet, building a marketplace, or running a franchise that needs auditable inspection records — Yoshi integrates with your platform. Let's talk about how live-video inspection fits your workflow.

Uber, Turo, and major transportation networks already trust Yoshi to keep their assets and contractors compliant. AI-powered live video and API-ready signed results give networks the scalable inspection layer their networks demand. Our partners include:

For Transportation Networks

Marketplaces, franchise networks, brokers, and specialty transport operators use Yoshi to qualify assets and operators before they go to work — conducted over live video with signed, auditable results.

For Commercial Vehicles & Fleets

Yoshi helps fleets stay compliant without disrupting operations. Inspections are conducted over real-time video by ASE-certified inspectors and meet FMCSA standards for DOT annual inspections. Results are securely stored in your portal for easy access and audit readiness. Schedule in bulk, support multiple drivers, and manage everything from one platform built for fleet compliance. Set up your fleet account in seconds and get started.

For Rideshare Drivers & Hosts

Driving with Uber or hosting on Turo? Yoshi makes your required annual inspection fast and hassle-free. Compliant inspections are done over real-time video. We're officially integrated with Uber and trusted by thousands of earners and hosts. Just schedule online, join a quick video call, and receive a digitally-signed inspection form by email instantly.

How It Works

Schedule in Minutes

Individual drivers or contractors use our online form to choose a time and add vehicle details. Fleets can bulk-schedule inspections for multiple vehicles and drivers.

Join Your Inspection

At your scheduled time, the driver joins the video call on their phone using the link we send. Our inspector will expertly guide them through the inspection steps.

Get Instant Results

We will email the driver the signed document after the inspection is complete. Company accounts can also access results stored in their web portal.

Partner With Us

Whether you're onboarding a contractor fleet, building a marketplace, or running a franchise that needs auditable inspection records — Yoshi integrates with your platform. Let's talk about how live-video inspection fits your workflow.

Learning that feels like magic

Confidence growing

Your child's own dedicated English speaking time with Annie.

kids come back to learn on their own because it's fun!

Trusted by parents

Loved by kids

"My son is pretty shy and used to hate speaking English in front of others, even at his school. But with Annie who's AI, he can practice comfortably in his own space, so we decided to subscribe."

name: Opusense AI
brief:
Product: Opusense AI
One-liner: AI for Field Inspection Reports
Description: Opusense AI automates field report writing for construction field inspectors. Instead of typing up notes at the end of the day, inspectors can now walk a site, speak observations aloud, snap photos, and let our AI assistant generate a detailed, organized report on-site and in real time. Combined, the founding team has over 15 years in the construction industry. Writing up these field reports used to take up at least 20% of the week. With Opusense, we cut that time by 5x.
Industry: Real Estate and Construction / Construction
target:
The AI-native field operations platform.

Opusense gives every organization its own AI-powered workspace for managing field operations, while making it effortless to collaborate across projects. Capture information however your team works, keep ownership of your own data, and share only what's needed with clients, consultants, contractors, and owners.

Pick the team you run.

One product, shaped around how each team actually works.

Real-time capture, built for the field

Inspect and document as you walk the site. Photo, voice, and typed notes — all synced to the cloud the moment you hit save. Full offline capability.

Photo documentation

High-resolution, time-stamped photos with automatic GPS tagging and annotation overlays. Organized by project, building, and inspector — a searchable audit trail for compliance and client recordkeeping.

Voice notes

Record observations. Hands-free speech-to-text converts every word in real time so you keep walking the site instead of typing with one hand.

Typed notes

Structured text input for detailed observations, checklists, and inspection notes — with smart templates that know what a roof, envelope, or mechanical room should contain.

Take Opusense to the site.

Capture photos, voice notes, and observations the moment you spot them — even with no signal. Everything syncs to your reports as soon as you're back online.

Bring an MP4, a MOV or a whole shoot. The first draft costs you one sentence.

This is the editor itself, not a picture of it. Press play, scrub the strip, mute a track.

A rough cut, a supercut, a vertical reel from a two hour shoot. Describe it once and Narrative delivers a finished edit on a timeline you can still open and change.

high quality edit

Edit faster than ever

The transcript, captions, versions, the frame and the models behind it all live in the same editor as the conversation.

Say what you want. The agent reads the footage, makes the cut and tells you what it did.

Anything you would say to an editor, you can say to this one. It works from the words, not a menu.

Each turn is a version. Step back to any of them, or put the project back to how a turn left it.

Fast for small changes, Balanced for most edits, Max for long footage and hard briefs.

Wedding films, podcasts, match highlights, product demos. Different footage, the same first step: say what you want.

Two hours of a wedding, one sentence: a three minute highlight with the vows in the middle. It was on the timeline before my coffee was cold, and I moved two cuts.

name: Abalone Bio
brief:
Product: Abalone Bio
One-liner: We create activating antibodies to treat diseases others can’t.
Description: Abalone Bio is tackling challenging undrugged targets underlying diseases affecting millions, focusing first cell-specific antibody drugs to treat obesity and metabolic disease without the GI side effects that cause 25% of GLP-1 drug patients to quit after 1 year.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
Tags: Machine Learning, Synthetic Biology, Therapeutics, Drug discovery
target:
The Future of Antibody Drugs is Function First

We create antibodies that activate hard-to-drug targets, unlocking therapies with fewer side effects to treat more people, more effectively.

Most antibody discovery and AI-enabled design focuses on structure or binding, not function, producing molecules limited to inhibition (or no activity at all). ‍ At Abalone Bio, we directly measure hundreds of millions of antibodies per experiment for what truly matters: functional activity. Our unparalleled proprietary large-scale activity datasets uniquely power our machine learning to create highly specific activating drugs that work where others fail, unlocking new therapies for the most challenging diseases.

Promising targets are hard-to-drug

Key targets lack drugs

Millions of patients remain untreated because drug discovery has failed to deliver therapeutics for many key disease targets.

Existing drugs lack specificity

Small molecules or peptides often have off-target interactions, resulting in intolerable side effects.

Antibodies are specific, but lack activity

Antibodies can recognize their targets with exquisite specificity. However, it has been a very difficult task to find activators.

Existing drugs lack specifity

Antibodies are specific but lack activity

We create target-activating antibodies that unlock key challenging disease targets

We have developed our Functional Antibody Selection Technology (FAST) platform to rapidly create difficult-to-discover antibody activators for challenging and promising target classes. We focus first on key G-protein coupled receptors (GPCRs), which play a role in regulating nearly every biological area.

What makes us different?

We tackle GPCRs, the hardest target class for antibodies

Unlike other target classes, which can be activated through dimerization or clustering, GPCRs require precise adjustments to their protein structures to activate or modulate them.

We measure function not just binding: 100M antibodies at once, 100X more than others

We biologically measure individual antibodies for activity in a massively parallel fashion with our engineered yeast cells that link cell survival to antibody functional against a target.

We have enabled AI to predict activating antibodies for GPCRs

We don’t only discover rare activators. With our large, proprietary activity datasets, we can design them.

We have enabled AI predict active antibodies, a first in the field

We haven’t just discovered rare activators. Using our large proprietary activity datasets , we have compiled large-scale activity data that paves the path to design.

Our leadership team

Discovering the next generation of antibody drugs

brief:
Product: HiOperator
One-liner: Customer support as a service.
Description: HiOperator provides customer support as a service. Banish your ticket backlog and free up your in-house team for higher level tasks.
Industry: B2B / Operations
Tags: Customer Service
target:
Elevate Customer Support with Generative AI Solutions

HiOperator's powerful technology personalizes customer support with a suite of automated tools including HiLite, HiAuto, Elite Agent, and more.

We Solve Your CS Pain Points

HiLite: Understand exactly why customers are writing to your company, and segment them accordingly, with auto-tagged data. ‍ ‍ HiAuto: Delight customers with quick and automated conversational responses using technology that reduces overhead as well as easily scales for seasonality. ‍ ‍ Elite Agents: Count on top-tier senior agents who are fully managed by HiOperator and directly benefit from our technology to service complex customer requests. SMSBot: Provide powerful, helpful, and conversational customer support directly to customers SMS. Now you can engage, assist, and delight customers directly on their phones.

The Intelligent Customer Service Difference

With HiOperator, your company receives a solution that aligns with your goals — from self-service auto-tagging to fully managed Elite Agents. Our technology easily connects to your existing providers — 3PLs, CRMs, Admin, OMS — and our team will have you up and running in days. No APIs? No problem! HiOperator's expert engineers are ready to help and will build a solution that fits your company’s technology stack.

Finely Tuned Technology

HiOperator uses workflow automation, refined LLMs, and generative AI to complete the entire customer service journey accurately, effectively, as well as personally. We created the most rigorous anti-hallucination frameworks so our technology stays on brand while solving tickets at the accelerated speed of today's business environment.

End-to-End Integration

HiOp aggregates all service providers' information, then auto-tagging continually tracks the customer journey, categorizes support issues, and uses this information to reinforce workflows to improve customer service.

Pay-Per-Resolution

We charge for each conversation we solve. No onboarding fees. No hourly rates. Pay for what you use.

HiOperator in the News

PRESS RELEASE: New SuperSAT Solution Scores Customer Sentiment in Real-Time

HiOperator unveils QAScout, setting new standards in customer support quality

How to create generative AI confidence for enterprise success

Transform Your Customer Service

We can onboard in a matter of days and we offer highly flexible contracts. Whether you need a large team to handle your support or some overflow assistance, getting started is easy.

HiOperator rapidly onboards fast and offers highly flexible contracts. Before you know it, our technology will augment your entire workflow — creating happy agents and satisfied customers.

name: Mailgun
brief:
Product: Mailgun
One-liner: Email API service.
Description: Mailgun is a developer-focused email delivery platform that empowers companies to send, receive, and track transactional and marketing emails through an API. Founded in 2010, Mailgun became a Y-Combinator success story later acquired by Rackspace. In February 2017, Mailgun spun back out as a standalone business focused on building best-in-class email deliverability solutions. We are headquartered in San Antonio with remote teams in San Francisco and Austin.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: API, Email
target:
Transactional Email Delivery Service & API for Developers

Is email still worth it? We surveyed 1,200+ senders and analyzed 400B emails to reveal ROI, relevance, and AI's influence. Unlock the full Email Impact report .

DELIVER EMAILS

Build with the platform that enables you to send, track, test, and optimize emails effortlessly. Get a complete email suite that delivers flawless email campaigns at scale.

Customize your email delivery and sending

No two businesses communicate alike, let alone to the same people. Pick and choose which solutions best fit your needs, with the ability to flex other tools should your strategy and goals change. Mailgun offers solutions that can be tailored to your business strategy.

Send emails

Optimize emails

Validate emails

Inspect emails

RELIABLE SCALABILITY

Send and deliver emails with assurance

Email plays a crucial role in your tech stack, and the technologies powering your email program should integrate seamlessly and scale effortlessly on a platform known for its compliance and reliability. Mailgun was built by developers, for developers. Whether you’re looking to send thousands or millions of emails to the inbox, parse incoming messages, or connect your email data to a CRM – Mailgun offers the flexibility and reliability you need to ensure your emails reach their destination, every time.

EFFORTLESS PERFORMANCE

Optimize emails with purpose

From day-to-day decision making to long-term strategic planning, we provide the perfect combination of insight and expertise you need to build and maintain a high-ROI email program. Mailgun Optimize combines two essential elements, applications and expertise, to create one comprehensive email deliverability suite.

EFFECTIVE VALIDATION

Validate email lists with accuracy

When every email counts, you can’t afford to waste time and money sending to addresses that don’t exist. Mailgun email validations leverage cached send data to deliver the fastest, most accurate results in the industry. Integrate our real-time Email Validation API or drag and drop your lists to quickly remove invalid and high-risk addresses.

Quality assurance

Preview with confidence

With the tools you know and love from Email On Acid, now built to scale for larger senders. Easily integrate trusted quality assurance tools into your email workflows with adaptable, scalable APIs you can trust with every email campaign.

BUILT ON PROOF, NOT PROMISES

The data speaks for itself

Results current customers see include

Decreased bounces

Increased open rates

Increased clicks

The leverage you need with an email delivery provider you can trust

brief:
Product: A quiet place for everything worth keeping
Description: Lightning-speed access to all your important links, from any device. Bookmark manager, golinks, and more.
target:
A quiet place for everything worth keeping.

Tefter is a bookmarking tool for people who read. Save a link from anywhere, find it again by meaning, and read it without the noise.

Your library, as Tefter keeps it

The Art of Not Reading Everything

essays.example.com · #reading #attention · saved from the extension

Πώς διαβάζουμε τώρα: σημειώσεις για την ψηφιακή ανάγνωση

kathimerini.gr · #ανάγνωση · readable, 7 min

A Field Guide to Distributed Systems

martinfowler.com · #architecture · in 2 team libraries

What Tefter does

Bookmarks that stay findable

Save any link with tags and notes, from the extension, the web, or Slack.

Lists, for what belongs together

Group bookmarks into a reading queue, a project, a syllabus. Keep a list to yourself, or give it a link and share it with anyone.

A reader worth reading in

Every article is kept in a clean, readable form — typography first, clutter never.

Kept, even when it is taken down

Tefter saves a copy of the page as it was the day you found it. When the link rots — and it will — the page is still there.

Search that finds it

Full text across everything you saved, and semantic search for when the words escape you but the meaning does not.

Aliases: the go/ shortcuts

Type go/gh in your address bar and land on GitHub. Short names for the places you live in.

go/gh → github.com go/docs → your handbook

Yours, always

Import from any browser. Export everything as Markdown notes for Obsidian, or as JSONL to hand a model — with the article text, if you want it. No feeds, no follower counts.

Alt+K, and everything is one list

Omni is Tefter's browser extension. One keystroke opens a single list of your open tabs, your history and your Tefter library — type a few letters and you are there. Your go/ aliases work from the same box, and the page you are on is one keystroke from saved. It all runs locally, in your browser.

Your team's library — and it lives in Slack

A shared library for the links your team passes around: bookmarks, lists and go/ aliases everyone can reach. Almost every team on Tefter runs it from Slack, so the bot works where the conversation already is.

In Slack

Or use the message action on any message, and Tefter bookmarks every link in it.

What it costs

name: DeveloperHub, Ship docs at the speed of your code
brief:
Product: DeveloperHub, Ship docs at the speed of your code
Description: Create powerful beautiful documentation, hassle-free. DeveloperHub is a hosted documentation platform for product docs, knowledge bases and API references.
target:
Ship docs at the speed of your code.

Your docs are always three sprints behind. Connect your repo and the agent watches the pull requests you merge, writes the pages into a changeset for you to review, and holds it there, while you were going to get to it “next quarter”.

Docs, API references and knowledge bases. One-click migration →

27,000+ docs written

It reads the code. Then it rewrites the docs.

Not autocomplete. A full agent with your repo and your entire docs tree in context. It drafts, restructures, audits, fixes links, and hands you suggestions to accept or bin.

“Restructure API Basics for a new reader”, and it does all nine pages, links included.

Stale snippets, dead endpoints, contradictions between guides: surfaced, with a fix attached.

Every change lands as a suggestion in a draft. Apply selectively. Nothing publishes behind your back.

Completely agentic, end to end.

Something changes: a PR merges, readers search for something that isn't there, a page gets thumbs-downed. The agent picks it up, writes the answer into a changeset you review in the editor, runs the checks, and waits for one click. That's the whole job.

Every changeset is reviewable, diffable and revertable, and nothing reaches a reader until somebody approves it. Opening the pull request itself is coming soon: today the agent reads the ones you merge and writes up the docs that owe you a change.

“The MCP is where it clicked for us. I can point Claude at our codebase and have it write Markdoc straight into DeveloperHub. Connecting our docs to our code and working with AI is the only way to go these days, and honestly I could not be happier.”

The best WYSIWYG editor in docs. No split view, no surprises.

Click anywhere and type. Markdown shortcuts if your hands insist, a toolbar if they don't. 30+ block types (tables, tabs, multi-tab code, callouts, drawings) and what you see is exactly what readers get.

Install the SDK, paste your key, make your first call. Five minutes, tops.

Not just API docs. Every doc your company keeps losing.

Knowledge bases, help centres, internal wikis, product guides, developer portals: one editor, one workflow, one bill. Publish a project to the world or gate it behind SSO, and run as many projects as you need.

Categories, article feedback, reader ratings and search analytics, with the agent drafting answers from tickets you keep re-answering.

Not just API docs. Every doc your company keeps losing.

Categories, article feedback, reader ratings and search analytics, with the agent drafting answers from tickets you keep re-answering.

brief:

One-liner: AI applied research lab building synthetic sapience; human-like AI
Description: we are making AI feel more human starting with voice. ai applied research lab training a novel end-to-end model & productizing what makes AI more personal, persistent, and human. frontier AI, like Claude and ChatGPT, are weak on memory, personality, relationship, and human-like interaction...that's our domain.
Industry: Consumer
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Consumer, AI, Conversational AI
target:
Agents are machines. We make them people.

ego is an applied AI research lab building personal agents indistinguishable from humans.

AI agents are machines, not people. People want to work and talk with people.

ego builds agents that are fun to be around.

The formula: a focused layer of utility, a thick layer of personality. Most agents are built the other way — raw intelligence, benchmark scores, a persona sprayed on top, and it shows. Here the character is the substance: it drives the behavior and it drives the voice.

The illusion holds in motion and text, but is lost the moment the character speaks.

Here is ours, at work: Ash, on a call with the team, bug bashing inside Unreal. Ash follows the work as it happens, speaks when there's something to say, and reacts the moment things change.

Recorded live during internal bug bashing. Unscripted.

yōkai

A yōkai is a voice agent with a personality, a memory, and a mind of its own. They live on the internet when idle, and personality and memory compound — no two yōkai stay the same.

Noted. See you in September.

name: Redouble AI
brief:
Product: Redouble AI
One-liner: Java-native multi-agentic AI operating system for enterprise
Description: At Redouble AI we have developed Silverlake, a Java-native agentic AI operating system for enterprise. While other AI solutions force enterprise stakeholders to embrace unfamiliar concepts in an unfamiliar language, we do the opposite: we slot agentic AI right into the enterprise comfort zone - by mapping all agentic concepts onto established enterprise primitives in their own language, their own security model, their own infrastructure.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, B2B, Workflow Automation, Enterprise
target:
If Your Enterprise Runs on Java, So Should Your Agents. Meet Silverlake.

An OS for your agents and tools built on the language, infrastructure, and security model your engineers already trust.

AI That Speaks Your Language

Empower your Java engineers to build the long-running agents of tomorrow.

Seamless Connectivity Across the Entire Enterprise Stack

Agents need data. It lives in modern endpoints, legacy databases, scanned archives, paywalled APIs, S3 buckets, and press releases.

Your agents reach all of it from Java – with the same libraries, credentials, and access controls your apps already use.

Security as a Foundational Substrate

Every agent output is untrusted input. Every tool call is scoped and guarded. Every guardrail is deterministic, written in code, and sits outside the model itself.

Our Operating System Just Drops Into Your Stack

Agents seamlessly deploy alongside your apps, your databases, your SSO. Same infrastructure, same security, same ops team.

Beyond the Pilot

Your infrastructure bill shouldn't scale with your ambition. Instead, our operating system enables you to grow exponentially while dramatically reducing cost compared to all other agentic frameworks. Adding new agents is free, and by unifying runtime, agents, and tools in one process, we can drastically reduce your bill.

Your Data + Your Expertise = Your Moat

Your AI compounds: every new data source expands it and every edit your team makes teaches it. The moat deepens with every workflow – on its own, while in production.

Keep Connecting

Plug in internal systems, external feeds, new data sources as your operations grow. Same governance, same access controls as day one.

Keep Learning

Every edit, every override, every tone adjustment your team makes feeds back into the system and leads to a better result next time.

An analyst rewrites a section. A regulatory writer shifts the tone. A claims reviewer overrides a calculation. Silverlake learns while in production.

Every Decision, Auditable

Tool calls, permission checks, agent reasoning – all recorded in excruciating detail.

Frequently Asked Questions

An enterprise AI operating system for building and running agents in production. Agents deploy with the same security, compliance, and engineering standards as the rest of your enterprise software.

Most platforms ship managed agent runtimes: Python-first, per-session billing. Silverlake is the only Java native operating system combining an agentic runtime with an authoring framework. Your engineers build in Java, deploy on your infrastructure, and run thousands of agents without watching the meter.

name: FutureClinic
brief:
Product: FutureClinic
One-liner: Personal doctors through chat
Description: FutureClinic is a platform that makes it easy for any doctor to open their own digital clinic. Our AI assistant takes a comprehensive medical history using an empathic chat or voice-based interface, uses sophisticated medical reasoning to narrow down likely diagnoses, and produces evidence-based treatment suggestions for each patient. Licensed doctors then review the text-based summaries of the cases our AI provides, and choose how to manage the patients.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Health Tech, Digital Health, Healthcare
target:
What if you could just text your doctors ?

Why we exist

Billionaires already have personal doctors. We think everyone should.

People who can afford it learned this long ago: your health doesn't improve in two rushed fifteen-minute visits a year. And it doesn't improve when a telehealth site turns you into a form and presses 'approve'.

It improves when one doctor knows you, watches what works, and answers your message any time you need them. AI now does expert intake in minutes. That makes a personal doctor cost less than a co-pay.

All through chat

How does it work?

Two steps. No appointments.

First, an AI Chief Resident takes your history.

“Oh, just another AI chatbot…” Nope. Your medical care is 100% human. Our AI speeds up intake and keeps costs low.

Your real doctor replies, typically the same day.

Your chosen doctor reviews your case and signs the plan with a live-recorded Human Signature™. Prescriptions and labs as needed.

Find your doctor

Find a personal doctor

Every face is a real, licensed doctor accepting patients today.

Why the same doctor matters

Why a personal doctor beats telehealth.

With your doctor

With telehealth roulette

Your acne progress

Care that fits your day

Why call, when you can text?

We're millennial founders. The idea of needing to make a phone call is, frankly, terrifying. But the real reason is simpler: life is busy. A video visit needs a booked slot, a quiet room, and a clean background. A text doesn't.

Start a message in the elevator, finish it at lunch, read your doctor's reply on the couch. And texting doesn't mean losing human connection. You and your doctor send photos, videos, and voice notes back and forth, so it feels like messaging a friend who happens to be your doctor.

You pay for unbiased medical advice

On FutureClinic, the doctor is the product.

Most digital health companies make their money on the medications and lab panels they steer you toward. Here, your fee buys one thing: your doctor's judgment. They can prescribe any medication and order any test, and they earn nothing extra when they do. You get what your care needs, never what someone needs to sell.

When something's wrong

You've had three options. Now you have four.

Four doors. Three of them were built for the system. One was built for you.

The clinic visit

brief:
Product: Disclo
One-liner: Health disclosure and accommodation management platform
Description: Disclo is the first software for employers to collect, verify, and manage health disclosures and employee accommodation requests (HIPAA and SOC2 compliant, of course). We help employees secure the enhancements and protections they need to succeed in their careers without having to disclose their underlying medical condition to their employer. We handle the collection of that data, the verification, the secure data management, and much more.
Industry: B2B / Human Resources
Tags: Human Resources, B2B, Compliance, HR Tech
target:
The easiest way to manage accommodations and medical certifications

Disclo's platform powers end-to-end accommodations management and AI-assisted medical certifications for FMLA, ADA, and state leave requests.

Trusted by leading global organizations

Why organizations choose Disclo

Cut costs, not corners

Cut down on growing administrative costs and reclaim valuable time with Disclo’s simple, efficient workflows. With the recent surge in accommodation requests and their increasing complexity, Disclo ensures your organization can handle them smoothly, resulting in significant time and cost savings.

Adopt a sustainable, compliant process that evolves alongside people and regulations

With accommodation-related cases being the leading cause of EEOC lawsuits, our software provides the peace of mind you need to operate confidently and securely. And we have the certifications to prove it.

Build a supportive and engaged workplace

Disclo helps foster an environment where employees feel valued and supported, leading to reduced leave and higher retention rates. Effectively managing accommodations enhances inclusivity and morale, transforming your workplace culture into a strategic asset that boosts productivity and employee satisfaction.

See Disclo in action

Disclo’s automated workflows makes navigating the interactive process a breeze

Employees can self-guide through requests with automated communications and structured processes that integrate seamlessly with your existing HR tech stack. Reduce manual intervention and speed up the medical verification process, freeing up your team to focus on what matters most – your people.

Turn compliance into a seamless part of your operations

Disclo meets HIPAA and SOC2 standards and is applicable globally, ensuring that your accommodation processes are both compliant and optimized for strategic efficiency.

Get 24/7 access to workplace accommodations experts

Our in-house experts offer continuous advice and support, ensuring your organization can handle any accommodation challenge with strategic insight and confidence. Only 21% of HR professionals feel confident in managing accommodations without external support (HR.com). With Disclo, your team will never be alone.

name: Zatanna
brief:
Product: Zatanna
One-liner: Turning all software into agent-first APIs
Description: Zatanna creates APIs for software that doesn't have any, by reverse engineering back ends of web-based cloud and on-prem software.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
target:
APIs for any EHR

UIs are for humans, not agents

Any portal becomes a fast, stable API your agents call in production — even the ones with no public API. No browser bots to babysit.

Trusted by some of the fastest-growing startups in healthcare, logistics, hospitality, and more

The real API was always there. We just expose it.

Capture the real API

We observe the actual network traffic behind your portal workflows and reconstruct the exact request flow — auth, sessions, sequencing, everything.

One stable endpoint

Your agents call a single, clean API. We manage auth, retries, anti-bot detection, and session handling underneath.

Milliseconds, not seconds

Direct API calls instead of browser automation. No UI dependencies, no fragile selectors, no headless Chrome overhead.

From one recorded workflow to a production API

Walk through the workflow once

We capture every underlying network request — login flows, API calls, session tokens, and sequencing — while a human completes the task.

Reconstruct the optimal request flow

We model the real calls, auth behavior, retry logic, and edge cases. No UI layer involved.

Call one stable endpoint

Your agents call a clean, parameterized API. We own the auth, retries, and maintenance below the surface.

Self-maintaining by design

Sessions expire. Portals update. Auth flows change. Zatanna detects when tools break and repairs them automatically — so you integrate once and treat workflows like stable infrastructure.

Works with any portal that has a login

If a human can reach it through a browser login, your agents can reach it through one API call.

Back-office & ops portals

ERP systems, freight carrier portals, insurance platforms, and internal tools with no public API

Document & form workflows

Claim submissions, permit applications, record lookups, and structured data entry at scale

AI agent actions

Agents that need to do real work in third-party software, not just read it

Bring one blocked workflow. We'll turn it into a production API.

Common questions

Browser automation renders full pages and clicks through UIs — it breaks when anything changes, is slow, and fails at scale. Zatanna works at the network layer. We reverse-engineer the underlying API calls behind any portal and deploy them as direct endpoints. That means milliseconds instead of seconds, structured data instead of scraped HTML, and integrations that don't break when a button moves.

Description: Zatanna creates APIs for software that doesn't have any, by reverse engineering back ends of web-based cloud and on-prem software.

APIs for any EHR

UIs are for humans, not agents

Any portal becomes a fast, stable API your agents call in production — even the ones with no public API. No browser bots to babysit.

Trusted by some of the fastest-growing startups in healthcare, logistics, hospitality, and more

The real API was always there. We just expose it.

Capture the real API

We observe the actual network traffic behind your portal workflows and reconstruct the exact request flow — auth, sessions, sequencing, everything.

One stable endpoint

Your agents call a single, clean API. We manage auth, retries, anti-bot detection, and session handling underneath.

Milliseconds, not seconds

Direct API calls instead of browser automation. No UI dependencies, no fragile selectors, no headless Chrome overhead.

From one recorded workflow to a production API

Walk through the workflow once

We capture every underlying network request — login flows, API calls, session tokens, and sequencing — while a human completes the task.

Reconstruct the optimal request flow

We model the real calls, auth behavior, retry logic, and edge cases. No UI layer involved.

Call one stable endpoint

Your agents call a clean, parameterized API. We own the auth, retries, and maintenance below the surface.

Self-maintaining by design

Sessions expire. Portals update. Auth flows change. Zatanna detects when tools break and repairs them automatically — so you integrate once and treat workflows like stable infrastructure.

Works with any portal that has a login

If a human can reach it through a browser login, your agents can reach it through one API call.

Back-office & ops portals

ERP systems, freight carrier portals, insurance platforms, and internal tools with no public API

Document & form workflows

Claim submissions, permit applications, record lookups, and structured data entry at scale

AI agent actions

Agents that need to do real work in third-party software, not just read it

Bring one blocked workflow. We'll turn it into a production API.

Common questions

Browser automation renders full pages and clicks through UIs — it breaks when anything changes, is slow, and fails at scale. Zatanna works at the network layer. We reverse-engineer the underlying API calls behind any portal and deploy them as direct endpoints. That means milliseconds instead of seconds, structured data instead of scraped HTML, and integrations that don't break when a button moves.

name: Onlook: Bring your Ring cameras to your Mac.
brief:
Product: Onlook: Bring your Ring cameras to your Mac.
Description: Bring your Ring devices to your Mac's menu bar.
target:
Ring in your menu bar

At home on your Mac.

Live views, motion alerts, and instant replay right in your menu bar.

Every camera, one click

Open any Ring feed from your menu bar. No phone, no app.

Never miss a thing

Doorbell and motion alerts arrive as native Mac OS notifications.

Two-way talk

See someone at the door and speak to them right from your Mac.

Activity log

Scrub back through motion clips and doorbell rings from the last few hours.

Nothing leaves your Mac

No analytics, no servers, no tracking. Your feeds stay local.

Frequently asked questions.

Onlook puts your Ring cameras in your Mac's menu bar. Live view, two-way talk, motion alerts, and clip playback — one click away, without opening a browser or reaching for your phone.

No. Onlook is an independent app, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Ring or Amazon. You sign in with your own Ring account, and your credentials go directly to Ring — never to us.

A Mac with Apple Silicon running macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later, a Ring account, and at least one Ring camera or doorbell. That's it — no other software to install.

Yes. Your email and password go only to Ring — Onlook never stores them and has no servers, no analytics, and no tracking. Video streams travel from Ring to your Mac and nowhere else. After sign-in, a Ring session token is kept securely on your Mac, the same way Ring's own app stays signed in.

Yes — recent motion events appear in the activity log and replay right in the app. Playback uses Ring's recordings, so it requires an active Ring Protect subscription.

Because Onlook is independent, a Ring-side change can occasionally interrupt features until we ship a fix. We watch closely and patch quickly — Onlook updates itself automatically, so fixes arrive without you doing anything.

Check that Audio Streaming is enabled for that camera in the Ring app (Device Settings → Audio). Some Ring cameras ship with it off — Onlook can only play the audio Ring sends.

name: Skyhook
brief:
Product: Skyhook
One-liner: PaaS-like experience with the power of Kubernetes, on your cloud
Description: We make running services on Kubernetes as easy as Heroku, but on your cloud and with all the flexibility and power of Kubernetes. Companies use Skyhook so that they don't have to hire dedicated infrastructure engineers. Although 50-70% of organizations have already adopted Kubernetes, most developers agree that it is too complex and difficult to manage.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, SaaS, B2B, Kubernetes, DevOps
target:
Kubernetes power. PaaS simplicity.

The production-grade Internal Developer Platform you'd build yourself if you had the time - deployed on your cloud in minutes. No lock-in.

No credit card required.

"It's like Vercel for Kubernetes"

See Skyhook in action

Watch how Skyhook simplifies your Kubernetes workflow

It's 2026. You don't have to compromise anymore.

We turned Kubernetes into the PaaS you always wanted. No lock-in, no limitations. Everything you need to ship faster - preview environments, canary deployments, monitoring and much more. Ready by tomorrow.

The Skyhook Approach

You own the platform stack. Skyhook builds, orchestrates and manages it for you

You retain the flexibility to change/extend any of the tools that make up the platform

Mix and match the tools you love

Works on AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI, on-prem, or any Kubernetes cluster

A self-service interface for Developers

No waiting on DevOps. No tickets. Just deploy.

Every DevOps dream come true

The platform and tools you never had the time to set up. With all the control you need.

Why Choose Skyhook?

Best Practices Out-of-the-Box

Start strong with monitoring, rollout strategies, ephemeral environments and secret management.

No Lock-in

Stay in control without being dependent on specific cloud providers or third-party tools. Unlike PaaS, you can easily migrate away.

Start and scale quickly

Get started in minutes, not days, with our fully configured environment. Grows with your needs, regardless of engineering group size.

Kubernetes based

Simplify Kubernetes for developers and make management easy for DevOps.

The Best tools

Skyhook has built-in support for the top tools in the Kubernetes ecosystem, such as ArgoCD, Kyverno, Grafana and many more.

Flexible

With Kubernetes under the hood, all the ecosystem and advanced functionality is readily available when you need it.

Powering the software development lifecycle, together

Scale your applications with zero infrastructure friction and full observability.

Chat with your infrastructure

Skyhook's agent provides developers and DevOps with the context they need. It knows your stack, your standards, and your golden paths.

Kubernetes inside, abstracted

Up and running in no time

Connect your existing clusters, or use skyhook to spin up production-grade clusters for you with the DevOps tools you need.

Automate deployments

name: Latchel
brief:
Product: Latchel
One-liner: 24/7 emergency maintenance department for property managers and…
Description: Latchel is the only end-to-end platform that automates maintenance coordination and delivers best in class resident amenities. We service over 80,000 homes across over 400 customers in all 50 states of the US. We’re growing rapidly and need a Product Designer to continue our rapid growth trajectory.
Industry: B2B / Operations
Tags: SaaS
target:
Less questions. Less work orders. Every call handled.

One AI platform that runs two front-line jobs: a 24/7 maintenance engine that resolves requests before dispatching, and an AI call center that answers every call. Real humans on standby when it matters.

Real teams. Real results.

However your team is organized, Latchel fits.

Replace your after-hours answering service and improve your maintenance with one platform — and cut the cost of both. Built for growing PMs who can't afford to miss an emergency repair or a new lead.

A maintenance engine that resolves work

Built to go further than any other maintenance tool — AI fixes what it can, sends emergencies to a video call with real experts, and perfectly dispatches your techs. All based on your unique rules.

A call center that answers everything

Built to match what you expect from a receptionist and an answering service — every caller heard, every call routed, nothing lost to voicemail.

24/7 AI that resolves maintenance — not just tags it.

Most triage tools only use AI to label severity. Latchel actually fixes requests with residents, dispatches the right vendor, and gives technicians everything they need before they arrive — cutting dispatches, callbacks, and overtime.

24/7 AI Troubleshooting

Via SMS, portal, or voice, AI walks residents through step-by-step fixes and resolves issues before dispatch. At anytime residents can switch to a live human to help them on a video call.

Intelligent dispatching

Latchel knows when a vendor is already headed to a property and routes extra work orders to that same trip. It also spots when a new request relates to an open issue and sends the vendor who already has context.

AI voice controls

Run maintenance by voice. Managers execute tasks hands-free, residents follow up and open work orders by voice, and vendors schedule visits and submit estimates by phone — no portal logins.

From “it's broken” to “it's fixed.”

Latchel's AI meets the most common resident issues at the door — and walks them to a fix at intake.

And it's all on the record.

Resolving at intake never means losing sight of what happened. Every interaction is captured — so even the issues the AI handled without you stay fully visible, traceable, and ready to audit.

An AI receptionist for every call your office gets.

name: InfluxData
brief:
Product: InfluxData
One-liner: The platform for building and operating time series applications.
Description: InfluxData, the creators of InfluxDB, delivers a modern Open Source Platform built from the ground up for analyzing metrics and events (time series data) for DevOps and IoT applications. Whether the data comes from humans, sensors, or machines, InfluxData empowers developers to build next-generation monitoring, analytics, and IoT applications faster, easier, and to scale delivering real business value quickly. Based in San Francisco, InfluxData customers include Autodesk, Cisco, eBay, and Coupa.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Analytics, Open Source, Time Series, Databases
target:
Time series starts with InfluxDB

The database for real-time systems powering physical AI

Developers choose InfluxDB

Built for systems that can’t afford to lag. Capture, analyze, and act on high-resolution operational data in real-time.

Downloads of InfluxDB

Live open source instances

InfluxData Telegraf downloads

Open source contributors

Time series database Source: DB Engines

Most databases weren’t built for time series

Telemetry, edge devices, and physical AI generate data that most databases can’t handle. InfluxDB handles continuous, high-resolution data with precision and speed.

Engineered for performance at scale

Handle continuous, high-resolution data without breaking cost, latency, or reliability

Real-time performance without cost runaway

Ingest at millions of data points per second while keeping storage and compute predictable

Edge-to-cloud continuity

Capture data where it’s generated and analyze it anywhere without redesigning your pipeline

Purpose-built architecture for continuous data

Optimized for fast ingest on high-velocity, high-resolution data with efficient compression and storage

Integrates with your stack

Deploy fast, scale seamlessly, and easily integrate without requiring specialized infrastructure

High-Speed Ingest

Ingest millions of series without impacting performance.

Real-Time Analytics

Transform and analyze unlimited series in real-time.

Eviction and Lakehouse Integration

Automatically evicts cold data and streams it into lakes, warehouses, and AI/ML pipelines.

Compression and Downsampling

Best-in-class compression. Parquet files store more data with less space.

Purpose-built for the world's most demanding systems

From grid stability to satellite telemetry, InfluxDB powers the systems that can't afford to lag.

Aerospace

Aerospace telemetry never stops. Stay ahead with a database built for speed, precision, and decades of data.

Energy & Utilities

Power modern energy systems with real-time insights that maximize efficiency and reduce downtime.

Modern Data Historian

Upgrade your historian for Industry 4.0 with real-time data that drives efficiency and lowers costs.

Physical AI runs on time series

Close the loop between telemetry and action.

AI systems need a stream of high-precision telemetry to improve. InfluxDB captures granular sensor data enabling AI to detect, respond and predict in real-time.

Aircraft and spacecraft require pinpoint precision for mission critical navigation. Capture high-rate sensor streams to power real-time diagnostics and adaptive control.

Manufacturing

Production lines generate constant signals. Feed real-time telemetry into AI models to predict equipment failures, optimize throughput, and maintain product quality.

Manage grid volatility across distributed assets. Real-time sensor streams feed predictive models to prevent costly edge failures.

Build systems and infrastructure monitoring that scales

brief:

target:
Desktop apps, reimagined by you.

Create any app in minutes by chatting with AI. Beautiful, powerful, and truly personal.

Available for macOS Tahoe and Apple Silicon

macOS Tahoe and Apple Silicon required

Build tools for everyday life

Trackers, planners, and tiny helpers people made just for themselves:

Mia Calendar

Flor

Reading Corner

Alto

Describe and create

Our agent helps you build anything, from first idea to finished app.

Bring your own agent

Use a Claude subscription or Glaze credits to build, open app sources with any agent.

Annotate

Send changes to your agent directly in your app.

Publish effortlessly

Easily share with your team or release publicly.

Made for teams

Build software for your specific tools and processes.

Discover & install

Explore apps from your team and our wider community of builders.

FAQ

Glaze lets you build your own desktop apps just by describing what you want. They live on your Mac, launch instantly, and work offline, so you get real software that fits the way you work.

Download Glaze for Mac and start building. Glaze currently requires macOS Tahoe and Apple Silicon, with Windows and Linux support planned down the road.

No. You describe what you want in plain language and Glaze builds it. If something isn’t right, just talk to it and change it. And if you do know how to code, you’ll feel right at home shaping things further.

Those tools build for the browser. Glaze builds for your desktop. That means your apps can access your file system, keyboard shortcuts, menu bar integration, background processes, and deeper integration with your OS. Your data stays on your machine, not on someone else’s server. It’s a different category entirely.

Anything that comes to mind. Internal tools for your team, personal utilities, menu bar apps, workflow automations, or just quick one-off things that make your life easier. If you can describe it, Glaze can build it. Browse the store for inspiration.

Sign in with Claude CLI, then connect Glaze and allow it to use your subscription. Your Claude models appear in the model picker next to Glaze's own models. Runs on your subscription don't spend Glaze credits and are unlimited on Glaze's side during the Beta, subject only to Claude's own usage limits.

brief:
Product: Maquoketa Research
One-liner: The intelligence layer for drones
Industry: Industrials / Defense
target:
Retrofit Autonomy for any UAS Platform

Automatic target recognition and guidance that actually works. No airframe redesign. No vendor lock. Three-figure price tag.

Synapse

Higher probability of mission success.

Hit rate for manually flown drones.

Hit rate with Synapse.

Built For

Add autonomy without redesigning your aircraft.

Synapse attaches to your airframe's payload bay via a picatinny rail, APEX bay, or another standard interface and plugs into your flight controller over usb. You get state-of-the-art autonomy features without having to build in-house, all while maintaining control over your flight stack, your BOM, and the ability to focus on your key differentiators.

Every component is sourced to NDAA and TAA requirements, so adding the capability does not compromise your compliance posture or your path to a Blue UAS listing. If you want to change your autonomy strategy later, you change a payload rather than a product line.

Ready to Collaborate?

Partner with us to deploy next-generation autonomous systems.

name: Free File Tools That Never Upload Your Files
brief:
Product: Free File Tools That Never Upload Your Files
Description: Convert images, read text from photos, and edit PDFs with 56 free tools that run entirely in your browser. No account, no upload, no limits.
target:
File tools that never upload your files.

No tool by that name. Try merge, HEIC, compress, or OCR.

Convert images, pull text out of photos and scans, and edit PDFs — all in this browser tab. No account, no queue, no server that sees your files.

Open last workbench

Most used

All 56 tools

Images, text recognition, PDFs, and text utilities. One page per job, same privacy on every one.

HEIC, WebP, AVIF, and JPG conversion, compression, resizing, and cropping.

Read text and tables out of photos and scans, on this device.

Merge, split, compress, sign, and convert PDF files without an upload.

Diff, word count, JSON, case conversion, and find and replace.

The file never leaves the tab

pdf-lib, PDF.js, and a WebAssembly image decoder run on your device. There is no upload endpoint. Open the network tab and watch nothing happen.

Free because of ads, not data

No accounts, no document API, no analytics on your files. Display ads sit around the workbench and never see what you are working on.

No queue, no limits

Nothing waits in line behind other people's jobs. Speed depends on your device, not on how busy a server is, and there is no daily cap.

Why these tools run in your browser

Almost every free file converter on the web works the same way: you upload a document, a server processes it, and you download the result. That model made sense when browsers could not do much. It has not been necessary for years, and it carries a cost that is easy to overlook because it is invisible — your file goes to a machine you do not control, handled under a privacy policy you did not read, retained for a period you were not told.

The files people most often need to convert are precisely the ones that argue against uploading. An iPhone photograph of a passport that Windows refuses to open. A photographed table that needs to become a spreadsheet. A payslip that needs its password removed. A bank statement compressed to fit an email. These are not incidental files, and handing them to an anonymous conversion service to accomplish something a browser can do locally is a bad trade that most people make without noticing they are making it.

What that means in practice

name: Odigos Technologies Inc.
brief:
Product: Odigos Technologies Inc.
One-liner: Enterprise-Grade OpenTelemetry
Description: Odigos leverages eBPF technology to create an open-source solution that can automatically generate distributed traces for any application without any engineering work. Developers are struggling with extracting and delivering high-quality monitoring data. Currently, building a pipeline is a manual process that takes months to implement, is an error-prone process that requires tons of code changes across multiple R&D teams, and demands collaboration.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
target:
Production context. For every decision.

Odigos records what runs inside every service, live, with nothing in your code. Your engineers, AI agents and security teams get the evidence they need.

Running in production at

Record production once. Debug it, defend it, and check what you shipped.

Logs and metrics record what someone predicted would matter. Incidents and attacks are the cases nobody predicted. Odigos keeps one record of what happened inside every running service, live, from outside your code, and every purpose reads from it. An engineer or an AI agent asks it after a page. A policy your team approved checks it on every call and refuses one. A coding agent checks what the change it just shipped did, before the next commit.

Engineers and AI agents

Root cause after a page. Ask what the code did on the failing request.

Your security policy

Approved by a human. Refuses one attack call. The service stays up.

Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot

See what the code they wrote did in production. Fix it before anyone pages.

What ran inside every service, live.

The cause from the code, not a guess from a graph.

Every trace from every service on day one. When the trace runs out, an engineer or an AI agent asks production what the code did on the failing request and has it in seconds. The cause is found in minutes, without a deploy.

Block the attack call. Keep the service.

An AI-driven attack moves as permitted calls between services. WAF, EDR and SIEM each see a permitted call. Odigos records every call and enforces a policy your team approved: it refuses the call the policy names, and nothing else. The service keeps serving. Scoped to the callers you name, the policy ships and reverts without a redeploy and comes off when the fix lands.

Wrote it at 14:30. Checked it at 14:31.

Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and the agents you build ship faster than anyone can watch. After each deploy they ask the record what their change did on real requests, so the fix is in the next commit, not the next incident. Same approvals, masking and audit as an engineer.

Same incident, two AI agents. One opens a pull request. One answers.

name: Citus Data
brief:
Product: Citus Data
One-liner: Real-time. Big data. PostgreSQL
Description: The amount of time businesses spend on their databases is altogether too much time. Citus is fixing this problem. Citus is worry-free Postgres. Built to scale out, Citus is an extension to Postgres that is available as open source, as enterprise software that can be run on-prem or on any cloud, and as a fully-managed database as a service.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Open Source, Big Data, Databases
target:
Citus 14 is here—with support for Postgres 18

📺 All 44 POSETTE: An Event for Postgres 2026 talks are now available on YouTube .

Citus gives you the Postgres you love plus horizontal scale-out with schema-based and row-based sharding. 100% open source. Now with Postgres 18 support!

GET STARTED ABOUT CITUS 14

Scale Postgres by distributing data & queries. You can start with a single Citus node, then add nodes & rebalance shards when you need to grow.

Reduce your infrastructure headaches by using a single database for both your transactional and analytical workloads.

Download and use Citus open source for free. You can manage Citus yourself, embrace open source, and help us improve Citus via GitHub.

As a Postgres extension, it’s easy to keep Citus in sync with the latest Postgres releases & stay current with all its latest innovations.

Citus = Postgres At Any Scale

The Citus database gives you the superpower of distributed tables. Because Citus is an open source extension to Postgres, you can leverage the Postgres features, tooling, and ecosystem you love. And thanks to schema-based sharding you can onboard existing apps with minimal changes and support entirely new workloads like microservices. With Citus, you can scale from a single node to a distributed cluster, giving you all the greatness of Postgres—at any scale.

Applications That Love Citus

SaaS apps often have a natural dimension on which to distribute data across nodes—dimensions such as tenant, customer, or account_id. Which means SaaS apps have a data model that is a good fit for a distributed database like Citus: just shard by tenant_id—and for cases with no natural distribution key, you can use schema-based sharding.

ABOUT MULTI-TENANT APPS

Customer-facing real-time analytics dashboards need to deliver sub-second query responses to 1000s of concurrent users, while simultaneously ingesting fresh data and enabling users to query the fresh data in real time, too.

By scaling out Postgres across multiple nodes, Citus gives your analytics dashboards the compute, memory, and performance they need to process billions of events in real time.

ABOUT REAL-TIME ANALYTICS

Citus supports schema-based sharding, which allows distributing regular database schemas across many machines. This sharding methodology fits nicely with typical microservices architecture, where each microservice can have its own schema in a shared distributed database.

Schema-based sharding is an easier model to adopt, create a new schema and just set the search_path in your service and you’re ready to go.

ABOUT MICROSERVICES

Ready To Get Started With Citus?

name: SerpApi: Google Search API
brief:
Product: SerpApi: Google Search API
Description: SerpApi is a real-time API to access Google search results. We handle proxies, solve captchas, and parse all rich structured data for you.
target:
Google Search API

Scrape Google and other search engines from our fast, easy, and complete API.

Easy Integration

Advanced Features

Leverage our infrastructure (IPs across the globe, full browser cluster, and CAPTCHA solving technology), and exploit our structured SERP data in the way you want.

Each API request runs immediately – no waiting for results. In addition, each API request runs in a full browser, and we'll even solve all CAPTCHAs, completely mimicking what a human would do. This guarantees that you get what users truly see.

Get Google results from anywhere in the world with our "location" parameter. SerpApi uses Google’s geolocated, encrypted params and routes your request through the proxy server nearest to your desired location to ensure accuracy. Get locations at our locations endpoint .

Regular organic results are available as well as Maps, Local, Stories, Shopping, Direct Answer, and Knowledge Graph. Lots of structured data is available for each result, including links, addresses, tweets, prices, thumbnails, ratings, reviews, rich snippets, and more.

Simple Pricing

Month-to-month contract. Cancel anytime.

Start for free, upgrade as you grow, or contact our team about an enterprise plan tailored to your volume, performance, and compliance needs.

Enterprise-grade security & support

Engineered for total data privacy, industry-leading compliance, and guaranteed global reliability.

ZeroTrace Mode

With ZeroTrace Mode enabled, we don't store your search parameters, files, or data. Once a search completes, it's as if it never happened.

Security & Compliance

We're SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, and ISO 27001 certified - Independently audited controls for security, availability, and confidentiality.

Premium support

Get help from a global team of experts, ready to guide you through any issue. Backed by uptime SLAs of up to 99.97%.

We capture your AI work traces, train smaller models, and automatically deploy them (only when they outperform the expensive model you are currently paying for). target:
Work becomes intelligence.

Orchestra trains and fine-tunes specialist models based on weights you always own.

Capture traces and expert corrections from live production workflows.

brief:
Product: Astraea
One-liner: AI Operating System for Clinical Development
Description: Astraea automates clinical trial biometrics from raw study inputs to FDA-ready outputs. The platform handles data normalization, CDISC mapping, SDTM, ADaM, TFLs, QC, and revision workflows in one auditable system, helping Phase II/III sponsors reduce months of manual programming and data management into automated, reviewable execution.
Industry: B2B
target:
Smarter, faster, safer clinical trials with agentic AI .

Enterprise-Grade AI for Regulated Clinical Development

From protocol design to FDA submission, Astraea automates clinical data workflows with multi-agent AI — deployed inside your own environment, where your data never leaves and we never see it. Faster cycles, lower costs, and audit-ready compliance at every step.

Faster biometrics cycles

Trusted across 10+ global pharma and biotech sponsors, from first-in-human programs to top-3 global pipelines.

Built for Regulated Trials

Compliance and data control, engineered in.

Audit-ready traceability, controlled execution, and e-signature support built into every workflow by design.

Submission-standard datasets, TFLs, and Define-XML automated end to end against CDISC conventions.

Validated, human-in-the-loop workflows aligned to FDA guidance and Good Clinical Practice expectations.

Forward-deployed inside your own environment. Astraea never stores or sees your clinical data.

Measurable Impact

Overcome your biggest clinical bottlenecks.

Astraea is built around the workflows regulators actually inspect, so every acceleration comes with traceability intact.

Compress the biometrics-to-reporting window in the workflows Astraea automates.

SDTM, ADaM, and Define-XML assets validated against submission conventions.

Applied to a typical 40–60 business-day CSR cycle when Astraea is on the critical path.

Standards-native traceability, controlled execution, and human-in-the-loop approval baked into every workflow.

See it in motion

Automation you can watch work.

Astraea orchestrates specialized AI agents across the biometrics workflow, every step logged, reviewable, and aligned to CDISC standards.

The Mission

The standards-aware execution layer for modern clinical development.

Astraea doesn't replace your biostatisticians, programmers, or medical writers — it gives them a traceable, standards-native execution layer for the regulatory work they actually own: eCRFs, SAP, TFLs, SDTM/ADaM, Define-XML, QC, and submission documents. Every output is automated, inspection-ready, and produced inside your own environment under human supervision — where your data never leaves.

Our Platform

One platform. Four standards-native engines.

Astraea orchestrates specialized AI agents across the full biometrics lifecycle: standards mapping, compliance, evidence synthesis, and statistical execution. All in one controlled, audit-ready system.

Astraea Standards

Automated SDTM, ADaM, Define-XML, and aCRF generation. CDISC-native mapping with Pinnacle 21 validation baked in.

Astraea Compliance

Governed execution, data desensitization, and audit trails aligned with HIPAA, GDPR, 21 CFR Part 11, and FDA guidance.

Astraea Evidence

Extracts and synthesizes evidence from protocols, SAPs, CSRs, and literature to support clinical and regulatory decisions.

Astraea Stats

SAP-driven TLF generation with full traceability, validated statistical outputs wired into submission-ready packages.
