name: Rally
brief:
Product: Rally
One-liner: Rally is Zoom for social events
Description: Rally is what Zoom breakouts should have been. Users can hop between groups easily, while seeing and hearing the other groups around them, as if they were in a shared space. Rally is perfect for happy hours, networking, and other social gatherings. We are being used by institutions like Amazon, Harvard and a multitude of startups across North America.
Industry: Consumer / Social
Tags: Collaboration, Video, Social
target:
Host incredible

meetings

online.

Traditional video calls are exhausting. Rally lets you hop between breakout rooms with one click. Making your meetings more collaborative and fun!

No download required.

Hosted 2000+ meetings & events for clients like:

Designed for Groups

Rally was built for small & large group gatherings and makes them more interactive and engaging. Each Rally room fits between 35-50 people.

Customize Every Event

Customize your venues and rooms to make the space your own. This is your event, so you decide what it should feel like. Share your secure link to easily invite your guests!

Easy to Use

We designed Rally to be easy to use and navigate through. Instead of spending time learning the platform, spend more time hanging out and socializing.

Break into groups

Don't feel like you're stuck in a conversation. Easily break off and move around freely between different groups to chat and mingle with others. You would never be stuck at a real table, and you shouldn't have to virtually either.

Feel the energy in the room

See and hear people around you as if you were in the same space as them. Adjust the background volume - you can decide how much you want to vibe with the energy of the room!

Present on Stage

Presenting to a muted audience is awkward. Rally lets you present to a live audience without having their sound cut over yours. Take the stage, make an announcement, or have a panel discussion with real time feedback!

As seen on

How Others Use Rally

"We couldn't have run a Murder Mystery without Rally; the spontaneous elements of people hopping from one conversation to another was technically not possible on any other platform. During a time when our team couldn't have in-person events, this truly gave us the connection, bonding, and fun we were hoping for."

Marketing Lead

"Rally saved the social part of our company culture when we went fully remote. Now, instead of a big group video call where 20 people listen to 2 people talking and you're counting the minutes until it's ok to sign-off (not fun; this basically killed happy hours), we actually look forward to weekly happy hours again and lose track of time!"

GM, Special Projects

name: Chert
brief:
Product: Chert
One-liner: iMessage infrastructure for business
Description: Chert provides the infrastructure for businesses to automate conversations over iMessage. We’re already working with B2C startups, customer experience teams, and sales teams to reach end users through trusted and conversational messaging.
Industry: B2B
target:
iMessage infrastructure for reaching people at scale.

Build and deploy AI on iMessage to reach people at scale while maintaining quality , trust , and personalized interaction .

Make iMessage programmable at scale.

Chert provides the API and workflow layer for sending, receiving, routing, and observing real iMessage conversations.

Built for any workflow where a message should become an action.

The same iMessage API can start the thread, interpret the reply, and move the workflow forward.

Onboarding

Welcome someone the moment they sign up.

Customer support

Resolve in iMessage. No portal, no ticket queue.

B2C agents

Books, reschedules, answers. Like a real person.

Cold outbound

Get replies SDRs can't, without the spam flag.

One thread, everywhere your team works.

Chert sits between your team's tools and the customer's phone.

Everything you need to know.

Answers to the questions we hear most .

Real iMessage. Outbound and inbound flow over Apple’s iMessage protocol with the blue-bubble UX your customers already trust. We fall back to SMS only if a recipient isn’t on iMessage, and we surface that distinction in the API so you always know which channel a message landed on.

Twilio is an A2P SMS pipe: carrier-filtered, 10DLC-registered, and visibly automated. Chert delivers a peer-to-peer iMessage thread that opens with the blue bubble, supports read receipts and tapbacks, and lives in the same inbox as a recipient’s family and friends. Open and reply rates are categorically different because the channel is.

Because iMessage is end-to-end and tied to Apple ID, it doesn’t inherit the carrier-side filtering that hammers A2P SMS. We rotate sending identities, warm them gradually, and cap volume per identity per day to stay well below the heuristics Apple uses to throttle abusive senders. Anyone promising "unlimited blast" volume is one ban away from disappearing.

We expose a REST API and webhooks for every inbound and outbound event, so you can wire conversations into your CRM, sales tools, voice agents, or internal data store with a few hours of work. We also ship native sync for the common cases (lead created, meeting booked, opt-out received). If you’d rather not build, we’ll handle the integration during onboarding.

Build with iMessage.

20-minute kickoff. We'll talk through your use case and work on integrating iMessage into your application.

brief:
Product: Plura (formerly Bloom Community)
One-liner: The social app for edge-of-culture communities
Description: Plura (formerly Bloom Community) is a YCombinator backed startup based in Oakland, CA on a mission to use software to bring people together. Plura is a social and dating community that helps you meet new friends and partners organically through shared events and experiences. We partner with local event producers to help you connect and chat with other attendees before and after events.
Industry: Consumer / Social
Tags: Community
target:
Find your people

Through real life interactions and shared experiences Plura helps people connect, play, and belong.

Finally found my people

Start with meeting

Want to meet people? Skip the swiping and ghosting and choose from dozens of events happening in your city every week.

Continue with matching

Make plans to meet at the event, follow up and continue the connection after the event is done. No more missed connections

Find your community on Plura

Pod, lover, forever-partner, festival-bestie, etc.. etc.. etc..

The best way to meet people- is to meet people

Bay Area

Kink and Leather Events

See what members have to say about us!

Building community is very important to me and Plura helped me do that in a way I wouldn't be able to find anywhere else. Plus, the Plura Team is responsive and professional - they were able to get my concerts into the system quickly so attendees could meet each other and connect.

Our recent partnership with Plura has added a new dimension to our events. Not only does Plura increase the peer-driven awareness of the events, it creates a sense of community and belonging. We love the new level of sharing and interactivity that Plura provides.

We have had such a positive experience sharing our wellness events on Plura. We've had incredible people discover our workshops and weekend retreats through Plura - these people are open-hearted, engaged, and so aligned with our mission of developing a deeper sense of community. Plura has had a direct impact on our ticket sales and our growing community.

name: ParaQuery
brief:
Product: ParaQuery
One-liner: Managed GPU-accelerated Spark + SQL at 2x speed and half the cost
Description: ParaQuery is a fully-managed GPU-accelerated Spark solution providing double the performance at half the cost compared to solutions like Databricks and BigQuery. It is fully Spark-compatible, cloud agnostic, and has seamless integrations everywhere, all without vendor lock-in. ParaQuery makes it trivial to run large SQL and Spark workloads efficiently and serverlessly, without any data migrations.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Developer Tools, Analytics, Big Data, Enterprise Software, Infrastructure
target:
Scalable Data Processing For the GPU Era

Fully-managed Spark + SQL at 2× speed and half the cost Built for teams that ship

Your Data Warehouse Is Slowing You Down

Compute costs balloon endlessly

Pipelines are slow, queries run for hours instead of minutes

Teams waste time managing infra instead of shipping insights

Learn how customers are saving

—with zero commitments!

Integrates with all common tools, major clouds, and GPU clouds

Built for Data Teams Who Need to Ship

Seamless Integration. No Lock-In. Pure Acceleration.

Data at the Speed of GPUs

brief:
Product: Book DJs, Bands, & Musicians for your event
Description: Cueup is the easiest way to get a great music act for your event. Find a DJ or Band, listen to their music, review prices, and book in minutes.
target:
Find DJs and Musicians for your event

1000s of successful events

Cueup is the easiest way for you to book a great DJ, band or musician for your event. Start by telling us about your event, and get prices from the artists in your area.

Excellent - 4320 five-star reviews by organizers

Book live music & DJs anywhere

Tell us about your event

Describe how you want your event to take place and your ideal musical performance.

Choose your artist

We'll match you with the most qualified artists. Message them to agree on the details and get a good price.

Enjoy the music

Once you've found the perfect artist, you can safely pay on Cueup, or use any form of payment you'd like.

Wedding DJs

Find and book a wedding DJ that knows how to create a magical night for you and all your guests.

Corporate event DJs

Find and book a corporate event DJ that knows exactly how a corporate event should be pulled off.

Birthday party DJs

Book a party DJ for your birthday, anniversary, or other private event - they'll make sure the party is a success.

Avoid the usual pains of organising music for events

Book your musical performance in a simpler, cheaper, and more secure way. Cueup simplifies every aspect of booking a artists compared to the traditional booking process.

Money back guarantee

If you are not satisfied with the performance, we'll refund you. If the artist cancels on you, we'll refund you - and make an extensive effort to find you a new similar act

Secure and easy

You can complete the booking using your preferred payment method, like cash or card, and when we act as the facilitator, you can be sure that your money is safe until the event is finished. Probably the easiest way to sort out live music for your event.

Music on your terms

Every artist has been screened by us or reviewed at previous events. You can also listen to mixes, see photos and videos from their other performances. With Cueup, you will always find a performance that suits your event.

Find your DJ on Cueup like thousands of other event organizers

name: Coupl
brief:
Product: Coupl
One-liner: Banking designed for Indian couples.
Description: Coupl is a digital joint account for Indian households. We help couples and families easily manage their shared and household payments from one shared account. Over 20 million Indians marry each year, creating a $300 billion market opportunity in household expenses. Couples juggle multiple accounts, cards, and expense-tracking tools. Joint accounts involve lengthy paperwork, rejections, and minimum balance requirements, making them inconvenient for modern couples.
Industry: Fintech / Banking and Exchange
Tags: Fintech, Consumer
target:
Money, built for two.

Coupl is India's first zero-balance digital joint account for couples. Open jointly in < 60s . Get matching RuPay cards. Pool, spend, and earn together.

One balance. Two cards. Zero math.

A shared digital account that lives in your phone. Top up once, spend together, see every transaction in real-time on both ends.

Shared expenses. Automatically tracked.

No receipts → No manual entries → No Splitwise updates → Just one shared wallet and one real-time view of your spending.

From signed-up to spending in 60s.

Aadhaar e-KYC, no paperwork, no branch visits. Just download, invite, swipe.

Love knows no boundaries, and neither does banking.

Married, dating, long-distance, same-sex: Coupl is for anyone in a relationship.

For every kind of relationship.

New, decade-long, or somewhere in between. Open jointly, close anytime. No questions asked.

Four steps. 60 seconds.

Create your account

Download the Coupl app, sign up with your Aadhaar. Sixty seconds, tops.

Invite your partner

One tap, one share link. They sign up, and your joint account is live.

Get matching cards

Two virtual RuPay debit cards activated immediately, delivered to your doorstep in 5–7 days.

Spend together

Top up your shared wallet and start spending, anywhere.

Joint Cards.

Two matching RuPay debit cards. One shared wallet. Every swipe pings both of you.

Pay every shared bill in one place

Electricity, internet, rent, OTT. Schedule once, split forever.

Real-time activity

Every tap, swipe and online payment, instantly mirrored.

Limits & alerts

Daily caps, category limits, instant pings for both.

Clean statements

Shared spends stay separate from your personal account.

RBI-regulated

Issued by an RBI-authorized PPI partner. Bank-grade security.

Joint account, shared rewards.

Earn perks every time you spend together. From airport lounges to OTT credits, better together, literally.

Getaways, better together.

Book handpicked luxury villas through Coupl and unlock up to 10% off — exclusive couple rates with our travel partners.

Up to 10% off Lohono Stays

Pay & book directly on Lohono · apply your Coupl code at checkout

Up to 10% off Elivaas Getaways

Pay & book directly on Elivaas · apply your Coupl code at checkout

and angels from

Why couples love Coupl.

name: RealPact
brief:
Product: RealPact
One-liner: AI-native OS for Real Estate Brokerages
Description: RealPact builds AI agents that handle the paperwork behind real estate transactions. They find property records like deeds, tax records, permits, parcel data, and MLS information, then use that data to fill out contracts, organize documents, track deadlines, and help brokerages close deals faster. We are starting by automating transactions and will expand into other parts of brokerage operations. Much of the software used across the real estate industry is outdated.
Industry: Real Estate and Construction / Housing and Real Estate
Tags: Real Estate, Enterprise Software, AI
target:
AI agents for real estate.

Voice-powered agents that pull deed, property, and tax records, fill the contracts, and move a transaction from hours to minutes.

Backed by Y Combinator & LeapYear Fund

10+ brokerages are running on RealPact today:

A signature-ready Purchase & Sale in under 5 minutes.

Our agents pull the deed, tax, property, and MLS records, then fill the New Hampshire P&S in front of you. The document below is real — click in and try it.

Every deal lives in a Pact.

Contracts, deadlines, records, and signatures — one living workspace per deal. The board below is a real sandbox: click it and run the Pact yourself.

The brokerage that runs itself.

Real estate doesn't have an AI problem. It has an infrastructure problem. While every other industry automates with AI, agents still run the world's largest transactions through disconnected software, forms, and email threads. RealPact is the intelligent transaction infrastructure that carries a deal from the first conversation to closing. Most real estate software stores the work. RealPact does the work.

We automate everything. You focus on clients.

The most time-consuming parts of every transaction — pulling records, extracting data, consolidating information, and filling contracts — all handled automatically.

Automatically pulls deed records from county registries, parses ownership chains, and flags encumbrances — so you never chase paperwork again.

One-liner: AI-native Accounting Firm that's killing Deloitte
Description: Billow handles the work of Accounting and FP&A FTEs keeping teams compliant and audit-ready. We work within existing stacks (NetSuite, Coupa, and 80+ other systems) and complex spreadsheets, chasing down information and coordinating approvals across stakeholders. name: PermitPortal
brief:
Product: PermitPortal
One-liner: AI Operating System for Pre-construction
Description: We are building workflows to help developers go from finding and closing development sites to getting a building permit faster. PermitPortal accelerates the most critical parts of the pre-construction phase: finding the right sites, understanding entitlements and navigating local development sentiment.
Industry: Real Estate and Construction
Tags: Real Estate, Construction, AI
target:
Applied AI for land development and government affairs.

PermitPortal helps development teams and utilities find viable sites, de-risk entitlement, and break ground on schedule.

Get more sites through entitlement, on schedule.

The expensive surprises in development show up early: a board that will not say yes, a water or power constraint nobody checked, a moratorium that appears after the LOI. PermitPortal finds them before you commit, and keeps watching after you do.

De-risk earlier

See how a jurisdiction has actually voted on projects like yours, and check water, power, and moratorium risk before you sign the LOI.

Entitle faster

Know every approval you need, in what order, with the dates that matter, and walk into every hearing with a briefing book.

Stay ahead once you own

Every ordinance, decision, and moratorium in your jurisdictions is tracked overnight, so you get the schedule impact and what to do about it, not a news alert.

Schedule monitoring.

Agents read every governing body in your jurisdictions each night. When something happens, it is priced against your permit schedule, so you get the new date and the move to make, not a news alert.

Site plan approval slips 10 to 14 weeks. The water service agreement has to be signed before the site plan can be approved, and it now sits behind the basin study. Ask the utility to execute the agreement before the Oct 14 second reading. Commissioner Alvarez voted against the 2025 withdrawal cap; brief her office this week.

Every project, every jurisdiction, one view.

The water service agreement is a predecessor to site plan approval. If the ordinance passes, the agreement moves behind the basin study and misses the Nov 4 need-by date.

No other project is affected. Sterling East is on a different utility.

Recommended: ask the utility to execute the agreement before the Oct 14 second reading, and brief Supervisor Alvarez, who voted against the 2025 overlay amendment.

The data engine.

Every governing body, vote, ordinance, parcel, layer, and utility around your project, collected once and read again every night. Hover a node to see what it holds.

The platform, and a team that builds AI workflows around what you need to get done.

The operating layer for land development.

Every project, every jurisdiction, and everything collected around them in one workspace, with AI agents that run the workflows and a data engine that reads the record every night.

AI workflows, built around your goals.

name: Maritime
brief:
Product: Maritime
One-liner: The managed cloud for AI agents.
Description: Maritime is cloud infrastructure for AI agents. We help companies give every customer an agent running in its own isolated, persistent computer, starting at $1 per agent per month. Maritime handles hosting, scaling, and sleep/wake automatically, so developers can run thousands of agents without managing the infrastructure.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Developer Tools, Cloud Computing, Infrastructure
target:
Host persistent agents on the cloud.

Give each of your users their own VM, forever.

No card to deploy your first agent

Developers building on Maritime work at these companies

Give your agents true autonomy. Their own space to explore, build, break things, and try again.

Persistent workspace. Files, repos, browser auth that stays signed in, etc. An agent can come back after a week and pick up where it left off.

Long-lived software agents spend most of their lifetime idle, yet the conventional deployment keeps a full virtual machine resident for each of them. We study a scheduler that snapshots an idle guest to disk and restores it on the next inbound message, so that a parked agent costs only its storage. We characterise the restore path, show that its latency is dominated by page-cache warm-up rather than by the hypervisor, and give a bound on the expected monthly cost of an agent as a function of its wake rate.

A persistent agent is a process with a disk, a set of credentials, and a schedule of its own. Unlike a request handler, it has state that outlives any single interaction, which rules out the stateless scaling model of serverless platforms. We model an agent as an alternating sequence of awake and asleep intervals and write a(t) ∈ {0, 1} for its state at time t. The cost over a horizon T is then

where S is the size of the snapshot on disk and cₛ, cᵥ are the storage and compute prices. For the agents in our fleet the second term is small: a typical agent is awake for eleven minutes a day, and the bound in Section 4 follows from this observation alone.

We restore a guest in three steps. The memory snapshot is mapped rather than read, so the first instructions execute before the file is resident; the block device is attached as a thin clone of the parked volume; and the network tap is re-created with the address the guest had when it slept.

Download and run software. Apt-get any library you need, run and operate headful Chrome, download WhatsApp, clone repos, and so on.

Run AI generated code. Have your agent write and serve web apps and APIs, or run scripts it wrote itself.

Actual isolation and safety. Give your agent the autonomy to try anything, and safely mess up along the way.

Every agent gets a real, persistent machine that's up in half a second.

name: One Codex
brief:
Product: One Codex
One-liner: Data platform for metagenomics and the microbiome.
Description: One Codex is a data platform for applied microbial genomics, enabling new and valuable applications in clinical diagnostics, food safety, and biosecurity. Acquired by Invitae (NVTA) in February 2021. Spun out as an independent company in September 2022.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare IT
Tags: Biotech, Diagnostics, Genomics
target:
A fast, easy-to-use platform for microbiome sequencing and analysis

Build a single source of truth for your microbial assets with the brand new Genome Library. Learn more →

Get started quickly with an intuitive interface and rapid, accurate analysis. One Codex is the world’s largest microbial reference database and can support millions of microbiome and infectious disease samples.

Accelerate your microbiome research with One Codex

Leading institutions trust One Codex for everything from microbiome sequencing to data analysis to reporting. Our customers include top academic labs, biotechnology companies developing live biotherapeutics (LBPs), and clinical laboratories performing infectious disease diagnostics.

Our advanced algorithms and curated database provide the most accurate picture of complex metagenomic samples. Meanwhile, an intuitive web-based interface makes data accessible to both bench scientists and computational biologists.

Turning biology into data

We make it easier to solve problems in biology through genomics. Go from stool sample to results quickly and easily - One Codex gives structure to complex datasets, answering questions like: "What microbes are present?" and "What are they doing?"

An easy-to-use web platform, simple APIs for accessing data programatically, and integrations with Illumina BaseSpace and other tools allow you and your collaborators to analyze hundreds or thousands of samples.

Fastest Turnaround Times

Save time with automated sequencing and analysis pipelines. Receive sequencing results in as little as two weeks, while analyses only take a few minutes.

Complete Reproducibility

Solve your reproducibility crisis and de-risk your research. Run the exact same analysis on sample number 1 and 1000, without worrying about bias from batch effects.

Secure and Compliant

Reduce your compliance burden. Our platform ensures your data is secure and can support almost any regulatory and compliance requirement from GxP to HIPAA.

Platform Features

Academic

Go from sequence to solution quickly with the most accurate microbiome analysis

Commercial

Translate your research to trials, therapies, and more with the leading microbiome data platform

Need sequencing too?

We offer high quality DNA extraction, library preparation, and shotgun sequencing for your gut microbiome samples.

name: Trainy
brief:
Product: Trainy
One-liner: Infrastructure for managing GPU clusters for training/serving.
Description: Goodbye Slurm, Hello Konduktor. Trainy Konduktor is a software platform for AI teams to schedule workloads with priority, control resource allocation, and improve GPU reliability. With Konduktor, teams submit jobs to a healthy pool of GPUs, assign job priority with a simple user interface, and never worry about hardware faults again.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Developer Tools, Machine Learning, SaaS, Infrastructure
target:
Run your GPUs like a frontier lab

Schedule training jobs, track experiments, and serve endpoints. Use one tool or all three, with reliability built into each.

5M+ GPU hours managed

From local to 64 H100s in under an hour - the fastest GPU setup we've seen

Scaled to hundreds of GPUs on demand, reducing infrastructure costs by 50%.

Trusted by

Backed by

Stop managing GPUs. Start using them.

Join leading AI teams that reduce their compute costs by 50% while shipping faster.

Meet Konduktor

Deploy AI workloads at scale on any cloud with a simple YAML file. Paste in your existing torchrun command, set num_nodes, and Konduktor handles the distributed setup.

num_nodes: 64 # scale up your workload

accelerators: H100:8

image_id: nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.06-py3

priority-class: high-priority

run: |

torchrun --master_addr=$MASTER_ADDR ...

Catch hardware failures before they kill your run

Konduktor detects bad GPUs and nodes, cordons them, and reschedules your job onto healthy hardware automatically. Its health checks were built from managing 5M+ GPU hours across nearly every cloud.

Debug your training code faster

Aggregated logs and diagnostics surface the real error so you fix the bug instead of chasing infrastructure ghosts.

From model checkpoint to production API in minutes

Deploy inference endpoints with autoscaling, load balancing, and health checks built in, on your own cluster.

Track every experiment without the lag

Meet Pluto, experiment tracking built for responsiveness at scale. W&B and Neptune-compatible APIs, dual-logging support, MCP integration. Sub-second UI even with thousands of runs.

Responsive

Filter thousands of runs, compare metrics, and drill into results without waiting, even mid-training.

Scalable

Handle 100M+ logged data points without slowing down. Built for teams running large-scale experiments across distributed infrastructure.

Reliable

Over 5 billion metric points stored with zero dropped. Client-side buffering holds your metrics and ensures nothing is lost mid-run.

Write your config file. Specify nodes, priority, and GPU types in one simple YAML file.

Deploy with one command. Launch your job with a single CLI command. We handle the rest.

Watch it scale. Monitor your training progress across nodes in real-time.

Know exactly where your compute is going

Managers get a per-team, per-engineer view of GPU usage and cost, making it easy to allocate compute to what matters most.

Deploy anywhere

Deploy Konduktor on any cloud or on bare metal. Whether your GPUs are on a hyperscaler, neocloud, or in your own racks, your team gets one consistent interface.

Frequently Asked Questions

name: Bitstack
brief:
Product: Bitstack
One-liner: All things money, with better money
Description: Bitstack is building a new neobank powered by crypto. Bitstack has gone from a simple product that turns your spare change into bitcoin to a bitcoin-native neobank that is bringing a better way to manage all things money, with better money. We believe getting started with Bitcoin should be simple, fun and accessible to everyone. Bitcoin is an unparalleled financial alternative: a radically new way to transact and store value all around the world.
Industry: Fintech
Tags: Crypto / Web3, Neobank
target:
The easiest way to save and invest in bitcoin

350M €

invested in bitcoin

All things money, with better money

Invest in bitcoin effortlessly

Round-Ups

Smart Recurring

Bitcoin is the best performing asset of the last decade

Spend with the Bitstack card, earn Bitcoin back.

Send and receive money instantly and securely

Get paid in bitcoin

We got you covered

Customer support

Regulated

Security

Join the future of money with 300,000+ users

Any questions?

What is Bitstack?

Bitstack is a mobile app that allows you to save effortlessly in bitcoin.

How does Bitstack work?

Simply sign up, link your bank account and set up your bitcoin savings plan. Schedule a recurring purchase or enable automatic rounding. Bitstack takes care of the rest.

How do roundups work?

When you make a purchase, Bitstack rounds up your expense to the nearest euro and saves the difference in bitcoin. For example, a coffee bought for €1.20 is rounded up to €2.00 and the €0.80 difference is saved in bitcoin.

What is DCA ("Dollar Cost Averaging")?

Recurrent buying (DCA technique) allows you to smooth the average purchase price in order to mitigate the impact of price volatility on your portfolio and gain exposure to the long-term performance of the asset.

Can I withdraw my money?

Yes. With Bitstack, you are always in control of your money. You can sell your bitcoins for euros and get them back in your linked bank account, or send your bitcoins to your external wallet.

In which countries is Bitstack available?

Bitstack is available in the following countries: Austria, Belgium, Croatia, Cyprus, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Monaco, Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and Switzerland. Every day, we are working hard to make Bitstack available to as many people as possible. If Bitstack is not yet supported in your country, hang tight, it will be soon! With new release dates coming up, follow us on social media for the latest announcements.

When you make a purchase, Bitstack rounds up your expense to the nearest euro and saves the difference in bitcoin. For example, a coffee bought for €1.20 is rounded up to €2.00 and the €0.80 difference is saved in bitcoin.

What is DCA ("Dollar Cost Averaging")?

Recurrent buying (DCA technique) allows you to smooth the average purchase price in order to mitigate the impact of price volatility on your portfolio and gain exposure to the long-term performance of the asset.

Can I withdraw my money?

Yes. With Bitstack, you are always in control of your money. You can sell your bitcoins for euros and get them back in your linked bank account, or send your bitcoins to your external wallet.

In which countries is Bitstack available?

Bitstack is available in the following countries: Austria, Belgium, Croatia, Cyprus, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Monaco, Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and Switzerland. Every day, we are working hard to make Bitstack available to as many people as possible. If Bitstack is not yet supported in your country, hang tight, it will be soon! With new release dates coming up, follow us on social media for the latest announcements.

Description: Flowly’s mobile app is the VR version of Calm with a focus on reducing chronic pain for 100 million Americans. Flowly subscribers receive a $5 VR headset and Heart Rate sensor that collects a user's biometric data like HR and HRV, and converts it to visualizations in virtual experiences that reduce pain by 46%. Flowly is backed by the National Institutes of Health.
Industry: Healthcare / Consumer Health and Wellness
Tags: Health Tech
target:
Live Pain-Free, Live Fully

Flowly is a virtual clinic delivering the latest in science for people living with pain and anxiety who have struggled to find relief. Work one-on-one with your licensed human therapist in our evidence-based 14-week program and gain the tools to reclaim your life.

Covered By Insurance

Science-backed, personalized approach to pain and anxiety management

Flowly’s program brings you the latest breakthroughs in pain and anxiety research, addressing the physical and mental challenges of persistent nonstructural pain.

88% of people with chronic pain can experience benefit from Flowly’s Healing from Pain program

55% reported improved sleep

Flowly is recommended by Physicians

I highly recommend Flowly’s [Healing from Pain and Anxiety] program as it provides an easy to follow and fun yet relaxing way to learn valuable information about how to become your own hero as you develop your hero’s journey out of chronic pain and into the life you want to celebrate."

Up to 88% of chronic pain is nonstructural

Pain that starts without an injury or starts several days after an injury, and persists even after the injury has healed.

Pain that starts during times of stress.

Pain that’s inconsistent, such as back pain while standing but not while running.

Pain that moves around the body, or becomes symmetrical.

Multiple pain spots that are difficult to explain.

Symptoms that follow an erratic or unpredictable pattern, changing daily or weekly in severity.

Nonstructural pain can encompass other forms of pain you may be familiar with, such as

Neuroplastic Pain

Primary Pain

Nonspecific Pain

Low-back Pain

Tension Headaches

Chronic Fatigue Syndrome

Irritable Bowel Syndrome

and more.

How Flowly's Healing from Pain Program Works

Cutting-Edge Pain and Anxiety Management Techniques

Flowly’s program leverages the latest advancements in pain and anxiety research to deliver innovative psychological approaches for treating nonstructural pain. Our licensed therapists use a blend of proven methods, personalized to meet your unique needs and goals.

One-on-One Personalized Sessions with your dedicated licensed Therapist

Begin with an assessment to identify nonstructural pain and anxiety, followed by a tailored program that educates you on the neuroscience, retrains your brain to reduce pain and anxiety signals, and builds emotional resilience. Each phase of your weekly therapy is conducted by your therapist to help you re-engage with life and restore meaningful connections.

On-Demand Tools to Enhance your Healing Journey

name: Oto
brief:
Product: Oto
One-liner: Digital program for tinnitus
Description: Oto’s digital programs are the best way to manage tinnitus, and at a fraction of the cost of in person treatment. Tinnitus or ringing in the ears affects 1 in 8 people, and before Oto effective therapy was only available via expensive meetings with a specialist.
Industry: Healthcare / Consumer Health and Wellness
Tags: Consumer Health Services, Health Tech, Digital Health
target:
Take back control from tinnitus

Oto pairs you with a tinnitus specialist and a daily app of guided exercises and soothing soundscapes, so you can sleep, focus, and feel like yourself again.

200,000+ enrolled · 4.7 ★ App Store rating

As seen in

You deserve better than “learn to live with it”.

15% of adults live with tinnitus every day. Most get told: there's no cure and you'll get used to it. It's no wonder so many lose hope.

But this isn't the whole story.

With the right support, you can learn to take back control. That's what Oto is for.

Apple Hearing Study with the University of Michigan, 2024

Meet Oto

What is Oto?

Oto is a tinnitus program that combines expert care with a daily mobile app. You're matched with an audiologist who specialises in tinnitus. You use the Oto app for daily sessions and soothing soundscapes. It's built around the approaches that leading health authorities recommend for people living with tinnitus.

Guided CBT exercises

Short daily exercises based on cognitive behavioural therapy to help you build coping skills.

Soothing soundscapes

A library of calming sounds and soundscapes to help you relax and switch off.

Better sleep

Wind-down routines and sounds designed to help you fall asleep more easily.

Calm and focus

Breathing and mindfulness exercises to lower stress and help you concentrate.

Progress, shared with your provider

Track how you're doing over time. Your provider sees your progress and adjusts your plan.

Getting started

How it works

Professional evaluation.

Your audiologist assesses your tinnitus and hearing to understand what you're experiencing and build a plan around you.

A plan built around you.

Together you create a personalised plan that combines the Oto app with your provider's clinical care.

Daily support in the app.

Use the Oto app for guided exercises, soothing soundscapes, and relaxation techniques, just 10 minutes a day between appointments.

Ongoing guidance.

Your provider tracks your progress and adjusts your plan as you go. You're never managing tinnitus alone.

name: Macromoltek
brief:
Product: Macromoltek
One-liner: Computational antibody design
Description: Macromoltek: Revolutionizing antibody design. Description: Macromoltek, a computational de novo drug design company, rapidly produces accurate and credible antibody designs. We have built a proprietary platform that enables design against difficult targets inaccessible by traditional methods and have are already designing antibodies for large biopharmas and smaller biotechs.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
Tags: AI-powered Drug Discovery, Deep Learning, Therapeutics
target:
Advanced Antibody Design Services

Macromoltek harnesses the power of computational modeling and artificial intelligence to accelerate and optimize the antibody discovery and engineering process. Our platform empowers biotech and pharmaceutical partners to design highly specific, effective antibodies, reducing time-to-market and increasing the probability of clinical success.

Our Antibody Design Services

AI-Driven Antibody Discovery

Computational Structure Modeling

Custom Antibody Engineering Partnerships

About Macromoltek

Macromoltek is a pioneering biotech company specializing in the use of advanced computational modeling and artificial intelligence to design next-generation antibodies. Serving both biotech and pharmaceutical partners, Macromoltek accelerates the discovery and optimization of therapeutic antibodies, transforming traditional drug development processes. Our innovative solutions help partners achieve breakthroughs in precision medicine, leading to more effective and targeted treatments.

Our Solutions: Next-Generation Antibody Design

At Macromoltek, we harness the power of advanced computational modeling and artificial intelligence to accelerate and revolutionize antibody discovery and engineering. Our proprietary technology enables biotech and pharmaceutical partners to streamline the development of highly specific, effective, and novel antibody therapeutics. From early-stage target identification to lead optimization, our integrated AI-driven platform delivers faster, more accurate candidate selection, reducing time and risk in the drug development pipeline. Partner with us to unlock innovative solutions tailored to your unique research and development needs.

Monica Berrondo, PhD

Susana Kaufmann

Susana Kaufmann is a software and algorithmic expert, with over 25 years of experience as a senior developer. She has cross-industry experience in inter-platform software development and computer simulation in the petrochemical, combustion, pharmaceutical and financial sectors. Susana has many years of successful delivery in technology services, having managed a software consulting company. As Macromoltek’s CTO and co-founder, Susana has leveraged her deep knowledge of fluid dynamics in building the company’s advanced computational engine. Additionally, she has driven the development of Macromoltek’s database used for custom antibody design projects.

Contact Macromoltek

Interested in advancing your antibody discovery and development? Get in touch with Macromoltek’s experts to learn how our AI-driven computational modeling can accelerate your therapeutic pipeline and deliver innovative solutions for your biotech or pharma organization.

name: Beeper
brief:
Product: Beeper
One-liner: One chat app to rule them all
Description: We're building the best chat app on earth. Beeper connects to 15+ different chat networks. Unified search, advanced filtering and more. Available on Desktop, Android, iPhone and iPad. The idea is simple: messaging today is painfully fragmented. We're going to fix that. Every time we communicate there is friction lurking under the surface. E.g. Which app did I message her on? Where's that photo gone? Why can't I join an iMessage group from my Android?
Industry: Consumer
Tags: SaaS, Community
target:
One inbox for all your chats

Get the most popular messaging services, all in a single app.

Messaging made easy

Secure chats

Beeper supports on-device connections for most chat apps. That means messages go straight from your device to the network, ensuring maximum privacy.

Multiple devices

Read and reply to your messages across multiple devices. Beeper is available on macOS (Apple silicon and Intel), iOS (iPhone and iPad), Android, Windows, and Linux.

Chat superpowers

Manage your inbox like a pro and never miss a message again with reminders, scheduling, and more. Upgrade to Beeper Plus to get the most powerful chat experience.

Get Beeper

Beeper is free to use, with optional paid subscription. You can use Beeper on all your devices—your messages sync seamlessly. Our apps are available on Android, iPhone, iPad, ChromeOS, macOS, Windows and Linux.

Scan with your phone

About Beeper

Beeper is a standalone app with no affiliation or endorsement from Apple, Google, Meta, or any other chat platform we support. We respect the platforms we integrate with and their business models. Each one pushes messaging forward in unique ways, and we’re here to amplify that. Our roadmap includes linking out to native apps for premium features, helping power users (like those managing multiple brand accounts) get more done with a unified, pro-grade interface.

If you work at one of these companies and want to chat about better integrations, new APIs, or shared missions like fighting spam, reach us at partnerships@beeper.com .

name: Understood Care
brief:
Product: Understood Care
One-liner: Healthcare personal assistants for Medicare patients.
Description: The American healthcare system is complicated. 88% of US adults cite difficulties navigating the healthcare system. The good news is patient advocacy became a covered benefit by Medicare in 2024. Understood Care matches Medicare patients with a healthcare personal assistant (known as a Patient Advocate) at little to no cost to the patient. Patient Advocates help patients patients access care - finding resources, helping fill out paperwork, and much more.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Health Tech, Healthcare, Health Insurance, AI, AI Assistant
target:
Match with a Health Care Advocate

Get help from a care advocate, anytime, for anything. Covered by Medicare.

4.8 out of 148 reviews

How Advocates Support You

Some examples of what we can do for you:

Care & Navigation

Get support managing your doctors, coordinating services, and making the most of your healthcare benefits so nothing falls through the cracks.

Financial Help

Get support with Medicare, insurance costs, claims, and paperwork so you can focus on your health, not the bills or forms.

Mobility

Get help arranging doctor visits, reliable rides, and access to medical equipment so you can get where you need to go and have what you need at home.

Meds & Chronic Care

Get help managing prescriptions, refills, and ongoing care for chronic conditions so you can stay on track with your health.

Housing & Meals

Get help finding safe, affordable housing, nutritious meals, and home safety support to make daily living easier and more secure.

Support Network

Get help connecting with caregivers, peer support groups, and resources for planning your care and future needs.

Patient advocates near you

Patient advocates in your state

Available in all 50 states, delivered virtually and covered by Medicare. Pick your state for the programs, plans, and rules that apply where you live.

See every state we cover 

How do Advocates Help?

Diagnosis Insights

Chronic Care Support

Care Navigation

Care for Loved Ones

Better Overall Care

Patient Advocacy Without the Call Center

Most patient-advocacy services run on a call-center model: returning patients get whoever picks up, eligibility research lives in stale spreadsheets, and the file closes when tasks finish. Understood Care replaces that model with three commitments.

One Advocate, For Life

Every patient is matched at intake with one dedicated advocate and given that advocate's personal phone number, email, and text. Patients do not go into a call queue. The assignment is permanent: even after we've helped with everything you needed, you keep the same advocate. If you need us again six months later, you'll have the same advocate.

AI-Supported, Human-Delivered

Understood Care is AI-supported . Behind every advocate, AI tools surface programs, benefits, and services tied to where you live, with the most up-to-date eligibility information. The result: patients and advocates get the resources they need faster.

The 7-Day / 30-Day Cadence

Match with a Health Care Advocate

Get help from a care advocate, anytime, for anything. Covered by Medicare.

How Advocates Support You

Some examples of what we can do for you:

Care & Navigation

Get support managing your doctors, coordinating services, and making the most of your healthcare benefits so nothing falls through the cracks.

Financial Help

Get support with Medicare, insurance costs, claims, and paperwork so you can focus on your health, not the bills or forms.

Mobility

Get help arranging doctor visits, reliable rides, and access to medical equipment so you can get where you need to go and have what you need at home.

Patient Advocacy Without the Call Center

name: Ekho Labs
brief:
Product: Ekho Labs
One-liner: World Model for Freight
Description: Ekho predicts the wars, strikes and tariffs that break global shipping, and tells freight teams which shipments are exposed and what to do about them. Predicting escalation is what our team did for eight years before this - now we bring the same engine to logistics.
Industry: B2B / Supply Chain and Logistics
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Hard Tech, SaaS, Supply Chain, Enterprise Software
target:
The decision layer for disrupted freight .

Freight intelligence · live

PO-level reroutes, carrier alternatives, and booking windows, delivered into your TMS days before disruption hits.

Built for freight teams managing the world’s most disrupted corridors.

PO-4471 · Hamburg → Jeddah

Reroute now: secure Cape capacity

Suez suspended. A longer route. A decision made before the window closes.

ETA Apr 02. Regional cover withdrawn; carriers moved off Suez.

+26 d. ETA Apr 28. Surcharge $150–500/TEU. Lock capacity 2–3 wks out; no uncongested route.

Signal → decision

Your TMS shows the news. Ekho shows the reroute.

With Suez transit suspended and insurers withdrawing regional cover, carriers shifted Europe–Middle East sailings around the Cape. The brief below quantified the delay and prescribed how to secure scarce capacity.

EIA · Lloyd’s List · carrier filings · AIS · sanctions feeds

Hold Cape contracts. Secure container allocation 2–3 weeks before loading. No uncongested route exists; do not cancel on ceasefire news.

The data behind your next freight decision.

Ekho combines 1M+ public and licensed data sources (sanctions registries, AIS, port authority feeds, carrier EDI, weather models, social signal networks, and congressional/union communications) into a comprehensive risk model for freight teams.

+26 days via Cape

The cost of acting late.

A single disruption triggers costs across multiple lines. They compound fast:

On PO-4471, equipment surcharge alone ran $150–500/TEU . Ekho helps teams make the call earlier, before these costs stack.

Delivered into the systems your teams already use.

Connect Ekho to your existing TMS, ERP, and visibility tools through a read-only API. We scope the integration to your stack during onboarding.

From forecast to fact.

We said: Ceasefire in 4–16 weeks

Came at week 5.5 (April 8).

We said: Transit penalty: +26 days via Cape (38–42 days vs. 14-day baseline)

Industry confirmed Cape routing at 35–45 days.

We said: European port congestion at Hamburg and Le Havre in early April

Hamburg's main terminal hit 89% yard capacity by April 1. Le Havre: more ships waiting than berthed. Antwerp shut down entirely April 10.

Get started

Your next disruption is already forming.

See Ekho run on your lanes. Book a 20-minute walkthrough, or read the latest brief first.

Or get the next intelligence brief every other Tuesday.

name: CoLab
brief:
Product: CoLab
One-liner: Human and AI design review for hardware
Description: CoLab is on a mission to accelerate the pace of innovation by helping engineering teams deliver better products faster. CoLab’s Design Engagement System (DES) enables engineering teams to have more effective design conversations, design reviews and ultimately make better engineering decisions. CoLab launched AutoReview in 2025 - an AI peer checker that marks up 2D and 3D files. CoLab is trusted by Fortune 500 organizations like Ford, Komatsu, Johnson Controls, GE Appliances and Lockheed Martin.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Hardware, SaaS, Collaboration
target:
AI that shapes engineering decisions in real time

Talk to a product expert

When you run virtual design reviews with CoLab, you codify expert knowledge automatically as you go. Now, AI agents can understand how your team makes decisions — so they can annotate files and surface insights that help you converge on the best design faster.

Recalls, scrap, program delays

You have the technical know‑how to prevent these issues — you’re just not tapping into it.

Your most experienced engineers can’t be in every review.

With CoLab, they don’t have to be.

AutoReview, CoLab’s AI Peer Checker, runs a first pass check

AutoReview is an AI Peer Checker trained on your design standards and guidelines, lessons learned, and industry best practices. It annotates drawings and 3D models to identify errors and non-conformances, so you can bring a cleaner design to your first SME review.

Run virtual design reviews, so SMEs can flag risks earlier

Use CoLab to make CAD accessible in the browser, so anyone can explore the model and add feedback — without needing special tools or training. In live reviews, engineers see each other’s comments appear in real time, sparking better ideas and discussions.

Track and organize knowledge as a byproduct of reviews (not an extra step)

Feedback in CoLab is automatically saved with full design context and pulled into a structured database — so it’s easy to search, filter, and act on. You can also bring in data from PLM, ERP, and past reviews to create a single source of design knowledge across your tools.

Deploy AI agents trained on your organization's collective knowledge

With your product data and knowledge data together in one place for the first time, you can deploy agents that assist engineers at any phase of a program. CoLab’s first out-of-the-box agent finds similar designs and surfaces insights from past reviews on those designs, automating the traditional lessons learned process.

Connecting CoLab with PLM and CAD is fast, easy, and secure.

CoLab integrates with major PLM systems, including Windchill, Teamcenter, and 3DXPERIENCE. You can share CAD directly to CoLab from your PLM, maintaining critical data associations. Because CoLab accepts 30+ file types, it’s easy to review native CAD, even if you’re working with a supplier or customer that uses a different CAD tool.

Engineering teams are transforming how they work with CoLab

Still delaying design decisions by weeks, while you wait for that review meeting?

brief:
Product: Palisade
One-liner: AI-native sales agents that run marketplaces
Description: Palisade spins up a personal sales agent for every single visitor to your website. Marketplaces like trading card platforms, vintage stores, and short-term rental operators sell more when each customer works with a personal agent that remembers them.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Marketplace, Sales, E-commerce
target:
Agents that make markets.

Every user gets their own agent. It knows your catalog, learns what they want, and remembers them every time they come back. Every owner and seller gets one too. Your team sees the demand it was missing.

Live in production today

Dune Cottage

4 BR · oceanfront

Pelican Point

5 BR · pool

Saltgrass Villa

6 BR · pool + spa

3 BR · dune deck

Make your marketplace AI-native.

One install. A whole team of agents.

Buyers, sellers, and your own staff each get an agent wired into your real data: live catalog, real pricing, your CRM.

For every buyer

For owners & sellers

For your team

Your traffic is full of buyers you can't see.

Most visitors browse and leave without ever inquiring. There's nothing for a support tool to answer. Palisade reads real behavior, spots intent, opens the conversation at the right moment, and hands your team a lead with the whole story attached.

The other side of your market gets an agent too.

Owners and sellers stop deciphering dashboards. They ask their agent what the data means, like "why did I lose those weeks?", and get straight answers with proposals ready to go.

Your product gets smarter every day.

Agents remember every user: their searches, their taste, what they almost bought. That memory feeds personalization, standing watchers, and a stream of concrete improvements to your product.

No Two Users See the Same Site

Results, images, and pages reorder around what each user is looking for.

Watchers on Every Channel

Buyers rarely convert on the first visit. Agents set standing watchers for price drops, new inventory, and open dates, then follow up over SMS and email the moment it happens. Waiting becomes a conversion channel instead of a lost tab.

Every Agent Reports Back

Each agent reports what it learns from real customers: friction, missed searches, listings that lose the race. It proposes concrete fixes to your product, down to pull requests on your code. Nothing ships without your approval.

Start with one line of code.

One script tag and your site starts learning. We wire in the deep integrations ourselves: your booking engine, PMS, CRM, and catalog. No lift on your end.

Palisade

name: Papa
brief:
Product: Papa
One-liner: One-stop-shop for flexible family care
Description: Papa is a one-stop-shop for flexible family care, providing companionship and a helping hand wherever it’s needed. With wide-ranging industry, technology, and transformation experience, we share a vision for a world where no one has to go it alone. And a deep well of gratitude for the Papa People who move this vision forward.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare IT
Tags: Consumer Health Services, Digital Health
target:
Hi! We’re Papa.

We all need a pal sometimes. That’s why Papa’s here.

Papa connects members and their families to real people for help with companion care, everyday tasks, transportation, and more. It’s vital human connection, right to the front door.

Companion care

Papa Pals provide vital social support and companion care to strengthen families, help older adults remain connected, and support diverse communities—providing win-win benefits for all.

Promote independence

Reduce inequities

Cure loneliness

Improve outcomes

Lower costs

Increase satisfaction

Health Plans

Meet your members where they are with flexible support to assist older adults, other underserved populations, and families in overcoming social barriers to health and well-being. Dozens of health plans and employers work with Papa in a shared mission to help Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and Special Needs Health Plan members live and feel better.

Employers

Attract and retain talent with a whole-family benefit that lightens the load on family caregivers, fosters physical and mental health, and gives your team time back in the day. Papa is not another digital front door, we’re help right to the door.

Papa Pals

Get a flexible job you can feel good about, helping members of your community on your schedule while working (and earning) as much as you like. Learn how Papa Pals create healthy connections, one visit at a time.

Members

Get support for yourself or someone you love. Papa is support that feels like family—when, where, and how you want it.

Stephen and Marcel

In Unseen Connection, Papa member Stephen, who is visually impaired, shares how his Papa Pal Marcel, a retired Veteran, helps him overcome loneliness and social isolation through the power of human connection.

Jessica

After caring for her father who had ALS, Jessica was inspired to work as a Papa Pal. Caring for others has made her feel like she has family even when she’s away from her own.

Rafael & Connor

Rafael, a 79-year-old veteran who is fiercely independent, enjoys weekly conversations and companionship with his Papa Pal, Connor.

How it works

Available nationwide, in-person or by phone, Papa Pals offer a hand to help, a shoulder to lean on, and an ear to listen.

Confirm your eligibility and sign up in the way that works best for you.

name: F4 Industries
brief:
Product: F4 Industries
One-liner: The GD&T Analysis Platform for Engineering Drawings
Description: GD&T takes years to master. Engineers must encode their design intent into a dense syntax that manufacturers must decode, and not everyone gets it right. Put ten engineers in front of the same drawing and you may get ten different interpretations. Which means errors often surface later in interface stack-ups, manufacturing, or in the field - when they’re far more expensive to fix. That’s why we built F4 - the platform that analyzes GD&T to determine whether your designs are ready for production.
Industry: Industrials
Tags: Hardware, B2B, Industrial
target:
The Analysis Platform for Engineering Drawings

Compliance & registrations

See GD&T Issues Instantly.

GD&T errors should never delay your projects. F4 catches them before you release your designs.

The Most Advanced Drawing Analysis Platform

Let nothing slip through your review process.

1. Import

Drag and drop PDF and STEP files directly into F4 — processed locally, never uploaded.

2. Validate

Check your full design against the ASME Y14.5 Standard, using F4’s Drawing Validation Engine.

We detect hundreds of kinds of common GD&T errors — without using AI.

F4 gives designers more confidence in their drawings and saves many painstaking hours of review and redlining.

3. Analyze

F4 performs a wide range of engineering analyses to help you understand your design beyond simple syntax.

Redlined Drawing

Generate a redlined drawing that clearly summarizes your validation results and analysis for review and communication.

4. Export

F4 plugs back into your design and manufacturing workflows. Generate redlined drawings, along with exports for every downstream workflow.

Other export options

Project File

Share project files with teammates to communicate design intent.

Inspection Report

Save your detected PMI data in a template FAIR table (AS9102).

MBD Export

Migrate to MBD - straight from your drawings.

Find the best solution for you

name: Avoca Systems
brief:
Product: Avoca Systems
One-liner: The AI-powered operating system for radiology networks
Description: Avoca is the AI patient access platform built for radiology. It integrates with a network’s existing systems and operational knowledge to automate calls, online scheduling, faxes, e-referrals and patient communications, from referral through to results and follow-up. Unlike generic scheduling tools, Avoca understands the clinical, operational and resource constraints behind every radiology booking, helping providers capture more demand, reduce administrative work and fill more scan capacity.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Healthcare, Enterprise Software, Healthcare IT
target:
Operational intelligence for radiology networks

From answering calls to managing the full patient journey, Avoca encodes and optimises how your clinics operate, so no demand goes uncaptured.

Avoca has delivered a better experience for our clients. They now have a seamless pathway into booking. And for our staff, it means they can focus on the things that really matter. With Avoca, it just makes business easy.

Avoca doesn't just automate how your clinic runs, it optimises it

Capture every booking, scale without adding headcount, and keep patients coming back.

Capture every booking across all your channels

Every unanswered call and stalled referral is demand that never converts. Avoca handles every channel 24/7, including the complex radiology bookings other tools pass to a human.

Build an enduring relationship with your patients

Patients judge the whole journey, not just the scan. Avoca manages every touchpoint from referral to results, keeping patients informed and coming back.

Scale your network without scaling your headcount

Growing your network shouldn't mean hiring in proportion. Avoca builds clinic-specific intelligence across your entire network, so every site runs consistently without losing what makes it unique.

Embedded into the systems you already use

Avoca connects directly to your RIS and works within your existing radiology setup. Run it silently alongside your current workflows, or as your primary interface for patient access across the network.

How Jobfit scaled bookings without scaling its team

"The AI converted 30 bookings within half a day. Some of our top booking agents convert between 30 and 40 bookings in a full eight-hour day, so that's essentially worth two FTE."

The intelligence layer to scale radiology operations

Helping radiology networks book more patients, build lasting loyalty, and operate with intelligence across every step of the patient journey.

What Synder automates, so you don’t have to lift a finger

Automated data sync

Sales, fees, refunds, and taxes from 30+ platforms post to your ledger automatically as individual transactions with full SKU and customer detail, or as a daily, monthly, or payout-based summary per channel.

Streamlined reconciliation

Sync each sale, fee, refund, and tax to a clearing account, then reconcile both sides inside Synder. The matching engine flags discrepancies before month end, and every reconciled period is logged for audit.

Automated categorization

Set if-then rules by amount, vendor, description, or location – Synder assigns the right accounts, classes, and tax codes to every transaction as it syncs across all connected platforms.

GAAP-compliant revenue recognition for subscriptions

Synder builds ASC 606-compliant recognition schedules from Stripe data or an Excel upload, recognizes revenue monthly on the P&L, and tracks upgrades, cancellations, and prorations.

Enterprise-grade security

brief:
Product: Tarifflo Inc.
One-liner: Supply chain compliance and cost savings
Description: Tarifflo is the infrastructure layer for modern customs - AI-powered filing, tariff recovery, and customs intelligence on one platform. Filing should be free. Legacy ABI software charges you per entry, per user, per module. Brokers charge for every transaction. Tarifflo's filing software costs nothing - file directly with CBP under companies own filer codes. We make money when our clients do. 1 in 8 entries has an error that overpays duty - misclassification, tariff stacking, valuation, origin.
Industry: B2B / Supply Chain and Logistics
Tags: B2B, LegalTech, Supply Chain
target:

Proven Results

Real recovery. Real refunds. Real impact.

10,000+ Items Audited. Multiple Errors Found.

Our AI automatically scoured through over 10,000 items from this major beauty importer's previous shipments, searching for misclassifications that led to overpaid duties.

Simple process. Real refunds.

We contract a 3rd party broker to validate and file Post Summary Corrections.

Get refunds

CBP sends refunds directly to you. We only get paid after you do.

Why importers choose us

No upfront costs

Traditional consultants charge $250-500/hour plus filing fees. We charge nothing until you get refunds.

Comprehensive error detection

Our system identifies classification errors, rate stacking issues, and origin mistakes that manual reviews miss.

Proven expertise

Led by former Big 4 consultants and customs experts who've recovered millions in overpaid duties.

Your competitors are already recovering millions

Join them with zero risk. We only get paid when you do.

name: VantedgeAI
brief:
Product: VantedgeAI
One-liner: FundOS — AI operations for fund managers
Description: FundOS is the agentic operating system for fund managers. It replaces the manual "human glue" between a fund's systems with audit-logged AI agents — covenant monitoring, capital calls, diligence, recon, and reporting — running on the data funds already have, via MCP, with no migration. Dogfooded at Eight Capital, where FundOS runs a 270+ company YC portfolio off a single spine of data, auto-generating NAVs and K-1s. Clients include Semper Capital (London) and a New York asset manager.
Industry: Fintech / Banking and Exchange
Tags: Fintech, SaaS, Workflow Automation, Analytics, AI
target:
Your fund, continuously current.

Continuous fund operations

FundOS connects your books, LP records, portfolio data, documents, and workflows so AI agents reconcile, monitor, and prepare fund operations against current data. Your team approves every consequential action.

FundOS operating queue

Monday, 7:43 AM

Fundraise and source

LP CRM / DDQ / Deal screening

Execute and close

VDR / Transactions / Pricer

Operate and report

CFO / Risk / HF Ops / K-1s

Audit and communicate

Compliance / Evidence / LP reporting

The operating problem

Stop rebuilding the fund every reporting cycle.

The data already exists. It is scattered across the administrator, general ledger, prime broker, CRM, document rooms, inboxes, and spreadsheets. Your team spends its time turning fragments back into a fund.

Reconciliation before anyone can answer a position question.

LP reporting rebuilt from closed books and remembered exceptions.

Evidence assembled across systems before review can begin.

One governed context

From fragmented records to current operations.

FundOS connects the systems you already trust, resolves which record wins, and keeps each decision tied to its source. The fund becomes continuously usable, not periodically reconstructed.

Entities, source rules, calculations, obligations, and approvals stay connected.

Keep your stack

FundOS connects the systems already running your firm.

Where teams feel the difference

One operating context across the fund lifecycle.

Start with the work causing the most friction. Every workflow strengthens the same fund record.

Fund accounting and close

NAV, capital accounts, fees, expenses, waterfalls, and vehicle books connected to the underlying records.

Investor operations

Capital calls, distributions, statements, K-1 workflows, side letters, and LP responses from current data.

Portfolio and risk

Positions, covenants, exposure, borrowing bases, reconciliations, and exceptions as information arrives.

Fundraising and LP CRM

Meeting context, DDQs, follow-ups, consultant coverage, and investor materials connected to each relationship.

Deals and transactions

Screening, diligence, term sheets, closing conditions, syndication, and ownership without re-entering the deal.

Compliance and audit

Controls tested against actual books, positions, investor records, and governing documents.

Governed agentic work

Agents prepare. Your team decides.

FundOS agents do more than answer questions. They prepare real work against current fund data and show their reasoning before anything moves.

Agent assembled the notice from approved commitment and cash requirement records.

LPA, subscription records, approved budget, and investor wiring instructions.

Operations lead confirmed amount, due date, and LP population.

Awaiting authorized signatory approval. Nothing has been sent.

Security and trust

Fund-grade controls are part of the operating surface.

brief:

Description: Video Text Remover: AI-powered tool to erase text, captions, and subtitles from any video. 30 free credits, no credit card required.
target:
Video Text Remover

Our video text remover erases text, captions, and subtitles from any video with AI-powered background reconstruction. Clean, blur‑free results in minutes — 30 free credits, no credit card required.

Drop or choose a video

Supports MP4, MOV, WEBM

ODDLY SATISFYING

GLASS PINEAPPLE CUT

Crystal slices. Zero cleanup.

30 free credits to start — no credit card required.

Four ways to clean your footage

Pick the workflow that matches your overlay — text, logos, subtitles, or watermarks. Each tool runs in your browser with AI background reconstruction.

Erase burned-in text, captions, timestamps, and labels. Auto-detect the subtitle band or draw boxes over any on-screen text — AI rebuilds the background behind it.

Formats : MP4, MOV, WebM

Remove Logo from Video

Clean corner watermarks, channel logos, TikTok marks, and stock preview stamps. Auto logo libraries or manual box selection for custom overlays.

Formats : MP4

Remove Captions & Subtitles

Strip hardcoded subtitles and captions that cannot be turned off. Box the subtitle strip and download a clean clip without blur or crop.

Remove Watermark from Video

Stock preview marks, TikTok stamps, screen recorder logos, and app export watermarks — box the mark and download a clean clip. AI rebuilds the background behind the watermark on every frame.

Three steps to a clean video

Upload, let AI remove text and reconstruct the background, then download — no watermark, no install.

Upload Your Video

Drag and drop your MP4, MOV, or WebM file into the upload box above. Our video text remover handles files up to 500MB and works entirely in your browser — no software to install, no plugins, no hassle. Pick your video and we take care of the rest.

AI Detects & Removes Text

Our AI scans every frame, identifies text regions — burned‑in subtitles, TikTok captions, timestamp overlays, or watermarks — and reconstructs the background behind them. No blur. No ghosting. No patchy artifacts. That's the difference between a real video text remover and a basic editing trick.

Download, No Watermark

Once processing finishes, download your video in the original resolution and frame rate. No watermark added. No compression. Your 30 free credits are available immediately — use them on any video, any format, no strings attached.
